e.en: She was {able} to finish the marathon despite the heat.
e.zh: 尽管天气炎热,她还是顺利跑完了马拉松。

e.en: He's a highly {able} engineer with a decade of experience.
e.zh: 他是一位非常能干的工程师,有十年的经验。

ablution.t: n. 沐浴；净身（宗教仪式）

e.en: Many religions require {ablution} before entering a sacred space.
e.zh: 许多宗教都要求在进入圣地之前进行净礼。

e.en: He performed his morning {ablution} and got dressed quickly.
e.zh: 他做完晨间盥洗后迅速穿好衣服。

e.en: The new manager handled the crisis {ably} and calmly.
e.zh: 新经理沉着干练地处理了这场危机。

e.en: She {ably} defended her thesis before the review committee.
e.zh: 她在评审委员会面前出色地为自己的论文答辩。

e.en: The treaty restricted the deployment of {ABM} systems on both sides.
e.zh: 该条约限制了双方反弹道导弹系统的部署。

e.en: Engineers tested a new {ABM} radar in the desert.
e.zh: 工程师在沙漠中测试了一种新的反导雷达。

abnegate.t: v. 放弃；克制（权利或欲望）

e.en: Monks {abnegate} worldly pleasures in pursuit of spiritual growth.
e.zh: 僧侣们放弃世俗享乐以追求精神成长。

e.en: She refused to {abnegate} her responsibilities to the team.
e.zh: 她拒绝放弃自己对团队应尽的责任。

e.en: His life of {abnegation} inspired many of his followers.
e.zh: 他自我克制的一生激励了众多追随者。

e.en: True charity often requires complete {abnegation} of selfish desires.
e.zh: 真正的慈善往往需要彻底放下自私的欲望。

e.en: The blood test came back showing {abnormal} cholesterol levels.
e.zh: 血液检测结果显示胆固醇水平异常。

e.en: It's {abnormal} for the river to freeze this early.
e.zh: 这条河这么早结冰是不正常的。

e.en: The scan detected a small {abnormality} in the patient's lung.
e.zh: 扫描在患者肺部发现了一处小小的异常。

e.en: Engineers traced the system failure to a software {abnormality}.
e.zh: 工程师将系统故障追溯到一个软件异常。

e.en: Temperatures have been {abnormally} high for this time of year.
e.zh: 今年这个时节的气温异常偏高。

e.en: The website is loading {abnormally} slowly this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上网站加载得异常缓慢。

abo.t: n. 澳洲土著（aboriginal 的蔑称，慎用）

e.en: Doctors checked her {ABO} blood type before the transfusion.
e.zh: 在输血前,医生检查了她的ABO血型。

e.en: The {ABO} system classifies blood into four main groups.
e.zh: ABO系统将血液分为四个主要类型。

aboard.t:
adv. 上（车、船、飞机）
prep. 在（车、船、飞机）上

e.en: All passengers should now be {aboard} the train.
e.zh: 所有乘客现在都应该已经上车了。

e.en: Welcome {aboard} our team — we're thrilled to have you!
e.zh: 欢迎加入我们的团队,有你加入我们非常高兴!

e.en: Please update your current {abode} on the registration form.
e.zh: 请在登记表上更新您目前的住址。

e.en: The cabin became their humble {abode} for the summer.
e.zh: 那间小木屋成了他们整个夏天简朴的居所。

abolish.t: v. 废除；废止（制度、法律）

e.en: Activists are campaigning to {abolish} unfair tipping practices.
e.zh: 维权人士正在发起运动,以废除不公平的小费惯例。

e.en: The new government promised to {abolish} the unpopular tax.
e.zh: 新政府承诺废除这项不受欢迎的税收。

abolished.t: v. 已废除（abolish 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The country {abolished} the death penalty in 1998.
e.zh: 该国于1998年废除了死刑。

e.en: Many companies have {abolished} the traditional five-day office week.
e.zh: 许多公司已经废除了传统的每周五天到岗制度。

abolishes.t: v. 废除（abolish 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This bill effectively {abolishes} all remaining tariffs on imports.
e.zh: 该法案实际上废除了所有剩余的进口关税。

e.en: The new policy {abolishes} mandatory overtime for hourly employees.
e.zh: 新政策取消了对小时工的强制加班规定。

abolishing.t: v. 废除（abolish 的现在分词）

e.en: The city is considering {abolishing} parking fees on weekends.
e.zh: 该市正在考虑取消周末的停车费。

e.en: {Abolishing} child labor remains a global priority for many NGOs.
e.zh: 消除童工依然是许多非政府组织的全球首要任务。

e.en: The {abolishment} of slavery transformed the nation's economy and society.
e.zh: 废除奴隶制改变了国家的经济与社会面貌。

e.en: Many citizens support the {abolishment} of outdated regulations.
e.zh: 许多公民支持废除过时的规章制度。

e.en: The {abolition} of slavery transformed American society forever.
e.zh: 废除奴隶制永远地改变了美国社会。

e.en: Many activists are calling for the {abolition} of the death penalty.
e.zh: 许多活动人士呼吁废除死刑。

e.en: {Abolitionism} gained momentum in the early nineteenth century.
e.zh: 废奴主义在十九世纪初获得了发展势头。

e.en: Her grandfather was a leading voice in {abolitionism}.
e.zh: 她的祖父是废奴运动中的重要声音。

e.en: Frederick Douglass was a famous {abolitionist} and author.
e.zh: 弗雷德里克·道格拉斯是著名的废奴主义者和作家。

e.en: The {abolitionist} movement spread quickly across the northern states.
e.zh: 废奴运动迅速在北方各州蔓延开来。

abominable.t: adj. 糟透的；令人憎恶的

e.en: The hotel served an {abominable} breakfast that nobody finished.
e.zh: 酒店供应的早餐糟糕透顶,没人吃完。

e.en: His behavior at the meeting was simply {abominable}.
e.zh: 他在会议上的行为简直令人厌恶。

e.en: The team played {abominably} in the second half.
e.zh: 球队下半场表现糟糕透顶。

e.en: He treated his employees {abominably} for years.
e.zh: 多年来他对员工的态度极其恶劣。

e.en: I {abominate} cruelty toward animals in any form.
e.zh: 我憎恶任何形式的虐待动物行为。

e.en: Critics {abominate} the new policy as deeply unjust.
e.zh: 批评人士憎恶这项新政策,认为它极不公正。

abomination.t: n. 令人厌恶之物；憎恶

e.en: The new building is an architectural {abomination}.
e.zh: 那栋新建筑在建筑学上简直是个怪物。

e.en: Many viewers called the film an {abomination}.
e.zh: 许多观众称这部电影是部烂作。

aboriginal.t:
adj. 原住民的；土著的
n. 原住民

e.en: The museum displays {aboriginal} artwork from across Australia.
e.zh: 博物馆展出来自澳大利亚各地的原住民艺术品。

e.en: Researchers studied the {aboriginal} languages of the region.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了该地区的原住民语言。

aboriginals.t: n. 原住民（aboriginal 的复数）

e.en: The {aboriginals} of this land have lived here for millennia.
e.zh: 这片土地上的原住民已经在此生活了数千年。

e.en: Local {aboriginals} guided the explorers through the dense forest.
e.zh: 当地原住民带领探险者穿过茂密的森林。

e.en: An Australian {aborigine} taught the visitors traditional songs.
e.zh: 一位澳大利亚原住民教来访者唱传统歌曲。

e.en: The {aborigine} elder shared stories about the dreamtime.
e.zh: 那位原住民长者分享了关于梦创时代的故事。

aborigines.t: n. 原住民（aborigine 的复数）

e.en: The {aborigines} have rich oral storytelling traditions.
e.zh: 原住民拥有丰富的口述故事传统。

e.en: Australian {aborigines} painted symbols on cave walls.
e.zh: 澳大利亚原住民在洞穴壁上绘制符号。

abort.t: v. 中止（操作、任务）；流产

e.en: You can {abort} the download by pressing Ctrl+C.
e.zh: 你可以按 Ctrl+C 终止下载。

e.en: Mission control decided to {abort} the launch due to weather.
e.zh: 任务指挥中心因天气原因决定中止发射。

aborted.t: v. 已中止（abort 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The script {aborted} when it ran out of memory.
e.zh: 脚本因内存耗尽而中断了。

e.en: Pilots {aborted} the landing after spotting debris on the runway.
e.zh: 飞行员发现跑道上有碎片后中止了着陆。

abortifacient.t:
n. 堕胎药
adj. 引起流产的

e.en: The pharmacist refused to dispense the {abortifacient} medication.
e.zh: 那位药剂师拒绝配发这种堕胎药物。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the herb had {abortifacient} properties.
e.zh: 研究人员争论这种草药是否具有引产作用。

e.en: The court's ruling reshaped {abortion} laws across the country.
e.zh: 法院的裁决重塑了全国的堕胎法律。

e.en: Access to safe {abortion} remains a contested political issue.
e.zh: 获得安全堕胎仍是一个有争议的政治议题。

e.en: In the past, an unlicensed {abortionist} risked imprisonment.
e.zh: 过去,无证从事堕胎手术的人面临入狱风险。

e.en: Critics labeled the doctor an {abortionist} despite his licensed practice.
e.zh: 尽管那位医生持有合法执照,批评者仍称他为堕胎医生。

e.en: The clinic provides safe and legal {abortions} for patients.
e.zh: 该诊所为患者提供安全合法的堕胎服务。

e.en: New legislation restricts {abortions} after twelve weeks.
e.zh: 新立法限制怀孕十二周后的堕胎。

e.en: The startup made an {abortive} attempt to enter the Asian market.
e.zh: 那家初创公司进军亚洲市场的尝试以失败告终。

e.en: Their {abortive} coup left the regime more powerful than before.
e.zh: 他们失败的政变反而让政权变得更加强大。

e.en: Rumors {abound} about the company's upcoming product launch.
e.zh: 关于该公司即将发布新品的传言满天飞。

e.en: Wildflowers {abound} in the meadow every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天草地上开满了野花。

abounded.t: v. 曾大量存在（abound 的过去式）

e.en: The forest {abounded} with deer and wild rabbits.
e.zh: 森林里到处是鹿和野兔。

e.en: Opportunities {abounded} for young engineers in the booming industry.
e.zh: 在蓬勃发展的行业里,年轻工程师机会无穷。

e.en: The garden was {abounding} with butterflies that summer.
e.zh: 那年夏天花园里到处是蝴蝶。

e.en: She wrote a memoir {abounding} in colorful anecdotes.
e.zh: 她写了一本充满精彩轶事的回忆录。

abounds.t: v. 大量存在（abound 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Talent {abounds} in this small coastal town.
e.zh: 这个海边小镇人才辈出。

e.en: Misinformation {abounds} on social media platforms today.
e.zh: 如今社交媒体平台上充斥着错误信息。

about.t:
prep. 关于；大约
adv. 大约；到处

e.en: The documentary is {about} climate change in the Arctic.
e.zh: 这部纪录片讲的是北极气候变化。

e.en: There are {about} fifty people waiting outside the venue.
e.zh: 场馆外大约有五十个人在等候。

above.t:
prep. 在…上方；超过
adv. 在上面

e.en: A small drone hovered {above} the crowded stadium.
e.zh: 一架小无人机在拥挤的体育场上空盘旋。

e.en: His test score was well {above} the class average.
e.zh: 他的考试成绩远高于班级平均水平。

aboveboard.t: adj. 光明正大的；坦率的

e.en: All her business dealings have been completely {aboveboard}.
e.zh: 她所有的商业往来都光明正大。

e.en: The negotiations were {aboveboard} and fully documented.
e.zh: 谈判公开透明,并有完整记录。

abracadabra.t: n. 魔法咒语（变魔术时用）

e.en: The magician shouted "{abracadabra}!" and pulled out a rabbit.
e.zh: 魔术师喊了一声“阿布拉卡达布拉!”然后变出一只兔子。

e.en: With a wave and an "{abracadabra}," the coin disappeared.
e.zh: 挥手之间一句“阿布拉卡达布拉”,硬币就消失了。

e.en: Sandpaper will {abrade} the surface before painting.
e.zh: 砂纸会在上漆前打磨表面。

e.en: Constant friction can {abrade} even the toughest metals.
e.zh: 持续的摩擦可以磨损即便最坚硬的金属。

abraded.t: v. 已磨损（abrade 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The rope had {abraded} the climber's gloves badly.
e.zh: 绳索把攀登者的手套磨损得很严重。

e.en: Wind and sand had {abraded} the ancient stone carvings.
e.zh: 风沙磨损了古老的石雕。

abraham.t: n. 亚伯拉罕（人名；圣经人物）

e.en: {Abraham} Lincoln remains one of America's most studied presidents.
e.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯至今仍是美国被研究最多的总统之一。

e.en: The story of {Abraham} appears in three major world religions.
e.zh: 亚伯拉罕的故事出现在三大世界宗教中。

abrahamic.t: adj. 亚伯拉罕的（三大一神教的共同源头）

e.en: Judaism, Christianity, and Islam are the major {Abrahamic} religions.
e.zh: 犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教是主要的亚伯拉罕诸教。

e.en: The conference brought together leaders from {Abrahamic} faith traditions.
e.zh: 会议汇集了亚伯拉罕信仰传统的各位领袖。

e.en: Harold {Abrahams} won the 100-meter sprint at the 1924 Olympics.
e.zh: 哈罗德·阿布拉罕斯在1924年奥运会上赢得了百米短跑冠军。

e.en: Several {Abrahams} appear in our company's old employee records.
e.zh: 我们公司旧员工记录中出现过几位阿布拉罕斯。

abrams.t: n. 艾布拉姆斯（姓氏；M1 主战坦克）

e.en: J.J. {Abrams} directed several blockbuster science fiction films.
e.zh: J.J. 艾布拉姆斯执导了多部科幻大片。

e.en: The army deployed {Abrams} tanks to support the operation.
e.zh: 军队部署了艾布拉姆斯坦克来支援行动。

e.en: Two senators chose to {abstain} from the controversial vote.
e.zh: 两名参议员选择在那次争议表决中弃权。

e.en: Doctors advised him to {abstain} from alcohol for a month.
e.zh: 医生建议他一个月内不要喝酒。

e.en: As a lifelong {abstainer}, she never touches a drop.
e.zh: 作为终身戒酒者,她滴酒不沾。

e.en: The committee had one yes, one no, one {abstainer}.
e.zh: 委员会的表决是一票赞成、一票反对、一票弃权。

e.en: His {abstemious} diet consists mostly of vegetables and water.
e.zh: 他饮食节制,几乎只吃蔬菜和喝水。

e.en: She lived an {abstemious} life devoted to her studies.
e.zh: 她过着克己自律的生活,专心于学业。

e.en: The motion passed with twelve votes and one {abstention}.
e.zh: 该动议以十二票赞成、一票弃权获得通过。

e.en: His {abstention} from sweets surprised everyone at the party.
e.zh: 他在派对上不碰甜食,让大家都很意外。

e.en: The monk's {abstentious} habits included skipping the evening meal.
e.zh: 那位僧人节制的习惯之一是不吃晚饭。

e.en: Her {abstentious} approach to social media restored her focus.
e.zh: 她对社交媒体的克制使用让她重新找回了专注。

e.en: Total {abstinence} from alcohol is hard but sometimes necessary.
e.zh: 完全戒酒虽然艰难,但有时是必要的。

e.en: The program promotes {abstinence} as one option among many.
e.zh: 该项目把禁欲作为众多选择之一加以推广。

e.en: He has stayed {abstinent} from gambling for five years.
e.zh: 他已经五年没碰过赌博了。

e.en: The clinic supports patients trying to remain {abstinent} long-term.
e.zh: 诊所帮助患者长期保持戒断状态。

abstract.t:
adj. 抽象的
n. 摘要

e.en: Quantum physics involves many {abstract} concepts that defy intuition.
e.zh: 量子物理涉及许多违反直觉的抽象概念。

e.en: Please write an {abstract} summarizing your research in 200 words.
e.zh: 请用200字撰写一篇概括你研究的摘要。

abstracted.t: adj. 心不在焉的；出神的

e.en: She seemed {abstracted} during dinner, barely touching her food.
e.zh: 她吃晚饭时心不在焉,几乎没动食物。

e.en: The data was {abstracted} from thousands of patient records.
e.zh: 这些数据是从数千份病历中提取出来的。

e.en: He stared {abstractedly} out the window during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时他出神地望着窗外。

e.en: She tapped her pen {abstractedly} while pondering the problem.
e.zh: 她一边思考问题一边出神地敲着笔。

e.en: Good software design relies on the right level of {abstraction}.
e.zh: 优秀的软件设计依赖于恰当的抽象层次。

e.en: Justice felt like an {abstraction} until it directly affected her.
e.zh: 正义在切身相关之前,对她来说只是个抽象概念。

e.en: The {abstractionist} painter rejected any hint of realism.
e.zh: 那位抽象派画家拒绝任何写实的痕迹。

e.en: Her {abstractionist} sculptures fill the museum's east wing.
e.zh: 她的抽象派雕塑摆满了博物馆的东翼。

e.en: Programmers build powerful systems by stacking layers of {abstractions}.
e.zh: 程序员通过堆叠多层抽象来构建强大的系统。

e.en: Children grasp concrete examples before they handle pure {abstractions}.
e.zh: 孩子先掌握具体例子,然后才能理解纯抽象概念。

e.en: He talks {abstractly} about freedom without giving any examples.
e.zh: 他抽象地谈论自由,却不举任何实例。

e.en: It's easier to think {abstractly} once you've seen real cases.
e.zh: 看过真实案例后,抽象思考会更容易。

e.en: The {abstractness} of the lecture lost half the audience.
e.zh: 讲座过于抽象,让一半听众跟不上。

e.en: Mathematics rewards those comfortable with high levels of {abstractness}.
e.zh: 数学会回报那些能接受高度抽象的人。

e.en: The professor's {abstruse} arguments confused even the graduate students.
e.zh: 教授晦涩的论证连研究生都听糊涂了。

e.en: The manual is full of {abstruse} jargon nobody understands.
e.zh: 这本手册满是没人看得懂的晦涩术语。

e.en: It's {absurd} to expect perfect grammar in a casual chat.
e.zh: 在闲聊中期待完美语法实在太荒唐了。

e.en: The price for that tiny apartment is completely {absurd}.
e.zh: 那间小公寓的价格简直离谱到家了。

absurdist.t:
adj. 荒诞派的
n. 荒诞派作家

e.en: The play is a classic example of {absurdist} theater.
e.zh: 这部戏是荒诞派戏剧的经典之作。

e.en: Her {absurdist} memes have built a huge online following.
e.zh: 她那些荒诞风格的迷因吸引了大量网友关注。

e.en: He laughed at the {absurdity} of his own mistake.
e.zh: 他对自己荒唐的错误忍不住笑了出来。

e.en: The novel exposes the {absurdity} of modern bureaucracy.
e.zh: 这部小说揭示了现代官僚体制的荒谬。

e.en: The rent has become {absurdly} expensive in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 这个街区的房租已经贵得离谱。

e.en: He answered the question {absurdly}, making everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他回答得很荒唐，把大家都逗笑了。

abta.t: n. 英国旅行代理商协会

e.en: Always book your holiday through an {ABTA}-registered travel agent.
e.zh: 度假一定要通过 ABTA 注册的旅行社预订。

e.en: The agency lost its {ABTA} membership after multiple complaints.
e.zh: 该旅行社因多次投诉被取消了 ABTA 会员资格。

abu.t: n. 阿布（阿拉伯人名/地名前缀）

e.en: We landed in {Abu} Dhabi after a long flight.
e.zh: 经过长途飞行，我们降落在阿布扎比。

e.en: {Abu} is a common given name across the Arab world.
e.zh: 阿布在阿拉伯世界是个常见的名字。

e.en: The garden produced an {abundance} of tomatoes this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天这个花园产出了大量西红柿。

e.en: She approaches life with an {abundance} of optimism.
e.zh: 她以满满的乐观态度面对生活。

e.en: Scientists measured the {abundances} of various elements in the rock.
e.zh: 科学家们测量了岩石中各种元素的丰度。

e.en: Different species show seasonal {abundances} in this forest.
e.zh: 这片森林里不同物种的数量随季节变化。

e.en: There is {abundant} evidence that exercise improves mental health.
e.zh: 有大量证据表明运动能改善心理健康。

e.en: Solar energy is {abundant} in desert regions.
e.zh: 在沙漠地区太阳能十分丰富。

e.en: It is {abundantly} clear that the policy isn't working.
e.zh: 非常明显，这项政策并没有奏效。

e.en: Wildflowers grow {abundantly} along the mountain trail.
e.zh: 野花在山间小径旁茂盛地生长。

e.en: The company was fined for {abuse} of customer data.
e.zh: 该公司因滥用客户数据而被罚款。

e.en: Please don't {abuse} the free trial system.
e.zh: 请不要滥用免费试用系统。

abused.t: adj. 被虐待的；被滥用的

e.en: He {abused} his position to get cheaper deals.
e.zh: 他利用职权之便为自己谋取更低价的交易。

e.en: The shelter helps animals that have been {abused}.
e.zh: 这家收容所帮助曾遭受虐待的动物。

e.en: The platform banned the {abuser} after several complaints.
e.zh: 平台在收到多次投诉后封禁了那个滥用者。

e.en: Recovery programs help both victims and the {abuser} heal.
e.zh: 康复项目帮助受害者和施暴者共同走出阴影。

abuses.t: n./v. 滥用；虐待（复数/三单）

e.en: The report documented serious human rights {abuses}.
e.zh: 该报告记录了严重的人权侵害行为。

e.en: He routinely {abuses} the company's expense policy.
e.zh: 他经常滥用公司的报销制度。

abusing.t: v. 滥用；虐待（现在分词）

e.en: Stop {abusing} the chat feature with spam messages.
e.zh: 不要再用垃圾信息滥用聊天功能了。

e.en: He was caught {abusing} prescription painkillers.
e.zh: 他被发现在滥用处方止痛药。

e.en: She finally left the {abusive} relationship last year.
e.zh: 她去年终于离开了那段充满虐待的关系。

e.en: Users can report {abusive} comments with one click.
e.zh: 用户可以一键举报辱骂性评论。

e.en: He spoke {abusively} to the customer service agent.
e.zh: 他对客服人员说话十分粗暴无礼。

e.en: The manager behaved {abusively} toward junior staff.
e.zh: 那位经理对下属员工态度恶劣。

e.en: The {abusiveness} of his messages got him banned.
e.zh: 他消息中的辱骂内容导致他被封号。

e.en: Coworkers complained about the boss's constant {abusiveness}.
e.zh: 同事们抱怨老板一贯的恶劣态度。

e.en: Our backyard {abuts} the neighbor's wooden fence.
e.zh: 我们的后院紧挨着邻居家的木栅栏。

e.en: The two buildings {abut} along the alley.
e.zh: 两栋楼沿着小巷紧贴在一起。

e.en: Engineers inspected the bridge {abutment} for cracks.
e.zh: 工程师检查了桥台是否有裂缝。

e.en: The {abutment} supports the weight of the entire span.
e.zh: 这个桥台支撑着整个跨距的重量。

e.en: The app's user reviews have been {abysmal} this month.
e.zh: 这款应用本月的用户评价糟糕透顶。

e.en: Service at the restaurant was {abysmal} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那家餐厅的服务差得不能再差。

e.en: The startup performed {abysmally} in its first quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司第一季度表现糟糕至极。

e.en: He failed {abysmally} on the certification exam.
e.zh: 他在认证考试中惨败收场。

e.en: Staring into the {abyss}, she felt strangely calm.
e.zh: 凝视着深渊，她却感到异常平静。

e.en: The economy is teetering on the edge of an {abyss}.
e.zh: 经济正摇摇欲坠地处于深渊边缘。

e.en: Strange creatures live in the {abyssal} zone of the ocean.
e.zh: 海洋深渊带里生活着各种奇异的生物。

e.en: The submarine descended to {abyssal} depths to collect samples.
e.zh: 潜艇下潜到深海采集样本。

abyssinia.t: n. 阿比西尼亚（埃塞俄比亚旧称）

e.en: {Abyssinia} is the historical name for modern Ethiopia.
e.zh: 阿比西尼亚是现代埃塞俄比亚的旧称。

e.en: Coffee was first cultivated in ancient {Abyssinia}.
e.zh: 咖啡最早在古代阿比西尼亚被栽培。

abyssinian.t:
adj. 阿比西尼亚的
n. 阿比西尼亚猫

e.en: Her {Abyssinian} cat is curious and surprisingly playful.
e.zh: 她的阿比西尼亚猫好奇心强，出奇地爱玩。

e.en: The museum displays ancient {Abyssinian} manuscripts and crosses.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了古阿比西尼亚的手稿和十字架。

aca.t: n. ACA（多义缩写，如特许会计师）

e.en: Millions gained insurance coverage under the {ACA}.
e.zh: 数百万人通过《平价医疗法案》获得了保险。

e.en: The {ACA} expanded access to preventive healthcare services.
e.zh: 《平价医疗法案》扩大了预防性医疗服务的覆盖范围。

e.en: Giraffes feed on the leaves of tall {acacia} trees.
e.zh: 长颈鹿以高大的金合欢树叶为食。

e.en: The yellow {acacia} blossoms perfumed the entire garden.
e.zh: 金黄的金合欢花让整个花园都飘着香气。

e.en: After ten years in industry, she returned to {academe}.
e.zh: 在业界工作十年后，她回到了学术界。

e.en: He spent his entire career within the walls of {academe}.
e.zh: 他的整个职业生涯都在学术界中度过。

e.en: Many PhDs leave {academia} for higher-paying tech jobs.
e.zh: 许多博士离开学术界，转向薪酬更高的科技行业。

e.en: Publishing pressure in {academia} keeps growing every year.
e.zh: 学术界的发表压力每年都在不断增加。

academic.t:
adj. 学术的
n. 学者

e.en: Her {academic} record earned her a full scholarship.
e.zh: 她的学术成绩为她赢得了全额奖学金。

e.en: That debate is purely {academic} at this point.
e.zh: 事到如今那场争论纯粹是纸上谈兵了。

e.en: Graduates wore traditional {academical} robes during the ceremony.
e.zh: 毕业生在典礼上穿着传统的学位袍。

e.en: The college maintains strict {academical} standards for admission.
e.zh: 该学院在招生方面保持着严格的学术标准。

e.en: She has always performed well {academically}, even under pressure.
e.zh: 即使在压力之下，她在学业上始终表现优异。

e.en: The argument is interesting {academically}, but impractical in real life.
e.zh: 这个论点在学术上很有趣，但在现实中不切实际。

e.en: The journalist was {abducted} while reporting from a war zone.
e.zh: 那名记者在战区采访时遭到绑架。

e.en: She claimed she was {abducted} by aliens, but no one believed her.
e.zh: 她声称自己被外星人绑架，但没人相信。

e.en: The {abductee} was finally rescued after three days in captivity.
e.zh: 那名被绑架者在被囚禁三天后终于获救。

e.en: Counselors offered support to every {abductee} after their return.
e.zh: 咨询师为每位获救者归来后提供心理支持。

e.en: The {abduction} of the diplomat made international headlines.
e.zh: 那位外交官被绑架的消息登上了国际头条。

e.en: Police are investigating the {abduction} of a young child.
e.zh: 警方正在调查一名幼童遭绑架的案件。

e.en: The {abductor} was caught at a roadblock outside the city.
e.zh: 绑架者在城外的路障处被抓获。

e.en: Detectives released a sketch of the suspected {abductor}.
e.zh: 侦探们公布了嫌疑绑架者的素描画像。

e.en: He stayed {abed} all morning nursing a terrible cold.
e.zh: 他因重感冒整个上午都卧床休息。

e.en: The children were already {abed} when their father came home.
e.zh: 父亲回家时孩子们已经上床睡觉了。

abercrombie.t: n. 阿伯克龙比（姓氏/品牌）

e.en: She bought a hoodie at {Abercrombie} during the weekend sale.
e.zh: 她周末打折时在Abercrombie买了一件连帽衫。

e.en: The mall's new {Abercrombie} store opened with long lines.
e.zh: 商场新开的Abercrombie门店开业当天排起了长队。

e.en: We hiked through the mist of the {Aberdare} mountains in Kenya.
e.zh: 我们在肯尼亚阿伯德尔山的雾气中徒步。

e.en: The {Aberdare} National Park is home to elephants and leopards.
e.zh: 阿伯德尔国家公园是大象和豹子的家园。

aberdeen.t: n. 阿伯丁（苏格兰城市）

e.en: {Aberdeen} is known as the granite city of Scotland.
e.zh: 阿伯丁被誉为苏格兰的花岗岩之城。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Aberdeen} to work in the oil industry.
e.zh: 我表哥搬到阿伯丁从事石油行业的工作。

e.en: {Aberdeenshire} has some of Scotland's most beautiful coastal cliffs.
e.zh: 阿伯丁郡拥有苏格兰一些最美的海岸悬崖。

e.en: They own a small farm in rural {Aberdeenshire}.
e.zh: 他们在阿伯丁郡乡下拥有一个小农场。

abergavenny.t: n. 阿伯加文尼（威尔士地名）

e.en: We took a weekend trip to {Abergavenny} in Wales.
e.zh: 我们周末去了威尔士的阿伯加文尼。

e.en: The {Abergavenny} food festival attracts thousands of visitors each year.
e.zh: 阿伯加文尼美食节每年吸引数千名游客。

abernethy.t: n. 阿伯内西（姓氏/地名）

e.en: Grandma served tea with a plate of {Abernethy} biscuits.
e.zh: 奶奶端上茶,还配了一盘阿伯内西饼干。

e.en: Dr. {Abernethy} published a paper on digestive health.
e.zh: 阿伯内西医生发表了一篇关于消化健康的论文。

e.en: The scan revealed {aberrant} cells in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 扫描在组织样本中发现了异常细胞。

e.en: His {aberrant} behavior surprised everyone at the meeting.
e.zh: 他反常的行为让会上每个人都很惊讶。

e.en: Last week's loss was just an {aberration} for the team.
e.zh: 上周的失利对球队来说只是一次反常表现。

e.en: The telescope corrects for chromatic {aberration} in the lens.
e.zh: 这架望远镜可以校正镜片的色差。

aberrational.t: adj. 反常的；偏离常态的

e.en: Analysts dismissed the spike as {aberrational} market noise.
e.zh: 分析师认为这次暴涨只是异常的市场波动。

e.en: Her calm reaction was {aberrational} given the stressful situation.
e.zh: 在如此紧张的情境下,她的冷静反应实属反常。

e.en: The data showed several {aberrations} worth investigating further.
e.zh: 数据中出现了几处值得深入调查的异常。

e.en: Statistical {aberrations} can mislead investors who chase short-term trends.
e.zh: 统计上的异常可能误导追逐短期趋势的投资者。

aberystwyth.t: n. 阿伯里斯特威斯（威尔士城镇）

e.en: She studied marine biology at {Aberystwyth} University.
e.zh: 她在阿伯里斯特威斯大学学习海洋生物学。

e.en: The train ride to {Aberystwyth} hugs the Welsh coast.
e.zh: 开往阿伯里斯特威斯的火车沿着威尔士海岸行驶。

e.en: He was charged with helping to {abet} the robbery.
e.zh: 他被控协助教唆这起抢劫案。

e.en: Social media can {abet} the spread of misinformation online.
e.zh: 社交媒体可能助长虚假信息在网上的传播。

e.en: The merger plan was held in {abeyance} during the investigation.
e.zh: 调查期间,合并计划被暂时搁置。

e.en: Construction remains in {abeyance} until the permits are approved.
e.zh: 在许可证批准之前,施工一直处于暂停状态。

e.en: Many readers {abhor} spoilers in movie reviews.
e.zh: 许多读者非常讨厌影评里出现剧透。

e.en: I {abhor} any form of cruelty toward animals.
e.zh: 我憎恶任何形式的虐待动物行为。

e.en: She {abhorred} the dishonest tactics used by her competitors.
e.zh: 她憎恶竞争对手所使用的不诚实手段。

e.en: The dictator was {abhorred} by citizens across the country.
e.zh: 这位独裁者遭到全国民众的憎恨。

e.en: He expressed his {abhorrence} of violence in a public statement.
e.zh: 他在公开声明中表达了对暴力的憎恶。

e.en: Her {abhorrence} for waste shaped her zero-trash lifestyle.
e.zh: 她对浪费的厌恶塑造了她零垃圾的生活方式。

abhorrent.t: adj. 可憎的；令人厌恶的

e.en: The committee found the comments deeply {abhorrent} and offensive.
e.zh: 委员会认为这些言论极其令人憎恶且具冒犯性。

e.en: Cheating on exams is {abhorrent} to most honest students.
e.zh: 考试作弊对大多数诚实的学生来说都是可憎的。

abhorrently.t: adv. 可憎地；令人厌恶地

e.en: The staff acted {abhorrently} toward the elderly residents.
e.zh: 工作人员对老年住户的行为令人憎恶。

e.en: He spoke {abhorrently} about minorities, sparking immediate backlash.
e.zh: 他用令人憎恶的言论谈论少数群体,立刻引发了强烈反弹。

e.en: While {abhorring} violence, she still supported the right to protest.
e.zh: 虽然憎恶暴力,她仍然支持抗议的权利。

e.en: He grew up {abhorring} the corruption he saw in politics.
e.zh: 他在憎恶政治腐败的环境中长大。

abhors.t: v. 憎恶（第三人称单数）

e.en: Nature {abhors} a vacuum, as the old saying goes.
e.zh: 俗话说,自然厌恶真空。

e.en: My grandmother {abhors} loud music and crowded restaurants.
e.zh: 我奶奶非常讨厌吵闹的音乐和拥挤的餐厅。

e.en: All players must {abide} by the league's new rules.
e.zh: 所有球员必须遵守联盟的新规则。

e.en: I cannot {abide} people who talk during movies.
e.zh: 我无法忍受看电影时讲话的人。

e.en: She has an {abiding} love for classical music and poetry.
e.zh: 她对古典音乐和诗歌怀有持久的热爱。

e.en: His {abiding} faith helped him through difficult times.
e.zh: 他坚定不移的信念帮他度过了艰难的岁月。

abidjan.t: n. 阿比让（科特迪瓦城市）

e.en: {Abidjan} is the largest city in Côte d'Ivoire.
e.zh: 阿比让是科特迪瓦最大的城市。

e.en: Our flight had a brief layover in {Abidjan}.
e.zh: 我们的航班在阿比让短暂停留。

e.en: The new app tests cognitive {abilities} through short daily puzzles.
e.zh: 这款新应用通过每日小谜题测试认知能力。

e.en: She quickly demonstrated her leadership {abilities} on the team.
e.zh: 她很快在团队中展现了她的领导才能。

e.en: Cloud storage gives users the {ability} to access files anywhere.
e.zh: 云存储让用户能够随时随地访问文件。

e.en: His {ability} to stay calm under pressure is impressive.
e.zh: 他在压力下保持冷静的能力令人印象深刻。

e.en: We rented a cottage near {Abingdon} for the holiday.
e.zh: 假期我们在阿宾顿附近租了一间小屋。

e.en: {Abingdon} is one of the oldest towns in England.
e.zh: 阿宾顿是英格兰最古老的城镇之一。

abiotic.t: adj. 非生物的；无生命的

e.en: Sunlight and temperature are key {abiotic} factors in an ecosystem.
e.zh: 阳光和温度是生态系统中关键的非生物因素。

e.en: The desert's {abiotic} conditions make survival extremely difficult.
e.zh: 沙漠的非生物环境使得生存极为困难。

e.en: Millions still live in {abject} poverty around the world.
e.zh: 全世界仍有数百万人生活在赤贫之中。

e.en: The team suffered an {abject} defeat in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中遭遇了惨痛的失败。

e.en: The novel explores themes of {abjection} and social exclusion.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了卑贱与社会排斥的主题。

e.en: Years of unemployment had left him in total {abjection}.
e.zh: 多年的失业让他陷入了彻底的潦倒境地。

e.en: He apologized {abjectly} for missing the important deadline.
e.zh: 他低声下气地为错过重要截止日期道歉。

e.en: The proposal failed {abjectly} despite months of preparation.
e.zh: 尽管准备了数月,这项提案还是惨败收场。

abjure.t: v. 公开放弃；宣誓弃绝

e.en: New citizens must {abjure} allegiance to any foreign government.
e.zh: 新公民必须放弃对任何外国政府的效忠。

e.en: He refused to {abjure} his religious beliefs under pressure.
e.zh: 他拒绝在压力下放弃自己的宗教信仰。

e.en: {Abkhazia} declared independence from Georgia in the early 1990s.
e.zh: 阿布哈兹在20世纪90年代初宣布脱离格鲁吉亚独立。

e.en: Few countries officially recognize {Abkhazia} as a sovereign state.
e.zh: 很少有国家正式承认阿布哈兹为主权国家。

e.en: The {ABL} case form is widely studied in Latin grammar classes.
e.zh: 夺格(ABL)在拉丁语语法课上被广泛学习。

e.en: Her thesis examined the {ABL} kinase pathway in cancer cells.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了癌细胞中的ABL激酶通路。

e.en: Surgeons use lasers to {ablate} damaged heart tissue precisely.
e.zh: 外科医生使用激光精确地切除受损的心脏组织。

e.en: Researchers {ablate} model layers to measure each part's contribution.
e.zh: 研究人员通过移除模型层来衡量各部分的贡献。

e.en: Cardiac {ablation} can correct certain types of irregular heartbeat.
e.zh: 心脏消融术可以治疗某些类型的心律不齐。

e.en: The {ablation} study showed which features mattered most to performance.
e.zh: 消融实验显示了哪些特征对性能最为关键。

e.en: The spacecraft uses an {ablative} heat shield during reentry.
e.zh: 航天器在重返大气层时使用烧蚀隔热层。

e.en: Latin students often struggle with the {ablative} case at first.
e.zh: 学拉丁语的学生最初常常对夺格感到吃力。

e.en: The entire warehouse was {ablaze} when firefighters arrived.
e.zh: 消防员赶到时,整座仓库已经燃起熊熊大火。

e.en: The garden was {ablaze} with colorful summer flowers.
e.zh: 花园里五彩缤纷的夏花开得灿烂如火。

aaa.t:
n. 7号电池
n. 最高信用评级

e.en: I called {AAA} when my car broke down on the highway.
e.zh: 我的车在高速公路上抛锚时，我打电话给了AAA救援。

e.en: The bond received a {AAA} rating from the agency.
e.zh: 该债券获得了评级机构的AAA级评定。

e.en: "{Aaah}, that coffee is exactly what I needed," she sighed.
e.zh: "啊，这咖啡正是我想要的，"她叹道。

e.en: He let out a long {aaah} as he sank into the hot bath.
e.zh: 他泡进热水浴时长长地舒了一声"啊"。

e.en: We visited the cathedral in {Aachen} during our German trip.
e.zh: 我们在德国旅行时参观了亚琛大教堂。

e.en: {Aachen} was the favorite city of Emperor Charlemagne.
e.zh: 亚琛是查理曼大帝最钟爱的城市。

e.en: The crowd let out a collective {aah} at the fireworks display.
e.zh: 观众看到烟花表演齐声发出赞叹。

e.en: "{Aah}, finally I understand what you mean," he said.
e.zh: "啊，我终于明白你的意思了，"他说。

aardvark.t: n. 土豚（非洲食蚁动物）

e.en: The {aardvark} uses its long tongue to catch ants and termites.
e.zh: 土豚用长长的舌头捕食蚂蚁和白蚁。

e.en: We saw an {aardvark} at the zoo's nocturnal animal exhibit.
e.zh: 我们在动物园的夜行动物展区看到了一只土豚。

e.en: "{Aargh}, I forgot my password again!" he groaned.
e.zh: "啊，我又忘记密码了！"他抱怨道。

e.en: She typed {aargh} in the chat after losing the game.
e.zh: 输掉游戏后她在聊天里打了个"啊"。

e.en: The merchant wore a traditional {aba} of camel hair.
e.zh: 那位商人穿着一件传统的驼毛阿拉伯长袍。

e.en: He draped a woolen {aba} over his shoulders against the cold.
e.zh: 他把一件羊毛长袍披在肩上御寒。

ababa.t: n. 亚的斯亚贝巴（埃塞俄比亚首都简称）

e.en: Addis {Ababa} is the capital and largest city of Ethiopia.
e.zh: 亚的斯亚贝巴是埃塞俄比亚的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Our flight to Addis {Ababa} takes about ten hours.
e.zh: 我们飞往亚的斯亚贝巴的航班大约要十小时。

aback.t: adv. 向后；吃惊地（常用 taken aback）

e.en: I was taken {aback} by his rude response.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的回应让我大吃一惊。

e.en: She was taken {aback} when the stranger called her by name.
e.zh: 那个陌生人叫出她的名字时，她吃了一惊。

e.en: My grandfather still uses an {abacus} to do his accounts.
e.zh: 我爷爷至今仍用算盘来记账。

e.en: Children in the class learned arithmetic with a wooden {abacus}.
e.zh: 班上的孩子用木制算盘学习算术。

e.en: Fresh {abalone} is considered a delicacy in many Asian cuisines.
e.zh: 新鲜鲍鱼在许多亚洲菜系中被视为美味。

e.en: The jewelry box was inlaid with shimmering {abalone} shell.
e.zh: 那个首饰盒镶嵌着闪亮的鲍鱼壳。

abandon.t:
v. 放弃；抛弃
n. 放纵

e.en: Don't {abandon} the project just because it's getting hard.
e.zh: 不要因为变难就放弃这个项目。

e.en: She danced with wild {abandon} at the music festival.
e.zh: 她在音乐节上尽情忘我地跳舞。

e.en: They explored the {abandoned} factory on the edge of town.
e.zh: 他们探索了城郊那座废弃的工厂。

e.en: The hikers {abandoned} their plan when the storm rolled in.
e.zh: 暴风雨来袭时，徒步者放弃了原计划。

abandoning.t: v. 放弃（abandon 的现在分词）

e.en: The company is {abandoning} its old logo for a fresh design.
e.zh: 公司正在放弃旧标志，启用全新设计。

e.en: He felt guilty about {abandoning} his coworkers during the crunch.
e.zh: 赶工期间撇下同事让他感到内疚。

e.en: The child still struggles with feelings of {abandonment}.
e.zh: 那个孩子仍在与被遗弃的感觉作斗争。

e.en: The court cited the father's {abandonment} of his family.
e.zh: 法庭引用了那位父亲对家人的遗弃行为。

abandons.t: v. 放弃（abandon 的三单形式）

e.en: He often {abandons} hobbies after just a few weeks.
e.zh: 他常常玩了几周就放弃了爱好。

e.en: The novel's hero {abandons} city life for the mountains.
e.zh: 小说主人公抛弃城市生活去了山里。

e.en: He refused to {abase} himself by begging for the job.
e.zh: 他不愿为求得这份工作而自贬身价。

e.en: She would never {abase} her values to please her boss.
e.zh: 她绝不会贬低自己的原则去讨好老板。

e.en: The public {abasement} of the disgraced minister shocked viewers.
e.zh: 那位失势部长的公开蒙羞令观众震惊。

e.en: He apologized with a tone of complete {abasement}.
e.zh: 他以彻底自卑的语气道了歉。

e.en: Nothing seemed to {abash} the confident young performer.
e.zh: 似乎没有什么能让那位自信的年轻表演者感到尴尬。

e.en: Even harsh criticism failed to {abash} the seasoned politician.
e.zh: 即使是严厉批评也无法让这位老练政客难堪。

abashed.t: adj. 感到窘迫的；羞愧的

e.en: She looked {abashed} when her boss caught her napping.
e.zh: 被老板撞见打盹时，她显得很尴尬。

e.en: He felt {abashed} after mispronouncing his colleague's name.
e.zh: 念错同事的名字后他觉得很难为情。

e.en: The storm began to {abate} by early morning.
e.zh: 清晨时分暴风雨开始减弱。

e.en: Pain medication helped the headache {abate} within an hour.
e.zh: 止痛药让头痛在一小时内缓解了。

e.en: The city is funding noise {abatement} measures near the airport.
e.zh: 市政府正资助机场附近的降噪措施。

e.en: Homeowners received a tax {abatement} for installing solar panels.
e.zh: 安装太阳能板的房主获得了减税优惠。

e.en: Animal rights activists protested outside the local {abattoir}.
e.zh: 动物权益人士在当地屠宰场外抗议。

e.en: The {abattoir} must follow strict hygiene regulations by law.
e.zh: 屠宰场依法必须遵守严格的卫生规定。

abaya.t: n. 阿巴雅（阿拉伯女性黑袍）

e.en: She wore an elegant black {abaya} embroidered with silver thread.
e.zh: 她身穿一件绣着银线的优雅黑色长袍。

e.en: Many women in the Gulf region wear an {abaya} in public.
e.zh: 海湾地区许多女性在公共场合穿阿巴雅长袍。

e.en: The weaver carefully aligned the {abb} thread on the loom.
e.zh: 织工小心地将经纱在织机上对齐。

e.en: In old textile mills, {abb} referred to the warp yarn used.
e.zh: 在旧式纺织厂中，abb指所用的经线。

abba.t:
n. 父亲（亚拉姆语）
n. ABBA（瑞典乐队）

e.en: My parents still play {ABBA} songs at every family party.
e.zh: 我父母仍在每次家庭聚会上放ABBA的歌。

e.en: "Dancing Queen" by {ABBA} remains a timeless disco anthem.
e.zh: ABBA的《Dancing Queen》至今仍是不朽的迪斯科金曲。

e.en: The village {abbé} was beloved for his gentle sermons.
e.zh: 村里的神父因温和的布道而广受爱戴。

e.en: An old {abbé} guided visitors through the cathedral's history.
e.zh: 一位年长的神父向游客讲解大教堂的历史。

e.en: The {abbess} oversaw daily life in the medieval convent.
e.zh: 女院长掌管着中世纪修道院的日常生活。

e.en: A wise {abbess} led the nuns through years of hardship.
e.zh: 一位睿智的女修道院长带领修女们度过艰难岁月。

abbeville.t: n. 阿布维尔（法国城市）

e.en: The town of {Abbeville} is famous for its prehistoric stone tools.
e.zh: 阿布维尔镇以其史前石器闻名。

e.en: We stopped in {Abbeville} on our drive through northern France.
e.zh: 我们驾车穿越法国北部时在阿布维尔停留。

e.en: Westminster {Abbey} hosts royal weddings and coronations in London.
e.zh: 威斯敏斯特教堂在伦敦举行皇室婚礼和加冕仪式。

e.en: Tourists wandered through the ruins of the medieval {abbey}.
e.zh: 游客们在那座中世纪修道院的废墟中漫步。

e.en: The {abbot} welcomed pilgrims to the monastery each spring.
e.zh: 院长每年春天都会欢迎朝圣者来到修道院。

e.en: A new {abbot} was elected after the old one retired.
e.zh: 老院长退休后选出了一位新院长。

e.en: You can {abbreviate} "United States" as "US" in headlines.
e.zh: 你可以在标题中把"United States"缩写为"US"。

e.en: Please {abbreviate} the report to fit on a single page.
e.zh: 请把报告缩短到能放在一页内。

e.en: He gave an {abbreviated} version of the story over coffee.
e.zh: 他喝咖啡时讲了那个故事的简短版本。

e.en: "Dr." is the {abbreviated} form of the word "Doctor."
e.zh: "Dr."是"Doctor"一词的缩写形式。

e.en: "FAQ" is a common {abbreviation} for "frequently asked questions."
e.zh: "FAQ"是"frequently asked questions"的常见缩写。

e.en: The textbook lists every {abbreviation} used in the appendix.
e.zh: 这本教材在附录中列出了所有使用的缩写。

e.en: My toddler is just learning his {ABCs} at preschool.
e.zh: 我家小孩在幼儿园刚开始学习ABC字母。

e.en: Watching the news on {ABC} has become my evening routine.
e.zh: 看ABC的新闻已经成了我的晚间习惯。

abd.t: n. 完成课程但未写论文者（All But Dissertation）

e.en: She finished coursework but is still {ABD} on her dissertation.
e.zh: 她修完了课程，但论文还处于"只差答辩"阶段。

e.en: Many graduate students remain {ABD} for several years.
e.zh: 许多研究生在ABD阶段会停留好几年。

e.en: The king chose to {abdicate} the throne to marry the woman he loved.
e.zh: 国王选择退位以迎娶他所爱的女人。

e.en: Managers should never {abdicate} their responsibility for safety.
e.zh: 管理者绝不应放弃自己的安全责任。

e.en: The queen's {abdication} shocked the entire nation.
e.zh: 女王的退位震惊了整个国家。

e.en: His {abdication} of duty cost the team the championship.
e.zh: 他逃避职责让球队失去了冠军。

e.en: The doctor pressed gently on her {abdomen} to check for pain.
e.zh: 医生轻按她的腹部检查是否有疼痛。

e.en: He felt a sharp pain in his lower {abdomen} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后他下腹部感到一阵剧痛。

e.en: Yoga can help strengthen your {abdominal} muscles over time.
e.zh: 瑜伽可以逐渐帮助加强你的腹部肌肉。

e.en: She went to the ER with severe {abdominal} pain.
e.zh: 她因剧烈腹痛去了急诊。

e.en: Police warned parents that strangers might try to {abduct} children.
e.zh: 警方警告家长，陌生人可能会试图绑架儿童。

e.en: In the film, aliens {abduct} an entire family from their farm.
e.zh: 在电影里，外星人从农场掳走了一整家人。

e.en: She had a small {abrasion} on her knee from the fall.
e.zh: 她摔倒后膝盖上有一处小擦伤。

e.en: This coating protects the floor from daily {abrasion}.
e.zh: 这种涂层可以保护地板免受日常磨损。

abrasive.t:
adj. 粗糙的；刺耳的
n. 研磨剂

e.en: His {abrasive} tone made everyone uncomfortable in the meeting.
e.zh: 他刺耳的语气让会议上每个人都不舒服。

e.en: Use a mild cleaner instead of an {abrasive} powder on the screen.
e.zh: 清洁屏幕请使用温和清洁剂,不要用磨砂粉。

e.en: The manager spoke {abrasively} to her team during the review.
e.zh: 经理在评审会上对团队说话十分刺耳。

e.en: He responded {abrasively} to even the most polite questions.
e.zh: 即便是最礼貌的问题,他也回应得粗鲁刺耳。

e.en: His {abrasiveness} cost him several promotions over the years.
e.zh: 他粗暴的待人方式让他多年来错失了几次升迁。

e.en: The {abrasiveness} of the sandpaper determines its grit number.
e.zh: 砂纸的磨蚀程度决定了它的目数。

abreast.t:
adv. 并排；并肩
phr. keep abreast of 跟上

e.en: I read tech blogs to keep {abreast} of new frameworks.
e.zh: 我看科技博客,以便跟上新框架的发展。

e.en: Three cyclists rode {abreast} along the country road.
e.zh: 三名骑行者在乡间小路上并排骑行。

e.en: The publisher decided to {abridge} the novel for younger readers.
e.zh: 出版商决定为年轻读者删节这部小说。

e.en: No law shall {abridge} the freedom of the press.
e.zh: 任何法律都不得削减新闻自由。

e.en: I listened to the {abridged} audiobook on my morning commute.
e.zh: 我早上通勤时听了那本删节版有声书。

e.en: The textbook offers an {abridged} history of the Roman Empire.
e.zh: 这本教科书提供了罗马帝国的简史。

e.en: This {abridgement} captures the novel's main plot in 200 pages.
e.zh: 这部删节本用两百页概括了小说的主要情节。

e.en: The court ruled the policy was an {abridgement} of free speech.
e.zh: 法院裁定该政策是对言论自由的削减。

e.en: Students often read an {abridgment} of War and Peace in class.
e.zh: 学生们在课上常读《战争与和平》的删节版。

e.en: Any {abridgment} of voting rights raises serious legal concerns.
e.zh: 对投票权的任何削减都会引发严重的法律担忧。

e.en: She studied {abroad} in Spain during her junior year.
e.zh: 她大三那年在西班牙留学。

e.en: Working {abroad} taught him to appreciate other cultures.
e.zh: 在国外工作让他学会欣赏其他文化。

abrogate.t: v. 废除；废止（法律、协议）

e.en: The new government threatened to {abrogate} the trade treaty.
e.zh: 新政府威胁要废除这项贸易条约。

e.en: Courts may {abrogate} laws that violate constitutional rights.
e.zh: 法院可以废除侵犯宪法权利的法律。

e.en: The {abrogation} of the agreement shocked diplomats worldwide.
e.zh: 该协议的废除震惊了全球外交界。

e.en: Critics warned against the {abrogation} of long-standing protections.
e.zh: 批评人士警告不要废除长期存在的保护措施。

e.en: The meeting came to an {abrupt} end when the fire alarm rang.
e.zh: 火警响起时,会议突然结束。

e.en: Her {abrupt} reply suggested she was annoyed with the question.
e.zh: 她生硬的回答表明她对这个问题很恼火。

e.en: The CEO {abruptly} resigned just before the earnings call.
e.zh: 首席执行官在财报电话会议前突然辞职了。

e.en: He stopped {abruptly} when he noticed the camera was recording.
e.zh: 他注意到摄像机正在录像时突然停了下来。

e.en: The {abruptness} of his departure surprised everyone in the office.
e.zh: 他离开的突然让办公室里每个人都感到意外。

e.en: She apologized for the {abruptness} of her earlier email.
e.zh: 她为之前邮件的语气生硬表示道歉。

e.en: He does crunches every morning to strengthen his {abs}.
e.zh: 他每天早上做仰卧起坐来锻炼腹肌。

e.en: The trainer designed a workout focused on the core and {abs}.
e.zh: 教练设计了一套针对核心和腹肌的训练。

e.en: The dentist drained the painful {abscess} on her gum.
e.zh: 牙医引流了她牙龈上那个疼痛的脓肿。

e.en: An untreated {abscess} can lead to serious infection.
e.zh: 未经治疗的脓肿可能引发严重感染。

e.en: He needed antibiotics for an {abscessed} tooth last week.
e.zh: 上周他因牙齿脓肿需要服用抗生素。

e.en: The vet treated the dog's {abscessed} paw with great care.
e.zh: 兽医细心地处理了这只狗化脓的爪子。

e.en: Drought triggered early leaf {abscission} in the apple orchard.
e.zh: 干旱使苹果园的叶片提早脱落。

e.en: Hormones regulate the {abscission} of ripe fruit from branches.
e.zh: 激素调控成熟果实从枝条上的脱离。

e.en: The treasurer tried to {abscond} with the company funds.
e.zh: 那名财务主管企图卷走公司资金潜逃。

e.en: Two inmates managed to {abscond} during the night shift.
e.zh: 两名囚犯在夜班时设法逃脱了。

abseil.t:
v. 绳索速降
n. 绳降

e.en: Climbers {abseil} down the cliff using sturdy ropes.
e.zh: 攀登者用结实的绳索沿崖壁速降。

e.en: She learned to {abseil} during her mountaineering course.
e.zh: 她在登山课程中学会了绳降。

e.en: Her {absence} from the meeting was noticed immediately.
e.zh: 她没出席会议立刻被人注意到了。

e.en: In the {absence} of evidence, charges were dropped.
e.zh: 由于缺乏证据,指控被撤销了。

e.en: Repeated {absences} from class hurt his final grade.
e.zh: 屡次缺课影响了他的期末成绩。

e.en: The manager flagged unexplained {absences} on the timesheet.
e.zh: 经理标出了考勤表上无故缺勤的记录。

e.en: Three students were {absent} from today's morning lecture.
e.zh: 今天上午的课有三名学生缺席。

e.en: His name was {absent} from the final guest list.
e.zh: 他的名字没有出现在最终的来宾名单上。

e.en: Many soldiers cast their {absentee} ballots from overseas bases.
e.zh: 许多军人在海外基地投出了缺席选票。

e.en: The {absentee} landlord rarely visited the rundown apartment.
e.zh: 那位缺席的房东很少来这间破旧的公寓。

e.en: High {absenteeism} forced the factory to delay production.
e.zh: 严重的旷工迫使工厂推迟了生产。

e.en: Flexible hours helped reduce {absenteeism} across the team.
e.zh: 弹性工时帮助团队减少了缺勤现象。

e.en: The teacher emailed homework to all the {absentees}.
e.zh: 老师把作业邮件发给了所有缺课的学生。

e.en: Several {absentees} missed the crucial vote in parliament.
e.zh: 几名缺席议员错过了议会的关键表决。

e.en: She stirred her coffee {absently} while reading the news.
e.zh: 她一边看新闻一边心不在焉地搅着咖啡。

e.en: He nodded {absently}, lost in his own thoughts.
e.zh: 他出神地点点头,沉浸在自己的思绪中。

absentmindedly.t: adv. 心不在焉地；恍惚地

e.en: He {absentmindedly} put his phone in the fridge.
e.zh: 他心不在焉地把手机放进了冰箱。

e.en: She {absentmindedly} doodled in the margins of her notebook.
e.zh: 她心不在焉地在笔记本边缘乱涂乱画。

e.en: The bartender poured a glowing green {absinthe} over sugar.
e.zh: 酒保把翠绿的苦艾酒淋在方糖上。

e.en: Nineteenth-century artists romanticized the effects of {absinthe}.
e.zh: 十九世纪的艺术家把苦艾酒的效果浪漫化了。

e.en: The new CEO demanded {absolute} loyalty from her staff.
e.zh: 新任CEO要求员工对她绝对忠诚。

e.en: There is no {absolute} answer to that ethical question.
e.zh: 那个伦理问题没有绝对的答案。

absolutely.t: adv. 绝对地；完全地；当然

e.en: You're {absolutely} right about the deadline being too tight.
e.zh: 你说得完全对,这个截止日期太紧了。

e.en: The kids were {absolutely} thrilled by the surprise puppy.
e.zh: 孩子们看到惊喜小狗简直高兴坏了。

e.en: Critics challenged the {absoluteness} of the king's authority.
e.zh: 批评者质疑国王权力的绝对性。

e.en: She rejected the {absoluteness} of any single moral code.
e.zh: 她拒绝接受任何单一道德准则的绝对性。

absolutes.t: n. 绝对的事物；绝对原则

e.en: In ethics, few {absolutes} survive close philosophical scrutiny.
e.zh: 在伦理学中,经得起细究的绝对原则寥寥无几。

e.en: He distrusts politicians who speak in {absolutes}.
e.zh: 他不信任说话非黑即白的政客。

e.en: The priest offered {absolution} after hearing his confession.
e.zh: 听完忏悔后,神父给予了他赦罪。

e.en: An apology alone cannot grant {absolution} for such harm.
e.zh: 仅凭一句道歉无法为如此伤害换得宽恕。

e.en: Louis XIV epitomized royal {absolutism} in seventeenth-century France.
e.zh: 路易十四是十七世纪法国君主专制的典型代表。

e.en: Moral {absolutism} leaves little room for nuanced debate.
e.zh: 道德绝对主义几乎不容许细致的讨论空间。

absolutist.t:
n. 专制主义者
adj. 专制的

e.en: His {absolutist} stance on free speech alienated many allies.
e.zh: 他在言论自由上的绝对立场疏远了许多盟友。

e.en: The regime ruled with {absolutist} control over the press.
e.zh: 该政权对媒体实行绝对主义式的控制。

e.en: The court will not {absolve} him of financial responsibility.
e.zh: 法庭不会免除他的经济责任。

e.en: Good intentions don't {absolve} you from the consequences.
e.zh: 善意并不能让你免于承担后果。

e.en: Paper towels {absorb} spills faster than ordinary cloth.
e.zh: 厨房纸吸收液体比普通布料快。

e.en: It takes time to {absorb} such complicated tax rules.
e.zh: 消化这么复杂的税收规则需要时间。

e.en: Surgeons used {absorbable} stitches that dissolve within weeks.
e.zh: 外科医生使用了几周内会自行溶解的可吸收缝线。

e.en: This vitamin form is more {absorbable} than older tablets.
e.zh: 这种维生素形态比旧式药片更易吸收。

e.en: The spectrometer measured the sample's {absorbance} at 280 nanometers.
e.zh: 分光光度计测量了样品在280纳米处的吸光度。

e.en: Higher protein concentration produced greater {absorbance} in the assay.
e.zh: 蛋白质浓度越高,测定中的吸光度就越大。

absorbed.t:
adj. 全神贯注的
v. 已吸收

e.en: She was so {absorbed} in the novel she missed dinner.
e.zh: 她沉浸在小说里,连晚饭都忘了吃。

e.en: The sponge quickly {absorbed} the water from the counter.
e.zh: 海绵迅速把台面上的水吸干了。

e.en: These diapers are advertised for their superior {absorbency}.
e.zh: 这些尿布以超强吸水性作为宣传卖点。

e.en: Cotton offers better {absorbency} than most synthetic fabrics.
e.zh: 棉的吸水性比大多数合成纤维更好。

e.en: Use an {absorbent} cloth to wipe up the oil spill.
e.zh: 用一块吸水性强的布把溢出的油擦干净。

e.en: The mat is highly {absorbent} and dries within minutes.
e.zh: 这块垫子吸水性极强,几分钟内就能干。

e.en: A worn shock {absorber} makes the car bounce on bumps.
e.zh: 减震器磨损会让车在颠簸路面上反复弹跳。

e.en: This foam panel acts as an effective sound {absorber}.
e.zh: 这块泡沫板是一种有效的吸音材料。

absorbing.t: adj. 引人入胜的；吸引人的

e.en: The documentary was so {absorbing} that nobody checked their phone.
e.zh: 这部纪录片太吸引人,没人去看手机。

e.en: Dark fabrics are good at {absorbing} heat from sunlight.
e.zh: 深色布料很善于吸收阳光的热量。

absorbs.t: v. 吸收；吸引（第三人称单数）

e.en: This skincare formula quickly {absorbs} into dry winter skin.
e.zh: 这款护肤配方能迅速被干燥的冬季肌肤吸收。

e.en: A good leader {absorbs} criticism without becoming defensive.
e.zh: 优秀的领导能听进批评而不急于辩解。

e.en: Vitamin D improves the {absorption} of calcium in the gut.
e.zh: 维生素D能促进肠道对钙的吸收。

e.en: Her complete {absorption} in painting blocked out all distractions.
e.zh: 她完全沉浸于绘画,屏蔽了一切干扰。

e.en: The {absorptive} lining keeps your running shoes dry inside.
e.zh: 这种吸湿内衬能让你的跑鞋内部保持干爽。

e.en: Healthy gut tissue maintains a high {absorptive} capacity for nutrients.
e.zh: 健康的肠道组织对营养具有很强的吸收能力。

e.en: The respected {academician} published over fifty research papers.
e.zh: 这位德高望重的院士发表了五十多篇研究论文。

e.en: She was elected an {academician} of the national science academy.
e.zh: 她当选为国家科学院的院士。

e.en: He balances {academics} with his role on the basketball team.
e.zh: 他在学业和篮球队的角色之间取得平衡。

e.en: Several leading {academics} signed the open letter.
e.zh: 几位顶尖学者在公开信上签了名。

academies.t: n. 学院；研究院（academy 的复数）

e.en: Military {academies} train future officers across the country.
e.zh: 军事院校在全国各地培养未来的军官。

e.en: Online coding {academies} have boomed since the pandemic.
e.zh: 自疫情以来，在线编程学院迅速兴起。

academy.t: n. 学院；专科院校；研究院

e.en: She enrolled her son in a coding {academy} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天她给儿子报了一个编程培训班。

e.en: The film won three {Academy} Awards last night.
e.zh: 这部电影昨晚赢得了三项奥斯卡奖。

acadian.t:
n. 阿卡迪亚人
adj. 阿卡迪亚的

e.en: Many {Acadian} families settled in Louisiana centuries ago.
e.zh: 许多阿卡迪亚家庭在几个世纪前定居于路易斯安那州。

e.en: The festival celebrates {Acadian} music and culture.
e.zh: 这个节日是为了庆祝阿卡迪亚的音乐与文化。

acanthus.t: n. 莨苕（一种叶形装饰植物）

e.en: Greek columns are often decorated with {acanthus} leaves.
e.zh: 希腊柱子上常常雕饰着茛苕叶纹样。

e.en: The {acanthus} plant has bold, sculptural foliage.
e.zh: 茛苕植物拥有大胆而富有雕塑感的叶片。

acapulco.t: n. 阿卡普尔科（墨西哥海滨城市）

e.en: We watched the famous cliff divers in {Acapulco}.
e.zh: 我们在阿卡普尔科观看了著名的悬崖跳水表演。

e.en: {Acapulco} was once a glamorous celebrity getaway.
e.zh: 阿卡普尔科曾经是名流们的奢华度假胜地。

acarpous.t: adj. 不结果实的（植物学）

e.en: Botanists labeled the mutant plant as {acarpous}.
e.zh: 植物学家将这株变异植物标记为不结果型。

e.en: An {acarpous} tree may bloom but produces no fruit.
e.zh: 不结果的树木可能会开花，但不会结出果实。

acas.t: n. 英国咨询、调解和仲裁服务局

e.en: The dispute was eventually resolved through {ACAS} mediation.
e.zh: 这场纠纷最终通过 ACAS 的调解得以解决。

e.en: Workers can call {ACAS} for free advice on employment rights.
e.zh: 工人可以致电 ACAS 获得免费的劳工权益咨询。

e.en: Please copy your manager and {acc} HR on the email.
e.zh: 请把这封邮件抄送你的主管，并附送人力资源部。

e.en: Duke and North Carolina remain rivals in the {ACC}.
e.zh: 杜克大学和北卡大学在 ACC 联赛中始终是宿敌。

accede.t: v. 同意；就任；加入（协议）

e.en: The company refused to {accede} to the union's demands.
e.zh: 公司拒绝答应工会的要求。

e.en: She will {accede} to the throne after her father retires.
e.zh: 父亲退位后她将继承王位。

e.en: Investigators found traces of an {accelerant} at the scene.
e.zh: 调查人员在现场发现了助燃剂的痕迹。

e.en: AI has become an {accelerant} for productivity in many industries.
e.zh: 人工智能已成为许多行业生产力的加速器。

e.en: The team plans to {accelerate} development of the new feature.
e.zh: 团队计划加快新功能的开发进度。

e.en: Press the pedal gently to {accelerate} on icy roads.
e.zh: 在结冰的路上要轻踩油门来加速。

accelerated.t:
adj. 加速的
v. accelerate 的过去式

e.en: The pandemic {accelerated} the shift to remote work.
e.zh: 疫情加速了向远程办公的转变。

e.en: She enrolled in an {accelerated} master's program.
e.zh: 她报读了一个加速制硕士项目。

accelerates.t: v. 加速（accelerate 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This electric car {accelerates} from zero to sixty in three seconds.
e.zh: 这辆电动车从零加速到六十英里只需三秒。

e.en: Caffeine {accelerates} your heart rate temporarily.
e.zh: 咖啡因会暂时加快你的心率。

accelerating.t:
v. 加速（accelerate 的进行式）
adj. 加速的

e.en: Climate change is {accelerating} faster than scientists predicted.
e.zh: 气候变化的速度比科学家预测的还要快。

e.en: The car kept {accelerating} down the empty highway.
e.zh: 那辆车在空旷的高速公路上不断加速行驶。

e.en: The sports car is famous for its rapid {acceleration}.
e.zh: 这款跑车以其迅猛的加速性能而闻名。

e.en: There has been a clear {acceleration} in AI adoption.
e.zh: 人工智能的应用明显在加速普及。

e.en: The drug had an {accelerative} effect on healing.
e.zh: 这种药物对伤口愈合有加速作用。

e.en: New tools provide an {accelerative} boost to small teams.
e.zh: 新工具为小团队带来了显著的加速效果。

accelerator.t: n. 油门；加速器；加速程序

e.en: The startup joined a six-month {accelerator} program in Berlin.
e.zh: 这家初创公司加入了柏林为期六个月的加速器项目。

e.en: She slammed the {accelerator} as the light turned green.
e.zh: 绿灯一亮她就猛踩油门。

e.en: Your phone uses an {accelerometer} to detect screen rotation.
e.zh: 你的手机通过加速度计来检测屏幕的旋转。

e.en: The fitness tracker's {accelerometer} counts every step you take.
e.zh: 健身追踪器的加速度计会记录你走的每一步。

e.en: She speaks English with a slight French {accent}.
e.zh: 她说英语带着轻微的法国口音。

e.en: The red pillows add a nice {accent} to the room.
e.zh: 红色靠枕为房间增添了一抹亮色。

accented.t: adj. 有口音的；带重音的

e.en: He spoke in heavily {accented} English during the interview.
e.zh: 他在面试时说着带有浓重口音的英语。

e.en: The designer {accented} the dress with a gold belt.
e.zh: 设计师用金色腰带点缀了这条裙子。

e.en: British and Australian {accents} can be hard to tell apart.
e.zh: 英国口音和澳大利亚口音有时很难区分。

e.en: The black sofa has bright yellow {accents} on the cushions.
e.zh: 黑色沙发的靠垫上有亮黄色的点缀。

e.en: English poetry often follows an {accentual} rhythm pattern.
e.zh: 英语诗歌常常遵循重音节奏模式。

e.en: Linguists study the {accentual} differences between dialects.
e.zh: 语言学家研究方言之间的重音差异。

e.en: This dress will {accentuate} your waistline beautifully.
e.zh: 这条裙子能很好地凸显你的腰线。

e.en: Soft lighting can {accentuate} the warm tones of the room.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光可以突出房间的暖色调。

accentuated.t: v. accentuate 的过去式；被强调的

e.en: Her smile was {accentuated} by bright red lipstick.
e.zh: 鲜红的口红让她的微笑更加迷人。

e.en: The recession {accentuated} the gap between rich and poor.
e.zh: 经济衰退加剧了贫富差距。

e.en: Correct {accentuation} is essential when learning Spanish.
e.zh: 学习西班牙语时,正确的重音非常重要。

e.en: The makeup artist focused on the {accentuation} of her eyes.
e.zh: 化妆师着重突出她的眼部轮廓。

e.en: Do you {accept} credit cards at this store?
e.zh: 你们店接受信用卡支付吗?

e.en: I had to {accept} that the project would be delayed.
e.zh: 我不得不接受项目会延期的事实。

e.en: The committee questioned the {acceptability} of the proposal.
e.zh: 委员会对该提案的可接受性提出了质疑。

e.en: Social {acceptability} of remote work has grown rapidly.
e.zh: 远程办公的社会接受度迅速提高。

acceptable.t: adj. 可接受的；令人满意的

e.en: Wearing jeans to the office is now {acceptable} here.
e.zh: 在我们这里,穿牛仔裤上班现在是可以接受的。

e.en: The test results are within the {acceptable} range.
e.zh: 检测结果在可接受范围之内。

e.en: The new intern performed {acceptably} during her first week.
e.zh: 这位新实习生第一周表现尚可。

e.en: The repair was done {acceptably}, though not perfectly.
e.zh: 修理工作做得还算合格,但不算完美。

e.en: She received an {acceptance} letter from Harvard last week.
e.zh: 她上周收到了哈佛大学的录取通知书。

e.en: Public {acceptance} of electric cars keeps growing.
e.zh: 公众对电动汽车的接受度在不断提高。

acceptances.t: n. 接受；承兑汇票（复数）

e.en: The university sent out thousands of {acceptances} this spring.
e.zh: 该大学今年春季发出了数千份录取通知。

e.en: He received multiple job {acceptances} after the interviews.
e.zh: 面试后他收到了多份录用通知。

e.en: She {accepted} the job offer without hesitation.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地接受了那份工作邀请。

e.en: It is widely {accepted} that exercise improves mental health.
e.zh: 人们普遍认为运动有助于改善心理健康。

accepting.t: adj. 乐于接受的；宽容的

e.en: The school is currently {accepting} applications for next year.
e.zh: 学校目前正在接受明年的入学申请。

e.en: His parents are very {accepting} of his lifestyle choices.
e.zh: 他的父母对他的生活方式选择非常包容。

acceptor.t: n. 接受者；受主；承兑人

e.en: In chemistry, an {acceptor} receives electrons during a reaction.
e.zh: 在化学中,受体在反应中接收电子。

e.en: The bank served as the {acceptor} of the bill of exchange.
e.zh: 银行作为汇票的承兑人。

accepts.t: v. 接受（accept 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This vending machine only {accepts} coins, not bills.
e.zh: 这台自动售货机只接受硬币,不接受纸币。

e.en: She gracefully {accepts} criticism from her colleagues.
e.zh: 她大方地接受同事们的批评。

access.t:
n. 访问；进入权限
v. 访问；获取

e.en: You need a password to {access} the company database.
e.zh: 你需要密码才能访问公司数据库。

e.en: Many rural areas still lack {access} to high-speed internet.
e.zh: 许多农村地区仍然缺乏高速互联网接入。

e.en: He was charged as an {accessary} to the robbery.
e.zh: 他被指控为该抢劫案的从犯。

e.en: The court found her guilty of being an {accessary} after the fact.
e.zh: 法庭判定她犯有事后从犯罪。

accessed.t: v. 访问（access 的过去式）

e.en: Hackers {accessed} thousands of user accounts last night.
e.zh: 黑客昨晚入侵了数千个用户账户。

e.en: The report can be {accessed} from our website anytime.
e.zh: 该报告可随时通过我们的网站获取。

accesses.t: v./n. 访问（access 的复数/第三人称单数）

e.en: The software logs every time someone {accesses} the file.
e.zh: 每当有人访问该文件时,软件都会记录下来。

e.en: Unauthorized {accesses} to the server triggered an alert.
e.zh: 对服务器的未授权访问触发了警报。

accessibilities.t: n. 可访问性；易接近性（复数）

e.en: The report compares the digital {accessibilities} of major banks.
e.zh: 该报告比较了各大银行的数字无障碍程度。

e.en: Different {accessibilities} are required for different disabilities.
e.zh: 不同的残障情况需要不同的无障碍设施。

accessibility.t: n. 可访问性；无障碍性

e.en: Web {accessibility} is crucial for users with disabilities.
e.zh: 网络无障碍设计对残障用户至关重要。

e.en: The museum improved {accessibility} by adding ramps and elevators.
e.zh: 博物馆通过增设坡道和电梯改善了无障碍设施。

accessible.t: adj. 可访问的；易理解的；无障碍的

e.en: The park is easily {accessible} by public transportation.
e.zh: 这个公园乘坐公共交通就能轻松到达。

e.en: Her writing makes complex science {accessible} to everyone.
e.zh: 她的文笔让复杂的科学变得人人都能理解。

accessing.t: v. 访问（access 的进行式）

e.en: I'm having trouble {accessing} my email this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我登录邮箱时遇到了问题。

e.en: {Accessing} medical records requires patient consent.
e.zh: 获取病历需要患者本人的同意。

accession.t: n. 加入；就任；新入藏品

e.en: The country celebrated the king's {accession} to the throne.
e.zh: 全国庆祝国王登基。

e.en: Turkey has long sought {accession} to the European Union.
e.zh: 土耳其长期以来一直寻求加入欧盟。

accessories.t: n. 配件；饰品（accessory 的复数）

e.en: She loves shopping for handbags and other {accessories}.
e.zh: 她喜欢购买手提包和其他配饰。

e.en: The phone comes with several useful {accessories} in the box.
e.zh: 这款手机的包装盒内附有几件实用配件。

accessorize.t: v. 用配饰搭配；添加附件

e.en: You can {accessorize} a simple dress with bold jewelry.
e.zh: 你可以用大胆的首饰来搭配一条简约的裙子。

e.en: She knows how to {accessorize} her outfits perfectly.
e.zh: 她知道如何完美地为自己的服装搭配配饰。

e.en: A leather belt is the perfect {accessory} for this outfit.
e.zh: 皮带是搭配这身衣服的完美配饰。

e.en: He was charged as an {accessory} to the crime.
e.zh: 他被指控为这起犯罪的从犯。

e.en: There was a serious car {accident} on the highway today.
e.zh: 今天高速公路上发生了一起严重的车祸。

e.en: I met my best friend completely by {accident}.
e.zh: 我和最好的朋友相识完全是个偶然。

accountants.t: n. 会计师；会计从业者

e.en: The firm hired ten new {accountants} ahead of tax season.
e.zh: 该公司在报税季前招聘了十名新会计师。

e.en: Many {accountants} are now learning Python for data analysis.
e.zh: 许多会计师正在学习 Python 来做数据分析。

accounted.t: v. account 的过去式，解释；视为

e.en: Online sales {accounted} for forty percent of total revenue.
e.zh: 线上销售占总收入的百分之四十。

e.en: All passengers were safely {accounted} for after the emergency landing.
e.zh: 紧急降落后,所有乘客都已确认安全。

accounting.t:
n. 会计；会计学
v. 解释（account 的现在分词）

e.en: She majored in {accounting} and now works at a bank.
e.zh: 她大学主修会计,现在在银行工作。

e.en: The startup hired a CFO to clean up its messy {accounting}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司聘请了一位 CFO 来整理混乱的账目。

accounts.t:
n. 账户；账目
v. 解释（第三人称单数）

e.en: He manages several social media {accounts} for the brand.
e.zh: 他为该品牌管理多个社交媒体账号。

e.en: Tourism {accounts} for nearly half the island's economy.
e.zh: 旅游业占该岛经济的近一半。

accouterments.t: n. 装备；配备（美式拼写）

e.en: The hiker arrived with all the usual outdoor {accouterments}.
e.zh: 那位徒步者带齐了各种常见的户外装备。

e.en: Her office had every {accouterments} of an executive suite.
e.zh: 她的办公室配齐了高管套间的各种附属设施。

e.en: A leather strap is a classic {accoutrement} for a luxury watch.
e.zh: 皮表带是奢华手表的经典配件。

e.en: The chef's hat is more than a mere {accoutrement}.
e.zh: 厨师帽不仅仅是一件配饰那么简单。

e.en: We landed in {Accra} just before sunset on Friday evening.
e.zh: 我们在周五傍晚日落前抵达了阿克拉。

e.en: {Accra} is the bustling capital city of Ghana.
e.zh: 阿克拉是加纳繁华的首都。

e.en: The agency will {accredit} the school after a thorough review.
e.zh: 该机构将在全面审核后为这所学校进行认证。

e.en: Historians {accredit} the discovery to a little-known scientist.
e.zh: 历史学家将这项发现归功于一位鲜为人知的科学家。

e.en: The university lost its {accreditation} after years of declining standards.
e.zh: 由于多年标准下滑,这所大学失去了认证资格。

e.en: Journalists must apply for press {accreditation} before the summit.
e.zh: 记者必须在峰会前申请媒体采访资格。

accredited.t: adj. 经认证的；官方认可的

e.en: Make sure you choose an {accredited} online degree program.
e.zh: 务必选择一个经过认证的网络学位课程。

e.en: Only {accredited} investors can participate in this funding round.
e.zh: 只有合格投资者才能参与这一轮融资。

accrediting.t: v. 进行认证（accredit 的现在分词）

e.en: The {accrediting} body visits each campus every five years.
e.zh: 认证机构每五年走访一次每所校园。

e.en: They are still {accrediting} the new medical school's curriculum.
e.zh: 他们仍在对这所新医学院的课程进行认证。

e.en: Small ice particles slowly {accrete} to form a comet.
e.zh: 小冰粒逐渐聚集形成一颗彗星。

e.en: Bad habits tend to {accrete} silently over many years.
e.zh: 坏习惯往往会在多年间悄悄累积起来。

e.en: The coral reef grew through the slow {accretion} of calcium.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁通过钙质的缓慢沉积而生长。

e.en: Tax laws suffer from decades of legislative {accretion}.
e.zh: 税法因数十年的立法叠加而变得臃肿。

accrington.t: n. 阿克灵顿（英国城镇）

e.en: {Accrington} is a small town in Lancashire, northern England.
e.zh: 阿克灵顿是英格兰北部兰开夏郡的一个小镇。

e.en: He grew up in {Accrington} before moving to Manchester.
e.zh: 他在搬到曼彻斯特之前一直在阿克灵顿长大。

e.en: Most companies use {accrual} accounting rather than cash basis.
e.zh: 大多数公司采用权责发生制而非收付实现制记账。

e.en: Vacation {accrual} starts on your first day of employment.
e.zh: 休假天数从入职第一天开始累计。

e.en: Interest will {accrue} on the loan starting next month.
e.zh: 贷款利息将从下月起开始累计。

e.en: Loyalty points {accrue} every time you shop at the store.
e.zh: 每次在该商店购物都会累积积分。

e.en: She had {accrued} over thirty days of unused vacation time.
e.zh: 她已经累积了超过三十天未使用的假期。

e.en: The investment {accrued} significant interest over the past decade.
e.zh: 这笔投资在过去十年里积累了可观的利息。

accrues.t: v. 累积（第三人称单数）

e.en: Interest {accrues} daily on the outstanding credit card balance.
e.zh: 信用卡未还余额每日产生利息。

e.en: Goodwill {accrues} to brands that consistently treat customers well.
e.zh: 始终善待客户的品牌会逐渐积累良好声誉。

accruing.t: v. 累积中（accrue 的现在分词）

e.en: Penalties keep {accruing} until you settle the unpaid bill.
e.zh: 在你结清欠款前,罚款会持续累积。

e.en: She is {accruing} miles quickly thanks to frequent business trips.
e.zh: 由于频繁出差,她的里程积分迅速累积。

e.en: It can take years for immigrants to fully {acculturate} to a new country.
e.zh: 移民可能需要数年才能完全融入新的国家文化。

e.en: Companies often help new hires {acculturate} to internal norms.
e.zh: 公司通常会帮助新员工适应内部文化规范。

acculturation.t: n. 文化适应；文化同化

e.en: The {acculturation} of immigrants often takes more than one generation.
e.zh: 移民的文化适应过程往往需要不止一代人的时间。

e.en: Studies show {acculturation} affects food choices and language use.
e.zh: 研究表明文化适应会影响饮食选择和语言使用。

e.en: Many students experience {acculturative} stress when studying abroad.
e.zh: 许多学生在出国留学时会经历文化适应压力。

e.en: Therapists discussed {acculturative} challenges faced by refugee families.
e.zh: 治疗师讨论了难民家庭面临的文化适应挑战。

e.en: Dust tends to {accumulate} on bookshelves over time.
e.zh: 灰尘往往会随着时间在书架上堆积起来。

e.en: You can {accumulate} points and redeem them for free coffee.
e.zh: 你可以积累积分,然后兑换免费咖啡。

accumulated.t:
adj. 累积的
v. 已积累

e.en: She has {accumulated} a huge following on TikTok this year.
e.zh: 她今年在 TikTok 上积累了大量粉丝。

e.en: Snow {accumulated} on the rooftops overnight.
e.zh: 积雪一夜之间堆积在屋顶上。

accumulates.t: v. 积累（第三人称单数）

e.en: Plaque {accumulates} on teeth if you skip flossing.
e.zh: 如果不用牙线清洁,牙菌斑会在牙齿上堆积。

e.en: Each click {accumulates} more data about user behavior.
e.zh: 每一次点击都会累积更多用户行为数据。

accumulating.t: v. 积累中（accumulate 的现在分词）

e.en: Evidence is {accumulating} that exercise improves mental health.
e.zh: 越来越多的证据表明运动有助于改善心理健康。

e.en: He keeps {accumulating} unread emails in his inbox.
e.zh: 他的收件箱里不断堆积着未读邮件。

e.en: Heavy snow {accumulation} forced the airport to close.
e.zh: 大量积雪迫使机场关闭。

e.en: Wealth {accumulation} is harder for younger generations today.
e.zh: 如今年轻一代积累财富变得更加困难。

e.en: Large {accumulations} of plastic waste are polluting the ocean.
e.zh: 大量堆积的塑料垃圾正在污染海洋。

e.en: Forecasters predict {accumulations} of up to ten inches of snow.
e.zh: 气象预报员预测积雪可达十英寸。

e.en: The course grade is {accumulative} across all assignments.
e.zh: 该课程的成绩是所有作业累计得出的。

e.en: Caffeine has an {accumulative} effect throughout the day.
e.zh: 咖啡因在一天中会产生累积效应。

e.en: The CPU stores intermediate results in an {accumulator} register.
e.zh: CPU 将中间结果存储在累加器寄存器中。

e.en: He placed an {accumulator} bet on four football matches.
e.zh: 他对四场足球比赛下了一个累计投注。

e.en: The model's {accuracies} across datasets ranged from 80 to 95 percent.
e.zh: 该模型在各数据集上的准确率介于 80% 到 95% 之间。

e.en: We compared the {accuracies} of three different translation tools.
e.zh: 我们比较了三种不同翻译工具的准确率。

e.en: The GPS has impressive {accuracy} even in dense forests.
e.zh: 这款 GPS 即使在茂密森林里也有惊人的精度。

e.en: Please double-check the {accuracy} of your tax return.
e.zh: 请仔细核对你纳税申报表的准确性。

e.en: Make sure your résumé contains {accurate} dates and titles.
e.zh: 确保你的简历中日期和职位都是准确的。

e.en: The weather app is surprisingly {accurate} for our area.
e.zh: 这个天气应用对我们这一带的预报出奇地准。

e.en: The sensor measures heart rate {accurately} during workouts.
e.zh: 该传感器在运动时能精确测量心率。

e.en: Can you describe the suspect {accurately} for the police?
e.zh: 你能向警察准确描述嫌疑人吗?

e.en: I can't get this {accursed} printer to work again.
e.zh: 我没法让这台讨厌的打印机重新工作了。

e.en: Legend says the {accursed} ring brings misfortune to its wearer.
e.zh: 传说那枚被诅咒的戒指会给佩戴者带来厄运。

e.en: He firmly denied the {accusation} of cheating on the exam.
e.zh: 他坚决否认了考试作弊的指控。

e.en: The {accusation} surfaced in a viral social media post.
e.zh: 这一指控出现在一篇热传的社交媒体帖子里。

e.en: The CEO faced serious {accusations} of financial misconduct.
e.zh: 这位 CEO 面临严重的财务不当行为指控。

e.en: Both sides traded {accusations} during the heated debate.
e.zh: 双方在激烈的辩论中互相指责。

e.en: Her {accusatory} tone made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她那种指责的语气让餐桌上每个人都不自在。

e.en: Try not to sound {accusatory} when raising concerns with coworkers.
e.zh: 向同事提出顾虑时尽量不要听起来像在指责。

e.en: Don't {accuse} someone without solid evidence.
e.zh: 没有确凿证据就不要指责别人。

e.en: Critics {accuse} the company of greenwashing its products.
e.zh: 批评者指责该公司对其产品进行漂绿宣传。

accused.t:
n. 被告
adj. 被指控的

e.en: The {accused} pleaded not guilty in court yesterday.
e.zh: 被告昨天在法庭上申辩无罪。

e.en: She {accused} him of stealing her lunch from the fridge.
e.zh: 她指责他从冰箱里偷走了她的午餐。

e.en: All three {accuseds} appeared together at the preliminary hearing.
e.zh: 三名被告在预审听证会上一同出庭。

e.en: The judge addressed the {accuseds} before reading the charges.
e.zh: 法官在宣读指控前向各被告致词。

e.en: The {accuser} testified for nearly three hours on Monday.
e.zh: 原告周一作证将近三个小时。

e.en: He demanded to confront his {accuser} face to face.
e.zh: 他要求与指控他的人当面对质。

accuses.t: v. 指控（第三人称单数）

e.en: The article {accuses} the senator of accepting illegal donations.
e.zh: 这篇文章指控这位参议员接受了非法捐款。

e.en: She often {accuses} her brother of borrowing things without asking.
e.zh: 她经常指责弟弟不打招呼就借东西。

accusing.t:
adj. 责备的
v. 指控中

e.en: He shot her an {accusing} look across the room.
e.zh: 他从房间另一头投来责备的目光。

e.en: Stop {accusing} me of things I didn't do.
e.zh: 别再指责我没做过的事了。

accusingly.t: adv. 责备地；带有指控地

e.en: "You ate the last cookie," she said {accusingly}.
e.zh: “你吃了最后一块饼干,”她带着责备的语气说。

e.en: He pointed {accusingly} at the broken window.
e.zh: 他责备地指着那扇破窗户。

e.en: It takes time to {accustom} yourself to working from home.
e.zh: 让自己适应在家工作需要一段时间。

e.en: Trainers slowly {accustom} puppies to wearing a leash.
e.zh: 训练员让幼犬慢慢习惯戴牵引绳。

accustomed.t: adj. 习以为常的；惯常的

e.en: I'm not {accustomed} to waking up this early.
e.zh: 我还不习惯这么早起床。

e.en: She quickly grew {accustomed} to life in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她很快就习惯了在东京的生活。

accustoming.t: v. 使习惯（accustom 的现在分词）

e.en: He's slowly {accustoming} himself to the new keyboard layout.
e.zh: 他正在慢慢适应新的键盘布局。

e.en: The trainer is {accustoming} the horse to traffic noise.
e.zh: 训练员正在让那匹马习惯交通噪音。

accustoms.t: v. 使习惯（第三人称单数）

e.en: Daily practice {accustoms} your fingers to the guitar strings.
e.zh: 每天练习能让你的手指适应吉他弦。

e.en: Living abroad {accustoms} people to constant change.
e.zh: 在国外生活让人习惯于不断的变化。

ace.t:
n. 王牌；高手
adj. 一流的

e.en: She totally {ace} the job interview yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天的面试表现堪称完美。

e.en: He drew an {ace} of spades from the deck.
e.zh: 他从牌堆里抽到了一张黑桃 A。

e.en: Viruses are {acellular} and need a host to replicate.
e.zh: 病毒没有细胞结构,需要宿主才能复制。

e.en: The vaccine uses an {acellular} form of the bacteria.
e.zh: 该疫苗使用的是这种细菌的无细胞形式。

acequia.t: n. (美国西南部) 灌溉水渠

e.en: The old {acequia} still carries water to the village fields.
e.zh: 那条古老的灌溉渠至今仍把水引到村里的田地。

e.en: Farmers in New Mexico maintain the community {acequia} every spring.
e.zh: 新墨西哥的农民每年春天都会维护社区的灌溉渠。

e.en: The garden featured a Japanese {acer} with deep red leaves.
e.zh: 花园里有一棵叶子深红的日本枫树。

e.en: Bonsai enthusiasts often shape miniature {acer} trees.
e.zh: 盆景爱好者常常修剪迷你的枫树。

acerbic.t: adj. 尖刻的，刻薄的 (言辞)

e.en: The critic is known for her {acerbic} restaurant reviews.
e.zh: 那位评论家以尖刻的餐厅评论闻名。

e.en: He made an {acerbic} comment about the manager's decision.
e.zh: 他对经理的决定发表了一句尖刻的评论。

e.en: She {acerbically} dismissed the proposal as completely unrealistic.
e.zh: 她尖刻地把那个提议斥为完全不切实际。

e.en: The columnist {acerbically} mocked the politician's empty promises.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家尖刻地嘲讽了这位政客的空头承诺。

e.en: The {acerbity} of his email surprised the whole team.
e.zh: 他邮件中的尖酸刻薄让整个团队都感到意外。

e.en: She responded with rare {acerbity} to the reporter's question.
e.zh: 她对记者的问题罕见地回以尖刻言辞。

acet.t: (罕用) 构词成分，表示乙酰/醋

e.en: The prefix {acet} appears in chemistry words like acetone and acetate.
e.zh: 前缀 {acet} 出现在丙酮和醋酸盐等化学词中。

e.en: Many lab compounds begin with the {acet} root for vinegar-related chemistry.
e.zh: 许多实验室化合物以词根 {acet} 开头,与醋酸相关。

e.en: Hangovers are partly caused by a buildup of {acetaldehyde} in the body.
e.zh: 宿醉部分是由于体内乙醛的堆积造成的。

e.en: The factory had to reduce its {acetaldehyde} emissions.
e.zh: 工厂不得不减少乙醛的排放。

acetaminophen.t: n. 对乙酰氨基酚 (扑热息痛)

e.en: Take two {acetaminophen} tablets for the headache.
e.zh: 头痛的话就吃两片对乙酰氨基酚。

e.en: Too much {acetaminophen} can damage your liver.
e.zh: 服用过多对乙酰氨基酚会损害肝脏。

e.en: The frames are made from lightweight cellulose {acetate}.
e.zh: 这副镜架是用轻质的醋酸纤维制成的。

e.en: Vinyl collectors sometimes hunt for rare original {acetate} discs.
e.zh: 黑胶收藏家有时会寻找稀有的原版醋酸盘。

e.en: Vinegar's sharp smell comes from {acetic} acid.
e.zh: 醋的刺鼻气味来自乙酸。

e.en: The cleaner contains a mild {acetic} solution.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂含有温和的醋酸溶液。

e.en: She used {acetone} to remove her gel nail polish.
e.zh: 她用丙酮卸掉了她的甲油胶。

e.en: Always store {acetone} away from open flames.
e.zh: 丙酮一定要远离明火存放。

e.en: Aspirin contains an {acetyl} group attached to salicylic acid.
e.zh: 阿司匹林含有一个连接在水杨酸上的乙酰基。

e.en: The enzyme transfers an {acetyl} group during the reaction.
e.zh: 该酶在反应过程中转移一个乙酰基。

e.en: {Acetylcholine} helps nerves communicate with muscles.
e.zh: 乙酰胆碱帮助神经与肌肉之间传递信号。

e.en: Low {acetylcholine} levels are linked to memory problems.
e.zh: 乙酰胆碱水平低与记忆问题有关。

e.en: Welders use {acetylene} torches to cut through thick steel.
e.zh: 焊工使用乙炔焊枪切割厚钢板。

e.en: The lamp burned {acetylene} to produce a bright white flame.
e.zh: 这盏灯燃烧乙炔以产生明亮的白色火焰。

ach.t: int. 啊 (表示惊讶或遗憾)

e.en: "{Ach}, I forgot my umbrella again," she sighed.
e.zh: “唉,我又忘带伞了,”她叹了口气。

e.en: He muttered "{ach}" under his breath when the call dropped.
e.zh: 电话掉线时他低声嘟囔了一声“唉”。

achaemenid.t: adj. 阿契美尼德王朝的 (古波斯)

e.en: The {Achaemenid} Empire once stretched from Egypt to India.
e.zh: 阿契美尼德帝国曾从埃及一直延伸到印度。

e.en: The museum displays beautiful {Achaemenid} gold artifacts.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了精美的阿契美尼德黄金文物。

ache.t:
v. 隐隐作痛
n. 疼痛

e.en: My back has been {ache}-ing since I started running.
e.zh: 自从我开始跑步,我的背就一直酸痛。

e.en: She felt a dull {ache} in her shoulder after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,她感到肩膀隐隐作痛。

ached.t: v. ache 的过去式，疼痛

e.en: My legs {ached} for days after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后我的腿酸痛了好几天。

e.en: He {ached} to see his family back home.
e.zh: 他渴望见到老家的亲人。

aches.t: n./v. 疼痛 (ache 的复数/三单)

e.en: The flu often causes muscle {aches} and a high fever.
e.zh: 流感常常引起肌肉酸痛和高烧。

e.en: My head {aches} whenever I stare at the screen too long.
e.zh: 我一旦盯着屏幕太久,头就发疼。

achievable.t: adj. 可实现的，可达到的

e.en: Setting small, {achievable} goals keeps you motivated each week.
e.zh: 设定一些小而可实现的目标能让你每周保持动力。

e.en: A promotion within two years is {achievable} with hard work.
e.zh: 只要努力，两年内升职是可以实现的。

e.en: She worked overtime to {achieve} her sales target.
e.zh: 她加班加点以达成销售目标。

e.en: You can {achieve} a lot by reading thirty minutes daily.
e.zh: 每天读三十分钟书就能收获很多。

achieved.t: v. achieve 的过去式，已实现

e.en: The startup {achieved} profitability in just two years.
e.zh: 这家初创公司仅用两年就实现了盈利。

e.en: She finally {achieved} the fluency she had dreamed of.
e.zh: 她终于达到了梦寐以求的流利程度。

e.en: Graduating debt-free was a major {achievement} for him.
e.zh: 无负债毕业对他来说是一项重大成就。

e.en: The game rewards every {achievement} with a shiny badge.
e.zh: 游戏会用闪亮徽章奖励每一项成就。

e.en: Her resume lists impressive {achievements} in data science.
e.zh: 她的简历上列着数据科学方面的亮眼成就。

e.en: The museum celebrates the scientific {achievements} of women.
e.zh: 这家博物馆颂扬女性在科学上的成就。

e.en: She is a high {achiever} who never misses a deadline.
e.zh: 她是个高成就者，从不错过任何截止日期。

e.en: Every {achiever} on the team got a bonus this quarter.
e.zh: 团队里每位业绩出众者本季度都拿到了奖金。

e.en: This algorithm {achieves} better accuracy with less data.
e.zh: 该算法用更少的数据就能取得更高的准确率。

e.en: He rarely {achieves} much when he skips breakfast.
e.zh: 他不吃早餐时通常做不成什么事。

achieving.t: v. achieve 的现在分词，正在实现

e.en: {Achieving} work-life balance takes constant adjustment.
e.zh: 实现工作与生活的平衡需要不断调整。

e.en: She is close to {achieving} her weight-loss goal.
e.zh: 她快要达成她的减肥目标了。

e.en: Public speaking is his {Achilles} heel during interviews.
e.zh: 公开演讲是他面试中的致命弱点。

e.en: The runner tore his {Achilles} tendon during the marathon.
e.zh: 那位跑者在马拉松中撕裂了跟腱。

e.en: After the hike my legs were {aching} all night.
e.zh: 徒步之后我的双腿一整夜都酸痛不已。

e.en: She felt an {aching} loneliness after moving abroad.
e.zh: 搬到国外后她感到一种深切的孤独。

achingly.t: adv. 令人心痛地，极其地

e.en: The film is {achingly} beautiful from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都美得令人心痛。

e.en: His voice sounded {achingly} familiar over the phone.
e.zh: 他的声音在电话里听起来熟悉得让人心酸。

e.en: The telescope uses an {achromat} to reduce color fringing.
e.zh: 这台望远镜用消色差透镜来减少色边。

e.en: Photographers prize this vintage {achromat} lens for sharpness.
e.zh: 摄影师们因清晰度而珍视这枚老式消色差镜头。

e.en: The designer chose an {achromatic} palette of black and grey.
e.zh: 设计师选用了黑白灰的无彩色调。

e.en: An {achromatic} lens corrects two wavelengths to one focus.
e.zh: 消色差透镜能让两种波长聚焦到同一点。

e.en: I feel {achy} all over after yesterday's workout.
e.zh: 昨天锻炼之后我浑身酸痛。

e.en: A fever often makes you tired and {achy}.
e.zh: 发烧常常会让人疲乏酸痛。

acid.t:
n. 酸
adj. 酸性的；尖刻的

e.en: Lemons contain a lot of citric {acid}.
e.zh: 柠檬含有大量柠檬酸。

e.en: Her review had an {acid} tone that stung the author.
e.zh: 她那篇尖刻的评论让作者很受伤。

e.en: Coffee can be too {acidic} for sensitive stomachs.
e.zh: 咖啡对肠胃敏感的人来说可能过于刺激。

e.en: Blueberries grow best in slightly {acidic} soil.
e.zh: 蓝莓最适合生长在微酸性土壤中。

e.en: Ocean {acidification} threatens coral reefs worldwide.
e.zh: 海洋酸化正威胁着全球的珊瑚礁。

e.en: Soil {acidification} reduces crop yields over time.
e.zh: 土壤酸化会逐渐降低作物产量。

acidified.t: v. acidify 的过去式，使酸化

e.en: The chef {acidified} the sauce with a splash of vinegar.
e.zh: 厨师加了一点醋让酱汁变酸。

e.en: Rainwater has {acidified} many lakes in this region.
e.zh: 雨水已使该地区许多湖泊酸化。

e.en: Adding lemon juice will {acidify} the marinade nicely.
e.zh: 加点柠檬汁能让腌料变酸，味道更好。

e.en: Industrial emissions can {acidify} nearby rivers.
e.zh: 工业排放会让附近的河流酸化。

e.en: The wine's bright {acidity} pairs well with seafood.
e.zh: 这款酒明亮的酸度很配海鲜。

e.en: High {acidity} in your stomach can cause heartburn.
e.zh: 胃酸过高会引起胃灼热。

e.en: "How original," she remarked {acidly} after his joke.
e.zh: 听完他的笑话她尖刻地说："真有创意啊。"

e.en: He responded {acidly} to the unfair criticism.
e.zh: 他对那番不公平的批评尖酸地回应。

e.en: Yogurt with {acidophilus} can support your gut health.
e.zh: 含嗜酸乳杆菌的酸奶有助于肠道健康。

e.en: The doctor recommended an {acidophilus} supplement after antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生建议在抗生素疗程后服用嗜酸菌补充剂。

e.en: Diabetic {acidosis} requires immediate medical attention.
e.zh: 糖尿病酸中毒需要立即就医。

e.en: Severe dehydration can lead to metabolic {acidosis}.
e.zh: 严重脱水可能导致代谢性酸中毒。

e.en: Strong {acids} should always be stored in glass containers.
e.zh: 强酸应当始终存放在玻璃容器中。

e.en: Fatty {acids} are essential for brain development.
e.zh: 脂肪酸对大脑发育至关重要。

e.en: The biopsy showed inflammation of the {acinar} cells.
e.zh: 活检显示腺泡细胞出现炎症。

e.en: Pancreatic {acinar} tissue produces digestive enzymes.
e.zh: 胰腺腺泡组织负责分泌消化酶。

e.en: {Ackee} and saltfish is Jamaica's national dish.
e.zh: 阿开木果配咸鱼是牙买加的国菜。

e.en: Unripe {ackee} can be dangerously toxic to eat.
e.zh: 未成熟的阿开木果食用起来可能有剧毒。

e.en: The discovery of penicillin was largely {accidental}.
e.zh: 青霉素的发现在很大程度上是偶然的。

e.en: She apologized for the {accidental} damage to his laptop.
e.zh: 她为不小心弄坏他的笔记本电脑道了歉。

e.en: I {accidentally} deleted the file I was working on.
e.zh: 我不小心删掉了正在编辑的文件。

e.en: She {accidentally} called her boss instead of her husband.
e.zh: 她不小心把电话打给了老板,而不是丈夫。

accidently.t: adv. 意外地（accidentally 的非标准拼写）

e.en: He {accidently} sent the message to the wrong group chat.
e.zh: 他不小心把消息发到了错的群里。

e.en: I {accidently} spilled coffee all over my keyboard.
e.zh: 我不小心把咖啡洒得键盘上到处都是。

e.en: Most road {accidents} are caused by distracted driving.
e.zh: 大多数交通事故都是由分心驾驶引起的。

e.en: Workplace {accidents} have decreased due to safety training.
e.zh: 由于安全培训,工伤事故有所减少。

acclaim.t:
v. 称赞，欢呼
n. 赞誉

e.en: Her debut novel received international {acclaim} last year.
e.zh: 她的处女作小说去年获得了国际赞誉。

e.en: Critics {acclaim} the film as the best of the decade.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这部电影为十年来最佳。

acclaimed.t: adj. 广受好评的，备受称赞的

e.en: The {acclaimed} director won three Oscars this year.
e.zh: 这位备受赞誉的导演今年赢得了三项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: Her performance was widely {acclaimed} by audiences.
e.zh: 她的表演受到了观众的广泛赞誉。

e.en: The new chairman was elected by {acclamation}.
e.zh: 新主席以欢呼方式获得一致推选。

e.en: The speech was met with loud {acclamation} from the crowd.
e.zh: 演讲赢得了人群的热烈欢呼。

e.en: It takes time to {acclimate} to a new country.
e.zh: 适应一个新国家需要时间。

e.en: Hikers should {acclimate} slowly to high altitudes.
e.zh: 登山者应该慢慢适应高海拔环境。

e.en: {Acclimation} to office life took her several weeks.
e.zh: 她花了几周时间才适应办公室生活。

e.en: Plants need a period of {acclimation} after being repotted.
e.zh: 植物在换盆后需要一段适应期。

acclimatisation.t: n. 适应（环境）(英式拼法)

e.en: Climbers spend days on {acclimatisation} before summit attempts.
e.zh: 登山者在冲顶前要花数天时间适应高海拔。

e.en: {Acclimatisation} to the tropical climate took several months.
e.zh: 适应热带气候花了几个月时间。

acclimatise.t: v. 使适应环境（英式拼法）

e.en: It can take weeks to fully {acclimatise} to high altitude.
e.zh: 完全适应高海拔可能需要几周时间。

e.en: New employees need time to {acclimatise} to the company culture.
e.zh: 新员工需要时间来适应公司文化。

e.en: Proper {acclimatization} is essential for climbing Everest safely.
e.zh: 安全攀登珠峰必须做好充分的适应训练。

e.en: The astronauts underwent {acclimatization} after returning to Earth.
e.zh: 宇航员返回地球后进行了适应性训练。

e.en: Give your body a few days to {acclimatize} to the heat.
e.zh: 给身体几天时间来适应炎热的天气。

e.en: The puppy quickly {acclimatize}d to her new home.
e.zh: 这只小狗很快适应了新家。

e.en: After a month, she had fully {acclimatized} to Tokyo life.
e.zh: 一个月后,她已完全适应了东京的生活。

e.en: The plants gradually {acclimatized} to the cooler temperatures.
e.zh: 这些植物逐渐适应了较低的温度。

e.en: Winning the Nobel Prize is the highest {accolade} for a scientist.
e.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖是科学家的最高荣誉。

e.en: Her novel earned the rare {accolade} of universal praise.
e.zh: 她的小说获得了广受赞誉的难得殊荣。

accommodate.t:
v. 容纳，适应
v. 为...提供住宿

e.en: The hotel can {accommodate} up to 500 guests at once.
e.zh: 这家酒店一次最多可接待五百位客人。

e.en: We'll try to {accommodate} your dietary restrictions.
e.zh: 我们会尽量满足你的饮食限制要求。

e.en: The restaurant {accommodated} our large birthday party easily.
e.zh: 这家餐厅轻松接待了我们的大型生日聚会。

e.en: Her schedule was {accommodated} to allow remote work.
e.zh: 她的日程被调整以方便远程办公。

accommodates.t: v. 容纳，适应（第三人称单数）

e.en: This minivan comfortably {accommodates} a family of seven.
e.zh: 这辆小型货车可以舒适地容纳一家七口。

e.en: The flexible policy {accommodates} different working styles.
e.zh: 这一灵活的政策能适应不同的工作方式。

accommodating.t: adj. 乐于助人的，通融的

e.en: The staff was very {accommodating} to our special requests.
e.zh: 员工对我们的特殊要求非常通融。

e.en: She's always {accommodating} when colleagues need help.
e.zh: 同事需要帮助时,她总是乐于配合。

accommodation.t:
n. 住宿，住处
n. 适应，迁就

e.en: Finding affordable {accommodation} in this city is difficult.
e.zh: 在这个城市找到价格合理的住宿很困难。

e.en: The company offers {accommodation} for employees with disabilities.
e.zh: 公司为残障员工提供便利设施。

e.en: Critics called him an {accommodationist} who never challenged the regime.
e.zh: 批评者称他是个从不挑战政权的妥协派。

e.en: The {accommodationist} approach prioritizes dialogue over open confrontation.
e.zh: 这种和解主义路线更看重对话而非正面冲突。

e.en: The hotel offers comfortable {accommodations} for business travelers.
e.zh: 这家酒店为商务旅客提供舒适的住宿。

e.en: Students with disabilities can request testing {accommodations} in advance.
e.zh: 残障学生可以提前申请考试便利安排。

accommodative.t: adj. 乐于通融的，适应性的

e.en: The central bank kept its {accommodative} monetary policy unchanged.
e.zh: 央行维持其宽松的货币政策不变。

e.en: She has an {accommodative} personality that puts everyone at ease.
e.zh: 她性格随和,让每个人都感到自在。

e.en: The CEO {accompanied} the team on their trip to Tokyo.
e.zh: 首席执行官陪同团队前往东京出差。

e.en: Heavy rain {accompanied} the typhoon as it hit the coast.
e.zh: 台风袭击海岸时伴随着倾盆大雨。

accompanies.t: v. 陪伴，伴随（第三人称单数）

e.en: A free dessert {accompanies} every dinner order on weekends.
e.zh: 周末每份晚餐订单都附赠一份甜点。

e.en: Her father always {accompanies} her to medical appointments.
e.zh: 她父亲总是陪她去看病。

accompaniment.t:
n. 伴奏
n. 伴随物

e.en: Roasted vegetables make a perfect {accompaniment} to grilled fish.
e.zh: 烤蔬菜是烤鱼的绝佳配菜。

e.en: She sang the song with piano {accompaniment} from her teacher.
e.zh: 她在老师的钢琴伴奏下演唱了这首歌。

e.en: The young singer thanked her {accompanist} after the recital.
e.zh: 年轻的歌手在独唱会后感谢了她的伴奏者。

e.en: Finding a skilled {accompanist} can transform any vocal performance.
e.zh: 找到一位出色的伴奏者能让任何声乐表演焕然一新。

accompany.t:
v. 陪伴，伴随
v. 为…伴奏

e.en: Children under twelve must be {accompany}ed by an adult.
e.zh: 十二岁以下的儿童必须有成人陪同。

e.en: Would you like me to {accompany} you to the airport?
e.zh: 要我陪你去机场吗?

e.en: Please read the {accompanying} documents before signing the contract.
e.zh: 请在签合同之前阅读随附的文件。

e.en: The fever and {accompanying} headache lasted for three days.
e.zh: 发烧和伴随的头痛持续了三天。

e.en: Police arrested the robber and his {accomplice} at the airport.
e.zh: 警方在机场逮捕了劫匪和他的同伙。

e.en: She refused to be an {accomplice} to her boss's fraud.
e.zh: 她拒绝成为老板欺诈行为的帮凶。

e.en: What do you hope to {accomplish} by the end of this year?
e.zh: 你希望今年年底前完成些什么?

e.en: You can {accomplish} a lot with just thirty focused minutes.
e.zh: 专注三十分钟就能做成不少事情。

e.en: She is an {accomplished} pianist who has toured across Europe.
e.zh: 她是一位才华横溢的钢琴家,曾在欧洲各地巡演。

e.en: The team {accomplished} all their quarterly goals ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 团队提前完成了所有季度目标。

accomplishes.t: v. 完成，达成（第三人称单数）

e.en: This shortcut {accomplishes} the same task in half the time.
e.zh: 这个捷径用一半的时间就能完成同样的任务。

e.en: Yelling rarely {accomplishes} anything productive in a meeting.
e.zh: 在会议上大喊大叫几乎产生不了任何有效的结果。

accomplishing.t: v. 完成，达成（现在分词）

e.en: She felt proud of {accomplishing} the marathon despite the injury.
e.zh: 尽管受伤,她仍为完成马拉松感到自豪。

e.en: We are slowly {accomplishing} the goals listed in the roadmap.
e.zh: 我们正在逐步实现路线图上列出的目标。

e.en: Graduating top of her class was a remarkable {accomplishment}.
e.zh: 以全班第一的成绩毕业是一项了不起的成就。

e.en: He smiled with a sense of {accomplishment} after fixing the bug.
e.zh: 修复这个 bug 后,他露出了成就感满满的微笑。

e.en: List your top three {accomplishments} on the first page of your résumé.
e.zh: 在简历首页列出你最重要的三项成就。

e.en: Her {accomplishments} in cancer research earned her a Nobel Prize.
e.zh: 她在癌症研究方面的成就为她赢得了诺贝尔奖。

accord.t:
n. 协议，一致
v. 符合，给予

e.en: The two countries signed a peace {accord} after years of conflict.
e.zh: 两国在多年冲突后签署了和平协议。

e.en: She left the company of her own {accord} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月主动从公司离职。

accordance.t: n. 一致，依照（常用 in accordance with）

e.en: The data is stored in {accordance} with privacy regulations.
e.zh: 数据按照隐私法规进行存储。

e.en: All employees must act in {accordance} with the company code.
e.zh: 所有员工必须按照公司守则行事。

e.en: The contract lists several {accordances} between the partner firms.
e.zh: 合同列出了合作公司之间的若干一致条款。

e.en: Legal {accordances} between regions help streamline international trade.
e.zh: 地区间的法律一致性有助于简化国际贸易。

e.en: {According} to the weather app, it will rain tomorrow afternoon.
e.zh: 根据天气应用,明天下午会下雨。

e.en: Sales increased by twelve percent, {according} to the latest report.
