e.zh: 根据最新报告,销售额增长了百分之十二。

e.en: The plan changed, so we adjusted our budget {accordingly}.
e.zh: 计划变了,我们也相应调整了预算。

e.en: Read the room and respond {accordingly} during difficult conversations.
e.zh: 在棘手的对话中,要察言观色,作出相应的回应。

e.en: He played a lively folk tune on his old {accordion}.
e.zh: 他用那把旧手风琴演奏了一首欢快的民谣。

e.en: The website uses an {accordion} menu to save vertical space.
e.zh: 该网站使用折叠式菜单以节省垂直空间。

e.en: A street {accordionist} entertained tourists outside the Paris café.
e.zh: 一位街头手风琴手在巴黎咖啡馆外为游客演奏。

e.en: The wedding band hired an {accordionist} for the cocktail hour.
e.zh: 婚礼乐队为鸡尾酒时段聘请了一位手风琴手。

e.en: A stranger tried to {accost} her near the subway entrance.
e.zh: 一个陌生人在地铁入口附近试图搭讪她。

e.en: Reporters {accost}ed the senator as he left the courthouse.
e.zh: 参议员离开法院时,记者们上前围堵询问。

account.t:
n. 账户，账号
n. 描述，说明

e.en: Please log into your {account} to view recent transactions.
e.zh: 请登录您的账户以查看最近的交易记录。

e.en: Her {account} of the accident matched the security footage exactly.
e.zh: 她对事故的描述与监控录像完全吻合。

e.en: The new role comes with broader {accountabilities} across three departments.
e.zh: 新职位涉及跨三个部门的更广泛职责。

e.en: Clear {accountabilities} prevent confusion when projects span multiple teams.
e.zh: 明确的权责划分能避免跨团队项目中的混乱。

e.en: Voters demanded greater {accountability} from elected officials.
e.zh: 选民要求民选官员承担更多问责责任。

e.en: A weekly check-in adds {accountability} to your fitness goals.
e.zh: 每周一次的进度检查能让健身目标更有约束力。

accountable.t: adj. 负有责任的，应说明的

e.en: Managers should be held {accountable} for their team's performance.
e.zh: 管理者应当对团队的表现负责。

e.en: I asked a friend to keep me {accountable} during the diet.
e.zh: 我请一位朋友在节食期间监督我。

e.en: She studied {accountancy} before joining a Big Four firm.
e.zh: 她在加入四大会计师事务所之前学的是会计学。

e.en: Modern {accountancy} relies heavily on cloud-based software tools.
e.zh: 现代会计行业高度依赖基于云端的软件工具。

e.en: My {accountant} files my taxes every spring without any drama.
e.zh: 我的会计师每年春天都会顺利地帮我报税。

e.en: She works as a senior {accountant} at a tech startup.
e.zh: 她在一家科技初创公司担任高级会计师。

e.en: Please {acknowledge} receipt of this email by Friday.
e.zh: 请在周五前回复确认收到此邮件。

e.en: He refused to {acknowledge} that he was wrong.
e.zh: 他拒绝承认自己错了。

acknowledged.t:
adj. 公认的
v. 承认（过去式）

e.en: The CEO {acknowledged} the team's hard work in her speech.
e.zh: CEO在演讲中对团队的辛勤工作表示了肯定。

e.en: She is an {acknowledged} expert in machine learning.
e.zh: 她是公认的机器学习专家。

e.en: He nodded in {acknowledgement} of her warm greeting.
e.zh: 他点头回应她热情的问候。

e.en: The package requires a signed {acknowledgement} on delivery.
e.zh: 这个包裹送达时需要签收确认。

e.en: The author thanked her editor in the {acknowledgements} section.
e.zh: 作者在致谢部分感谢了她的编辑。

e.en: Brief {acknowledgements} appear at the end of the paper.
e.zh: 简短的致谢出现在论文的末尾。

acknowledges.t: v. 承认；确认（第三人称单数）

e.en: The report {acknowledges} that more research is needed.
e.zh: 报告承认还需要进行更多研究。

e.en: She {acknowledges} every comment with a quick reply.
e.zh: 她对每条评论都会快速回复确认。

acknowledging.t: v. 承认；确认（现在分词）

e.en: He walked past without {acknowledging} his old friend.
e.zh: 他从老朋友身边走过却没打招呼。

e.en: {Acknowledging} mistakes early builds trust with your team.
e.zh: 及早承认错误能与团队建立信任。

e.en: Her promotion was an {acknowledgment} of years of effort.
e.zh: 她的升职是对多年付出的肯定。

e.en: Please send an {acknowledgment} when the file arrives.
e.zh: 文件到达后请回复确认。

e.en: The book's {acknowledgments} mention dozens of collaborators.
e.zh: 这本书的致谢部分提到了数十位合作者。

e.en: He skipped straight past the {acknowledgments} to chapter one.
e.zh: 他直接跳过致谢翻到第一章。

e.en: Winning the Nobel Prize marked the {acme} of her career.
e.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖标志着她职业生涯的巅峰。

e.en: The 1960s are seen as the {acme} of jazz innovation.
e.zh: 上世纪六十年代被视为爵士乐创新的巅峰。

e.en: Many teenagers struggle with {acne} during puberty.
e.zh: 许多青少年在青春期都为痤疮所困扰。

e.en: This cleanser is gentle enough for {acne}-prone skin.
e.zh: 这款洁面乳温和到适合易长痘的肌肤。

e.en: The young {acolyte} followed the famous chef everywhere.
e.zh: 那位年轻的追随者无论走到哪里都跟着这位名厨。

e.en: He started as an {acolyte} and became a top researcher.
e.zh: 他从一名小助手起步，最终成为顶尖研究员。

e.en: {Aconite} is a beautiful but highly poisonous garden plant.
e.zh: 乌头是一种美丽却剧毒的园艺植物。

e.en: Old herbalists used {aconite} to treat fevers and pain.
e.zh: 古时的草药师用乌头来治疗发烧和疼痛。

e.en: The squirrel buried an {acorn} under the oak tree.
e.zh: 松鼠把一颗橡子埋在橡树下。

e.en: From a tiny {acorn} grows a mighty oak.
e.zh: 参天橡树由小小的橡子长成。

acoustic.t: adj. 声学的；原声的（乐器）

e.en: She prefers playing {acoustic} guitar at small cafés.
e.zh: 她更喜欢在小咖啡馆里弹原声吉他。

e.en: The hall has excellent {acoustic} properties for orchestras.
e.zh: 这个音乐厅有非常适合管弦乐团的声学效果。

e.en: Engineers added {acoustical} panels to dampen office noise.
e.zh: 工程师们加装了吸音板来减弱办公室噪音。

e.en: The studio underwent an {acoustical} upgrade last spring.
e.zh: 这家录音棚去年春天进行了声学升级。

acoustically.t: adv. 声学上；在音响方面

e.en: This hall is {acoustically} one of the best in Europe.
e.zh: 这座音乐厅在声学上是全欧洲最好的之一。

e.en: The room was {acoustically} treated with thick curtains.
e.zh: 房间用厚窗帘做了吸音处理。

e.en: An {acoustician} helped redesign the noisy restaurant.
e.zh: 一位声学专家帮忙重新设计了那家嘈杂的餐厅。

e.en: The studio hired an {acoustician} to fix the echo.
e.zh: 录音棚请来一位声学师解决回声问题。

e.en: The new concert hall has stunning {acoustics}.
e.zh: 新音乐厅的音响效果令人惊艳。

e.en: Poor {acoustics} made the lecture hard to follow.
e.zh: 糟糕的音效让那场讲座很难听清。

acp.t: n. ACP（多种缩写，如非加太集团）

e.en: The {ACP} cartridge is popular with handgun enthusiasts.
e.zh: ACP弹药在手枪爱好者中很受欢迎。

e.en: He bought a box of .45 {ACP} rounds at the range.
e.zh: 他在靶场买了一盒点45 ACP子弹。

e.en: Let me {acquaint} you with our team's workflow.
e.zh: 我来让你熟悉一下我们团队的工作流程。

e.en: New hires should {acquaint} themselves with the safety rules.
e.zh: 新员工应当熟悉一下安全规则。

e.en: He's just an {acquaintance}, not a close friend.
e.zh: 他只是个熟人，并不是亲密朋友。

e.en: I made her {acquaintance} at a tech conference last year.
e.zh: 去年我在一次科技大会上认识了她。

e.en: She has many {acquaintances} but few real friends.
e.zh: 她认识的人很多，真正的朋友却不多。

e.en: Old {acquaintances} gathered for the high school reunion.
e.zh: 老相识们齐聚一堂参加高中同学会。

e.en: Their brief {acquaintanceship} grew into a lifelong friendship.
e.zh: 他们短暂的相识发展成了一生的友谊。

e.en: Casual {acquaintanceship} can be useful for networking.
e.zh: 普通的相识关系对人脉拓展也很有用。

e.en: We got {acquainted} during a weekend coding bootcamp.
e.zh: 我们在一个周末编程训练营上结识了。

e.en: Are you {acquainted} with the new privacy policy?
e.zh: 你了解新的隐私政策吗？

e.en: She refused to {acquiesce} to the unfair demands.
e.zh: 她拒绝默许这些不公平的要求。

e.en: He chose to {acquiesce} rather than start an argument.
e.zh: 他选择默默接受,而不是挑起争论。

e.en: Her silence was taken as {acquiescence} to the plan.
e.zh: 她的沉默被视为对该计划的默许。

e.en: The deal required the {acquiescence} of all board members.
e.zh: 这项协议需要全体董事会成员的默许。

e.en: He grew tired of being so {acquiescent} at work.
e.zh: 他厌倦了在工作中总是这么顺从。

e.en: An {acquiescent} nod ended the long debate.
e.zh: 一个默许的点头结束了漫长的辩论。

e.en: The startup hopes to {acquire} a smaller rival next year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司希望明年收购一家较小的竞争对手。

e.en: Children {acquire} language remarkably quickly.
e.zh: 孩子们学习语言的速度快得惊人。

acquired.t:
adj. 后天的
v. 获得（过去式）

e.en: Google {acquired} YouTube back in 2006.
e.zh: 谷歌早在2006年就收购了YouTube。

e.en: Strong coffee is an {acquired} taste for many people.
e.zh: 对许多人来说,浓咖啡是一种后天养成的口味。

e.en: The {acquirer} agreed to retain all existing employees.
e.zh: 收购方同意留用所有现有员工。

e.en: Banks act as the {acquirer} in most card transactions.
e.zh: 在大多数刷卡交易中,银行充当收单方。

acquires.t: v. 获得；收购（第三人称单数）

e.en: The brand {acquires} new fans every time it goes viral.
e.zh: 该品牌每次走红都会吸引到新的粉丝。

e.en: Microsoft {acquires} another AI startup this quarter.
e.zh: 微软本季度又收购了一家人工智能初创公司。

acquiring.t: v. 获取；收购（现在分词）

e.en: The company is {acquiring} smaller competitors to expand reach.
e.zh: 该公司正在收购规模较小的竞争对手以扩大业务范围。

e.en: She enjoys {acquiring} new skills through online courses.
e.zh: 她喜欢通过在线课程学习新技能。

e.en: The {acquisition} of TikTok was blocked by regulators.
e.zh: 对TikTok的收购被监管机构阻止了。

e.en: Language {acquisition} happens naturally in early childhood.
e.zh: 语言习得在幼儿时期自然发生。

e.en: The firm announced three major {acquisitions} this year.
e.zh: 该公司今年宣布了三项重大收购。

e.en: Her recent {acquisitions} include rare vintage watches.
e.zh: 她最近购入的物品包括几只稀有的古董手表。

acquisitive.t: adj. 贪求的；渴望得到的

e.en: He has an {acquisitive} eye for valuable artwork.
e.zh: 他对珍贵艺术品有着贪求的眼光。

e.en: The {acquisitive} CEO bought five companies in a year.
e.zh: 这位贪图扩张的CEO一年内收购了五家公司。

e.en: His {acquisitiveness} for power eventually cost him friends.
e.zh: 他对权力的贪求最终让他失去了朋友。

e.en: Modern consumer culture rewards endless {acquisitiveness}.
e.zh: 现代消费文化奖励无止境的占有欲。

e.en: The jury voted to {acquit} the defendant of all charges.
e.zh: 陪审团投票宣告被告所有指控均不成立。

e.en: She managed to {acquit} herself well in the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中表现得相当出色。

e.en: The {acquittal} surprised everyone in the courtroom.
e.zh: 这一无罪判决让法庭上的所有人都感到意外。

e.en: His lawyers celebrated the unexpected {acquittal}.
e.zh: 他的律师们为这意外的无罪判决而庆祝。

e.en: They bought a quiet {acre} of land near the lake.
e.zh: 他们在湖边买下了一英亩安静的土地。

e.en: Every {acre} of the farm is used for organic crops.
e.zh: 农场的每一英亩土地都种植有机作物。

e.en: The ranch's total {acreage} exceeds two thousand.
e.zh: 该牧场的总面积超过两千英亩。

e.en: Farmers are reducing corn {acreage} this season.
e.zh: 农民们本季正在减少玉米的种植面积。

e.en: Large {acreages} are becoming harder to find near cities.
e.zh: 在城市附近,大片的土地越来越难找到了。

e.en: The report compares {acreages} planted across five states.
e.zh: 该报告比较了五个州的种植面积。

acres.t: n. 英亩（复数）；大片土地

e.en: The estate covers fifty {acres} of rolling hills.
e.zh: 这片庄园占地五十英亩,绵延起伏。

e.en: Wildfires destroyed thousands of {acres} of forest.
e.zh: 野火烧毁了数千英亩的森林。

e.en: An {acrid} smell of smoke filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 厨房里弥漫着一股刺鼻的烟味。

e.en: The debate took an {acrid} tone toward the end.
e.zh: 辩论到最后变得火药味十足。

e.en: Their divorce became increasingly {acrimonious} over money.
e.zh: 他们的离婚因金钱问题变得越来越针锋相对。

e.en: The meeting ended in an {acrimonious} shouting match.
e.zh: 会议在激烈的争吵中结束。

e.en: The merger talks broke down amid public {acrimony}.
e.zh: 合并谈判在公开的激烈争执中破裂。

e.en: There was no {acrimony} between the former partners.
e.zh: 前合伙人之间并无怨恨。

e.en: The {acrobat} balanced gracefully on a single rope.
e.zh: 那位杂技演员优雅地在一根绳子上保持平衡。

e.en: Her son dreams of becoming a circus {acrobat}.
e.zh: 她儿子梦想成为一名马戏团杂技演员。

e.en: The goalkeeper made an {acrobatic} save in extra time.
e.zh: 守门员在加时赛中做出了一次精彩的鱼跃扑救。

e.en: Her {acrobatic} dance routine wowed the audience.
e.zh: 她杂技般的舞蹈表演震撼了观众。

e.en: He leapt {acrobatically} over the fallen barrier.
e.zh: 他像杂技演员一样跃过倒下的障碍物。

e.en: The cat landed {acrobatically} on the narrow ledge.
e.zh: 那只猫灵巧地落在狭窄的窗台上。

e.en: The fighter jets performed stunning aerial {acrobatics}.
e.zh: 战斗机表演了令人惊叹的空中特技。

e.en: Her financial {acrobatics} kept the company afloat.
e.zh: 她的财务腾挪让公司免于破产。

acronym.t: n. 首字母缩写词（如 NASA）

e.en: NASA is a familiar {acronym} for the space agency.
e.zh: NASA是该航天机构众所周知的首字母缩写。

e.en: Tech companies love inventing a new {acronym} every week.
e.zh: 科技公司每周都喜欢发明一个新的缩略词。

e.en: His {acrophobia} keeps him off tall buildings entirely.
e.zh: 他的恐高症让他完全不敢上高楼。

e.en: She overcame her {acrophobia} by climbing small hills first.
e.zh: 她通过先爬小山丘克服了恐高症。

e.en: Tourists climbed to the {acropolis} at sunrise.
e.zh: 游客们在日出时分爬上了卫城。

e.en: The ancient {acropolis} dominates the Athens skyline.
e.zh: 古老的卫城在雅典的天际线上格外醒目。

across.t:
prep. 穿过；横跨
adv. 在对面

e.en: The cafe is just {across} the street from my office.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆就在我办公室对面。

e.en: This trend is spreading {across} social media platforms.
e.zh: 这种潮流正在各大社交媒体平台上蔓延。

acrylic.t:
adj. 丙烯酸的
n. 亚克力；丙烯颜料

e.en: She painted the canvas with bright {acrylic} colors.
e.zh: 她用鲜艳的丙烯颜料在画布上作画。

e.en: This sweater is made from soft {acrylic} fibers.
e.zh: 这件毛衣是用柔软的腈纶纤维制成的。

act.t:
v. 行动；表演
n. 行为；法案

e.en: We need to {act} quickly before the offer expires.
e.zh: 我们得趁这个优惠到期前赶紧行动。

e.en: She landed her first big {act} in a Broadway play.
e.zh: 她在一部百老汇剧中获得了第一个重要角色。

acted.t: v. act 的过去式；行动；表演

e.en: He {acted} immediately when he saw the smoke.
e.zh: 他一看到烟就立刻采取了行动。

e.en: She {acted} in dozens of films before retiring.
e.zh: 退休前她出演过几十部电影。

e.en: {Actin} filaments give muscle cells their structure.
e.zh: 肌动蛋白丝赋予肌肉细胞结构。

e.en: Researchers studied how {actin} drives cell movement.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了肌动蛋白如何驱动细胞运动。

acting.t:
n. 表演
adj. 代理的

e.en: Her {acting} in the new series has been widely praised.
e.zh: 她在新剧中的演技受到广泛好评。

e.en: The deputy is {acting} as CEO until a replacement is found.
e.zh: 在找到接替者之前,副手暂代首席执行官一职。

actinic.t: adj. 光化的；光化学作用的

e.en: Years of sun exposure caused {actinic} damage to her skin.
e.zh: 多年的日晒造成了她皮肤的光化性损伤。

e.en: The dermatologist treated several {actinic} keratoses.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生治疗了几处光化性角化病。

e.en: {Actinomycin} D is used to treat certain childhood cancers.
e.zh: 放线菌素D用于治疗某些儿童癌症。

e.en: Scientists discovered {actinomycin} from soil bacteria.
e.zh: 科学家从土壤细菌中发现了放线菌素。

action.t:
n. 行动；动作
v. 采取行动处理

e.en: The government promised swift {action} on climate change.
e.zh: 政府承诺在气候变化问题上迅速采取行动。

e.en: This button triggers the same {action} as pressing Enter.
e.zh: 这个按钮触发的操作和按回车键相同。

actionable.t: adj. 可执行的；可操作的

e.en: The report offers {actionable} insights for product teams.
e.zh: 该报告为产品团队提供了可执行的洞见。

e.en: Without evidence, the complaint isn't legally {actionable}.
e.zh: 没有证据,这项投诉在法律上无法立案。

actions.t: n. 行动；操作（action 复数）

e.en: Your {actions} speak much louder than your words.
e.zh: 你的行动远比你的言语更有说服力。

e.en: GitHub {actions} automate our deployment pipeline.
e.zh: GitHub Actions自动化了我们的部署流程。

e.en: Tap the link to {activate} your new account.
e.zh: 点击链接以激活您的新账户。

e.en: Cold weather can {activate} symptoms of asthma.
e.zh: 寒冷天气可能会引发哮喘症状。

e.en: She {activated} her phone using a fingerprint scan.
e.zh: 她用指纹扫描激活了手机。

e.en: Carbon filters use {activated} charcoal to purify water.
e.zh: 碳过滤器使用活性炭来净化水。

activates.t: v. 激活（activate 第三人称单数）

e.en: This shortcut {activates} the screen reader instantly.
e.zh: 这个快捷键能立即启动屏幕阅读器。

e.en: Sunlight {activates} vitamin D production in the skin.
e.zh: 阳光促进皮肤合成维生素D。

activating.t: v. 正在激活（activate 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent the afternoon {activating} his new SIM card.
e.zh: 他花了一下午时间激活新的SIM卡。

e.en: Stretching helps in {activating} stiff muscles before runs.
e.zh: 跑步前拉伸有助于唤醒僵硬的肌肉。

e.en: Account {activation} usually takes about five minutes.
e.zh: 账户激活通常需要大约五分钟。

e.en: The drug works by blocking receptor {activation}.
e.zh: 这种药物通过阻断受体激活而起作用。

activations.t: n. 激活次数（activation 复数）

e.en: The campaign drove millions of new app {activations}.
e.zh: 这次营销活动带来了数百万次新应用激活。

e.en: Neural network {activations} reveal what the model learned.
e.zh: 神经网络的激活值揭示了模型所学到的内容。

e.en: Yeast acts as an {activator} in the bread-making process.
e.zh: 酵母在制作面包的过程中起到激活剂的作用。

e.en: This gene serves as an {activator} for cell division.
e.zh: 该基因作为细胞分裂的激活因子。

e.en: He stays {active} by cycling to work every day.
e.zh: 他每天骑车上下班来保持运动。

e.en: The app has over a million {active} users monthly.
e.zh: 该应用每月活跃用户超过一百万。

e.en: She is {actively} looking for a remote engineering role.
e.zh: 她正在积极寻找一份远程工程师的工作。

e.en: The team {actively} monitors security threats around the clock.
e.zh: 团队全天候积极监控安全威胁。

activism.t: n. 行动主义；维权运动

e.en: Her climate {activism} has inspired students worldwide.
e.zh: 她的气候行动主义激励了世界各地的学生。

e.en: Online {activism} can quickly turn into real-world change.
e.zh: 网络行动主义可以迅速转化为现实世界的改变。

e.en: The young {activist} addressed the United Nations assembly.
e.zh: 这位年轻的活动家在联合国大会上发言。

e.en: An {activist} investor pushed the board to cut costs.
e.zh: 一位激进派投资者推动董事会削减成本。

activists.t: n. 活动人士（activist 复数）

e.en: Climate {activists} blocked traffic outside the conference center.
e.zh: 气候活动人士堵住了会议中心外的交通。

e.en: Several {activists} were interviewed for the documentary.
e.zh: 几位社运人士接受了这部纪录片的采访。

e.en: The app tracks your daily {activities} and sleep patterns.
e.zh: 这款应用会追踪你每天的活动和睡眠模式。

e.en: After-school {activities} include coding club and soccer.
e.zh: 课后活动包括编程社和足球。

e.en: There's been unusual login {activity} on your account.
e.zh: 你的账户出现了异常的登录活动。

e.en: Hiking is my favorite weekend {activity}.
e.zh: 徒步是我最喜欢的周末活动。

e.en: We drove through {Acton} on our way to Boston.
e.zh: 我们去波士顿的路上经过了阿克顿镇。

e.en: Lord {Acton} famously wrote about power and corruption.
e.zh: 阿克顿勋爵关于权力与腐败的名言广为流传。

e.en: The lead {actor} forgot his lines during rehearsal.
e.zh: 主演在排练时忘了台词。

e.en: Russia is considered a major {actor} in the conflict.
e.zh: 俄罗斯被视为这场冲突中的主要参与方。

e.en: The {actors} rehearsed the scene for three hours.
e.zh: 演员们把这场戏排练了三个小时。

e.en: Many {actors} in this drama are political insiders.
e.zh: 这场戏中的许多角色都是政界内部人士。

e.en: The {actress} won an Oscar for her debut role.
e.zh: 这位女演员凭借处女作获得了奥斯卡奖。

e.en: She trained as an {actress} before becoming a director.
e.zh: 她在成为导演之前接受过演员训练。

e.en: Several famous {actresses} attended the charity gala.
e.zh: 几位著名女演员出席了慈善晚宴。

e.en: Both {actresses} were nominated for the same award.
e.zh: 两位女演员都获得了同一奖项的提名。

acts.t: n./v. 行为；表演（act 复数/三单）

e.en: The play has three {acts} and a short intermission.
e.zh: 这出戏有三幕,中间有一段短暂的幕间休息。

e.en: Small {acts} of kindness can change someone's day.
e.zh: 小小的善举就能改变一个人的一天。

e.en: The {actual} cost was much higher than the estimate.
e.zh: 实际费用比预算高出了不少。

e.en: What were her {actual} words during the meeting?
e.zh: 她在会上实际说了什么?

actualise.t: v. 实现；使成为现实（英式拼写）

e.en: The startup hopes to {actualise} its vision next year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司希望明年实现自己的愿景。

e.en: Good leaders help their teams {actualise} their potential.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会帮助团队充分发挥潜力。

e.en: In {actuality}, the project took twice as long.
e.zh: 实际上,这个项目花了两倍的时间。

e.en: The plan sounds great but lacks {actuality}.
e.zh: 这个计划听起来不错,但缺乏实质内容。

e.en: Self-{actualization} sits at the top of Maslow's hierarchy.
e.zh: 自我实现位于马斯洛需求层次的顶端。

e.en: The {actualization} of the plan required years of effort.
e.zh: 该计划的实现耗费了多年的努力。

e.en: Therapy helped her {actualize} her long-buried dreams.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮助她实现了埋藏已久的梦想。

e.en: It takes discipline to {actualize} a creative idea.
e.zh: 将创意付诸实现需要自律。

e.en: She finally {actualized} her dream of opening a bakery.
e.zh: 她终于实现了开一家面包店的梦想。

e.en: He seems calm and fully {actualized} as a person.
e.zh: 他显得平静,作为一个人已经完全自我实现了。

e.en: I {actually} prefer tea over coffee in the morning.
e.zh: 早上我其实更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

e.en: Did the meeting {actually} start on time today?
e.zh: 今天会议真的准时开始了吗?

actuarial.t: adj. 精算的；保险统计的

e.en: She passed three {actuarial} exams in one year.
e.zh: 她一年内通过了三门精算师考试。

e.en: The premium is based on detailed {actuarial} tables.
e.zh: 保费是根据详细的精算表计算的。

e.en: My cousin works as an {actuary} for an insurance firm.
e.zh: 我表哥在一家保险公司当精算师。

e.en: The {actuary} calculated the expected payout carefully.
e.zh: 精算师仔细计算了预期赔付金额。

e.en: Press this lever to {actuate} the emergency brake.
e.zh: 按下这个手柄即可启动紧急制动。

e.en: Heat sensors {actuate} the sprinklers automatically.
e.zh: 热传感器会自动触发喷水装置。

e.en: The valve's {actuation} time is under one second.
e.zh: 该阀门的启动时间不到一秒。

e.en: Mechanical keyboards have a satisfying tactile {actuation}.
e.zh: 机械键盘的触发手感非常令人满意。

e.en: The robot's arm uses a hydraulic {actuator}.
e.zh: 机器人的手臂使用液压执行器。

e.en: A faulty {actuator} caused the door to jam.
e.zh: 执行器故障导致门卡住了。

e.en: Eagles have remarkable visual {acuity} from great heights.
e.zh: 鹰即使在高空也具有非凡的视觉敏锐度。

e.en: Her mental {acuity} hasn't faded with age.
e.zh: 她的思维敏锐度并未随年龄衰退。

e.en: Her business {acumen} turned the small shop into a chain.
e.zh: 她的商业头脑把这家小店发展成了连锁。

e.en: The lawyer is known for his sharp legal {acumen}.
e.zh: 这位律师以敏锐的法律洞察力著称。

e.en: The clinic offers free counseling for recovering {addicts}.
e.zh: 该诊所为康复中的成瘾者提供免费咨询。

e.en: Coffee {addicts} crowd the cafe every morning.
e.zh: 咖啡控们每天早上挤满了这家咖啡馆。

adding.t: v. 添加；增加（add 的现在分词）

e.en: She is {adding} avocado to her toast.
e.zh: 她正在往吐司上加牛油果。

e.en: We're {adding} two new engineers to the team.
e.zh: 我们要给团队再加两名工程师。

e.en: The bus stops at {Addington} station every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 巴士每十五分钟在阿丁顿站停一次。

e.en: Mr. {Addington} taught history at our school for decades.
e.zh: 阿丁顿先生在我们学校教了几十年历史。

addis.t: n. 阿迪斯（人名，常指埃塞俄比亚首都 Addis Ababa）

e.en: Our flight lands in {Addis} Ababa just before dawn.
e.zh: 我们的航班在黎明前降落在亚的斯亚贝巴。

e.en: {Addis} hosts the headquarters of the African Union.
e.zh: 亚的斯亚贝巴是非洲联盟总部所在地。

addition.t:
n. 添加；增加
n. 加法

e.en: The new playground is a great {addition} to the park.
e.zh: 新游乐场是公园的一大亮点补充。

e.en: My daughter is learning {addition} in first grade.
e.zh: 我女儿在一年级正在学加法。

e.en: Please provide {additional} documents for your visa application.
e.zh: 请为您的签证申请提供更多文件。

e.en: There's an {additional} fee for express delivery.
e.zh: 快递服务需要额外收费。

additionality.t: n. 额外性（新增效益，常用于环保/资助语境）

e.en: Carbon offset projects must demonstrate clear {additionality}.
e.zh: 碳抵消项目必须证明明显的额外性。

e.en: Auditors questioned the {additionality} of the funding.
e.zh: 审计人员对该笔资金的额外性提出了质疑。

e.en: {Additionally}, the package includes a free phone case.
e.zh: 此外,套餐还包含一个免费手机壳。

e.en: She speaks Mandarin and, {additionally}, fluent French.
e.zh: 她会说普通话,此外还能讲流利的法语。

e.en: The menu has several exciting {additions} this season.
e.zh: 这一季菜单上新增了几道很棒的菜品。

e.en: Recent {additions} to the team have boosted morale.
e.zh: 团队近期的新成员提振了士气。

additive.t:
n. 添加剂
adj. 累加的

e.en: This juice contains no artificial color or {additive}.
e.zh: 这款果汁不含任何人工色素或添加剂。

e.en: {Additive} manufacturing is reshaping aerospace design.
e.zh: 增材制造正在重塑航空航天设计。

e.en: Many parents avoid snacks loaded with chemical {additives}.
e.zh: 许多家长避免给孩子吃含有化学添加剂的零食。

e.en: Fuel {additives} can improve engine performance.
e.zh: 燃油添加剂可以提升发动机性能。

e.en: Too much screen time can {addle} a tired brain.
e.zh: 长时间盯屏幕会让疲惫的大脑变得迟钝。

e.en: Strong cocktails tend to {addle} my thinking quickly.
e.zh: 烈性鸡尾酒很快就会让我的思路变得混乱。

e.en: She felt {addled} after pulling an all-nighter.
e.zh: 熬了一整夜后她感觉脑袋一片混沌。

e.en: The jet lag left him completely {addled}.
e.zh: 时差让他整个人都晕头转向。

address.t:
n. 地址
v. 处理；应对

e.en: Please enter your shipping {address} at checkout.
e.zh: 请在结账时填写收货地址。

e.en: The CEO will {address} the team this afternoon.
e.zh: 首席执行官今天下午将向团队发表讲话。

addressable.t: adj. 可寻址的；可触达的

e.en: The total {addressable} market is over ten billion dollars.
e.zh: 潜在可触及市场总规模超过一百亿美元。

e.en: Each LED on the strip is individually {addressable}.
e.zh: 灯带上的每颗 LED 都可以单独寻址控制。

addressed.t: v. 已处理；已解决（address 的过去式）

e.en: She {addressed} the package to her grandmother.
e.zh: 她把包裹的收件人写成了奶奶。

e.en: The manager {addressed} our concerns at the meeting.
e.zh: 经理在会上回应了我们的疑虑。

e.en: The {addressee} was not home, so we left a note.
e.zh: 收件人不在家,我们留了张便条。

e.en: Please verify the {addressee} before sealing the envelope.
e.zh: 封口前请核对一下收件人信息。

e.en: The email had over fifty {addressees} in the cc field.
e.zh: 这封邮件抄送栏里有五十多位收件人。

e.en: All {addressees} must confirm receipt by Friday.
e.zh: 所有收件人必须在周五前确认收到。

addresses.t:
n. 地址（复数）
v. 处理；致辞

e.en: Save your favorite {addresses} for faster checkout.
e.zh: 保存常用地址可以让结账更快捷。

e.en: The article {addresses} common myths about sleep.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨了关于睡眠的常见误解。

addressing.t:
v. 处理；应对
n. 寻址（计算机）

e.en: The team is {addressing} bugs reported by users.
e.zh: 团队正在处理用户反馈的错误。

e.en: She's {addressing} envelopes for the wedding invitations.
e.zh: 她正在为婚礼请柬写信封地址。

adds.t: v. 添加；增加（add 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Garlic really {adds} flavor to this pasta.
e.zh: 大蒜确实给这道意面增添了不少风味。

e.en: The new feature {adds} value for premium users.
e.zh: 新功能为付费用户带来了更多价值。

e.en: The lawyer could {adduce} no evidence for the claim.
e.zh: 律师拿不出任何证据来支持这一说法。

e.en: Researchers {adduce} several studies to support their theory.
e.zh: 研究人员引用了多项研究来支持他们的理论。

adduct.t:
n. 加合物（化学）
v. 内收

e.en: The chemist isolated a stable {adduct} from the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家从反应中分离出一种稳定的加合物。

e.en: Try to {adduct} your arms toward your body.
e.zh: 试着把手臂向身体方向内收。

adduction.t: n. 内收（肢体向中线运动）

e.en: Hip {adduction} exercises strengthen your inner thighs.
e.zh: 髋内收训练能强化大腿内侧肌肉。

e.en: The therapist demonstrated proper shoulder {adduction} form.
e.zh: 治疗师演示了正确的肩部内收动作。

e.en: He pulled an {adductor} muscle during the soccer match.
e.zh: 他在足球比赛中拉伤了内收肌。

e.en: Stretch your {adductor} gently before sprinting.
e.zh: 冲刺前要轻轻拉伸一下内收肌。

ade.t: n. 果汁饮料（如 lemonade 的后缀）

e.en: Nothing beats homemade lemon{ade} on a hot afternoon.
e.zh: 炎热的下午没什么比自制柠檬水更解暑。

e.en: She ordered a raspberry {ade} at the cafe.
e.zh: 她在咖啡馆点了一杯覆盆子果汁饮料。

adelaide.t: n. 阿德莱德（澳大利亚城市/女性名）

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring beaches near {Adelaide}.
e.zh: 我们周末在阿德莱德附近的海滩玩了两天。

e.en: {Adelaide} is known for its wine regions and festivals.
e.zh: 阿德莱德以葡萄酒产区和节庆活动闻名。

adelgid.t: n. 球蚜（一种危害针叶树的昆虫）

e.en: The hemlock {adelgid} is killing trees across the forest.
e.zh: 铁杉球蚜正在让森林里的树木大量死亡。

e.en: Foresters spray to control the invasive {adelgid}.
e.zh: 林业人员喷药以控制入侵的球蚜。

adelphi.t: n. 阿德尔菲（地名/大学名）

e.en: She enrolled at {Adelphi} University last fall.
e.zh: 她去年秋天进入阿德菲大学就读。

e.en: We grabbed coffee near the {Adelphi} theatre in London.
e.zh: 我们在伦敦阿德尔菲剧院附近喝了杯咖啡。

aden.t: n. 亚丁（也门港口城市）

e.en: The ship docked safely at the port of {Aden}.
e.zh: 船只安全停靠在亚丁港。

e.en: {Aden} has long been a strategic harbor on the coast.
e.zh: 亚丁长期以来都是沿海的战略港口。

adenine.t: n. 腺嘌呤（DNA 碱基 A）

e.en: {Adenine} pairs with thymine in the DNA double helix.
e.zh: 在 DNA 双螺旋中,腺嘌呤与胸腺嘧啶配对。

e.en: Caffeine's structure is similar to that of {adenine}.
e.zh: 咖啡因的结构与腺嘌呤相似。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed early-stage lung {adenocarcinoma}.
e.zh: 活检结果确认为早期肺腺癌。

e.en: {Adenocarcinoma} often originates in glandular tissues.
e.zh: 腺癌通常起源于腺体组织。

adenoid.t: n. 腺样体（鼻咽部淋巴组织）

e.en: The doctor checked whether the child's {adenoid} tissue was swollen.
e.zh: 医生检查了孩子的腺样体是否肿大。

e.en: Chronic infections can cause the {adenoid} to enlarge in young kids.
e.zh: 慢性感染会导致幼儿腺样体增大。

adenoidal.t: adj. 腺样体的；鼻音重的

e.en: He spoke in an {adenoidal} voice because of his stuffy nose.
e.zh: 由于鼻塞,他说话带着浓重的鼻音。

e.en: The singer's {adenoidal} tone gave the song a quirky charm.
e.zh: 歌手鼻音浓重的嗓音让这首歌别具一格。

e.en: The boy underwent an {adenoidectomy} to help him breathe better at night.
e.zh: 小男孩做了腺样体切除术,以改善夜间呼吸。

e.en: Recovery from an {adenoidectomy} usually takes about a week.
e.zh: 腺样体切除术后通常需要一周左右恢复。

e.en: The biopsy revealed a benign {adenoma} in the colon.
e.zh: 活检发现结肠中有一个良性腺瘤。

e.en: Doctors removed the small {adenoma} during the routine procedure.
e.zh: 医生在常规手术中切除了那个小腺瘤。

e.en: The pathologist identified {adenomatous} polyps that needed removal.
e.zh: 病理学家发现了需要切除的腺瘤性息肉。

e.en: Regular screening helps detect {adenomatous} growths early.
e.zh: 定期筛查有助于及早发现腺瘤性病变。

e.en: The patient presented with cervical {adenopathy} after the infection.
e.zh: 感染后,患者出现了颈部淋巴结病。

e.en: Persistent {adenopathy} should always be evaluated by a doctor.
e.zh: 持续性淋巴结肿大应由医生进行检查。

e.en: Caffeine blocks {adenosine} receptors, which is why coffee keeps you awake.
e.zh: 咖啡因会阻断腺苷受体,这就是咖啡让人保持清醒的原因。

e.en: The cardiologist used {adenosine} to slow the patient's racing heart.
e.zh: 心脏科医生用腺苷来减缓病人加速的心跳。

e.en: An {adenovirus} outbreak swept through the dormitory last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天宿舍爆发了一场腺病毒疫情。

e.en: Some vaccines use a modified {adenovirus} to deliver their payload.
e.zh: 一些疫苗利用改造过的腺病毒来递送有效成分。

adept.t:
adj. 熟练的；擅长的
n. 内行

e.en: She is remarkably {adept} at solving tricky coding problems.
e.zh: 她非常擅长解决棘手的编程问题。

e.en: He became {adept} at negotiating after years in sales.
e.zh: 多年的销售经验让他在谈判方面非常老练。

e.en: The chef {adeptly} sliced the onions without shedding a tear.
e.zh: 厨师熟练地切着洋葱,眼泪都没流。

e.en: She {adeptly} handled the tough questions during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中熟练地应对了那些棘手的问题。

e.en: His {adeptness} with social media helped grow the brand quickly.
e.zh: 他在社交媒体方面的娴熟令品牌迅速成长。

e.en: The team was impressed by her {adeptness} at debugging.
e.zh: 团队对她在调试方面的娴熟印象深刻。

e.en: Only true {adepts} can master this complex martial art.
e.zh: 只有真正的高手才能掌握这门复杂的武术。

e.en: The workshop attracted {adepts} from across the design industry.
e.zh: 该研讨会吸引了设计行业各地的高手。

e.en: The auditor questioned the {adequacy} of our security measures.
e.zh: 审计员对我们安全措施的充分性提出了质疑。

e.en: They tested the {adequacy} of the bridge under heavy loads.
e.zh: 他们测试了桥梁在重载下的承受能力。

e.en: The hotel room was small but {adequate} for one night.
e.zh: 酒店房间不大,但住一晚足够了。

e.en: Make sure you get {adequate} sleep before the exam.
e.zh: 考试前请确保有足够的睡眠。

e.en: The report does not {adequately} address the safety concerns.
e.zh: 该报告未能充分回应安全方面的担忧。

e.en: Please dress {adequately} for the cold weather outside.
e.zh: 外面天气寒冷,请穿戴足够的衣物。

administer.t:
v. 管理；执行
v. 给予（药物等）

e.en: Nurses {administer} the vaccine in three doses.
e.zh: 护士分三剂为患者接种疫苗。

e.en: A small team will {administer} the scholarship fund.
e.zh: 一个小团队将管理这项奖学金基金。

administered.t:
v. administer 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 被管理的

e.en: The hospital {administered} antibiotics within the first hour.
e.zh: 医院在第一小时内就给患者用了抗生素。

e.en: The exam is {administered} online twice a year.
e.zh: 该考试每年在线举行两次。

administering.t:
v. administer 的现在分词
n. 管理；执行

e.en: The pharmacist is {administering} flu shots all weekend.
e.zh: 药剂师整个周末都在为大家接种流感疫苗。

e.en: She is responsible for {administering} the company's pension plan.
e.zh: 她负责管理公司的养老金计划。

administers.t: v. administer 的第三人称单数

e.en: The agency {administers} federal housing programs nationwide.
e.zh: 该机构在全国范围内管理联邦住房项目。

e.en: A trained nurse {administers} the medication every morning.
e.zh: 每天早晨由专业护士给药。

e.en: He was hired to {administrate} the new research grant.
e.zh: 他被聘来管理这项新的研究基金。

e.en: Volunteers help {administrate} the community food bank.
e.zh: 志愿者帮助管理社区食物银行。

administration.t:
n. 管理；行政
n. 政府；当局

e.en: The new {administration} promised tax cuts for small businesses.
e.zh: 新政府承诺为小企业减税。

e.en: School {administration} sent an email about updated policies.
e.zh: 学校行政部门发邮件通知了新政策。

administrations.t:
n. administration 的复数
n. 历届政府

e.en: Several past {administrations} tried to reform healthcare.
e.zh: 过去几届政府都曾试图改革医疗体系。

e.en: University {administrations} are reviewing free speech policies.
e.zh: 各大学校方正在审查言论自由政策。

e.en: She handles all the {administrative} tasks for our team.
e.zh: 她负责我们团队所有的行政事务。

e.en: The {administrative} costs of the program were too high.
e.zh: 该项目的行政成本太高。

e.en: The two regions are {administratively} separate but share resources.
e.zh: 这两个地区行政上独立，但共享资源。

e.en: The proposal was rejected {administratively} without a public vote.
e.zh: 该提案在行政层面被否决，未经公开投票。

administrator.t:
n. 管理员
n. 行政官员

e.en: Contact the system {administrator} to reset your password.
e.zh: 请联系系统管理员重置你的密码。

e.en: The hospital {administrator} oversees a staff of two hundred.
e.zh: 医院管理者负责管理两百名员工。

e.en: School {administrators} met to discuss the budget cuts.
e.zh: 学校管理人员开会讨论了预算削减问题。

e.en: Database {administrators} need to monitor performance daily.
e.zh: 数据库管理员需要每天监控系统性能。

admirable.t: adj. 令人钦佩的；极好的

e.en: Her dedication to volunteer work is truly {admirable}.
e.zh: 她对志愿工作的奉献精神着实令人敬佩。

e.en: The team showed {admirable} patience during the long negotiation.
e.zh: 团队在漫长的谈判中表现出令人钦佩的耐心。

admirably.t: adv. 令人钦佩地；出色地

e.en: She handled the difficult question {admirably} during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中很出色地处理了那个难题。

e.en: The new app performs {admirably} even on older phones.
e.zh: 这款新应用在旧手机上也运行得相当出色。

admiral.t: n. 海军上将；舰队司令

e.en: The {admiral} addressed the crew before the mission began.
e.zh: 任务开始前，海军上将对全体船员讲了话。

e.en: She was promoted to {admiral} after thirty years of service.
e.zh: 服役三十年后，她晋升为海军上将。

e.en: The {Admiralty} announced new shipbuilding contracts this week.
e.zh: 海军部本周宣布了新的造船合同。

e.en: Naval policy is decided at the {admiralty} headquarters.
e.zh: 海军政策由海军部总部决定。

e.en: She gazed at the painting with quiet {admiration}.
e.zh: 她带着无声的赞叹凝视着这幅画。

e.en: His courage earned the {admiration} of his colleagues.
e.zh: 他的勇气赢得了同事们的钦佩。

admirations.t:
n. admiration 的复数
n. 赞赏之情

e.en: The poet expressed her many {admirations} for the natural world.
e.zh: 这位诗人表达了她对大自然的种种赞美。

e.en: His public {admirations} for the artist filled several essays.
e.zh: 他对那位艺术家的公开赞颂写满了好几篇文章。

e.en: I really {admire} how she balances work and family.
e.zh: 我真的很佩服她如何兼顾工作和家庭。

e.en: Tourists stopped to {admire} the cathedral's stained glass.
e.zh: 游客们停下来欣赏大教堂的彩绘玻璃。

admired.t:
v. admire 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 受赞赏的

e.en: She is widely {admired} for her honesty and hard work.
e.zh: 她因诚实和勤奋而广受敬仰。

e.en: He {admired} the sunset from the hotel balcony.
e.zh: 他在酒店阳台上欣赏着日落。

e.en: The singer received flowers from a secret {admirer}.
e.zh: 那位歌手收到了一位神秘仰慕者送的鲜花。

e.en: I'm a longtime {admirer} of her writing style.
e.zh: 我一直很欣赏她的写作风格。

admires.t: v. admire 的第三人称单数

e.en: He {admires} his grandfather for his quiet wisdom.
e.zh: 他敬佩祖父那份沉静的智慧。

e.en: She {admires} the craftsmanship of handmade furniture.
e.zh: 她欣赏手工家具的精湛工艺。

e.en: She gave him an {admiring} look after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲结束后，她向他投去赞许的目光。

e.en: Crowds gathered, {admiring} the fireworks over the harbor.
e.zh: 人群聚集在一起，欣赏港口上空的烟花。

e.en: He spoke {admiringly} of his mentor's career achievements.
e.zh: 他满怀敬佩地谈起了导师的职业成就。

e.en: The students looked {admiringly} at the visiting astronaut.
e.zh: 学生们用钦佩的目光望着来访的宇航员。

admissibility.t: n. 可接受性；（证据）可采性

e.en: The judge will rule on the {admissibility} of the evidence.
e.zh: 法官将就证据的可采性作出裁决。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {admissibility} of the recorded conversation.
e.zh: 律师们就录音对话的可采性进行了辩论。

admissible.t: adj. 可接受的；可采纳的

e.en: The court ruled that the photos were {admissible} as evidence.
e.zh: 法院裁定这些照片可作为证据采纳。

e.en: Hearsay is generally not {admissible} in criminal trials.
e.zh: 传闻证据在刑事审判中通常不被采纳。

admission.t:
n. 准入；入学
n. 承认

e.en: {Admission} to the museum is free on Sundays.
e.zh: 博物馆周日免费入场。

e.en: His {admission} of guilt surprised everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他承认有罪的话让在场所有人都很惊讶。

admissions.t:
n. 招生；录取
n. admission 的复数

e.en: The college received record {admissions} applications this year.
e.zh: 今年这所大学收到了创纪录的入学申请。

e.en: Hospital {admissions} spike during flu season every winter.
e.zh: 每年冬季流感季医院的入院人数都会激增。

admit.t:
v. 承认
v. 准许进入

e.en: I have to {admit} that the food was actually delicious.
e.zh: 我得承认，那食物其实非常好吃。

e.en: The club won't {admit} guests after midnight.
e.zh: 这家俱乐部午夜后不再接待客人。

admits.t: v. admit 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {admits} that learning Chinese has been harder than expected.
e.zh: 她承认学中文比预想的要难。

e.en: The hospital only {admits} emergency cases after hours.
e.zh: 这家医院非工作时间只接收急诊病人。

e.en: The sign read "No {admittance} without authorization."
e.zh: 牌子上写着"未经许可不得入内"。

e.en: He was refused {admittance} to the private club.
e.zh: 他被拒于这家私人俱乐部门外。

admitted.t:
v. admit 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 公认的

e.en: She finally {admitted} that she had made a mistake.
e.zh: 她终于承认自己犯了一个错误。

e.en: He was {admitted} to the hospital with chest pains.
e.zh: 他因胸痛被送进医院。

e.en: The plan is {admittedly} risky, but it could work.
e.zh: 诚然这个计划有风险，但有可能成功。

e.en: {Admittedly}, I haven't read the entire report yet.
e.zh: 老实说，我还没读完整份报告。

e.en: He apologized without ever {admitting} he was wrong.
e.zh: 他道了歉，却始终没承认自己错了。

e.en: The nurse handles patient registration in the {admitting} office.
e.zh: 护士在住院登记处办理病人入院手续。

e.en: The concrete contains an {admixture} to speed up curing.
e.zh: 这种混凝土含有加速凝固的外加剂。

e.en: Her style is an {admixture} of jazz and classical influences.
e.zh: 她的风格融合了爵士与古典两种元素。

e.en: Teachers sometimes {admonish} students for using phones in class.
e.zh: 老师有时会因学生在课堂上玩手机而训诫他们。

e.en: The coach will {admonish} any player who skips practice.
e.zh: 教练会斥责任何缺席训练的队员。

e.en: He received a stern {admonishment} from his supervisor.
e.zh: 他受到了主管严厉的训诫。

e.en: Her gentle {admonishment} reminded the children to be polite.
e.zh: 她温和的告诫提醒孩子们要懂礼貌。

e.en: The teacher gave a stern {admonition} about cheating on exams.
e.zh: 老师就考试作弊一事提出了严厉的告诫。

e.en: Ignore his {admonition} at your own risk.
e.zh: 无视他的警告，后果自负。

e.en: She shot him an {admonitory} glance across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去一个警告的眼神。

e.en: His email had an {admonitory} tone about missed deadlines.
e.zh: 他的邮件带着对错过截止日期的告诫语气。

e.en: The acronym {adn} stands for Associate Degree in Nursing.
e.zh: 缩写 ADN 代表护理副学士学位。

e.en: She earned her {adn} before pursuing a bachelor's degree.
e.zh: 她在攻读学士学位之前先取得了护理副学士学位。

e.en: Without further {ado}, let's begin the meeting.
e.zh: 闲话少说，我们开始开会吧。

e.en: There was much {ado} about the new office policy.
e.zh: 大家对新的办公室政策议论纷纷。

adobe.t:
n. Adobe 公司
n. 土坯；砖坯

e.en: The village houses are built from traditional {adobe} bricks.
e.zh: 村里的房屋是用传统的土坯砖建造的。

e.en: I subscribe to {Adobe} Creative Cloud for design work.
e.zh: 我订阅了 Adobe Creative Cloud 用于设计工作。

adobo.t: n. 阿斗波（菲律宾炖肉料理）

e.en: Filipino chicken {adobo} is my favorite comfort food.
e.zh: 菲律宾阿斗波鸡肉是我最爱的家常菜。

e.en: She marinated the pork in soy sauce and {adobo} spices.
e.zh: 她用酱油和阿斗波香料腌制了猪肉。

adolescence.t: n. 青春期；青少年时期

e.en: Many habits are formed during {adolescence}.
e.zh: 许多习惯都是在青春期养成的。

e.en: Social media has reshaped modern {adolescence}.
e.zh: 社交媒体重塑了现代青少年的成长经历。

adolescent.t:
n. 青少年
adj. 青春期的

e.en: The clinic specializes in {adolescent} mental health.
e.zh: 该诊所专门治疗青少年心理健康问题。

e.en: His humor is a bit {adolescent} for a thirty-year-old.
e.zh: 对一个三十岁的人来说，他的幽默有点幼稚。

e.en: Many {adolescents} struggle with sleep deprivation.
e.zh: 许多青少年都饱受睡眠不足的困扰。

e.en: The app is designed specifically for {adolescents}.
e.zh: 这款应用是专为青少年设计的。

acupressure.t: n. 指压疗法（穴位按摩）

e.en: {Acupressure} on the wrist can help relieve nausea.
e.zh: 按压手腕的穴位有助于缓解恶心。

e.en: She booked an {acupressure} session for her back pain.
e.zh: 她预约了一次穴位按摩来缓解背痛。

e.en: He tried {acupuncture} to treat his chronic migraines.
e.zh: 他尝试用针灸治疗慢性偏头痛。

e.en: {Acupuncture} originated in ancient Chinese medicine.
e.zh: 针灸起源于中国古代医学。

e.en: My {acupuncturist} also recommends herbal remedies.
e.zh: 我的针灸师还会推荐一些草药疗法。

e.en: She trained for years to become a licensed {acupuncturist}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练才成为执业针灸师。

acute.t:
adj. 严重的；敏锐的
adj. 急性的（疾病）

e.en: He was rushed to the ER with {acute} appendicitis.
e.zh: 他因急性阑尾炎被紧急送往急诊室。

e.en: There's an {acute} shortage of nurses in rural areas.
e.zh: 农村地区严重缺乏护士。

e.en: She was {acutely} aware of everyone watching her.
e.zh: 她敏锐地察觉到所有人都在看她。

e.en: The team felt the loss {acutely} after the final match.
e.zh: 决赛之后,团队深切地感受到了失败的痛苦。

e.en: The {acuteness} of his hearing surprised the doctors.
e.zh: 他听觉的敏锐程度让医生们都感到惊讶。

e.en: The crisis grew in {acuteness} as supplies ran out.
e.zh: 随着物资耗尽,危机愈发严峻。

acyclovir.t: n. 阿昔洛韦（抗病毒药）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {acyclovir} for the cold sore outbreak.
e.zh: 医生开了阿昔洛韦来治疗唇疱疹发作。

e.en: {Acyclovir} works best when taken at the first symptoms.
e.zh: 阿昔洛韦在症状刚出现时服用效果最好。

ad-lib.t:
v. 即兴表演
adj. 即兴的

e.en: The host had to {ad-lib} when the guest didn't show up.
e.zh: 嘉宾没出现,主持人只好临场发挥。

e.en: That hilarious line was just an {ad-lib} on set.
e.zh: 那句搞笑的台词只是片场的即兴发挥。

ad-libbed.t: v. 即兴表演（ad-lib 的过去式）

e.en: He {ad-libbed} half his speech after losing his notes.
e.zh: 他丢了讲稿后,一半的演讲都是即兴发挥的。

e.en: The actress {ad-libbed} the funniest line in the film.
e.zh: 片中最搞笑的台词是这位女演员即兴说出的。

ad-libbing.t: v. 即兴表演（ad-lib 的现在分词）

e.en: Stand-up comedians are masters at {ad-libbing} on stage.
e.zh: 脱口秀演员都是台上即兴发挥的高手。

e.en: She kept {ad-libbing} when the teleprompter froze.
e.zh: 提词器卡住后,她一直在即兴发挥。

ad-libs.t:
v. 即兴表演（第三人称单数）
n. 即兴之作

e.en: His clever {ad-libs} kept the audience laughing all night.
e.zh: 他机智的即兴台词让观众笑了一整晚。

e.en: The director loved the {ad-libs} and kept them in.
e.zh: 导演很喜欢这些即兴台词,就保留了下来。

ada.t: n. 艾达（女子名）；Ada 编程语言

e.en: The {Ada} programming language is used in aerospace systems.
e.zh: Ada 编程语言被用于航空航天系统。

e.en: {Ada} Lovelace is often called the first programmer.
e.zh: 埃达·洛夫莱斯常被称为第一位程序员。

e.en: The old {adage} "time is money" still rings true.
e.zh: "时间就是金钱"这句老话至今依然适用。

e.en: My grandfather lived by the {adage} "measure twice, cut once."
e.zh: 我祖父信奉"量两次,切一次"这条格言。

adagio.t:
n. 柔板（音乐）
adv. 缓慢地

e.en: The orchestra played the {adagio} with breathtaking tenderness.
e.zh: 乐团把这段慢板演奏得温柔动人。

e.en: Her favorite movement is the slow {adagio} in Mahler's Fifth.
e.zh: 她最喜欢的乐章是马勒第五交响曲中的慢板。

e.en: {Adam} sent me the project files this morning.
e.zh: 亚当今早把项目文件发给我了。

e.en: The story of {Adam} and Eve appears in Genesis.
e.zh: 亚当与夏娃的故事出现在《创世记》中。

e.en: She was {adamant} about not changing the deadline.
e.zh: 她坚决不肯更改截止日期。

e.en: My parents are {adamant} that I finish university.
e.zh: 我父母坚持要我读完大学。

adamantine.t: adj. 坚硬的；不可动摇的

e.en: His {adamantine} resolve never wavered during negotiations.
e.zh: 他在谈判中坚如磐石的决心从未动摇。

e.en: The hero's sword was forged from {adamantine} steel.
e.zh: 英雄的剑是用坚不可摧的钢铁锻造的。

e.en: He {adamantly} denied any involvement in the leak.
e.zh: 他坚决否认与泄密事件有任何牵连。

e.en: She {adamantly} refused to apologize for her remarks.
e.zh: 她断然拒绝为自己的言论道歉。

adana.t: n. 阿达纳（土耳其城市）

e.en: We tried real {Adana} kebab at a Turkish restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在一家土耳其餐厅尝了正宗的阿达纳烤肉。

e.en: {Adana} is one of the largest cities in Turkey.
e.zh: 阿达纳是土耳其最大的城市之一。

adapt.t:
v. 适应；使适应
v. 改编（作品）

e.en: New employees usually {adapt} to the workflow within weeks.
e.zh: 新员工通常在几周内就能适应工作流程。

e.en: They plan to {adapt} the novel into a Netflix series.
e.zh: 他们计划把这部小说改编成 Netflix 剧集。

e.en: Employers value {adaptability} more than technical skills now.
e.zh: 雇主现在更看重适应能力,而不是技术能力。

e.en: The team's {adaptability} helped them survive the crisis.
e.zh: 团队的适应能力帮助他们度过了危机。

adaptable.t: adj. 能适应的；可改编的

e.en: This recipe is highly {adaptable} to different diets.
e.zh: 这份食谱可以灵活适配不同的饮食习惯。

e.en: She's {adaptable} and thrives in fast-changing environments.
e.zh: 她适应力强,在快速变化的环境中如鱼得水。

adaptation.t:
n. 改编作品
n. 适应；调整

e.en: The film is a loose {adaptation} of the original novel.
e.zh: 这部电影是对原著小说的一次自由改编。

e.en: Camouflage is a clever {adaptation} for survival.
e.zh: 伪装是一种巧妙的生存适应能力。

e.en: The director made several {adaptational} changes for pacing.
e.zh: 导演为节奏做了几处改编上的调整。

e.en: Fans debated the {adaptational} choices in the new series.
e.zh: 粉丝们为新剧的改编选择争论不休。

adaptations.t: n. 改编作品（复数）；适应

e.en: Hollywood keeps producing {adaptations} of classic comic books.
e.zh: 好莱坞不断把经典漫画改编成电影。

e.en: Desert plants have remarkable {adaptations} for storing water.
e.zh: 沙漠植物具有出色的储水适应能力。

adapted.t:
adj. 适合的
v. 改编（adapt 的过去式）

e.en: She quickly {adapted} to working from home full time.
e.zh: 她很快就适应了全职在家办公。

e.en: The play was {adapted} from a short story by Chekhov.
e.zh: 这部戏是根据契诃夫的一篇短篇小说改编的。

adapter.t:
n. 适配器；转接头
n. 改编者

e.en: I forgot to pack a travel {adapter} for Europe.
e.zh: 我忘了带去欧洲用的旅行转换插头。

e.en: You'll need a USB-C {adapter} to connect this monitor.
e.zh: 你需要一个 USB-C 转接头才能连接这台显示器。

adapting.t: v. 适应；改编（adapt 的现在分词）

e.en: She is {adapting} the novel into a screenplay.
e.zh: 她正在把这部小说改编成剧本。

e.en: Teachers are {adapting} their methods for online classes.
e.zh: 老师们正在调整教学方法以适应网课。

e.en: The film is a loose {adaption} of the original book.
e.zh: 这部电影是原著的松散改编版。

e.en: Quick {adaption} to new tools is essential at startups.
e.zh: 在初创公司,快速适应新工具至关重要。

e.en: The app uses {adaptive} brightness based on ambient light.
e.zh: 这款应用根据环境光线自动调节亮度。

e.en: Cats are highly {adaptive} to indoor environments.
e.zh: 猫对室内环境的适应能力很强。

e.en: I need a USB-C {adaptor} for my new laptop.
e.zh: 我的新笔记本需要一个 USB-C 转接头。

e.en: Bring a travel {adaptor} when visiting Europe.
e.zh: 去欧洲旅行时记得带一个转换插头。

adapts.t: v. 适应；改编（第三人称单数）

e.en: The website {adapts} smoothly to mobile screens.
e.zh: 这个网站能流畅适配手机屏幕。

e.en: She quickly {adapts} to whatever team she joins.
e.zh: 她无论加入哪个团队都能很快适应。

adat.t: n. 阿达特（马来习惯法）

e.en: The studio still uses an old {adat} machine for backups.
e.zh: 这家录音室仍用旧的 ADAT 机器做备份。

e.en: He digitized hours of {adat} tapes from the nineties.
e.zh: 他把九十年代的 ADAT 磁带数字化了好几个小时。

e.en: The chip's {adc} samples voltage at one megahertz.
e.zh: 这块芯片的模数转换器以一兆赫采样电压。

e.en: Our {adc} main carries the team in late game.
e.zh: 我们的 ADC 主力在后期带动了整支队伍。

add.t:
v. 添加；增加
v. 相加；求和

e.en: Please {add} milk to the shopping list.
e.zh: 请把牛奶加到购物清单里。

e.en: Tap the plus icon to {add} a new contact.
e.zh: 点击加号图标即可添加新联系人。

added.t:
adj. 额外的
v. 添加（add 的过去式）

e.en: She {added} a touch of salt to the soup.
e.zh: 她在汤里加了一点盐。

e.en: The update {added} dark mode to the app.
e.zh: 这次更新为应用增加了深色模式。

e.en: The contract included three {addenda} about delivery.
e.zh: 合同附有三份关于交付的附录。

e.en: Please review the {addenda} before signing.
e.zh: 签字前请先查看这些附录。

e.en: He attached an {addendum} clarifying the payment terms.
e.zh: 他附上了一份附录,澄清付款条款。

e.en: The textbook has a useful {addendum} on grammar.
e.zh: 这本教材有一份很实用的语法附录。

adder.t:
n. 加法器（电路）
n. 蝰蛇

e.en: A digital {adder} circuit is core to every CPU.
e.zh: 加法器电路是每个 CPU 的核心组件。

e.en: Hikers should watch out for the venomous {adder}.
e.zh: 徒步者要小心有毒的蝰蛇。

addict.t:
n. 瘾君子；痴迷者
v. 使上瘾

e.en: He's a total coffee {addict} in the morning.
e.zh: 他早上是个十足的咖啡控。

e.en: The clinic helps each {addict} build a recovery plan.
e.zh: 这家诊所帮每位成瘾者制定康复计划。

e.en: I'm completely {addicted} to this new puzzle game.
e.zh: 我完全迷上了这款新的解谜游戏。

e.en: He became {addicted} to painkillers after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他对止痛药产生了依赖。

e.en: That short video app is seriously {addicting}.
e.zh: 那款短视频应用真的让人上瘾。

e.en: She finds salt-and-vinegar chips dangerously {addicting}.
e.zh: 她觉得盐醋味薯片让人停不下来。

e.en: Social media {addiction} is a growing concern among teens.
e.zh: 社交媒体成瘾在青少年中越来越令人担忧。

e.en: Her {addiction} to coffee starts every morning at six.
e.zh: 她对咖啡的依赖每天早上六点开始。

e.en: The center treats a wide range of {addictions}.
e.zh: 该中心治疗各种各样的成瘾问题。

e.en: Many small {addictions} quietly shape our daily routines.
e.zh: 许多小小的瘾不知不觉塑造着我们的日常。

addictive.t: adj. 让人上瘾的；使人沉迷的

e.en: This game is dangerously {addictive} once you start.
e.zh: 这款游戏一旦上手就让人欲罢不能。

e.en: Sugar can be as {addictive} as some drugs.
e.zh: 糖的成瘾性可以堪比某些药物。

adhd.t: n. 注意力缺陷多动障碍

e.en: Many adults are diagnosed with {ADHD} only later in life.
e.zh: 许多成年人直到中年才被诊断出多动症。

e.en: Children with {ADHD} often benefit from structured routines.
e.zh: 患有多动症的孩子通常受益于规律的作息。

e.en: All employees must {adhere} to the company's safety guidelines.
e.zh: 所有员工都必须遵守公司的安全规定。

e.en: The label won't {adhere} properly to the wet bottle.
e.zh: 这种标签贴不牢湿瓶子。

adhered.t: v. adhere 的过去式；已黏附、已遵守

e.en: She strictly {adhered} to the diet her doctor recommended.
e.zh: 她严格遵守了医生推荐的饮食方案。

e.en: The sticker {adhered} firmly to the laptop lid.
e.zh: 贴纸牢牢地贴在了笔记本电脑盖上。

e.en: Strict {adherence} to deadlines is expected from every team member.
e.zh: 每位团队成员都需严格遵守截止日期。

e.en: Patient {adherence} to medication greatly improves outcomes.
e.zh: 病人按时服药能显著改善治疗效果。

adherent.t:
n. 拥护者
adj. 黏着的

e.en: She is a devoted {adherent} of minimalist design principles.
e.zh: 她是极简设计理念的忠实拥趸。

e.en: The coating is {adherent} enough to survive years of weather.
e.zh: 这种涂层附着力强,能经受多年的风雨。

adheres.t: v. adhere 的第三人称单数；黏附、遵守

e.en: This tape {adheres} well to glass and metal surfaces.
e.zh: 这种胶带在玻璃和金属表面都能贴得很牢。

e.en: Our company strictly {adheres} to international privacy standards.
e.zh: 我们公司严格遵守国际隐私标准。

adhering.t: v. 正在黏附；遵守（规则）

e.en: By {adhering} to the schedule, we finished the project early.
e.zh: 通过严格遵守进度表,我们提前完成了项目。

e.en: Dust was {adhering} to the screen no matter how often I wiped it.
e.zh: 无论我擦多少次,灰尘还是粘在屏幕上。

e.en: The new glue offers superior {adhesion} on plastic surfaces.
e.zh: 这种新胶水在塑料表面上有出色的粘附力。

e.en: Tire {adhesion} is critical for safe driving in the rain.
e.zh: 轮胎抓地力对雨天安全驾驶至关重要。

e.en: Surgeons sometimes have to remove {adhesions} from previous operations.
e.zh: 外科医生有时不得不清除前次手术留下的粘连。

e.en: Scar {adhesions} can cause chronic pain after abdominal surgery.
e.zh: 腹部手术后疤痕粘连可能引起慢性疼痛。

adhesive.t:
n. 黏合剂
adj. 有黏性的

e.en: Use a strong {adhesive} to mount the shelf on the wall.
e.zh: 用一种强力胶把架子固定在墙上。

e.en: The {adhesive} on the back of the sticker had dried out.
e.zh: 贴纸背面的胶已经干掉了。

e.en: The textbook explains the {adiabatic} compression of gases clearly.
e.zh: 教科书清晰地讲解了气体的绝热压缩。

e.en: An ideal {adiabatic} process exchanges no heat with the surroundings.
e.zh: 理想的绝热过程不与外界交换热量。

e.en: She waved a final {adieu} as the train pulled away.
e.zh: 火车开动时,她挥手作了最后的告别。

e.en: He bid {adieu} to his colleagues after twenty years.
e.zh: 工作二十年后,他向同事们道别。

e.en: He shouted "{adios}!" and sped off on his motorcycle.
e.zh: 他大喊一声“再见!”就骑着摩托车飞驰而去。

e.en: With one click, your old files are {adios} forever.
e.zh: 只要点一下,你的旧文件就永远说再见了。

e.en: The miners entered the mountain through a narrow {adit}.
e.zh: 矿工们从一条狭窄的横坑道进入了山体。

e.en: An old {adit} from the gold rush still marks the hillside.
e.zh: 淘金热时期遗留的一条横坑道至今仍留在山坡上。

e.en: The graph is stored as an {adjacency} list in memory.
e.zh: 该图在内存中以邻接表的形式存储。

e.en: Office {adjacency} to public transit boosted the property's value.
e.zh: 办公室紧邻公共交通,使其地产价值上升。

e.en: My hotel room was {adjacent} to the noisy elevator shaft.
e.zh: 我的酒店房间紧挨着吵闹的电梯井。

e.en: The café sits {adjacent} to a small public park.
e.zh: 咖啡馆紧邻一个小型公园。

e.en: In English, nouns can sometimes serve in an {adjectival} role.
e.zh: 在英语中,名词有时可以充当形容词的角色。

e.en: The teacher highlighted the {adjectival} phrase modifying the noun.
e.zh: 老师着重指出修饰名词的形容词性短语。

e.en: "Bright" is an {adjective} that describes the sunny morning.
e.zh: “明亮的”是一个形容这个阳光明媚早晨的形容词。

e.en: Try replacing each weak {adjective} with a more vivid one.
e.zh: 试着把每个平淡的形容词换成更生动的词。

e.en: Good writers use {adjectives} sparingly to keep prose tight.
e.zh: 优秀的作者会克制使用形容词,以保持文字精炼。

e.en: The kids learned to underline all the {adjectives} in the sentence.
e.zh: 孩子们学会了在句子中划出所有形容词。

e.en: Their backyards {adjoin}, separated only by a low fence.
e.zh: 他们的后院相邻,只隔着一道矮栅栏。

e.en: The two conference rooms {adjoin} through a sliding door.
e.zh: 两个会议室通过一扇推拉门相连。

adjoined.t: v. adjoin 的过去式；已毗连

e.en: The kitchen {adjoined} a sunny breakfast nook.
e.zh: 厨房紧挨着一个阳光明媚的早餐角。

e.en: Their farms {adjoined} for over a hundred years.
e.zh: 他们两家的农场相邻已超过一百年。

e.en: We booked two {adjoining} rooms so the kids could stay close.
e.zh: 我们订了两间相邻的房间,好让孩子们离得近些。

e.en: The library has an {adjoining} café with great coffee.
e.zh: 图书馆旁边有一家咖啡很棒的咖啡馆。

adjoins.t: v. 毗连（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her property {adjoins} a protected nature reserve.
e.zh: 她的地产紧邻一处受保护的自然保护区。

e.en: The new wing {adjoins} the original hospital building.
e.zh: 新建的侧楼与原来的医院主楼相连。

e.en: The judge decided to {adjourn} the trial until Monday.
e.zh: 法官决定将审判延期至周一。

e.en: Let's {adjourn} the meeting and grab some lunch.
e.zh: 我们休会去吃点午饭吧。

e.en: The committee {adjourned} after a heated three-hour debate.
e.zh: 经过三小时的激烈辩论,委员会休会了。

e.en: Court was {adjourned} until further evidence could be gathered.
e.zh: 法庭休庭,等待收集更多证据。

e.en: The lawyer requested an {adjournment} to review the new evidence.
e.zh: 律师请求休庭以审阅新证据。

e.en: After a brief {adjournment}, the senators returned to vote.
e.zh: 短暂休会后,参议员们回到席位投票。

e.en: The court will {adjudge} the defendant guilty if evidence holds.
e.zh: 如果证据成立,法庭将判定被告有罪。

e.en: Critics {adjudge} her latest novel her finest work yet.
e.zh: 评论家认为她最新的小说是她迄今最出色的作品。

e.en: A neutral panel will {adjudicate} the contract dispute next week.
e.zh: 下周将由一个中立小组裁决这起合同纠纷。

e.en: It's not my job to {adjudicate} who started the argument.
e.zh: 评判谁先挑起争吵不是我的职责。

e.en: The case is currently awaiting {adjudication} by the appeals court.
e.zh: 该案目前正等待上诉法院的裁决。

e.en: Online platforms often handle dispute {adjudication} automatically.
e.zh: 线上平台通常会自动处理纠纷裁定。

e.en: The agency has full {adjudicative} authority over visa appeals.
e.zh: 该机构对签证上诉拥有完整的裁决权。

e.en: Judges follow strict procedures during {adjudicative} hearings.
e.zh: 法官在裁决听证会上遵循严格的程序。

e.en: An independent {adjudicator} was brought in to settle the dispute.
e.zh: 一位独立裁判员被请来解决这起争端。

e.en: The {adjudicator} ruled in favor of the smaller company.
e.zh: 裁决人作出了对较小公司有利的判决。

adjunct.t:
n. 附属物
adj. 附属的；兼任的

e.en: She works as an {adjunct} professor while finishing her dissertation.
e.zh: 她一边写完博士论文,一边担任兼职教授。

e.en: Meditation can be a useful {adjunct} to traditional therapy.
e.zh: 冥想可以作为传统治疗的有益辅助。

e.en: The drug is approved as an {adjunctive} treatment for epilepsy.
e.zh: 该药物被批准作为癫痫的辅助治疗。

e.en: Physical therapy serves as {adjunctive} care after the surgery.
e.zh: 物理治疗在术后作为辅助护理。

e.en: You can {adjust} the brightness in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里调节亮度。

e.en: It took her months to {adjust} to life in a new city.
e.zh: 她花了好几个月才适应在新城市的生活。

e.en: This office chair is praised for its excellent {adjustability}.
e.zh: 这把办公椅以出色的可调节性而受到好评。

e.en: Parents love the stroller's {adjustability} as their child grows.
e.zh: 随着孩子长大,家长们很喜欢这款婴儿车的可调节性。

e.en: This office chair has an {adjustable} backrest for comfort.
e.zh: 这把办公椅有可调节的靠背，更舒适。

e.en: Most loans come with {adjustable} interest rates these days.
e.zh: 现在大多数贷款都采用可调利率。

adjusted.t:
v. 已调整
adj. 经调整的

e.en: She {adjusted} her glasses before reading the contract.
e.zh: 她在阅读合同前扶了扶眼镜。

e.en: The team {adjusted} their strategy after the first loss.
e.zh: 球队在首场失利后调整了策略。

e.en: The insurance {adjuster} inspected the damaged car carefully.
e.zh: 保险理赔员仔细检查了受损的汽车。

e.en: Turn the {adjuster} on the strap to tighten the helmet.
e.zh: 转动带子上的调节器以收紧头盔。

e.en: He spent the morning {adjusting} the camera settings.
e.zh: 他花了一上午调整相机的设置。

e.en: New employees often need time {adjusting} to office life.
e.zh: 新员工通常需要时间适应办公室生活。

e.en: A small {adjustment} to the recipe made the cake perfect.
e.zh: 对食谱的小调整让蛋糕变得完美。

e.en: Moving abroad requires a big {adjustment} for the whole family.
e.zh: 移居国外需要全家做出很大的适应。

e.en: The designer made several {adjustments} to the website layout.
e.zh: 设计师对网站布局做了几处调整。

e.en: Minor {adjustments} to your diet can improve sleep quality.
e.zh: 对饮食做些小调整就能改善睡眠质量。

e.en: The claims {adjustor} arrived to assess the flood damage.
e.zh: 理赔员到场评估洪水造成的损失。

e.en: Loosen the {adjustor} screw before sliding the bracket.
e.zh: 滑动支架前先松开调节螺丝。

adjusts.t: v. 调整（第三人称单数）

e.en: The thermostat automatically {adjusts} the room temperature.
e.zh: 恒温器会自动调节室内温度。

e.en: She quickly {adjusts} her tone when speaking to clients.
e.zh: 她和客户说话时会迅速调整语气。

e.en: The general's {adjutant} delivered the order to the front line.
e.zh: 将军的副官把命令送到了前线。

e.en: He served as {adjutant} to the colonel for two years.
e.zh: 他担任了上校的副官两年。

adjuvant.t:
n. 佐剂（医学）
adj. 辅助的

e.en: Doctors recommend {adjuvant} chemotherapy after surgery.
e.zh: 医生建议术后进行辅助化疗。

e.en: The vaccine contains an {adjuvant} to boost the immune response.
e.zh: 该疫苗含有佐剂以增强免疫反应。

e.en: Alfred {Adler} founded the school of individual psychology.
e.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·阿德勒创立了个体心理学学派。

e.en: Professor {Adler} will lecture on classical philosophy tonight.
e.zh: 阿德勒教授今晚将讲授古典哲学。

adlib.t:
v. 即兴发挥
adj. 即兴的

e.en: The actor had to {adlib} when his co-star forgot the line.
e.zh: 当搭档忘词时，演员只能即兴发挥。

e.en: Stand-up comedians often {adlib} based on the audience reaction.
e.zh: 脱口秀演员常根据观众反应即兴表演。

e.en: The veteran {adman} created some of the most iconic slogans.
e.zh: 那位资深广告人创作了一些最经典的广告语。

e.en: As an {adman}, he understood consumer psychology deeply.
e.zh: 作为一名广告人，他对消费心理理解深刻。

e.en: You need {admin} privileges to install this software.
e.zh: 安装这款软件需要管理员权限。

e.en: The office {admin} handles scheduling and supplies.
e.zh: 办公室行政人员负责日程安排和办公用品。

adonis.t: n. 美男子（源自希腊神话）

e.en: With his sculpted features, he looked like an {Adonis}.
e.zh: 他五官轮廓分明，看起来就像个美男子。

e.en: The painting depicts a young {Adonis} in a forest.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一个年轻的美少年在森林中。

adopt.t:
v. 采用，采纳
v. 收养

e.en: The company plans to {adopt} a four-day work week.
e.zh: 公司计划采用四天工作制。

e.en: They decided to {adopt} a rescue dog from the shelter.
e.zh: 他们决定从收容所领养一只救援犬。

adoptable.t:
adj. 可收养的
adj. 可采用的

e.en: All the puppies in the shelter are {adoptable} this weekend.
e.zh: 本周末收容所里所有的小狗都可以被领养。

e.en: The framework is highly {adoptable} by small teams.
e.zh: 这个框架非常适合小团队采用。

adopted.t:
adj. 被收养的
adj. 被采用的

e.en: They {adopted} a kitten from the local animal shelter.
e.zh: 他们从当地动物收容所领养了一只小猫。

e.en: The team {adopted} a new project management tool.
e.zh: 团队采用了新的项目管理工具。

e.en: As an {adoptee}, she searched for her birth parents online.
e.zh: 作为一名被领养者，她在网上寻找自己的亲生父母。

e.en: The {adoptee} reunited with her biological siblings last year.
e.zh: 那位被领养者去年与她的亲生兄弟姐妹团聚了。

adopter.t:
n. 采用者
n. 收养人

e.en: She was an early {adopter} of electric vehicles.
e.zh: 她是电动汽车的早期使用者。

e.en: Every {adopter} receives a welcome packet for their new pet.
e.zh: 每位领养人都会收到一份给新宠物的欢迎礼包。

adopting.t: v. 采用（adopt 的现在分词）

e.en: We're {adopting} a remote-first work culture next month.
e.zh: 下个月我们将采用远程优先的工作文化。

e.en: They are {adopting} a baby from overseas.
e.zh: 他们正在从海外领养一个婴儿。

adoption.t:
n. 采用，采纳
n. 收养

e.en: Cloud {adoption} has accelerated across the industry.
e.zh: 云技术在整个行业的应用正在加速。

e.en: The {adoption} process took nearly two years.
e.zh: 整个领养流程花了将近两年时间。

e.en: The shelter celebrated a record number of {adoptions} this year.
e.zh: 今年收容所的领养数量创下了纪录。

e.en: Software {adoptions} often stall without proper training.
e.zh: 如果没有适当的培训，软件的采用往往会停滞不前。

adoptive.t: adj. 收养的（养父母、养子女）

e.en: Her {adoptive} parents raised her with great love.
e.zh: 她的养父母用无尽的爱将她抚养长大。

e.en: The {adoptive} family sent updates every holiday season.
e.zh: 那个领养家庭每逢节日都会发来近况更新。

adopts.t: v. 采用，收养（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new policy {adopts} a stricter approach to data privacy.
e.zh: 新政策对数据隐私采取了更严格的措施。

e.en: Whenever she {adopts} a stray, the cat thrives.
e.zh: 每次她收养流浪猫，那只猫都过得很好。

adorable.t: adj. 可爱的，讨人喜欢的

e.en: Their golden retriever puppy is absolutely {adorable}.
e.zh: 他们家的金毛幼犬实在太可爱了。

e.en: She wore an {adorable} polka-dot dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条可爱的圆点连衣裙去派对。

e.en: The toddler waved {adorably} at the camera.
e.zh: 那个小孩对着镜头可爱地挥了挥手。

e.en: He {adorably} mispronounced his sister's name.
e.zh: 他把妹妹的名字念错了，可爱极了。

adoral.t: adj. 近口的（生物学术语）

e.en: Biologists examined the starfish's {adoral} surface under a microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下检查海星的近口面。

e.en: The species has distinctive markings on its {adoral} side.
e.zh: 该物种在其口侧有独特的斑纹。

e.en: The puppy gazed at his owner with pure {adoration}.
e.zh: 小狗用充满崇拜的眼神望着主人。

e.en: Fans showed their {adoration} by lining up overnight.
e.zh: 粉丝们彻夜排队以表达他们的爱慕之情。

e.en: I absolutely {adore} this little café on Main Street.
e.zh: 我超喜欢主街上的这家小咖啡馆。

e.en: The kids {adore} their new puppy.
e.zh: 孩子们非常喜爱他们的新小狗。

adored.t:
adj. 深受喜爱的
v. 爱慕（过去式）

e.en: She was {adored} by everyone who worked with her.
e.zh: 所有和她共事过的人都很喜爱她。

e.en: As a child, he {adored} comic books and superheroes.
e.zh: 小时候，他特别喜爱漫画书和超级英雄。

adores.t: v. 非常喜爱（第三人称单数）

e.en: My grandmother {adores} her weekly video calls with us.
e.zh: 奶奶非常喜欢每周和我们视频通话。

e.en: He {adores} the new espresso machine in the office.
e.zh: 他对办公室那台新的浓缩咖啡机爱不释手。

adoring.t: adj. 爱慕的，充满爱意的

e.en: She blew kisses to her {adoring} fans.
e.zh: 她向爱戴她的粉丝们飞吻致意。

e.en: The dog gave its owner an {adoring} look.
e.zh: 那只狗用爱慕的眼神看着主人。

e.en: He gazed {adoringly} at his newborn daughter.
e.zh: 他爱怜地凝视着刚出生的女儿。

e.en: The crowd cheered {adoringly} as the band took the stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时，人群发出爱戴的欢呼声。

e.en: Fresh flowers {adorn} every table at the wedding venue.
e.zh: 婚礼场地的每张桌子都用鲜花装饰。

e.en: Murals {adorn} the walls of the subway station.
e.zh: 壁画装点着地铁站的墙壁。

adorned.t:
adj. 被装饰的
v. 装饰（过去式）

e.en: The cake was {adorned} with edible gold leaf.
e.zh: 蛋糕上装饰着可食用金箔。

e.en: Her wrist was {adorned} with delicate silver bangles.
e.zh: 她的手腕上戴着精致的银手镯作装饰。

e.en: Lanterns {adorning} the streets created a festive atmosphere.
e.zh: 装点街道的灯笼营造出节日的氛围。

e.en: She spent hours {adorning} the Christmas tree with ornaments.
e.zh: 她花了好几个小时用饰品装饰圣诞树。

e.en: The dress is elegant without any extra {adornment}.
e.zh: 这件连衣裙不加任何装饰也很优雅。

e.en: Gold jewelry has long been a symbol of personal {adornment}.
e.zh: 金饰长期以来一直是个人装饰的象征。

e.en: The temple is famous for its intricate stone {adornments}.
e.zh: 这座寺庙以其精美的石雕装饰而闻名。

e.en: She prefers a clean look without too many {adornments}.
e.zh: 她喜欢简洁的造型，不要太多装饰。

e.en: Theodor {Adorno} influenced generations of critical theorists.
e.zh: 西奥多·阿多诺影响了几代批判理论学者。

e.en: We read {Adorno}'s essays in our cultural studies seminar.
e.zh: 我们在文化研究研讨课上读了阿多诺的论文。

adorns.t: v. 装饰（第三人称单数）

e.en: A massive chandelier {adorns} the hotel lobby.
e.zh: 酒店大堂装点着一盏巨大的吊灯。

e.en: Graffiti {adorns} every wall in the abandoned warehouse.
e.zh: 废弃仓库的每面墙上都涂满了涂鸦。

adp.t:
n. 二磷酸腺苷（生化）
n. 自动数据处理

e.en: Our company uses {ADP} to process payroll every two weeks.
e.zh: 我们公司每两周使用 ADP 处理一次工资。

e.en: Cells convert ATP to {ADP} to release energy.
e.zh: 细胞将 ATP 转化为 ADP 以释放能量。

adrenal.t:
adj. 肾上腺的
n. 肾上腺

e.en: The doctor ordered tests to check her {adrenal} function.
e.zh: 医生让她做检查以评估肾上腺功能。

e.en: Chronic stress can exhaust your {adrenal} glands.
e.zh: 长期压力会让你的肾上腺疲惫不堪。

e.en: Bungee jumping gave him a huge rush of {adrenalin}.
e.zh: 蹦极让他肾上腺素飙升。

e.en: The chase scene was pure {adrenalin} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那段追逐戏从头到尾都让人肾上腺素爆棚。

e.en: My {adrenaline} was pumping during the final minute of the game.
e.zh: 比赛最后一分钟，我的肾上腺素飙升。

e.en: Skydivers chase the {adrenaline} rush of free fall.
e.zh: 跳伞者追求自由落体带来的肾上腺素刺激。

e.en: Different {adrenalines} are released depending on the type of stress.
e.zh: 根据压力类型不同，会释放出不同的肾上腺素。

e.en: Researchers compared synthetic {adrenalines} for emergency use.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了用于急救的几种合成肾上腺素。

adriatic.t:
adj. 亚得里亚海的
n. 亚得里亚海

e.en: We sailed along the {Adriatic} coast last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿着亚得里亚海岸航行。

e.en: Croatia's {Adriatic} beaches attract millions of tourists.
e.zh: 克罗地亚的亚得里亚海海滩吸引了数百万游客。

adrift.t:
adv. 漂流地
adj. 漂泊的，迷茫的

e.en: The small boat was left {adrift} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，那艘小船随波漂流。

e.en: He felt {adrift} after losing his job.
e.zh: 失业后他感到迷茫无依。

e.en: She is an {adroit} negotiator in high-stakes deals.
e.zh: 在高风险交易中她是一位精明的谈判者。

e.en: His {adroit} handling of the crisis impressed everyone.
e.zh: 他对这场危机的巧妙处理给所有人留下了深刻印象。

e.en: She {adroitly} sidestepped the reporter's tough question.
e.zh: 她巧妙地回避了记者的尖锐问题。

e.en: The chef {adroitly} balanced sweet and spicy flavors.
e.zh: 厨师巧妙地平衡了甜味和辣味。

e.en: His {adroitness} in diplomacy earned him wide respect.
e.zh: 他在外交上的娴熟手腕赢得了广泛的尊重。

e.en: She handled the awkward situation with surprising {adroitness}.
e.zh: 她以惊人的机敏处理了那个尴尬局面。

e.en: YouTube shows too many {ads} before each video.
e.zh: YouTube 在每个视频前播放太多广告了。

e.en: The startup spent thousands on Instagram {ads} last quarter.
e.zh: 上个季度这家初创公司在 Instagram 广告上花了数千美元。

e.en: Activated charcoal can {adsorb} toxins from water.
e.zh: 活性炭可以从水中吸附毒素。

e.en: The filter is designed to {adsorb} odor molecules.
e.zh: 该过滤器专为吸附异味分子而设计。

adsorbed.t:
adj. 被吸附的
v. 吸附（过去式）

e.en: The pollutants were quickly {adsorbed} onto the carbon surface.
e.zh: 污染物很快被吸附到碳表面上。

e.en: Moisture {adsorbed} by the silica gel kept the box dry.
e.zh: 硅胶吸附了水分，让盒子保持干燥。

e.en: Air purifiers rely on {adsorption} to trap harmful gases.
e.zh: 空气净化器依靠吸附作用来捕获有害气体。

e.en: Scientists studied the {adsorption} of dye onto nanoparticles.
e.zh: 科学家研究了染料在纳米颗粒上的吸附作用。

adt.t:
n. 大西洋夏令时间
n. 抽象数据类型

e.en: The hospital uses {ADT} systems to track patient admissions.
e.zh: 医院使用ADT系统来追踪病人的入院情况。

e.en: Our security firm installed an {ADT} alarm at the new office.
e.zh: 我们的安保公司在新办公室安装了ADT警报器。

e.en: Fans tend to {adulate} celebrities without knowing the real person.
e.zh: 粉丝往往盲目崇拜明星,却不了解真实的他们。

e.en: Critics warned the public not to {adulate} the young politician.
e.zh: 评论员警告公众不要过度吹捧这位年轻政客。

e.en: The pop star received endless {adulation} from her fans online.
e.zh: 这位流行歌手在网上受到粉丝无尽的追捧。

e.en: He grew uncomfortable with the constant {adulation} after his win.
e.zh: 获胜后,他对不断的吹捧感到不自在。

e.en: The biography is far too {adulatory} to be taken seriously.
e.zh: 这本传记过于阿谀奉承,难以让人当真。

e.en: She received {adulatory} reviews after her debut performance.
e.zh: 她首演之后收到了一片赞美的评论。

adult.t:
n. 成年人
adj. 成年的

e.en: You must be an {adult} to sign up for this app.
e.zh: 必须是成年人才能注册这个应用。

e.en: Returning to school as an {adult} can feel intimidating at first.
e.zh: 成年后重返校园一开始可能会让人有些胆怯。

e.en: I clicked on an {advertisement} for running shoes.
e.zh: 我点了一个跑鞋的广告。

e.en: The magazine featured a full-page {advertisement} for cars.
e.zh: 那本杂志刊登了一整版的汽车广告。

e.en: Most apps show {advertisements} unless you pay for premium.
e.zh: 大多数应用都会显示广告,除非你订阅会员。

e.en: The newspaper is full of job {advertisements} today.
e.zh: 今天的报纸上满是招聘广告。

e.en: Each {advertiser} pays based on the number of clicks.
e.zh: 每个广告商按点击量付费。

e.en: The platform is the largest {advertiser} for tech startups.
e.zh: 该平台是科技初创公司最大的广告投放方。

e.en: The website {advertises} discounted flights to Europe.
e.zh: 该网站宣传飞往欧洲的特价机票。

e.en: She {advertises} her photography services on Instagram.
e.zh: 她在 Instagram 上宣传自己的摄影服务。

advertising.t:
n. 广告业；广告宣传
v. 做广告

e.en: Online {advertising} brings in most of the company's revenue.
e.zh: 在线广告为公司带来了大部分收入。

e.en: He works in {advertising} for a major agency.
e.zh: 他在一家大型广告公司从事广告业。

e.en: YouTube {adverts} keep getting longer every year.
e.zh: YouTube 广告一年比一年长。

e.en: She skips all the {adverts} before videos.
e.zh: 她跳过视频前的所有广告。

e.en: My mom gave me great {advice} about the interview.
e.zh: 我妈妈给了我很好的面试建议。

e.en: You should follow your doctor's {advice} carefully.
e.zh: 你应该认真听从医生的建议。

e.en: The board questioned the {advisability} of expanding too quickly.
e.zh: 董事会质疑过快扩张是否明智。

e.en: Doctors debated the {advisability} of the new treatment.
e.zh: 医生们对这种新疗法是否可取展开了讨论。

e.en: It's {advisable} to back up your files regularly.
e.zh: 定期备份文件是明智之举。

e.en: Booking tickets early is highly {advisable} during holidays.
e.zh: 假期期间强烈建议提前订票。

e.en: I would {advise} you to read the contract carefully.
e.zh: 我建议你仔细阅读合同。

e.en: Doctors {advise} drinking plenty of water every day.
e.zh: 医生建议每天多喝水。

advised.t:
adj. 经过慎重考虑的
v. advise 的过去式

e.en: She {advised} me to take the train instead.
e.zh: 她建议我改坐火车。

e.en: Travelers are {advised} to avoid that area at night.
e.zh: 建议游客夜间避开那一带。

e.en: I use the word "crisis" {advisedly}, not lightly.
e.zh: 我用"危机"一词是经过深思熟虑的,并非随意。

e.en: He chose the term {advisedly} after much consideration.
e.zh: 他经过深思熟虑后才慎重地选用了这个词。

e.en: The professor met with each {advisee} once a semester.
e.zh: 那位教授每学期都会和每名学生见一次面。

e.en: As an {advisee}, you should prepare questions before meetings.
e.zh: 作为受指导的学生,你应在见面前准备好问题。

e.en: The judge took the motion under {advisement} for review.
e.zh: 法官将该动议予以审议。

e.en: The committee took her proposal under {advisement}.
e.zh: 委员会对她的提议进行了认真考虑。

e.en: My financial {adviser} helped me plan for retirement.
e.zh: 我的理财顾问帮我做了退休规划。

e.en: She became a senior {adviser} to the prime minister.
e.zh: 她成为了首相的高级顾问。

e.en: The president consulted his closest {advisers} before deciding.
e.zh: 总统在决策前咨询了他最亲近的顾问们。

e.en: Academic {advisers} help students choose the right courses.
e.zh: 学业指导老师帮助学生选择合适的课程。

e.en: The app {advises} users when their password is weak.
e.zh: 该应用会在用户密码强度不足时提醒。

e.en: He {advises} several startups on growth strategy.
e.zh: 他为多家初创公司提供增长策略建议。

e.en: She spends Fridays {advising} graduate students on research.
e.zh: 她周五的时间用来指导研究生做研究。

e.en: The senator is {advising} the committee on tax policy.
e.zh: 这位参议员正在为委员会的税收政策提供建议。

e.en: My academic {advisor} signed off on my course schedule.
e.zh: 我的学业导师批准了我的选课计划。

e.en: He hired a tax {advisor} to handle his returns.
e.zh: 他聘请了一位税务顾问处理报税事宜。

e.en: The CEO surrounded herself with experienced {advisors}.
e.zh: 这位 CEO 身边聚集了一批经验丰富的顾问。

e.en: Financial {advisors} recommend diversifying your investments.
e.zh: 理财顾问建议分散投资。

advisory.t:
adj. 咨询的；顾问的
n. 公告；警报

e.en: The weather service issued an {advisory} about heavy rain.
e.zh: 气象部门发布了暴雨预警。

e.en: She sits on the company's {advisory} board.
e.zh: 她是该公司顾问委员会的成员。

e.en: The group is known for its {advocacy} of children's rights.
e.zh: 该团体以倡导儿童权利而闻名。

e.en: Her {advocacy} helped change the local recycling laws.
e.zh: 她的呼吁推动了当地回收法律的修改。

advocate.t:
v. 提倡；拥护
n. 拥护者；律师

e.en: She is a strong {advocate} for mental health awareness.
e.zh: 她是心理健康意识的坚定倡导者。

e.en: Many experts {advocate} regular exercise for better sleep.
e.zh: 许多专家提倡通过规律运动来改善睡眠。

e.en: He {advocated} stricter privacy laws for tech companies.
e.zh: 他主张对科技公司实施更严格的隐私法律。

e.en: The teacher {advocated} project-based learning over rote memorization.
e.zh: 那位老师提倡项目式学习而非死记硬背。

advocates.t:
n. 倡导者
v. 提倡

e.en: Climate {advocates} gathered outside the parliament building.
e.zh: 气候倡导者们聚集在国会大厦外。

e.en: The author {advocates} reading paper books over screens.
e.zh: 作者主张读纸质书而非电子屏幕。

e.en: She has spent years {advocating} for fair housing policies.
e.zh: 多年来她一直在为公平住房政策奔走呼吁。

e.en: The doctor is {advocating} earlier cancer screenings for adults.
e.zh: 这位医生提倡成年人尽早做癌症筛查。

e.en: The carpenter shaped the beam with an {adze}.
e.zh: 木匠用扁斧把横梁削成形。

e.en: Museums often display the ancient {adze} as a tool.
e.zh: 博物馆常把古代的扁斧作为工具展品展出。

e.en: The {aea} conference draws economists from around the world.
e.zh: 美国经济学会的年会吸引了世界各地的经济学家。

e.en: She presented her paper at the annual {aea} meeting.
e.zh: 她在美国经济学会的年会上发表了论文。

e.en: The {aeg} logo appears on many vintage German appliances.
e.zh: AEG 的标志出现在许多老式德国家电上。

e.en: My grandmother's old {aeg} washing machine still works perfectly.
e.zh: 我奶奶那台老式 AEG 洗衣机至今还能正常工作。

e.en: We sailed across the {Aegean} sea last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们乘船横渡了爱琴海。

e.en: The {Aegean} islands are popular tourist destinations in Greece.
e.zh: 爱琴海诸岛是希腊热门的旅游胜地。

e.en: The project ran under the {aegis} of the United Nations.
e.zh: 该项目在联合国的支持下进行。

e.en: Several charities operate under the {aegis} of the foundation.
e.zh: 多家慈善机构都在该基金会的庇护下运作。

e.en: Students often read the {Aeneid} in Latin classes.
e.zh: 学生在拉丁语课上常常阅读《埃涅阿斯纪》。

e.en: Virgil's {Aeneid} tells the story of Aeneas's journey.
e.zh: 维吉尔的《埃涅阿斯纪》讲述了埃涅阿斯的旅程。

e.en: The desert dunes were shaped by {aeolian} forces over centuries.
e.zh: 这些沙漠沙丘是几个世纪以来风力作用形成的。

e.en: She played a haunting melody in the {aeolian} mode.
e.zh: 她以爱奥尼亚调式演奏了一段令人难忘的旋律。

e.en: It feels like an {aeon} since we last met.
e.zh: 感觉我们上次见面已经过了一个世纪。

e.en: These rocks formed over an {aeon} of geological change.
e.zh: 这些岩石是经过亿万年的地质变化形成的。

e.en: The Latin root {aer} means "air" in many English words.
e.zh: 拉丁词根 aer 在许多英文单词中意为"空气"。

e.en: Words like aerial come from the root {aer}.
e.zh: 像 aerial 这样的词来源于词根 aer。

e.en: You should {aerate} the lawn once a year.
e.zh: 你应该每年给草坪松一次土通气。

e.en: Swirl the wine in the glass to {aerate} it.
e.zh: 在杯中摇晃葡萄酒,让它充分接触空气。

aerated.t:
adj. 充气的
v. 使充气（过去式）

e.en: The bread has a light, {aerated} texture.
e.zh: 这款面包口感轻盈蓬松。

e.en: Properly {aerated} soil helps roots grow stronger.
e.zh: 通气良好的土壤有助于根系长得更强壮。

e.en: Lawn {aeration} improves water absorption and grass health.
e.zh: 草坪打孔通气有助于吸水和草的健康生长。

e.en: The fish tank needs proper {aeration} to keep oxygen levels up.
e.zh: 鱼缸需要适当的增氧来维持氧气含量。

e.en: I installed a new {aerator} on the kitchen faucet.
e.zh: 我在厨房水龙头上装了一个新的起泡器。

e.en: The pond {aerator} keeps the water from going stagnant.
e.zh: 池塘的曝气器能防止水变得不流动。

aerial.t:
adj. 空中的；航空的
n. 天线

e.en: The drone captured stunning {aerial} footage of the coastline.
e.zh: 无人机拍下了海岸线的精彩航拍画面。

e.en: Adjust the {aerial} if the TV reception gets fuzzy.
e.zh: 电视信号不清时就调一下天线。

e.en: The {aerialist} swung gracefully high above the circus crowd.
e.zh: 那位空中飞人在马戏团观众头顶优雅地飞荡。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {aerialist}.
e.zh: 她训练多年才成为一名专业的空中表演者。

aerie.t: n. (猛禽) 高巢；山顶住所

e.en: The eagle returned to its {aerie} on the cliff.
e.zh: 那只鹰回到了悬崖上的巢穴。

e.en: His mountaintop cabin felt like a private {aerie}.
e.zh: 他山顶的小屋就像一个私人的高处栖所。

e.en: The new car has a sleek {aero} design for efficiency.
e.zh: 这款新车采用流线型空气动力学设计以提升效率。

e.en: Cyclists wear {aero} helmets to reduce wind resistance.
e.zh: 自行车手戴着空气动力头盔以减少风阻。

e.en: The pilot performed a stunning {aerobatic} display at the show.
e.zh: 飞行员在表演中做了精彩的特技飞行表演。

e.en: He flies an {aerobatic} plane at weekend air shows.
e.zh: 他周末在航空表演中驾驶特技飞机。

e.en: The crowd cheered as the jets performed daring {aerobatics}.
e.zh: 喷气机做出大胆的特技动作时,观众欢呼起来。

e.en: Learning {aerobatics} requires years of careful flight training.
e.zh: 学习特技飞行需要多年的严格训练。

adulterate.t: v. 掺假；掺杂（降低品质）

e.en: Some vendors {adulterate} olive oil with cheaper sunflower oil.
e.zh: 有些商家会用便宜的葵花油掺假橄榄油。

e.en: It is illegal to {adulterate} milk with water for profit.
e.zh: 为牟利在牛奶中掺水是违法的。

adulterated.t:
adj. 被掺假的
v. adulterate 的过去式

e.en: Lab tests showed the honey was heavily {adulterated} with syrup.
e.zh: 化验显示这批蜂蜜被大量糖浆掺假。

e.en: The factory was fined for selling {adulterated} baby formula.
e.zh: 该工厂因销售掺假婴儿奶粉而被罚款。

adulterates.t: v. adulterate 的第三人称单数

e.en: The supplier secretly {adulterates} the spice with cheap fillers.
e.zh: 该供应商偷偷往香料里掺入廉价填充物。

e.en: Anyone who {adulterates} medicine faces serious criminal charges.
e.zh: 任何掺假药品的人都将面临严重刑事指控。

e.en: Inspectors caught the company {adulterating} fuel with water.
e.zh: 检查员当场抓到该公司向燃料中掺水。

e.en: They were arrested for {adulterating} wine with industrial alcohol.
e.zh: 他们因用工业酒精掺假葡萄酒而被捕。

e.en: Food {adulteration} remains a serious problem in many markets.
e.zh: 食品掺假在许多市场仍是严重问题。

e.en: New tests can quickly detect {adulteration} of imported olive oil.
e.zh: 新型检测能快速发现进口橄榄油的掺假。

e.en: In the novel, the {adulterer} eventually loses his family and career.
e.zh: 在小说中,这个出轨者最终失去了家庭和事业。

e.en: Society once shamed any man labeled an {adulterer}.
e.zh: 过去社会会羞辱任何被贴上通奸者标签的男人。

e.en: The play centers on an {adulteress} caught between two lovers.
e.zh: 这部戏剧围绕一位夹在两个情人之间的出轨女子展开。

e.en: In the old story, the {adulteress} is publicly condemned by villagers.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里,这位出轨女子被村民们当众谴责。

e.en: He confessed to an {adulterous} affair with his coworker.
e.zh: 他承认与同事有过一段不正当的婚外情。

e.en: The film explores the fallout of an {adulterous} relationship.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了一段婚外恋带来的种种后果。

e.en: She filed for divorce after discovering his {adultery}.
e.zh: 在发现他出轨后,她提出了离婚。

e.en: In some countries, {adultery} is still treated as a crime.
e.zh: 在某些国家,通奸至今仍被当作犯罪处理。

e.en: Many young people delay {adulthood} by living with their parents.
e.zh: 许多年轻人通过与父母同住推迟进入成年生活。

e.en: Reaching {adulthood} brings new responsibilities and freedoms.
e.zh: 步入成年既带来新的责任,也带来新的自由。

e.en: This playground is for kids, not {adults}.
e.zh: 这个游乐场是给小孩玩的,不是给成年人的。

e.en: Most {adults} in the survey reported feeling stressed at work.
e.zh: 调查中大多数成年人表示工作压力很大。

adumbrate.t: v. 大致描述；预示（书面语）

e.en: The CEO will {adumbrate} next year's strategy at the meeting.
e.zh: 首席执行官将在会议上简要勾勒明年的战略。

e.en: Early chapters {adumbrate} the themes the novel later develops.
e.zh: 前几章预先勾勒出小说后面展开的主题。

advance.t:
v. 推进；前进
n. 进展；进步

e.en: Please book your tickets in {advance} to get a discount.
e.zh: 请提前预订门票以享受折扣。

e.en: Recent breakthroughs {advance} our understanding of the brain.
e.zh: 近期的突破推进了我们对大脑的认识。

e.en: She enrolled in an {advanced} machine learning course online.
e.zh: 她在网上报了一门高阶机器学习课程。

e.en: The team {advanced} to the finals after a tough match.
e.zh: 球队在一场苦战后晋级决赛。

e.en: The job offers great opportunities for career {advancement}.
e.zh: 这份工作提供很好的职业晋升机会。

e.en: Recent {advancement} in AI is reshaping many industries.
e.zh: 人工智能的最新进展正在重塑许多行业。

e.en: Medical {advancements} have dramatically extended human lifespan.
e.zh: 医学的进步已大幅延长了人类寿命。

e.en: Tech {advancements} make remote work easier than ever.
e.zh: 科技的进步让远程办公比以往更轻松。

e.en: She is regarded as a major {advancer} of women's rights.
e.zh: 她被视为推动女性权益的重要人物。

e.en: The startup positioned itself as an {advancer} of clean energy.
e.zh: 这家初创公司将自己定位为清洁能源的推动者。

advances.t:
n. 进展（复数）
v. advance 第三人称单数

e.en: Recent {advances} in AI are transforming the medical field.
e.zh: 人工智能的最新进展正在改变医疗领域。

e.en: She politely rejected his romantic {advances} at the party.
e.zh: 她在派对上礼貌地拒绝了他的示好。

advancing.t:
v. advance 的现在分词
adj. 前进的

e.en: The team is {advancing} steadily toward the project deadline.
e.zh: 团队正稳步推进,朝着项目截止日期前进。

e.en: Technology is {advancing} faster than regulations can keep up.
e.zh: 科技的发展速度比监管的跟进还要快。

e.en: Speaking two languages gives her a real {advantage} in interviews.
e.zh: 会两种语言让她在面试中占有真正的优势。

e.en: The startup took {advantage} of the booming AI market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司利用了人工智能市场的火热。

advantaged.t: adj. 占优势的；条件优越的

e.en: Children from {advantaged} families often attend top universities.
e.zh: 出身优渥家庭的孩子往往能进入顶尖大学。

e.en: He felt {advantaged} compared to classmates without internet at home.
e.zh: 与家中没有网络的同学相比,他觉得自己很有优势。

e.en: Remote work is {advantageous} for parents with young children.
e.zh: 远程办公对有幼儿的家长来说很有利。

e.en: Signing the contract early proved {advantageous} for both sides.
e.zh: 提前签合同对双方都很有利。

e.en: The hotel is {advantageously} located near the train station.
e.zh: 这家酒店位置优越,就在火车站附近。

e.en: She used her network {advantageously} to land the job.
e.zh: 她巧妙地利用人脉拿到了这份工作。

e.en: Working from home has many {advantages} over commuting daily.
e.zh: 在家办公比每天通勤有许多优势。

e.en: List the {advantages} and disadvantages before making a decision.
e.zh: 在做决定之前先列出利弊。

e.en: The {advent} of smartphones changed how we communicate.
e.zh: 智能手机的出现改变了我们的沟通方式。

e.en: With the {advent} of AI, many jobs are being redefined.
e.zh: 随着人工智能的到来,许多岗位正在被重新定义。

e.en: She grew up attending an {Adventist} church every Saturday.
e.zh: 她从小每周六都去基督复临安息日会的教堂。

e.en: The {Adventist} hospital is known for its plant-based diet program.
e.zh: 这家基督复临安息日会的医院以植物饮食项目闻名。

e.en: Their meeting was purely {adventitious}, not planned at all.
e.zh: 他们的相遇纯属偶然,完全不是事先安排的。

e.en: The plant developed {adventitious} roots along its stem.
e.zh: 这种植物沿着茎部长出了不定根。

e.en: History records several technological {advents} that reshaped daily life.
e.zh: 历史上记录了多次重塑日常生活的科技问世。

e.en: The book lists key {advents} in the development of computing.
e.zh: 这本书列出了计算机发展史上的关键里程碑。

e.en: Backpacking through Asia was the {adventure} of a lifetime.
e.zh: 背包穿越亚洲是一生难忘的冒险。

e.en: The kids love any movie with a thrilling {adventure} plot.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢任何带有惊险冒险情节的电影。

e.en: The famous {adventurer} crossed Antarctica on foot alone.
e.zh: 这位著名的冒险家独自徒步穿越了南极洲。

e.en: She is an {adventurer} at heart, always planning her next trip.
e.zh: 她骨子里就是个冒险家,总在策划下一次旅行。

e.en: He shares his travel {adventures} on a popular YouTube channel.
e.zh: 他在一个热门的YouTube频道分享自己的旅行冒险。

e.en: The book recounts the {adventures} of two friends crossing Mongolia.
e.zh: 这本书讲述了两个朋友穿越蒙古的种种冒险。

e.en: My cousin is {adventuresome} and always tries new street foods.
e.zh: 我表弟很爱冒险,总会尝试各种街头小吃。

e.en: The trail is best suited for {adventuresome} hikers in good shape.
e.zh: 这条小道最适合体力好且爱冒险的徒步者。

adventuress.t: n. 女冒险家；投机的女子

e.en: The novel features a clever {adventuress} who outwits every suitor.
e.zh: 小说讲述了一位聪明的女冒险家,智胜每一个追求者。

e.en: She played the charming {adventuress} in the classic film.
e.zh: 她在那部经典电影中扮演迷人的女冒险家。

adventurism.t: n. 冒险主义（多含贬义）

e.en: Critics accused the government of military {adventurism} abroad.
e.zh: 批评者指责政府在海外搞军事冒险主义。

e.en: His financial {adventurism} eventually bankrupted the family business.
e.zh: 他在金融上的冒险主义最终让家族企业破产。

adventurous.t: adj. 爱冒险的；富有冒险精神的

e.en: She is an {adventurous} eater who tries every local dish.
e.zh: 她吃东西很爱尝鲜,每道当地菜都要试试。

e.en: He took an {adventurous} route across the mountains last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他选了一条充满冒险的山路穿行。

e.en: She {adventurously} ordered the chef's most exotic dish.
e.zh: 她很大胆地点了主厨最具异域风味的那道菜。

e.en: He {adventurously} quit his job to travel around the world.
e.zh: 他大胆地辞掉工作,去环游世界。

adventurousness.t: n. 爱冒险；大胆的性格

e.en: Her {adventurousness} led her to backpack across five continents.
e.zh: 她的冒险精神让她背包走遍了五大洲。

e.en: The brand markets to people with a sense of {adventurousness}.
e.zh: 该品牌主要面向有冒险精神的人群。

e.en: The word "quickly" is an {adverb} that modifies a verb.
e.zh: "quickly"这个词是修饰动词的副词。

e.en: Many English {adverb} forms end with the suffix "-ly".
e.zh: 许多英语副词形式以"-ly"结尾。

adverbial.t:
adj. 副词的
n. 状语

e.en: The phrase "in the morning" works as an {adverbial} of time.
e.zh: "in the morning"这一短语充当时间状语。

e.en: Students often confuse {adverbial} clauses with adjective clauses.
e.zh: 学生常常把状语从句和定语从句搞混。

e.en: Most {adverbs} in English are formed by adding "-ly".
e.zh: 英语中的大多数副词都是加"-ly"构成的。

e.en: Good writers use {adverbs} sparingly to keep prose tight.
e.zh: 好的作者会少用副词,让文字更紧凑。

e.en: Their relationship turned {adversarial} after the contract dispute.
e.zh: 合同纠纷之后,他们的关系变得对立。

e.en: Researchers train models to resist {adversarial} attacks on their inputs.
e.zh: 研究人员训练模型以抵御针对输入的对抗性攻击。

e.en: The two teams have been longtime {adversaries} on the basketball court.
e.zh: 这两支球队在篮球场上是多年的老对手。

e.en: Political {adversaries} rarely agree, even on basic facts.
e.zh: 政治对手很少能达成共识,哪怕是基本事实。

e.en: Chess taught him to respect every {adversary} across the board.
e.zh: 下棋让他学会尊重棋盘对面的每一个对手。

e.en: The startup's biggest {adversary} is a billion-dollar tech giant.
e.zh: 这家初创公司最大的对手是一家市值十亿美元的科技巨头。

e.en: The medication can have {adverse} effects on your stomach.
e.zh: 这种药可能对你的胃产生不良反应。

e.en: Farmers struggled through years of {adverse} weather conditions.
e.zh: 农民们熬过了多年的恶劣天气。

e.en: Lack of sleep can {adversely} affect your concentration at work.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会对你的工作专注力产生不利影响。

e.en: The new tax {adversely} impacted small businesses across the country.
e.zh: 新税收对全国的小企业造成了不利影响。
