e.zh: 这款香水的前调带有清新的醛香特质。

e.en: An old {alder} tree leaned over the riverbank.
e.zh: 一棵老赤杨树斜倾在河岸上。

e.en: They smoked the salmon over {alder} wood chips.
e.zh: 他们用赤杨木屑熏制三文鱼。

e.en: The local {alderman} promised to repair the broken streetlights.
e.zh: 当地的市议员承诺修好坏掉的路灯。

e.en: She campaigned for {alderman} in the city's third ward.
e.zh: 她在该市第三选区竞选市议员。

aldermaston.t: n. 奥尔德马斯顿（英国地名）

e.en: Protesters held annual marches from {Aldermaston} during the 1960s.
e.zh: 上世纪六十年代,抗议者每年从奥尔德马斯顿出发举行游行。

e.en: {Aldermaston} is best known for its atomic weapons research site.
e.zh: 奥尔德马斯顿最出名的是其原子武器研究基地。

e.en: The ferry to {Alderney} only runs a few times a week.
e.zh: 前往奥尔德尼岛的渡轮每周只运行几班。

e.en: {Alderney} is the third largest of the Channel Islands.
e.zh: 奥尔德尼是海峡群岛中第三大的岛屿。

aldershot.t: n. 奥尔德肖特（英国城镇）

e.en: His grandfather trained as a soldier in {Aldershot}.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在奥尔德肖特接受士兵训练。

e.en: {Aldershot} has been called the home of the British Army.
e.zh: 奥尔德肖特一直被称为英国陆军的故乡。

alderton.t: n. 奥尔德顿（地名/姓氏）

e.en: We rented a cottage near {Alderton} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们在奥尔德顿附近租了一间小屋度周末。

e.en: {Alderton} appears as a quiet village on the old map.
e.zh: 在那张旧地图上,奥尔德顿是一个安静的小村庄。

aldwych.t: n. 奥德维奇（伦敦街区）

e.en: The disused {Aldwych} tube station is sometimes opened for tours.
e.zh: 已停用的奥尔德维奇地铁站偶尔会开放参观。

e.en: Their office is just off {Aldwych} near the law courts.
e.zh: 他们的办公室就在奥尔德维奇旁边,靠近法院。

ale.t: n. 麦芽啤酒；爱尔啤酒

e.en: He ordered a pint of local {ale} at the pub.
e.zh: 他在酒吧点了一品脱当地的麦芽啤酒。

e.en: The brewery's pale {ale} won a regional gold medal.
e.zh: 那家啤酒厂的淡色艾尔啤酒获得了地区金奖。

e.en: The composer used {aleatory} techniques to introduce randomness into the piece.
e.zh: 作曲家运用偶然音乐技法为作品加入随机元素。

e.en: Insurance contracts are classic examples of {aleatory} agreements.
e.zh: 保险合同是典型的射幸合同案例。

e.en: Travelers stopped at the country {alehouse} for a meal.
e.zh: 旅人们在乡间小酒馆停下来吃饭。

e.en: The old {alehouse} on the corner has stood for centuries.
e.zh: 街角那家古老的小酒馆已经矗立了几个世纪。

alendronate.t: n. 阿仑膦酸钠（治骨质疏松药）

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {alendronate} to slow the bone loss.
e.zh: 医生给她开了阿仑膦酸钠以减缓骨质流失。

e.en: Patients should take {alendronate} on an empty stomach with water.
e.zh: 患者应空腹用水服用阿仑膦酸钠。

aleph.t: n. 阿列夫（希伯来字母；数学基数）

e.en: The Hebrew alphabet begins with the letter {aleph}.
e.zh: 希伯来字母表以字母aleph开头。

e.en: Borges wrote a famous short story called "The {Aleph}."
e.zh: 博尔赫斯写过一部著名的短篇小说《阿莱夫》。

aleppo.t: n. 阿勒颇（叙利亚城市）

e.en: Many ancient buildings in {Aleppo} were destroyed during the war.
e.zh: 阿勒颇的许多古老建筑在战争中被摧毁。

e.en: {Aleppo} is famous for its traditional handmade soap.
e.zh: 阿勒颇以传统手工皂闻名于世。

alert.t:
n. 警报；提醒
adj. 警觉的

e.en: My phone buzzed with an emergency weather {alert}.
e.zh: 我的手机响起紧急天气警报。

e.en: Try to stay {alert} during long highway drives.
e.zh: 长途高速驾驶时要尽量保持警觉。

alerted.t: v. 警示；提醒（alert 的过去式）

e.en: The smoke detector {alerted} everyone in the building.
e.zh: 烟雾报警器警示了大楼里的每个人。

e.en: A neighbor {alerted} the police about the suspicious car.
e.zh: 一位邻居就那辆可疑车辆向警方报警。

alerting.t: v. 警示；提醒（alert 的进行式）

e.en: The app keeps {alerting} me about new messages every minute.
e.zh: 这个应用每分钟都在提醒我有新消息。

e.en: She thanked him for {alerting} her to the schedule change.
e.zh: 她感谢他提醒自己日程有变。

e.en: The dog watched the door {alertly}, ears pricked up.
e.zh: 那只狗机警地盯着门,竖起了耳朵。

e.en: He {alertly} caught the typo before the email was sent.
e.zh: 他在邮件发出前机敏地发现了那个错别字。

e.en: Coffee improves {alertness} but can also disrupt sleep.
e.zh: 咖啡能提高警觉度,但也会影响睡眠。

e.en: Pilots are tested for {alertness} before long-haul flights.
e.zh: 飞行员在执行长途航班前要接受警觉度测试。

alerts.t:
n. 提醒、通知（复数）
v. 提醒

e.en: You can disable push {alerts} in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单中关闭推送提醒。

e.en: The system {alerts} the team whenever a server goes down.
e.zh: 每当服务器宕机时,系统都会通知团队。

e.en: Strong winds sweep across the {Aleutian} Islands year-round.
e.zh: 强风全年吹过阿留申群岛。

e.en: Fishing boats brave the rough {Aleutian} waters for crab.
e.zh: 渔船冒着阿留申海域的恶劣水况捕捞螃蟹。

e.en: Schools of {alewife} migrate up the river each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天成群的灰西鲱会沿河洄游。

e.en: I caught the train at {Alewife} station in Cambridge.
e.zh: 我在剑桥的Alewife站搭上了地铁。

alexandria.t: n. 亚历山大（埃及城市）

e.en: The ancient library of {Alexandria} was a center of learning.
e.zh: 古代的亚历山大图书馆曾是学术中心。

e.en: We toured the harbor of {Alexandria} on our trip to Egypt.
e.zh: 我们在埃及旅行时游览了亚历山大港。

alfa.t: n. 阿尔法（Alfa Romeo 等品牌）

e.en: He restored a vintage {Alfa} Romeo in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修复了一辆老式阿尔法·罗密欧。

e.en: In the phonetic alphabet, the letter A is called {alfa}.
e.zh: 在通讯字母表中,字母A读作alfa。

e.en: The farmer grows {alfalfa} to feed his dairy cows.
e.zh: 那位农民种植苜蓿来喂养奶牛。

e.en: She sprinkled {alfalfa} sprouts on top of her salad.
e.zh: 她在沙拉上撒了一些苜蓿芽。

e.en: The {alimentary} canal runs from the mouth to the anus.
e.zh: 消化道从口腔一直延伸到肛门。

e.en: Doctors examined his {alimentary} tract for signs of inflammation.
e.zh: 医生检查了他的消化道是否有炎症迹象。

e.en: He pays {alimony} to his ex-wife every month.
e.zh: 他每个月都要付赡养费给前妻。

e.en: The judge ordered {alimony} payments for the next five years.
e.zh: 法官判决在未来五年内支付赡养费。

aline.t: v. 对齐（align 的旧拼写）

e.en: Older texts sometimes {aline} the columns by hand.
e.zh: 较早的文本有时会手工把列对齐。

e.en: Engineers carefully {aline} the rails before welding them.
e.zh: 工程师在焊接前会仔细对齐铁轨。

aliquot.t:
n. 等分试样
adj. 可整除的

e.en: The technician took an {aliquot} of the sample for testing.
e.zh: 技术员取了样品的一小份用于检测。

e.en: Each {aliquot} was stored in a separate frozen tube.
e.zh: 每一小份样品都被分别存放在冷冻管中。

e.en: {Alitalia} was Italy's flagship airline for many decades.
e.zh: 意大利航空数十年来一直是意大利的旗舰航空公司。

e.en: My grandfather always flew {Alitalia} when visiting Rome.
e.zh: 我祖父去罗马时总是乘坐意大利航空。

e.en: The garden comes {alive} with color every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天花园都会被各种色彩点亮。

e.en: She's the only person {alive} who remembers that day.
e.zh: 她是唯一还记得那一天的在世之人。

e.en: Yoga gives her a deep sense of {aliveness} each morning.
e.zh: 瑜伽每天早晨都让她有一种鲜活的生命感。

e.en: The painting conveys an extraordinary {aliveness} in every brushstroke.
e.zh: 这幅画每一笔都传达出非凡的生命力。

aliyah.t: n. 犹太人移居以色列

e.en: Her family made {aliyah} to Israel last summer.
e.zh: 她家去年夏天移居到了以色列。

e.en: He's been preparing for {aliyah} for almost two years.
e.zh: 他为移居以色列已经准备了近两年。

e.en: Artists often use {alizarin} crimson for deep red shadows.
e.zh: 画家常用茜素深红来画深红色阴影。

e.en: The dye {alizarin} was originally extracted from madder roots.
e.zh: 茜素染料最初是从茜草根中提取的。

e.en: Strong {alkali} solutions can burn the skin badly.
e.zh: 强碱溶液会严重灼伤皮肤。

e.en: Soap is made by reacting fat with an {alkali}.
e.zh: 肥皂是用脂肪和碱反应制成的。

e.en: Many people drink {alkaline} water for its claimed health benefits.
e.zh: 很多人喝碱性水,认为对健康有益。

e.en: The soil here is too {alkaline} for blueberries to thrive.
e.zh: 这里的土壤碱性过强,蓝莓长不好。

e.en: Test the pool's {alkalinity} before adding any chemicals.
e.zh: 在加任何化学药剂之前先测一下泳池的碱度。

e.en: High {alkalinity} in the soil affects plant growth.
e.zh: 土壤碱度过高会影响植物生长。

e.en: Caffeine is a natural {alkaloid} found in coffee beans.
e.zh: 咖啡因是咖啡豆中天然存在的一种生物碱。

e.en: Some plants produce {alkaloid} compounds to deter herbivores.
e.zh: 有些植物会产生生物碱化合物来驱赶食草动物。

e.en: They repainted the door with a glossy {alkyd} enamel.
e.zh: 他们用一种亮光醇酸瓷漆重新粉刷了门。

e.en: {Alkyd} paint dries to a tough, durable finish.
e.zh: 醇酸漆干后会形成坚韧耐用的漆面。

e.en: An {alkyl} group consists of carbon and hydrogen atoms.
e.zh: 烷基由碳原子和氢原子组成。

e.en: Chemists attached an {alkyl} chain to the benzene ring.
e.zh: 化学家在苯环上连接了一条烷基链。

all.t:
adj. 所有的
pron. 全部

e.en: {All} the cookies were gone by the end of lunch.
e.zh: 午饭结束时所有饼干都被吃光了。

e.en: She thanked {all} of her teachers at the graduation ceremony.
e.zh: 她在毕业典礼上感谢了她所有的老师。

all-encompassing.t: adj. 包罗万象的；无所不包的

e.en: The platform offers an {all-encompassing} solution for online retailers.
e.zh: 该平台为在线零售商提供一站式的全方位解决方案。

e.en: His love for music is {all-encompassing} and shapes daily life.
e.zh: 他对音乐的热爱无所不包,塑造着日常生活。

e.en: The piece is marked "{alla} marcia" in the score.
e.zh: 乐谱上把这段标为"alla marcia"(进行曲风格)。

e.en: They cooked the pasta {alla} carbonara for dinner.
e.zh: 他们晚餐做了卡邦尼意面。

e.en: Muslims around the world worship {Allah} five times daily.
e.zh: 全世界的穆斯林每天礼拜真主五次。

e.en: The phrase "{Allah} hu Akbar" means "God is great".
e.zh: "真主至大"这句话的意思是"上帝是伟大的"。

allay.t: v. 减轻（疑虑、恐惧）；平息

e.en: The CEO spoke publicly to {allay} investor concerns.
e.zh: CEO公开发表讲话以缓解投资者的担忧。

e.en: A warm cup of tea helped {allay} her anxiety.
e.zh: 一杯热茶帮她缓解了焦虑。

e.en: The company denied every {allegation} made by the former employee.
e.zh: 公司否认了前员工提出的每一项指控。

e.en: Police are investigating an {allegation} of fraud at the firm.
e.zh: 警方正在调查该公司涉嫌欺诈的指控。

e.en: The senator dismissed the {allegations} as politically motivated.
e.zh: 参议员将这些指控斥为出于政治目的。

e.en: Several {allegations} of misconduct surfaced during the trial.
e.zh: 审判期间出现了多项不当行为的指控。

allege.t: v. 声称；指控（未经证实）

e.en: Critics {allege} that the app secretly tracks user location.
e.zh: 批评者指称该应用偷偷追踪用户位置。

e.en: The lawsuit will {allege} negligence on the part of the hospital.
e.zh: 该诉讼将指控医院存在疏忽。

e.en: The {alleged} hacker was arrested at the airport yesterday.
e.zh: 那名被指控的黑客昨天在机场被捕。

e.en: Reporters questioned the CEO about his {alleged} insider trading.
e.zh: 记者们就这位CEO涉嫌内幕交易一事提问。

e.en: He {allegedly} leaked the document to a foreign newspaper.
e.zh: 据称他把文件泄露给了一家外国报纸。

e.en: The driver was {allegedly} texting just before the crash.
e.zh: 据称司机在车祸发生前正在发短信。

alleges.t: v. 声称（alleges 第三人称单数）

e.en: The complaint {alleges} that the manager ignored safety reports.
e.zh: 投诉指控经理无视安全报告。

e.en: She {alleges} the company stole her original design.
e.zh: 她声称该公司窃取了她的原创设计。

e.en: Students pledge {allegiance} to the flag every morning.
e.zh: 学生们每天早上向国旗宣誓效忠。

e.en: Many gamers shifted their {allegiance} to the new console.
e.zh: 许多玩家将忠诚转向了新的游戏主机。

e.en: She filed a lawsuit {alleging} discrimination by her employer.
e.zh: 她提起诉讼,指控雇主存在歧视行为。

e.en: Reports {alleging} corruption have rocked the city council.
e.zh: 指控腐败的报道震动了市议会。

e.en: The novel offers an {allegorical} take on modern politics.
e.zh: 这部小说以寓言的方式呈现了现代政治。

e.en: Her paintings are full of {allegorical} figures and symbols.
e.zh: 她的画作充满了寓言式的人物和符号。

e.en: The film {allegorically} depicts the struggle between freedom and control.
e.zh: 这部电影以寓言方式描绘了自由与控制之间的斗争。

e.en: He spoke {allegorically} about the company's recent troubles.
e.zh: 他用寓言的方式谈论公司近来的困境。

e.en: Many fairy tales are {allegories} about growing up.
e.zh: 许多童话都是关于成长的寓言。

e.en: The author writes political {allegories} disguised as fantasy.
e.zh: 这位作家把政治寓言伪装成奇幻故事。

e.en: Critics often {allegorize} the dragon as corporate greed.
e.zh: 评论家常把那条龙寓意为企业贪婪。

e.en: The director chose to {allegorize} the war through animal characters.
e.zh: 导演选择用动物角色来寓意这场战争。

e.en: Animal Farm is a famous {allegory} about totalitarian power.
e.zh: 《动物农场》是一部讽喻极权统治的著名寓言。

e.en: The painting works as an {allegory} of human ambition.
e.zh: 这幅画是一则关于人类野心的寓言。

allegro.t:
n. 快板（音乐）
adv. 快速地

e.en: The orchestra played the {allegro} movement with great energy.
e.zh: 乐团充满活力地演奏了快板乐章。

e.en: She practiced the {allegro} section until her fingers ached.
e.zh: 她反复练习快板部分,直到手指发酸。

e.en: This {allele} is linked to a higher risk of diabetes.
e.zh: 这个等位基因与较高的糖尿病风险有关。

e.en: Each parent passes one {allele} of the gene to the child.
e.zh: 父母各自将该基因的一个等位基因传给孩子。

allelopathy.t: n. 化感作用（植物间相互影响）

e.en: Walnut trees use {allelopathy} to suppress nearby plants.
e.zh: 核桃树通过化感作用抑制周围植物的生长。

e.en: Researchers study {allelopathy} to develop natural weed control.
e.zh: 研究人员研究化感作用以开发天然除草方法。

alleluia.t: int. 哈利路亚；赞美上帝

e.en: The choir burst into a joyful {alleluia} at the finale.
e.zh: 合唱团在终曲中迸发出欢乐的哈利路亚。

e.en: She softly sang an {alleluia} as the sun rose.
e.zh: 日出时她轻轻唱着一首哈利路亚。

e.en: General {Allenby} led British forces into Jerusalem in 1917.
e.zh: 艾伦比将军于1917年率领英军进入耶路撒冷。

e.en: Tourists often cross into Jordan via the {Allenby} Bridge.
e.zh: 游客常通过艾伦比大桥进入约旦。

e.en: Peanuts are a common {allergen} for young children.
e.zh: 花生是幼儿常见的过敏原。

e.en: The label warns about every potential {allergen} in the snack.
e.zh: 标签上标明了零食中所有潜在的过敏原。

allergenic.t: adj. 致敏的；引起过敏的

e.en: Dust mites are highly {allergenic} for many asthma sufferers.
e.zh: 尘螨对许多哮喘患者具有很强的致敏性。

e.en: The brand markets a less {allergenic} laundry detergent.
e.zh: 该品牌主打一款致敏性较低的洗衣液。

e.en: My roommate is {allergic} to cats and sneezes constantly.
e.zh: 我室友对猫过敏,一直打喷嚏。

e.en: He's {allergic} to any kind of corporate jargon.
e.zh: 他对任何企业术语都极其反感。

e.en: The {allergist} ran a skin test to find the trigger.
e.zh: 过敏专科医生做了皮肤测试以找出过敏源。

e.en: Her {allergist} recommended weekly shots to build immunity.
e.zh: 她的过敏专科医生建议每周打针以建立免疫力。

e.en: My peanut {allergy} forces me to read every food label.
e.zh: 我的花生过敏让我必须阅读每一份食品标签。

e.en: Spring pollen always triggers my seasonal {allergy}.
e.zh: 春季花粉总会引发我的季节性过敏。

e.en: They drove through {Allerton} on their way to Liverpool.
e.zh: 他们开车经过阿勒顿前往利物浦。

e.en: John Lennon spent his childhood in the {Allerton} area.
e.zh: 约翰·列侬的童年是在阿勒顿地区度过的。

alleviate.t: v. 缓解；减轻（痛苦、问题）

e.en: This medicine can {alleviate} back pain within minutes.
e.zh: 这种药能在几分钟内缓解背痛。

e.en: The new policy aims to {alleviate} child poverty nationwide.
e.zh: 新政策旨在缓解全国的儿童贫困问题。

alleviated.t: v. 缓解（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The hot tea {alleviated} her sore throat almost immediately.
e.zh: 那杯热茶几乎立刻缓解了她的喉咙痛。

e.en: Government aid {alleviated} suffering after the earthquake.
e.zh: 政府援助缓解了地震后的灾情。

alleviates.t: v. 缓解（第三人称单数）

e.en: Stretching daily {alleviates} stiffness in my shoulders.
e.zh: 每天拉伸能缓解我肩膀的僵硬。

e.en: This app {alleviates} stress with guided breathing sessions.
e.zh: 这款应用通过引导呼吸来缓解压力。

alleviating.t:
v. 缓解（现在分词）
adj. 有缓解作用的

e.en: Doctors focused on {alleviating} the patient's symptoms first.
e.zh: 医生们首先专注于缓解病人的症状。

e.en: Remote work has been effective in {alleviating} commute fatigue.
e.zh: 远程办公在缓解通勤疲劳方面效果显著。

e.en: The charity focuses on poverty {alleviation} in rural areas.
e.zh: 该慈善机构专注于农村地区的扶贫工作。

e.en: Pain {alleviation} is the main goal of the new treatment.
e.zh: 缓解疼痛是这种新疗法的主要目标。

e.en: The cat darted down a narrow {alley} behind the bakery.
e.zh: 那只猫窜进了面包店后面一条狭窄的小巷。

e.en: We knocked down all ten pins at the bowling {alley}.
e.zh: 我们在保龄球馆把十个瓶子全打倒了。

e.en: A stray dog wandered into the dark {alleyway}.
e.zh: 一只流浪狗走进了昏暗的小巷。

e.en: The cafe hides a charming garden behind a tiny {alleyway}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆在一条小巷后藏着一个迷人的花园。

allgemeine.t: adj. 德语词，意为“普遍的、一般的”

e.en: He subscribes to the Frankfurter {Allgemeine} for German news.
e.zh: 他订阅《法兰克福汇报》以获取德国新闻。

e.en: The phrase {allgemeine} simply means 'general' in German.
e.zh: allgemeine这个词在德语中就是“一般的”意思。

e.en: The two startups formed an {alliance} to challenge the giants.
e.zh: 这两家初创公司结成联盟以挑战巨头。

e.en: NATO is the largest military {alliance} in modern history.
e.zh: 北约是现代历史上最大的军事联盟。

e.en: Players form temporary {alliances} to survive the early game.
e.zh: 玩家们结成临时联盟以在前期生存下来。

e.en: Shifting {alliances} reshaped the tech industry last decade.
e.zh: 不断变化的联盟在过去十年重塑了科技行业。

allied.t:
adj. 结盟的；同盟的
v. 联合（过去式）

e.en: The {allied} forces coordinated their landing on the beaches.
e.zh: 盟军协调了他们的海滩登陆行动。

e.en: Our team is closely {allied} with the marketing department.
e.zh: 我们团队与市场部紧密合作。

e.en: She found unexpected {allies} among her former competitors.
e.zh: 她在以前的竞争对手中找到了意想不到的盟友。

e.en: The country relies heavily on its NATO {allies} for defense.
e.zh: 该国在防务上严重依赖其北约盟友。

e.en: A massive {alligator} sunned itself on the riverbank.
e.zh: 一只巨大的短吻鳄在河岸上晒太阳。

e.en: Tourists snapped photos of the {alligator} from the boardwalk.
e.zh: 游客们从木栈道上拍下了那只短吻鳄的照片。

e.en: Copywriters often {alliterate} to make slogans more memorable.
e.zh: 文案撰稿人常用押头韵让广告语更易记。

e.en: Try to {alliterate} the band's name for stronger branding.
e.zh: 试着让乐队名押头韵,以打造更强的品牌效应。

e.en: Headlines often use {alliteration} to grab the reader's attention.
e.zh: 新闻标题常用押头韵来吸引读者的注意。

e.en: 'Peter Piper' is a classic example of {alliteration}.
e.zh: “Peter Piper”是押头韵的经典例子。

e.en: The poet favored short, {alliterative} lines for rhythmic effect.
e.zh: 诗人偏爱简短押头韵的诗句以制造节奏感。

e.en: Brand names like Coca-Cola use an {alliterative} pattern.
e.zh: 像可口可乐这样的品牌名采用了押头韵的形式。

e.en: She picked up the phone and said '{allo}?' cheerfully.
e.zh: 她拿起电话,愉快地说了声“喂?”。

e.en: In French films, characters answer the phone with '{allo}'.
e.zh: 在法国电影里,角色们用“allo”来接电话。

alloa.t: n. 阿洛厄（苏格兰地名）

e.en: {Alloa} is a small town on the north bank of the Forth.
e.zh: 阿洛厄是福斯河北岸的一个小镇。

e.en: They watched a football match between {Alloa} and Falkirk.
e.zh: 他们观看了一场阿洛厄队对福尔柯克队的足球比赛。

allocate.t: v. 分配；划拨（资源、资金）

e.en: The team needs to {allocate} more budget to user research.
e.zh: 团队需要把更多预算分配给用户研究。

e.en: Please {allocate} two hours each day to deep work.
e.zh: 请每天划出两个小时用于深度工作。

allocated.t: v. 分配（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The manager {allocated} three engineers to the urgent bug.
e.zh: 经理调派了三名工程师来处理这个紧急bug。

e.en: Funds were {allocated} to upgrade the school's computers.
e.zh: 资金已被分配用于升级学校的电脑。

allocates.t: v. 分配（第三人称单数）

e.en: The OS dynamically {allocates} memory as programs request it.
e.zh: 操作系统根据程序需要动态分配内存。

e.en: The grant {allocates} half a million dollars to climate research.
e.zh: 该资助将五十万美元拨给气候研究。

e.en: We're {allocating} more servers to handle the holiday traffic.
e.zh: 我们正在调配更多服务器来应对节假日的流量。

e.en: She spent the morning {allocating} tasks to her interns.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在给实习生分配任务。

e.en: The budget {allocation} for marketing doubled this year.
e.zh: 今年市场营销的预算分配翻了一番。

e.en: Memory {allocation} bugs can crash the entire application.
e.zh: 内存分配错误可能让整个应用崩溃。

e.en: The committee reviewed funding {allocations} for each department.
e.zh: 委员会审核了各部门的资金分配。

e.en: Server resource {allocations} are adjusted based on real-time load.
e.zh: 服务器资源分配会根据实时负载进行调整。

e.en: Markets are praised for their {allocative} efficiency.
e.zh: 市场因其在资源配置上的效率而受到赞誉。

e.en: Taxes can distort the {allocative} decisions of firms.
e.zh: 税收可能扭曲企业的资源配置决策。

allocator.t: n. 分配器（程序中的内存分配器）

e.en: A custom memory {allocator} can dramatically speed up the program.
e.zh: 定制的内存分配器能大幅加快程序运行速度。

e.en: The {allocator} distributes computing resources across the cluster.
e.zh: 该分配器在集群中分配计算资源。

e.en: Doctors performed an {allogeneic} stem cell transplant on the patient.
e.zh: 医生为患者进行了异体干细胞移植。

e.en: {Allogeneic} donors must match the recipient's tissue type.
e.zh: 异体捐献者的组织类型必须与受者相匹配。

e.en: The burn victim received a skin {allograft} from a donor.
e.zh: 烧伤者接受了一份来自捐献者的皮肤同种移植。

e.en: Bone {allograft} is commonly used in spinal surgery.
e.zh: 同种异体骨移植在脊柱手术中很常用。

e.en: Researchers studied the {allometric} growth of fish fins.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了鱼鳍的异速生长。

e.en: Brain size shows an {allometric} relationship with body mass.
e.zh: 脑容量与体重呈异速比例关系。

e.en: {Allometry} explains why elephants need thicker legs than mice.
e.zh: 异速生长学解释了为何大象的腿比老鼠粗得多。

e.en: Biologists use {allometry} to compare organ sizes across species.
e.zh: 生物学家用异速生长来比较不同物种的器官大小。

e.en: She prefers {allopathic} medicine over herbal remedies.
e.zh: 她更倾向于现代西医而非草药疗法。

e.en: Most hospitals practice {allopathic} treatments for serious illnesses.
e.zh: 大多数医院采用对抗疗法治疗重病。

e.en: The museum displays a full {allosaurus} skeleton near the entrance.
e.zh: 博物馆入口附近展示着一具完整的异特龙骨架。

e.en: An {allosaurus} was a fierce predator of the late Jurassic period.
e.zh: 异特龙是侏罗纪晚期的凶猛掠食者。

e.en: The teacher will {allot} ten minutes for each presentation.
e.zh: 老师将给每个演讲分配十分钟时间。

e.en: We need to {allot} more budget to marketing this quarter.
e.zh: 我们这个季度需要给市场部分配更多预算。

e.en: Each employee gets a yearly vacation {allotment} of 20 days.
e.zh: 每位员工每年享有20天的休假额度。

e.en: He grows tomatoes on his small {allotment} outside town.
e.zh: 他在城外的小块菜地上种番茄。

e.en: The council rents {allotments} to local gardeners cheaply.
e.zh: 市政府以低价向本地园丁出租菜地。

e.en: Budget {allotments} were finalized at the meeting yesterday.
e.zh: 预算分配方案在昨天的会议上敲定了。

allots.t: v. 分配（第三人称单数）

e.en: The system {allots} bandwidth based on user priority.
e.zh: 系统根据用户优先级分配带宽。

e.en: She {allots} an hour each morning for exercise.
e.zh: 她每天早上留出一小时锻炼。

allotted.t:
adj. 分配的
v. 分配（过去式）

e.en: You only have the {allotted} time to finish the exam.
e.zh: 你只能在规定时间内完成考试。

e.en: Each speaker was {allotted} five minutes at the panel.
e.zh: 研讨会上每位发言者被分配了五分钟。

e.en: The {allottee} must register the property within 30 days.
e.zh: 获分配人必须在30天内办理产权登记。

e.en: Each {allottee} received written notice of their share.
e.zh: 每位受配人都收到了关于其份额的书面通知。

e.en: The committee is {allotting} funds to several charities.
e.zh: 委员会正在向几家慈善机构分配资金。

e.en: Try {allotting} time for breaks in your study schedule.
e.zh: 在学习计划里留出休息时间吧。

e.en: Please {allow} two business days for delivery.
e.zh: 请预留两个工作日的送货时间。

e.en: The app does not {allow} screenshots in private mode.
e.zh: 该应用在隐私模式下不允许截屏。

e.en: The {allowable} carry-on weight is seven kilograms.
e.zh: 允许携带的随身行李重量为七公斤。

e.en: That expense is not {allowable} under company policy.
e.zh: 按公司规定,那项开支不予报销。

e.en: My parents gave me a weekly {allowance} as a kid.
e.zh: 我小时候父母每周给我零花钱。

e.en: The hotel charges extra beyond the baggage {allowance}.
e.zh: 酒店对超出行李限额的部分加收费用。

e.en: Travel {allowances} are reimbursed at the end of each month.
e.zh: 差旅津贴每月底统一报销。

e.en: You should make {allowances} for her lack of experience.
e.zh: 你应该体谅她经验不足。

allowed.t:
v. 允许（过去式/过去分词）
adj. 被允许的

e.en: Pets are not {allowed} in the dining area.
e.zh: 用餐区不允许携带宠物。

e.en: She {allowed} her son to stay up late on weekends.
e.zh: 她允许儿子周末晚睡。

allowing.t: v. 允许；允许的现在分词

e.en: The new feature is {allowing} users to share notes instantly.
e.zh: 新功能让用户可以即时分享笔记。

e.en: They updated the policy, {allowing} remote work twice a week.
e.zh: 他们更新了政策,允许每周远程办公两天。

allows.t: v. 允许；准许（第三人称单数）

e.en: This setting {allows} push notifications from the app.
e.zh: 此设置允许该应用发送推送通知。

e.en: The schedule {allows} time for both work and rest.
e.zh: 这个时间表兼顾了工作与休息。

alloy.t:
n. 合金
v. 掺合

e.en: Bronze is an {alloy} of copper and tin.
e.zh: 青铜是铜和锡的合金。

e.en: The bike frame is made from a lightweight aluminum {alloy}.
e.zh: 这辆自行车的车架由轻质铝合金制成。

e.en: Add a pinch of {allspice} to the pumpkin pie filling.
e.zh: 在南瓜派馅料里加一小撮多香果粉。

e.en: Jamaican jerk seasoning relies heavily on {allspice}.
e.zh: 牙买加烟熏调料里多香果是主角。

e.en: Politicians often {allude} to their rivals without naming them.
e.zh: 政客们常含沙射影地暗指对手却不点名。

e.en: The song's lyrics {allude} to a painful breakup.
e.zh: 这首歌的歌词暗指一段痛苦的分手。

e.en: The CEO {alluded} to upcoming layoffs in his speech.
e.zh: 首席执行官在讲话中暗示即将裁员。

e.en: She {alluded} to her childhood without sharing details.
e.zh: 她提到了童年但没透露细节。

alludes.t: v. 暗指（第三人称单数）

e.en: The novel's title {alludes} to a famous Bible verse.
e.zh: 这部小说的书名暗指一句著名的圣经经文。

e.en: He often {alludes} to his time in the army.
e.zh: 他常常提及自己服役的那段日子。

e.en: She kept {alluding} to a secret she wouldn't reveal.
e.zh: 她不停暗示一个不肯透露的秘密。

e.en: The article is clearly {alluding} to recent political scandals.
e.zh: 这篇文章显然在影射最近的政治丑闻。

allure.t:
n. 魅力；诱惑
v. 吸引

e.en: The {allure} of big city life drew her to Shanghai.
e.zh: 大城市生活的魅力把她吸引到了上海。

e.en: Cryptocurrency's {allure} fades when prices crash.
e.zh: 币价暴跌时,加密货币的吸引力就消退了。

e.en: Free shipping is a powerful {allurement} for online shoppers.
e.zh: 免运费对网购者是巨大的诱惑。

e.en: The brochure used scenic photos as {allurement} for tourists.
e.zh: 宣传册用风景照作为吸引游客的诱饵。

e.en: The shop window display was simply too {alluring} to ignore.
e.zh: 店铺橱窗的陈列实在让人无法忽视。

e.en: She gave him an {alluring} smile across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头向他投去迷人的微笑。

e.en: The dessert menu was {alluringly} displayed near the entrance.
e.zh: 甜点菜单诱人地摆在入口附近。

e.en: She spoke {alluringly} about her travels in Italy.
e.zh: 她绘声绘色地讲述着自己在意大利的旅行。

e.en: His speech contained a clear {allusion} to past mistakes.
e.zh: 他的讲话明显暗指过去的错误。

e.en: The film makes a subtle {allusion} to a Hitchcock classic.
e.zh: 这部电影巧妙地致敬了一部希区柯克经典。

e.en: The poem is full of {allusions} to Greek mythology.
e.zh: 这首诗里满是希腊神话的典故。

e.en: His {allusions} to her past made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他暗指她过去的事让所有人都不自在。

allusive.t: adj. 暗示的；引用典故的

e.en: Her writing style is highly {allusive} and rich in references.
e.zh: 她的文风用典极多,充满引申意味。

e.en: The lecture was {allusive}, hinting at deeper meanings.
e.zh: 那场讲座意有所指,暗示着更深的含义。

e.en: The Nile delta has rich {alluvial} soil for farming.
e.zh: 尼罗河三角洲拥有适合耕作的肥沃冲积土。

e.en: Gold is often found in {alluvial} deposits along rivers.
e.zh: 沿河的冲积层中常能发现黄金。

e.en: The river deposits {alluvium} on its banks each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天,这条河都会在两岸沉积冲积土。

e.en: Layers of {alluvium} make this valley extremely fertile.
e.zh: 层层冲积土让这个山谷异常肥沃。

ally.t:
n. 盟友；同盟国
v. 结盟

e.en: Japan is a key {ally} of the United States in Asia.
e.zh: 日本是美国在亚洲的重要盟友。

e.en: She tried to {ally} herself with the new manager.
e.zh: 她努力与新任经理结成同盟。

e.en: Smaller nations are {allying} to counter regional pressure.
e.zh: 小国正在结盟以抵御地区压力。

e.en: By {allying} with rivals, the company reshaped the market.
e.zh: 通过与对手联手,这家公司重塑了市场格局。

alm.t: n. 施舍物（罕用，多用复数 alms）

e.en: The beggar received a small {alm} from a passerby.
e.zh: 乞丐从一位路人那里得到了一点施舍。

e.en: Even one {alm} can mean a meal to the hungry.
e.zh: 哪怕一点施舍,对饥饿者而言也意味着一顿饭。

alma.t: n. 母校（常见于 alma mater）

e.en: He returned to his {alma} mater for the alumni reunion.
e.zh: 他回到母校参加校友聚会。

e.en: Stanford is the {alma} mater of many tech founders.
e.zh: 斯坦福是许多科技创始人的母校。

e.en: Farmers still consult the {almanac} for planting dates.
e.zh: 农民们仍然会查阅年鉴来确定播种日期。

e.en: The sports {almanac} lists every champion since 1950.
e.zh: 这本体育年鉴收录了1950年以来的每位冠军。

almeida.t: n. 阿尔梅达（人名/地名）

e.en: The {Almeida} Theatre in London is famous for bold productions.
e.zh: 伦敦的阿尔梅达剧院以大胆的剧作闻名。

e.en: Vasco de {Almeida} signed the contract on behalf of the firm.
e.zh: 瓦斯科·德·阿尔梅达代表公司签署了合同。

e.en: There was an {almighty} crash from the kitchen downstairs.
e.zh: 楼下厨房传来一声巨响。

e.en: Many religions worship an {almighty} creator.
e.zh: 许多宗教都崇拜一位全能的造物主。

e.en: I drink {almond} milk in my morning coffee.
e.zh: 我早上的咖啡里加杏仁奶。

e.en: This cake has a delicate {almond} flavor.
e.zh: 这款蛋糕带有淡淡的杏仁香味。

e.en: The hospital {almoner} helps patients with financial problems.
e.zh: 医院的救济员帮助有经济困难的病人。

e.en: In medieval times, the {almoner} distributed food to the poor.
e.zh: 中世纪时,施赈员负责向穷人分发食物。

e.en: I'm {almost} done with the report, just five more minutes.
e.zh: 报告我快写完了,再五分钟就好。

e.en: She {almost} missed her flight because of traffic.
e.zh: 她因为堵车差点错过了航班。

e.en: Monks rely on {alms} from local villagers for food.
e.zh: 僧侣们依靠当地村民的布施获取食物。

e.en: He gave {alms} to the homeless every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 他每周日早晨都会施舍给无家可归的人。

e.en: The old {almshouse} now serves as a community museum.
e.zh: 那座旧济贫院如今成了社区博物馆。

e.en: Elderly widows once lived in the village {almshouse}.
e.zh: 村里的济贫院曾收容年长的寡妇。

e.en: {Alnwick} Castle was used as Hogwarts in early Harry Potter films.
e.zh: 早期哈利·波特电影曾在阿尼克城堡取景拍摄霍格沃茨。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the gardens at {Alnwick}.
e.zh: 我们周末在阿尼克的花园里逛了个遍。

e.en: Apply some {aloe} gel to soothe your sunburn.
e.zh: 涂点芦荟胶可以缓解晒伤。

e.en: My grandmother grows {aloe} on the kitchen windowsill.
e.zh: 奶奶在厨房的窗台上种了芦荟。

e.en: The protesters held banners {aloft} as they marched.
e.zh: 抗议者在游行时高举横幅。

e.en: Eagles soared {aloft} on the warm afternoon thermals.
e.zh: 老鹰在温暖的午后气流中高飞翱翔。

aloha.t: int. 你好/再见（夏威夷语问候）

e.en: She greeted every guest with a warm {aloha} and a smile.
e.zh: 她用温暖的阿罗哈和微笑迎接每一位客人。

e.en: The hotel staff said {aloha} as we checked in.
e.zh: 我们办理入住时酒店员工说了声阿罗哈。

alone.t:
adj. 独自的
adv. 独自地

e.en: I prefer to work {alone} when I need to focus.
e.zh: 我需要专注时更喜欢独自工作。

e.en: You are not {alone} in feeling nervous before interviews.
e.zh: 面试前感到紧张的不止你一个人。

e.en: He found a quiet {aloneness} that helped him think clearly.
e.zh: 他找到了一种安静的独处状态,有助于清晰思考。

e.en: The poem captures the {aloneness} of city life.
e.zh: 这首诗捕捉了都市生活中的孤独感。

along.t:
prep. 沿着
adv. 向前；一起

e.en: We walked {along} the river until sunset.
e.zh: 我们沿着河边散步直到日落。

e.en: Bring your laptop {along} to the meeting tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天开会时把你的笔记本电脑带上。

e.en: She works {alongside} engineers on the new app.
e.zh: 她和工程师们一起开发这款新应用。

e.en: The boat pulled up {alongside} the dock quietly.
e.zh: 小船静静地停靠在码头旁。

e.en: He stayed {aloof} from office gossip and politics.
e.zh: 他对办公室的八卦和政治保持距离。

e.en: The new manager seemed {aloof} on her first day.
e.zh: 新经理上班第一天显得有些冷淡。

e.en: His {aloofness} at parties is often mistaken for arrogance.
e.zh: 他在聚会上的疏离常被误解为傲慢。

e.en: The cat's {aloofness} is part of its charm.
e.zh: 那只猫的高冷正是它的魅力所在。

e.en: Stress can sometimes trigger temporary {alopecia} in adults.
e.zh: 压力有时会引发成年人暂时性脱发。

e.en: She spoke openly about living with {alopecia}.
e.zh: 她坦然地谈论自己与脱发症共处的经历。

e.en: He shrugged and said {alors} before changing the subject.
e.zh: 他耸耸肩说了声那么,然后换了话题。

e.en: {Alors}, what do you want to do next?
e.zh: 那么,你接下来想做什么?

e.en: Please read the next paragraph {aloud} to the class.
e.zh: 请把下一段大声读给全班听。

e.en: She wondered {aloud} whether the plan would actually work.
e.zh: 她大声地琢磨这个计划到底行不行得通。

alp.t: n. 高山；阿尔卑斯山（常用复数 Alps）

e.en: The hikers camped on a grassy {alp} above the village.
e.zh: 徒步者在村庄上方的高山牧场扎营。

e.en: Cows graze on the {alp} every summer.
e.zh: 奶牛每年夏天都在高山草场上吃草。

e.en: This sweater is made from soft Peruvian {alpaca} wool.
e.zh: 这件毛衣是用柔软的秘鲁羊驼毛织成的。

e.en: An {alpaca} stared at us curiously over the fence.
e.zh: 一只羊驼隔着栅栏好奇地盯着我们。

alpenglow.t: n. 高山红晕（日落时山顶泛红）

e.en: The pink {alpenglow} lit up the snowy peaks at dusk.
e.zh: 傍晚时分,粉色的高山辉光照亮了雪峰。

e.en: We hiked early to catch the morning {alpenglow}.
e.zh: 我们一早出发,只为赶上清晨的高山红霞。

alpha.t: n. 阿尔法（希腊字母 α）；初始版本

e.en: The team is testing an {alpha} version of the app.
e.zh: 团队正在测试这款应用的内测版本。

e.en: He acts like the {alpha} in every group project.
e.zh: 在每个小组项目里他都表现得像头领。

e.en: My daughter is learning the {alphabet} at preschool.
e.zh: 我女儿正在幼儿园学字母表。

e.en: The Greek {alphabet} has twenty-four letters.
e.zh: 希腊字母表共有二十四个字母。

alphabetic.t: adj. 字母的；按字母顺序的

e.en: Sort the contacts in {alphabetic} order before printing.
e.zh: 打印前请按字母顺序整理联系人。

e.en: The dictionary uses an {alphabetic} index for quick lookup.
e.zh: 这本词典使用字母索引以便快速查找。

e.en: Please list the names in {alphabetical} order.
e.zh: 请按字母顺序列出名字。

e.en: The library shelves books in strict {alphabetical} sequence.
e.zh: 图书馆严格按字母顺序排列书籍。

e.en: The files are arranged {alphabetically} by author surname.
e.zh: 这些文件按作者姓氏的字母顺序排列。

e.en: You can sort the spreadsheet {alphabetically} with one click.
e.zh: 你可以一键将表格按字母顺序排序。

e.en: Could you {alphabetize} this list of student names?
e.zh: 你能把这份学生名单按字母顺序排好吗?

e.en: The app will {alphabetize} your bookmarks automatically.
e.zh: 这款应用会自动按字母顺序排列你的书签。

alphabetized.t:
adj. 已按字母顺序排列的
v. alphabetize 的过去式

e.en: She {alphabetized} her bookshelf over the weekend.
e.zh: 她周末把书架上的书按字母顺序排好了。

e.en: The neatly {alphabetized} folders made auditing much easier.
e.zh: 整齐按字母排序的文件夹让审计轻松多了。

e.en: Russian and Greek use different {alphabets} from English.
e.zh: 俄语和希腊语使用与英语不同的字母表。

e.en: He's fascinated by ancient {alphabets} and writing systems.
e.zh: 他对古代字母表和书写系统很着迷。

e.en: Your password must include {alphanumeric} characters and a symbol.
e.zh: 你的密码必须包含字母数字和一个符号。

e.en: The license plate uses an {alphanumeric} code.
e.zh: 车牌使用字母与数字组合的编码。

alpine.t: adj. 高山的；阿尔卑斯山的

e.en: They spent the holiday in a cozy {alpine} village.
e.zh: 他们在一个舒适的高山小村度过假期。

e.en: This jacket is designed for serious {alpine} climbing.
e.zh: 这件夹克是为专业高山攀登设计的。

e.en: The {alpinist} reached the summit just before sunrise.
e.zh: 这位高山登山者在日出前刚好登顶。

e.en: Every serious {alpinist} trains year-round for big climbs.
e.zh: 每位认真的登山者都会全年训练以应对大攀登。

e.en: We went skiing in the Swiss {Alps} last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天我们在瑞士阿尔卑斯山滑雪。

e.en: The {Alps} stretch across several European countries.
e.zh: 阿尔卑斯山脉横跨多个欧洲国家。

e.en: I've {already} finished the report you asked for.
e.zh: 你要的报告我已经写完了。

e.en: Is it {already} midnight? Time flew tonight.
e.zh: 已经半夜了吗?今晚时间过得真快。

alright.t: adv. 好的；没问题（= all right）

e.en: Don't worry, everything is going to be {alright}.
e.zh: 别担心,一切都会好起来的。

e.en: Are you {alright} after that long flight?
e.zh: 经过那么长的飞行,你还好吗?

alsace.t: n. 阿尔萨斯（法国地区）

e.en: We toured small wineries throughout {Alsace} last September.
e.zh: 去年九月我们游览了阿尔萨斯各地的小酒庄。

e.en: {Alsace} is famous for its dry white wines.
e.zh: 阿尔萨斯以其干白葡萄酒闻名。

alsatian.t:
n. 德国牧羊犬
adj. 阿尔萨斯的

e.en: Their {alsatian} guards the yard every night.
e.zh: 他们家的德国牧羊犬每晚都看守院子。

e.en: The chef prepared a hearty {Alsatian} stew for dinner.
e.zh: 厨师为晚餐准备了一道丰盛的阿尔萨斯炖菜。

e.en: She speaks French and {also} a little Japanese.
e.zh: 她会说法语,也会一点日语。

e.en: The new phone is faster and {also} cheaper.
e.zh: 这款新手机更快,而且也更便宜。

alt.t: n. 键盘 Alt 键；替代文本（alternative 缩写）

e.en: Hold {alt} and click to open the link in another tab.
e.zh: 按住 alt 键并点击,可以在新标签中打开链接。

e.en: Always add descriptive {alt} text to every image.
e.zh: 务必为每张图片添加描述性的替代文本。

e.en: Skiers love the deep powder at {Alta}, Utah.
e.zh: 滑雪者喜爱犹他州奥尔塔的深厚粉雪。

e.en: We booked a cabin near {Alta} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们在奥尔塔附近订了一间小木屋过周末。

e.en: The {Altai} mountains span Russia, Mongolia, and China.
e.zh: 阿尔泰山脉横跨俄罗斯、蒙古和中国。

e.en: Researchers study ancient burial sites in the {Altai}.
e.zh: 研究人员在阿尔泰地区考察古代墓葬遗址。

e.en: The bride walked slowly toward the {altar}.
e.zh: 新娘缓缓走向圣坛。

e.en: Fresh flowers were placed on the church {altar}.
e.zh: 教堂的圣坛上摆放着新鲜的花。

e.en: The medieval {altarpiece} depicts scenes from the Bible.
e.zh: 这件中世纪祭坛画描绘了圣经中的场景。

e.en: Tourists stood quietly admiring the gilded {altarpiece}.
e.zh: 游客们静静地欣赏那幅镀金的祭坛画。

e.en: Many homes here keep small ancestral {altars}.
e.zh: 这里许多家庭都设有小小的祖先祭坛。

e.en: The temple has several {altars} for different deities.
e.zh: 这座寺庙有几个供奉不同神明的祭坛。

e.en: The telescope sits on a sturdy {altazimuth} mount.
e.zh: 这台望远镜安装在坚固的地平式支架上。

e.en: An {altazimuth} mount tracks objects using two simple axes.
e.zh: 地平式支架通过两个简单的轴来跟踪天体。

altdorf.t: n. 阿尔特多夫（瑞士城镇）

e.en: We changed trains in {Altdorf} on the way south.
e.zh: 我们南下时在阿尔特多夫换了火车。

e.en: {Altdorf} is famous for its statue of William Tell.
e.zh: 阿尔特多夫以威廉·泰尔的雕像而闻名。

e.en: The tailor can {alter} the dress before the wedding.
e.zh: 裁缝可以在婚礼前修改这件礼服。

e.en: Nothing you say will {alter} my decision.
e.zh: 无论你说什么都改变不了我的决定。

e.en: The settings are easily {alterable} from the dashboard.
e.zh: 这些设置可以在仪表盘上轻松更改。

e.en: His opinions are rarely {alterable} once formed.
e.zh: 他的观点一旦形成就很难改变。

e.en: The dress needs a small {alteration} around the waist.
e.zh: 这条裙子腰部需要稍作修改。

e.en: Even a tiny {alteration} to the code broke the build.
e.zh: 哪怕是对代码做一点小改动,构建也崩了。

e.en: A loud {altercation} broke out between two customers.
e.zh: 两位顾客之间爆发了一场激烈的争吵。

e.en: Police arrived after a brief {altercation} in the parking lot.
e.zh: 在停车场发生短暂争执后警方赶到了。

altered.t:
adj. 被改动过的
v. alter 的过去式

e.en: The new evidence completely {altered} the jury's view.
e.zh: 新证据彻底改变了陪审团的看法。

e.en: She had her wedding dress {altered} twice.
e.zh: 她把婚纱改了两次。

altering.t: v. alter 的现在分词；改变

e.en: The CEO is {altering} the company's hiring strategy.
e.zh: 首席执行官正在调整公司的招聘策略。

e.en: {Altering} this file might break the application.
e.zh: 修改这个文件可能会导致应用崩溃。

e.en: The novel explores themes of identity and {alterity}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了身份与他者性的主题。

e.en: Philosophers often discuss {alterity} when talking about the self.
e.zh: 哲学家在谈论自我时常常讨论他者性。

alternate.t:
v. 交替；轮流
adj. 备用的；交替的

e.en: You can take an {alternate} route to avoid traffic.
e.zh: 你可以走另一条路来避开堵车。

e.en: We {alternate} who picks up the kids each week.
e.zh: 我们每周轮流接孩子。

alternated.t: v. alternate 的过去式；已交替

e.en: She {alternated} between coffee and tea throughout the morning.
e.zh: 整个上午她交替着喝咖啡和茶。

e.en: The runners {alternated} the lead during the final lap.
e.zh: 在最后一圈,选手们交替领先。

e.en: The lights flashed {alternately} red and blue.
e.zh: 灯光交替闪烁着红色和蓝色。

e.en: He felt {alternately} excited and nervous before the show.
e.zh: 演出前他时而兴奋时而紧张。

alternates.t:
n. 备选者（复数）
v. 交替

e.en: The team named two {alternates} in case someone got injured.
e.zh: 球队指定了两名替补,以防有人受伤。

e.en: The schedule {alternates} morning and evening shifts each week.
e.zh: 这份排班每周交替安排早班和晚班。

e.en: The wallpaper has {alternating} stripes of blue and gold.
e.zh: 这种壁纸有蓝金交替的条纹。

e.en: He spent the day {alternating} between meetings and emails.
e.zh: 他一整天都在开会和回邮件之间来回切换。

e.en: The {alternation} of light and dark made the photo striking.
e.zh: 明暗交替让这张照片格外抢眼。

e.en: Their schedule follows a strict {alternation} between work and rest.
e.zh: 他们的日程严格按照工作与休息交替安排。

alternative.t:
n. 替代方案
adj. 可替代的

e.en: Is there a vegetarian {alternative} on the menu?
e.zh: 菜单上有素食的替代选择吗？

e.en: We need an {alternative} plan in case the flight is canceled.
e.zh: 我们需要一个备用方案以防航班取消。

e.en: You can pay online, or {alternatively} mail a check.
e.zh: 你可以在线支付，或者也可以邮寄支票。

e.en: {Alternatively}, we could meet at the cafe near your office.
e.zh: 或者，我们可以在你办公室附近的咖啡馆见面。

e.en: The app suggests healthier {alternatives} to sugary drinks.
e.zh: 这款应用会推荐含糖饮料的更健康替代品。

e.en: We explored several {alternatives} before choosing this design.
e.zh: 在选定这个设计之前，我们考察了好几种方案。

e.en: The mechanic said the {alternator} needs to be replaced.
e.zh: 修车师傅说交流发电机需要更换了。

e.en: A failing {alternator} can drain your car battery quickly.
e.zh: 发电机故障会很快耗光汽车电瓶。

alters.t: v. 更改（第三人称单数）

e.en: Adding salt slightly {alters} the flavor of the soup.
e.zh: 加点盐会稍微改变汤的味道。

e.en: This update {alters} how notifications appear on your phone.
e.zh: 这次更新改变了通知在手机上的显示方式。

althorp.t: n. 奥尔索普（英国庄园名）

e.en: Tourists visit {Althorp} to see Princess Diana's childhood home.
e.zh: 游客们前往奥尔索普庄园参观戴安娜王妃童年的家。

e.en: The {Althorp} estate hosts an annual literary festival.
e.zh: 奥尔索普庄园每年都会举办文学节。

e.en: {Although} it was raining, we still went hiking.
e.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是去爬山了。

e.en: She enjoyed the movie, {although} the ending felt rushed.
e.zh: 她挺喜欢这部电影，虽然结尾感觉有点仓促。

e.en: The pilot checked the {altimeter} before beginning descent.
e.zh: 飞行员在开始下降前查看了高度表。

e.en: My smartwatch has a built-in {altimeter} for hiking.
e.zh: 我的智能手表内置了适合徒步的高度计。

altiplano.t: n. 南美高原（尤指安第斯）

e.en: Llamas graze freely across the Bolivian {altiplano}.
e.zh: 羊驼在玻利维亚高原上自由地吃草。

e.en: The {altiplano} stretches between two ranges of the Andes.
e.zh: 这片高原延伸于安第斯山脉的两条山系之间。

e.en: Some travelers feel sick at high {altitude}.
e.zh: 有些旅客在高海拔地区会感到不适。

e.en: The plane reached cruising {altitude} about ten minutes after takeoff.
e.zh: 飞机起飞约十分钟后达到了巡航高度。

e.en: Water boils at lower temperatures at high {altitudes}.
e.zh: 在高海拔地区，水会在更低的温度下沸腾。

e.en: Drones in this category cannot fly at certain {altitudes}.
e.zh: 此类无人机不能在特定高度飞行。

e.en: The study examined {altitudinal} variation in plant species.
e.zh: 该研究考察了植物物种随海拔的变化。

e.en: Hikers noticed clear {altitudinal} changes in vegetation along the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者注意到沿途植被随海拔有明显变化。

e.en: She sings {alto} in the church choir.
e.zh: 她在教堂唱诗班里担任女低音。

e.en: The composer wrote a beautiful solo for {alto} saxophone.
e.zh: 作曲家为中音萨克斯写了一段优美的独奏。

e.en: The trip cost {altogether} about two thousand dollars.
e.zh: 这次旅行总共花了大约两千美元。

e.en: His attitude has changed {altogether} since the promotion.
e.zh: 他升职以后态度完全变了。

e.en: We took a weekend trip to {Alton} Towers theme park.
e.zh: 我们周末去奥尔顿塔主题公园玩了一趟。

e.en: {Alton} is a small town in the south of England.
e.zh: 奥尔顿是英格兰南部的一座小镇。

altrincham.t: n. 奥尔特灵厄姆（英国地名）

e.en: The new restaurant in {Altrincham} has great reviews online.
e.zh: 奥尔特灵厄姆那家新餐厅在网上好评如潮。

e.en: {Altrincham} market is popular with foodies on weekends.
e.zh: 奥尔特灵厄姆市场周末很受美食爱好者欢迎。

e.en: Her {altruism} inspired others to volunteer at the shelter.
e.zh: 她的利他精神激励了更多人到收容所做志愿者。

e.en: Pure {altruism} is rare, but small kind acts add up.
e.zh: 纯粹的利他很少见，但点滴善举会积少成多。

altruisms.t: n. 利他行为（altruism 的复数）

e.en: The book contrasts different {altruisms} across cultures.
e.zh: 这本书对比了不同文化中的各种利他行为。

e.en: Researchers debate which {altruisms} are truly selfless.
e.zh: 研究人员争论哪些利他行为才是真正无私的。

e.en: He's a true {altruist} who donates most of his income.
e.zh: 他是一个真正的利他主义者，把大部分收入都捐了出去。

e.en: Every {altruist} I know quietly helps without seeking credit.
e.zh: 我认识的每个利他者都默默助人，不求回报。

e.en: Her {altruistic} work in the village earned widespread respect.
e.zh: 她在村里无私的工作赢得了广泛尊敬。

e.en: Donating blood is one of the most {altruistic} things you can do.
e.zh: 献血是你能做的最无私的事情之一。

e.en: He acted {altruistically}, refusing any payment for his help.
e.zh: 他无私地行动，拒绝接受任何报酬。

e.en: She {altruistically} gave up her seat to the elderly passenger.
e.zh: 她无私地把座位让给了那位年长的乘客。

alum.t:
n. 明矾
n. 校友（口语缩写）

e.en: She's a proud Stanford {alum} who mentors current students.
e.zh: 她是一名自豪的斯坦福校友，会指导在校学生。

e.en: The conference reunited several {alum} from the same lab.
e.zh: 这次会议让来自同一实验室的几位校友重聚。

e.en: Smartphone screens often use a hardened {alumina} coating.
e.zh: 智能手机屏幕常常采用强化氧化铝涂层。

e.en: The factory refines bauxite into {alumina} for export.
e.zh: 这家工厂把铝土矿精炼成氧化铝出口。

e.en: The new laptop has a sleek {aluminium} body.
e.zh: 这款新笔记本拥有时尚的铝合金机身。

e.en: Please rinse the {aluminium} cans before recycling.
e.zh: 回收前请把铝罐冲洗一下。

aluminiums.t: n. 铝制品（aluminium 的复数）

e.en: The supplier listed several {aluminiums} suitable for aerospace use.
e.zh: 供应商列出了几种适合航空航天使用的铝合金。

e.en: Different {aluminiums} vary widely in strength and corrosion resistance.
e.zh: 不同的铝材在强度和耐腐蚀性上差异很大。

e.en: Wrap the leftovers in {aluminum} foil before refrigerating.
e.zh: 把剩菜用铝箔包好再放进冰箱。

e.en: This bike frame is made of lightweight {aluminum}.
e.zh: 这辆自行车的车架是用轻质铝制成的。

aluminums.t: n. 铝制品（aluminum 的复数）

e.en: The catalog lists several aerospace-grade {aluminums}.
e.zh: 目录中列出了几种航空级铝材。

e.en: Engineers compared various {aluminums} before choosing the alloy.
e.zh: 工程师在选定合金前比较了多种铝材。

e.en: The famous {alumna} returned to give the graduation speech.
e.zh: 这位著名的女校友回到母校做毕业演讲。

e.en: Every {alumna} received an invitation to the reunion dinner.
e.zh: 每位女校友都收到了校友聚餐的邀请。

e.en: The university hosts an {alumni} dinner every spring.
e.zh: 这所大学每年春天都会举办校友晚宴。

e.en: Many successful {alumni} donate to scholarship funds.
e.zh: 许多成功的校友会向奖学金基金捐款。

e.en: He's a distinguished {alumnus} of Harvard Business School.
e.zh: 他是哈佛商学院的杰出校友。

e.en: Every {alumnus} received a personalized letter from the dean.
e.zh: 每位校友都收到了院长亲笔写的信。

e.en: Smoking damages the {alveolar} sacs in the lungs.
e.zh: 吸烟会损伤肺部的肺泡囊。

e.en: English /t/ is typically an {alveolar} consonant.
e.zh: 英语中的 /t/ 通常是一个齿龈音。

e.en: Each {alveolus} exchanges oxygen and carbon dioxide with the blood.
e.zh: 每个肺泡都与血液交换氧气和二氧化碳。

e.en: The infection inflamed an {alveolus} near the molar.
e.zh: 感染让臼齿附近的一个牙槽发炎了。

e.en: I {always} drink coffee before my morning meeting.
e.zh: 我总是在早会前喝杯咖啡。

e.en: She's {always} willing to help when someone needs advice.
e.zh: 每当有人需要建议时，她总是乐意帮忙。

e.en: Tiny white {alyssum} flowers spilled over the garden wall.
e.zh: 细小的白色香雪球花从花园墙边漫出来。

e.en: She planted {alyssum} along the path for its sweet scent.
e.zh: 她沿小路种了香雪球，为的是那股甜香。

e.en: His grandmother was diagnosed with {Alzheimer}'s disease last year.
e.zh: 他奶奶去年被诊断出阿尔茨海默病。

e.en: Researchers are racing to find a cure for {Alzheimer}'s.
e.zh: 研究人员正争分夺秒寻找阿尔茨海默病的疗法。

ama.t: abbr. Ask Me Anything 的缩写

e.en: The actor did an {AMA} on Reddit last night.
e.zh: 那位演员昨晚在 Reddit 上做了一场问答活动。

e.en: Fans flooded the {AMA} with questions about the new album.
e.zh: 粉丝们在问答里抛出大量关于新专辑的问题。

e.en: The film {Amadeus} won eight Academy Awards in 1985.
e.zh: 电影《莫扎特传》在1985年获得了八项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: Mozart's full name included {Amadeus}, meaning "beloved of God".
e.zh: 莫扎特的全名中带有Amadeus，意思是"上帝所爱"。

e.en: The city is an {amalgam} of cultures and cuisines.
e.zh: 这座城市是多种文化与美食的融合体。

e.en: Old fillings often used a silver {amalgam}.
e.zh: 过去的补牙常使用银汞合金。

e.en: The two startups plan to {amalgamate} by next quarter.
e.zh: 两家初创公司计划在下季度合并。

e.en: Editors {amalgamate} reader feedback into the next draft.
e.zh: 编辑们会把读者反馈整合进下一稿。

e.en: The two banks {amalgamated} into one financial group.
e.zh: 两家银行合并成了一个金融集团。

e.en: She {amalgamated} years of notes into a single book.
e.zh: 她把多年的笔记汇总成了一本书。

e.en: The project is an {amalgamation} of design and engineering ideas.
e.zh: 这个项目是设计与工程理念的融合。

e.en: Their merger created the largest {amalgamation} in the industry.
e.zh: 他们的合并造就了业内规模最大的集团。

e.en: The blind author dictated each chapter to his {amanuensis}.
e.zh: 那位失明的作家把每一章口述给他的抄写员。

e.en: As her {amanuensis}, he typed up every interview transcript.
e.zh: 作为她的助手，他把每一篇采访稿都打了出来。

e.en: {Amaranth} grain is gluten-free and rich in protein.
e.zh: 苋菜籽不含麸质，富含蛋白质。

e.en: She added cooked {amaranth} to her morning porridge.
e.zh: 她在早晨的粥里加了煮熟的苋菜籽。

e.en: He poured a splash of {amaretto} into his coffee.
e.zh: 他往咖啡里倒了一点杏仁酒。

e.en: This dessert pairs beautifully with a glass of {amaretto}.
e.zh: 这道甜点配上一杯杏仁酒非常合适。

e.en: The red {amaryllis} bloomed just before Christmas.
e.zh: 那株红色的孤挺花正好在圣诞节前开花了。

e.en: She gave her mother an {amaryllis} bulb as a gift.
e.zh: 她送给妈妈一颗孤挺花的球根作为礼物。

e.en: The startup hopes to {amass} a million users this year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司希望今年累积一百万用户。

e.en: It took decades to {amass} such a remarkable art collection.
e.zh: 积累如此可观的艺术收藏花了几十年。

amassing.t: v. 积累（amass 的现在分词）

e.en: He's been {amassing} vintage cameras for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他收集复古相机已经超过二十年了。

e.en: The video is {amassing} views faster than expected.
e.zh: 这个视频的观看量增长得比预期还要快。

amateur.t:
n. 业余爱好者
adj. 业余的

e.en: She's an {amateur} photographer with a sharp eye for detail.
e.zh: 她是一位业余摄影师，对细节非常敏锐。

e.en: The tournament is open to both pros and {amateur} players.
e.zh: 这项比赛同时向职业选手和业余选手开放。

e.en: The website looked {amateurish} and lost their trust quickly.
e.zh: 那个网站看起来很业余，很快就失去了用户的信任。

e.en: His first short film felt charming rather than {amateurish}.
e.zh: 他的第一部短片让人觉得别有韵味，而不是业余。

e.en: The film's {amateurishness} showed in every shaky camera shot.
e.zh: 这部电影每个晃动的镜头都透着业余感。

e.en: Critics mocked the {amateurishness} of the new product launch.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑这次新品发布的业余水准。

amateurism.t: n. 业余爱好；非职业性

e.en: The Olympics once strictly enforced rules of {amateurism}.
e.zh: 奥运会曾经严格执行业余运动员制度。

e.en: His report was criticized for its obvious {amateurism}.
e.zh: 他的报告因明显的业余水平而受到批评。

e.en: The tournament welcomes both pros and {amateurs} alike.
e.zh: 这项赛事欢迎职业选手和业余爱好者参加。

e.en: Many talented {amateurs} post their music online for free.
e.zh: 许多有才华的业余爱好者免费在网上发布自己的音乐。

e.en: The poet was famous for his {amatory} verses.
e.zh: 这位诗人以他的爱情诗篇而闻名。

e.en: The novel contains several {amatory} scenes between the main characters.
e.zh: 小说中包含几段主角之间的爱情场景。

e.en: His magic tricks never fail to {amaze} the audience.
e.zh: 他的魔术总能让观众惊叹不已。

e.en: The speed of modern AI continues to {amaze} researchers.
e.zh: 现代人工智能的发展速度持续让研究人员惊讶。

e.en: I was {amazed} at how quickly she learned Chinese.
e.zh: 我惊讶于她学中文的速度有多快。

e.en: Tourists stood {amazed} before the ancient temple.
e.zh: 游客们在古老的寺庙前惊叹不已。

e.en: She watched in {amazement} as the dolphins jumped.
e.zh: 她惊讶地看着海豚跃出水面。

e.en: To my {amazement}, the broken phone started working again.
e.zh: 令我惊讶的是,坏掉的手机又能用了。

e.en: The trip was full of small {amazements} every day.
e.zh: 这次旅行每天都充满了小小的惊喜。

e.en: Childhood is filled with countless tiny {amazements}.
e.zh: 童年充满了无数微小的惊奇时刻。

amazes.t: v. 使惊奇（第三人称单数）

e.en: It {amazes} me how much you can learn from YouTube.
e.zh: 让我惊讶的是,你能从YouTube上学到那么多东西。

e.en: Her dedication to volunteering really {amazes} everyone.
e.zh: 她对志愿工作的投入真的让大家惊叹。

e.en: That new restaurant has {amazing} pasta dishes.
e.zh: 那家新餐厅的意面真的很棒。

e.en: It's {amazing} how fast technology has changed our lives.
e.zh: 科技改变我们生活的速度真是惊人。

e.en: The phone is {amazingly} thin and lightweight.
e.zh: 这部手机薄得令人惊讶,而且很轻。

e.en: She finished the marathon {amazingly} fast for a beginner.
e.zh: 作为新手,她跑完马拉松的速度快得惊人。

e.en: I ordered the book on {Amazon} last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚在亚马逊上订了那本书。

e.en: The {Amazon} rainforest produces a huge share of Earth's oxygen.
e.zh: 亚马逊雨林产生了地球很大一部分的氧气。

e.en: Deforestation in {Amazonia} threatens countless species.
e.zh: 亚马逊地区的森林砍伐威胁着无数物种。

e.en: Scientists study indigenous tribes living deep in {Amazonia}.
e.zh: 科学家研究居住在亚马逊腹地的原住民部落。

amazonian.t: adj. 亚马逊的；女战士般的

e.en: The documentary explored {Amazonian} wildlife in stunning detail.
e.zh: 这部纪录片以惊人的细节展现了亚马逊的野生动物。

e.en: She studied {Amazonian} languages for her PhD thesis.
e.zh: 她为博士论文研究亚马逊地区的语言。

e.en: The new {ambassador} arrived in Beijing yesterday.
e.zh: 新任大使昨天抵达北京。

e.en: She became a brand {ambassador} for the sportswear company.
e.zh: 她成为了那家运动服装公司的品牌大使。

ambassadorial.t: adj. 大使的；外交使节的

e.en: He was given an {ambassadorial} post in Tokyo.
e.zh: 他被任命到东京担任大使职位。

e.en: Her {ambassadorial} skills helped resolve the dispute peacefully.
e.zh: 她的外交才能帮助和平解决了争端。

e.en: Foreign {ambassadors} attended the president's inauguration.
e.zh: 各国大使出席了总统的就职典礼。

e.en: Athletes often serve as {ambassadors} for their countries.
e.zh: 运动员经常担任自己国家的形象大使。

e.en: He was offered an {ambassadorship} in Paris last year.
e.zh: 去年他获得了驻巴黎大使的职位。

e.en: Her {ambassadorship} lasted nearly six years before retirement.
e.zh: 她的大使任期在退休前持续了将近六年。

amber.t:
n. 琥珀
adj. 琥珀色的；（信号灯）黄色的

e.en: The traffic light turned {amber} as I approached.
e.zh: 我接近时交通灯变成了黄色。

e.en: She wore a beautiful necklace made of {amber}.
e.zh: 她戴着一条漂亮的琥珀项链。

e.en: {Ambergris} from sperm whales is highly valued in perfumes.
e.zh: 抹香鲸产的龙涎香在香水制造中价值极高。

e.en: A fisherman found a chunk of {ambergris} worth thousands.
e.zh: 一位渔民发现了一块价值数千元的龙涎香。

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking near {Amberley} village.
e.zh: 我们周末在安伯利村附近徒步旅行。

e.en: {Amberley} Castle is a popular wedding venue in Sussex.
e.zh: 安伯利城堡是萨塞克斯郡热门的婚礼场地。

e.en: The cafe's warm {ambiance} made it perfect for studying.
e.zh: 咖啡馆温馨的氛围使它成为学习的理想场所。

e.en: Soft jazz added to the restaurant's romantic {ambiance}.
e.zh: 柔和的爵士乐为餐厅增添了浪漫的氛围。

e.en: Being {ambidextrous} gives him an advantage in tennis.
e.zh: 双手都能用让他在网球比赛中占有优势。

e.en: Only about one percent of people are truly {ambidextrous}.
e.zh: 只有大约百分之一的人真正能双手并用。

e.en: Candles created a cozy {ambience} for the dinner party.
e.zh: 蜡烛为晚宴营造出温馨的氛围。

e.en: The hotel lobby has a luxurious {ambience}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂洋溢着奢华的氛围。

ambient.t: adj. 周围的；环境的（音乐/光线）

e.en: The app plays {ambient} sounds to help you sleep.
e.zh: 这款应用播放环境音帮助你入睡。

e.en: {Ambient} temperature affects how batteries perform.
e.zh: 环境温度会影响电池的性能。

ambiguities.t: n. 歧义；模棱两可之处（复数）

e.en: The contract had several {ambiguities} that lawyers debated.
e.zh: 这份合同有几处歧义,律师们对此争论不休。

e.en: Translators must carefully handle {ambiguities} in the original text.
e.zh: 译者必须谨慎处理原文中的歧义之处。

e.en: The law's {ambiguity} led to many court cases.
e.zh: 该法律的模糊性导致了许多法庭案件。

e.en: There's some {ambiguity} about who actually owns the data.
e.zh: 关于数据的实际所有权存在一些模糊之处。

ambiguous.t: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊的

e.en: His response was deliberately {ambiguous} to avoid commitment.
e.zh: 他的回答故意含糊其辞,以避免做出承诺。

e.en: The movie's {ambiguous} ending sparked online debate.
e.zh: 这部电影模棱两可的结局引发了网上的讨论。

ambiguously.t: adv. 含糊地；模棱两可地

e.en: The CEO answered {ambiguously} when asked about layoffs.
e.zh: 被问及裁员时,首席执行官含糊其辞地回答。

e.en: The clause was {ambiguously} worded and caused confusion.
e.zh: 这一条款措辞含糊,造成了混乱。

e.en: This issue falls outside the {ambit} of our committee.
e.zh: 这个问题不在我们委员会的职权范围内。

e.en: Privacy laws extend the {ambit} of consumer protection.
e.zh: 隐私法扩展了消费者保护的范围。

e.en: Her lifelong {ambition} is to become a doctor.
e.zh: 她一生的志向是成为一名医生。

e.en: He has the talent and {ambition} to succeed.
e.zh: 他有成功所需的才华和雄心。

e.en: She has big {ambitions} for her startup company.
e.zh: 她对自己的初创公司抱有远大的抱负。

e.en: Political {ambitions} drove him to run for mayor.
e.zh: 政治抱负促使他竞选市长。

ambitious.t: adj. 有雄心的；有野心的

e.en: The company has an {ambitious} plan to reach net zero.
e.zh: 该公司有一个雄心勃勃的净零排放计划。

e.en: She's smart, hardworking, and incredibly {ambitious}.
e.zh: 她聪明、勤奋,而且雄心勃勃。

e.en: The team {ambitiously} aimed to launch within three months.
e.zh: 团队雄心勃勃地计划在三个月内上线。

e.en: He set goals {ambitiously} despite his limited resources.
e.zh: 尽管资源有限,他依然雄心勃勃地设定目标。

ambivalence.t: n. 矛盾心理；又爱又恨

e.en: She felt deep {ambivalence} about leaving her hometown.
e.zh: 对于离开家乡,她内心充满矛盾。

e.en: Voters expressed {ambivalence} toward both candidates.
e.zh: 选民对两位候选人都表现出矛盾的态度。

ambivalent.t: adj. 情感矛盾的；好恶参半的

e.en: I'm {ambivalent} about whether to accept the job offer.
e.zh: 我对是否接受这份工作邀请感到犹豫。

e.en: Many people feel {ambivalent} about social media use.
e.zh: 许多人对使用社交媒体感到矛盾。

e.en: She smiled {ambivalently} when asked about the wedding plans.
e.zh: 被问及婚礼计划时,她带着复杂的表情笑了笑。

e.en: He shrugged {ambivalently} at his friend's question.
e.zh: 对朋友的问题,他矛盾地耸了耸肩。

amble.t:
v. 缓步走；漫步
n. 漫步

e.en: We took a slow {amble} along the riverbank.
e.zh: 我们沿着河岸悠闲地散步。

e.en: Tourists {amble} through the old town every evening.
e.zh: 游客们每天傍晚在老城区悠闲地漫步。

e.en: The priest read the gospel from the {ambo}.
e.zh: 神父在讲经台上诵读福音。

e.en: A marble {ambo} stood at the front of the cathedral.
e.zh: 大教堂前方矗立着一座大理石讲经台。

ambrosia.t: n. 神的食物；美味佳肴

e.en: This chocolate cake tastes like pure {ambrosia}.
e.zh: 这块巧克力蛋糕尝起来简直是人间美味。

e.en: In Greek myth, {ambrosia} was the food of the gods.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,神食是众神的食物。

ambrosial.t: adj. 芬芳的；美味可口的

e.en: The bakery filled the street with {ambrosial} aromas.
e.zh: 面包店让整条街弥漫着令人陶醉的香气。

e.en: She described the dessert as absolutely {ambrosial}.
e.zh: 她形容那道甜点简直是美味无比。

e.en: Someone called an {ambulance} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后有人叫了救护车。

e.en: The {ambulance} arrived within five minutes of the call.
e.zh: 救护车在接到电话后五分钟内就赶到了。

e.en: The {ambulanceman} quickly checked the patient's pulse.
e.zh: 救护员迅速检查了病人的脉搏。

e.en: An off-duty {ambulanceman} rescued the drowning child.
e.zh: 一名下班的救护员救起了那个溺水的孩子。

e.en: Three {ambulances} rushed to the scene of the crash.
e.zh: 三辆救护车赶到了车祸现场。

e.en: Hospitals across the city dispatched {ambulances} during the emergency.
e.zh: 紧急情况下全市的医院都派出了救护车。

e.en: Patients are encouraged to {ambulate} soon after surgery.
e.zh: 鼓励患者在手术后尽快下床走动。

e.en: The elderly man could barely {ambulate} without assistance.
e.zh: 那位老人没有协助几乎无法行走。

e.en: Early {ambulation} helps patients recover faster after surgery.
e.zh: 早期下床行走有助于病人术后更快康复。

e.en: Her {ambulation} improved with daily physical therapy.
e.zh: 通过每日的物理治疗,她的行走能力有所改善。

ambulatory.t:
adj. 行走的；可走动的
n. 回廊

e.en: The clinic offers {ambulatory} care for minor injuries.
e.zh: 该诊所为轻伤患者提供门诊护理。

e.en: Most patients become {ambulatory} within a day after surgery.
e.zh: 大多数患者在术后一天内就能下床走动。

ambush.t:
n. 埋伏；伏击
v. 伏击

e.en: Reporters tried to {ambush} the senator outside his home.
e.zh: 记者们试图在参议员家门外突袭采访他。

e.en: The convoy was attacked in a roadside {ambush}.
e.zh: 车队在路边遭到了伏击。

e.en: My new laptop has an {AMD} processor instead of Intel.
e.zh: 我的新笔记本电脑用的是AMD处理器而不是英特尔的。

e.en: {AMD} stock jumped after the latest chip announcement.
e.zh: 最新芯片发布后,AMD的股价大涨。

amdahl.t: n. 阿姆达尔（人名/公司名）

e.en: {Amdahl}'s law explains the limits of parallel computing speedups.
e.zh: 阿姆达尔定律解释了并行计算加速的极限。

e.en: Gene {Amdahl} was a famous American computer architect.
e.zh: 吉恩·阿姆达尔是一位著名的美国计算机架构师。

e.en: New policies aim to {ameliorate} working conditions in the factory.
e.zh: 新政策旨在改善工厂的工作条件。

e.en: A warm meal can {ameliorate} the misery of a cold day.
e.zh: 一顿热饭能缓解寒冷天气带来的不适。

ameliorating.t: v. 正在改善（ameliorate 的现在分词）

e.en: The medication is slowly {ameliorating} her chronic back pain.
e.zh: 这种药物正在慢慢缓解她的慢性背痛。

e.en: Volunteers focused on {ameliorating} living conditions in the shelter.
e.zh: 志愿者们致力于改善收容所的生活条件。

e.en: The treaty led to a clear {amelioration} of relations between the two countries.
e.zh: 该条约让两国关系明显改善。

e.en: Doctors noticed gradual {amelioration} of the patient's symptoms.
e.zh: 医生注意到患者症状逐渐好转。

e.en: The agency took {ameliorative} steps to reduce traffic congestion downtown.
e.zh: 该机构采取了改善措施以减少市中心的交通拥堵。

e.en: Therapy can have an {ameliorative} effect on anxiety symptoms.
e.zh: 治疗对焦虑症状有一定的缓解作用。

amen.t:
int. 阿门（祷告结束语）
adv. 的确如此

e.en: The whole congregation said {amen} after the prayer.
e.zh: 祷告结束后,全体会众齐声说"阿门"。

e.en: "Working from home is great." "{Amen} to that!"
e.zh: "在家工作真好。""完全同意!"

amenable.t: adj. 愿意服从的；易受影响的

e.en: The manager is {amenable} to flexible working hours.
e.zh: 经理对弹性工作时间持开放态度。

e.en: This problem is {amenable} to a simple mathematical solution.
e.zh: 这个问题可以用简单的数学方法解决。

amend.t: v. 修改，修订（法案、文件）

e.en: Congress voted to {amend} the existing privacy law.
e.zh: 国会投票决定修订现行的隐私法。

e.en: Please {amend} the document to include the latest figures.
e.zh: 请修改文件,补充最新的数据。

e.en: The contract is {amendable} with written consent from both parties.
e.zh: 经双方书面同意,合同可以修改。

e.en: Club rules are {amendable} during the annual meeting.
e.zh: 俱乐部规则可在年度会议上修改。

amended.t:
adj. 已修订的
v. amend 的过去式

e.en: The {amended} bill passed with bipartisan support.
e.zh: 修订后的法案在两党支持下获得通过。

e.en: She {amended} her resume to highlight recent projects.
e.zh: 她修改了简历,突出近期的项目。

amending.t: v. 正在修改（amend 的现在分词）

e.en: The committee is {amending} the draft proposal this week.
e.zh: 委员会本周正在修改提案草稿。

e.en: {Amending} the constitution requires a two-thirds majority.
e.zh: 修宪需要三分之二多数票通过。

e.en: The First {Amendment} protects freedom of speech.
e.zh: 第一修正案保障言论自由。

e.en: They proposed an {amendment} to the company's bylaws.
e.zh: 他们提议对公司章程进行修订。

e.en: Several {amendments} were added to the bill before the vote.
e.zh: 在投票前,该法案增加了几项修正条款。

e.en: The board reviewed all proposed {amendments} carefully.
e.zh: 董事会仔细审议了所有拟议的修订。

e.en: He sent flowers to make {amends} for forgetting her birthday.
e.zh: 他送花以弥补忘记她生日的过失。

e.en: The company made {amends} by refunding affected customers.
e.zh: 公司通过退款向受影响的客户赔礼。

amenities.t: n. 便利设施（amenity 的复数）

e.en: The hotel offers modern {amenities} like a gym and spa.
e.zh: 酒店提供健身房和水疗等现代化设施。

e.en: This neighborhood has all the {amenities} young families need.
e.zh: 这个社区拥有年轻家庭所需的各种便利设施。

e.en: Free Wi-Fi is now considered a basic {amenity} in cafés.
e.zh: 免费Wi-Fi如今被视为咖啡馆的基本配置。

e.en: The pool is the most popular {amenity} in our building.
e.zh: 游泳池是我们楼里最受欢迎的设施。

e.en: Excessive exercise can sometimes cause {amenorrhea} in young athletes.
e.zh: 过度运动有时会导致年轻运动员闭经。

e.en: The doctor ran tests to determine the cause of her {amenorrhea}.
e.zh: 医生做了检查以查明她闭经的原因。

e.en: The textbook abbreviates American as {Amer}. in citations.
e.zh: 教科书在引用中将American缩写为Amer。

e.en: Library catalogs sometimes list {Amer}. Lit. for American Literature courses.
e.zh: 图书馆目录有时把美国文学课程标注为Amer. Lit。

e.en: Many {Amerasian} children were born during the Vietnam War era.
e.zh: 许多美亚混血儿童出生于越战时期。

e.en: The documentary tells the story of an {Amerasian} family reunited after decades.
e.zh: 这部纪录片讲述一个美亚混血家庭在数十年后重聚的故事。

e.en: She moved to {America} for graduate school last year.
e.zh: 她去年到美国读研究生了。

e.en: South {America} is famous for its rainforests and diverse cultures.
e.zh: 南美洲以热带雨林和多元文化闻名。

american.t:
adj. 美国的
n. 美国人

e.en: He speaks with a clear {American} accent.
e.zh: 他说话带着明显的美式口音。

e.en: The {American} delegation arrived at the conference yesterday.
e.zh: 美国代表团昨天抵达会议现场。

americana.t: n. 美国文化藏品；美国风情

e.en: The museum displays vintage {Americana} from the 1950s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出20世纪50年代的美国文化收藏品。

e.en: Diners and drive-ins are classic pieces of {Americana}.
e.zh: 小餐馆和汽车餐厅是经典的美国文化象征。

americanism.t: n. 美式用语；美国精神

e.en: "Cookie" is an {Americanism}; the British say "biscuit".
e.zh: "Cookie"是美式英语用法,英国人说"biscuit"。

e.en: Her speech was full of {Americanism} that confused the British audience.
e.zh: 她的演讲满是美式表达,让英国观众一头雾水。

e.en: The professor is a respected {Americanist} specializing in colonial history.
e.zh: 这位教授是一位受人尊敬的美国研究学者,专攻殖民史。

e.en: Leading {Americanist} scholars gathered for the annual conference.
e.zh: 顶尖的美国研究学者齐聚年度会议。

e.en: Globalization has accelerated the {Americanization} of pop culture worldwide.
e.zh: 全球化加速了流行文化在世界范围内的美国化。

e.en: Critics worry about the {Americanization} of local cuisine in Asia.
e.zh: 批评者担心亚洲本地饮食正被美国化。

e.en: The restaurant serves an {americanized} version of Chinese food.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应美国化的中餐。

e.en: After ten years abroad, his accent had become quite {americanized}.
e.zh: 在国外生活十年后,他的口音变得相当美式。

e.en: The film captures a sense of {Americanness} through its small-town setting.
e.zh: 这部电影通过小镇背景展现出浓浓的美国味。

e.en: Critics debated the {Americanness} of jazz versus blues.
e.zh: 评论家就爵士与布鲁斯哪个更具美国特色展开讨论。

e.en: Coffee is grown across the tropical regions of the {Americas}.
e.zh: 咖啡在美洲的热带地区广泛种植。

e.en: The conference brought together leaders from all over the {Americas}.
e.zh: 这次会议汇聚了来自整个美洲的领导人。

e.en: Most household smoke detectors contain a tiny amount of {americium}.
e.zh: 大多数家用烟雾报警器含有少量镅。

e.en: {Americium} is a synthetic radioactive element discovered in 1944.
e.zh: 镅是1944年发现的人造放射性元素。

e.en: The exhibit showcases traditional {Amerindian} pottery and textiles.
e.zh: 展览展示了传统的美洲印第安陶器和纺织品。

e.en: Many place names in the region come from {Amerindian} languages.
e.zh: 该地区许多地名源自美洲印第安语言。

e.en: She studies agriculture at Iowa State University in {Ames}.
e.zh: 她在艾姆斯的爱荷华州立大学学习农业。

e.en: The {Ames} test is widely used to detect mutagenic chemicals.
e.zh: 埃姆斯试验被广泛用于检测诱变化学物质。

e.en: She wore an elegant {amethyst} pendant to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着一条精致的紫水晶吊坠出席晚会。

e.en: The cave was lined with sparkling {amethyst} crystals.
e.zh: 洞穴里布满了闪闪发光的紫水晶。

amharic.t: n. 阿姆哈拉语（埃塞俄比亚官方语）

e.en: {Amharic} is the official working language of Ethiopia.
e.zh: 阿姆哈拉语是埃塞俄比亚的官方工作语言。

e.en: He learned basic {Amharic} before traveling to Addis Ababa.
e.zh: 他在去亚的斯亚贝巴前学了基本的阿姆哈拉语。

e.en: She received her degree from {Amherst} College in Massachusetts.
e.zh: 她在马萨诸塞州的阿默斯特学院获得学位。

e.en: Emily Dickinson lived most of her life in {Amherst}.
e.zh: 艾米莉·狄金森一生大部分时间都住在阿默斯特。

ami.t: n. 朋友（法语）；AMI 缩写

e.en: He greeted his old French {ami} with a warm hug.
e.zh: 他给老朋友一个热情的拥抱,用法语说"老友"。

e.en: "Bonjour, mon {ami}!" she called out to her neighbor.
e.zh: "你好,我的朋友!"她朝邻居喊道。

e.en: His natural {amiability} makes him popular at every gathering.
e.zh: 他天生和蔼可亲,在每次聚会上都很受欢迎。

e.en: The dog was known for her gentle {amiability} with children.
e.zh: 这只狗以对孩子温和友善而闻名。

amiable.t: adj. 和蔼可亲的，友善的

e.en: Our new neighbor is {amiable} and always waves hello.
e.zh: 我们的新邻居很友好,总是挥手打招呼。

e.en: They had an {amiable} chat over coffee yesterday.
e.zh: 他们昨天一边喝咖啡一边友好地聊天。

e.en: The two rivals chatted {amiably} after the debate ended.
e.zh: 辩论结束后,两位对手友好地交谈起来。

e.en: She smiled {amiably} at every customer who walked in.
e.zh: 她对每一位进店的顾客都和蔼地微笑。

e.en: The couple reached an {amicable} divorce settlement out of court.
e.zh: 这对夫妇在庭外达成了和平的离婚协议。

e.en: Despite the dispute, the meeting ended on an {amicable} note.
e.zh: 尽管有争执,会议还是在友好的气氛中结束。

e.en: The two companies settled the lawsuit {amicably} last week.
e.zh: 两家公司上周友好地解决了这场诉讼。

e.en: They parted {amicably} after working together for ten years.
e.zh: 共事十年后,他们友好地分道扬镳。

e.en: Stock prices rose {amid} growing optimism about the economy.
e.zh: 在经济乐观情绪升温之际,股价上涨。

e.en: She found peace {amid} the chaos of the busy airport.
e.zh: 在繁忙的机场喧嚣中,她找到了宁静。

e.en: The torpedo struck the destroyer {amidships}, splitting it in two.
e.zh: 鱼雷击中驱逐舰中部,将其拦腰炸成两段。

e.en: Heavy cargo should be stowed {amidships} for better balance.
e.zh: 重货应放在船舯以保持更好的平衡。

amidst.t: prep. 在……之中（amid 的变体）

e.en: The startup launched {amidst} fierce competition from larger rivals.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在大公司激烈竞争中推出了产品。

e.en: She remained calm {amidst} all the holiday shopping chaos.
e.zh: 在节日购物的混乱中,她依然保持冷静。

e.en: The Gothic cathedral in {Amiens} is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
e.zh: 亚眠的哥特式大教堂是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

e.en: We took a day trip from Paris to {Amiens} to see the cathedral.
e.zh: 我们从巴黎出发去亚眠看大教堂,游了一天。

amiga.t: n. Amiga 电脑（早期个人电脑）

e.en: My best {amiga} from college is visiting next weekend.
e.zh: 我大学时最好的女性朋友下周末要来。

e.en: The Commodore {Amiga} was a popular home computer in the late 1980s.
e.zh: 康懋达Amiga是1980年代末很受欢迎的家用电脑。

e.en: "Hey {amigo}, want to grab some tacos later?"
e.zh: "嘿,老兄,待会儿一起去吃墨西哥卷怎么样?"

e.en: He greeted his old {amigo} with a hearty handshake.
e.zh: 他热情地与老友握手致意。

e.en: Many drugs contain an {amine} group that affects how they bind to receptors.
e.zh: 许多药物含有胺基,这影响它们与受体的结合方式。

e.en: Histamine is an {amine} released by the body during allergic reactions.
e.zh: 组胺是人体在过敏反应中释放的一种胺。

e.en: Proteins are built from chains of {amino} acids.
e.zh: 蛋白质由氨基酸链构成。

e.en: The body cannot produce essential {amino} acids on its own.
e.zh: 人体无法自行合成必需氨基酸。

aminoglycoside.t: n. 氨基糖苷类抗生素

e.en: Doctors prescribed an {aminoglycoside} antibiotic for the severe infection.
e.zh: 医生开了氨基糖苷类抗生素治疗严重感染。

e.en: {Aminoglycoside} drugs can damage hearing if used long-term.
e.zh: 氨基糖苷类药物长期使用可能损害听力。

e.en: Elevated {aminotransferase} levels often indicate liver damage.
e.zh: 转氨酶水平升高通常提示肝脏受损。

e.en: The blood test measures {aminotransferase} activity to assess liver health.
e.zh: 这项血液检查通过转氨酶活性评估肝脏健康。

amir.t: n. 埃米尔（穆斯林头衔）

e.en: The {amir} of the small Gulf state hosted the summit.
e.zh: 这个海湾小国的埃米尔主持了此次峰会。

e.en: Historical records describe the {amir} as both warrior and poet.
e.zh: 史料记载这位埃米尔既是战士又是诗人。

e.en: The novel by Martin {Amis} became a bestseller worldwide.
e.zh: 马丁·艾米斯的小说成了全球畅销书。

e.en: Mes {amis} from Paris are visiting next week.
e.zh: 我巴黎的朋友们下周要来访。

amish.t:
adj. 阿米什人的
n. 阿米什教派

e.en: The {Amish} community lives without electricity or cars.
e.zh: 阿米什社区不使用电力和汽车。

e.en: We bought handmade furniture from an {Amish} family.
e.zh: 我们从一个阿米什家庭买了手工家具。

amiss.t:
adj. 不对的，出差错的
adv. 错误地

e.en: She sensed something was {amiss} when the door was open.
e.zh: 看到门开着,她感觉有些不对劲。

e.en: A little extra help wouldn't go {amiss} right now.
e.zh: 现在多一点帮助也不为过。

e.en: The two nations signed a treaty of {amity} and cooperation.
e.zh: 两国签署了友好合作条约。

e.en: The town of {Amity} appears in the movie Jaws.
e.zh: 《大白鲨》电影中出现了阿米蒂镇。

amma.t: n. 妈妈（印度语对母亲的称呼）

e.en: In Tamil culture, {amma} is the affectionate word for mother.
e.zh: 在泰米尔文化中,amma是对母亲的亲切称呼。

e.en: The guru known as {Amma} hugs thousands of devotees daily.
e.zh: 被称为Amma的导师每天拥抱成千上万的信徒。

e.en: {Amman} is the capital and largest city of Jordan.
e.zh: 安曼是约旦的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Our flight to {Amman} departs at midnight.
e.zh: 我们飞往安曼的航班午夜起飞。

e.en: The soldiers were running low on {ammo} during the firefight.
e.zh: 士兵们在交火中弹药快用完了。

e.en: His witty comeback gave him {ammo} for the debate.
e.zh: 他机智的回击为辩论提供了弹药。

e.en: The cleaner had a strong smell of {ammonia}.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂有浓烈的氨水味。

e.en: {Ammonia} is widely used as fertilizer in agriculture.
e.zh: 氨在农业中被广泛用作肥料。

e.en: Different {ammonias} are sold for various household cleaning tasks.
e.zh: 市面上有不同种类的氨水用于各种家务清洁。

e.en: The lab tested several {ammonias} for industrial use.
e.zh: 实验室测试了几种工业用氨水。

e.en: She found a fossilized {ammonite} on the beach.
e.zh: 她在海滩上发现了一块菊石化石。

e.en: The {ammonite} lived in oceans millions of years ago.
e.zh: 菊石生活在数百万年前的海洋中。

e.en: {Ammonium} nitrate is commonly used in fertilizers.
e.zh: 硝酸铵常用于化肥中。

e.en: The factory produces large quantities of {ammonium} chloride.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产大量氯化铵。

e.en: The troops needed more {ammunition} before the next attack.
e.zh: 部队在下次进攻前需要更多弹药。

e.en: The scandal gave critics plenty of {ammunition}.
e.zh: 这起丑闻给了批评者大量的攻击材料。

e.en: After the accident, he suffered from temporary {amnesia}.
e.zh: 事故后,他出现了短暂的失忆症。

e.en: The movie's hero wakes up with complete {amnesia}.
e.zh: 电影主角醒来时完全失去了记忆。

amnesiac.t:
n. 失忆症患者
adj. 失忆的

e.en: The {amnesiac} patient couldn't recognize his own family.
e.zh: 这位失忆症患者认不出自己的家人。

e.en: Radiohead's album {Amnesiac} was released in 2001.
e.zh: 电台司令乐队的专辑《Amnesiac》于2001年发行。

amnesty.t:
n. 大赦；特赦
v. 赦免

e.en: The government granted {amnesty} to political prisoners.
e.zh: 政府向政治犯发放了大赦令。

e.en: {Amnesty} International campaigns for human rights worldwide.
e.zh: 国际特赦组织在全球范围内倡导人权。

amnio.t: n. 羊水穿刺（amniocentesis 的缩写）

e.en: The doctor recommended an {amnio} due to her age.
e.zh: 由于她的年龄,医生建议做羊水穿刺。

e.en: She decided to skip the {amnio} test this time.
e.zh: 这次她决定不做羊水穿刺检查。

e.en: {Amniocentesis} can detect chromosomal abnormalities in the fetus.
e.zh: 羊膜穿刺术可以检测胎儿的染色体异常。

e.en: The clinic schedules {amniocentesis} for high-risk pregnancies.
e.zh: 诊所为高风险妊娠安排羊膜穿刺术。

e.en: Her {amniotic} fluid broke just before midnight.
e.zh: 她的羊水在午夜前破了。

e.en: The fetus floats safely inside the {amniotic} sac.
e.zh: 胎儿在羊膜囊内安全地漂浮着。

e.en: In Latin, "{amo}" means "I love".
e.zh: 在拉丁语中,amo意为"我爱"。

e.en: Te {amo} is a common phrase in Spanish.
e.zh: Te amo是西班牙语中常见的表达。

amoco.t: n. 阿莫科（美国石油公司）

e.en: {Amoco} was once one of America's largest oil companies.
e.zh: 阿莫科曾是美国最大的石油公司之一。

e.en: He stopped at the {Amoco} station to refuel.
e.zh: 他在阿莫科加油站停下来加油。

amoeba.t: n. 变形虫；阿米巴原虫

e.en: The {amoeba} changes shape as it moves through water.
e.zh: 变形虫在水中移动时会改变形状。

e.en: We studied a single-celled {amoeba} under the microscope.
e.zh: 我们在显微镜下观察了一个单细胞变形虫。

amoebic.t: adj. 阿米巴的；变形虫的

e.en: He caught {amoebic} dysentery while traveling abroad.
e.zh: 他在国外旅行时染上了阿米巴痢疾。

e.en: The patient was treated for an {amoebic} infection.
e.zh: 病人接受了阿米巴感染的治疗。

e.en: The crowd ran {amok} after the concert was canceled.
e.zh: 演唱会取消后,人群陷入了疯狂。

e.en: Without supervision, the puppies ran {amok} in the garden.
e.zh: 没人看管时,小狗们在花园里横冲直撞。

e.en: {Amon} was an ancient Egyptian god worshipped at Thebes.
e.zh: 阿蒙是古埃及在底比斯被供奉的神。

e.en: The temple of {Amon} stands as a remarkable ruin.
e.zh: 阿蒙神庙作为一处非凡的遗迹依然矗立。

e.en: She was the youngest {among} the candidates.
e.zh: 她是候选人中最年轻的。

e.en: Trust {among} team members is essential for success.
e.zh: 团队成员之间的信任对成功至关重要。

amongst.t: prep. 在…之中（among 的变体）

e.en: The treasure was hidden {amongst} the old books.
e.zh: 宝藏藏在旧书堆中。

e.en: He felt at home {amongst} fellow musicians.
e.zh: 他和音乐家同行在一起感觉很自在。

amontillado.t: n. 阿蒙蒂亚多雪莉酒

e.en: He poured a glass of dry {amontillado} sherry.
e.zh: 他倒了一杯干型阿蒙蒂亚多雪利酒。

e.en: Poe's famous story features a cask of {amontillado}.
e.zh: 爱伦·坡著名的故事讲述了一桶阿蒙蒂亚多酒。

amor.t: n. 爱（源自拉丁语/西语）

e.en: The Spanish word "{amor}" means love in English.
e.zh: 西班牙语单词amor在英语中意为爱。

e.en: She named her cafe "Mi {Amor}" after her grandmother.
e.zh: 她以祖母的名字将咖啡馆命名为"我的爱"。

amoral.t: adj. 无关道德的；不讲道德的

e.en: The corporation was criticized for its {amoral} business practices.
e.zh: 这家公司因其无道德观念的商业行为而受到批评。

e.en: He is a completely {amoral} character without conscience.
e.zh: 他是个毫无良知、完全没有道德观的人。

e.en: The film explores the {amorality} of wartime decisions.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了战时决策的无道德性。

e.en: Critics condemned the {amorality} of the financial industry.
e.zh: 评论家谴责了金融业的无道德性。

amoroso.t:
adv. 深情地（音乐术语）
n. 一种雪莉酒

e.en: The pianist played the passage {amoroso} and tenderly.
e.zh: 钢琴家温柔深情地演奏了这一乐段。

e.en: {Amoroso} sherry has a rich, sweet flavor profile.
e.zh: Amoroso雪利酒口感浓郁香甜。

e.en: He gave her an {amorous} glance across the table.
e.zh: 他隔着桌子向她投以含情脉脉的一瞥。

e.en: The novel describes their {amorous} adventures in Paris.
e.zh: 小说描述了他们在巴黎的风流韵事。

amorphous.t: adj. 无定形的；无组织的

e.en: The cloud took on an {amorphous} shape in the sky.
e.zh: 云朵在天空中呈现出无定形的形状。

e.en: His ideas remained {amorphous} and difficult to summarize.
e.zh: 他的想法仍然模糊,难以概括。

e.en: The crowd moved {amorphously} through the city streets.
e.zh: 人群无形地在城市街道中流动。

e.en: The project evolved {amorphously} without clear direction.
e.zh: 这个项目漫无目的地发展,没有明确方向。

amortise.t: v. 摊销；分期偿还（英式拼写）

e.en: The company will {amortise} the loan over ten years.
e.zh: 公司将在十年内分期偿还这笔贷款。

e.en: Businesses {amortise} intangible assets like patents and copyrights.
e.zh: 企业将专利和版权等无形资产摊销。

e.en: The mortgage {amortization} schedule shows monthly principal payments.
e.zh: 抵押贷款摊还表显示每月本金还款额。

e.en: {Amortization} reduces the asset's value on the balance sheet.
e.zh: 摊销减少了资产负债表上的资产价值。

e.en: You can {amortize} the cost over five years.
e.zh: 你可以将这笔费用在五年内摊销。

e.en: The business will {amortize} its software development expenses.
e.zh: 企业将摊销其软件开发费用。

amount.t:
n. 数量；总额
v. 总计；相当于

e.en: The total {amount} due is three hundred dollars.
e.zh: 应付总金额为三百美元。

e.en: His efforts didn't {amount} to much in the end.
e.zh: 他的努力最终没有取得多大成果。

amounted.t: v. 总计；相当于（amount 的过去式）

e.en: The damage {amounted} to thousands of dollars.
e.zh: 损失高达数千美元。

e.en: His accusations {amounted} to nothing more than gossip.
e.zh: 他的指控不过是流言蜚语。

amounting.t: v. 总计；相当于（amount 的现在分词）

e.en: She received a bonus {amounting} to half her salary.
e.zh: 她拿到了相当于她半年工资的奖金。

e.en: The fines, {amounting} to millions, shocked the company.
e.zh: 高达数百万的罚款震惊了这家公司。

amounts.t:
n. 数量（复数）
v. 总计（第三人称单数）

e.en: Small {amounts} of caffeine can improve focus.
e.zh: 少量咖啡因可以提高专注力。

e.en: Refusing to apologize {amounts} to admitting guilt.
e.zh: 拒绝道歉等于承认有罪。

e.en: Their secret {amour} lasted for many years.
e.zh: 他们的秘密恋情持续了许多年。

e.en: The novel chronicles his many romantic {amours}.
e.zh: 小说记录了他的多次浪漫艳遇。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {amoxicillin} for the ear infection.
e.zh: 医生为治疗耳部感染开了阿莫西林。

e.en: {Amoxicillin} is a common antibiotic for bacterial infections.
e.zh: 阿莫西林是治疗细菌感染的常用抗生素。

amp.t:
n. 安培（ampere 缩写）
n. 放大器（amplifier 缩写）

e.en: He plugged his guitar into the {amp} and started playing.
e.zh: 他把吉他插进音箱,开始弹奏。

e.en: The circuit blew because it drew too many {amps}.
e.zh: 电路烧了,因为电流太大。

e.en: Check the {amperage} rating before connecting the appliance.
e.zh: 连接电器前请检查安培数额定值。

e.en: High {amperage} can damage sensitive electronic components.
e.zh: 高电流会损坏敏感的电子元件。

e.en: The fuse blew when the current exceeded one {ampere}.
e.zh: 当电流超过一安培时,保险丝烧断了。

e.en: The {ampere} is the standard unit of electric current.
e.zh: 安培是电流的标准单位。

e.en: Use an {ampersand} instead of writing out the word "and".
e.zh: 用&符号代替写出"and"这个单词。

e.en: The company logo features a stylized {ampersand}.
e.zh: 公司标志以一个风格化的&符号为特色。

e.en: {Amphetamine} is sometimes prescribed to treat ADHD.
e.zh: 安非他命有时被用于治疗注意力缺陷多动障碍。

e.en: Police seized a large quantity of {amphetamine} pills.
e.zh: 警方缴获了大量安非他命药片。

amphibian.t:
n. 两栖动物
adj. 两栖的

e.en: A frog is an {amphibian} that lives both in water and on land.
e.zh: 青蛙是一种水陆两栖的两栖动物。

e.en: Scientists are concerned about declining {amphibian} populations.
e.zh: 科学家们担忧两栖动物数量的减少。

amphibious.t: adj. 两栖的；水陆两用的

e.en: The military uses {amphibious} vehicles for beach landings.
e.zh: 军方使用两栖车辆进行抢滩登陆。

e.en: Frogs are {amphibious} creatures with permeable skin.
e.zh: 青蛙是皮肤具有渗透性的两栖动物。

amphitheater.t: n. 圆形剧场；阶梯式看台

e.en: The Roman {amphitheater} still hosts concerts every summer.
e.zh: 这座罗马圆形剧场每年夏天仍会举办音乐会。

e.en: Students gathered in the open-air {amphitheater} for graduation.
e.zh: 学生们聚集在露天剧场里参加毕业典礼。

amphitheatre.t: n. 圆形剧场（英式拼写）

e.en: The ancient {amphitheatre} in Verona is remarkably well preserved.
e.zh: 维罗纳的古老圆形剧场保存得相当完好。

e.en: Lectures are held in the main {amphitheatre} on campus.
e.zh: 讲座在校园主剧场式阶梯教室里举行。

amphora.t: n. (古希腊罗马) 双耳陶罐

e.en: The diver recovered an ancient Greek {amphora} from the wreck.
e.zh: 潜水员从沉船里打捞出一只古希腊双耳瓶。

e.en: Wine was once stored and shipped in clay {amphora} jars.
e.zh: 葡萄酒曾经用陶制双耳罐储存和运输。

amphotericin.t: n. 两性霉素（抗真菌药）

e.en: Doctors prescribed {amphotericin} to treat the severe fungal infection.
e.zh: 医生开了两性霉素来治疗严重的真菌感染。

e.en: {Amphotericin} B can cause significant kidney side effects.
e.zh: 两性霉素B可能引起明显的肾脏副作用。

e.en: The pediatrician prescribed {ampicillin} for the child's ear infection.
e.zh: 儿科医生为孩子的耳部感染开了氨苄西林。

e.en: Some bacterial strains have become resistant to {ampicillin}.
e.zh: 某些细菌菌株已经对氨苄西林产生了耐药性。

e.en: There's {ample} parking behind the shopping center.
e.zh: 购物中心后面有充足的停车位。

e.en: We had {ample} time to finish before the deadline.
e.zh: 我们有充裕的时间在截止日期前完成。

ampleforth.t: n. 安普福斯（地名/人名）

e.en: {Ampleforth} is a rebasing crypto token with elastic supply.
e.zh: Ampleforth是一种供应量弹性变化的再平衡加密代币。

e.en: He attended {Ampleforth} College in North Yorkshire.
e.zh: 他就读于北约克郡的安普尔福斯学院。

e.en: The guitar needs more {amplification} to fill the venue.
e.zh: 这把吉他需要更强的扩音才能传遍整个场地。

e.en: Social media causes rapid {amplification} of misinformation.
e.zh: 社交媒体会让虚假信息迅速被放大传播。

e.en: The report adds useful {amplifications} to the original findings.
e.zh: 这份报告对原始结论作了有益的补充阐述。

e.en: Several {amplifications} were made to clarify the legal text.
e.zh: 为了澄清法律文本,做了若干补充说明。

amplified.t:
adj. 经放大的
v. 放大（过去式）

e.en: The microphone {amplified} her voice across the entire stadium.
e.zh: 麦克风把她的声音放大,传遍了整个体育场。

e.en: Twitter {amplified} the small protest into a global movement.
e.zh: 推特把这场小型抗议放大成了一场全球运动。

e.en: He plugged his guitar into a vintage tube {amplifier}.
e.zh: 他把吉他插进了一台老式电子管功放。

e.en: Email is a powerful {amplifier} for marketing campaigns.
e.zh: 电子邮件是营销活动强有力的放大器。

e.en: The studio has rows of vintage guitar {amplifiers}.
e.zh: 录音棚里摆着一排排复古的吉他音箱。

e.en: Influencers act as {amplifiers} for emerging brands.
e.zh: 网红就像新兴品牌的传播放大器。

e.en: The new feature {amplifies} every creator's reach on the platform.
e.zh: 新功能让每位创作者在平台上的影响力被放大。

e.en: Stress {amplifies} the symptoms of chronic pain.
e.zh: 压力会放大慢性疼痛的症状。

amplify.t: v. 放大；增强；详细阐述

e.en: We use ads to {amplify} the launch announcement.
e.zh: 我们通过广告来放大产品发布的声量。

e.en: Please {amplify} your point with a concrete example.
e.zh: 请用一个具体例子来进一步阐述你的观点。

amplifying.t:
v. 放大（现在分词）
adj. 起放大作用的

e.en: The algorithm keeps {amplifying} extreme content in the feed.
e.zh: 算法不断在信息流里放大极端内容。

e.en: She spent the meeting {amplifying} her teammate's ideas.
e.zh: 整场会议她都在为队友的想法发声助力。

e.en: The wave's {amplitude} doubled after the storm intensified.
e.zh: 风暴加剧后,波浪的振幅翻了一倍。

e.en: Analysts track the {amplitude} of stock price swings.
e.zh: 分析师会跟踪股价波动的幅度。

e.en: The evidence {amply} demonstrates that the policy worked.
e.zh: 证据充分地表明这项政策起了作用。

e.en: His salary {amply} covers the family's monthly expenses.
e.zh: 他的工资足够支付家庭每月的开销。

ampoule.t: n. 安瓿（药水小玻璃瓶）

e.en: The nurse snapped open a glass {ampoule} of saline.
e.zh: 护士掰开了一支玻璃安瓿装的生理盐水。

e.en: Each {ampoule} contains a single dose of the vaccine.
e.zh: 每支安瓿瓶装有单剂量的疫苗。

ampule.t: n. 安瓿（ampoule 美式拼写）

e.en: He carefully drew the medicine from the small {ampule}.
e.zh: 他小心地从小安瓿瓶里抽取药液。

e.en: The kit includes a sterile {ampule} of adrenaline.
e.zh: 急救包内含一支无菌的肾上腺素安瓿。

ampulla.t: n. 壶腹（解剖学）；圣油瓶

e.en: The surgeon located a stone in the bile duct {ampulla}.
e.zh: 外科医生在胆管壶腹部找到了一颗结石。

e.en: Each semicircular canal ends in a swelling called an {ampulla}.
e.zh: 每条半规管末端都有一个膨大部分,称为壶腹。

e.en: Doctors had to {amputate} his leg to save his life.
e.zh: 为了保住他的命,医生不得不截肢。

e.en: The vet decided to {amputate} the dog's injured paw.
e.zh: 兽医决定为这只狗截掉受伤的爪子。

amputated.t:
v. 截肢（过去式）
adj. 被截肢的

e.en: The surgeon {amputated} the gangrenous toe yesterday morning.
e.zh: 外科医生昨天上午切除了那根坏疽的脚趾。

e.en: After the accident, his right arm had to be {amputated}.
e.zh: 事故之后,他的右臂不得不被截肢。

e.en: Diabetes is a leading cause of lower-limb {amputation}.
e.zh: 糖尿病是下肢截肢的主要原因之一。

e.en: The {amputation} surgery lasted nearly four hours.
e.zh: 这场截肢手术持续了将近四个小时。

e.en: The {amputee} learned to run again with a carbon-fiber blade.
e.zh: 那位截肢者借助碳纤维假肢重新学会了奔跑。

e.en: He founded a charity that supports young {amputee} athletes.
e.zh: 他创立了一家支持年轻截肢运动员的慈善机构。

amr.t: n. 抗菌素耐药性（Antimicrobial Resistance 缩写）

e.en: Hospitals are tracking {AMR} to fight drug-resistant bacteria.
e.zh: 医院正在监测耐药性以对抗抗药细菌。

e.en: The WHO calls {AMR} one of the top global health threats.
e.zh: 世卫组织将抗微生物药物耐药性列为全球头号健康威胁之一。

amritsar.t: n. 阿姆利则（印度城市）

e.en: Tourists flock to {Amritsar} to visit the Golden Temple.
e.zh: 游客们蜂拥前往阿姆利则参观金庙。

e.en: The flight from Delhi to {Amritsar} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从德里飞往阿姆利则大约需要一个小时。

ams.t: n. 阿姆斯特丹机场代码；加速质谱法

e.en: The lab uses {AMS} to date archaeological samples precisely.
e.zh: 实验室用加速器质谱法精确测定考古样本的年代。

e.en: Our flight has a layover at {AMS} Schiphol Airport.
e.zh: 我们的航班在阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场中转。

amsterdam.t: n. 阿姆斯特丹（荷兰首都）

e.en: We rented bikes and explored {Amsterdam}'s canals all weekend.
e.zh: 我们租了自行车,整个周末都在阿姆斯特丹的运河边骑行。

e.en: Her startup just opened a new office in {Amsterdam}.
e.zh: 她的初创公司刚在阿姆斯特丹开设了新办公室。

amtrak.t: n. 美国国家铁路客运公司

e.en: I took the {Amtrak} from Boston to New York yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天搭乘美铁列车从波士顿到了纽约。

e.en: {Amtrak} delays are common during heavy winter storms.
e.zh: 严重的冬季风暴期间,美铁列车经常晚点。

e.en: She wore a small silver {amulet} for good luck.
e.zh: 她戴着一个小银护身符以求好运。

e.en: The ancient {amulet} was buried with the pharaoh.
e.zh: 那枚古老的护身符与法老一同下葬。

amundsen.t: n. 阿蒙森（挪威探险家）

e.en: {Amundsen} reached the South Pole in December 1911.
e.zh: 阿蒙森于1911年12月抵达了南极点。

e.en: The research base is named after the explorer {Amundsen}.
e.zh: 这座科考站以探险家阿蒙森的名字命名。

e.en: The puppy's antics never fail to {amuse} the kids.
e.zh: 小狗的滑稽举动总能逗乐孩子们。

e.en: I brought board games to {amuse} guests during the storm.
e.zh: 我带了几款桌游,好在暴风雨期间让客人们解闷。

amused.t: adj. 觉得好笑的；被逗乐的

e.en: She seemed quietly {amused} by his terrible dance moves.
e.zh: 她似乎被他糟糕的舞步暗自逗乐了。

e.en: The toddler {amused} herself with a cardboard box for hours.
e.zh: 那个学步的孩子用一个纸盒子自娱自乐了好几个小时。

e.en: He watched the chaotic meeting with quiet {amusement}.
e.zh: 他带着一丝乐趣默默看着这场混乱的会议。

e.en: The {amusement} park reopens next weekend after renovations.
