e.zh: 游乐园下周末翻新完工后将重新开放。

amusements.t: n. 娱乐活动；游乐设施

e.en: Phones have replaced many traditional childhood {amusements}.
e.zh: 手机已经取代了许多传统的童年娱乐活动。

e.en: The seaside town is famous for its arcade {amusements}.
e.zh: 这座海滨小镇以其街机游乐场而闻名。

e.en: It still {amuses} him how seriously his cat takes naps.
e.zh: 他至今仍觉得好笑——他的猫睡觉时居然那么一本正经。

e.en: The comedian {amuses} audiences with absurd everyday observations.
e.zh: 这位喜剧演员用荒诞的日常观察把观众逗得乐不可支。

e.en: He told an {amusing} story about his first job interview.
e.zh: 他讲了一个关于自己第一次面试的有趣故事。

e.en: I find her sarcastic comments oddly {amusing}.
e.zh: 我觉得她那些挖苦的话莫名其妙地好笑。

amusingly.t: adv. 有趣地；令人发笑地

e.en: The cat {amusingly} tried to fit into a tiny shoebox.
e.zh: 那只猫滑稽地试图挤进一个小小的鞋盒里。

e.en: His résumé was {amusingly} honest about his weaknesses.
e.zh: 他的简历对自己的缺点坦白得令人发笑。

e.en: The {amygdala} plays a key role in processing fear.
e.zh: 杏仁核在处理恐惧情绪中起着关键作用。

e.en: Meditation appears to reduce {amygdala} reactivity over time.
e.zh: 研究表明冥想能逐渐降低杏仁核的反应活跃度。

e.en: The chemist measured a small volume of {amyl} alcohol.
e.zh: 化学家量取了少量的戊醇。

e.en: {Amyl} nitrite was once prescribed for chest pain.
e.zh: 亚硝酸戊酯曾被用来治疗心绞痛。

e.en: Saliva contains {amylase}, which begins breaking down starch.
e.zh: 唾液中含有淀粉酶,可以开始分解淀粉。

e.en: Doctors check {amylase} levels to diagnose pancreatic problems.
e.zh: 医生通过检测淀粉酶水平来诊断胰腺疾病。

e.en: Alzheimer's patients accumulate {amyloid} plaques in the brain.
e.zh: 阿尔茨海默病患者的大脑中会堆积淀粉样蛋白斑块。

e.en: Researchers are testing drugs that target {amyloid} buildup.
e.zh: 研究人员正在测试针对淀粉样蛋白沉积的药物。

e.en: He was diagnosed with cardiac {amyloidosis} last spring.
e.zh: 他去年春天被诊断出患有心脏淀粉样变性。

e.en: {Amyloidosis} can damage the kidneys and nervous system.
e.zh: 淀粉样变性会损伤肾脏和神经系统。

e.en: His grandfather died of {amyotrophic} lateral sclerosis.
e.zh: 他的祖父死于肌萎缩性侧索硬化症。

e.en: {Amyotrophic} diseases gradually weaken the body's muscles.
e.zh: 肌萎缩类疾病会逐渐使身体的肌肉变弱。

e.en: The doctor ordered an {ANA} test to check for lupus.
e.zh: 医生开了抗核抗体检测来筛查狼疮。

e.en: She compiled a charming {ana} of her grandfather's sayings.
e.zh: 她整理了一本祖父语录的趣闻集。

e.en: The {Anabaptist} community rejects infant baptism on principle.
e.zh: 再洗礼派群体在原则上拒绝婴儿洗礼。

e.en: Mennonites trace their roots to the {Anabaptist} movement.
e.zh: 门诺派可以追溯到再洗礼派运动。

e.en: The athlete tested positive for {anabolic} steroids.
e.zh: 那名运动员的合成代谢类固醇检测呈阳性。

e.en: Sleep triggers powerful {anabolic} processes that rebuild muscle.
e.zh: 睡眠会启动强大的合成代谢过程来修复肌肉。

anachronism.t: n. 时代错误；不合时宜的人或事

e.en: A typewriter on his desk feels like a charming {anachronism}.
e.zh: 他桌上的打字机看起来像一种有趣的时代错位。

e.en: The hand-written ledger is an {anachronism} in a digital office.
e.zh: 在数字化办公室里,手写账本简直是种时代错位。

anachronistic.t: adj. 不合时代的；过时的

e.en: His {anachronistic} views on email feel decades out of date.
e.zh: 他对电子邮件的看法落伍得像是几十年前的。

e.en: The film featured {anachronistic} smartphones in a 1920s setting.
e.zh: 这部电影把智能手机错置进了1920年代的场景里。

e.en: The novel {anachronistically} places jazz music in medieval France.
e.zh: 这本小说时代错乱地把爵士乐放进了中世纪的法国。

e.en: The character {anachronistically} uses slang from the 2020s.
e.zh: 这个角色不合时代地使用着2020年代的俚语。

anaclitic.t: adj. 情感依附的（心理学）

e.en: The therapist described his {anaclitic} attachment to his mother.
e.zh: 治疗师描述了他对母亲的依赖型依恋。

e.en: Some children develop {anaclitic} depression when separated from caregivers.
e.zh: 有些孩子在与照顾者分离时会产生依赖性抑郁。

e.en: An {anaconda} can grow over twenty feet long.
e.zh: 森蚺的体长可超过二十英尺。

e.en: We installed Python using the {Anaconda} distribution.
e.zh: 我们用 Anaconda 发行版安装了 Python。

e.en: Salmon are {anadromous} fish that return to rivers to spawn.
e.zh: 鲑鱼是溯河产卵的鱼类,会回到河流中产卵。

e.en: The dam blocks {anadromous} species from reaching their spawning grounds.
e.zh: 这座水坝阻挡了溯河鱼类回到产卵地。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with iron-deficiency {anaemia}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有缺铁性贫血。

e.en: Fatigue and pale skin are common signs of {anaemia}.
e.zh: 疲劳和面色苍白是贫血的常见症状。

e.en: She felt weak and looked {anaemic} after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后她感到虚弱,脸色显得贫血。

e.en: The economy showed {anaemic} growth last quarter.
e.zh: 上个季度经济增长疲软无力。

e.en: Sprinting relies mostly on {anaerobic} energy systems.
e.zh: 短跑主要依赖无氧能量系统。

e.en: These bacteria thrive in {anaerobic} environments deep underground.
e.zh: 这些细菌在地下深处的厌氧环境中繁殖。

e.en: The patient was given general {anaesthesia} before surgery.
e.zh: 手术前给病人施行了全身麻醉。

e.en: Local {anaesthesia} numbed the area around the tooth.
e.zh: 局部麻醉使牙齿周围的区域失去知觉。

anaesthetic.t:
n. 麻醉剂
adj. 麻醉的

e.en: The dentist injected a local {anaesthetic} into my gum.
e.zh: 牙医在我的牙龈中注射了局部麻醉剂。

e.en: She is allergic to certain types of {anaesthetic}.
e.zh: 她对某些类型的麻醉药过敏。

e.en: Vets often {anaesthetise} large animals before performing surgery.
e.zh: 兽医在为大型动物手术前通常会进行麻醉。

e.en: The drug can {anaesthetise} a patient within seconds.
e.zh: 这种药物可以在几秒钟内使病人麻醉。

e.en: The surgeon waited until the patient was fully {anaesthetised}.
e.zh: 外科医生等到病人完全被麻醉后才动手术。

e.en: Endless scrolling left her emotionally {anaesthetised}.
e.zh: 无休止的刷屏让她在情感上变得麻木。

e.en: The {anaesthetist} monitored her vital signs throughout the operation.
e.zh: 麻醉师在整个手术过程中监测她的生命体征。

e.en: He trained for years to become a paediatric {anaesthetist}.
e.zh: 他经过多年训练才成为一名儿科麻醉师。

e.en: The vet will {anaesthetize} the dog before extracting the tooth.
e.zh: 兽医会在拔牙前为这只狗进行麻醉。

e.en: Constant bad news can {anaesthetize} us to real suffering.
e.zh: 不断的负面新闻会让我们对真实的苦难变得麻木。

anagnorisis.t: n. （戏剧中的）发现；真相揭示

e.en: The play's {anagnorisis} comes when the hero learns his true identity.
e.zh: 剧中的发现时刻出现在主人公得知自己真实身份之时。

e.en: Aristotle considered {anagnorisis} a key element of tragedy.
e.zh: 亚里士多德认为发现是悲剧的关键要素。

anagogic.t: adj. 神秘寓意的；灵性解释的

e.en: Medieval scholars gave the text an {anagogic} reading focused on heaven.
e.zh: 中世纪学者对文本进行了关注天国的神秘灵性解读。

e.en: The poem invites an {anagogic} interpretation of the soul's ascent.
e.zh: 这首诗邀请人们对灵魂升华作出神秘灵性的解读。

anagram.t: n. 字母重组词；变位词

e.en: "Listen" is an {anagram} of "silent".
e.zh: "Listen" 是 "silent" 的字母重组词。

e.en: He hid his name as an {anagram} in the puzzle.
e.zh: 他把自己的名字以字母重组的方式藏在谜题里。

e.en: My boss is really {anal} about formatting in spreadsheets.
e.zh: 我的老板对电子表格的格式过于挑剔。

e.en: The doctor recommended an {anal} examination for screening.
e.zh: 医生建议做一次肛门检查以进行筛查。

e.en: The hospital offers epidural {analgesia} during childbirth.
e.zh: 医院在分娩期间提供硬膜外镇痛。

e.en: Adrenaline can produce temporary {analgesia} after an injury.
e.zh: 肾上腺素可在受伤后产生暂时性镇痛作用。

analgesic.t:
n. 止痛药
adj. 止痛的

e.en: Ibuprofen is a common over-the-counter {analgesic}.
e.zh: 布洛芬是一种常见的非处方止痛药。

e.en: The cream has a mild {analgesic} effect on sore muscles.
e.zh: 这种乳膏对酸痛的肌肉有轻微的镇痛效果。

analog.t:
adj. 模拟的（非数字）
n. 类似物

e.en: He still prefers an {analog} watch over a smartwatch.
e.zh: 他仍然更喜欢机械指针表而不是智能手表。

e.en: Vinyl records produce a warm {analog} sound.
e.zh: 黑胶唱片能产生温暖的模拟音色。

e.en: Children learn grammar partly through {analogical} reasoning.
e.zh: 儿童在一定程度上通过类比推理学习语法。

e.en: She drew an {analogical} comparison between cells and factories.
e.zh: 她将细胞与工厂作了一个类比。

analogies.t: n. 类比；类推（analogy 的复数）

e.en: Good teachers use {analogies} to explain complex ideas.
e.zh: 好老师会用类比来解释复杂的概念。

e.en: The article draws {analogies} between the brain and computers.
e.zh: 这篇文章把大脑和计算机作了类比。

e.en: Lawyers often {analogize} new cases to past precedents.
e.zh: 律师常把新案件类比成过去的判例。

e.en: It helps to {analogize} memory to a filing cabinet.
e.zh: 把记忆类比成档案柜会有助于理解。

e.en: The human eye is {analogous} to a camera in many ways.
e.zh: 人眼在许多方面与照相机类似。

e.en: Their roles in the company are roughly {analogous}.
e.zh: 他们在公司里的角色大致相似。

e.en: The two systems behave {analogously} under pressure.
e.zh: 这两个系统在压力下表现类似。

e.en: {Analogously}, water flows from high to low pressure.
e.zh: 类似地,水从高压区流向低压区。

analogue.t:
n. 类似物；对应物
adj. 模拟的

e.en: There is no perfect digital {analogue} for face-to-face conversation.
e.zh: 面对面交流没有完美的数字化对应物。

e.en: He collects vintage {analogue} synthesizers from the seventies.
e.zh: 他收藏七十年代的复古模拟合成器。

e.en: She drew an {analogy} between writing code and gardening.
e.zh: 她把写代码比作园艺,作了一个类比。

e.en: The teacher used a simple {analogy} to explain gravity.
e.zh: 老师用一个简单的类比来解释引力。

e.en: The data is easily {analysable} with standard statistical tools.
e.zh: 这些数据可以用标准统计工具轻松分析。

e.en: Not every emotional response is fully {analysable}.
e.zh: 并非每一种情感反应都能被完全剖析。

analysand.t: n. 精神分析的受分析者

e.en: The {analysand} described a recurring dream to her therapist.
e.zh: 接受精神分析者向治疗师描述了一个反复出现的梦。

e.en: A successful analysis depends on the {analysand}'s honesty.
e.zh: 成功的精神分析取决于受分析者的坦诚。

e.en: Researchers {analyse} the survey results before publishing.
e.zh: 研究人员在发表前会分析调查结果。

e.en: Let me {analyse} the code before we deploy it.
e.zh: 让我在部署之前分析一下这段代码。

analysed.t:
v. 分析（过去式）
adj. 已分析的

e.en: The team {analysed} thousands of customer reviews last week.
e.zh: 团队上周分析了数千条客户评价。

e.en: She {analysed} the painting's symbolism in her essay.
e.zh: 她在文章中分析了这幅画的象征意义。

e.en: The lab uses a gas {analyser} to detect impurities.
e.zh: 实验室用气体分析仪来检测杂质。

e.en: A spectrum {analyser} helped engineers debug the radio signal.
e.zh: 频谱分析仪帮助工程师调试无线电信号。

analyses.t:
n. 分析（复数）
v. 分析（第三人称单数）

e.en: The report includes detailed {analyses} of each market segment.
e.zh: 该报告包括对每个细分市场的详细分析。

e.en: She {analyses} customer feedback for the product team.
e.zh: 她为产品团队分析客户反馈。

analysing.t: v. 正在分析（analyse 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent the afternoon {analysing} traffic data from the site.
e.zh: 他用了一个下午分析网站的流量数据。

e.en: {Analysing} your sleep patterns can improve your health.
e.zh: 分析你的睡眠模式可以改善健康。

e.en: Her {analysis} of the election surprised many commentators.
e.zh: 她对这次选举的分析让许多评论员感到意外。

e.en: The lab sent the blood sample for further {analysis}.
e.zh: 实验室把血样送去做进一步分析。

e.en: The {analyst} predicted strong earnings for the next quarter.
e.zh: 该分析师预测下一季度业绩将强劲。

e.en: She works as a data {analyst} at a fintech startup.
e.zh: 她在一家金融科技初创公司担任数据分析师。

analysts.t: n. 分析师们（analyst 的复数）

e.en: Wall Street {analysts} downgraded the stock yesterday.
e.zh: 华尔街分析师昨天下调了该股的评级。

e.en: Industry {analysts} expect AI spending to keep rising.
e.zh: 行业分析师预计人工智能支出将继续上升。

e.en: The sensor detects the target {analyte} in blood samples.
e.zh: 该传感器可在血样中检测目标分析物。

e.en: Calibration ensures accurate measurement of each {analyte}.
e.zh: 校准可确保对每种分析物的精确测量。

e.en: He has a sharp {analytic} mind perfect for solving puzzles.
e.zh: 他有敏锐的分析头脑,非常适合解谜。

e.en: The course teaches {analytic} approaches to literature.
e.zh: 这门课教授分析性的文学研究方法。

analytical.t: adj. 分析的；善于分析的

e.en: The job requires strong {analytical} skills and attention to detail.
e.zh: 这份工作需要很强的分析能力和对细节的关注。

e.en: She took an {analytical} approach to solving the problem.
e.zh: 她采取分析性的方法来解决这个问题。

analytically.t: adv. 分析地；用分析方法

e.en: He approaches every decision {analytically} rather than emotionally.
e.zh: 他对每个决定都采取分析的态度,而非情绪化。

e.en: The problem can be solved {analytically} without simulation.
e.zh: 这个问题无需仿真就能解析地求解。

analytics.t: n. 数据分析；分析工具

e.en: The startup uses {analytics} to track user behavior in real time.
e.zh: 这家初创公司用数据分析来实时跟踪用户行为。

e.en: Google {Analytics} shows traffic dropped over the weekend.
e.zh: Google Analytics 显示周末流量下降了。

e.en: We use Python to {analyze} large datasets at work.
e.zh: 我们在工作中用 Python 来分析大型数据集。

e.en: Coaches {analyze} game footage to improve player performance.
e.zh: 教练们通过分析比赛录像来提升球员表现。

analyzed.t: v. analyze 的过去式／过去分词

e.en: The startup {analyzed} millions of tweets to gauge public mood.
e.zh: 这家初创公司分析了数百万条推文来衡量公众情绪。

e.en: She {analyzed} her own mistakes after losing the match.
e.zh: 输掉比赛后,她分析了自己的失误。

e.en: The network {analyzer} captured every packet on the wire.
e.zh: 网络分析仪捕获了线路上的每一个数据包。

e.en: A static code {analyzer} flagged several potential bugs.
e.zh: 静态代码分析器标记出了几个潜在的漏洞。

analyzes.t: v. analyze 的第三人称单数

e.en: The app {analyzes} your sleep and suggests improvements.
e.zh: 这款应用会分析你的睡眠并提出改进建议。

e.en: She {analyzes} financial statements for a hedge fund.
e.zh: 她为一家对冲基金分析财务报表。

e.en: The team is busy {analyzing} this quarter's sales numbers.
e.zh: 团队正忙于分析本季度的销售数据。

e.en: {Analyzing} your spending habits can save real money.
e.zh: 分析自己的消费习惯可以省下不少钱。

e.en: The director shot the film with {anamorphic} lenses for a wider look.
e.zh: 导演用变形镜头拍摄影片,以获得更宽广的画面。

e.en: The painting reveals a hidden skull when viewed at an {anamorphic} angle.
e.zh: 这幅画在变形角度下会显现出一个隐藏的头骨。

ananda.t: n. 阿难（佛陀弟子）；阿南达

e.en: In Sanskrit, {ananda} means pure bliss or spiritual joy.
e.zh: 在梵语中,ananda 意为纯粹的喜悦或灵性之乐。

e.en: The yoga retreat promised a state of {ananda} for participants.
e.zh: 这次瑜伽静修承诺让参与者体验一种喜乐的状态。

e.en: In "Maya forgot her keys," "her" is an {anaphor} referring to Maya.
e.zh: 在"Maya forgot her keys"中,"her"是指代 Maya 的回指词。

e.en: Linguists study how each {anaphor} finds its antecedent.
e.zh: 语言学家研究每个回指词如何找到其先行词。

e.en: The speech used {anaphora} by repeating "I have a dream".
e.zh: 这篇演讲通过反复使用"我有一个梦想"运用了首语重复修辞。

e.en: Resolving {anaphora} is a challenging task in natural language processing.
e.zh: 指代消解在自然语言处理中是一项有挑战的任务。

e.en: He carries an EpiPen for severe {anaphylactic} reactions to peanuts.
e.zh: 他随身带着肾上腺素笔，以防对花生发生严重过敏性休克。

e.en: The patient went into {anaphylactic} shock minutes after the injection.
e.zh: 病人在注射后几分钟内出现过敏性休克。

anaphylaxis.t: n. 过敏性休克；严重过敏反应

e.en: Bee stings can trigger {anaphylaxis} in sensitive individuals.
e.zh: 蜂蜇可能引发敏感人群的过敏性休克。

e.en: Doctors trained the staff to recognize signs of {anaphylaxis}.
e.zh: 医生培训员工识别过敏性休克的征兆。

anarchic.t: adj. 无政府状态的；混乱的

e.en: The classroom became {anarchic} when the substitute teacher left.
e.zh: 代课老师一离开，教室就乱成一团。

e.en: Critics described the early internet as a wild, {anarchic} space.
e.zh: 评论家把早期的互联网形容为一个无序狂野的空间。

anarchical.t: adj. 无政府状态的；混乱无序的

e.en: The protest devolved into an {anarchical} scene of broken windows.
e.zh: 抗议演变成砸碎窗户的无政府混乱场面。

e.en: Their startup had a fun but {anarchical} working culture.
e.zh: 他们的创业公司有种有趣但毫无章法的工作文化。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on the history of {anarchism} in Spain.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于西班牙无政府主义历史的论文。

e.en: Modern {anarchism} rejects both state power and corporate control.
e.zh: 现代无政府主义同时反对国家权力与企业控制。

e.en: The {anarchist} group organized a peaceful march downtown.
e.zh: 无政府主义团体在市中心组织了和平游行。

e.en: She read every book by the famous {anarchist} philosopher.
e.zh: 她读遍了那位著名无政府主义哲学家的每本书。

e.en: His {anarchistic} views made him unpopular at corporate meetings.
e.zh: 他无政府主义式的观点让他在公司会议上不受欢迎。

e.en: The band's lyrics had a strong {anarchistic} streak.
e.zh: 这支乐队的歌词带有强烈的无政府主义色彩。

e.en: Without rules, the playground descended into total {anarchy}.
e.zh: 没有规则，操场陷入彻底的混乱。

e.en: Critics warned the policy would lead to economic {anarchy}.
e.zh: 批评者警告这项政策会导致经济失序。

anasazi.t: n. 阿纳萨齐人（古印第安部落）

e.en: The {Anasazi} built remarkable cliff dwellings in the American Southwest.
e.zh: 阿那萨齐人在美国西南部建造了出色的悬崖居所。

e.en: Tourists visit the canyon to see ancient {Anasazi} ruins.
e.zh: 游客前往峡谷参观古老的阿那萨齐遗址。

e.en: The surgeon carefully completed the bowel {anastomosis} during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中小心完成了肠道吻合术。

e.en: Plant veins form a network through tiny vascular {anastomosis}.
e.zh: 植物的叶脉通过细小的血管吻合形成网络。

anathema.t: n. 深恶痛绝之物；诅咒

e.en: Eating meat is {anathema} to strict vegetarians.
e.zh: 对严格的素食者来说，吃肉是绝对不能接受的事。

e.en: Censorship is {anathema} to most journalists.
e.zh: 对大多数记者而言，审查是无法容忍的。

anatolia.t: n. 安纳托利亚（小亚细亚）

e.en: Ancient civilizations flourished across {Anatolia} for thousands of years.
e.zh: 古代文明在安纳托利亚繁荣了数千年。

e.en: They traveled through central {Anatolia} to visit Cappadocia.
e.zh: 他们穿越安纳托利亚中部去参观卡帕多奇亚。

anatolian.t:
adj. 安纳托利亚的
n. 安纳托利亚人

e.en: She studied {Anatolian} languages at university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究安纳托利亚语言。

e.en: The shepherd brought home an {Anatolian} dog to guard the flock.
e.zh: 牧羊人带回一只安纳托利亚牧羊犬看守羊群。

e.en: The textbook includes detailed {anatomic} drawings of the heart.
e.zh: 教科书附有心脏的详细解剖图。

e.en: Surgeons rely on precise {anatomic} landmarks during operations.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中依靠精确的解剖标志。

anatomical.t: adj. 解剖学的；结构上的

e.en: The museum displays an {anatomical} model of the human body.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具人体解剖模型。

e.en: Doctors note small {anatomical} differences between patients.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人之间细微的解剖差异。

e.en: The dolls are {anatomically} accurate for medical training.
e.zh: 这些人偶在解剖结构上很准确，用于医学培训。

e.en: The sculpture is beautiful but not {anatomically} correct.
e.zh: 这座雕塑很美，但解剖结构并不准确。

e.en: The {anatomist} demonstrated muscle structure to medical students.
e.zh: 解剖学家向医学生演示肌肉结构。

e.en: Leonardo da Vinci was both an artist and an {anatomist}.
e.zh: 达芬奇既是艺术家，也是解剖学家。

e.en: Medical students spend their first year studying human {anatomy}.
e.zh: 医学生第一年都在学习人体解剖学。

e.en: The article breaks down the {anatomy} of a successful startup.
e.zh: 这篇文章剖析了一家成功创业公司的构成要素。

anc.t: n. 非洲人国民大会（南非政党）

e.en: The {ANC} has dominated South African politics since 1994.
e.zh: 自1994年以来，非国大一直主导着南非政治。

e.en: Mandela led the {ANC} during the struggle against apartheid.
e.zh: 曼德拉在反种族隔离斗争中领导着非国大。

e.en: My great-grandfather was an {ancestor} who emigrated from Italy.
e.zh: 我的曾祖父是从意大利移民来的祖先。

e.en: This phone is the direct {ancestor} of all modern smartphones.
e.zh: 这部手机是所有现代智能手机的直接前身。

e.en: Her {ancestors} arrived on the East Coast in the 1800s.
e.zh: 她的祖先在19世纪到达东海岸。

e.en: Many cultures honor their {ancestors} with annual ceremonies.
e.zh: 许多文化都用年度仪式来纪念祖先。

e.en: They returned to their {ancestral} village in southern China.
e.zh: 他们回到了在中国南方的祖籍村庄。

e.en: The painting hangs in the family's {ancestral} home.
e.zh: 那幅画挂在这个家族的祖宅里。

e.en: She traced her lineage back to an {ancestress} from Wales.
e.zh: 她把家族血统追溯到一位来自威尔士的女祖先。

e.en: The legendary {ancestress} of the tribe appears in many stories.
e.zh: 这个部落的传奇女始祖出现在许多故事中。

e.en: DNA tests revealed her mixed European and Asian {ancestry}.
e.zh: DNA检测揭示了她混合的欧亚血统。

e.en: He's proud of his Scottish {ancestry} and wears the family tartan.
e.zh: 他为自己的苏格兰血统感到自豪，常穿家族格子呢。

ancho.t: n. 安秋辣椒（干的波布拉诺辣椒）

e.en: The chef added dried {ancho} chiles to the stew.
e.zh: 厨师在炖菜里加了干安乔辣椒。

e.en: This sauce gets its smoky flavor from {ancho} peppers.
e.zh: 这款酱料的烟熏味来自安乔辣椒。

anchor.t:
n. 锚；主播
v. 锚定；固定

e.en: The captain ordered the crew to drop {anchor} in the bay.
e.zh: 船长命令船员在海湾里抛锚。

e.en: She's the evening news {anchor} on channel five.
e.zh: 她是五频道的晚间新闻主播。

e.en: The harbor offers safe {anchorage} during heavy storms.
e.zh: 这个港口在暴风雨中能提供安全的停泊处。

e.en: We flew to {Anchorage} to start our Alaskan cruise.
e.zh: 我们飞到安克雷奇开始阿拉斯加邮轮之旅。

e.en: The coast has several sheltered {anchorages} for small boats.
e.zh: 这片海岸有几个适合小船停泊的避风锚地。

e.en: Sailors marked the safest {anchorages} on their charts.
e.zh: 水手们在海图上标出了最安全的锚地。

anchored.t: v. anchor 的过去式；已固定的

e.en: The yacht {anchored} just outside the harbor for the night.
e.zh: 那艘游艇在港口外抛锚过夜。

e.en: Her career is firmly {anchored} in scientific research.
e.zh: 她的职业生涯牢牢扎根于科学研究。

anchoring.t:
n. 锚定效应
v. anchor 的现在分词

e.en: He's been {anchoring} the morning news for over a decade.
e.zh: 他主持晨间新闻已经超过十年了。

e.en: Strong roots are {anchoring} the tree against the wind.
e.zh: 粗壮的树根把这棵树牢牢固定，抵御大风。

e.en: The veteran {anchorman} announced his retirement on live TV.
e.zh: 这位资深男主播在直播中宣布退休。

e.en: Every {anchorman} on the network covered the breaking story.
e.zh: 电视网的每位男主播都报道了这条突发新闻。

e.en: Two {anchormen} co-hosted the election night broadcast.
e.zh: 两位男主播共同主持了选举之夜的直播。

e.en: Famous {anchormen} from the seventies shaped TV journalism.
e.zh: 七十年代的知名男主播塑造了电视新闻业。

anchorpeople.t: n. 新闻主播（复数，不分性别）

e.en: The network hired several new {anchorpeople} this year.
e.zh: 该电视网今年聘用了几位新主播。

e.en: Local {anchorpeople} interviewed the mayor after the election.
e.zh: 当地的主播们在选举后采访了市长。

anchorperson.t: n. 新闻主播（不分性别）

e.en: The {anchorperson} read the headlines with calm authority.
e.zh: 主播以沉稳权威的语气播报头条。

e.en: She became the youngest {anchorperson} ever hired by the station.
e.zh: 她成了该电视台聘用过的最年轻的主播。

anchors.t:
n. anchor 的复数
v. 第三人称单数

e.en: The ship's massive {anchors} weighed several tons each.
e.zh: 这艘船的巨型锚每个都重达数吨。

e.en: All three {anchors} delivered the breaking news live.
e.zh: 三位主播都对这条突发新闻进行了直播。

e.en: The {anchorwoman} won an award for her war reporting.
e.zh: 这位女主播因战地报道获得了奖项。

e.en: She became the network's lead {anchorwoman} last spring.
e.zh: 她在去年春天成为该电视网的首席女主播。

e.en: He ordered a pizza topped with olives and {anchovy}.
e.zh: 他点了一份加橄榄和凤尾鱼的披萨。

e.en: The Caesar dressing gets its flavor from a single {anchovy}.
e.zh: 这款凯撒酱的风味来自一条凤尾鱼。

e.en: Tourists flock to see the {ancient} ruins of Rome.
e.zh: 游客们蜂拥而至，参观罗马的古代遗迹。

e.en: My laptop is so {ancient} that it can barely run anything.
e.zh: 我的笔记本太老了，几乎跑不动任何程序。

e.en: This temple was {anciently} dedicated to a forgotten god.
e.zh: 这座庙宇在远古时期供奉着一位被遗忘的神。

e.en: The path was {anciently} used by traders crossing the desert.
e.zh: 这条路在古时是穿越沙漠的商人所走的。

e.en: The hospital provides {ancillary} services like physical therapy.
e.zh: 医院还提供物理治疗等辅助服务。

e.en: Streaming is now their main income, with merchandise an {ancillary} stream.
e.zh: 流媒体现在是他们的主要收入，周边商品只是辅助来源。

ancona.t: n. 安科纳（意大利港口城市）

e.en: We took a ferry from {Ancona} to Croatia last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从安科纳坐渡轮去克罗地亚。

e.en: The {Ancona} chicken is known for its black-and-white feathers.
e.zh: 安科纳鸡以黑白相间的羽毛闻名。

ancova.t: n. 协方差分析（统计方法）

e.en: Researchers ran an {ANCOVA} to control for baseline differences.
e.zh: 研究人员用协方差分析来控制基线差异。

e.en: The {ANCOVA} results showed a significant treatment effect.
e.zh: 协方差分析结果显示治疗效果显著。

e.en: I'd like a coffee {and} a croissant, please.
e.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡和一个牛角包。

e.en: She studied hard {and} eventually passed the exam.
e.zh: 她努力学习，最终通过了考试。

andalucia.t: n. 安达卢西亚（西班牙南部地区）

e.en: We spent two weeks exploring small villages in {Andalucia}.
e.zh: 我们花了两周时间游览安达卢西亚的小村庄。

e.en: Flamenco music originated in southern {Andalucia}.
e.zh: 弗拉明戈音乐起源于安达卢西亚南部。

andalusia.t: n. 安达卢西亚（西班牙南部地区）

e.en: The whitewashed villages of {Andalusia} attract millions of tourists.
e.zh: 安达卢西亚的白墙村庄吸引了数百万游客。

e.en: Olive trees cover much of the rolling countryside in {Andalusia}.
e.zh: 橄榄树覆盖了安达卢西亚起伏的乡村。

andalusian.t:
adj. 安达卢西亚的
n. 安达卢西亚人

e.en: She rides a beautiful {Andalusian} horse in competitions.
e.zh: 她在比赛中骑一匹漂亮的安达卢西亚马。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Andalusian} dishes like gazpacho.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的安达卢西亚菜，比如冷汤。

andante.t: n. 行板（音乐术语，中速）

e.en: The orchestra played the {andante} movement with great tenderness.
e.zh: 乐团以极大的温柔演奏了行板乐章。

e.en: She marked the passage {andante} on the score.
e.zh: 她在乐谱上把这一段标为行板。

e.en: The director {Ande} won an award at the indie film festival.
e.zh: 导演安德在独立电影节上获奖。

e.en: Her younger brother {Ande} just started high school.
e.zh: 她的弟弟安德刚上高中。

e.en: {Andean} farmers have grown potatoes for thousands of years.
e.zh: 安第斯山区的农民种植土豆已有数千年历史。

e.en: We hiked through {Andean} villages on the way to Machu Picchu.
e.zh: 前往马丘比丘的路上我们徒步穿过了安第斯山的村庄。

e.en: The typo {andf} appeared three times in his draft.
e.zh: 他的草稿里有三处出现了拼写错误“andf”。

e.en: Spell check immediately flagged {andf} as a misspelling.
e.zh: 拼写检查立刻把“andf”标记为错字。

e.en: An iron {andiron} held the burning logs in place.
e.zh: 一只铁制的柴架把燃烧的木柴稳稳托住。

e.en: She polished the antique brass {andiron} by the fireplace.
e.zh: 她擦亮了壁炉旁那只古董黄铜柴架。

e.en: We hiked the mountain trails of {Andorra} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在安道尔徒步走了几条山间小道。

e.en: {Andorra} is a tiny country between France and Spain.
e.zh: 安道尔是夹在法国和西班牙之间的小国。

andouille.t: n. 安杜耶肠（法式烟熏猪肉肠）

e.en: The gumbo gets its smoky flavor from {andouille} sausage.
e.zh: 这锅秋葵浓汤的烟熏味来自安杜伊香肠。

e.en: He grilled {andouille} for the jambalaya recipe.
e.zh: 他烤了安杜伊香肠用来做什锦饭。

e.en: She studied at a prep school in {Andover}, Massachusetts.
e.zh: 她在马萨诸塞州安多弗的一所预科学校读书。

e.en: The train from Boston to {Andover} runs every hour.
e.zh: 从波士顿开往安多弗的火车每小时一班。

e.en: Critics called the film's worldview deeply {androcentric}.
e.zh: 评论家认为这部电影的世界观极其以男性为中心。

e.en: Many old textbooks present an {androcentric} view of history.
e.zh: 许多旧课本呈现的是以男性为中心的历史视角。

e.en: Testosterone is the most well-known {androgen} in humans.
e.zh: 睾酮是人体中最广为人知的雄激素。

e.en: The clinic tested his blood for low {androgen} levels.
e.zh: 诊所给他做了血液检查,看雄激素水平是否偏低。

androgenetic.t: adj. 雄激素性的（如脱发）

e.en: {Androgenetic} alopecia is the medical term for male pattern baldness.
e.zh: 雄激素性脱发是男性型脱发的医学名称。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her with {androgenetic} hair loss in her thirties.
e.zh: 医生在她三十多岁时诊断出她患有雄激素性脱发。

androgynous.t: adj. 中性的；雌雄同体的

e.en: The model has a strikingly {androgynous} look on the runway.
e.zh: 这位模特在 T 台上展现出极具雌雄同体气质的造型。

e.en: Many fashion brands now design {androgynous} clothing for everyone.
e.zh: 许多时装品牌如今为所有人设计中性服装。

e.en: David Bowie famously embraced {androgyny} in his stage persona.
e.zh: 大卫·鲍伊以舞台上的中性气质而闻名。

e.en: The exhibit explores {androgyny} in twentieth-century art.
e.zh: 这场展览探讨了二十世纪艺术中的雌雄同体现象。

e.en: My new phone runs the latest version of {Android}.
e.zh: 我的新手机装的是最新版的安卓系统。

e.en: The sci-fi novel features an {android} who develops emotions.
e.zh: 这本科幻小说讲述了一个产生情感的机器人。

e.en: The {Andromeda} galaxy is visible to the naked eye.
e.zh: 仙女座星系用肉眼就能看到。

e.en: Astronomers say {Andromeda} will collide with the Milky Way someday.
e.zh: 天文学家说仙女座星系总有一天会与银河系相撞。

e.en: Several athletes were banned for using {androstenedione} as a supplement.
e.zh: 几位运动员因使用雄烯二酮作为补剂而被禁赛。

e.en: The lab measured her {androstenedione} levels during the hormone panel.
e.zh: 实验室在激素检查中测了她的雄烯二酮水平。

e.en: The evidence is purely {anecdotal} and not scientifically proven.
e.zh: 这些证据纯粹是道听途说,没有科学依据。

e.en: Her support for the diet is based on {anecdotal} reports.
e.zh: 她对这种饮食法的支持只是基于一些个例反馈。

e.en: He opened the speech with a funny childhood {anecdote}.
e.zh: 他用一段有趣的童年轶事开始了演讲。

e.en: She loves sharing {anecdotes} about her travels in Japan.
e.zh: 她喜欢分享她在日本旅行的趣闻。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with iron-deficiency {anemia}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有缺铁性贫血。

e.en: Severe {anemia} can cause fatigue and shortness of breath.
e.zh: 严重的贫血会导致疲劳和气短。

anemic.t: adj. 贫血的；缺乏活力的

e.en: She's been feeling {anemic} and constantly tired lately.
e.zh: 她最近感觉贫血,总是觉得很累。

e.en: Sales growth this quarter has been disappointingly {anemic}.
e.zh: 本季度的销售增长令人失望地疲软。

e.en: The weather station's {anemometer} measured gusts of fifty miles per hour.
e.zh: 气象站的风速计测到了每小时五十英里的阵风。

e.en: Sailors check the {anemometer} before leaving the harbor.
e.zh: 水手们在出港前会查看风速计。

anemone.t:
n. 海葵
n. 银莲花

e.en: A clownfish hides safely inside the sea {anemone}.
e.zh: 一条小丑鱼安全地藏在海葵里。

e.en: Purple {anemones} bloomed across the meadow in spring.
e.zh: 春天里,紫色的银莲花开满了整片草地。

e.en: The {anencephalic} infant was unable to survive after birth.
e.zh: 那名无脑畸形的婴儿出生后无法存活。

e.en: Doctors detected the {anencephalic} condition during the second trimester.
e.zh: 医生在孕中期检测出了无脑畸形。

e.en: Folic acid supplements help reduce the risk of {anencephaly}.
e.zh: 补充叶酸有助于降低无脑畸形的风险。

e.en: {Anencephaly} is a rare and fatal birth defect.
e.zh: 无脑畸形是一种罕见且致命的出生缺陷。

e.en: The patient was put under general {anesthesia} for the surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术中接受了全身麻醉。

e.en: Local {anesthesia} numbed the area before the dentist drilled.
e.zh: 牙医钻牙前用局部麻醉让这块区域失去知觉。

e.en: The {anesthesiologist} explained the risks before the operation began.
e.zh: 麻醉师在手术开始前解释了相关风险。

e.en: She trained for years to become a pediatric {anesthesiologist}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练才成为一名儿科麻醉师。

e.en: He chose {anesthesiology} as his medical specialty after residency.
e.zh: 住院医师培训后,他选择麻醉学作为自己的专业方向。

e.en: The hospital's {anesthesiology} department is one of the best.
e.zh: 这家医院的麻醉科是全国最好的之一。

anesthetic.t:
n. 麻醉剂
adj. 麻醉的

e.en: The dentist gave me a local {anesthetic} before the filling.
e.zh: 补牙前牙医给我打了局部麻醉。

e.en: Some {anesthetics} can cause nausea after the procedure.
e.zh: 有些麻醉药术后会引起恶心。

e.en: The {anesthetist} carefully monitored the patient's vital signs.
e.zh: 麻醉师仔细监测着病人的生命体征。

e.en: A nurse {anesthetist} assisted during the emergency operation.
e.zh: 一名麻醉护士协助了那场紧急手术。

e.en: The vet had to {anesthetize} the dog before the X-ray.
e.zh: 兽医在拍 X 光前不得不给那只狗打麻醉。

e.en: Surgeons {anesthetize} patients to prevent pain during operations.
e.zh: 外科医生给病人麻醉,以防手术中产生疼痛。

e.en: The patient was fully {anesthetized} before the incision was made.
e.zh: 在切开之前病人已经被完全麻醉。

e.en: Researchers studied the {anesthetized} mice in the lab.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室里观察那些已被麻醉的小鼠。

e.en: {Aneurin} is another name for vitamin B1.
e.zh: 硫胺素是维生素 B1 的另一个名字。

e.en: A deficiency of {aneurin} can lead to nerve problems.
e.zh: 硫胺素缺乏会导致神经系统问题。

e.en: He suffered a brain {aneurism} and was rushed to surgery.
e.zh: 他突发脑动脉瘤,被紧急送去手术。

e.en: A ruptured {aneurism} can be fatal within minutes.
e.zh: 动脉瘤破裂可能在几分钟内致命。

e.en: Doctors discovered a small {aneurysm} during the routine MRI scan.
e.zh: 医生在常规核磁共振扫描中发现了一个小动脉瘤。

e.en: An aortic {aneurysm} requires immediate medical attention.
e.zh: 主动脉瘤需要立刻就医处理。

e.en: After the breakup, she decided to start her life {anew}.
e.zh: 分手之后,她决定重新开始自己的生活。

e.en: They moved abroad and built their careers {anew}.
e.zh: 他们搬到国外,从头打造自己的事业。

anfield.t: n. 安菲尔德（利物浦队主场）

e.en: Liverpool fans packed {Anfield} for the Champions League match.
e.zh: 利物浦球迷把安菲尔德球场塞得满满的,只为看欧冠比赛。

e.en: The atmosphere at {Anfield} on match day is electric.
e.zh: 比赛日安菲尔德球场的氛围令人热血沸腾。

e.en: The director {Ang} Lee won two Oscars for Best Director.
e.zh: 导演李安两度斩获奥斯卡最佳导演奖。

e.en: In Filipino, "{ang}" is a common grammatical marker.
e.zh: 在菲律宾语里,"ang" 是一个常见的语法标记词。

angel.t:
n. 天使
n. 天使投资人

e.en: My grandmother believes a guardian {angel} watches over her.
e.zh: 我奶奶相信有一位守护天使在保佑她。

e.en: She was an absolute {angel} during my recovery from surgery.
e.zh: 我手术康复期间,她简直就像个天使一样。

angeles.t: n. 地名（如洛杉矶 Los Angeles）

e.en: We're flying to Los {Angeles} for vacation next week.
e.zh: 我们下周要飞去洛杉矶度假。

e.en: Los {Angeles} traffic can be brutal during rush hour.
e.zh: 洛杉矶高峰时段的交通可能非常糟糕。

e.en: The bright {angelfish} glided through the coral reef.
e.zh: 那条色彩鲜艳的神仙鱼在珊瑚礁间游动。

e.en: She keeps a pair of {angelfish} in her saltwater tank.
e.zh: 她在海水鱼缸里养了一对神仙鱼。

e.en: The choir's voices sounded almost {angelic} in the cathedral.
e.zh: 大教堂里合唱团的歌声听起来宛如天籁。

e.en: The baby gave us an {angelic} smile from her crib.
e.zh: 宝宝在婴儿床里给了我们一个天使般的微笑。

angelica.t:
n. 当归；白芷
n. 女子名

e.en: She candied {angelica} stems to decorate the cake.
e.zh: 她把当归茎做成蜜饯,用来装饰蛋糕。

e.en: {Angelica} is used in some traditional herbal teas.
e.zh: 当归被用在一些传统的草药茶里。

e.en: The painting shows {angels} hovering above the manger.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了天使们盘旋在马槽上方的景象。

e.en: The Los Angeles {Angels} lost their game last night.
e.zh: 洛杉矶天使队昨晚输掉了比赛。

angelus.t: n. 三钟经（天主教祷告）

e.en: The church bell rings the {Angelus} every day at noon.
e.zh: 教堂的钟每天中午都会敲响三钟经。

e.en: The villagers paused to pray during the evening {Angelus}.
e.zh: 村民们在傍晚的三钟经时停下来祈祷。

anger.t:
n. 愤怒
v. 激怒

e.en: He couldn't hide his {anger} when he heard the news.
e.zh: 听到那条消息时,他无法掩饰自己的怒气。

e.en: Therapy helped her learn to manage her {anger}.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮她学会了管理自己的愤怒。

angered.t:
v. 激怒（过去式）
adj. 愤怒的

e.en: The unfair decision {angered} fans across the country.
e.zh: 那个不公平的判罚激怒了全国各地的球迷。

e.en: His rude comments {angered} everyone at the dinner table.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的评论惹怒了餐桌上的所有人。

angevin.t:
adj. 安茹王朝的
n. 安茹人

e.en: The {Angevin} kings ruled large parts of medieval France and England.
e.zh: 安茹王朝的国王曾统治中世纪法国和英格兰的大片土地。

e.en: This museum displays artifacts from the {Angevin} period.
e.zh: 这家博物馆展出了安茹王朝时期的文物。

e.en: He takes nitroglycerin to relieve his {angina} attacks.
e.zh: 他服用硝酸甘油来缓解心绞痛发作。

e.en: Chest pain from {angina} usually signals a heart problem.
e.zh: 心绞痛带来的胸痛通常意味着心脏出了问题。

e.en: Tumors rely on {angiogenesis} to grow new blood vessels.
e.zh: 肿瘤依靠血管生成来长出新的血管。

e.en: Researchers are testing drugs that block {angiogenesis} in cancer cells.
e.zh: 研究人员正在测试能阻断癌细胞血管生成的药物。

e.en: The cardiologist ordered an {angiogram} to check for blocked arteries.
e.zh: 心脏科医生开了一份血管造影,来检查动脉是否堵塞。

e.en: His {angiogram} revealed two narrowed coronary arteries.
e.zh: 他的血管造影显示有两条冠状动脉变窄。

e.en: CT {angiography} provides detailed images of the heart's blood vessels.
e.zh: CT 血管造影能提供心脏血管的详细图像。

e.en: The hospital uses advanced {angiography} to diagnose vascular disease.
e.zh: 医院用先进的血管造影技术来诊断血管疾病。

e.en: He underwent {angioplasty} to open his blocked coronary artery.
e.zh: 他接受了血管成形术,来打通堵塞的冠状动脉。

e.en: Balloon {angioplasty} has saved countless heart attack patients.
e.zh: 球囊血管成形术挽救了无数心脏病发作的患者。

e.en: {Angiosarcoma} is a rare and aggressive cancer of blood vessels.
e.zh: 血管肉瘤是一种罕见且具侵袭性的血管癌症。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the patient with liver {angiosarcoma}.
e.zh: 医生诊断这位病人患有肝脏血管肉瘤。

e.en: Roses and oak trees are both examples of {angiosperms}.
e.zh: 玫瑰和橡树都是被子植物的例子。

e.en: Most flowering plants on Earth are classified as {angiosperms}.
e.zh: 地球上大多数开花植物都被归类为被子植物。

e.en: The drug blocks {angiotensin} to lower blood pressure.
e.zh: 这种药物通过阻断血管紧张素来降低血压。

e.en: Doctors measured her {angiotensin} levels during the trial.
e.zh: 医生在试验期间测量了她的血管紧张素水平。

e.en: We watched the sunrise behind {Angkor} Wat last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在吴哥窟后面看了日出。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Angkor} for its ancient temples.
e.zh: 游客们涌向吴哥参观古老的寺庙。

anglaise.t: adj. 英式风格的（法语借词）

e.en: She ordered pears {anglaise} with vanilla custard for dessert.
e.zh: 她点了一份配香草蛋奶的英式炖梨作甜点。

e.en: The chef poured warm crème {anglaise} over the cake.
e.zh: 厨师在蛋糕上浇了温热的英式蛋奶酱。

angle.t:
n. 角；角度
v. 倾斜；从某角度叙述

e.en: Try shooting the photo from a lower {angle}.
e.zh: 试着从更低的角度拍这张照片。

e.en: The reporter found a fresh {angle} on the story.
e.zh: 记者为这则报道找到了一个新颖的切入点。

angled.t:
adj. 有角度的
v. 倾斜（过去式）

e.en: She {angled} the laptop screen away from the window.
e.zh: 她把笔记本屏幕调整成背对窗户的角度。

e.en: The roof is {angled} to shed snow easily.
e.zh: 屋顶设计成倾斜的，方便积雪滑落。

anglepoise.t: n. 摇臂式可调台灯（品牌）

e.en: He bought a vintage {anglepoise} lamp for his desk.
e.zh: 他买了一盏复古的鹅颈台灯放在书桌上。

e.en: The {anglepoise} bends to light any corner of the page.
e.zh: 这盏可调节台灯能照亮书页的任何角落。

angler.t:
n. 钓鱼者
n. 鮟鱇鱼

e.en: The {angler} cast his line into the misty river.
e.zh: 那位钓鱼者把鱼线甩进了雾蒙蒙的河中。

e.en: Every weekend dozens of {anglers} gather at the lake.
e.zh: 每个周末都有几十位垂钓者聚集在湖边。

angles.t:
n. 角度（复数）
n. 盎格鲁人

e.en: The camera captures the scene from multiple {angles}.
e.zh: 摄像机从多个角度捕捉这个场景。

e.en: Investigators are exploring all possible {angles} in the case.
e.zh: 调查人员正在从所有可能的角度调查此案。

anglesey.t: n. 安格尔西岛（威尔士）

e.en: We took the ferry across to {Anglesey} for the holiday.
e.zh: 假期里我们搭渡轮去了安格尔西岛。

e.en: {Anglesey} is famous for its rugged coastal walks.
e.zh: 安格尔西岛以崎岖的海岸步道而闻名。

anglia.t: n. 盎格利亚（英格兰东部地区旧称）

e.en: East {Anglia} is known for its flat farmland and big skies.
e.zh: 东盎格利亚以平坦的农田和广阔的天空著称。

e.en: She studied literature at the University of East {Anglia}.
e.zh: 她在东英吉利亚大学学习文学。

anglian.t:
adj. 盎格鲁人的
n. 盎格鲁人

e.en: The museum displays {Anglian} artifacts from the seventh century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了七世纪的盎格利亚人文物。

e.en: Old {Anglian} dialects still influence local speech today.
e.zh: 古盎格利亚方言至今仍影响着当地口音。

anglican.t:
adj. 英国圣公会的
n. 圣公会教徒

e.en: They were married in a small {Anglican} church.
e.zh: 他们在一座小型圣公会教堂里结婚。

e.en: The {Anglican} community gathered for the Christmas service.
e.zh: 圣公会信众聚在一起参加圣诞礼拜。

anglicanism.t: n. 圣公宗；英国圣公会教义

e.en: {Anglicanism} blends Catholic tradition with Protestant reform.
e.zh: 圣公宗融合了天主教传统与新教改革。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on the global spread of {Anglicanism}.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于圣公宗全球传播的论文。

anglicise.t: v. 使英国化；使英语化

e.en: Editors often {anglicise} foreign place names for British readers.
e.zh: 编辑们经常把外国地名英语化以方便英国读者。

e.en: He refused to {anglicise} the spelling of his surname.
e.zh: 他拒绝把自己的姓氏拼写英语化。

anglicised.t: adj. 已英国化的；已英语化的

e.en: Her grandfather {anglicised} the family name on arriving in London.
e.zh: 她祖父抵达伦敦时把家族姓氏改成了英语化拼写。

e.en: The menu uses {anglicised} versions of French dish names.
e.zh: 菜单上用的是法国菜名的英语化版本。

anglicize.t: v. 使英国化；使英语化

e.en: American newspapers tend to {anglicize} unfamiliar foreign words.
e.zh: 美国报纸倾向于把不熟悉的外来词英语化。

e.en: She chose not to {anglicize} her given name at school.
e.zh: 她在学校选择不把自己的名字英语化。

anglicized.t: adj. 已英国化的；已英语化的

e.en: "Florence" is the {anglicized} form of "Firenze."
e.zh: "Florence"是"Firenze"的英语化拼写。

e.en: Many immigrants used {anglicized} names to fit in faster.
e.zh: 许多移民使用英语化的名字以便更快融入社会。

e.en: He spends every Sunday {angling} on the quiet riverbank.
e.zh: 他每个周日都在安静的河岸边垂钓。

e.en: She was clearly {angling} for a promotion at the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会上显然是想谋求升职。

anglo.t:
n. 英裔美国人；英语白人
adj. 英裔的

e.en: The {Anglo}-French summit produced a joint statement on trade.
e.zh: 英法峰会就贸易问题发表了联合声明。

e.en: He grew up in an {Anglo} neighborhood of Montreal.
e.zh: 他在蒙特利尔的一个英语裔社区长大。

e.en: As an {anglophile}, she watches every British costume drama.
e.zh: 作为一个亲英派，她每部英国古装剧都看。

e.en: The shop attracts {anglophiles} hunting for imported tea.
e.zh: 这家店吸引着寻找进口茶叶的亲英派顾客。

anglophone.t:
adj. 讲英语的
n. 英语使用者

e.en: Montreal has a large {anglophone} community in its west end.
e.zh: 蒙特利尔西区有一个庞大的英语社区。

e.en: The conference will be held in {anglophone} countries this year.
e.zh: 今年的会议将在英语国家举行。

e.en: {Angola} exports oil and diamonds to markets worldwide.
e.zh: 安哥拉向世界各地市场出口石油和钻石。

e.en: She traveled to {Angola} for a documentary project.
e.zh: 她为一个纪录片项目前往安哥拉。

angolan.t:
adj. 安哥拉的
n. 安哥拉人

e.en: The {Angolan} delegation arrived in Beijing for trade talks.
e.zh: 安哥拉代表团抵达北京进行贸易会谈。

e.en: She loves the rhythms of traditional {Angolan} music.
e.zh: 她喜爱安哥拉传统音乐的节奏。

angora.t: n. 安哥拉兔毛；马海毛

e.en: She knitted a soft scarf out of {angora} wool.
e.zh: 她用安哥拉羊毛织了一条柔软的围巾。

e.en: Their fluffy white {angora} rabbit sat on the cushion.
e.zh: 他们那只毛茸茸的白色安哥拉兔坐在垫子上。

e.en: He slammed the door {angrily} and stormed out.
e.zh: 他愤怒地摔上门，怒气冲冲地走了出去。

e.en: She {angrily} deleted the rude comment from her post.
e.zh: 她气愤地删掉了帖子下那条无礼的评论。

e.en: My boss got really {angry} when the deadline slipped.
e.zh: 截止日期延误时我老板真的很生气。

e.en: Don't post anything online when you're still {angry}.
e.zh: 还在生气的时候不要在网上发任何东西。

e.en: Teenage {angst} fills the lyrics of his early albums.
e.zh: 他早期专辑的歌词中充满了青春期的焦虑。

e.en: She wrote about her {angst} over choosing a career.
e.zh: 她写下了自己对职业选择的焦虑。

e.en: The atom is roughly one {angstrom} across.
e.zh: 这个原子的直径大约是一埃。

e.en: Engineers measure semiconductor layers in {angstroms}.
e.zh: 工程师用埃为单位测量半导体的薄层。

e.en: The novel explores the everyday {angsts} of office life.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了办公室生活中日常的种种焦虑。

e.en: He writes songs about his suburban {angsts} and dreams.
e.zh: 他写歌描述自己郊区生活中的焦虑与梦想。

angsty.t: adj. 焦虑的；烦躁不安的

e.en: She went through an {angsty} phase in high school.
e.zh: 她在高中经历过一段焦虑叛逆的阶段。

e.en: The film is full of {angsty} indie rock songs.
e.zh: 这部电影里充满了焦虑情绪的独立摇滚歌曲。

anguilla.t: n. 安圭拉（加勒比海岛屿）

e.en: They honeymooned on the white beaches of {Anguilla}.
e.zh: 他们在安圭拉白色的沙滩上度蜜月。

e.en: {Anguilla} remains a quiet alternative to busier Caribbean islands.
e.zh: 安圭拉相比其他热闹的加勒比岛屿仍是个安静的去处。

anguish.t:
n. 极度痛苦；苦恼
v. 使痛苦

e.en: His face showed deep {anguish} when he heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息时他脸上流露出深深的痛苦。

e.en: Parents felt enormous {anguish} during the long search.
e.zh: 在漫长的搜寻过程中父母们感到极度痛苦。

anguished.t: adj. 极度痛苦的；苦恼的

e.en: She let out an {anguished} cry as the door closed.
e.zh: 门关上时她发出一声痛苦的哭喊。

e.en: His {anguished} letters reveal years of quiet suffering.
e.zh: 他那些痛苦的信件揭示了多年默默承受的煎熬。

anguishes.t:
n. 痛苦（复数）
v. 使痛苦

e.en: The diary records the small {anguishes} of teenage life.
e.zh: 这本日记记录了青少年生活中的种种小烦恼与痛苦。

e.en: She still {anguishes} over decisions made years ago.
e.zh: 她仍为多年前的决定而苦恼不已。

anguishing.t: v. 使极度痛苦（现在分词）

e.en: He spent the night {anguishing} over the rejection email.
e.zh: 他整夜都在为那封拒信而痛苦。

e.en: Stop {anguishing} about a mistake you can't undo.
e.zh: 别再为一个无法挽回的错误苦恼了。

angular.t:
adj. 有棱角的；瘦削的
n. Angular（前端框架）

e.en: The new sofa has a sleek, {angular} design.
e.zh: 这款新沙发采用了利落有棱角的设计。

e.en: His {angular} face stands out in the team photo.
e.zh: 他那张棱角分明的脸在团队合照中格外醒目。

e.en: The artist exaggerates the {angularities} of the human figure.
e.zh: 这位艺术家夸大了人体的棱角线条。

e.en: She softened the {angularities} of the design with curves.
e.zh: 她用曲线柔化了设计中尖锐的棱角。

e.en: The building's stark {angularity} dominates the skyline.
e.zh: 这栋建筑棱角分明的造型主宰着天际线。

e.en: Her drawings emphasize the {angularity} of modern furniture.
e.zh: 她的画作突出了现代家具的棱角感。

e.en: The X-ray showed slight {angulation} of the broken bone.
e.zh: X光显示骨折处有轻微的成角畸形。

e.en: Skiers adjust their {angulation} when carving sharp turns.
e.zh: 滑雪者在做急转弯时会调整身体的倾角。

angus.t: n. 安格斯（牛品种；人名）

e.en: The restaurant serves prime {Angus} beef burgers.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应顶级安格斯牛肉汉堡。

e.en: They raise black {Angus} cattle on a Scottish farm.
e.zh: 他们在苏格兰的一个农场养殖黑色安格斯牛。

angy.t: adj. 生气的（angry 的网络拼写）

e.en: Don't text me when you're {angy} — call instead.
e.zh: 你生气的时候别给我发短信，直接打电话吧。

e.en: The cat made an {angy} face after missing the jump.
e.zh: 那只猫跳没成功后摆出一副生气的表情。

e.en: Acetic {anhydride} is widely used in pharmaceutical synthesis.
e.zh: 乙酸酐在制药合成中被广泛使用。

e.en: The lab stores the {anhydride} away from moisture.
e.zh: 实验室把这种酸酐远离潮湿存放。

e.en: The reaction requires {anhydrous} ethanol to proceed cleanly.
e.zh: 这个反应需要无水乙醇才能顺利进行。

e.en: Farmers apply {anhydrous} ammonia as a nitrogen fertilizer.
e.zh: 农民施用无水氨作为氮肥。

e.en: A noisy {ani} perched on the fence post.
e.zh: 一只吵闹的犀鹃停在围栏柱子上。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a smooth-billed {ani} in the field.
e.zh: 观鸟者在田野里发现了一只光嘴犀鹃。

e.en: Dyers once extracted blue pigment from the {anil} plant.
e.zh: 染匠过去曾从木蓝植物中提取蓝色颜料。

e.en: The fabric was tinted a deep {anil} blue.
e.zh: 这块布料被染成了深靛蓝色。

e.en: {Aniline} dyes revolutionized the textile industry in the 1800s.
e.zh: 苯胺染料在十九世纪彻底改变了纺织业。

e.en: The leather was finished with a soft {aniline} coating.
e.zh: 这块皮革表面采用了柔软的苯胺涂层。

anima.t: n. 阿尼玛（荣格心理学，男性内在女性原型）

e.en: Jung described the {anima} as the feminine side of the male psyche.
e.zh: 荣格把阿尼玛描述为男性心灵中的女性一面。

e.en: Her paintings explore the {anima} hidden in everyday scenes.
e.zh: 她的画作探索了日常场景中隐藏的内在灵魂。

animal.t:
n. 动物
adj. 动物的

e.en: My favorite {animal} at the zoo is the red panda.
e.zh: 我在动物园里最喜欢的动物是小熊猫。

e.en: Please don't leave any {animal} alone in a hot car.
e.zh: 请不要把任何动物单独留在闷热的车里。

e.en: The dancer moved with raw, {animalistic} energy on stage.
e.zh: 那位舞者在台上以原始野性的能量舞动。

e.en: His {animalistic} growl startled everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他那野兽般的低吼让屋里所有人都吓了一跳。

e.en: The novel explores the {animality} beneath civilized behavior.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了文明行为之下的兽性。

e.en: His sculptures capture both grace and raw {animality}.
e.zh: 他的雕塑同时捕捉到了优雅与原始的兽性。

e.en: The shelter rescued dozens of {animals} from the storm.
e.zh: 收容所从风暴中救出了几十只动物。

e.en: Wild {animals} roam freely across the national park.
e.zh: 野生动物在国家公园里自由地游荡。

animate.t:
v. 制作动画；使生动
adj. 有生命的

e.en: Designers use software to {animate} characters frame by frame.
e.zh: 设计师用软件逐帧制作角色动画。

e.en: A good teacher can {animate} even the dullest topic.
e.zh: 好老师能让最枯燥的话题也变得生动。

animated.t: adj. 动画的；生气勃勃的

e.en: They had an {animated} discussion about the new policy.
e.zh: 他们就新政策展开了一场热烈的讨论。

e.en: Pixar released another {animated} film this summer.
e.zh: 皮克斯今年夏天又推出了一部动画电影。

e.en: She gestured {animatedly} while telling the story.
e.zh: 她讲故事时手舞足蹈地比划着。

e.en: The kids chatted {animatedly} about the game.
e.zh: 孩子们兴奋地谈论着那场比赛。

animates.t: v. 制作动画；赋予活力

e.en: Passion {animates} every line of his writing.
e.zh: 激情让他笔下的每一行字都充满活力。

e.en: This software {animates} 3D models with realistic motion.
e.zh: 这个软件能让3D模型呈现出逼真的动作。

animating.t: v. 制作动画；使生动（现在分词）

e.en: She spent the weekend {animating} a short cartoon.
e.zh: 她整个周末都在制作一部短动画片。

e.en: Curiosity is the {animating} force behind science.
e.zh: 好奇心是推动科学发展的核心力量。

e.en: Japanese {animation} has fans all over the world.
e.zh: 日本动画在全世界都有粉丝。

e.en: Add a subtle fade {animation} to the button.
e.zh: 给按钮加一个淡入淡出的小动效。

e.en: The app's smooth {animations} make navigation feel fast.
e.zh: 应用流畅的动效让操作感觉很快。

e.en: Disney produced several classic {animations} in the nineties.
e.zh: 迪士尼在九十年代推出了几部经典动画。

animator.t: n. 动画师；动画制作者

e.en: She works as a freelance {animator} for streaming shows.
e.zh: 她为流媒体剧集做自由职业动画师。

e.en: Every {animator} on the team uses the same software.
e.zh: 团队里每位动画师都使用同一款软件。

animatronic.t: adj. 电子动画的（仿真机械人偶）

e.en: The theme park unveiled a new {animatronic} dinosaur.
e.zh: 主题公园推出了一只全新的电动恐龙模型。

e.en: Old films often used {animatronic} creatures instead of CGI.
e.zh: 老电影常用电动模型代替电脑特效。

animatronics.t: n. 电子动画技术；仿真机械人偶

e.en: Disney's {animatronics} have improved dramatically over the decades.
e.zh: 迪士尼的电动模型技术几十年来进步巨大。

e.en: He studies {animatronics} to build robotic theme park figures.
e.zh: 他学习电动机械学,为主题公园打造机器人形象。

e.en: She watches {anime} every night before bed.
e.zh: 她每晚睡前都会看动漫。

e.en: That {anime} series became a global hit overnight.
e.zh: 那部动漫一夜之间风靡全球。

animism.t: n. 万物有灵论；泛灵信仰

e.en: {Animism} is the belief that natural objects have spirits.
e.zh: 万物有灵论认为自然物体都有灵魂。

e.en: Many indigenous cultures practice forms of {animism}.
e.zh: 许多原住民文化都奉行某种万物有灵的信仰。

animist.t: n. 泛灵论者；万物有灵信仰者

e.en: The tribe holds {animist} beliefs about the forest.
e.zh: 这个部落对森林持有万物有灵的信仰。

e.en: He grew up in an {animist} village in the mountains.
e.zh: 他在山里一个信奉万物有灵论的村庄长大。

animistic.t: adj. 泛灵论的；万物有灵的

e.en: The novel draws on {animistic} traditions from West Africa.
e.zh: 这部小说借鉴了西非的万物有灵传统。

e.en: Their rituals reflect deeply {animistic} worldviews.
e.zh: 他们的仪式反映出浓厚的万物有灵世界观。

e.en: There's clear {animosity} between the two coworkers.
e.zh: 那两位同事之间明显有敌意。

e.en: Years of competition bred {animosity} between the rivals.
e.zh: 多年的竞争让对手之间结下了仇怨。

animus.t: n. 敌意；(心理学) 男性意象

e.en: His public {animus} toward the press surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他对媒体公开表现的敌意让所有人都很意外。

e.en: The article reveals an underlying political {animus}.
e.zh: 这篇文章透露出潜在的政治敌意。

e.en: Chloride is a common negatively charged {anion} in seawater.
e.zh: 氯离子是海水中常见的带负电阴离子。

e.en: Each {anion} attracts positively charged particles nearby.
e.zh: 每个阴离子都会吸引附近带正电的粒子。

e.en: The cookies have a strong flavor of {anise}.
e.zh: 这些饼干带有浓浓的茴香味。

e.en: Star {anise} is essential in Chinese braised dishes.
e.zh: 八角是中式红烧菜里不可缺少的香料。

e.en: She added a pinch of {aniseed} to the bread dough.
e.zh: 她往面包面团里加了一点茴香籽。

e.en: The candy has a strong {aniseed} taste.
e.zh: 这种糖果有浓郁的茴香味。

e.en: He poured a small glass of {anisette} after dinner.
e.zh: 他晚饭后倒了一小杯茴香酒。

e.en: {Anisette} is a sweet, anise-flavored Italian liqueur.
e.zh: 茴香酒是一种甜味的意大利茴香利口酒。

e.en: Wood is {anisotropic}, behaving differently along each grain direction.
e.zh: 木材具有各向异性,沿不同纹理方向表现不同。

e.en: The crystal showed clearly {anisotropic} optical properties.
e.zh: 这种晶体表现出明显的各向异性光学性质。

e.en: Material {anisotropy} affects how stress spreads through the structure.
e.zh: 材料的各向异性影响应力在结构中的传递方式。

e.en: Engineers must account for {anisotropy} when designing composite parts.
e.zh: 工程师设计复合材料零件时必须考虑各向异性。

anjou.t: n. 安茹（法国地区）；安茹梨

e.en: She picked a ripe {anjou} pear from the basket.
e.zh: 她从篮子里挑了一只熟透的安久梨。

e.en: {Anjou} pears stay firm even when fully ripe.
e.zh: 安久梨即使完全成熟也保持紧实。

ankara.t: n. 安卡拉（土耳其首都）

e.en: They flew to {Ankara} for a diplomatic conference.
e.zh: 他们飞往安卡拉参加一场外交会议。

e.en: {Ankara} is the capital of Turkey, not Istanbul.
e.zh: 土耳其的首都是安卡拉,不是伊斯坦布尔。

ankh.t: n. 安卡（古埃及生命符号）

e.en: She wore a small silver {ankh} around her neck.
e.zh: 她脖子上戴着一枚小小的银制安卡十字。

e.en: The {ankh} symbolized eternal life in ancient Egypt.
e.zh: 安卡十字在古埃及象征着永生。

e.en: He twisted his {ankle} during the soccer match.
e.zh: 他在足球比赛中扭伤了脚踝。

e.en: The water came up to her {ankle}.
e.zh: 水深刚到她的脚踝。

e.en: Her {ankles} swelled after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后她的脚踝肿了起来。

e.en: The puppy nipped playfully at his {ankles}.
e.zh: 小狗调皮地咬着他的脚踝。

e.en: She wore a delicate silver {anklet} to the beach.
e.zh: 她戴着一条精致的银脚链去了海边。

e.en: The dancer's {anklet} jingled with every step.
e.zh: 舞者的脚铃随着每一步叮当作响。

e.en: {Anna} just moved to Berlin for her new job.
e.zh: 安娜刚搬到柏林开始新工作。

e.en: Tolstoy's novel {Anna} Karenina remains widely read today.
e.zh: 托尔斯泰的小说《安娜·卡列尼娜》至今仍广受阅读。

e.en: The discovery earned a place in the {annal} of physics.
e.zh: 这一发现在物理学史册上占有一席之地。

e.en: Each {annal} records one year of monastery life.
e.zh: 每一卷年史都记载着修道院一年的生活。

e.en: Her victory secured a spot in the {annals} of tennis.
e.zh: 她的胜利让她在网球史册上留下了一席之地。

e.en: The {annals} of the empire span over a thousand years.
e.zh: 这个帝国的编年史跨越了千余年。

annamese.t:
n. 安南人；越南人
adj. 越南的

e.en: The museum displayed ancient {Annamese} ceramics from Vietnam.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自越南的古代安南陶瓷。

e.en: Scholars studied the {Annamese} dynasty's trade routes.
e.zh: 学者研究了安南王朝的贸易路线。

e.en: They drove through {Annandale} on the way to Edinburgh.
e.zh: 他们前往爱丁堡途中经过了安嫩代尔。

e.en: {Annandale} is a quiet valley in southern Scotland.
e.zh: 安嫩代尔是苏格兰南部一处宁静的山谷。

anneal.t: v. (金属) 退火；韧化处理

e.en: Smiths {anneal} steel to make it less brittle.
e.zh: 铁匠通过退火处理让钢材不那么脆。

e.en: You must {anneal} the glass slowly to prevent cracks.
e.zh: 必须缓慢退火处理玻璃才能防止开裂。

e.en: {Annealing} relieves internal stress in the metal.
e.zh: 退火处理可以消除金属内部的应力。

e.en: Simulated {annealing} is a popular optimization algorithm.
e.zh: 模拟退火是一种常用的优化算法。

e.en: The {Annesley} family donated their archive to the library.
e.zh: 安斯利家族把他们的档案捐给了图书馆。

e.en: Lord {Annesley} once owned the entire estate.
e.zh: 安斯利勋爵曾经拥有整片庄园。

annex.t:
n. 附属建筑；附件
v. 兼并；并入

e.en: The school built an {annex} to house more classrooms.
e.zh: 学校建了一栋附楼用来容纳更多教室。

e.en: The treaty allowed the country to {annex} the territory.
e.zh: 这项条约允许该国吞并那片领土。

e.en: The {annexation} of Crimea drew international condemnation.
e.zh: 对克里米亚的吞并招致国际社会的谴责。

e.en: Many residents protested the {annexation} of their town.
e.zh: 许多居民抗议把他们的镇子并入他城。

annexe.t: n. 附楼；附件（annex 的英式拼写）

e.en: Guests stay in the small {annexe} behind the house.
e.zh: 客人住在房子后面的小附楼里。

e.en: The library's {annexe} holds rare manuscripts.
e.zh: 图书馆的附楼存放着珍贵的手稿。

e.en: Russia {annexed} the peninsula in 2014.
e.zh: 俄罗斯于2014年吞并了那个半岛。

e.en: The kingdom {annexed} several smaller states centuries ago.
e.zh: 这个王国几百年前吞并了几个较小的国家。

annexes.t: n. 附件；附属建筑（复数）

e.en: The hospital has two new {annexes} for outpatient care.
e.zh: 医院新建了两栋门诊附楼。

e.en: The report includes several {annexes} with detailed data.
e.zh: 这份报告附有几个含详细数据的附录。

e.en: The empire spent decades {annexing} neighboring territories.
e.zh: 这个帝国花了几十年时间吞并邻近的领土。

e.en: They are {annexing} the old warehouse to expand the office.
e.zh: 他们正把旧仓库并入办公区以扩展空间。

e.en: A direct hit could {annihilate} the entire base.
e.zh: 直接命中可能会把整个基地夷为平地。

e.en: The team will {annihilate} their rivals in the finals.
e.zh: 那支队伍会在决赛中彻底击溃对手。

e.en: Nuclear war threatens the {annihilation} of entire cities.
e.zh: 核战争威胁着整座城市被彻底毁灭。

e.en: Matter and antimatter meet in mutual {annihilation}.
e.zh: 物质与反物质相遇会发生互相湮灭。

e.en: They celebrate their wedding {anniversaries} with a quiet dinner.
e.zh: 他们每年都用安静的晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。

e.en: The company marks important {anniversaries} with charity events.
e.zh: 公司用慈善活动来纪念重要的周年。

e.en: Today is our tenth wedding {anniversary}.
e.zh: 今天是我们结婚十周年纪念日。

e.en: The museum hosts a special show for its {anniversary}.
e.zh: 博物馆为其周年庆举办了一场特别展览。

anno.t: prep. 于（某年），如 Anno Domini 公元

e.en: The cornerstone is dated {anno} domini 1885.
e.zh: 这块奠基石的日期是公元1885年。

e.en: Latin inscriptions often start with {anno} followed by a year.
e.zh: 拉丁铭文常以"anno"加年份开头。

e.en: Students {annotate} the text to remember key arguments.
e.zh: 学生在文本上做批注以记住关键论点。

e.en: You can {annotate} PDFs directly inside the app.
e.zh: 你可以直接在应用里给PDF做批注。

annotated.t: adj. 已加注释的，已标注的

e.en: She gave me an {annotated} copy of the novel.
e.zh: 她给了我一本带批注的小说。

e.en: The professor {annotated} every page with detailed comments.
e.zh: 教授在每一页都写下了详细的批注。

e.en: Each {annotation} in the margin explains a tricky line of code.
e.zh: 页边每条注释都解释了一行棘手的代码。

e.en: Add an {annotation} to flag this paragraph for the editor.
e.zh: 加个批注，把这段标出来给编辑看。

e.en: The company will {announce} its new phone next Tuesday.
e.zh: 公司将在下周二发布新手机。

e.en: Please {announce} your name clearly when you enter the room.
e.zh: 进屋时请清楚地报上你的名字。

e.en: She {announced} her resignation in a short email.
e.zh: 她在一封简短的邮件中宣布了辞职。

e.en: The airline {announced} a delay of two hours.
e.zh: 航空公司宣布航班延误两小时。

e.en: Apple made a surprise {announcement} at the keynote.
e.zh: 苹果在主题演讲上发布了一个意外消息。

e.en: Did you see the wedding {announcement} on Instagram?
e.zh: 你看到 Instagram 上那条婚讯了吗？

e.en: Check the team channel for important {announcements} each morning.
e.zh: 每天早上去团队频道看重要通知。

e.en: The app sends push {announcements} whenever a new episode drops.
e.zh: 每出新一集，应用就会推送通知。

e.en: The radio {announcer} introduced the next song with a joke.
e.zh: 电台主播用一个笑话引出了下一首歌。

e.en: A famous {announcer} called the championship game last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那场冠军赛由一位著名的解说员解说。

announces.t: v. 宣布（第三人称单数）

e.en: Netflix usually {announces} renewals a few weeks after release.
e.zh: Netflix 通常在剧集上线几周后宣布续订。

e.en: The intercom {announces} every station along the route.
e.zh: 广播会播报沿线的每一站。

e.en: They posted a video {announcing} the baby's name.
e.zh: 他们发了一段视频公布宝宝的名字。

e.en: The CEO is {announcing} layoffs at the all-hands meeting.
e.zh: 首席执行官正在全员大会上宣布裁员。

e.en: Loud notifications really {annoy} me during meetings.
e.zh: 开会时刺耳的通知声真让我心烦。

e.en: Don't {annoy} the cat while she's eating.
e.zh: 猫吃饭时别去烦它。

e.en: Pop-up ads are a constant {annoyance} on free websites.
e.zh: 免费网站上的弹窗广告让人无比烦躁。

e.en: She sighed in {annoyance} when the printer jammed again.
e.zh: 打印机又卡纸了，她烦躁地叹了口气。

annoyances.t: n. 烦恼，恼人之事（复数）

e.en: Slow Wi-Fi is one of the biggest daily {annoyances}.
e.zh: 网速慢是日常最让人头疼的事之一。

e.en: The update fixed a bunch of small UI {annoyances}.
e.zh: 这次更新修复了许多小的界面烦人之处。

e.en: He looked {annoyed} when his phone kept buzzing.
e.zh: 手机响个不停，他显得很烦。

e.en: I'm a bit {annoyed} that no one replied to my message.
e.zh: 没人回我消息，我有点不爽。

e.en: That ringtone is incredibly {annoying} after a few hours.
e.zh: 那个铃声听几个小时真的特别烦人。

e.en: It's {annoying} when autocomplete keeps changing your words.
e.zh: 自动补全老是改你的字真的很讨厌。

annoyingly.t: adv. 烦人地，令人恼火地

e.en: The app is {annoyingly} slow on older phones.
e.zh: 这款应用在旧手机上慢得让人抓狂。

e.en: He was {annoyingly} cheerful at seven in the morning.
e.zh: 早上七点他就开心得让人嫌弃。

annoys.t: v. 惹恼（第三人称单数）

e.en: It really {annoys} me when people talk during movies.
e.zh: 看电影时有人说话真让我烦。

e.en: My sister always {annoys} me by stealing my charger.
e.zh: 我妹老偷我的充电器，真烦人。

annual.t: adj. 年度的，一年一次的

e.en: The company holds an {annual} retreat every spring.
e.zh: 公司每年春天都办一次员工团建。

e.en: My gym membership has a flat {annual} fee.
e.zh: 我的健身房会员是按年统一收费的。

e.en: The fund posted an {annualised} return of nine percent.
e.zh: 该基金的年化收益率为百分之九。

e.en: Inflation hit an {annualised} rate of four percent last quarter.
e.zh: 上季度通胀年化率达到了百分之四。

e.en: Her startup hit ten million in {annualized} revenue.
e.zh: 她的创业公司年化营收达到了一千万。

e.en: The chart shows {annualized} growth over five years.
e.zh: 图表显示过去五年的年化增长率。

e.en: Subscribers can pay monthly or {annually} for a discount.
e.zh: 订阅可按月付费，或按年付费享受折扣。

e.en: The festival is held {annually} in early October.
e.zh: 这个节日每年十月初举办一次。

e.en: He bought an {annuity} to guarantee monthly income in retirement.
e.zh: 他买了一份年金，保证退休后每月有收入。

e.en: An {annuity} pays out a fixed sum for life.
e.zh: 年金会终身按固定金额发放。

e.en: The court agreed to {annul} their brief marriage.
e.zh: 法院同意撤销他们短暂的婚姻。

e.en: Officials voted to {annul} the disputed election results.
e.zh: 官员们投票宣布有争议的选举结果无效。

e.en: We watched an {annular} solar eclipse from the rooftop.
e.zh: 我们在屋顶看了一次日环食。

e.en: The lamp casts a soft {annular} glow on the ceiling.
e.zh: 那盏灯在天花板上投出柔和的环形光晕。

e.en: She filed for an {annulment} instead of a divorce.
e.zh: 她申请的是婚姻无效，而不是离婚。

e.en: The {annulment} of the contract took several months.
e.zh: 撤销那份合同花了好几个月。

e.en: The math problem asked for the area of an {annulus}.
e.zh: 这道数学题要求计算一个圆环的面积。

e.en: Engineers measured the gap inside the metal {annulus}.
e.zh: 工程师测量了金属环形件内部的间隙。

annunciation.t: n. 告知；（宗教）天使报喜

e.en: The painting depicts the {annunciation} in soft golden light.
e.zh: 这幅画以柔和的金色光线描绘了天使报喜。

e.en: Many Renaissance artists painted the {annunciation} scene.
e.zh: 许多文艺复兴艺术家都画过天使报喜的场景。

e.en: The Spanish word "{ano}" means "year" without the tilde.
e.zh: 西班牙语 "ano" 不带波浪号时意思是"年"。

e.en: Be careful not to type {ano} when you mean "año".
e.zh: 想打"año"时小心别敲成了 "ano"。

e.en: The battery's {anode} is usually made of graphite.
e.zh: 电池的阳极通常是用石墨做的。

e.en: Corrosion built up on the metal {anode} over time.
e.zh: 金属阳极上日积月累出现了腐蚀。

anodized.t: adj. 经阳极氧化处理的

e.en: The laptop comes in a sleek {anodized} aluminum finish.
e.zh: 这款笔记本采用了精致的阳极氧化铝外壳。

e.en: He prefers {anodized} parts because they resist scratches.
e.zh: 他更喜欢阳极氧化的零件，因为耐刮。

anodyne.t:
adj. 温和的，不得罪人的
n. 止痛药

e.en: The CEO gave an {anodyne} response that pleased nobody.
e.zh: CEO 给出了一个四平八稳、谁也不得罪的回答。

e.en: Hotel lobbies often play {anodyne} background music.
e.zh: 酒店大堂常播放那种平淡无味的背景音乐。

anoint.t: v. 涂油膏；指定（继承人）

e.en: The board seemed ready to {anoint} her as the next CEO.
e.zh: 董事会似乎准备钦点她为下一任 CEO。

e.en: Priests would {anoint} the king's forehead with holy oil.
e.zh: 祭司会用圣油涂抹国王的额头。

e.en: Critics have {anointed} her the voice of her generation.
e.zh: 评论家把她奉为这一代人的代言人。

e.en: The newly {anointed} champion lifted the trophy proudly.
e.zh: 新加冕的冠军骄傲地高举奖杯。

e.en: The press is busy {anointing} him as the next big thing.
e.zh: 媒体正忙着把他捧为下一个大热门。

e.en: The ceremony included the {anointing} of the new bishop.
e.zh: 仪式包括为新主教施行涂油礼。

e.en: His {anointment} as heir surprised the rest of the family.
e.zh: 他被钦定为继承人，让家里其他人都很意外。

e.en: The {anointment} of a new king was a sacred ritual.
e.zh: 为新国王施行涂油礼是一种神圣的仪式。

anole.t: n. 安乐蜥（一种小型蜥蜴）

e.en: A green {anole} sunned itself on the porch railing.
e.zh: 一只绿色变色蜥在门廊栏杆上晒太阳。

e.en: The {anole} changed color to match the brown fence.
e.zh: 那只变色蜥变了色，与棕色围栏融为一体。

e.en: The sensor flagged an {anomalous} spike in network traffic.
e.zh: 传感器标记出网络流量中一处异常峰值。

e.en: Scientists found {anomalous} readings near the volcano.
e.zh: 科学家在火山附近发现了异常的读数。

e.en: Temperatures have been {anomalously} high all winter.
e.zh: 整个冬天的气温都异常偏高。

e.en: The stock traded {anomalously} low after the earnings call.
e.zh: 财报电话会后，该股价跌至异常低位。

e.en: The dashboard alerts us whenever it detects an {anomaly}.
e.zh: 仪表盘一检测到异常就会提醒我们。

e.en: A warm February is an {anomaly} in this region.
e.zh: 在这个地区，二月里这么暖和算是反常现象。

anomic.t: adj. 社会失范的，缺乏准则的

e.en: The novel paints an {anomic} picture of modern city life.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了现代都市生活的失序图景。

e.en: After the layoffs, the office felt strangely {anomic}.
e.zh: 裁员之后，办公室里弥漫着一种诡异的失序感。

anomie.t: n. 社会失范，道德沦丧

e.en: Sociologists link rising {anomie} to weakening community ties.
e.zh: 社会学家将日益严重的失范感与社区联系减弱挂钩。

e.en: He wrote about teenage {anomie} in the suburbs.
e.zh: 他写过郊区青少年那种迷茫无依的状态。

anon.t:
n. 匿名者（anonymous 缩写）
adv. 不久

e.en: The forum post was signed simply "{anon}".
e.zh: 那条论坛帖子的署名只是"匿名"。

e.en: "I'll see you {anon}," she said with a wink.
e.zh: "待会儿见，"她眨眼说道。

e.en: Different platforms offer different {anonymities} to their users.
e.zh: 不同平台为用户提供不同程度的匿名性。

e.en: The paper compares {anonymities} across major social networks.
e.zh: 该论文比较了各大社交网络的匿名机制。

e.en: The whistleblower was granted full {anonymity} by the reporter.
e.zh: 举报人获得了记者承诺的完全匿名保护。

e.en: VPNs give users a basic layer of online {anonymity}.
e.zh: VPN 为用户提供了一层基本的网络匿名。

e.en: You can leave {anonymous} feedback through this Google form.
e.zh: 你可以通过这个谷歌表单匿名反馈意见。

e.en: An {anonymous} donor gave the school a million dollars.
e.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者向学校捐了一百万美元。

e.en: Employees can report harassment {anonymously} on this hotline.
e.zh: 员工可以通过这条热线匿名举报骚扰行为。

e.en: He {anonymously} tipped off the police about the scam.
e.zh: 他匿名向警方举报了那场骗局。

e.en: Pack a warm {anorak} if you're hiking in the highlands.
e.zh: 如果去高地徒步，记得带件保暖的连帽防风衣。

e.en: He zipped up his {anorak} as the rain started.
e.zh: 雨一下来，他就把防风外套拉链拉上了。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {anorectal} surgery and screenings.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门做肛肠手术和筛查。

e.en: Doctors recommend regular {anorectal} exams after age fifty.
e.zh: 医生建议五十岁以后定期做肛肠检查。

e.en: She has been in recovery from {anorexia} for two years.
e.zh: 她已经从厌食症中康复了两年。

e.en: Early treatment of {anorexia} greatly improves outcomes.
e.zh: 及早治疗厌食症能大大改善预后。

anorexic.t:
adj. 厌食症的
n. 厌食症患者

e.en: The magazine was criticized for showing {anorexic} models.
e.zh: 这本杂志因刊登瘦得厌食症般的模特而受到批评。

e.en: Doctors warned the teen was becoming dangerously {anorexic}.
e.zh: 医生警告说这名青少年已出现危险的厌食症倾向。

another.t:
adj. 另一个，再一个
pron. 另一个

e.en: Could I have {another} cup of coffee, please?
e.zh: 能再给我来一杯咖啡吗？

e.en: That's a problem for {another} day.
e.zh: 那是改天再操心的问题。

anova.t: n. 方差分析（统计学方法）

e.en: We ran an {anova} to compare the three groups' scores.
e.zh: 我们做了方差分析来比较三组的得分。

e.en: The {anova} showed no significant difference between treatments.
e.zh: 方差分析显示各处理之间没有显著差异。

e.en: Brain {anoxia} can cause permanent damage within minutes.
e.zh: 大脑缺氧几分钟内就可能造成永久损伤。

e.en: Deep lake {anoxia} kills most fish at the bottom.
e.zh: 湖泊深处缺氧使底层大多数鱼类死亡。

e.en: The patient suffered an {anoxic} brain injury after cardiac arrest.
e.zh: 患者心脏骤停后出现了缺氧性脑损伤。

e.en: {Anoxic} water at the bottom of the lake supports few organisms.
e.zh: 湖底的缺氧水域几乎养不活什么生物。

e.en: The 1938 {Anschluss} united Austria with Nazi Germany.
e.zh: 1938年的合并将奥地利并入纳粹德国。

e.en: Historians still debate the legality of the {Anschluss}.
e.zh: 史学家至今仍在争论这次吞并的合法性。

e.en: {Anselm} of Canterbury proposed a famous proof of God's existence.
e.zh: 坎特伯雷的安瑟伦提出了著名的上帝存在论证。

e.en: Students still read {Anselm}'s writings in philosophy class.
e.zh: 哲学课上学生们至今仍在阅读安瑟伦的著作。

ansi.t: n. 美国国家标准学会（缩写）

e.en: My terminal supports {ANSI} color codes for colored output.
e.zh: 我的终端支持ANSI颜色码以显示彩色输出。

e.en: The keyboard uses an {ANSI} layout instead of ISO.
e.zh: 这款键盘使用ANSI布局而不是ISO布局。

anstruther.t: n. 安斯特拉瑟（姓氏/苏格兰地名）

e.en: We ate fish and chips at {Anstruther} harbour.
e.zh: 我们在安斯特拉瑟港口吃了炸鱼薯条。

e.en: {Anstruther} is a small fishing village on the Fife coast.
e.zh: 安斯特拉瑟是法夫海岸的一个小渔村。

answer.t:
n. 答案
v. 回答，回应

e.en: Please {answer} the email before you leave today.
e.zh: 请在你今天下班前回复那封邮件。

e.en: I don't know the {answer} to this math problem.
e.zh: 这道数学题的答案我不知道。

answerable.t: adj. 需负责的；可回答的

e.en: The CEO is {answerable} to the board for every decision.
e.zh: 首席执行官每项决定都要向董事会负责。

e.en: Public officials should be {answerable} to the people they serve.
e.zh: 公职人员应当对他们所服务的人民负责。

e.en: She {answered} the phone on the third ring.
e.zh: 电话响到第三声她才接起来。

e.en: He politely {answered} every question from the reporters.
e.zh: 他礼貌地回答了记者们的每一个问题。

answering.t:
v. 回答中
adj. 应答的

e.en: She spent the morning {answering} customer emails.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在回复客户邮件。

e.en: Stop {answering} every text the moment it arrives.
e.zh: 别一收到短信就立刻回。

e.en: Leave a message on the {answerphone} after the beep.
e.zh: 听到提示音后请在留言机上留言。

e.en: I came home to fifteen messages on the {answerphone}.
e.zh: 我回到家发现答录机上有十五条留言。

answers.t:
n. 答案（复数）
v. 回答（第三人称单数）

e.en: The teacher checked everyone's {answers} after the quiz.
e.zh: 小测后老师检查了每个人的答案。

e.en: She rarely {answers} her phone during meetings.
e.zh: 开会期间她很少接电话。

e.en: A tiny {ant} crawled across my laptop screen.
e.zh: 一只小蚂蚁爬过了我的笔记本屏幕。

e.en: The {ant} colony built a huge mound in the garden.
e.zh: 蚁群在花园里筑起了一个大蚁丘。

antacid.t:
n. 抗酸药
adj. 中和胃酸的

e.en: I took an {antacid} after that spicy meal.
e.zh: 吃完那顿辛辣的饭后我吃了一片胃药。

e.en: Chewable {antacid} tablets work faster than liquid forms.
e.zh: 咀嚼型抗酸片比液体型起效更快。

antagonise.t: v. 使敌对，招惹（英式拼写）

e.en: Try not to {antagonise} your manager during the review.
e.zh: 考评期间尽量别去激怒你的上司。

e.en: His sarcastic comments {antagonise} almost everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他那些讽刺话几乎惹恼了房间里所有人。

e.en: There is deep {antagonism} between the two political parties.
e.zh: 两党之间存在深刻的对立。

e.en: Years of {antagonism} between the brothers finally faded.
e.zh: 兄弟俩多年的不和终于消解了。

e.en: The novel's {antagonist} is a brilliant but ruthless billionaire.
e.zh: 小说的反派是一个聪明但冷酷的亿万富翁。

e.en: She emerged as the main {antagonist} in the lawsuit.
e.zh: 她成了这场诉讼中的主要对手。

e.en: He took an {antagonistic} tone throughout the entire interview.
e.zh: 整场面试他都带着对立的口气。

e.en: The two chemicals have an {antagonistic} effect on each other.
e.zh: 这两种化学物质会相互拮抗。

e.en: Don't {antagonize} the customer; just resolve the complaint.
e.zh: 别去激怒客户,把投诉处理好就行。

e.en: His blunt remarks tend to {antagonize} potential allies.
e.zh: 他直白的言论往往会得罪潜在的盟友。

antarctic.t:
adj. 南极的
n. 南极地区

e.en: Scientists drilled deep into the {Antarctic} ice for climate data.
e.zh: 科学家在南极冰层深处钻取气候数据。

e.en: {Antarctic} winds can reach hurricane speeds in winter.
e.zh: 南极的风在冬季可达到飓风级别。

e.en: Only researchers and tourists ever visit {Antarctica}.
e.zh: 只有科研人员和游客会前往南极洲。

e.en: {Antarctica} holds about seventy percent of the world's fresh water.
e.zh: 南极洲拥有全球大约百分之七十的淡水。

ante.t:
n. 底注（赌注）
v. 下注

e.en: Each player must {ante} ten dollars before the cards are dealt.
e.zh: 发牌前每位玩家必须先下十美元的底注。

e.en: The startup raised the {ante} with a bigger funding round.
e.zh: 这家初创公司通过更大规模的融资抬高了赌注。

e.en: The {anteater} uses its long tongue to catch insects.
e.zh: 食蚁兽用长舌头来捕捉昆虫。

e.en: A giant {anteater} can eat thirty thousand ants in one day.
e.zh: 一只大食蚁兽一天能吃下三万只蚂蚁。

antebellum.t: adj. 战前的（尤指美国南北战争前）

e.en: The mansion is a beautifully preserved {antebellum} home.
e.zh: 这座宅邸是一栋保存完好的内战前老宅。

e.en: {Antebellum} Southern society relied heavily on slave labor.
e.zh: 内战前的美国南方社会严重依赖奴隶劳动。

e.en: The court considered the {antecedence} of similar rulings.
e.zh: 法院考虑了类似判决的先例性。

e.en: Logical {antecedence} matters when ordering steps in a proof.
e.zh: 在排列证明步骤时,逻辑上的先后关系很重要。

antecedent.t:
n. 先例；先行词
adj. 先前的

e.en: Every pronoun should have a clear {antecedent} in the sentence.
e.zh: 每个代词在句中都应有明确的先行词。

e.en: Poverty is often an {antecedent} of poor health outcomes.
e.zh: 贫困往往是健康状况不佳的前因。

e.en: Guests waited in the {antechamber} before meeting the king.
e.zh: 宾客们在前厅等候,然后才能觐见国王。

e.en: A small {antechamber} leads into the main gallery.
e.zh: 一间小前厅通向主展厅。

e.en: These cave paintings {antedate} written history by thousands of years.
e.zh: 这些洞穴壁画比文字史早了好几千年。

e.en: Don't {antedate} the contract; use today's actual date.
e.zh: 别把合同日期提前,用今天的实际日期。

e.en: My boss still uses an {antediluvian} flip phone from 2005.
e.zh: 我老板还在用一部2005年的老古董翻盖手机。

e.en: Their views on technology feel almost {antediluvian}.
e.zh: 他们对科技的看法简直像出土文物一样陈旧。

e.en: A herd of {antelope} grazed on the open savanna.
e.zh: 一群羚羊在开阔的草原上吃草。

e.en: The cheetah chased a young {antelope} across the plain.
e.zh: 猎豹在平原上追赶一只小羚羊。

e.en: She attends {antenatal} classes every Tuesday evening.
e.zh: 她每周二晚上都去上产前课。

e.en: Good {antenatal} care reduces the risk of birth complications.
e.zh: 良好的产前护理能降低分娩并发症的风险。

e.en: Adjust the {antenna} to get better TV reception.
e.zh: 调一下天线就能收到更清晰的电视信号。

e.en: The butterfly slowly waved one delicate {antenna}.
e.zh: 蝴蝶轻轻地挥动着一根纤细的触角。

e.en: The beetle's {antennae} twitched as it sensed danger.
e.zh: 甲虫感觉到危险时触角不停地抽动。

e.en: Insects use their {antennae} to smell and feel their surroundings.
e.zh: 昆虫用触角来嗅闻和感知周围环境。

e.en: The {anterior} part of the brain controls decision-making.
e.zh: 大脑前部负责决策功能。

e.en: He tore a ligament in the {anterior} of his knee.
e.zh: 他撕裂了膝盖前侧的一条韧带。

e.en: The tumor had spread {anteriorly} toward the chest wall.
e.zh: 肿瘤已向前扩散至胸壁方向。

e.en: The muscle attaches {anteriorly} to the rib cage.
e.zh: 该肌肉在前方附着于胸廓。

e.en: Reporters waited in the {anteroom} for the press conference.
e.zh: 记者们在前厅等候新闻发布会开始。

e.en: A small {anteroom} separates the office from the hallway.
e.zh: 一间小前厅把办公室和走廊隔开。

e.en: The radiologist took an {anteroposterior} view of the chest.
e.zh: 放射科医师拍了一张胸部前后位片。

e.en: An {anteroposterior} X-ray clearly showed the fractured rib.
e.zh: 一张前后位X光片清楚地显示出肋骨骨折。

e.en: The crowd stood as the national {anthem} began to play.
e.zh: 国歌响起时全场起立。

e.en: That song became the {anthem} of an entire generation.
e.zh: 那首歌成了整整一代人的代表曲。

e.en: The band's new single has a hugely {anthemic} chorus.
e.zh: 乐队的新单曲副歌部分非常具有圣歌般的感染力。

e.en: Her speech ended on an {anthemic} note about hope.
e.zh: 她的演讲在关于希望的振奋呼号中结束。

e.en: The bee brushed against the flower's yellow {anther}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂蹭过了花朵黄色的花药。

e.en: Pollen is produced inside the {anther} of each stamen.
e.zh: 每根雄蕊的花药内部会产生花粉。

e.en: My dog accidentally stepped on a huge {anthill}.
e.zh: 我的狗不小心踩到了一个大蚁丘。

e.en: The kids watched the {anthill} swarm with activity.
e.zh: 孩子们看着蚁丘上蚂蚁忙忙碌碌。

e.en: Blueberries are rich in {anthocyanin}, a powerful antioxidant.
e.zh: 蓝莓富含花青素,是一种强效抗氧化剂。

e.en: {Anthocyanin} gives autumn leaves their deep red color.
e.zh: 花青素让秋叶呈现出深红色。

e.en: The library has several {anthologies} of modern poetry.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏了好几本现代诗选集。

e.en: Her short stories appear in many sci-fi {anthologies}.
e.zh: 她的短篇小说被收录在许多科幻选集中。

e.en: The {anthologist} chose twenty essays for the new collection.
e.zh: 这位选编者为新文集挑选了二十篇散文。

e.en: As an {anthologist}, she favors overlooked women writers.
e.zh: 作为选集编者,她偏爱被忽视的女性作家。

e.en: Editors plan to {anthologize} her best essays next year.
e.zh: 编辑们计划明年把她最好的散文结集出版。

e.en: Few critics expected the magazine to {anthologize} blog posts.
e.zh: 很少有评论家想到这本杂志会把博客文章收入选集。

e.en: I'm reading an {anthology} of contemporary American short stories.
e.zh: 我在读一本当代美国短篇小说选集。

e.en: The streaming service released an {anthology} series of horror tales.
e.zh: 流媒体平台推出了一部恐怖故事单元剧集。

e.en: {Anthracite} burns cleaner and hotter than ordinary coal.
e.zh: 无烟煤比普通煤燃烧得更干净也更旺。

e.en: He chose an {anthracite} gray suit for the wedding.
e.zh: 他为婚礼挑了一套煤灰色的西装。

e.en: Vets vaccinate cattle to protect them from {anthrax}.
e.zh: 兽医给牛接种疫苗以预防炭疽。

e.en: The lab studies {anthrax} spores under strict safety protocols.
e.zh: 该实验室在严格的安全规程下研究炭疽孢子。

anthropic.t: adj. 人类的；与人类相关的

e.en: The {anthropic} principle suggests the universe seems tuned for life.
e.zh: 人择原理认为宇宙似乎是为生命量身调好的。

e.en: Many cosmologists are skeptical of purely {anthropic} explanations.
e.zh: 许多宇宙学家对纯粹的人择论解释持怀疑态度。

e.en: Older science textbooks took a deeply {anthropocentric} view of nature.
e.zh: 早期科学教材对自然抱有深深的人类中心视角。

e.en: Critics call the policy {anthropocentric} and dismissive of wildlife.
e.zh: 批评者认为该政策以人类为中心,漠视野生动物。

e.en: Critics argue that {anthropocentrism} blinds us to animal suffering.
e.zh: 批评者认为人类中心主义让我们对动物的痛苦视而不见。

e.en: Her essay challenges the {anthropocentrism} of mainstream environmental policy.
e.zh: 她的文章挑战了主流环保政策中的人类中心主义。

anthropogenic.t: adj. 人为的；由人类活动造成的

e.en: Scientists link the heatwave to {anthropogenic} climate change.
e.zh: 科学家将这次热浪归因于人为造成的气候变化。

e.en: Coral reefs are dying from {anthropogenic} ocean warming.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁正因人为造成的海洋升温而死亡。

anthropoid.t:
n. 类人猿
adj. 似人的

e.en: The film features an {anthropoid} robot that walks like a human.
e.zh: 这部电影中有一个像人类一样走路的类人机器人。

e.en: Gorillas and chimpanzees are {anthropoid} apes.
e.zh: 大猩猩和黑猩猩属于类人猿。

e.en: She published an {anthropological} study of online dating.
e.zh: 她发表了一项关于网络约会的人类学研究。

e.en: The museum hosts a major {anthropological} exhibit this fall.
e.zh: 博物馆今秋举办一场重要的人类学展览。

e.en: {Anthropologically} speaking, gift-giving builds social trust.
e.zh: 从人类学角度说,送礼能建立社会信任。

e.en: The ritual is {anthropologically} significant across many cultures.
e.zh: 这项仪式在许多文化中都具有人类学意义。

e.en: The library carries dozens of regional {anthropologies}.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏了几十部地区人类学著作。

e.en: Modern {anthropologies} often blend ethnography with digital methods.
e.zh: 现代人类学研究常将民族志与数字方法结合。

e.en: The {anthropologist} lived with the tribe for two years.
e.zh: 这位人类学家与该部落共同生活了两年。

e.en: A young {anthropologist} studies remote work culture in startups.
e.zh: 一位年轻的人类学家研究初创公司的远程办公文化。

e.en: {Anthropologists} are increasingly studying social media communities.
e.zh: 人类学家越来越多地研究社交媒体社群。

e.en: Several {anthropologists} contributed essays to the new volume.
e.zh: 几位人类学家为这本新书撰写了文章。

e.en: She majored in {anthropology} at a small liberal arts college.
e.zh: 她在一所小型文理学院主修人类学。

e.en: Cultural {anthropology} examines how meaning is created in everyday life.
e.zh: 文化人类学研究意义如何在日常生活中产生。

e.en: Designers used {anthropometric} data to size the new chair.
e.zh: 设计师使用人体测量数据来确定新椅子的尺寸。

e.en: The clinic recorded {anthropometric} measurements for every child.
e.zh: 诊所为每个孩子记录了人体测量数据。

e.en: Modern ergonomics relies heavily on {anthropometry}.
e.zh: 现代人体工学在很大程度上依赖人体测量学。

e.en: {Anthropometry} helps engineers design safer car interiors.
e.zh: 人体测量学帮助工程师设计更安全的车内空间。

e.en: The cartoon stars an {anthropomorphic} fox in a suit.
e.zh: 这部动画的主角是一只穿西装的拟人化狐狸。

e.en: Many brands use {anthropomorphic} mascots to feel friendlier.
e.zh: 许多品牌使用拟人化吉祥物来显得更亲切。

e.en: Pet owners often slip into {anthropomorphism} when describing their dogs.
e.zh: 宠物主人在描述自家狗狗时常会陷入拟人化。

e.en: The book warns against {anthropomorphism} in animal research.
e.zh: 这本书警告动物研究中要避免拟人化。

e.en: It's tempting to {anthropomorphize} the robot vacuum.
e.zh: 人们很容易把扫地机器人当成人来看待。

e.en: Children naturally {anthropomorphize} their stuffed animals.
e.zh: 孩子们会自然地把毛绒玩具当作人来对待。

e.en: A bright red {anthurium} brightened the office desk.
e.zh: 一盆鲜红的火鹤花点亮了办公桌。

e.en: The florist recommended an {anthurium} for low-light rooms.
e.zh: 花店推荐火鹤花适合光线较弱的房间。

anti.t:
prep. 反对
n. 反对者

e.en: He's strongly {anti} any new tax increases.
e.zh: 他强烈反对任何新增税收。

e.en: The forum split into pro and {anti} camps overnight.
e.zh: 论坛一夜之间分裂成支持和反对两派。

e.en: The base is protected by modern {antiaircraft} missiles.
e.zh: 该基地由现代防空导弹保护。

e.en: Soldiers manned the {antiaircraft} guns through the night.
e.zh: 士兵们整夜操作着防空炮。

antibacterial.t:
adj. 抗菌的
n. 抗菌剂

e.en: She wiped the counter with an {antibacterial} spray.
e.zh: 她用抗菌喷雾擦拭了台面。

e.en: The soap claims to have strong {antibacterial} properties.
e.zh: 这款肥皂声称具有强效抗菌功能。

antibiotic.t:
n. 抗生素
adj. 抗菌的

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {antibiotic} for the infection.
e.zh: 医生给这次感染开了抗生素。

e.en: Overusing {antibiotic} medicines can create resistant bacteria.
e.zh: 滥用抗生素药物会产生耐药细菌。

e.en: You should finish the full course of {antibiotics}.
e.zh: 你应该把这个疗程的抗生素吃完。

e.en: Many {antibiotics} are losing effectiveness against common infections.
e.zh: 许多抗生素对常见感染的疗效正在下降。

e.en: A blood test can detect {antibody} levels after vaccination.
e.zh: 血液检测可以测出接种后的抗体水平。

e.en: Her body produced a strong {antibody} response within days.
e.zh: 她的身体在几天内产生了强烈的抗体反应。

antic.t: n. 滑稽动作；怪诞举止

e.en: The puppy's latest {antic} sent everyone laughing.
e.zh: 这只小狗最新的滑稽动作把大家逗笑了。

e.en: His {antic} behavior at the meeting embarrassed his boss.
e.zh: 他在会议上的滑稽举动让老板很尴尬。

e.en: Researchers are testing a new {anticancer} drug in trials.
e.zh: 研究人员正在试验一种新的抗癌药物。

e.en: Green tea contains compounds with mild {anticancer} effects.
e.zh: 绿茶中含有具有轻微抗癌作用的化合物。

e.en: The lab develops next-generation {anticancers} from marine sources.
e.zh: 该实验室从海洋资源中开发下一代抗癌药物。

e.en: Several promising {anticancers} are entering phase three trials.
e.zh: 几种有前景的抗癌药物正进入三期临床试验。

e.en: Some preachers warn that an {antichrist} will arise before the end.
e.zh: 一些传教士警告末日前会出现一个敌基督。

e.en: Rivals on the talk show called him a political {antichrist}.
e.zh: 脱口秀上的对手称他为政治敌基督。

e.en: We {anticipate} heavy traffic during the holiday weekend.
e.zh: 我们预计假期周末交通会非常拥堵。

e.en: Good waiters {anticipate} what guests need before being asked.
e.zh: 优秀的服务员会在客人开口前就预料到需求。

anticipated.t:
adj. 预期的
v. 预料（过去式）

e.en: The launch was more successful than anyone {anticipated}.
e.zh: 这次发布比任何人预期的都更成功。

e.en: Fans lined up for the long-{anticipated} sequel.
e.zh: 粉丝们为这部期待已久的续集排起长队。

anticipates.t: v. 预期（第三人称单数）

e.en: The CEO {anticipates} record sales this quarter.
e.zh: 首席执行官预计本季度销售将创纪录。

e.en: The app {anticipates} your next move based on past habits.
e.zh: 这款应用会根据过往习惯预测你的下一步操作。

e.en: She kept refreshing her inbox, {anticipating} a reply.
e.zh: 她不停刷新收件箱,期待着一封回复。

e.en: Investors are {anticipating} a rate cut next month.
e.zh: 投资者正预期下个月会降息。

e.en: The room buzzed with {anticipation} before the show began.
e.zh: 演出开始前,整个房间都洋溢着期待。

e.en: He bought extra snacks in {anticipation} of the storm.
e.zh: 他预料到风暴来临,多买了一些零食。

e.en: Her {anticipations} about college turned out to be wildly off.
e.zh: 她对大学的种种预想结果完全偏离了实际。

e.en: Market {anticipations} of a rate hike sent stocks tumbling.
e.zh: 市场对加息的预期导致股市大跌。

e.en: She felt an {anticipatory} thrill before opening the gift.
e.zh: 她在拆礼物前感到一阵期待的兴奋。

e.en: The team made {anticipatory} hires before the project launched.
e.zh: 团队在项目启动前就提前招聘了人手。

e.en: The revolution had a strongly {anticlerical} streak.
e.zh: 这场革命带有强烈的反教权色彩。

e.en: He wrote {anticlerical} pamphlets criticizing church power.
e.zh: 他写了反教权的小册子批评教会权力。

e.en: {Anticlericalism} spread quickly through nineteenth-century Europe.
e.zh: 反教权主义在十九世纪的欧洲迅速传播。

e.en: The party's roots lie in early twentieth-century {anticlericalism}.
e.zh: 该党的根源在于二十世纪初的反教权主义。

anticlimactic.t: adj. 虎头蛇尾的；令人扫兴的

e.en: After all the buildup, the finale felt {anticlimactic}.
e.zh: 经过那么多铺垫,大结局让人感到虎头蛇尾。

e.en: Their first date was sweet but a little {anticlimactic}.
e.zh: 他们的初次约会很甜蜜,但略显平淡收尾。

e.en: The match ended {anticlimactically} with a missed penalty.
e.zh: 这场比赛以一次罚球失误虎头蛇尾地结束。

e.en: His big speech wrapped up {anticlimactically} after a microphone failure.
e.zh: 麦克风出故障后,他的重要演讲草草收场。

anticlimax.t: n. 虎头蛇尾；令人失望的结局

e.en: The quiet ending felt like an {anticlimax} after the chase.
e.zh: 在追逐戏之后,平静的结局显得虎头蛇尾。

e.en: Winning by default was a real {anticlimax} for the team.
e.zh: 靠对手弃权获胜对球队来说实在扫兴。

e.en: Geologists drilled along the {anticline} hoping to find oil.
e.zh: 地质学家沿着背斜钻探,希望找到石油。

e.en: The exposed rock layers form a textbook {anticline}.
e.zh: 裸露的岩层形成了一个教科书式的背斜构造。

anticlockwise.t:
adj. 逆时针的
adv. 逆时针地

e.en: Turn the lid {anticlockwise} to open the jar.
e.zh: 逆时针转动盖子来打开罐子。

e.en: Runners jogged {anticlockwise} around the track.
e.zh: 跑者沿着跑道逆时针慢跑。

anticoagulant.t:
n. 抗凝血剂
adj. 抗凝血的

e.en: Patients with stents often take an {anticoagulant} daily.
e.zh: 装有支架的患者通常每天服用抗凝药。

e.en: The {anticoagulant} medication helps prevent dangerous blood clots.
e.zh: 这种抗凝药物有助于预防危险的血栓。

e.en: Doctors monitor {anticoagulation} levels with regular blood tests.
e.zh: 医生通过定期验血来监测抗凝水平。

e.en: Long-term {anticoagulation} therapy carries some bleeding risk.
e.zh: 长期抗凝治疗存在一定的出血风险。

anticonvulsant.t: n. 抗惊厥药；抗癫痫药

e.en: Her epilepsy is well controlled by an {anticonvulsant}.
e.zh: 她的癫痫通过一种抗惊厥药得到了很好的控制。

e.en: The new {anticonvulsant} causes fewer side effects than older drugs.
e.zh: 这种新型抗惊厥药比旧药副作用更少。

antics.t: n. 滑稽举动；怪异行为

e.en: The kitten's {antics} make great videos for social media.
e.zh: 小猫的滑稽动作很适合发到社交媒体上。

e.en: Fans adored the comedian's on-stage {antics}.
e.zh: 粉丝们喜爱这位喜剧演员在台上的滑稽表演。

e.en: Her doctor started her on a low-dose {antidepressant}.
e.zh: 她的医生让她开始服用低剂量的抗抑郁药。

e.en: Therapy combined with an {antidepressant} worked best for him.
e.zh: 心理治疗结合抗抑郁药对他效果最好。

antiseptic.t:
n. 消毒剂
adj. 抗菌的

e.en: The nurse cleaned the cut with an {antiseptic} wipe.
e.zh: 护士用消毒湿巾清理了伤口。

e.en: The hotel lobby felt cold and oddly {antiseptic}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂感觉冰冷,带着一种奇怪的消毒气息。

antisera.t: n. 抗血清（antiserum 的复数）

e.en: The lab stores {antisera} for diagnosing several tropical diseases.
e.zh: 实验室储存了用于诊断多种热带疾病的抗血清。

e.en: Researchers tested {antisera} produced from immunized horses.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了由免疫马匹生产的抗血清。

e.en: Doctors administered an {antiserum} immediately after the snake bite.
e.zh: 医生在被蛇咬伤后立即注射了抗血清。

e.en: The veterinary clinic keeps {antiserum} for tetanus on hand.
e.zh: 这家兽医诊所常备破伤风抗血清。

e.en: The {antislavery} movement gained momentum throughout the early 1800s.
e.zh: 反奴隶制运动在十九世纪初不断壮大。

e.en: She wrote passionate {antislavery} pamphlets distributed across New England.
e.zh: 她撰写了在新英格兰各地传阅的激昂反奴隶制小册子。

antisocial.t: adj. 反社会的；不合群的

e.en: He gets {antisocial} after long hours in back-to-back meetings.
e.zh: 他连续开了好几个会后就变得不想社交。

e.en: Vandalism is treated as {antisocial} behavior under local law.
e.zh: 故意破坏在当地法律中被视为反社会行为。

e.en: Technicians wear {antistatic} wristbands when assembling computer components.
e.zh: 技术员组装电脑零件时会佩戴防静电手环。

e.en: This {antistatic} spray keeps your skirt from clinging in winter.
e.zh: 这款防静电喷雾能防止你的裙子在冬天粘身。

e.en: The agency leads {antiterrorism} operations across the region.
e.zh: 该机构在该地区领导反恐行动。

e.en: Congress approved new {antiterrorism} funding this week.
e.zh: 国会本周批准了新的反恐拨款。

antitheses.t: n. 对立面（antithesis 的复数）

e.en: Freedom and tyranny are clear {antitheses} in his book.
e.zh: 自由与暴政在他的书中是鲜明的对立面。

e.en: The two characters serve as {antitheses} of each other.
e.zh: 这两个角色互为对立面。

e.en: Her calm style is the {antithesis} of his chaos.
e.zh: 她沉稳的风格与他的混乱截然相反。

e.en: That product is the {antithesis} of good design.
e.zh: 那个产品与优秀设计完全相反。

antithetical.t: adj. 截然相反的；对立的

e.en: Cheating is {antithetical} to everything our team values.
e.zh: 作弊与我们团队的价值观完全相悖。

e.en: His views are {antithetical} to mainstream economics.
e.zh: 他的观点与主流经济学背道而驰。

e.en: Doctors injected an {antitoxin} to neutralize the venom.
e.zh: 医生注射抗毒素以中和毒液。

e.en: The lab developed a new {antitoxin} for snake bites.
e.zh: 实验室研发出针对蛇咬伤的新抗毒素。
