e.en: We sailed slowly through the {archipelago} off the Croatian coast.
e.zh: 我们沿着克罗地亚海岸的群岛缓缓航行。

e.en: The {architect} unveiled plans for a stunning new concert hall.
e.zh: 建筑师公布了一座惊艳新音乐厅的设计方案。

e.en: She is the chief {architect} behind the company's cloud platform.
e.zh: 她是公司云平台背后的首席架构师。

e.en: The system was {architected} for high availability from day one.
e.zh: 该系统从第一天起就是按高可用性架构设计的。

e.en: He {architected} a modular framework that the whole team adopted.
e.zh: 他设计出了一个模块化框架,整个团队都采用了它。

e.en: The cathedral's {architectonic} details reveal centuries of design evolution.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的建筑构造细节揭示了数百年的设计演变。

e.en: Critics praised the novel's {architectonic} structure and balanced chapters.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这部小说的建筑式结构与匀称的章节安排。

architects.t: n. 建筑师；架构师（复数）

e.en: The {architects} presented three different concepts for the museum.
e.zh: 建筑师们为这座博物馆提出了三种不同的方案。

e.en: Software {architects} usually focus on long-term system design.
e.zh: 软件架构师通常关注系统的长期设计。

e.en: Barcelona is famous for its bold {architectural} style.
e.zh: 巴塞罗那以其大胆的建筑风格闻名于世。

e.en: We need an {architectural} review before scaling the service.
e.zh: 在扩展该服务之前,我们需要一次架构评审。

architecturally.t: adv. 在建筑上，在架构上

e.en: The library is {architecturally} stunning, but very cold inside.
e.zh: 这座图书馆建筑上极为惊艳,但里面非常冷。

e.en: The two services are {architecturally} similar despite different languages.
e.zh: 尽管使用不同的语言,这两个服务在架构上是相似的。

architecture.t:
n. 架构（软件）
n. 建筑，建筑风格

e.en: Tokyo's modern {architecture} blends concrete towers with quiet temples.
e.zh: 东京的现代建筑将水泥高楼与幽静寺庙融合在一起。

e.en: The team is rewriting the backend {architecture} to support more users.
e.zh: 团队正在重写后端架构,以支持更多用户。

e.en: Different chip {architectures} require different compiler optimizations.
e.zh: 不同的芯片架构需要不同的编译器优化。

e.en: The book compares Gothic and Romanesque {architectures} side by side.
e.zh: 这本书将哥特式与罗马式建筑风格作了并列比较。

e.en: A carved {architrave} runs across the top of the temple's columns.
e.zh: 神庙柱顶之上横贯着一道雕刻精美的额枋。

e.en: The painters refreshed the {architrave} above the front doorway.
e.zh: 油漆工重新粉刷了前门门楣上的额枋。

e.en: The newspaper digitized its {archival} photos from the 1970s.
e.zh: 该报纸将其上世纪七十年代的存档照片进行了数字化。

e.en: We use {archival} paper to preserve documents for centuries.
e.zh: 我们使用档案纸来保存文件,可以保留数百年。

archive.t:
v. 归档，存档
n. 档案库

e.en: You can {archive} old emails to keep your inbox clean.
e.zh: 你可以归档旧邮件,让收件箱保持整洁。

e.en: The national {archive} holds millions of historical documents.
e.zh: 国家档案馆收藏了数百万份历史文件。

e.en: The team {archived} the project after launching its successor.
e.zh: 在新项目上线后,团队把这个项目归档了。

e.en: She found {archived} interviews from the 1980s on the website.
e.zh: 她在网站上找到了上世纪八十年代的归档采访。

e.en: Researchers spent weeks digging through the city {archives}.
e.zh: 研究人员花了好几周翻阅市档案。

e.en: The newsletter {archives} every issue automatically on the blog.
e.zh: 这份通讯会自动把每一期归档到博客上。

e.en: We're {archiving} old chat logs to free up storage space.
e.zh: 我们正在归档旧的聊天记录,以释放存储空间。

e.en: {Archiving} historical photos requires careful temperature and humidity control.
e.zh: 归档历史照片需要严格控制温度和湿度。

e.en: The {archivist} cataloged thousands of letters from the war era.
e.zh: 档案管理员为成千上万封战时书信编了目录。

e.en: As an {archivist}, she protects fragile manuscripts from light damage.
e.zh: 作为档案管理员,她保护脆弱的手稿不受光照损害。

e.en: "How original," she said {archly}, rolling her eyes.
e.zh: "真有创意啊,"她故作俏皮地说着,翻了个白眼。

e.en: He smiled {archly} when asked about the office gossip.
e.zh: 被问到办公室八卦时,他狡黠地笑了笑。

archrival.t: n. 头号劲敌，主要对手

e.en: The team finally beat its {archrival} in the championship final.
e.zh: 球队终于在冠军决赛中击败了头号对手。

e.en: Coca-Cola has long viewed Pepsi as its {archrival}.
e.zh: 可口可乐长期以来都把百事可乐视为头号对手。

e.en: They posed for a photo under the stone {archway}.
e.zh: 他们在石拱门下合影留念。

e.en: A leafy {archway} marked the entrance to the secret garden.
e.zh: 一道布满藤叶的拱门标记着秘密花园的入口。

e.en: Sparks were {arcing} from the loose wire near the panel.
e.zh: 配电盘附近松动的电线正打出电弧火花。

e.en: The ball came {arcing} over the fence into our backyard.
e.zh: 球画着弧线越过篱笆,落进了我们的后院。

e.en: The telescope can resolve details smaller than one {arcminute}.
e.zh: 这台望远镜能分辨小于一角分的细节。

e.en: One degree contains sixty {arcminute} units of angle.
e.zh: 一度等于六十个角分。

e.en: The conductor signaled the cellists to play {arco} again.
e.zh: 指挥示意大提琴手重新用弓拉奏。

e.en: After the pizzicato section, return to {arco} immediately.
e.zh: 拨奏段之后立即恢复用弓演奏。

arctic.t:
adj. 北极的
n. 北极地区

e.en: Polar bears roam across the {arctic} ice each winter.
e.zh: 北极熊每年冬天在北极冰面上漫游。

e.en: She wore an {arctic} parka rated for extreme cold.
e.zh: 她穿着一件能抵御极寒的北极派克大衣。

e.en: German tanks pushed through the {ardenne} forest in 1944.
e.zh: 德军坦克于1944年穿越阿登森林发起进攻。

e.en: We hiked the rolling hills of the {ardenne} region.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿越了阿登地区起伏的丘陵。

e.en: She is an {ardent} supporter of climate research funding.
e.zh: 她是气候研究资金的热忱支持者。

e.en: His {ardent} love letters surprised everyone in the family.
e.zh: 他热情洋溢的情书让全家人都感到惊讶。

e.en: Fans cheered {ardently} as the team scored the winning goal.
e.zh: 球迷在球队踢进制胜球时热情欢呼。

e.en: He {ardently} defended his thesis against tough criticism.
e.zh: 他热切地为自己的论文辩护,顶住了严厉批评。

e.en: She approached the project with youthful {ardor} and energy.
e.zh: 她以年轻人的热情和活力投入这个项目。

e.en: His political {ardor} cooled after years of disappointment.
e.zh: 多年的失望之后,他的政治热情逐渐冷却。

e.en: The novel chronicles the {ardors} of revolutionary youth.
e.zh: 这部小说记述了革命青年的种种激情。

e.en: Time tempered the romantic {ardors} of his earlier years.
e.zh: 时间冷却了他早年的浪漫热情。

ardour.t: n. 热情，激情（英式拼写）

e.en: She spoke about her cause with genuine {ardour}.
e.zh: 她以真挚的热忱谈论自己的事业。

e.en: His {ardour} for old films never faded with age.
e.zh: 他对老电影的热情从未随年龄减退。

ardours.t: n. 热情（英式拼写复数）

e.en: The poem captures the {ardours} of first love beautifully.
e.zh: 这首诗优美地捕捉了初恋的炽烈情感。

e.en: Daily routine eventually dulled his earlier {ardours}.
e.zh: 日常琐事最终消磨了他早年的种种热情。

ards.t: n. 急性呼吸窘迫综合征（缩写）

e.en: The {ards} peninsula stretches along the eastern Irish coast.
e.zh: 阿兹半岛沿爱尔兰东海岸延伸。

e.en: We rented a cottage in the {ards} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们在阿兹地区租了一间小屋过周末。

e.en: Climbing the mountain proved more {arduous} than expected.
e.zh: 登上这座山比预想的还要艰苦。

e.en: The {arduous} negotiations dragged on for several months.
e.zh: 艰难的谈判持续了好几个月。

e.en: She {arduously} translated the entire manuscript by hand.
e.zh: 她费尽辛劳地手工翻译了整部手稿。

e.en: The team {arduously} restored the damaged painting over years.
e.zh: 团队历经数年艰辛修复了那幅受损画作。

are.t: v. 是（be 动词复数形式）

e.en: There {are} several new features in this update.
e.zh: 此次更新中有若干新功能。

e.en: You {are} welcome to join us for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 欢迎你今晚加入我们共进晚餐。

area.t:
n. 区域，领域
n. 面积

e.en: This {area} of the city has great coffee shops.
e.zh: 城市这一区有很多很棒的咖啡店。

e.en: Machine learning is her main research {area} now.
e.zh: 机器学习目前是她的主要研究领域。

e.en: The map shows {areal} variation in average rainfall.
e.zh: 地图显示了平均降雨量的区域性差异。

e.en: Geographers study {areal} patterns of population density.
e.zh: 地理学家研究人口密度的空间分布格局。

e.en: Several {areas} of the app still need improvement.
e.zh: 这款应用还有几个方面需要改进。

e.en: Coastal {areas} were evacuated before the typhoon arrived.
e.zh: 台风到来前沿海地区已被疏散。

e.en: The city issued an {areawide} alert about the storm.
e.zh: 市政府就这场风暴发布了全区域警报。

e.en: An {areawide} power outage affected thousands of homes.
e.zh: 一次全区域停电影响了数千户家庭。

e.en: The concert sold out the {arena} within an hour.
e.zh: 演唱会在一小时内卖光了整个体育馆的票。

e.en: She entered the political {arena} after retiring from law.
e.zh: 退出律师行业后,她踏入了政治舞台。

e.en: Major {arenas} across the country host the playoff games.
e.zh: 全国各大体育馆都将举办季后赛比赛。

e.en: Tech and finance are competitive {arenas} for top talent.
e.zh: 科技和金融是争夺顶尖人才的激烈舞台。

e.en: The doctor examined a small rash near the {areola}.
e.zh: 医生检查了乳晕附近的一小片皮疹。

e.en: Pregnancy can darken the {areola} on each breast.
e.zh: 怀孕可能会使乳晕颜色加深。

e.en: In Greek myth, {ares} represented the brutal side of war.
e.zh: 希腊神话中,阿瑞斯象征着战争残酷的一面。

e.en: The temple of {ares} once stood in central Athens.
e.zh: 阿瑞斯神庙曾矗立在雅典中心。

e.en: The puppy let out a tiny {arf} at the mailman.
e.zh: 小狗朝邮递员发出一声小小的汪叫。

e.en: She wrote "{arf}!" in the speech bubble above the dog.
e.zh: 她在小狗上方的对话框里写了一声“汪!”

e.en: {argentina} is famous for its tango, beef, and football.
e.zh: 阿根廷以探戈、牛肉和足球而闻名。

e.en: We flew to {argentina} to hike in Patagonia.
e.zh: 我们飞往阿根廷去巴塔哥尼亚徒步。

argentine.t:
adj. 阿根廷的
n. 阿根廷人

e.en: The {argentine} steakhouse on the corner is always packed.
e.zh: 街角那家阿根廷牛排馆总是座无虚席。

e.en: He grew up speaking {argentine} Spanish at home.
e.zh: 他从小在家说阿根廷西班牙语。

argentinean.t:
adj. 阿根廷的
n. 阿根廷人

e.en: Our {argentinean} guide showed us the best tango bars.
e.zh: 我们的阿根廷向导带我们去了最棒的探戈酒吧。

e.en: She married an {argentinean} musician she met in Paris.
e.zh: 她嫁给了在巴黎认识的一位阿根廷音乐家。

argentinian.t:
adj. 阿根廷的
n. 阿根廷人

e.en: The {argentinian} team celebrated their World Cup victory.
e.zh: 阿根廷队庆祝了他们的世界杯胜利。

e.en: We tried an {argentinian} red wine with dinner last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚晚餐配了一瓶阿根廷红酒。

e.en: {arginine} is an amino acid important for blood flow.
e.zh: 精氨酸是一种对血液循环很重要的氨基酸。

e.en: Athletes sometimes take {arginine} supplements before workouts.
e.zh: 运动员有时会在训练前服用精氨酸补剂。

e.en: {argon} gas fills the space between double-glazed windows.
e.zh: 双层玻璃窗之间填充的是氩气。

e.en: Welders often use {argon} to shield molten metal.
e.zh: 焊工常用氩气来保护熔融金属。

argonaut.t: n. 阿尔戈号船员；冒险者

e.en: Each {argonaut} sailed with Jason in search of the fleece.
e.zh: 每位阿尔戈英雄都与伊阿宋一起出海寻找金羊毛。

e.en: He felt like a modern {argonaut} crossing the Pacific alone.
e.zh: 独自横渡太平洋让他感觉像一位现代的阿尔戈英雄。

argos.t: n. 阿尔戈斯（希腊古城）

e.en: {argos} was a major retailer on the British high street.
e.zh: Argos曾是英国主街上一家大型零售商。

e.en: In Homer's tale, {argos} recognized Odysseus after twenty years.
e.zh: 在荷马的故事里,阿尔戈斯在二十年后认出了奥德修斯。

e.en: Programmers often speak in an {argot} outsiders find baffling.
e.zh: 程序员常说一种外人听来摸不着头脑的行话。

e.en: The novel captures the {argot} of 1920s street thieves.
e.zh: 这部小说还原了1920年代街头小偷的黑话。

arguable.t: adj. 有争议的；可论证的

e.en: It is {arguable} whether the new policy will help workers.
e.zh: 新政策是否能帮到工人,这一点值得商榷。

e.en: She made an {arguable} case for raising the budget.
e.zh: 她为提高预算提出了一个有理有据的论点。

e.en: He is {arguably} the best striker in the league.
e.zh: 他可以说是联赛中最好的前锋。

e.en: This is {arguably} the most important update of the year.
e.zh: 这堪称是今年最重要的一次更新。

e.en: My roommates always {argue} about whose turn it is to clean.
e.zh: 我的室友们总是为该轮到谁打扫而争吵。

e.en: Critics {argue} that the new law goes too far.
e.zh: 批评者认为这项新法律走得太远了。

e.en: She {argued} her case persuasively before the judge.
e.zh: 她在法官面前极具说服力地陈述了自己的主张。

e.en: They {argued} for hours over which movie to watch.
e.zh: 他们为了看哪部电影争论了好几个小时。

argues.t: v. 争论（第三人称单数）

e.en: The author {argues} that remote work boosts productivity.
e.zh: 作者认为远程办公可以提升工作效率。

e.en: He rarely {argues} with his boss in public meetings.
e.zh: 他在公开会议上很少和老板争辩。

e.en: Stop {arguing} and just listen to what she's saying.
e.zh: 别争了,好好听听她在说什么。

e.en: They were still {arguing} about the bill when I left.
e.zh: 我离开时,他们还在为账单争论不休。

e.en: Her {argument} convinced even the skeptics on the panel.
e.zh: 她的论点甚至说服了评审团里的怀疑者。

e.en: We had a small {argument} about where to eat dinner.
e.zh: 我们就去哪儿吃晚饭起了一点争执。

e.en: The course teaches logical {argumentation} and critical thinking.
e.zh: 这门课教授逻辑论证和批判性思维。

e.en: His {argumentation} was clear, structured, and easy to follow.
e.zh: 他的论证清晰、结构分明,易于跟随。

e.en: My brother gets {argumentative} after just one cup of coffee.
e.zh: 我哥哥喝一杯咖啡之后就变得爱抬杠。

e.en: The essay is more descriptive than {argumentative} in tone.
e.zh: 这篇文章的语气更偏描述而非论辩。

e.en: Both sides presented strong {arguments} during the debate.
e.zh: 辩论中双方都提出了有力的论据。

e.en: The function accepts three {arguments} and returns a string.
e.zh: 该函数接受三个参数并返回一个字符串。

e.en: The myth says {argus} had a hundred ever-watching eyes.
e.zh: 神话说阿耳戈斯长着一百只永不闭合的眼睛。

e.en: Security cameras kept {argus}-like watch over the warehouse.
e.zh: 监控摄像头像阿耳戈斯一般守视着这座仓库。

e.en: There was a bit of {argy}-bargy outside the pub last night.
e.zh: 昨晚酒吧外有一点小争执推搡。

e.en: The match ended with some {argy}-bargy between the players.
e.zh: 比赛结束时球员之间发生了一些口角推搡。

e.en: He wore an {argyle} sweater to the office holiday party.
e.zh: 他穿着一件菱形格毛衣参加了公司圣诞派对。

e.en: Golfers often pair {argyle} socks with checkered shorts.
e.zh: 高尔夫球手常把菱形格袜子和格子短裤搭配在一起。

argyll.t: n. 阿盖尔（苏格兰地名）

e.en: We spent a quiet weekend hiking in {argyll}, Scotland.
e.zh: 我们在苏格兰阿盖尔度过了一个安静的徒步周末。

e.en: The castle in {argyll} dates back to the thirteenth century.
e.zh: 阿盖尔的这座城堡可追溯到十三世纪。

e.en: The pathologist identified {argyrophil} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 病理医生在显微镜下识别出了嗜银细胞。

e.en: {argyrophil} fibers stained dark in the prepared tissue sample.
e.zh: 嗜银纤维在制备好的组织样本中染成深色。

e.en: The soprano performed a stunning {aria} from La Traviata.
e.zh: 女高音演唱了一首动人的《茶花女》咏叹调。

e.en: He hummed an {aria} while washing the dinner dishes.
e.zh: 他一边洗晚餐的碗一边哼着一段咏叹调。

ariadne.t: n. 阿里阿德涅（希腊神话人物）

e.en: In the legend, {ariadne} gave Theseus a thread to escape.
e.zh: 传说中,阿里阿德涅给了忒修斯一根线以便逃出迷宫。

e.en: The opera retells the story of {ariadne} on Naxos.
e.zh: 这部歌剧重新讲述了阿里阿德涅在纳克索斯岛的故事。

e.en: The bishop denounced {arian} teachings as outright heresy.
e.zh: 主教谴责阿里乌教派的教义为彻头彻尾的异端。

e.en: Early councils debated {arian} views on Christ's divinity.
e.zh: 早期的大公会议辩论了阿里乌派关于基督神性的观点。

e.en: The soprano performed three famous {arias} at the gala.
e.zh: 女高音在晚会上演唱了三首著名的咏叹调。

e.en: He streams opera {arias} while cooking dinner.
e.zh: 他做晚饭时会播放歌剧咏叹调。

e.en: Cacti thrive in the {arid} climate of the desert.
e.zh: 仙人掌在沙漠干旱的气候中茁壮生长。

e.en: The textbook had an {arid} writing style that bored students.
e.zh: 这本教科书文风枯燥,让学生们感到无聊。

e.en: The {aridity} of the region makes farming nearly impossible.
e.zh: 该地区的干旱使得耕种几乎不可能。

e.en: Critics noted the {aridity} of his recent essays.
e.zh: 评论家指出他近期文章的枯燥乏味。

ariel.t: n. 艾瑞尔（人名）；小羚羊

e.en: My daughter dressed up as {Ariel} for Halloween.
e.zh: 我女儿万圣节时打扮成了爱丽儿。

e.en: {Ariel} is one of the moons orbiting Uranus.
e.zh: 爱丽儿是环绕天王星的卫星之一。

e.en: People born in early April are usually {Aries}.
e.zh: 四月初出生的人通常是白羊座。

e.en: She believes {Aries} are bold and energetic leaders.
e.zh: 她认为白羊座是大胆且充满活力的领导者。

e.en: If I remember {aright}, the meeting starts at noon.
e.zh: 如果我没记错,会议中午开始。

e.en: Few people understood the situation {aright} at the time.
e.zh: 当时很少有人正确地理解这个情况。

e.en: Problems often {arise} when teams fail to communicate.
e.zh: 团队沟通不畅时往往会出现问题。

e.en: New opportunities {arise} from unexpected conversations.
e.zh: 新的机会常常从意想不到的对话中产生。

e.en: Several issues have {arisen} since the software update.
e.zh: 自从软件更新以来出现了几个问题。

e.en: A new generation of artists has {arisen} online.
e.zh: 新一代艺术家已经在网络上崛起。

arises.t: v. 出现（第三人称单数）

e.en: The question {arises} whether this policy is fair.
e.zh: 由此产生一个问题:这项政策是否公平。

e.en: Conflict often {arises} from simple misunderstandings.
e.zh: 冲突往往源于简单的误解。

e.en: We discussed the challenges {arising} from remote work.
e.zh: 我们讨论了远程办公带来的挑战。

e.en: Costs {arising} from the delay will be reimbursed.
e.zh: 因延误产生的费用将获得补偿。

e.en: He dressed like an {aristo} at the costume party.
e.zh: 他在化装舞会上打扮得像个贵族。

e.en: The novel mocks the lazy young {aristo} class.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了懒散的年轻贵族阶层。

e.en: European {aristocracies} lost much power after World War I.
e.zh: 一战后欧洲贵族阶层失去了大部分权力。

e.en: Tech billionaires form the new {aristocracies} of our age.
e.zh: 科技亿万富翁构成了我们这个时代的新贵族。

aristocracy.t: n. 贵族阶层；贵族统治

e.en: The British {aristocracy} once owned most of the land.
e.zh: 英国贵族曾经拥有大部分土地。

e.en: Silicon Valley has its own tech {aristocracy} today.
e.zh: 硅谷如今有自己的科技贵族阶层。

e.en: The young {aristocrat} inherited a sprawling country estate.
e.zh: 这位年轻贵族继承了一座占地广阔的乡村庄园。

e.en: She carried herself like a born {aristocrat}.
e.zh: 她举手投足像个天生的贵族。

e.en: His {aristocratic} accent gave away his elite schooling.
e.zh: 他贵族式的口音暴露了他精英学校的背景。

e.en: The hotel had an old, {aristocratic} charm.
e.zh: 这家酒店有着古老的贵族魅力。

aristophanes.t: n. 阿里斯托芬（古希腊剧作家）

e.en: {Aristophanes} wrote sharp satirical comedies in ancient Athens.
e.zh: 阿里斯托芬在古雅典创作了犀利的讽刺喜剧。

e.en: Students read {Aristophanes} to understand Greek political humor.
e.zh: 学生们阅读阿里斯托芬以了解希腊政治幽默。

e.en: The revolution turned ordinary people against the {aristos}.
e.zh: 革命让普通民众转而对抗贵族阶层。

e.en: Wealthy {aristos} dominated the social scene in Victorian London.
e.zh: 富有的贵族主宰了维多利亚时期伦敦的社交圈。

e.en: {Armoured} vehicles rolled through the city center.
e.zh: 装甲车辆驶过市中心。

e.en: The bank uses an {armoured} van for cash transfers.
e.zh: 银行用装甲车运送现金。

armourer.t: n. 军械士；武器制造者

e.en: The film's {armourer} ensured all guns were safe.
e.zh: 影片的军械师确保所有枪支都安全。

e.en: A skilled {armourer} repaired the soldier's rifle.
e.zh: 一位熟练的军械师修好了士兵的步枪。

e.en: The royal {armouries} hold centuries of weaponry.
e.zh: 皇家军械库收藏着几个世纪的兵器。

e.en: Old {armouries} across Britain now host exhibitions.
e.zh: 英国各地的旧军械库如今举办着展览。

e.en: Soldiers signed out rifles from the {armoury}.
e.zh: 士兵们从军械库领出步枪。

e.en: Patience is a key weapon in a teacher's {armoury}.
e.zh: 耐心是教师武器库中的关键利器。

e.en: Sweat stains showed under his {armpit}.
e.zh: 他腋下露出了汗渍。

e.en: Always apply deodorant to a clean {armpit}.
e.zh: 涂止汗剂前请先把腋下洗干净。

e.en: She rested her elbow on the {armrest}.
e.zh: 她把胳膊肘搁在扶手上。

e.en: The plane seat's {armrest} folds up easily.
e.zh: 飞机座椅的扶手可以轻松收起。

arms.t:
n. 武器；军备
n. 手臂（arm 复数）

e.en: She wrapped her {arms} around the sleepy child.
e.zh: 她伸出双臂搂住困倦的孩子。

e.en: The treaty bans the sale of nuclear {arms}.
e.zh: 该条约禁止核武器的买卖。

armstrong.t: n. 阿姆斯特朗（人名/姓氏）

e.en: Neil {Armstrong} was the first person on the Moon.
e.zh: 尼尔·阿姆斯特朗是登上月球的第一人。

e.en: Louis {Armstrong} revolutionized jazz with his trumpet.
e.zh: 路易斯·阿姆斯特朗用小号革新了爵士乐。

e.en: He joined the {army} right after high school.
e.zh: 他高中毕业后就参军了。

e.en: An {army} of volunteers cleaned up the beach.
e.zh: 一大批志愿者清理了海滩。

e.en: The Battle of {Arnhem} was a major WWII operation.
e.zh: 阿纳姆战役是二战中的一场重大行动。

e.en: {Arnhem} is a charming city in the Netherlands.
e.zh: 阿纳姆是荷兰一座迷人的城市。

e.en: She rubbed {arnica} cream on her sore knee.
e.zh: 她在酸痛的膝盖上涂了山金车药膏。

e.en: {Arnica} is often used to treat bruises.
e.zh: 山金车常用于治疗瘀伤。

e.en: The {Arno} river flows through the heart of Florence.
e.zh: 阿诺河穿过佛罗伦萨的中心。

e.en: We strolled along the {Arno} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时我们沿着阿诺河散步。

e.en: The {aroma} of fresh coffee filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 新鲜咖啡的香气弥漫整个厨房。

e.en: This wine has a rich fruity {aroma}.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒有浓郁的果香。

e.en: The {aromatherapist} blended oils to ease her stress.
e.zh: 芳疗师调配精油帮她缓解压力。

e.en: She trained as an {aromatherapist} after leaving nursing.
e.zh: 她离开护理工作后接受了芳疗师培训。

e.en: She uses lavender {aromatherapy} to help her sleep.
e.zh: 她用薰衣草芳香疗法帮助入睡。

e.en: The spa offers {aromatherapy} sessions every weekend.
e.zh: 水疗中心每个周末都提供芳香疗法服务。

aromatic.t: adj. 芳香的；香气四溢的

e.en: The chef added {aromatic} herbs to the stew.
e.zh: 厨师在炖菜里加入了芳香草本。

e.en: She brewed an {aromatic} cup of jasmine tea.
e.zh: 她泡了一杯香气扑鼻的茉莉花茶。

arose.t: v. 出现、发生（arise 的过去式）

e.en: A heated argument {arose} during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议期间爆发了一场激烈的争论。

e.en: New questions {arose} after the report was published.
e.zh: 报告发布后又出现了新的问题。

around.t:
prep. 在…周围
adv. 到处；大约

e.en: The kids ran {around} the playground for hours.
e.zh: 孩子们在操场上跑来跑去玩了好几个小时。

e.en: The meeting starts {around} three o'clock.
e.zh: 会议大约三点开始。

e.en: Caffeine increases mental {arousal} and focus.
e.zh: 咖啡因能提升精神兴奋度和专注力。

e.en: The film aimed to provoke emotional {arousal}.
e.zh: 这部电影旨在激起情感上的强烈反应。

arouse.t: v. 激起、唤起（情感、兴趣）

e.en: The strange noise began to {arouse} her suspicions.
e.zh: 那奇怪的声音开始引起她的怀疑。

e.en: His speech failed to {arouse} much enthusiasm.
e.zh: 他的演讲未能激起多少热情。

aroused.t:
adj. 被激起的；性兴奋的
v. arouse 的过去式

e.en: The mystery novel {aroused} her curiosity instantly.
e.zh: 那本悬疑小说立刻勾起了她的好奇心。

e.en: His odd behavior {aroused} the neighbors' suspicion.
e.zh: 他古怪的举止引起了邻居们的怀疑。

e.en: The proposal {arouses} strong feelings on both sides.
e.zh: 这项提案在双方都激起了强烈情绪。

e.en: Her music {arouses} a sense of nostalgia.
e.zh: 她的音乐唤起一种怀旧之情。

arousing.t:
adj. 引起兴奋的
v. arouse 的现在分词

e.en: The coach gave an {arousing} pep talk before the match.
e.zh: 教练在比赛前发表了一番振奋人心的动员讲话。

e.en: He left quietly to avoid {arousing} attention.
e.zh: 他悄悄离开以免引起注意。

arp.t:
n. 阿尔普（艺术家姓氏）
n. ARP 协议（地址解析）

e.en: Hans {Arp} was a pioneer of Dada sculpture.
e.zh: 汉斯·阿尔普是达达派雕塑的先驱。

e.en: The synth's {arp} pattern drove the whole song.
e.zh: 合成器的琶音音型贯穿了整首歌。

e.en: She practiced the {arpeggio} slowly on the piano.
e.zh: 她在钢琴上慢慢练习这个琶音。

e.en: The guitarist opened the song with a soft {arpeggio}.
e.zh: 吉他手以柔和的琶音开启了这首歌。

e.en: The court will {arraign} the suspect tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 法庭将于明天上午对嫌疑人进行传讯。

e.en: Prosecutors plan to {arraign} him on fraud charges.
e.zh: 检察官计划以欺诈罪对他提起传讯。

arraignment.t: n. 提审；刑事传讯程序

e.en: He pleaded not guilty at his {arraignment}.
e.zh: 他在传讯时表示不认罪。

e.en: The {arraignment} was scheduled for Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 传讯安排在周五下午进行。

e.en: The Isle of {Arran} is a popular Scottish getaway.
e.zh: 阿兰岛是苏格兰热门的度假胜地。

e.en: We hiked across {Arran} during our summer holiday.
e.zh: 暑假我们徒步穿越了阿兰岛。

e.en: Please {arrange} the chairs in a circle.
e.zh: 请把椅子摆成一个圆圈。

e.en: I'll {arrange} a meeting with the client tomorrow.
e.zh: 我明天会安排与客户会面。

arranged.t:
adj. 事先安排好的
v. arrange 的过去式

e.en: She {arranged} the flowers in a tall vase.
e.zh: 她把花插进了一个高花瓶里。

e.en: We {arranged} to meet at the café at noon.
e.zh: 我们约好中午在咖啡馆见面。

e.en: They reached an {arrangement} on splitting the costs.
e.zh: 他们就分摊费用达成了一项协议。

e.en: The flower {arrangement} brightened up the table.
e.zh: 插花让桌子顿时鲜亮了起来。

arrangements.t: n. 各项安排（arrangement 复数）

e.en: We've made {arrangements} for the airport pickup.
e.zh: 我们已经安排好了机场接机。

e.en: Funeral {arrangements} will be announced later.
e.zh: 葬礼安排稍后会公布。

e.en: The {arranger} adapted the song for a full orchestra.
e.zh: 编曲者把这首歌改编成了全套管弦乐版本。

e.en: She works as an {arranger} for film soundtracks.
e.zh: 她为电影配乐担任编曲。

e.en: He {arranges} weekly book club meetings online.
e.zh: 他每周在网上组织读书会聚会。

e.en: She {arranges} fresh flowers in the lobby every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上在大堂插放新鲜的花。

arranging.t: v. 正在安排（arrange 的现在分词）

e.en: She is {arranging} a surprise party for her sister.
e.zh: 她正在为妹妹筹备一个惊喜派对。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {arranging} files on his desk.
e.zh: 他花了一下午整理桌上的文件。

arrant.t: adj. 十足的；彻头彻尾的

e.en: That's {arrant} nonsense and you know it.
e.zh: 那纯粹是胡说八道,你心里清楚。

e.en: He dismissed the rumor as {arrant} lies.
e.zh: 他斥那谣言为彻头彻尾的谎言。

arras.t:
n. 织锦挂毯
n. 阿拉斯（法国城市）

e.en: The killer hid behind the {arras} in the throne room.
e.zh: 凶手藏在王座厅的挂毯后面。

e.en: A faded {arras} covered the castle wall.
e.zh: 一幅褪色的挂毯遮住了城堡的墙壁。

array.t:
n. 数组（编程）；一系列
v. 排列；部署

e.en: The store offers a wide {array} of fresh produce.
e.zh: 这家店提供种类繁多的新鲜农产品。

e.en: The function returns an {array} of user IDs.
e.zh: 该函数返回一个用户 ID 数组。

arrayed.t:
adj. 排列的；盛装的
v. array 的过去式

e.en: Books were neatly {arrayed} along the wooden shelves.
e.zh: 书籍整齐地排列在木架上。

e.en: Soldiers were {arrayed} in formation across the field.
e.zh: 士兵们列队排开横跨整个原野。

arrays.t:
n. 数组（复数）
v. 排列（三单）

e.en: JavaScript {arrays} can hold values of mixed types.
e.zh: JavaScript 数组可以存放各种类型的值。

e.en: Solar {arrays} cover the entire roof of the warehouse.
e.zh: 太阳能板阵列覆盖了整座仓库的屋顶。

e.en: He fell into {arrears} on his rent payments.
e.zh: 他拖欠了房租。

e.en: The company paid the wages in {arrears} last month.
e.zh: 公司上个月补发了拖欠的工资。

arrest.t:
v. 逮捕；阻止
n. 逮捕；拘留

e.en: Police made an {arrest} outside the bank yesterday.
e.zh: 警方昨天在银行外逮捕了一人。

e.en: The new drug can {arrest} the spread of the disease.
e.zh: 这种新药能阻止疾病扩散。

aristotelian.t: adj. 亚里士多德学派的

e.en: The professor took an {Aristotelian} approach to ethics.
e.zh: 这位教授采用亚里士多德式的方法研究伦理学。

e.en: Medieval scholars relied heavily on {Aristotelian} logic.
e.zh: 中世纪学者非常依赖亚里士多德的逻辑学。

aristotle.t: n. 亚里士多德（古希腊哲学家）

e.en: {Aristotle} tutored Alexander the Great as a young prince.
e.zh: 亚里士多德曾担任年轻王子亚历山大大帝的老师。

e.en: Many philosophy classes still begin with {Aristotle}.
e.zh: 许多哲学课程至今仍从亚里士多德讲起。

arithmetic.t:
n. 算术；算法
adj. 算术的

e.en: Kids learn basic {arithmetic} before moving on to algebra.
e.zh: 孩子们在学习代数之前会先学基础算术。

e.en: The {arithmetic} of the budget simply does not add up.
e.zh: 这份预算的账目根本算不通。

e.en: She spotted an {arithmetical} error in the spreadsheet.
e.zh: 她在电子表格中发现了一个算术错误。

e.en: The puzzle requires careful {arithmetical} reasoning.
e.zh: 这道谜题需要细致的算术推理。

e.en: The numbers are {arithmetically} correct but misleading.
e.zh: 这些数字算术上没错,但具有误导性。

e.en: He explained the result {arithmetically} step by step.
e.zh: 他用算术方法一步步解释了这个结果。

e.en: We hiked the Grand Canyon in {Arizona} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在亚利桑那州徒步游览了大峡谷。

e.en: {Arizona} is known for its hot, dry desert climate.
e.zh: 亚利桑那州以其炎热干燥的沙漠气候而闻名。

e.en: Children love the story of Noah's {ark} and the flood.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢诺亚方舟和大洪水的故事。

e.en: The synagogue's {ark} holds the sacred Torah scrolls.
e.zh: 犹太会堂的约柜里存放着神圣的《托拉》经卷。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Arkansas} for a teaching job.
e.zh: 我表弟为了一份教职搬到了阿肯色州。

e.en: {Arkansas} is famous for its hot springs and forests.
e.zh: 阿肯色州以其温泉和森林而闻名。

e.en: {Arkwright} invented the spinning frame during the Industrial Revolution.
e.zh: 阿克莱特在工业革命期间发明了水力纺纱机。

e.en: History students study {Arkwright} as a textile pioneer.
e.zh: 历史专业的学生将阿克莱特作为纺织业先驱来研究。

e.en: We visited {Arlington} National Cemetery on Memorial Day.
e.zh: 阵亡将士纪念日那天我们参观了阿灵顿国家公墓。

e.en: Many federal workers commute from {Arlington} into Washington.
e.zh: 许多联邦雇员从阿灵顿通勤到华盛顿上班。

arm.t:
n. 手臂；武器
v. 武装

e.en: She broke her {arm} falling off a skateboard.
e.zh: 她从滑板上摔下来摔断了胳膊。

e.en: The research {arm} of the company focuses on AI.
e.zh: 该公司的研究部门专注于人工智能。

armada.t: n. 舰队（尤指大型战舰队）

e.en: The Spanish {Armada} was famously defeated in 1588.
e.zh: 西班牙无敌舰队在1588年遭遇了著名的惨败。

e.en: An {armada} of delivery trucks left the warehouse at dawn.
e.zh: 一支送货卡车大军在黎明时分驶离了仓库。

e.en: An {armadillo} curled into a ball when it sensed danger.
e.zh: 那只犰狳察觉到危险时蜷缩成了一团。

e.en: Texas drivers often spot an {armadillo} along rural roads.
e.zh: 得州司机常在乡间公路上看到犰狳。

e.en: The film depicts an {Armageddon} caused by a giant asteroid.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了由巨大小行星引发的世界末日。

e.en: Investors feared a financial {Armageddon} during the crash.
e.zh: 在股市崩盘期间投资者担心金融末日的到来。

armagh.t: n. 阿马（北爱尔兰地名）

e.en: {Armagh} is one of the oldest cities in Ireland.
e.zh: 阿马是爱尔兰最古老的城市之一。

e.en: We toured the cathedrals of {Armagh} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们参观了阿马的几座大教堂。

e.en: He poured a glass of aged {Armagnac} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他倒了一杯陈年雅文邑白兰地。

e.en: {Armagnac} is a brandy made in southwest France.
e.zh: 雅文邑是法国西南部酿造的一种白兰地。

e.en: The country expanded its nuclear {armament} during the Cold War.
e.zh: 该国在冷战期间扩充了核武库。

e.en: Modern fighter jets carry sophisticated {armament} systems.
e.zh: 现代战斗机配备了精密的武器系统。

armamentarium.t: n. 全套装备（尤指医疗器械）

e.en: Doctors now have a vast {armamentarium} of cancer drugs.
e.zh: 医生现在拥有大量抗癌药物可供使用。

e.en: This software adds another tool to a designer's {armamentarium}.
e.zh: 这款软件为设计师的工具库增添了一件利器。

e.en: He wore an elegant {Armani} suit to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着一套优雅的阿玛尼西装去参加婚礼。

e.en: {Armani} stores are usually located in luxury shopping districts.
e.zh: 阿玛尼专卖店通常位于高端购物区。

e.en: The sculptor built a wire {armature} before adding clay.
e.zh: 雕塑家在添加黏土之前先搭了一个铁丝骨架。

e.en: The motor's {armature} spins between two strong magnets.
e.zh: 马达的电枢在两块强磁铁之间旋转。

e.en: The captain wore a black {armband} to honor his teammate.
e.zh: 队长戴着黑色臂章以悼念他的队友。

e.en: Runners use a phone {armband} during their morning workouts.
e.zh: 跑步者晨练时会使用手机臂带。

armchair.t:
n. 扶手椅
adj. 纸上谈兵的

e.en: Grandpa fell asleep in his favorite leather {armchair}.
e.zh: 爷爷在他最喜欢的皮扶手椅上睡着了。

e.en: He's an {armchair} critic who has never played the game.
e.zh: 他是个从未玩过这游戏的纸上谈兵的批评家。

e.en: Two leather {armchairs} flanked the fireplace in the study.
e.zh: 书房壁炉两侧摆放着两把皮质扶手椅。

e.en: The hotel lobby was filled with plush {armchairs}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里摆满了豪华的扶手椅。

e.en: Several {armed} guards patrolled the embassy entrance.
e.zh: 几名武装警卫在大使馆入口处巡逻。

e.en: She arrived {armed} with charts and detailed research.
e.zh: 她带着图表和详尽的研究资料前来。

e.en: {Armenia} was the first country to adopt Christianity officially.
e.zh: 亚美尼亚是第一个正式将基督教定为国教的国家。

e.en: The food in {Armenia} blends Mediterranean and Middle Eastern flavors.
e.zh: 亚美尼亚的食物融合了地中海和中东的风味。

armenian.t:
adj. 亚美尼亚的
n. 亚美尼亚人/语

e.en: My neighbor speaks fluent {Armenian} with her grandmother.
e.zh: 我邻居能用流利的亚美尼亚语和她奶奶交谈。

e.en: This bakery sells delicious {Armenian} flatbread every morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天早上都卖美味的亚美尼亚薄饼。

e.en: She carried an {armful} of groceries up the stairs.
e.zh: 她抱着满满一抱杂货上楼。

e.en: The toddler brought an {armful} of toys to share.
e.zh: 那个小孩抱着一大堆玩具来分享。

e.en: Volunteers carried {armfuls} of donated clothes to the truck.
e.zh: 志愿者们抱着一抱抱捐赠的衣物送上卡车。

e.en: She gathered {armfuls} of wildflowers from the meadow.
e.zh: 她从草地上采了一抱抱的野花。

e.en: The shirt's {armhole} was too tight to be comfortable.
e.zh: 这件衬衫的袖孔太紧,穿着不舒服。

e.en: Tailors carefully measure each {armhole} before stitching.
e.zh: 裁缝在缝制之前会仔细测量每个袖孔。

e.en: Two {armies} faced each other across the river.
e.zh: 两支军队在河两岸隔河对峙。

e.en: {Armies} of fans waited overnight for concert tickets.
e.zh: 成群的粉丝彻夜等待购买演唱会门票。

arming.t:
n. 武装；配备
v. 武装（现在分词）

e.en: The country is {arming} itself against potential threats.
e.zh: 该国正在武装自己以应对潜在威胁。

e.en: Schools are {arming} teachers with better digital tools.
e.zh: 学校正在为教师配备更好的数字工具。

e.en: The {armistice} was signed at the eleventh hour.
e.zh: 停战协议在最后一刻签署了。

e.en: Both sides agreed to a temporary {armistice} during negotiations.
e.zh: 双方在谈判期间同意暂时停火。

e.en: The museum displayed an {armless} marble statue from Greece.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一尊来自希腊的无臂大理石雕像。

e.en: He prefers an {armless} chair for his small desk.
e.zh: 他喜欢用一把没有扶手的椅子配他的小书桌。

e.en: She wore a silver {armlet} above her elbow.
e.zh: 她在肘部上方戴着一只银质臂环。

e.en: The ancient warrior's bronze {armlet} was on display.
e.zh: 那位古代战士的青铜臂饰正在展出。

e.en: He carried an {armload} of groceries to the kitchen.
e.zh: 他抱着一大堆杂货走进厨房。

e.en: She brought home an {armload} of library books.
e.zh: 她抱了一大摞图书馆借的书回家。

e.en: Grandma stored linens in the antique {armoire}.
e.zh: 奶奶把床单收在那个古董大衣柜里。

e.en: The bedroom features a tall oak {armoire}.
e.zh: 卧室里摆着一只高大的橡木衣柜。

e.en: The knight's {armor} gleamed in the sunlight.
e.zh: 骑士的盔甲在阳光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: Humor is her {armor} against criticism.
e.zh: 幽默是她抵御批评的盔甲。

e.en: An {armored} truck delivered cash to the bank.
e.zh: 一辆装甲运钞车把现金送到了银行。

e.en: The president travels in an {armored} vehicle.
e.zh: 总统乘坐装甲车出行。

armorer.t: n. 军械士；武器制造者

e.en: The medieval {armorer} forged swords for the king.
e.zh: 中世纪的兵器匠为国王打造刀剑。

e.en: On set, the {armorer} handles all weapon props.
e.zh: 在片场,兵器师负责所有武器道具。

e.en: The hall displayed the family's {armorial} bearings.
e.zh: 大厅里展示着家族的纹章徽记。

e.en: He studied the {armorial} designs of medieval knights.
e.zh: 他研究中世纪骑士的纹章图案。

e.en: Several {armories} were converted into museums.
e.zh: 好几座军械库被改造成了博物馆。

e.en: The state's {armories} store National Guard equipment.
e.zh: 该州的军械库存放着国民警卫队的装备。

e.en: Rebels broke into the {armory} to seize weapons.
e.zh: 反叛者闯入军械库抢夺武器。

e.en: Sarcasm is the sharpest tool in his {armory}.
e.zh: 讽刺是他武器库里最锋利的工具。

armour.t: n. 盔甲；装甲（英式拼写）

e.en: The museum displays a full suit of medieval {armour}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一整套中世纪盔甲。

e.en: Confidence is her best {armour} in negotiations.
e.zh: 自信是她在谈判中最好的盔甲。

e.en: Shoplifting is an {arrestable} offense in this state.
e.zh: 在本州,入店行窃属于可逮捕的罪行。

e.en: The protest leaders committed several {arrestable} acts.
e.zh: 抗议领袖实施了多项可被逮捕的行为。

arrested.t:
adj. 被逮捕的
v. 逮捕（过去式）

e.en: Two suspects were {arrested} at the airport this morning.
e.zh: 两名嫌疑人今天上午在机场被捕。

e.en: The treatment {arrested} the tumor's growth completely.
e.zh: 该疗法完全阻止了肿瘤的生长。

e.en: The {arrestee} requested a lawyer before answering questions.
e.zh: 被捕者在回答问题前要求请律师。

e.en: Officers read the {arrestee} his rights at the scene.
e.zh: 警察在现场向被捕者宣读了权利。

arresting.t:
adj. 引人注目的
v. 逮捕（现在分词）

e.en: She wore an {arresting} red dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一件惊艳的红裙子去派对。

e.en: The film opens with an {arresting} desert landscape.
e.zh: 影片以一片震撼的沙漠风光开场。

arrestingly.t: adv. 显著地，引人注目地

e.en: The novel is {arrestingly} honest about modern friendship.
e.zh: 这部小说对现代友谊的描写真实得令人震撼。

e.en: Her voice was {arrestingly} clear in the quiet hall.
e.zh: 她的声音在寂静的大厅里清晰得引人注目。

arrests.t:
n. 逮捕（复数）
v. 逮捕（第三人称单数）

e.en: Police made dozens of {arrests} during the protest.
e.zh: 警方在抗议期间逮捕了数十人。

e.en: The medication {arrests} hair loss in most patients.
e.zh: 这种药物能阻止大多数患者的脱发。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with a mild heart {arrhythmia}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有轻度心律失常。

e.en: His smartwatch detected an irregular {arrhythmia} last night.
e.zh: 他的智能手表昨晚检测到心律不齐。

arrhythmic.t: adj. 心律不齐的；无节奏的

e.en: The patient's pulse was weak and {arrhythmic}.
e.zh: 病人的脉搏微弱且不规律。

e.en: The drummer played a deliberately {arrhythmic} beat.
e.zh: 鼓手故意打出不规则的节奏。

arrival.t: n. 抵达；到达的人或物

e.en: Please show your passport on {arrival} at the airport.
e.zh: 请在抵达机场时出示护照。

e.en: The {arrival} of spring brought everyone outdoors.
e.zh: 春天的到来让人们都涌向户外。

e.en: Check the screen for international flight {arrivals}.
e.zh: 请查看屏幕上的国际航班到达信息。

e.en: The store features new {arrivals} every Friday.
e.zh: 这家店每周五上新。

e.en: Your package will {arrive} by Tuesday afternoon.
e.zh: 您的包裹将在周二下午送达。

e.en: We need to {arrive} at a decision by Friday.
e.zh: 我们必须在周五前作出决定。

e.en: The guests {arrived} just as dinner was served.
e.zh: 客人们正好在开饭时到达。

e.en: Smartphones have {arrived} in nearly every household.
e.zh: 智能手机已进入几乎每个家庭。

arrives.t: v. 到达（第三人称单数）

e.en: The morning train {arrives} at platform three.
e.zh: 晨间列车在三号站台到站。

e.en: Spring {arrives} late in this mountain region.
e.zh: 这个山区的春天来得比较晚。

e.en: Passengers {arriving} from Tokyo should proceed to gate B.
e.zh: 从东京到达的乘客请前往B登机口。

e.en: New shipments are {arriving} at the warehouse daily.
e.zh: 新货每天都在抵达仓库。

e.en: The old families dismissed him as a vulgar {arriviste}.
e.zh: 那些老牌家族把他视为庸俗的暴发户。

e.en: She refused to be labeled an {arriviste} in society circles.
e.zh: 她拒绝被社交圈贴上暴发户的标签。

e.en: His {arrogance} made teamwork nearly impossible.
e.zh: 他的傲慢让团队合作几乎无法进行。

e.en: The startup's {arrogance} cost it several major clients.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的傲慢让它失去了几个大客户。

e.en: The new manager came across as cold and {arrogant}.
e.zh: 新经理给人的印象是冷漠又傲慢。

e.en: Don't be {arrogant} just because you got promoted.
e.zh: 别因为升职就变得目中无人。

e.en: He {arrogantly} dismissed every suggestion from the team.
e.zh: 他傲慢地否决了团队的每一条建议。

e.en: She walked {arrogantly} past the waiting customers.
e.zh: 她傲慢地从等候的顾客身旁走过。

e.en: The CEO tried to {arrogate} all decision-making authority.
e.zh: 这位CEO试图独揽所有决策权。

e.en: No single agency should {arrogate} powers over the internet.
e.zh: 任何机构都不应擅自将互联网管辖权据为己有。

e.en: She lives in the trendy eleventh {arrondissement} of Paris.
e.zh: 她住在巴黎时髦的第十一区。

e.en: Each {arrondissement} has its own town hall and mayor.
e.zh: 每个区都有自己的市政厅和区长。

e.en: Click the back {arrow} to return to the previous page.
e.zh: 点击返回箭头回到上一页。

e.en: The hunter notched an {arrow} into his bow.
e.zh: 猎人将一支箭搭上了弓。

e.en: Archaeologists unearthed a stone {arrowhead} near the river.
e.zh: 考古学家在河边出土了一枚石箭头。

e.en: The logo features a sleek silver {arrowhead} design.
e.zh: 该标志采用了流畅的银色箭头造型。

e.en: Use {arrowroot} instead of cornstarch to thicken the sauce.
e.zh: 用葛粉代替玉米淀粉来勾芡酱汁。

e.en: The biscuits were made with {arrowroot} flour.
e.zh: 这些饼干是用葛粉制成的。

e.en: Follow the green {arrows} to reach the exit.
e.zh: 沿着绿色箭头就能到达出口。

e.en: The archer fired three {arrows} in quick succession.
e.zh: 弓箭手连续快速射出三支箭。

e.en: The medieval {arrowsmith} crafted hundreds of arrows weekly.
e.zh: 这位中世纪的箭匠每周制作数百支箭。

e.en: Few villages still have a working {arrowsmith} today.
e.zh: 如今很少有村庄还有真正的箭匠。

e.en: Heavy rain quickly filled the dry {arroyo} with water.
e.zh: 暴雨很快让干涸的旱谷涨满了水。

e.en: They camped beside a shallow desert {arroyo}.
e.zh: 他们在一条浅浅的沙漠干河旁扎营。

e.en: The phrase "{ars} longa, vita brevis" means art is long.
e.zh: "艺术长存,人生短暂"中的ars意为艺术。

e.en: Latin students often memorize the line "{ars} amatoria."
e.zh: 拉丁文学生常背诵"爱的艺术"这一名句。

arse.t: n. 屁股（英式粗俗用语）

e.en: He fell on his {arse} trying to skateboard.
e.zh: 他玩滑板时一屁股摔在地上。

e.en: Stop being such an {arse} to the waiter.
e.zh: 别再对服务员那么混蛋了。

e.en: Don't be an {arsehole} about the parking spot.
e.zh: 别为了一个停车位那么混蛋。

e.en: Her ex turned out to be a real {arsehole}.
e.zh: 她的前任原来是个十足的混蛋。

e.en: The chef has an impressive {arsenal} of kitchen knives.
e.zh: 这位厨师拥有令人惊叹的一整套厨刀。

e.en: Police seized an entire {arsenal} from the basement.
e.zh: 警方从地下室查获了整批军火。

e.en: Old orchards still contain lead {arsenate} in the soil.
e.zh: 老果园的土壤里仍残留着砷酸铅。

e.en: The lab tested the sample for calcium {arsenate} residues.
e.zh: 实验室检测了样品中的砷酸钙残留。

e.en: Trace amounts of {arsenic} were found in the well water.
e.zh: 井水中检测出微量的砷。

e.en: In Victorian novels, killers often used {arsenic} as poison.
e.zh: 在维多利亚时代小说里,凶手常用砒霜作毒药。

arsenical.t:
adj. 含砷的
n. 含砷药剂

e.en: The factory once produced {arsenical} pesticides for cotton.
e.zh: 这家工厂曾生产用于棉田的含砷农药。

e.en: Doctors warned about the {arsenical} contamination of the soil.
e.zh: 医生警告土壤受到了砷化合物的污染。

e.en: Gallium {arsenide} is widely used in high-speed electronics.
e.zh: 砷化镓被广泛用于高速电子器件。

e.en: Solar cells often contain a thin layer of {arsenide}.
e.zh: 太阳能电池常含有一层薄薄的砷化物。

e.en: Investigators believe the warehouse fire was {arson}.
e.zh: 调查人员认为这场仓库火灾是纵火所致。

e.en: He was charged with {arson} after the building burned down.
e.zh: 大楼被烧毁后,他被控纵火罪。

e.en: Police are still searching for the serial {arsonist}.
e.zh: 警方仍在追捕这名连环纵火犯。

e.en: The {arsonist} was caught on the warehouse security camera.
e.zh: 纵火犯被仓库的监控摄像头拍了下来。

e.en: She studied modern {art} at university in New York.
e.zh: 她在纽约的大学学习现代艺术。

e.en: Cooking pasta well is something of an {art}.
e.zh: 把意面煮得好,本身就是一门艺术。

e.en: Commedia dell'{arte} influenced European theater for centuries.
e.zh: 即兴喜剧影响了欧洲戏剧数百年。

e.en: The museum's wing on commedia dell'{arte} reopened today.
e.zh: 博物馆关于即兴喜剧的展厅今天重新开放。

artefact.t: n. 手工艺品；文物（= artifact）

e.en: The museum displayed a rare bronze {artefact} from Egypt.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自埃及的稀有青铜文物。

e.en: That dark line is just a scanning {artefact}, not a tumor.
e.zh: 那条黑线只是扫描伪影,并不是肿瘤。

e.en: The shadow on the X-ray was purely {artefactual}.
e.zh: X光片上的阴影纯属伪影造成的。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the pattern was real or {artefactual}.
e.zh: 研究人员争论这一图样是真实的还是伪影。

artemis.t: n. 阿尔忒弥斯（希腊月亮与狩猎女神）

e.en: NASA's {Artemis} program aims to return humans to the Moon.
e.zh: NASA的阿耳忒弥斯计划旨在让人类重返月球。

e.en: In Greek myth, {Artemis} was the goddess of the hunt.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,阿耳忒弥斯是狩猎女神。

e.en: The garden bed was edged with silvery {artemisia}.
e.zh: 花圃边缘种着银白色的蒿属植物。

e.en: {Artemisia} is the source of an important antimalarial drug.
e.zh: 青蒿属植物是一种重要抗疟药的来源。

e.en: Doctors monitored his {arterial} blood pressure overnight.
e.zh: 医生整夜监测他的动脉血压。

e.en: This highway is a major {arterial} route into the city.
e.zh: 这条高速公路是进入市区的主干道。

e.en: Cholesterol can slowly clog the {arteries} over time.
e.zh: 胆固醇会随着时间慢慢堵塞动脉。

e.en: The city's main {arteries} were jammed with rush-hour traffic.
e.zh: 城市的主干道在高峰期堵得水泄不通。

e.en: The cardiologist ordered an {arteriography} to locate the blockage.
e.zh: 心脏科医生开了动脉造影以查明阻塞位置。

e.en: {Arteriography} clearly showed the narrowed coronary vessel.
e.zh: 动脉造影清楚地显示出狭窄的冠状血管。

e.en: His grandfather suffered from advanced {arteriosclerosis}.
e.zh: 他的祖父患有严重的动脉硬化。

e.en: Diet and exercise can slow the progression of {arteriosclerosis}.
e.zh: 饮食和运动能减缓动脉硬化的进展。

e.en: Surgeons repaired the patient's {arteriovenous} malformation.
e.zh: 外科医生修复了患者的动静脉畸形。

e.en: Dialysis patients often need an {arteriovenous} fistula.
e.zh: 透析患者常常需要建立动静脉瘘。

e.en: The surgeon carefully repaired the damaged {artery}.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地修复了受损的动脉。

e.en: Main Street is the commercial {artery} of our town.
e.zh: 主街是我们镇的商业大动脉。

e.en: The farm draws water from a deep {artesian} well.
e.zh: 这个农场从一口深的自流井取水。

e.en: Pressure forces the {artesian} spring to flow naturally upward.
e.zh: 压力使这股自流泉自然向上涌出。

e.en: She gave an {artful} answer that dodged the real question.
e.zh: 她给出一个巧妙的回答,避开了真正的问题。

e.en: The chef arranged the dessert in an {artful} pattern.
e.zh: 厨师把甜点摆成一个精美的图案。

e.en: He {artfully} steered the conversation away from politics.
e.zh: 他巧妙地把话题从政治上引开。

e.en: The flowers were {artfully} arranged in a tall vase.
e.zh: 鲜花被精心地插在一只高花瓶里。

e.en: Her {artfulness} in negotiations impressed the whole team.
e.zh: 她在谈判中的机敏给整个团队留下了深刻印象。

e.en: There was a quiet {artfulness} to the film's editing.
e.zh: 这部电影的剪辑有一种含蓄的巧思。

arthritic.t:
adj. 患关节炎的
n. 关节炎患者

e.en: My grandmother's {arthritic} fingers ache in cold weather.
e.zh: 我祖母患关节炎的手指在冷天会疼。

e.en: The old dog moved slowly on its {arthritic} legs.
e.zh: 那只老狗用患关节炎的腿慢慢地走着。

e.en: She takes medication daily to manage her {arthritis}.
e.zh: 她每天服药来控制她的关节炎。

e.en: Cold mornings make his {arthritis} flare up badly.
e.zh: 寒冷的早晨会让他的关节炎严重发作。

e.en: He recovered quickly after his hip {arthroplasty} surgery.
e.zh: 他做完髋关节置换手术后恢复得很快。

e.en: Knee {arthroplasty} can dramatically improve a patient's mobility.
e.zh: 膝关节置换术可以大幅改善患者的活动能力。

e.en: Spiders are the most diverse {arthropod} group on land.
e.zh: 蜘蛛是陆地上种类最丰富的节肢动物类群。

e.en: Every {arthropod} has a segmented body and jointed legs.
e.zh: 每种节肢动物都有分节的身体和有关节的腿。

e.en: The doctor recommended {arthroscopy} to examine the torn ligament.
e.zh: 医生建议做关节镜检查来查看撕裂的韧带。

e.en: Knee {arthroscopy} usually requires only a small incision.
e.zh: 膝关节镜手术通常只需要一个小切口。

e.en: The novel retells classic {arthurian} legends from Merlin's perspective.
e.zh: 这本小说从梅林的视角重述了经典的亚瑟王传说。

e.en: She studies {arthurian} romance literature at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究亚瑟王传奇文学。

e.en: The kids shortened "artichoke" to {arti} as a nickname.
e.zh: 孩子们把"洋蓟"简称为"arti"作为昵称。

e.en: In the recipe app, {arti} is slang for artichoke.
e.zh: 在这个菜谱应用里,"arti"是洋蓟的俚语说法。

artic.t: n. 铰接式卡车（articulated lorry 缩写）

e.en: A massive {artic} blocked the narrow village road.
e.zh: 一辆巨大的铰接式卡车堵住了狭窄的村道。

e.en: The driver carefully reversed the {artic} into the loading bay.
e.zh: 司机小心地把铰接卡车倒进装货区。

e.en: She steamed an {artichoke} and served it with butter.
e.zh: 她蒸了一个洋蓟,配黄油上桌。

e.en: Spinach and {artichoke} dip is everyone's favorite at parties.
e.zh: 菠菜洋蓟酱是派对上人人都爱的小食。

e.en: I read a fascinating {article} about deep-sea creatures today.
e.zh: 我今天读了一篇关于深海生物的精彩文章。

e.en: Every {article} in the contract was carefully reviewed.
e.zh: 合同中的每一条款都经过仔细审查。

articled.t: adj. 签约见习的（如见习律师）

e.en: She {articled} at a top law firm after graduation.
e.zh: 她毕业后在一家顶尖律所做实习律师。

e.en: Young accountants often spend years {articled} to senior partners.
e.zh: 年轻会计师常常要在高级合伙人手下当几年学徒。

e.en: The website publishes new {articles} every weekday morning.
e.zh: 该网站每个工作日早上都会发布新文章。

e.en: Please pack your personal {articles} into the gray bin.
e.zh: 请把你的个人物品放进灰色的箱子里。

articulacy.t: n. 口齿清晰、善于表达

e.en: Her {articulacy} under pressure made her a great spokesperson.
e.zh: 她在压力下的清晰表达使她成为出色的发言人。

e.en: The debate coach helps students develop their {articulacy}.
e.zh: 辩论教练帮助学生提升他们的口才表达力。

e.en: The injury damaged the {articular} cartilage in his knee.
e.zh: 这次受伤损坏了他膝盖里的关节软骨。

e.en: Doctors examined the {articular} surface using an MRI scan.
e.zh: 医生通过核磁共振扫描检查了关节面。

articulate.t:
v. 清晰表达
adj. 口齿清楚的

e.en: She is {articulate} and confident in every interview.
e.zh: 她在每次面试中都表达清晰、充满自信。

e.en: Try to {articulate} exactly what's bothering you about the design.
e.zh: 请清楚地说出这个设计哪里让你不满意。

articulated.t:
adj. 铰接的（如挂车）
v. 清晰表达(过去式)

e.en: He {articulated} his concerns clearly during the team meeting.
e.zh: 他在团队会议上清楚地表达了自己的担忧。

e.en: An {articulated} bus bends in the middle to turn corners.
e.zh: 铰接式公交车通过中间弯折来转弯。

articulately.t: adv. 清晰地、有条理地表达

e.en: She spoke {articulately} about the challenges facing small businesses.
e.zh: 她清晰流畅地谈论了小企业面临的挑战。

e.en: The witness answered each question {articulately} and calmly.
e.zh: 证人清楚而冷静地回答了每一个问题。

articulateness.t: n. 表达清晰、口齿伶俐

e.en: His {articulateness} on complex topics earned widespread respect.
e.zh: 他对复杂话题的清晰阐述赢得了广泛的尊重。

e.en: The teacher praised the student's {articulateness} during the debate.
e.zh: 老师称赞了那位学生在辩论中的表达能力。

articulates.t: v. 清晰表达（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new policy {articulates} our commitment to sustainability.
e.zh: 这项新政策清楚地表明了我们对可持续发展的承诺。

e.en: A skilled lawyer {articulates} arguments with precision and clarity.
e.zh: 一位优秀的律师能精准而清晰地阐述论点。

e.en: He had trouble {articulating} his feelings after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后他难以表达自己的感受。

e.en: The CEO is good at {articulating} a long-term vision.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官擅长清晰地表达长远愿景。

articulation.t: n. 清晰表达；发音；关节连接

e.en: Her clear {articulation} makes the podcast easy to follow.
e.zh: 她清晰的发音让这个播客很容易听懂。

e.en: The plan needs better {articulation} of its core goals.
e.zh: 这个计划需要更清楚地阐明其核心目标。

articulations.t: n. 表达；关节连接（复数）

e.en: The robot's joint {articulations} allow smooth, lifelike movement.
e.zh: 这个机器人的关节连接让动作流畅而逼真。

e.en: Her {articulations} of the proposal won over the skeptics.
e.zh: 她对该提案的清晰阐述说服了那些持怀疑态度的人。

articulator.t: n. 发音器官；清晰表达者

e.en: The tongue is the most flexible {articulator} in human speech.
e.zh: 舌头是人类语音中最灵活的发音器官。

e.en: She is a powerful {articulator} of progressive ideas.
e.zh: 她是进步思想的有力阐述者。

e.en: Speech therapists analyze {articulatory} patterns to diagnose pronunciation issues.
e.zh: 言语治疗师通过分析发音模式来诊断发音问题。

e.en: The course covers {articulatory} phonetics in great detail.
e.zh: 这门课程非常详细地讲解了发音语音学。

artifact.t: n. 文物、人工制品；（数据中的）伪影

e.en: The museum displayed an ancient bronze {artifact} from China.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自中国的古代青铜文物。

e.en: That blurry shadow is just a compression {artifact} in the video.
e.zh: 那个模糊的阴影只是视频里的压缩伪影。

artifacts.t: n. 文物、人工制品（复数）

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered hundreds of {artifacts} at the dig site.
e.zh: 考古学家在发掘现场发现了数百件文物。

e.en: The image had visible JPEG {artifacts} around sharp edges.
e.zh: 图像在锐利的边缘附近有明显的 JPEG 压缩痕迹。

artifactual.t: adj. 人工制品的；伪影的

e.en: The strange noise in the recording is purely {artifactual}.
e.zh: 录音里那个奇怪的杂音纯粹是设备伪影造成的。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the pattern was real or {artifactual}.
e.zh: 研究者们争论这个图样是真实的还是伪影造成的。

e.en: Her smile felt like pure {artifice} rather than warmth.
e.zh: 她的微笑感觉纯粹是装出来的,毫无温暖。

e.en: The film succeeds despite all its theatrical {artifice}.
e.zh: 尽管充满戏剧化的人为雕琢,这部电影依然成功。

e.en: A skilled {artificer} crafted the silver clasp by hand.
e.zh: 一位手艺精湛的工匠手工打造了这枚银扣。

e.en: In the game, the {artificer} class builds magical gadgets.
e.zh: 在游戏中,工匠职业可以制作魔法装置。

e.en: The novelist relies on clever {artifices} to keep readers guessing.
e.zh: 这位小说家靠巧妙的写作手法让读者一直猜不透。

e.en: Politicians often use rhetorical {artifices} to dodge tough questions.
e.zh: 政客经常用修辞手段来回避棘手的问题。

artificial.t: adj. 人造的、人工的；虚假的

e.en: This drink contains no {artificial} colors or preservatives.
e.zh: 这款饮料不含人工色素或防腐剂。

e.en: Many companies are investing heavily in {artificial} intelligence.
e.zh: 许多公司在大力投资人工智能。

e.en: The {artificiality} of reality TV bothers some viewers.
e.zh: 真人秀的人为做作让一些观众感到反感。

e.en: Critics complained about the {artificiality} of the dialogue.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨这些对白显得很不自然。

e.en: The fruit was ripened {artificially} using ethylene gas.
e.zh: 这些水果是用乙烯气体人工催熟的。

e.en: Prices have been {artificially} inflated by recent shortages.
e.zh: 价格因为最近的短缺被人为地抬高了。

e.en: Heavy {artillery} fire echoed across the valley all night.
e.zh: 重炮的炮火声整夜在山谷中回荡。

e.en: The army deployed modern {artillery} along the eastern border.
e.zh: 军队在东部边境部署了现代化的火炮。

e.en: Each {artilleryman} was trained to load the cannon quickly.
e.zh: 每位炮兵都受过快速装填火炮的训练。

e.en: The veteran {artilleryman} shared stories from his service days.
e.zh: 那位老兵炮手分享了他服役时的故事。

e.en: A local {artisan} hand-stitches every leather wallet in the shop.
e.zh: 店里每个皮夹都是当地工匠手工缝制的。

e.en: The bakery sells fresh {artisan} bread every morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天早上出售新鲜的手工面包。

artisanal.t: adj. 手工制作的（如手工面包）

e.en: This café serves {artisanal} coffee from a single farm.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应来自单一农场的精品手工咖啡。

e.en: She started an {artisanal} cheese business in the countryside.
e.zh: 她在乡下开了一家手工奶酪生意。

e.en: The young {artist} sold her first painting last week.
e.zh: 这位年轻的艺术家上周卖出了她的第一幅画。

e.en: Every tattoo {artist} at this studio has years of experience.
e.zh: 这家工作室的每位纹身师都有多年的经验。

e.en: The cabaret {artiste} dazzled the audience with her routine.
e.zh: 那位歌舞表演艺术家用她的节目惊艳了观众。

e.en: He fancied himself a tortured {artiste} in art school.
e.zh: 他在艺术学院时自认为是个受尽煎熬的艺术家。

artistic.t: adj. 艺术的；有艺术天赋的

e.en: She has a strong {artistic} sense for color and design.
e.zh: 她在色彩和设计方面有很强的艺术感。

e.en: The film was praised for its bold {artistic} vision.
e.zh: 这部电影因其大胆的艺术视野而受到赞扬。

artistically.t: adv. 艺术性地、富艺术感地

e.en: The dishes were {artistically} plated with edible flowers.
e.zh: 这些菜肴用可食用的花朵作了艺术性的摆盘。

e.en: He grew up in an {artistically} inclined family of musicians.
e.zh: 他在一个充满艺术气息的音乐家家庭中长大。

e.en: The exhibit celebrated diverse {artistries} from across Asia.
e.zh: 这次展览展示了来自亚洲各地的多样艺术造诣。

e.en: Her many {artistries} include painting, dance, and ceramics.
e.zh: 她在多个艺术领域都很出色,包括绘画、舞蹈和陶艺。

artistry.t: n. 艺术造诣、艺术技巧

e.en: The pianist played with breathtaking technical {artistry}.
e.zh: 这位钢琴家以令人叹为观止的技艺演奏。

e.en: You can see real {artistry} in every embroidered stitch.
e.zh: 你可以从每一针刺绣中看到真正的艺术造诣。

e.en: Many {artists} now sell their work directly through Instagram.
e.zh: 许多艺术家现在直接通过 Instagram 出售作品。

e.en: The festival features street {artists} from twenty different countries.
e.zh: 这个节日汇集了来自二十个不同国家的街头艺术家。

e.en: Her {artless} honesty made everyone trust her instantly.
e.zh: 她毫不做作的诚实让每个人立刻就信任她。

e.en: The child's {artless} drawing hangs proudly on the fridge.
e.zh: 那个孩子天真无邪的画骄傲地贴在冰箱上。

e.en: She {artlessly} admitted that she had forgotten his birthday.
e.zh: 她毫不掩饰地承认自己忘了他的生日。

e.en: The toddler {artlessly} hugged the stranger in the park.
e.zh: 那个小孩天真地抱住了公园里的陌生人。

artois.t: n. 阿图瓦（法国历史地区）

e.en: He ordered a cold Stella {Artois} at the pub.
e.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯冰镇时代啤酒。

e.en: The county of {Artois} lies in northern France.
e.zh: 阿图瓦郡位于法国北部。

e.en: Cigarette {ash} fell onto the clean white tablecloth.
e.zh: 烟灰掉到了干净的白桌布上。

e.en: The volcano covered nearby villages in thick gray {ash}.
e.zh: 火山把附近的村庄覆盖上厚厚的灰色火山灰。

e.en: He felt deeply {ashamed} after lying to his parents.
e.zh: 对父母撒谎后他感到非常羞愧。

e.en: You shouldn't be {ashamed} of asking for help sometimes.
e.zh: 偶尔向别人求助没什么好羞愧的。

ashbourne.t: n. 阿什伯恩（英国地名）

e.en: We stopped for tea in the market town of {Ashbourne}.
e.zh: 我们在阿什本这个集镇停下喝了杯茶。

e.en: {Ashbourne} hosts a famous Shrovetide football match each year.
e.zh: 阿什本每年都会举办著名的忏悔节足球赛。

e.en: {Ashburton} is a small town on New Zealand's South Island.
e.zh: 阿什伯顿是新西兰南岛上的一个小镇。

e.en: We drove through {Ashburton} on the way to Christchurch.
e.zh: 我们开车去基督城时路过了阿什伯顿。

e.en: The village of {Ashby} sits in rural Leicestershire.
e.zh: 阿什比村坐落在莱斯特郡的乡间。

e.en: Mr. {Ashby} taught history at the local secondary school.
e.zh: 阿什比先生在当地中学教历史。

ashcroft.t: n. 阿什克罗夫特（姓氏）

e.en: Lord {Ashcroft} published a controversial biography of the prime minister.
e.zh: 阿什克罗夫特勋爵出版了一本关于首相的争议性传记。

e.en: The {Ashcroft} polls are often cited in British political coverage.
e.zh: 阿什克罗夫特民调在英国政治报道中经常被引用。

e.en: Paddy {Ashdown} led the Liberal Democrats throughout the 1990s.
e.zh: 帕迪·阿什当在整个九十年代领导着自由民主党。

e.en: We hiked across {Ashdown} Forest on a misty Sunday morning.
e.zh: 我们在一个雾蒙蒙的周日早晨徒步穿越阿什当森林。

ashen.t: adj. 灰白的；面无血色的

e.en: Her face turned {ashen} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息时,她的脸变得灰白。

e.en: The survivors emerged with {ashen} cheeks and trembling hands.
e.zh: 幸存者面色灰白、双手颤抖地走了出来。

e.en: He scattered his father's {ashes} over the lake at sunset.
e.zh: 他在日落时将父亲的骨灰撒在湖面上。

e.en: Only smoldering {ashes} remained after the warehouse fire.
e.zh: 仓库大火后只剩下还在冒烟的灰烬。

e.en: {Ashfield} is a district council in Nottinghamshire, England.
e.zh: 阿什菲尔德是英格兰诺丁汉郡的一个区议会。

e.en: The by-election in {Ashfield} drew national media attention.
e.zh: 阿什菲尔德的补选吸引了全国媒体的关注。

e.en: The high-speed train stops at {Ashford} on its way to Paris.
e.zh: 高速列车在前往巴黎的途中会在阿什福德停靠。

e.en: She grew up in a quiet village just outside {Ashford}.
e.zh: 她在阿什福德郊外一个安静的村庄长大。

ashkenazi.t: n. 阿什肯纳兹犹太人

e.en: Many {Ashkenazi} traditions trace back to medieval Central Europe.
e.zh: 许多阿什肯纳兹犹太人的传统可追溯到中世纪的中欧。

e.en: The study examined genetic markers common in {Ashkenazi} populations.
e.zh: 该研究调查了阿什肯纳兹族群中常见的遗传标记。

ashkenazic.t: adj. 阿什肯纳兹犹太人的

e.en: The synagogue follows {Ashkenazic} liturgical customs.
e.zh: 这座犹太会堂遵循阿什肯纳兹礼仪传统。

e.en: He grew up speaking Yiddish in an {Ashkenazic} household.
e.zh: 他在一个阿什肯纳兹家庭中长大,说意第绪语。

e.en: The cathedral's walls are built from finely cut {ashlar} blocks.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的墙壁由精心切割的方石砌成。

e.en: Masons admired the smooth {ashlar} facing on the old courthouse.
e.zh: 石匠们赞叹那座旧法院光滑的方石饰面。

e.en: {Ashley} sent me a text about dinner plans tonight.
e.zh: 阿什莉发短信和我商量今晚的晚餐安排。

e.en: My cousin {Ashley} just started medical school in Boston.
e.zh: 我表妹阿什莉刚在波士顿开始读医学院。

ashmore.t: n. 阿什莫尔（姓氏/地名）

e.en: {Ashmore} Reef is a remote Australian territory in the Indian Ocean.
e.zh: 阿什摩尔礁是位于印度洋的一处偏远的澳大利亚领地。

e.en: Dr. {Ashmore} published a new paper on coral bleaching.
e.zh: 阿什摩尔博士发表了一篇关于珊瑚白化的新论文。

e.en: The exhausted swimmer finally crawled {ashore} at dawn.
e.zh: 精疲力竭的游泳者终于在黎明时爬上了岸。

e.en: Strong winds washed plastic debris {ashore} along the coast.
e.zh: 强风将塑料垃圾冲上了沿岸。

e.en: She spent three months meditating at an {ashram} in Rishikesh.
e.zh: 她在瑞诗凯诗的一处道场里冥想了三个月。

e.en: The {ashram} offered yoga classes and vegetarian meals to visitors.
e.zh: 这家修行所为来访者提供瑜伽课程和素食餐。

e.en: He flicked his cigarette into the glass {ashtray} on the table.
e.zh: 他把烟弹进了桌上的玻璃烟灰缸里。

e.en: The hotel room's {ashtray} hadn't been emptied in days.
e.zh: 这间酒店房间的烟灰缸已经好几天没倒了。

e.en: His skin looked dry and {ashy} after the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长的冬天过后,他的皮肤看起来干燥又灰白。

e.en: The volcano left an {ashy} film on every car in town.
e.zh: 火山在镇上每辆车上都留下了一层灰白的薄膜。

e.en: She's planning a backpacking trip across Southeast {Asia} next summer.
e.zh: 她计划明年夏天在东南亚背包旅行。

e.en: {Asia} is home to more than half the world's population.
e.zh: 亚洲拥有全球一半以上的人口。

asian.t:
adj. 亚洲的
n. 亚洲人

e.en: The new {Asian} fusion restaurant downtown has amazing dumplings.
e.zh: 市中心新开的亚洲融合餐厅的饺子非常好吃。

e.en: Many {Asian} economies grew rapidly during the 1990s.
e.zh: 许多亚洲经济体在九十年代实现了快速增长。

e.en: The {Asiatic} lion now survives only in India's Gir Forest.
e.zh: 亚洲狮如今只在印度的吉尔森林里存活。

e.en: Old maps labeled the region as the {Asiatic} steppe.
e.zh: 旧地图把这片地区标注为亚洲草原。

aside.t:
adv. 到/在一旁
n. 旁白

e.en: Please step {aside} so the paramedics can get through.
e.zh: 请让到一边,好让急救人员通过。

e.en: Joking {aside}, we need to ship this feature by Friday.
e.zh: 玩笑归玩笑,我们必须在周五前发布这个功能。

e.en: Stop asking such {asinine} questions during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时别再问这种愚蠢的问题了。

e.en: The new policy struck everyone as completely {asinine}.
e.zh: 这项新政策让所有人都觉得彻头彻尾地荒唐。

e.en: Don't be afraid to {ask} for help when you're stuck.
e.zh: 卡住的时候别不好意思寻求帮助。

e.en: Shipping in two weeks is a big {ask} for the team.
e.zh: 两周内发布对团队来说是一项艰巨的要求。

e.en: Investors looked {askance} at the startup's bold revenue claims.
e.zh: 投资者对这家初创公司大胆的营收说法投以怀疑的目光。

e.en: Neighbors glanced {askance} at the strange truck parked outside.
e.zh: 邻居们怀疑地瞥了一眼停在外面的那辆奇怪卡车。

e.en: Colonial powers recruited {askari} soldiers throughout East Africa.
e.zh: 殖民列强在整个东非招募阿斯卡里士兵。

e.en: The old {askari} guarded the embassy gate every night.
e.zh: 那位老阿斯卡里每晚都守卫着大使馆的大门。

asked.t: v. ask 的过去式；问过

e.en: She {asked} the waiter for the dessert menu.
e.zh: 她向服务员要了甜点菜单。

e.en: He {asked} whether the meeting could be rescheduled.
e.zh: 他询问会议能否改期。

e.en: His tie was {askew} after the long flight home.
e.zh: 长途飞行回家后,他的领带歪到了一边。

e.en: The picture frame hung slightly {askew} above the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉上方的画框微微歪斜地挂着。

asking.t: v. 询问；请求（现在分词）

e.en: She kept {asking} questions long after the lecture ended.
e.zh: 讲座结束后她还一直在提问。

e.en: The {asking} price for the apartment seemed unreasonably high.
e.zh: 那套公寓的开价高得离谱。

asks.t: v. ask 的第三人称单数

e.en: My daughter always {asks} for one more bedtime story.
e.zh: 我女儿睡前总要再听一个故事才肯睡。

e.en: The form {asks} for your phone number and email address.
e.zh: 这张表格要求填写你的电话号码和电子邮件。

e.en: Sunlight fell {aslant} across the dusty wooden floor.
e.zh: 阳光斜斜地洒在落满灰尘的木地板上。

e.en: The fallen tree lay {aslant} the narrow forest path.
e.zh: 那棵倒下的树斜横在狭窄的林间小路上。

e.en: The toddler fell {asleep} halfway through the cartoon.
e.zh: 那个小孩看动画片看到一半就睡着了。

e.en: Don't wake him up — he's finally {asleep}.
e.zh: 别吵醒他,他终于睡着了。

aslef.t: n. 英国火车司机工会缩写

e.en: {ASLEF} members voted overwhelmingly to continue the rail strike.
e.zh: ASLEF工会成员以压倒性多数投票决定继续铁路罢工。

e.en: The train operator reached a pay deal with {ASLEF} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚火车运营公司与ASLEF工会达成了薪资协议。

asmara.t: n. 阿斯马拉（厄立特里亚首都）

e.en: {Asmara} is famous for its well-preserved Italian modernist architecture.
e.zh: 阿斯马拉以其保存完好的意大利现代主义建筑而闻名。

e.en: Our flight to {Asmara}, the capital of Eritrea, was delayed.
e.zh: 我们飞往厄立特里亚首都阿斯马拉的航班延误了。

asocial.t: adj. 不合群的；缺乏社交的

e.en: He's not rude, just somewhat {asocial} at large parties.
e.zh: 他并不粗鲁,只是在大型聚会上有点不爱社交。

e.en: The teenager's {asocial} habits worried his parents.
e.zh: 这个少年不愿与人交往的习惯让父母很担心。

e.en: Legend says Cleopatra died from the bite of an {asp}.
e.zh: 传说克利奥帕特拉是被一条角蝰咬死的。

e.en: The hiker spotted a small {asp} sunning itself on a rock.
e.zh: 那位徒步者看到一条小角蝰在岩石上晒太阳。

e.en: I roasted some {asparagus} with olive oil and lemon zest.
e.zh: 我用橄榄油和柠檬皮烤了一些芦笋。

e.en: Fresh {asparagus} only stays in season for a few weeks.
e.zh: 新鲜芦笋的应季时间只有短短几周。

e.en: Many diet sodas use {aspartame} instead of sugar.
e.zh: 许多无糖汽水用阿斯巴甜代替了糖。

e.en: Recent studies have raised health concerns about {aspartame} consumption.
e.zh: 最近的研究对摄入阿斯巴甜的健康风险提出了担忧。

e.en: The user interface is the most polished {aspect} of the app.
e.zh: 用户界面是这款应用最精致的方面。

e.en: We need to consider every {aspect} of the proposal carefully.
e.zh: 我们需要仔细考虑这份提案的方方面面。

aspects.t: n. 各方面（aspect 的复数）

e.en: The course covers both theoretical and practical {aspects} of design.
e.zh: 这门课程涵盖设计的理论和实践两个方面。

e.en: Several {aspects} of the contract still need negotiation.
e.zh: 合同的若干方面还需要进一步协商。

arts.t: n. 艺术（arts，常指人文艺术）

e.en: She majored in liberal {arts} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学主修文科。

e.en: The city funds local {arts} programs every year.
e.zh: 该市每年都资助本地艺术项目。

artsy.t: adj. 文艺范的，装艺术的

e.en: That cafe has a really {artsy} vibe inside.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆里面很有艺术气息。

e.en: He wears {artsy} glasses and writes poetry.
e.zh: 他戴着文艺范儿的眼镜,还写诗。

e.en: The album cover features stunning {artwork} by a local painter.
e.zh: 专辑封面是一位本地画家的精美作品。

e.en: Please upload the final {artwork} before Friday's print deadline.
e.zh: 请在周五印刷截止前上传最终设计稿。

e.en: The museum displays over a thousand {artworks} from Asia.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一千多件亚洲艺术作品。

e.en: Several {artworks} were damaged during shipping last week.
e.zh: 上周运输过程中有几件艺术品受损。

arty.t: adj. 装文艺的，矫饰艺术的

e.en: She lives in an {arty} neighborhood full of galleries.
e.zh: 她住在一个画廊林立的文艺街区。

e.en: His photos look a bit too {arty} for ads.
e.zh: 他的照片对于广告来说有点太文艺了。

e.en: I tossed some fresh {arugula} into the salad.
e.zh: 我往沙拉里加了些新鲜的芝麻菜。

e.en: This pizza comes topped with prosciutto and {arugula}.
e.zh: 这款披萨配有意式火腿和芝麻菜。

e.en: A white {arum} lily bloomed in the shaded garden.
e.zh: 一朵白色的马蹄莲在阴凉的花园里绽放。

e.en: The {arum} plant thrives in damp, woodland soil.
e.zh: 海芋喜欢生长在潮湿的林地土壤里。

arundel.t: n. 阿伦德尔（英国地名）

e.en: We visited {Arundel} Castle on our trip to Sussex.
e.zh: 我们去苏塞克斯旅行时参观了阿伦德尔城堡。

e.en: The town of {Arundel} sits along a quiet river.
e.zh: 阿伦德尔小镇坐落在一条安静的河边。

aryan.t:
adj. 雅利安人的
n. 雅利安人

e.en: Nazi propaganda promoted a fictional {Aryan} master race.
e.zh: 纳粹宣传鼓吹一个虚构的雅利安优等种族。

e.en: The term {Aryan} originally referred to ancient Indo-Iranian peoples.
e.zh: 雅利安一词最初指古代印度伊朗民族。

e.en: The surgeon carefully examined the patient's {arytenoid} cartilage.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了病人的杓状软骨。

e.en: Vocal cords attach to the {arytenoid} at the back.
e.zh: 声带后端连接在杓状软骨上。

asahi.t: n. 朝日（日本品牌／名称）

e.en: He ordered an ice-cold {Asahi} with his sushi.
e.zh: 他点了一瓶冰镇朝日啤酒配寿司。

e.en: {Asahi} is one of Japan's largest beer brands.
e.zh: 朝日是日本最大的啤酒品牌之一。

asap.t: adv. 尽快（as soon as possible 缩写）

e.en: Please send me the report {ASAP}, ideally tonight.
e.zh: 请尽快把报告发给我,最好今晚就发。

e.en: We need to fix this bug {asap} before launch.
e.zh: 我们得在上线前尽快修好这个bug。

e.en: I transferred the rent through my {ASB} mobile app.
e.zh: 我通过ASB手机应用转了房租。

e.en: {ASB} Bank is one of New Zealand's major lenders.
e.zh: ASB银行是新西兰主要的贷款机构之一。

e.en: The old building was condemned because of {asbestos} insulation.
e.zh: 那栋老楼因含石棉隔热层而被判定危房。

e.en: Workers wore masks while removing the {asbestos} from the ceiling.
e.zh: 工人们戴着口罩拆除天花板上的石棉。

e.en: Decades of inhaling fibers left him with severe {asbestosis}.
e.zh: 数十年吸入纤维使他患上了严重的石棉肺。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the retired miner with {asbestosis} last year.
e.zh: 医生去年诊断这位退休矿工患有石棉肺。

e.en: Sort the results by date {asc} to show oldest first.
e.zh: 按日期升序排序,先显示最旧的。

e.en: Add ORDER BY price {asc} to your SQL query.
e.zh: 在SQL查询里加上按价格升序排列。

e.en: The hikers slowly {ascend} the steep mountain trail.
e.zh: 徒步者缓缓爬上陡峭的山路。

e.en: Stock prices began to {ascend} after the earnings report.
e.zh: 财报发布后股价开始上涨。

e.en: The startup's rapid {ascendance} surprised industry veterans.
e.zh: 这家创业公司的快速崛起让业内老手吃惊。

e.en: Streaming services are now in clear {ascendance} over cable.
e.zh: 流媒体服务如今明显压过了有线电视。

e.en: The party gained political {ascendancy} after the landslide election.
e.zh: 该党在压倒性选举胜利后掌握了政治主导权。

e.en: Tech giants enjoy economic {ascendancy} over traditional retailers.
e.zh: 科技巨头在经济上对传统零售商占据主导地位。

e.en: Electric vehicles are clearly in the {ascendant} this decade.
e.zh: 电动车在这十年里明显处于上升势头。

e.en: She joined an {ascendant} company before its IPO.
e.zh: 她在一家蒸蒸日上的公司上市前加入了。

e.en: The general's {ascendency} over the troops was unquestioned.
e.zh: 将军对部队的支配地位无可置疑。

e.en: Mobile gaming gained {ascendency} over console sales worldwide.
e.zh: 手游在全球范围内压过了主机游戏的销量。

ascender.t: n. 字母上伸部分（排版）

e.en: The letter 'h' has a tall {ascender} above the baseline.
e.zh: 字母h在基线上方有一根高高的上伸笔画。

e.en: This font's {ascender} height makes it easier to read.
e.zh: 这种字体的上伸高度让它更易阅读。

e.en: Sort the table in {ascending} order by price.
e.zh: 将表格按价格升序排列。

e.en: The plane was still {ascending} when turbulence hit.
e.zh: 飞机遇到颠簸时还在继续爬升。

ascension.t:
n. 上升，登基
n. 耶稣升天

e.en: His {ascension} to CEO surprised many senior employees.
e.zh: 他升任CEO让许多资深员工感到意外。

e.en: The kingdom celebrated the queen's {ascension} to the throne.
e.zh: 王国庆祝女王登基。

e.en: Their {ascent} of Everest took nearly two months.
e.zh: 他们攀登珠峰花了将近两个月。

e.en: The company's rapid {ascent} made headlines last year.
e.zh: 这家公司的迅速崛起去年成为头条新闻。

e.en: Police are trying to {ascertain} the cause of the fire.
e.zh: 警方正在设法查明火灾的起因。

e.en: Please {ascertain} whether the package has been delivered yet.
e.zh: 请确认一下包裹是否已经送到了。

ascertainable.t: adj. 可查明的，可确定的

e.en: The exact damages are not easily {ascertainable} at this stage.
e.zh: 现阶段确切的损失数额很难查明。

e.en: His whereabouts last night are still not {ascertainable}.
e.zh: 他昨晚的下落仍无法查实。

e.en: The judge ordered the {ascertainment} of all relevant facts.
e.zh: 法官下令查明所有相关事实。

e.en: Proper {ascertainment} of damages requires detailed financial records.
e.zh: 准确确定损失需要详细的财务记录。

ascetic.t:
n. 苦行者
adj. 苦行的，禁欲的

e.en: The monk lived an {ascetic} life of fasting and prayer.
e.zh: 那位僧侣过着禁食祈祷的苦行生活。

e.en: She prefers an {ascetic} apartment with almost no furniture.
e.zh: 她喜欢一间近乎空无一物的极简公寓。

e.en: His strict {asceticism} included no meat, alcohol, or entertainment.
e.zh: 他严格的苦行主义包括戒肉、戒酒、戒娱乐。

e.en: Many philosophers admired the {asceticism} of ancient Stoics.
e.zh: 许多哲学家钦佩古代斯多葛派的禁欲主义。

ascii.t: n. ASCII 码（美国信息交换标准代码）

e.en: The file is plain {ASCII} text with no formatting.
e.zh: 该文件是纯ASCII文本,没有任何格式。

e.en: He drew a tiny dog using {ASCII} characters.
e.zh: 他用ASCII字符画了一只小狗。

e.en: The patient developed {ascites} due to advanced liver disease.
e.zh: 病人因肝病晚期出现了腹水。

e.en: Doctors drained the {ascites} fluid to relieve the pressure.
e.zh: 医生抽出腹水以减轻压力。

ascot.t:
n. 阿斯科特领巾
n. 阿斯科特（地名）

e.en: He wore a silk {ascot} tucked into his shirt.
e.zh: 他在衬衫里塞了一条丝质宽领巾。

e.en: The royal family attended the races at {Ascot} again.
e.zh: 王室成员再次出席了阿斯科特赛马会。

e.en: Critics {ascribe} the film's success to its clever script.
e.zh: 评论家把这部电影的成功归功于巧妙的剧本。

e.en: Don't {ascribe} dishonest motives to people without proof.
e.zh: 没有证据就不要把不诚实的动机强加于人。

ascribed.t: v. ascribe 的过去式，被归于

e.en: Historians {ascribed} the painting to a 17th-century master.
e.zh: 历史学家把这幅画归于一位17世纪大师之手。

e.en: Her recovery was {ascribed} to early diagnosis and rest.
e.zh: 她的康复被归功于早期诊断和休息。

e.en: The {ascription} of the poem to Shakespeare remains disputed.
e.zh: 这首诗是否出自莎士比亚之手仍有争议。

e.en: Casual {ascription} of motives can damage someone's reputation.
e.zh: 随意揣测他人动机可能毁掉他人的名誉。

e.en: Sociologists distinguish achieved status from {ascriptive} status like ethnicity.
e.zh: 社会学家把后天取得的地位与种族等先赋地位区分开。

e.en: Caste systems rely on {ascriptive} traits assigned at birth.
e.zh: 种姓制度依赖于出生时就被赋予的先赋特征。

asda.t: n. 阿斯达（英国连锁超市）

e.en: I picked up some milk from {Asda} on the way home.
e.zh: 我回家路上在阿斯达超市买了点牛奶。

e.en: {Asda} just opened a new store near our flat.
e.zh: 阿斯达刚在我们公寓附近开了家新店。

e.en: The fishing fleet has been {asea} for three weeks.
e.zh: 渔船队已经出海三周了。

e.en: Sailors spend months {asea} far from their families.
e.zh: 水手们一连数月在海上,远离家人。

asean.t: n. 东盟（东南亚国家联盟）

e.en: {ASEAN} leaders met in Jakarta to discuss regional trade.
e.zh: 东盟领导人在雅加达开会讨论区域贸易。

e.en: Singapore is one of the founding members of {ASEAN}.
e.zh: 新加坡是东盟创始成员国之一。

e.en: Surgeons must follow strict {aseptic} technique in the operating room.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术室里必须严格遵守无菌操作。

e.en: The juice is packaged in {aseptic} cartons for long shelf life.
e.zh: 果汁用无菌纸盒包装,保质期更长。

e.en: The instruments were {aseptically} sealed before shipment to hospitals.
e.zh: 这些器械在运往医院前已无菌密封。

e.en: Milk is {aseptically} processed to remain safe without refrigeration.
e.zh: 牛奶经无菌加工,无需冷藏即可保存。

asexual.t: adj. 无性的，无性生殖的

e.en: Many plants reproduce through {asexual} budding rather than seeds.
e.zh: 许多植物通过无性出芽繁殖,而不是种子。

e.en: She came out as {asexual} to her close friends.
e.zh: 她向亲密朋友坦白自己是无性恋。

e.en: Strawberries can spread {asexually} through their long runners.
e.zh: 草莓能通过长长的匍匐茎进行无性繁殖。

e.en: This species reproduces {asexually} when mates are scarce.
e.zh: 这个物种在缺少配偶时会进行无性繁殖。

e.en: The {aspen} leaves shimmered gold in the autumn breeze.
e.zh: 白杨树叶在秋风中闪烁着金色的光泽。

e.en: We rented a cabin near {Aspen} for our ski trip.
e.zh: 我们在阿斯彭附近租了间小木屋,去滑雪度假。

aspergillosis.t: n. 曲霉菌感染引起的疾病

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with pulmonary {aspergillosis} after the biopsy.
e.zh: 活检后,这位患者被诊断为肺部曲霉病。

e.en: {Aspergillosis} can be life-threatening for people with weakened immune systems.
e.zh: 曲霉病对免疫力低下的人可能危及生命。

e.en: She replied with unexpected {asperity} when questioned about the deadline.
e.zh: 被问到截止日期时,她出乎意料地厉声回应。

e.en: The judge spoke with {asperity} to the disruptive lawyer.
e.zh: 法官严厉地训斥了那位扰乱秩序的律师。

e.en: I refuse to cast {aspersion} on a colleague's character without proof.
e.zh: 没有证据,我拒绝诋毁同事的人品。

e.en: His memoir cast an unfair {aspersion} on his former mentor.
e.zh: 他的回忆录对他从前的导师进行了不公正的诋毁。

asphalt.t:
n. 沥青
v. 铺沥青

e.en: The fresh {asphalt} steamed under the summer afternoon sun.
e.zh: 新铺的沥青在夏日午后的阳光下冒着热气。

e.en: Crews resurfaced the parking lot with smooth black {asphalt}.
e.zh: 工人们用平整的黑色沥青重新铺设了停车场。

e.en: The coroner listed {asphyxia} as the cause of death.
e.zh: 验尸官将窒息列为死因。

e.en: Newborns showing signs of {asphyxia} require immediate resuscitation.
e.zh: 出现窒息迹象的新生儿需要立刻复苏抢救。

e.en: Smoke can {asphyxiate} a person within minutes inside a closed room.
e.zh: 在封闭的房间里,浓烟几分钟内就能使人窒息。

e.en: Plastic bags left near children can easily {asphyxiate} them.
e.zh: 放在孩子附近的塑料袋很容易使他们窒息。

e.en: Firefighters rescued the family before {asphyxiation} could set in.
e.zh: 消防员在窒息发生之前救出了那一家人。

e.en: The autopsy revealed death by {asphyxiation} from carbon monoxide.
e.zh: 尸检显示死因是一氧化碳导致的窒息。

e.en: Grandma served chicken in {aspic} at every holiday dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶在每次节日晚宴上都端出鸡肉冻。

e.en: The chef molded the salmon into a delicate lemon {aspic}.
e.zh: 厨师将三文鱼塑成一道精致的柠檬肉冻。

aspidistra.t: n. 蜘蛛抱蛋（观叶植物）

e.en: An old {aspidistra} sat in the corner of the parlor.
e.zh: 客厅角落里摆着一盆老蜘蛛抱蛋。

e.en: The {aspidistra} thrives even in the dimmest hallway light.
e.zh: 蜘蛛抱蛋即使在昏暗的走廊光线下也能茂盛生长。

aspirant.t: n. 有志者；追求某职位者

e.en: Every {aspirant} for the championship trained twice a day.
e.zh: 每位冠军候选人都每天训练两次。

e.en: She is a serious {aspirant} to the senate seat next year.
e.zh: 她是明年参议员席位的有力竞争者。

aspirate.t:
v. 抽吸（液体）；送气发音
n. 送气音

e.en: Be careful not to {aspirate} water while swimming laps.
e.zh: 游泳时小心不要呛到水。

e.en: In English, you usually {aspirate} the 'p' in 'pin'.
e.zh: 在英语中,'pin'中的'p'通常会送气发音。

aspirated.t:
adj. 送气的（语音）
v. 抽吸（过去式）

e.en: The unconscious patient {aspirated} food and developed pneumonia.
e.zh: 那位昏迷的病人吸入了食物,随后患上了肺炎。

e.en: Mandarin distinguishes {aspirated} consonants from unaspirated ones.
e.zh: 普通话区分送气辅音和不送气辅音。

e.en: Her biggest {aspiration} is to start her own company.
e.zh: 她最大的志向是创办自己的公司。

e.en: The young artist spoke about her {aspiration} to paint murals.
e.zh: 那位年轻艺术家谈到她想画壁画的愿望。

e.en: The brand uses {aspirational} marketing to attract young buyers.
e.zh: 该品牌用激励性营销吸引年轻买家。

e.en: That salary feels more {aspirational} than realistic right now.
e.zh: 那个薪水现在听起来更像理想而非现实。

e.en: Many students have {aspirations} of studying abroad.
e.zh: 许多学生都有出国留学的愿望。

e.en: Her career {aspirations} changed after she became a mother.
e.zh: 她当了母亲后,职业理想发生了变化。

e.en: Most engineers {aspire} to work at top tech companies.
e.zh: 大多数工程师都渴望进入顶尖科技公司工作。

e.en: Children naturally {aspire} to be like their heroes.
e.zh: 孩子们天生想要成为像偶像那样的人。

e.en: He always {aspired} to be a professional musician.
e.zh: 他一直渴望成为一名职业音乐家。

e.en: She {aspired} to lead the company one day.
e.zh: 她渴望有朝一日能领导这家公司。

aspires.t: v. 渴望（第三人称单数）

e.en: Every junior developer {aspires} to write cleaner code.
e.zh: 每个初级开发者都渴望写出更干净的代码。

e.en: She {aspires} to become a chef after culinary school.
e.zh: 她希望烹饪学校毕业后成为一名厨师。

aspirin.t: n. 阿司匹林（解热镇痛药）

e.en: I took an {aspirin} to ease the headache.
e.zh: 我吃了一片阿司匹林来缓解头痛。

e.en: Doctors recommend low-dose {aspirin} for some heart patients.
e.zh: 医生建议部分心脏病患者服用小剂量阿司匹林。

aspiring.t: adj. 有抱负的；有志于…的

e.en: The workshop is designed for {aspiring} writers.
e.zh: 这个工作坊专为有抱负的作家设计。

e.en: She mentors {aspiring} entrepreneurs through an online program.
e.zh: 她通过在线项目指导有抱负的创业者。

e.en: He swallowed two {aspirins} before the long flight.
e.zh: 他在长途飞行前吞下了两片阿司匹林。

e.en: The cabinet had a small bottle of {aspirins} inside.
e.zh: 柜子里放着一小瓶阿司匹林。

asprey.t: n. 爱丝普蕾（英国奢侈品牌）

e.en: She bought a leather wallet from {Asprey} in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦的爱思普雷买了一个皮夹。

e.en: The royal family has long shopped at {Asprey}.
e.zh: 英国王室长期在爱思普雷购物。

asquith.t: n. 阿斯奎斯（英国前首相）

e.en: {Asquith} served as British prime minister before World War I.
e.zh: 阿斯奎斯在第一次世界大战前担任英国首相。

e.en: Historians often debate {Asquith}'s wartime leadership decisions.
e.zh: 历史学家经常讨论阿斯奎斯的战时领导决策。

ass.t:
n. 屁股；蠢货
n. 驴

e.en: Stop being such an {ass} and apologize already.
e.zh: 别那么蠢了,赶紧道歉吧。

e.en: The farmer loaded the heavy sacks onto his {ass}.
e.zh: 农夫把沉重的麻袋放到他的驴背上。

e.en: Critics continue to {assail} the new tax policy.
e.zh: 批评者持续抨击这项新的税收政策。

e.en: Doubts began to {assail} her right before the speech.
e.zh: 演讲前疑虑开始向她袭来。

e.en: Police are still searching for the {assailant}.
e.zh: 警方仍在搜寻袭击者。

e.en: The victim could not clearly describe her {assailant}.
e.zh: 受害者无法清楚地描述袭击她的人。

assam.t: n. 阿萨姆（印度邦名、红茶产地）

e.en: {Assam} is famous for its strong, malty black tea.
e.zh: 阿萨姆以其浓郁麦香的红茶而闻名。

e.en: We visited a tea plantation in {Assam} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天我们参观了阿萨姆的一座茶园。

e.en: The {assassin} escaped through the back of the building.
e.zh: 刺客从大楼后方逃脱。

e.en: In the game, you play as a stealthy {assassin}.
e.zh: 在游戏中你扮演一名潜行刺客。

e.en: Rebels plotted to {assassinate} the visiting general.
e.zh: 叛军密谋暗杀来访的将军。

e.en: It is illegal to {assassinate} a foreign leader.
e.zh: 暗杀外国领导人是违法的。

e.en: President Lincoln was {assassinated} at Ford's Theatre in 1865.
e.zh: 林肯总统于1865年在福特剧院遇刺身亡。

e.en: The journalist was {assassinated} for exposing corruption.
e.zh: 那名记者因揭露腐败被暗杀。

e.en: The {assassination} shocked the entire nation.
e.zh: 这起暗杀事件震惊了整个国家。

e.en: Security tightened after the failed {assassination} attempt.
e.zh: 暗杀未遂后,安保措施加强了。

e.en: The 1960s saw several high-profile political {assassinations}.
e.zh: 1960年代发生了几起轰动一时的政治暗杀。

e.en: The documentary explores unsolved {assassinations} in modern history.
e.zh: 该纪录片探讨了现代史上未解的暗杀案。

assault.t:
n. 袭击；攻击
v. 殴打

e.en: He was charged with {assault} after the bar fight.
e.zh: 酒吧斗殴后他被指控人身伤害罪。

e.en: The army launched a surprise {assault} at dawn.
e.zh: 军队在黎明发动了突袭。

e.en: The victim was {assaulted} while walking home alone.
e.zh: 受害者独自走回家时遭到袭击。

e.en: Strong winds {assaulted} the small fishing boat all night.
e.zh: 狂风整夜猛烈拍打着这艘小渔船。

e.en: He was arrested for {assaulting} a police officer.
e.zh: 他因袭击警察而被捕。

e.en: Reporters kept {assaulting} the senator with tough questions.
e.zh: 记者们不断用尖锐问题向参议员发难。

e.en: The patient showed {assaultive} behavior toward the nurses.
e.zh: 该病人对护士表现出攻击性行为。

e.en: Schools have policies for handling {assaultive} students safely.
e.zh: 学校制定了安全处理有暴力倾向学生的政策。

assaults.t:
n. 袭击（复数）
v. 袭击

e.en: Reported {assaults} in the city dropped this year.
e.zh: 该市今年报告的袭击案件有所下降。

e.en: The candidate {assaults} her opponent's record at every debate.
e.zh: 这位候选人在每场辩论中都猛烈抨击对手的履历。

assay.t:
v. 化验；分析
n. 含量测定

e.en: The lab will {assay} the gold sample for purity.
e.zh: 实验室将分析这份金样本的纯度。

e.en: Each {assay} confirmed the ore had high silver content.
e.zh: 每次化验都确认这种矿石含银量很高。

e.en: The {assayer} weighed the nugget on a precise scale.
e.zh: 化验员用精密天平称量了这块金块。

e.en: Miners brought their finds to the town {assayer}.
e.zh: 矿工们把自己的收获带到镇上的化验员那里。

e.en: The exhibit features an {assemblage} of vintage cameras.
e.zh: 展览展示了一组复古相机的集合。

e.en: A strange {assemblage} of guests gathered in the lobby.
e.zh: 一群形形色色的客人聚集在大堂。

e.en: It took two hours to {assemble} the bookshelf.
e.zh: 组装这个书架花了两个小时。

e.en: The team will {assemble} in the main conference room.
e.zh: 团队将在主会议室集合。

assembled.t:
v. 组装（过去式）
adj. 装配好的

e.en: The crowd {assembled} outside the courthouse to protest.
e.zh: 人群聚集在法院外抗议。

e.en: He {assembled} the new desk using only the included tools.
e.zh: 他只用附带的工具就组装好了新书桌。

e.en: She works as an {assembler} on the car factory line.
e.zh: 她在汽车厂的生产线上做装配工。

e.en: Low-level programmers sometimes still write in {assembler}.
e.zh: 底层程序员有时仍会用汇编语言编写代码。

assembles.t: v. 组装（第三人称单数）

e.en: The robot {assembles} circuit boards faster than any human.
e.zh: 这个机器人组装电路板比任何人都快。

e.en: The choir {assembles} every Thursday for rehearsal.
e.zh: 合唱团每周四都会集合排练。

e.en: The school holds weekly {assemblies} in the gym.
e.zh: 学校每周在体育馆举行集会。

e.en: The factory produces battery {assemblies} for electric cars.
e.zh: 该工厂生产用于电动车的电池组件。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {assembling} the IKEA wardrobe.
e.zh: 他花了一下午组装宜家的衣柜。

e.en: The director is still {assembling} the perfect cast.
e.zh: 导演仍在物色组建理想的演员阵容。

assembly.t:
n. 装配；集会
n. 汇编语言

e.en: The student {assembly} starts at nine in the morning.
e.zh: 学生大会上午九点开始。

e.en: Each phone is tested before leaving the {assembly} line.
e.zh: 每部手机离开装配线前都会经过测试。

e.en: The {assemblyman} voted against the controversial housing bill.
e.zh: 这位议员投票反对那项有争议的住房法案。

e.en: Our local {assemblyman} hosts town halls every month.
e.zh: 我们当地的议员每月都举办市民大会。

assistive.t: adj. 辅助的（如辅助技术）

e.en: {Assistive} technology helps blind users navigate websites.
e.zh: 辅助技术帮助盲人用户浏览网站。

e.en: The school provides {assistive} devices for hearing-impaired students.
e.zh: 学校为听障学生提供辅助设备。

assists.t:
v. 协助，帮助
n. (体育) 助攻

e.en: He led the league in {assists} this season.
e.zh: 他本赛季的助攻数高居联盟第一。

e.en: The app {assists} users in tracking daily expenses.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助用户记录每日开支。

e.en: The judge presided over the spring {assize} in York.
e.zh: 法官主持了在约克举行的春季巡回法庭。

e.en: Historic records describe the medieval {assize} of bread.
e.zh: 史料记载了中世纪关于面包的法令。

associate.t:
n. 同事，伙伴
v. 联想，关联

e.en: Many people {associate} red with passion or danger.
e.zh: 很多人把红色与激情或危险联系在一起。

e.en: She works as a sales {associate} at the bookstore.
e.zh: 她在书店担任销售助理。

e.en: Smoking is strongly {associated} with lung cancer.
e.zh: 吸烟与肺癌有密切关联。

e.en: The costs {associated} with shipping have risen sharply.
e.zh: 与运输相关的费用大幅上涨。

associates.t:
n. 同事们，伙伴们
v. 联系（第三人称单数）

e.en: He often {associates} with successful entrepreneurs.
e.zh: 他经常与成功的企业家交往。

e.en: The law firm hired three new {associates} this year.
e.zh: 这家律所今年新招了三名律师助理。

associateship.t: n. 准会员资格；副研究员职位

e.en: She earned an {associateship} at the prestigious institute.
e.zh: 她在那所知名研究院获得了准研究员职位。

e.en: His {associateship} comes with full research funding.
e.zh: 他的研究员职位附带全额科研经费。

e.en: Stop {associating} every mistake with personal failure.
e.zh: 别再把每个错误都跟个人失败联系起来。

e.en: He enjoys {associating} with people from different backgrounds.
e.zh: 他喜欢与不同背景的人交往。

association.t:
n. 协会，社团
n. 联系，联想

e.en: The neighborhood {association} meets every first Tuesday.
e.zh: 社区协会每月第一个周二开会。

e.en: There's a clear {association} between exercise and mood.
e.zh: 运动与情绪之间有明显的关联。

e.en: Memory often works through {associational} links between ideas.
e.zh: 记忆往往通过观念之间的联想链接来运作。

e.en: The poem relies on {associational} rather than logical thought.
e.zh: 这首诗依靠的是联想而非逻辑思维。

e.en: Many trade {associations} lobby for industry-friendly laws.
e.zh: 许多行业协会为有利于业界的法律进行游说。

e.en: The smell of pine brings back childhood {associations}.
e.zh: 松木的气味勾起了童年的联想。

e.en: Addition is an {associative} operation in mathematics.
e.zh: 加法在数学中是一种结合运算。

e.en: Brainstorming uses {associative} thinking to spark new ideas.
e.zh: 头脑风暴利用联想思维来激发新点子。

e.en: The poet uses {assonance} to create a musical rhythm.
e.zh: 诗人用元音叠韵来营造音乐般的节奏。

e.en: Notice the {assonance} in 'fleet feet sweep by sleeping geese'.
e.zh: 注意这句话里反复出现的元音叠韵。

assorted.t: adj. 各式各样的，混合的

e.en: She bought a box of {assorted} chocolates for the party.
e.zh: 她为派对买了一盒什锦巧克力。

e.en: The drawer was full of {assorted} cables and chargers.
e.zh: 抽屉里装满了各式各样的数据线和充电器。

e.en: The bakery offers a wide {assortment} of fresh pastries.
e.zh: 这家面包店提供各种各样的新鲜糕点。

e.en: She bought an {assortment} of colored pens for school.
e.zh: 她为上学买了一套各色钢笔。

e.en: His title on the door reads {asst} manager.
e.zh: 他门上的职衔写着助理经理。

e.en: The shelf label said {asst} flavors available today.
e.zh: 货架标签写着今日有多种口味可选。

assuage.t: v. 缓解，减轻（痛苦、担忧）

e.en: A warm apology helped {assuage} her hurt feelings.
e.zh: 一句诚恳的道歉缓解了她受伤的情绪。

e.en: The company made promises to {assuage} customer concerns.
e.zh: 公司作出承诺以平息客户的疑虑。

assume.t:
v. 假定，认为
v. 承担（职责）

e.en: Don't {assume} everyone has read the email already.
e.zh: 别想当然地以为每个人都看过那封邮件了。

e.en: She will {assume} the role of CEO next month.
e.zh: 她下个月将接任首席执行官一职。

assumed.t:
adj. 假定的，假冒的
v. 假设（过去式）

e.en: I {assumed} the meeting was canceled because of the storm.
e.zh: 我以为会议因为暴风雨被取消了。

e.en: He traveled under an {assumed} name to avoid reporters.
e.zh: 他用化名出行以避开记者。

assumes.t: v. 假设；承担（第三人称单数）

e.en: The plan {assumes} that funding will arrive on time.
e.zh: 该计划假定资金会按时到位。

e.en: She {assumes} responsibility whenever the team faces a crisis.
e.zh: 团队遇到危机时,她总是主动承担责任。

assuming.t:
v. 假设，认为
conj. 假如

e.en: {Assuming} traffic is light, we'll arrive by seven.
e.zh: 假如路上不堵,我们七点前就能到。

e.en: He spoke in an {assuming} tone that annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 他说话的口气傲慢自负,惹恼了大家。

assumption.t:
n. 假设，设想
n. 承担（职责）

e.en: Your argument rests on a flawed {assumption}.
e.zh: 你的论点建立在一个有问题的假设上。

e.en: Don't make the {assumption} that silence means agreement.
e.zh: 别想当然地认为沉默就代表同意。

e.en: We need to test our {assumptions} before launching the product.
e.zh: 在产品上线前,我们需要验证这些假设。

e.en: Many {assumptions} about remote work turned out to be wrong.
e.zh: 许多关于远程办公的设想后来被证明是错的。

assurance.t:
n. 保证，把握
n. 人寿保险（英式）

e.en: She gave me her {assurance} that the data was safe.
e.zh: 她向我保证数据是安全的。

e.en: He answered the questions with calm {assurance}.
e.zh: 他从容自信地回答了所有问题。

e.en: Despite the company's {assurances}, customers remained skeptical.
e.zh: 尽管公司一再保证,客户仍持怀疑态度。

e.en: The minister offered repeated {assurances} about food safety.
e.zh: 部长就食品安全问题多次作出保证。

e.en: I can {assure} you the package will arrive tomorrow.
e.zh: 我可以向你保证包裹明天会到。

e.en: Let me {assure} the team that no jobs are at risk.
e.zh: 我向团队保证,没有人会失去工作。

e.en: She walked into the interview looking calm and {assured}.
e.zh: 她走进面试场,神态镇定而自信。
