e.en: Both {attorneys} delivered strong closing arguments.
e.zh: 双方律师都做了强有力的结案陈词。

e.en: Bright colors {attract} bees to the flowers.
e.zh: 鲜艳的颜色会吸引蜜蜂飞向花朵。

e.en: The new café hopes to {attract} younger customers.
e.zh: 这家新咖啡馆希望能吸引更年轻的顾客。

e.en: The trap uses a sweet {attractant} to lure mosquitoes.
e.zh: 这种陷阱用甜味引诱剂来诱捕蚊子。

e.en: Pheromones serve as a powerful {attractant} for many insects.
e.zh: 信息素对许多昆虫来说是一种强效引诱剂。

attracted.t:
adj. 被吸引的
v. 吸引（过去式）

e.en: The street performer {attracted} a large crowd.
e.zh: 那位街头艺人吸引了一大群观众。

e.en: She was {attracted} to him from their very first meeting.
e.zh: 她从第一次见面就对他有好感。

e.en: The viral video is {attracting} millions of views daily.
e.zh: 这段爆红视频每天吸引数百万的播放量。

e.en: The startup is {attracting} interest from major investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正吸引着主要投资者的关注。

e.en: The Eiffel Tower is the city's biggest tourist {attraction}.
e.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是这座城市最大的旅游景点。

e.en: She felt an instant {attraction} when they first met.
e.zh: 两人初次见面时,她就感到一种瞬间的吸引。

e.en: The theme park has dozens of {attractions} for families.
e.zh: 这家主题乐园有几十个适合家庭的游乐项目。

e.en: Tokyo's {attractions} range from temples to neon districts.
e.zh: 东京的景点从寺庙到霓虹街区应有尽有。

attractive.t: adj. 有吸引力的，迷人的

e.en: The new job offer is very {attractive} financially.
e.zh: 这份新工作的待遇很有吸引力。

e.en: He has an {attractive} smile and warm personality.
e.zh: 他笑容迷人,性格温暖。

attractively.t: adv. 迷人地，有吸引力地

e.en: The dishes were {attractively} arranged on the buffet table.
e.zh: 菜肴在自助餐台上摆放得很美观。

e.en: The house is {attractively} priced for a quick sale.
e.zh: 这套房子定价很有吸引力,以便尽快出售。

e.en: The {attractiveness} of remote work has grown since 2020.
e.zh: 自 2020 年以来,远程办公的吸引力越来越大。

e.en: Studies show that symmetry boosts perceived {attractiveness}.
e.zh: 研究表明,对称性会提升人们感知到的吸引力。

e.en: The report compared the relative {attractivenesses} of several markets.
e.zh: 该报告比较了几个市场各自的吸引力。

e.en: Different cultures rate facial {attractivenesses} in surprisingly similar ways.
e.zh: 不同文化对面部吸引力的评价方式惊人地相似。

e.en: In chaos theory, a strange {attractor} produces fractal patterns.
e.zh: 在混沌理论中,奇异吸引子会产生分形图案。

e.en: Bright lights act as a powerful {attractor} for moths.
e.zh: 明亮的灯光对飞蛾来说是个强大的诱因。

attracts.t: v. 吸引（第三人称单数）

e.en: Honey {attracts} more flies than vinegar, as the saying goes.
e.zh: 俗话说,蜂蜜比醋更能招来苍蝇。

e.en: The festival {attracts} thousands of visitors every summer.
e.zh: 这个节日每年夏天都吸引成千上万的游客。

e.en: The price drop is largely {attributable} to weak demand.
e.zh: 价格下跌主要归因于需求疲软。

e.en: Only twenty percent of cases are {attributable} to genetics.
e.zh: 只有百分之二十的病例可归因于遗传。

attribute.t:
n. 属性，特性
v. 归因于

e.en: Patience is an important {attribute} for a teacher.
e.zh: 耐心是教师重要的品质。

e.en: Critics {attribute} the painting to a young Picasso.
e.zh: 评论家将这幅画归于年轻的毕加索。

e.en: She {attributed} her success to hard work and luck.
e.zh: 她把成功归功于努力和运气。

e.en: The quote is often {attributed} to Mark Twain.
e.zh: 这句话常被认为出自马克·吐温。

attributes.t:
n. 属性（复数）
v. 归因于

e.en: This API returns user {attributes} like name and email.
e.zh: 这个接口返回用户的姓名、邮箱等属性。

e.en: The coach {attributes} the win to teamwork.
e.zh: 教练把胜利归功于团队合作。

e.en: Avoid {attributing} every failure to bad luck.
e.zh: 不要把每次失败都归咎于运气不好。

e.en: She quoted the poem without {attributing} the author.
e.zh: 她引用了这首诗却没有注明作者。

e.en: Please add an {attribution} link when reposting the article.
e.zh: 转发这篇文章时请加上来源链接。

e.en: Marketing teams struggle with accurate ad {attribution}.
e.zh: 营销团队很难做到准确的广告归因。

e.en: His {attributional} style blames others for every setback.
e.zh: 他的归因风格总是把挫折怪到别人头上。

e.en: Therapists often address {attributional} patterns in depressed patients.
e.zh: 治疗师常会处理抑郁患者的归因模式。

e.en: In "red car," the adjective is used {attributive}ly.
e.zh: 在 red car 中,形容词作定语使用。

e.en: English allows nouns in {attributive} position, like "coffee cup."
e.zh: 英语允许名词作定语,例如 coffee cup。

e.en: Employee {attrition} jumped after the company canceled remote work.
e.zh: 取消远程办公后,员工流失率大幅上升。

e.en: The startup is losing customers through slow {attrition}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正缓慢地流失客户。

e.en: The report compares quarterly {attritions} across departments.
e.zh: 报告对比了各部门季度的人员流失情况。

e.en: Repeated {attritions} weakened the team's morale.
e.zh: 接连的人员流失削弱了团队士气。

e.en: Good designers {attune} themselves to user feedback quickly.
e.zh: 优秀的设计师能迅速适应用户反馈。

e.en: Meditation helps you {attune} to your own emotions.
e.zh: 冥想帮助你与自己的情绪保持同频。

e.en: She is deeply {attuned} to her child's moods.
e.zh: 她对孩子的情绪非常敏感。

e.en: The brand stays {attuned} to teen culture trends.
e.zh: 这个品牌始终紧贴青少年文化潮流。

e.en: Emotional {attunement} between parent and baby builds trust.
e.zh: 父母与婴儿之间的情感同频能建立信任。

e.en: The therapist emphasized {attunement} over giving advice.
e.zh: 治疗师强调情感共鸣胜过给出建议。

atypical.t: adj. 非典型的，不寻常的

e.en: His symptoms are {atypical} for a common cold.
e.zh: 他的症状对于普通感冒来说不太典型。

e.en: This warm December is {atypical} for our region.
e.zh: 如此温暖的十二月在我们这一带很反常。

e.en: The market was {atypically} quiet on Monday morning.
e.zh: 周一上午的市场异常平静。

e.en: She spoke {atypically} sharply during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会上一反常态地言辞犀利。

aubergine.t:
n. 茄子（英式）
adj. 深紫色的

e.en: I roasted an {aubergine} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 我用蒜和橄榄油烤了一个茄子。

e.en: She wore an elegant {aubergine} silk dress.
e.zh: 她穿了一条优雅的茄紫色丝绸连衣裙。

e.en: The market sells fresh {aubergines} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 市场每周六早上都卖新鲜茄子。

e.en: Grilled {aubergines} are a staple of Mediterranean cooking.
e.zh: 烤茄子是地中海料理的常见菜。

auburn.t:
adj. 赤褐色的
n. 赤褐色

e.en: She has long {auburn} hair and green eyes.
e.zh: 她有一头赤褐色长发和绿色眼眸。

e.en: Autumn leaves turned a brilliant {auburn} this year.
e.zh: 今年的秋叶变成了亮丽的赤褐色。

aubusson.t: n. 奥比松（法国地名、挂毯）

e.en: An antique {aubusson} rug covered the drawing room floor.
e.zh: 客厅地板上铺着一张古董奥布松地毯。

e.en: The auction featured a rare 18th-century {aubusson} tapestry.
e.zh: 拍卖会展出了一件罕见的十八世纪奥布松挂毯。

auckland.t: n. 奥克兰（新西兰城市）

e.en: We flew to {Auckland} for a week of hiking.
e.zh: 我们飞到奥克兰徒步了一周。

e.en: {Auckland} is the largest city in New Zealand.
e.zh: 奥克兰是新西兰最大的城市。

autocrat.t: n. 独裁者；专制统治者

e.en: The {autocrat} silenced journalists who criticized his policies.
e.zh: 这位独裁者压制批评他政策的记者。

e.en: He ran the company like an old-school {autocrat}.
e.zh: 他像个老派独裁者一样经营这家公司。

e.en: Her {autocratic} management style frustrated the entire team.
e.zh: 她独断专行的管理风格让整个团队感到沮丧。

e.en: The regime grew increasingly {autocratic} after the failed coup.
e.zh: 政变失败后,该政权变得越来越专制。

e.en: He ran the meeting {autocratically}, ignoring everyone's input.
e.zh: 他独断专行地主持会议,无视所有人的意见。

e.en: The CEO behaved {autocratically} despite claims of being collaborative.
e.zh: 尽管声称合作,这位 CEO 行事却很独裁。

e.en: The news anchor read smoothly from the {autocue}.
e.zh: 新闻主播流畅地照着提词器念稿。

e.en: She forgot her lines when the {autocue} suddenly froze.
e.zh: 提词器突然卡住时,她忘了台词。

e.en: A self-taught coder, he's a true {autodidact}.
e.zh: 作为自学成才的程序员,他是真正的自学者。

e.en: The famous {autodidact} learned five languages without any teacher.
e.zh: 这位著名的自学者没有老师就学会了五种语言。

autoerotic.t: adj. 自慰的；自我性欲的

e.en: Her therapist discussed {autoerotic} behaviors as part of normal development.
e.zh: 她的治疗师把自慰行为作为正常发育的一部分来讨论。

e.en: The book explored {autoerotic} themes with clinical precision.
e.zh: 这本书以临床的精准度探讨了自慰相关的主题。

autofocus.t:
n. 自动对焦
v. 自动对焦

e.en: The new camera's {autofocus} locks on faces almost instantly.
e.zh: 这款新相机的自动对焦几乎瞬间就能锁定人脸。

e.en: Turn off {autofocus} when shooting through a glass window.
e.zh: 隔着玻璃窗拍摄时请关闭自动对焦。

e.en: She practices {autogenic} training to manage her anxiety.
e.zh: 她练习自律训练法来缓解焦虑。

e.en: The therapist taught {autogenic} relaxation techniques to reduce stress.
e.zh: 治疗师教授自律放松技巧来减轻压力。

autograph.t:
n. 亲笔签名
v. 签名（于）

e.en: Fans waited two hours for the singer's {autograph}.
e.zh: 粉丝们等了两个小时就为了拿到歌手的签名。

e.en: Could you {autograph} my book, please?
e.zh: 请您在我的书上签个名好吗?

e.en: He proudly displayed the {autographed} baseball in his office.
e.zh: 他自豪地把那个签名棒球摆在办公室里。

e.en: The author {autographed} copies for everyone in line.
e.zh: 作者为排队的每个人签了书。

e.en: Lupus is a chronic {autoimmune} disease affecting many organs.
e.zh: 狼疮是一种影响多个器官的慢性自身免疫性疾病。

e.en: Doctors suspect an {autoimmune} disorder caused her joint pain.
e.zh: 医生怀疑是自身免疫性疾病导致了她的关节疼痛。

e.en: Researchers are studying the genetic basis of {autoimmunity}.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究自身免疫的遗传基础。

e.en: Stress may trigger {autoimmunity} in genetically susceptible individuals.
e.zh: 压力可能会在基因易感人群中引发自身免疫反应。

autoloader.t: n. 自动装填装置；自动装载机

e.en: The composer loads classes through PHP's class {autoloader}.
e.zh: 这位编程者通过 PHP 的类自动加载器加载类。

e.en: Modern frameworks rely on an {autoloader} to find files.
e.zh: 现代框架依赖自动加载器来查找文件。

autologous.t: adj. 自体的（自身来源的）

e.en: The patient received an {autologous} stem cell transplant last week.
e.zh: 该患者上周接受了自体干细胞移植。

e.en: Surgeons prefer {autologous} tissue grafts to reduce rejection risk.
e.zh: 外科医生倾向使用自体组织移植以降低排斥风险。

e.en: The Japanese {automaker} announced a new electric SUV today.
e.zh: 这家日本汽车制造商今天发布了一款新电动 SUV。

e.en: Every major {automaker} is racing to build self-driving cars.
e.zh: 每家主要汽车制造商都在抢着造自动驾驶汽车。

e.en: My grandfather used to grab lunch at the {automat} downtown.
e.zh: 我祖父过去常在市中心的自动售餐厅吃午饭。

e.en: The retro diner was modeled after a 1950s {automat}.
e.zh: 这家复古餐厅是仿照 1950 年代的自动售餐厅设计的。

automata.t: n. 自动机（automaton 的复数）

e.en: The course covers finite {automata} and formal language theory.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖有限自动机和形式语言理论。

e.en: Eighteenth-century craftsmen built mechanical {automata} that mimicked living creatures.
e.zh: 十八世纪的工匠制作了模仿生物的机械自动装置。

e.en: We use scripts to {automate} our deployment pipeline.
e.zh: 我们用脚本来自动化我们的部署流程。

e.en: The factory plans to {automate} most assembly line tasks.
e.zh: 工厂计划把大部分装配线工作自动化。

automated.t: adj. 自动化的；自动执行的

e.en: Customers complain about the company's {automated} phone system.
e.zh: 客户抱怨这家公司的自动电话系统。

e.en: The bank {automated} loan approval using machine learning.
e.zh: 该银行用机器学习实现了贷款审批自动化。

automates.t: v. 使自动化（第三人称单数）

e.en: This tool {automates} repetitive data entry tasks.
e.zh: 这款工具能自动完成重复性的数据录入工作。

e.en: The new software {automates} invoice processing across departments.
e.zh: 新软件将各部门的发票处理流程自动化。

automatic.t:
adj. 自动的；无意识的
n. 自动档汽车；自动武器

e.en: My new washer has an {automatic} detergent dispenser.
e.zh: 我的新洗衣机有一个自动洗涤剂分配器。

e.en: Praise becomes {automatic} when you do something every day.
e.zh: 当你每天都做一件事时,夸奖就会变得自然而然。

e.en: The lights turn off {automatically} when no one's home.
e.zh: 家里没人时,灯会自动关闭。

e.en: Subscribers are {automatically} charged on the first of each month.
e.zh: 订阅者会在每月一号自动扣款。

e.en: The factory was {automaticed} after the management restructure.
e.zh: 管理重组后,这家工厂被自动化改造了。

e.en: Several routine checks were {automaticed} to save staff time.
e.zh: 几项常规检查被自动化处理以节省员工时间。

e.en: They are {automaticing} the entire customer service workflow.
e.zh: 他们正在将整个客服流程自动化。

e.en: The team spent months {automaticing} previously manual reports.
e.zh: 团队花了几个月把以前的手动报表自动化。

e.en: Daily practice builds {automaticity} when reading new languages.
e.zh: 每天练习能在阅读新语言时建立自动化能力。

e.en: Skilled drivers operate the pedals with complete {automaticity}.
e.zh: 熟练的司机能完全自动地操作踏板。

automatics.t: n. 自动武器；自动档车（复数）

e.en: He prefers manual transmissions over {automatics} for sports cars.
e.zh: 对于跑车,他更喜欢手动挡而不是自动挡。

e.en: Modern {automatics} actually deliver better fuel economy than manuals.
e.zh: 现代自动挡车的油耗实际上比手动挡更省油。

automating.t: v. 使自动化（现在分词）

e.en: She's busy {automating} the team's weekly reporting process.
e.zh: 她正忙着把团队的每周报告流程自动化。

e.en: {Automating} repetitive tasks frees engineers to tackle harder problems.
e.zh: 将重复任务自动化可以让工程师腾出手来处理更难的问题。

e.en: Factory {automation} has dramatically reduced production costs.
e.zh: 工厂自动化大幅降低了生产成本。

e.en: Many fear {automation} will eliminate millions of jobs.
e.zh: 许多人担心自动化会让数百万人失业。

automatism.t: n. 无意识动作；自动行为

e.en: The defendant claimed {automatism} due to a sleepwalking episode.
e.zh: 被告以梦游为由声称自己处于无意识状态。

e.en: Surrealist painters explored {automatism} to bypass conscious thought.
e.zh: 超现实主义画家探索自动主义,以绕过有意识的思考。

automaton.t: n. 自动机器人；机械般行动的人

e.en: He moved through his job like a tired {automaton}.
e.zh: 他像个疲惫的机器人一样机械地完成工作。

e.en: The museum displayed an eighteenth-century chess-playing {automaton}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台十八世纪的下棋自动机。

e.en: The first mass-produced {automobile} changed American life forever.
e.zh: 第一款量产汽车永远地改变了美国人的生活。

e.en: He works as an {automobile} engineer at Ford.
e.zh: 他在福特做汽车工程师。

e.en: The {automotive} industry is shifting rapidly toward electric vehicles.
e.zh: 汽车行业正快速向电动车转型。

e.en: She runs a small {automotive} repair shop downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心经营一家小型汽车修理店。

e.en: Breathing is controlled by the {autonomic} nervous system.
e.zh: 呼吸是由自主神经系统控制的。

e.en: Stress can disrupt normal {autonomic} responses like heart rate.
e.zh: 压力会扰乱心率等正常的自主神经反应。

e.en: Spain grants different {autonomies} to its various regions.
e.zh: 西班牙给予其各地区不同的自治权。

e.en: The treaty preserved local {autonomies} within the federation.
e.zh: 该条约保留了联邦内部的地方自治权。

e.en: Tesla is testing fully {autonomous} taxis in several cities.
e.zh: 特斯拉正在多个城市测试完全自动驾驶的出租车。

e.en: Tibet is technically an {autonomous} region of China.
e.zh: 西藏在名义上是中国的一个自治区。

e.en: The drone navigates {autonomously} using GPS and onboard cameras.
e.zh: 这架无人机利用 GPS 和机载摄像头自主导航。

e.en: Each team operates {autonomously} but reports to the same director.
e.zh: 每个团队自主运作,但都向同一位主管汇报。

e.en: Remote workers value the {autonomy} their jobs provide.
e.zh: 远程工作者很看重工作带给他们的自主权。

e.en: The province demanded greater {autonomy} from the central government.
e.zh: 该省要求中央政府给予更大的自治权。

e.en: The captain switched on {autopilot} after reaching cruising altitude.
e.zh: 机长在达到巡航高度后开启了自动驾驶。

e.en: I was on {autopilot} during my entire morning commute.
e.zh: 整个早上的通勤我都处于无意识的状态。

e.en: Modern {autopilots} can land planes in zero-visibility conditions.
e.zh: 现代自动驾驶系统能在零能见度下让飞机着陆。

e.en: Ships use sophisticated {autopilots} to maintain course across oceans.
e.zh: 船只使用先进的自动驾驶系统来保持跨洋航向。

e.en: The {autopsy} revealed the victim died of poisoning.
e.zh: 尸检显示受害者死于中毒。

e.en: The team did a project {autopsy} to identify what failed.
e.zh: 团队对项目做了一次复盘以找出失败原因。

e.en: The lab used {autoradiography} to image radioactive isotopes in tissue.
e.zh: 实验室使用放射自显影技术对组织中的放射性同位素成像。

e.en: {Autoradiography} reveals where the labeled DNA bound on the gel.
e.zh: 放射自显影显示了带标记的DNA在凝胶上的结合位置。

autoregressive.t: adj. 自回归的（统计、模型）

e.en: GPT models are {autoregressive}, predicting one token at a time.
e.zh: GPT模型是自回归的,每次预测一个词元。

e.en: Economists fitted an {autoregressive} model to the inflation data.
e.zh: 经济学家用自回归模型拟合了通胀数据。

e.en: The system will {autoroute} support tickets to the right team.
e.zh: 系统会自动把客服工单分派到对应团队。

e.en: We took the {autoroute} south toward Lyon last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们走高速公路一路南下到里昂。

e.en: Used {autos} are selling fast in the local dealership.
e.zh: 当地经销店里的二手车卖得很快。

e.en: He collects vintage {autos} from the 1950s.
e.zh: 他收藏五十年代的老式汽车。

e.en: Cystic fibrosis is an {autosomal} recessive disorder.
e.zh: 囊性纤维化是一种常染色体隐性遗传疾病。

e.en: The trait shows clear {autosomal} dominant inheritance in the family.
e.zh: 该性状在该家族中表现为明显的常染色体显性遗传。

e.en: We sped along the Italian {autostrada} toward Milan.
e.zh: 我们沿着意大利高速公路飞驰前往米兰。

e.en: Tolls on the {autostrada} are paid at exit booths.
e.zh: 高速公路的过路费在出口收费亭支付。

e.en: Her father worked as an {autoworker} in Detroit for decades.
e.zh: 她父亲在底特律当了几十年的汽车工人。

e.en: The strike rallied thousands of {autoworker} families across the state.
e.zh: 这次罢工凝聚了全州数千个汽车工人家庭。

e.en: The leaves turn bright red every {autumn} here.
e.zh: 这里每到秋天树叶都会变成鲜红色。

e.en: She prefers {autumn} hikes when the weather is cool.
e.zh: 她更喜欢在凉爽的秋天去远足。

e.en: The café switched to an {autumnal} menu of pumpkin and spice.
e.zh: 咖啡馆换上了以南瓜和香料为主的秋季菜单。

e.en: He wore an {autumnal} sweater in deep orange tones.
e.zh: 他穿着一件深橙色调的秋意毛衣。

e.en: She has spent ten {autumns} living in this old town.
e.zh: 她已在这座老城度过了十个秋天。

e.en: New England {autumns} attract photographers from around the world.
e.zh: 新英格兰的秋天吸引着世界各地的摄影师。

avila.t: n. 阿维拉（西班牙城市）

e.en: The medieval walls of {Avila} are remarkably well preserved.
e.zh: 阿维拉的中世纪城墙保存得非常完好。

e.en: Saint Teresa of {Avila} wrote influential spiritual texts.
e.zh: 阿维拉的圣特蕾莎写下了具有影响力的灵修著作。

e.en: The jet's {avionics} were upgraded with new navigation software.
e.zh: 这架喷气机的航电系统升级了新的导航软件。

e.en: Modern {avionics} allow pilots to fly in poor visibility.
e.zh: 现代航电设备让飞行员能在能见度差的情况下飞行。

aviv.t: n. 阿维夫（人名，常见于 Tel Aviv）

e.en: Tel {Aviv} is famous for its beaches and nightlife.
e.zh: 特拉维夫以其海滩和夜生活而闻名。

e.en: Her flight to Tel {Aviv} departs early tomorrow.
e.zh: 她飞往特拉维夫的航班明天一早起飞。

e.en: I had {avocado} toast for breakfast this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我吃了牛油果吐司当早餐。

e.en: A ripe {avocado} should yield gently to pressure.
e.zh: 成熟的牛油果按下去应该有微微的弹性。

e.en: Photography started as an {avocation} but became his career.
e.zh: 摄影最初是他的业余爱好,后来成了他的职业。

e.en: Gardening is her favorite weekend {avocation}.
e.zh: 园艺是她最喜欢的周末业余消遣。

avocational.t: adj. 业余爱好的，副业的

e.en: He pursues astronomy on an {avocational} basis.
e.zh: 他以业余的方式钻研天文学。

e.en: The club welcomes both professional and {avocational} musicians.
e.zh: 该俱乐部欢迎专业和业余的音乐爱好者。

e.en: Try to {avoid} clicking suspicious links in emails.
e.zh: 尽量避免点击邮件中的可疑链接。

e.en: We took a side road to {avoid} the traffic.
e.zh: 我们走了条小路以避开拥堵。

e.en: Most of these errors are easily {avoidable} with good planning.
e.zh: 只要规划得当,这些错误大多是可以避免的。

e.en: The accident was entirely {avoidable} if drivers stayed alert.
e.zh: 如果司机保持警觉,这场事故完全可以避免。

e.en: His {avoidance} of the topic suggested he felt guilty.
e.zh: 他对这个话题的回避显示他心里有愧。

e.en: Tax {avoidance} is legal, but tax evasion is not.
e.zh: 避税是合法的,但逃税不是。

avoided.t: v. 避免（avoid 的过去式）

e.en: She {avoided} eye contact throughout the awkward meeting.
e.zh: 在那场尴尬的会议中,她一直避免眼神接触。

e.en: The driver narrowly {avoided} a collision on the highway.
e.zh: 司机在高速公路上险些撞车。

e.en: He's a chronic conflict {avoider} who never speaks up.
e.zh: 他是个习惯性回避冲突的人,从不主动表态。

e.en: As a tax {avoider}, she carefully studied the loopholes.
e.zh: 作为一个避税者,她仔细研究了各种漏洞。

avoiding.t: v. 正在避免（avoid 的现在分词）

e.en: She's been {avoiding} my calls for several days.
e.zh: 她已经好几天不接我的电话了。

e.en: The app helps drivers in {avoiding} congested routes.
e.zh: 这个应用程序帮助司机避开拥堵路线。

avoids.t: v. 避免（avoid 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He carefully {avoids} processed sugar in his diet.
e.zh: 他在饮食中刻意避开加工糖。

e.en: The shy cat {avoids} strangers whenever possible.
e.zh: 那只害羞的猫只要可能就躲着陌生人。

avon.t: n. 雅芳（化妆品品牌）；埃文河（英国）

e.en: Shakespeare was born in Stratford-upon-{Avon} in 1564.
e.zh: 莎士比亚于1564年出生于埃文河畔斯特拉特福。

e.en: My grandmother used to sell {Avon} cosmetics door to door.
e.zh: 我祖母过去常常挨家挨户推销雅芳化妆品。

avonmouth.t: n. 埃文茅斯（英国港口）

e.en: Container ships dock regularly at the port of {Avonmouth}.
e.zh: 集装箱船定期停靠在埃文茅斯港。

e.en: He works at a chemical plant near {Avonmouth}.
e.zh: 他在埃文茅斯附近的一家化工厂工作。

e.en: I can {avouch} for the accuracy of his report.
e.zh: 我可以担保他报告的准确性。

e.en: Several witnesses {avouch} the truth of her statement.
e.zh: 几位证人证实了她陈述的真实性。

e.en: She was willing to {avow} her support for the candidate.
e.zh: 她愿意公开声明对那位候选人的支持。

e.en: Few politicians {avow} their mistakes so openly.
e.zh: 很少有政客如此坦率地承认自己的错误。

e.en: His public {avowal} of guilt shocked the community.
e.zh: 他公开承认有罪震惊了整个社区。

e.en: The letter contained a heartfelt {avowal} of love.
e.zh: 那封信里包含了一段真挚的爱情表白。

avowed.t: adj. 公开宣称的，公认的

e.en: She is an {avowed} fan of classic horror films.
e.zh: 她是公认的经典恐怖片粉丝。

e.en: The senator is an {avowed} opponent of the new bill.
e.zh: 那位参议员公开反对这项新法案。

e.en: The magazine is {avowedly} progressive in its politics.
e.zh: 这本杂志在政治立场上公开宣称是进步派的。

e.en: He is {avowedly} skeptical of cryptocurrency investments.
e.zh: 他坦言对加密货币投资持怀疑态度。

avro.t: n. 阿弗罗（英国飞机制造商）

e.en: The {Avro} Lancaster was a famous British bomber.
e.zh: 阿芙罗兰开斯特是一款著名的英国轰炸机。

e.en: Our data pipeline uses {Avro} for efficient serialization.
e.zh: 我们的数据管道使用 Avro 进行高效的序列化。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed an {avulsion} fracture in his ankle.
e.zh: 医生诊断他的脚踝是撕脱性骨折。

e.en: A river {avulsion} dramatically changed the floodplain's shape.
e.zh: 河流改道大幅改变了泛洪平原的形状。

avuncular.t: adj. 像叔伯一样（慈祥）的

e.en: The professor had an {avuncular} manner that put students at ease.
e.zh: 那位教授有种慈祥长辈般的风度,让学生感到放松。

e.en: He gave me {avuncular} advice about my career choices.
e.zh: 他像长辈一样给了我关于职业选择的建议。

awa.t: adv. 走开，离开（苏格兰方言）

e.en: In Scottish dialect, {awa} simply means away.
e.zh: 在苏格兰方言里,awa 就是 away 的意思。

e.en: The old song urges listeners to gang {awa} home.
e.zh: 那首老歌劝听众回家去吧。

e.en: Several surprises {await} you at the party tonight.
e.zh: 今晚的派对上有几个惊喜等着你。

e.en: We {await} the test results with growing anxiety.
e.zh: 我们越来越焦虑地等待检测结果。

awaited.t: v. 等待（await 的过去式）

e.en: The long-{awaited} sequel finally hit theaters last weekend.
e.zh: 期待已久的续集终于在上周末上映了。

e.en: She {awaited} his reply by the phone all evening.
e.zh: 她整晚都守在电话旁等他回复。

awaiting.t: v. 正在等待（await 的现在分词）

e.en: Your package is currently {awaiting} customs clearance.
e.zh: 您的包裹目前正在等待海关清关。

e.en: He sat quietly, {awaiting} the doctor's diagnosis.
e.zh: 他静静地坐着,等待医生的诊断。

awaits.t: v. 等待（await 的第三人称单数）

e.en: A bright future {awaits} this talented young athlete.
e.zh: 光明的未来正等待着这位有天赋的年轻运动员。

e.en: Your driver {awaits} you at the hotel entrance.
e.zh: 您的司机正在酒店门口等候。

awake.t:
adj. 醒着的
v. 醒来，唤醒

e.en: I lay {awake} for hours thinking about the interview.
e.zh: 我躺在床上几个小时睡不着,一直想着面试的事。

e.en: The baby is finally {awake} and ready to play.
e.zh: 宝宝终于醒了,准备好玩耍了。

e.en: The smell of coffee can {awaken} even the deepest sleeper.
e.zh: 咖啡的香味能唤醒就连睡得最沉的人。

e.en: The documentary helped {awaken} public concern about climate change.
e.zh: 这部纪录片唤起了公众对气候变化的关注。

awakened.t: v. 唤醒（awaken 的过去式）

e.en: I was {awakened} at dawn by birdsong outside the window.
e.zh: 我在黎明时被窗外的鸟鸣声唤醒。

e.en: The trip {awakened} her interest in marine biology.
e.zh: 那次旅行唤起了她对海洋生物学的兴趣。

awakening.t:
n. 觉醒，觉悟
v. 唤醒中

e.en: Moving abroad was a real cultural {awakening} for him.
e.zh: 出国生活对他来说是一次真正的文化觉醒。

e.en: The city is slowly {awakening} as the sun rises.
e.zh: 随着太阳升起,这座城市正缓缓苏醒。

award.t:
n. 奖项，奖励
v. 授予，颁发

e.en: She won an {award} for best supporting actress.
e.zh: 她赢得了最佳女配角奖。

e.en: The judge will {award} damages to the injured party.
e.zh: 法官将判给受伤方损害赔偿。

awarded.t: v. 授予（award 的过去式）

e.en: He was {awarded} a scholarship to study in Tokyo.
e.zh: 他获得了赴东京学习的奖学金。

e.en: The court {awarded} her full custody of the children.
e.zh: 法庭判给她孩子的完全监护权。

awarding.t: v. 颁发（award 的现在分词）

e.en: The committee is {awarding} grants to ten promising researchers.
e.zh: 委员会正在向十位有潜力的研究人员颁发资助。

e.en: The judge is {awarding} the contract to the lowest bidder.
e.zh: 法官正把合同判给出价最低的投标方。

e.en: The film swept all the major {awards} this year.
e.zh: 这部电影横扫了今年的所有主要奖项。

e.en: She {awards} bonus points to students who participate.
e.zh: 她会给参与的学生加分。

e.en: Are you {aware} that the deadline has been moved up?
e.zh: 你知道截止日期提前了吗?

e.en: He's deeply {aware} of his own privilege and limitations.
e.zh: 他深刻地意识到自己的特权和局限。

e.en: The campaign aims to raise {awareness} about mental health.
e.zh: 这场活动旨在提高人们对心理健康的认识。

e.en: Meditation can improve your {awareness} of bodily sensations.
e.zh: 冥想可以增强你对身体感受的觉察力。

e.en: Different cultural {awarenesses} shaped the team's design choices.
e.zh: 不同的文化意识塑造了团队的设计选择。

e.en: The workshop explored various social {awarenesses} among teenagers.
e.zh: 工作坊探讨了青少年中各种各样的社会意识。

e.en: The basement was {awash} with water after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后,地下室全被水淹没了。

e.en: Social media is {awash} with conspiracy theories these days.
e.zh: 如今社交媒体上充斥着各种阴谋论。

e.en: My parents live three hours {away} by train.
e.zh: 我父母住的地方坐火车要三小时。

e.en: Please put your phones {away} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会期间请把手机收起来。

awe.t:
n. 敬畏
v. 使敬畏

e.en: The view from the summit filled us with {awe}.
e.zh: 从山顶看到的景色让我们心生敬畏。

e.en: Children watched the magician in stunned {awe}.
e.zh: 孩子们惊叹地看着魔术师表演。

awe-inspiring.t: adj. 令人敬畏的，震撼的

e.en: The Grand Canyon is truly an {awe-inspiring} sight.
e.zh: 大峡谷真是一处令人敬畏的奇景。

e.en: Her dedication to the cause was {awe-inspiring} to everyone.
e.zh: 她对这项事业的奉献令所有人肃然起敬。

e.en: Tourists stood {awed} before the ancient cathedral's facade.
e.zh: 游客们敬畏地站在古老大教堂的正面前。

e.en: The audience was {awed} by her powerful performance.
e.zh: 观众被她极具感染力的表演震撼了。

awes.t: v. 使敬畏（awe 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The sheer scale of the universe still {awes} astronomers.
e.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚至今仍让天文学家感到敬畏。

e.en: Her quiet courage {awes} everyone who meets her.
e.zh: 她沉静的勇气让每一个见到她的人肃然起敬。

e.en: That concert last night was absolutely {awesome}.
e.zh: 昨晚那场演唱会真是太棒了。

e.en: The view from the mountaintop is truly {awesome}.
e.zh: 从山顶看到的景色令人惊叹。

awesomely.t: adv. 极棒地，令人惊叹地

e.en: The new phone is {awesomely} fast and responsive.
e.zh: 这款新手机的速度反应快得惊人。

e.en: She {awesomely} solved the puzzle in under a minute.
e.zh: 她不到一分钟就漂亮地解开了谜题。

awestruck.t: adj. 充满敬畏的，惊叹的

e.en: The children stood {awestruck} before the giant dinosaur skeleton.
e.zh: 孩子们站在巨大的恐龙骨架前惊叹不已。

e.en: Tourists were {awestruck} by the beauty of the canyon.
e.zh: 游客们被峡谷的美景震撼得目瞪口呆。

e.en: The traffic this morning was absolutely {awful}.
e.zh: 今天早上的交通真是糟透了。

e.en: I feel {awful} about forgetting your birthday.
e.zh: 我忘了你的生日,感觉很愧疚。

e.en: It's {awfully} kind of you to help me move.
e.zh: 你来帮我搬家真是太好了。

e.en: The soup tastes {awfully} salty tonight.
e.zh: 今晚这汤咸得不行。

e.en: Nobody could ignore the sheer {awfulness} of the news.
e.zh: 没人能忽视这则新闻有多么糟糕。

e.en: She described the {awfulness} of the long flight in detail.
e.zh: 她详细描述了那趟长途飞行有多难熬。

e.en: Let's sit and chat {awhile} before dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭前我们坐着聊一会儿吧。

e.en: I haven't seen him in {awhile}.
e.zh: 我已经有一阵子没见过他了。

awing.t: v. 使敬畏（awe 的现在分词）

e.en: The fireworks display was truly {awing} to watch.
e.zh: 那场烟花表演看着真令人惊叹。

e.en: The vast night sky has an {awing} effect on visitors.
e.zh: 浩瀚的夜空让游客们心生敬畏。

e.en: There was an {awkward} silence after his joke.
e.zh: 他讲完笑话后场面陷入了尴尬的沉默。

e.en: This box is too {awkward} to carry alone.
e.zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太不方便了。

e.en: He {awkwardly} tried to explain why he was late.
e.zh: 他笨拙地解释自己为什么迟到。

e.en: She smiled {awkwardly} when her ex walked in.
e.zh: 前任走进来时她尴尬地笑了笑。

e.en: There was a moment of {awkwardness} between the old friends.
e.zh: 老朋友之间出现了片刻的尴尬。

e.en: He laughed to cover up his {awkwardness}.
e.zh: 他用笑声掩饰自己的尴尬。

e.en: The shoemaker used an {awl} to punch holes in the leather.
e.zh: 鞋匠用锥子在皮革上扎孔。

e.en: She kept a small {awl} in her sewing kit.
e.zh: 她的针线盒里放着一把小锥子。

e.en: We took shelter under the café's striped {awning}.
e.zh: 我们在咖啡馆的条纹遮阳篷下躲雨。

e.en: The shop's red {awning} flapped in the wind.
e.zh: 店铺的红色遮阳棚在风中啪啪作响。

awol.t: adj. 擅离职守的（军事缩写）

e.en: Two soldiers went {awol} during the night.
e.zh: 两名士兵在夜里擅自离营了。

e.en: My coworker has been {awol} from meetings all week.
e.zh: 我同事整周都没出现在会议上。

awry.t:
adv. 出岔子；不对劲
adj. 歪的

e.en: Their carefully laid plans went completely {awry}.
e.zh: 他们精心制定的计划全乱套了。

e.en: His tie was hanging {awry} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他的领带歪到了一边。

aww.t: int. 哎呀；真可爱（网络感叹）

e.en: "{Aww}, that puppy is so cute!" she exclaimed.
e.zh: “哎呀,那只小狗好可爱!”她惊呼道。

e.en: {Aww}, I'm sorry to hear about your bad day.
e.zh: 哎,听说你今天不顺,真替你难过。

axa.t: n. 安盛（法国保险集团）

e.en: She bought her car insurance from {AXA} last year.
e.zh: 她去年在安盛购买了车险。

e.en: {AXA} is one of the largest insurance companies in Europe.
e.zh: 安盛是欧洲最大的保险公司之一。

axe.t:
n. 斧头
v. 砍掉；裁员

e.en: He used an {axe} to chop firewood for winter.
e.zh: 他用斧头劈柴过冬。

e.en: The company decided to {axe} the unprofitable product line.
e.zh: 公司决定砍掉那条不赚钱的产品线。

axel.t: n. 阿克塞尔跳（花样滑冰动作）

e.en: The skater landed a triple {axel} flawlessly.
e.zh: 那名滑冰选手完美地完成了三周阿克塞尔跳。

e.en: Practicing the {axel} takes years of dedication.
e.zh: 练成阿克塞尔跳需要多年的努力。

e.en: The {axeman} swung his blade with practiced ease.
e.zh: 那位斧手熟练自如地挥动着斧刃。

e.en: The band's lead {axeman} stole the show with his solo.
e.zh: 乐队的主音吉他手凭独奏抢尽了风头。

axes.t: n. 轴（axis 的复数）；斧头（axe 的复数）

e.en: The graph has labeled {axes} for time and temperature.
e.zh: 该图表的坐标轴分别标注了时间和温度。

e.en: The lumberjacks sharpened their {axes} before heading out.
e.zh: 伐木工人出发前磨快了他们的斧头。

e.en: The engineer measured the {axial} load on the shaft.
e.zh: 工程师测量了轴上的轴向载荷。

e.en: An {axial} CT scan revealed the tumor's exact location.
e.zh: 轴向CT扫描显示出了肿瘤的确切位置。

e.en: The bearing is loaded {axially} during normal operation.
e.zh: 轴承在正常运转时受到轴向载荷。

e.en: The components are aligned {axially} for smooth rotation.
e.zh: 这些部件沿轴向对齐以实现平稳转动。

e.en: The doctor checked the lymph nodes in the {axilla}.
e.zh: 医生检查了腋窝处的淋巴结。

e.en: Sweat glands are highly concentrated in the {axilla}.
e.zh: 汗腺高度集中在腋窝部位。

e.en: The surgeon removed several {axillary} lymph nodes for testing.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了几个腋窝淋巴结进行检测。

e.en: The plant develops {axillary} buds along its stem.
e.zh: 这种植物会沿茎部长出腋芽。

axing.t: v. 砍掉；裁撤（ax 的现在分词）

e.en: The studio is {axing} the show after one season.
e.zh: 该工作室在播完一季后就把这部剧砍掉了。

e.en: Management is {axing} hundreds of jobs to cut costs.
e.zh: 管理层为削减成本正在裁掉数百个职位。

e.en: The professor explored {axiological} questions about right and wrong.
e.zh: 教授探讨了关于对错的价值论问题。

e.en: Her dissertation took an {axiological} approach to ethics.
e.zh: 她的论文从价值论角度研究伦理学。

e.en: "Time is money" is a common business {axiom}.
e.zh: “时间就是金钱”是一句常见的商业格言。

e.en: Every geometric proof starts from a basic {axiom}.
e.zh: 每个几何证明都是从一条基本公理开始的。

axiomatic.t: adj. 不言自明的；公理的

e.en: It's {axiomatic} that good design starts with the user.
e.zh: 好的设计从用户出发,这是不言自明的。

e.en: Honesty in journalism should be {axiomatic}.
e.zh: 新闻报道中的诚实本应是天经地义的。

e.en: Euclidean geometry is built on a few simple {axioms}.
e.zh: 欧几里得几何建立在几条简单的公理之上。

e.en: Her grandmother loved repeating old {axioms} about hard work.
e.zh: 她祖母喜欢反复念叨那些关于勤奋的老格言。

axion.t: n. 轴子（物理学假想粒子）

e.en: Physicists are searching for the elusive {axion} particle.
e.zh: 物理学家们正在寻找难以捉摸的轴子粒子。

e.en: The {axion} could explain a major puzzle in physics.
e.zh: 轴子或许能解开物理学中的一个重大谜题。

e.en: The Earth rotates on its {axis} once every day.
e.zh: 地球每天绕自己的地轴自转一圈。

e.en: Label the horizontal {axis} with time in seconds.
e.zh: 请将横轴标注为以秒为单位的时间。

e.en: The engineers designed an {axisymmetric} nozzle for the rocket.
e.zh: 工程师们为火箭设计了一个轴对称喷嘴。

e.en: This {axisymmetric} model simplifies the flow simulation.
e.zh: 这个轴对称模型简化了流场仿真计算。

e.en: The truck's rear {axle} broke on the rough road.
e.zh: 卡车的后桥在颠簸的路上断了。

e.en: He greased the {axle} before the long road trip.
e.zh: 长途出行前他给车轴上了油。

axminster.t: n. 阿克斯明斯特地毯（一种英国地毯）

e.en: The hotel lobby featured a luxurious {axminster} carpet.
e.zh: 酒店大堂铺着一块奢华的阿克斯明斯特地毯。

e.en: She inherited an antique {axminster} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一块古董阿克斯明斯特地毯。

e.en: Each neuron sends signals through a long {axon}.
e.zh: 每个神经元通过长长的轴突传递信号。

e.en: Damage to the {axon} can disrupt nerve communication.
e.zh: 轴突受损会扰乱神经间的信号传递。

e.en: The injury caused significant {axonal} damage in the brain.
e.zh: 这次受伤导致大脑中出现了严重的轴突损伤。

e.en: Researchers studied {axonal} growth in developing neurons.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了发育中神经元的轴突生长情况。

e.en: The {ayah} took the children to the park each afternoon.
e.zh: 那位印度保姆每天下午都带孩子们去公园。

e.en: Her childhood {ayah} taught her several Hindi songs.
e.zh: 她童年时的保姆教过她好几首印地语歌曲。

ayatollah.t: n. 阿亚图拉（什叶派高阶神职）

e.en: The {ayatollah} addressed the crowd from the balcony.
e.zh: 阿亚图拉在阳台上向人群发表讲话。

e.en: His speech echoed the words of a senior {ayatollah}.
e.zh: 他的演讲呼应了一位资深阿亚图拉的话。

aye.t:
int. 赞成；是
n. 赞成票

e.en: All those in favor, please say "{aye}."
e.zh: 赞成的请说“同意”。

e.en: "{Aye}, captain," the sailor replied promptly.
e.zh: “是,船长,”水手立刻应答道。

ayers.t: n. 艾尔斯（姓氏；如 Ayers Rock）

e.en: Tourists flock to {Ayers} Rock to watch the sunset.
e.zh: 游客们蜂拥前往艾尔斯岩观赏日落。

e.en: {Ayers} Rock is sacred to Australia's Aboriginal people.
e.zh: 艾尔斯岩对澳大利亚原住民来说是圣地。

aylesbury.t: n. 艾尔斯伯里（英国城镇）

e.en: They raised {Aylesbury} ducks on their small farm.
e.zh: 他们在自家小农场养了艾尔斯伯里鸭。

e.en: The town of {Aylesbury} lies northwest of London.
e.zh: 艾尔斯伯里镇位于伦敦西北方向。

ayodhya.t: n. 阿约提亚（印度古城）

e.en: Pilgrims travel to {Ayodhya} from across India each year.
e.zh: 每年都有来自印度各地的朝圣者前往阿约提亚。

e.en: {Ayodhya} is considered the birthplace of Lord Rama.
e.zh: 阿约提亚被视为罗摩神的诞生地。

e.en: We spent the weekend on the beach at {Ayr}.
e.zh: 我们在艾尔的海滩上度过了周末。

e.en: The poet Robert Burns lived near {Ayr} in Scotland.
e.zh: 诗人罗伯特·彭斯曾居住在苏格兰艾尔附近。

ayrshire.t: n. 艾尔郡（苏格兰地区）

e.en: The farm raises {Ayrshire} cattle for their rich milk.
e.zh: 这家农场饲养艾尔郡奶牛以获取浓郁的牛奶。

e.en: {Ayrshire} is a beautiful coastal region in Scotland.
e.zh: 艾尔郡是苏格兰一处美丽的沿海地区。

ayurvedic.t: adj. 阿育吠陀的（印度传统医学）

e.en: She tried {ayurvedic} medicine for her chronic headaches.
e.zh: 她尝试用阿育吠陀医学治疗慢性头痛。

e.en: The spa offers traditional {ayurvedic} massage treatments.
e.zh: 这家水疗中心提供传统的阿育吠陀按摩疗程。

e.en: The {azalea} bushes bloomed brilliantly in early spring.
e.zh: 杜鹃花丛在初春绚丽绽放。

e.en: She planted a pink {azalea} by the front porch.
e.zh: 她在前廊旁种了一棵粉色杜鹃花。

e.en: {Azerbaijan} is known for its rich oil reserves.
e.zh: 阿塞拜疆以丰富的石油储量而闻名。

e.en: The capital of {Azerbaijan} is Baku, on the Caspian Sea.
e.zh: 阿塞拜疆的首都是位于里海之滨的巴库。

azerbaijani.t:
n. 阿塞拜疆人
adj. 阿塞拜疆的

e.en: She enjoyed an {Azerbaijani} dinner at the new restaurant.
e.zh: 她在那家新餐厅享用了一顿阿塞拜疆晚餐。

e.en: The {Azerbaijani} delegation arrived at the summit yesterday.
e.zh: 阿塞拜疆代表团昨天抵达了峰会现场。

azeri.t:
adj. 阿塞拜疆的
n. 阿塞拜疆人

e.en: He learned a few {Azeri} phrases before his trip.
e.zh: 出行前他学了几句阿塞拜疆语。

e.en: The festival celebrated traditional {Azeri} music and dance.
e.zh: 该节庆活动展示了传统的阿塞拜疆音乐与舞蹈。

e.en: The pilot adjusted the antenna's {azimuth} to track the satellite.
e.zh: 飞行员调整天线的方位角以跟踪卫星。

e.en: Hikers use a compass to determine the {azimuth} of distant peaks.
e.zh: 徒步者用指南针测定远处山峰的方位角。

e.en: The map uses an {azimuthal} projection centered on the North Pole.
e.zh: 这张地图采用以北极为中心的方位投影。

e.en: Engineers measured the {azimuthal} angle of the radar dish.
e.zh: 工程师测量了雷达天线的方位角度。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {azithromycin} for her chest infection.
e.zh: 医生给她开了阿奇霉素治疗胸部感染。

e.en: {Azithromycin} is commonly used to treat bacterial infections.
e.zh: 阿奇霉素常用于治疗细菌感染。

azt.t: n. 齐多夫定（抗艾滋病药物）

e.en: {AZT} was the first approved drug to treat HIV.
e.zh: 齐多夫定是首个获批治疗艾滋病的药物。

e.en: Patients in the trial received {AZT} twice daily.
e.zh: 试验中的患者每日服用两次齐多夫定。

aztec.t:
n. 阿兹特克人
adj. 阿兹特克的

e.en: The museum displays an ancient {Aztec} calendar stone.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一块古老的阿兹特克历石。

e.en: {Aztec} warriors once ruled much of central Mexico.
e.zh: 阿兹特克武士曾统治墨西哥中部的大片地区。

azure.t:
adj. 蔚蓝的
n. 天蓝色

e.en: The yacht sailed across the {azure} waters of the Mediterranean.
e.zh: 游艇在地中海蔚蓝的海面上航行。

e.en: Our team deploys the app on Microsoft {Azure}.
e.zh: 我们团队把应用部署在微软 Azure 云上。

auvergne.t: n. 奥弗涅（法国地区名）

e.en: We toured the volcanic landscapes of {Auvergne} last July.
e.zh: 去年七月我们游览了奥弗涅的火山地貌。

e.en: {Auvergne} is famous for its blue cheeses and lentils.
e.zh: 奥弗涅以蓝纹奶酪和扁豆而闻名。

aux.t:
adj. 辅助的（auxiliary 的缩写）
n. 音频输入接口

e.en: Plug your phone into the car's {aux} port to play music.
e.zh: 把手机插到车里的辅助音频接口就能放音乐。

e.en: The amplifier has an {aux} input for external devices.
e.zh: 这台功放带有一个用于外接设备的辅助输入接口。

e.en: {Auxerre} sits on the Yonne River in northern Burgundy.
e.zh: 欧塞尔坐落于北勃艮第的约讷河畔。

e.en: The football club from {Auxerre} returned to Ligue 1 this season.
e.zh: 欧塞尔的足球俱乐部本赛季重返法甲联赛。

auxiliary.t:
adj. 辅助的；备用的
n. 助手；助动词

e.en: The boat has an {auxiliary} engine in case the sails fail.
e.zh: 这艘船配有辅助发动机以防风帆失灵。

e.en: "Have" works as an {auxiliary} verb in perfect tenses.
e.zh: "have"在完成时态中用作助动词。

avail.t:
v. 有助于
n. 效用；帮助

e.en: She tried calling all night, to no {avail}.
e.zh: 她整晚不停地打电话,却毫无效果。

e.en: Travelers can {avail} themselves of free Wi-Fi in the lounge.
e.zh: 旅客可以在贵宾室免费使用Wi-Fi。

availabilities.t: n. 可用时间；可用资源（复数）

e.en: Please share your {availabilities} for a meeting next week.
e.zh: 请告诉我你下周可以开会的时间段。

e.en: The booking site lists hotel {availabilities} in real time.
e.zh: 订房网站实时显示酒店的空房情况。

availability.t: n. 可用性；有空的时间

e.en: Check the {availability} of the conference room before booking.
e.zh: 预订会议室前先查一下是否有空。

e.en: Limited {availability} drove prices up during the holiday season.
e.zh: 假期期间供应紧张推高了价格。

e.en: The new feature is now {available} on iOS and Android.
e.zh: 这项新功能现已在iOS和安卓上线。

e.en: Are you {available} for a quick call this afternoon?
e.zh: 你今天下午有空打个电话聊一下吗?

avalanche.t:
n. 雪崩；大量涌来
v. 雪崩般涌来

e.en: An {avalanche} buried the mountain road overnight.
e.zh: 一场雪崩一夜之间掩埋了那条山路。

e.en: The post triggered an {avalanche} of angry comments online.
e.zh: 那篇帖子在网上引来了铺天盖地的愤怒评论。

avalon.t: n. 阿瓦隆（传说中的仙岛）

e.en: In legend, King Arthur was carried to the isle of {Avalon}.
e.zh: 传说中亚瑟王被带到了阿瓦隆岛。

e.en: They named the resort {Avalon} after the mythical paradise.
e.zh: 他们以传说中的乐园之名将度假村取名阿瓦隆。

avant.t: adj. 前卫的（多用于合成词）

e.en: The gallery showcases {avant} works that challenge tradition.
e.zh: 这家画廊展出挑战传统的前卫作品。

e.en: His film techniques were {avant} for their time.
e.zh: 他的电影手法在当时颇为前卫。

avant-garde.t:
adj. 先锋的；前卫的
n. 先锋派

e.en: The director is known for her {avant-garde} stage productions.
e.zh: 这位导演以前卫的舞台作品而闻名。

e.en: Paris in the 1920s was a hub of {avant-garde} art.
e.zh: 二十年代的巴黎是先锋艺术的中心。

e.en: The novel portrays the banker's ruinous {avarice}.
e.zh: 小说刻画了那位银行家毁灭性的贪婪。

e.en: Pure {avarice} drove him to cheat his closest friends.
e.zh: 纯粹的贪婪驱使他欺骗了最亲近的朋友。

e.en: The villain is portrayed as cruel and {avaricious}.
e.zh: 反派被刻画得既残忍又贪婪。

e.en: An {avaricious} landlord kept raising the rent every month.
e.zh: 一个贪得无厌的房东每个月都涨房租。

avascular.t: adj. 无血管的（医学用语）

e.en: Cartilage is largely {avascular}, so it heals slowly.
e.zh: 软骨基本不含血管,因此愈合得很慢。

e.en: The scan revealed {avascular} necrosis of the hip.
e.zh: 扫描显示髋部出现了缺血性坏死。

avatar.t:
n. 头像；虚拟形象
n. 化身

e.en: You can customize your {avatar} in the game's profile menu.
e.zh: 你可以在游戏的个人资料菜单里自定义头像。

e.en: She uploaded a cartoon {avatar} to her chat profile.
e.zh: 她在聊天软件上传了一张卡通头像。

avc.t: n. 高级视频编码（视频压缩标准）

e.en: The video is encoded in H.264 {AVC} for wide compatibility.
e.zh: 该视频采用H.264 AVC编码以保证广泛兼容。

e.en: Most streaming platforms still support {AVC} alongside newer codecs.
e.zh: 大多数流媒体平台仍在支持AVC与更新的编码格式并存。

ave.t:
n. 大道（avenue 的缩写）
int. 万岁

e.en: The shop is located on Fifth {Ave} near Central Park.
e.zh: 那家店位于中央公园附近的第五大道上。

e.en: The crowd cheered "{ave}!" as the emperor passed.
e.zh: 皇帝经过时人群高呼"万岁"。

avebury.t: n. 埃夫伯里（英国史前遗址）

e.en: {Avebury} contains the largest stone circle in Europe.
e.zh: 埃夫伯里拥有欧洲最大的巨石阵。

e.en: We walked among the ancient stones at {Avebury} at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出时分漫步于埃夫伯里的古老巨石之间。

e.en: The phrase "café {avec} lait" means coffee with milk.
e.zh: "café avec lait"这个短语意为加奶咖啡。

e.en: He signed the postcard "{avec} amour" to his sister.
e.zh: 他在明信片上写下"avec amour"寄给妹妹,意为"附上爱意"。

e.en: The hero swore to {avenge} his murdered family.
e.zh: 主角发誓要为被害的家人报仇。

e.en: She wanted to {avenge} the unfair treatment her team received.
e.zh: 她想为团队所受的不公待遇讨回公道。

e.en: In the comics, he becomes a masked {avenger} of the night.
e.zh: 在漫画里,他化身为夜晚的蒙面复仇者。

e.en: The film follows a lone {avenger} hunting down corrupt officials.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一名独行复仇者追捕腐败官员的故事。

avenging.t:
adj. 复仇的
v. 报仇（现在分词）

e.en: He spent years {avenging} his brother's death.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间为弟弟之死复仇。

e.en: The novel ends with the hero {avenging} every betrayal.
e.zh: 小说以主角为每一次背叛复仇而告终。

avenue.t:
n. 大街；大道
n. 途径；方法

e.en: They live on a quiet, tree-lined {avenue}.
e.zh: 他们住在一条安静的林荫大道上。

e.en: Crowdfunding opened a new {avenue} for indie game developers.
e.zh: 众筹为独立游戏开发者打开了一条新途径。

e.en: The city is laid out with wide {avenues} and small parks.
e.zh: 这座城市的布局是宽阔的大道点缀着小公园。

e.en: We're exploring several {avenues} to grow user engagement.
e.zh: 我们正在探索多种途径来提升用户活跃度。

e.en: Witnesses {aver} that they saw the suspect leave at midnight.
e.zh: 证人坚称他们看到嫌疑人在午夜离开。

e.en: The lawyers continue to {aver} their client's innocence.
e.zh: 律师们继续断言他们当事人的清白。

average.t:
n. 平均值
adj. 平均的；一般的

e.en: The {average} commute time in this city is 40 minutes.
e.zh: 这座城市的平均通勤时间为40分钟。

e.en: His scores are above {average} for his age group.
e.zh: 他的分数在同龄段中高于平均水平。

e.en: Sales {averaged} about ten thousand units per month last year.
e.zh: 去年销量平均每月约一万件。

e.en: The model {averaged} predictions from five different runs.
e.zh: 该模型对五次不同运行的预测结果取了平均。

e.en: The film performed {averagely} at the box office.
e.zh: 这部电影的票房表现一般。

e.en: He plays guitar only {averagely}, but he writes great lyrics.
e.zh: 他弹吉他只算一般,但歌词写得很棒。

e.en: Studies suggest facial {averageness} is often perceived as attractive.
e.zh: 研究表明,平均化的面孔常被认为更具吸引力。

e.en: The book celebrates the quiet {averageness} of suburban life.
e.zh: 这本书赞美郊区生活那种平淡的普通感。

averages.t:
n. 平均值（复数）
v. 平均为

e.en: The site shows daily price {averages} over the past year.
e.zh: 该网站显示过去一年每日的平均价格。

e.en: He {averages} eight hours of sleep on weekdays.
e.zh: 他工作日平均睡八小时。

averaging.t: v. 求平均值（现在分词）

e.en: The team is {averaging} two new releases per month.
e.zh: 该团队平均每月推出两次新版本。

e.en: He scored well, {averaging} 25 points per game this season.
e.zh: 他本赛季表现出色,场均得到25分。

e.en: Many older investors are {averse} to risky tech stocks.
e.zh: 许多年长的投资者对高风险科技股心存抵触。

e.en: She isn't {averse} to working weekends if the project demands it.
e.zh: 如果项目需要,她也不介意周末加班。

e.en: He has a strong {aversion} to spicy food.
e.zh: 他对辛辣食物极为反感。

e.en: Her {aversion} to public speaking held back her career.
e.zh: 她对公开演讲的抗拒影响了她的职业发展。

aversive.t: adj. 引起厌恶的；嫌恶的

e.en: The dog learned to avoid the {aversive} buzzing sound.
e.zh: 那只狗学会了躲避令它厌恶的嗡嗡声。

e.en: Therapists rarely use {aversive} techniques on young children.
e.zh: 治疗师很少对幼童使用厌恶疗法。

avert.t:
v. 避免；防止
v. 转移（目光）

e.en: Quick action by the pilot helped {avert} a major disaster.
e.zh: 飞行员的迅速反应避免了一场重大灾难。

e.en: She tried to {avert} her eyes from the gruesome scene.
e.zh: 她努力把目光从那血腥的场面移开。

averted.t: v. 已避免；已转移（过去式）

e.en: The strike was {averted} after last-minute negotiations.
e.zh: 经过最后关头的谈判,罢工得以避免。

e.en: He {averted} his gaze when the topic became uncomfortable.
e.zh: 话题变得令人尴尬时,他把目光移开了。

e.en: Health officials warn of a new {avian} flu outbreak.
e.zh: 卫生官员警告出现了新的禽流感疫情。

e.en: The reserve protects dozens of rare {avian} species.
e.zh: 这个保护区保护着数十种珍稀鸟类。

e.en: The zoo's tropical {aviary} houses hundreds of colorful birds.
e.zh: 动物园的热带鸟舍里饲养着数百只多彩的鸟。

e.en: He built a small {aviary} for his pet parakeets.
e.zh: 他为家养的虎皮鹦鹉搭了一座小鸟舍。

e.en: She built a long career in commercial {aviation}.
e.zh: 她在民航业打拼出了长期的事业。

e.en: The museum traces the history of early {aviation}.
e.zh: 这座博物馆讲述了早期航空业的发展历程。

e.en: The {aviator} circled the airfield twice before landing safely.
e.zh: 飞行员在安全降落前绕机场盘旋了两圈。

e.en: He bought stylish {aviator} sunglasses for the road trip.
e.zh: 他为公路旅行买了一副时髦的飞行员太阳镜。

e.en: She is an {avid} reader of science fiction novels.
e.zh: 她是一个狂热的科幻小说读者。

e.en: Fans showed {avid} interest in the new game release.
e.zh: 粉丝们对新游戏的发布表现出极大的热情。

e.en: He pursued the project with surprising {avidity}.
e.zh: 他以惊人的热情投入这个项目。

e.en: The antibody's {avidity} determines how tightly it binds.
e.zh: 抗体的亲合力决定了它的结合强度。

e.en: Children listened {avidly} as the teacher told the story.
e.zh: 孩子们津津有味地听老师讲故事。

e.en: She {avidly} collects rare vinyl records from the seventies.
e.zh: 她热衷于收藏七十年代的稀有黑胶唱片。

avignon.t: n. 阿维尼翁（法国城市）

e.en: We spent a sunny afternoon walking through {Avignon}.
e.zh: 我们在阿维尼翁度过了一个阳光明媚的下午。

e.en: The papacy was once based in {Avignon}, France.
e.zh: 教廷曾设在法国阿维尼翁。

airmen.t: n. 飞行员, 空军士兵

airier.t: a. 空气的, 空中的, 通风的, 幻想的, 轻快的

aldermen.t: n. 市政委员会委员, 高级市政官\n[法] 市议员, 市长助理, 地方官

amoebae.t: n. 阿米巴, 变形虫\n[医] 阿米巴属, 变形虫属

angrier.t: a. 生气的, 愤怒的

anticking.t: n. 滑稽动作\na. 古怪的

anticked.t: n. 滑稽动作\na. 古怪的

apices.t: n. 顶, 尖端, 最高潮\n[医] 尖, 尖端

appendices.t: n. 附录, 附加物, 阑尾\n[化] 增补

arcking.t: n. 弧, 弧形, 弓形, 弧光\n[化] 弧

arcked.t: n. 弧, 弧形, 弓形, 弧光\n[化] 弧

awoke.t: a. 醒着的\nvt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到\nvi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到

awoken.t: a. 醒着的\nvt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到\nvi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到

e.en: The deed will {abalienate} the property to his nephew.
e.zh: 这份契约将把财产转让给他的侄子。

e.en: His harsh words began to {abalienate} loyal friends.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话开始让忠心的朋友疏远他。

abampere.t: 绝对安培（电磁制电流单位）

e.en: One {abampere} equals ten conventional amperes.
e.zh: 一绝对安培等于十普通安培。

e.en: Old textbooks still use the {abampere} in formulas.
e.zh: 旧教科书在公式里仍使用绝对安培。

abandonee.t: 接受被弃财产者；受让人

e.en: The insurer became the {abandonee} of the wrecked ship.
e.zh: 保险公司成为这艘失事船只的接受方。

e.en: As {abandonee}, he assumed all rights to the cargo.
e.zh: 作为受让人，他取得货物的所有权利。

e.en: The pain was {abarticular} rather than within the joint.
e.zh: 疼痛位于关节外而非关节内部。

e.en: Doctors noted an {abarticular} swelling on his arm.
e.zh: 医生注意到他手臂上有关节外的肿胀。

e.en: His pride proved hardly {abasable} by criticism.
e.zh: 他的骄傲几乎无法被批评所贬低。

e.en: The tariff was {abasable} only by treaty.
e.zh: 关税只有通过条约才能降低。

e.en: She lowered her eyes in {abashment}.
e.zh: 她羞愧地低下了眼睛。

e.en: His {abashment} at the praise was obvious.
e.zh: 他听到表扬时的窘迫显而易见。

e.en: The patient's {abasia} made unaided walking impossible.
e.zh: 该病人的失立症使他无法独自行走。

e.en: Neurologists suspected hysterical {abasia}.
e.zh: 神经科医生怀疑是癔病性行走不能。

abask.t: 沐浴在阳光中；惬意取暖地

e.en: The cat lay {abask} on the windowsill.
e.zh: 那只猫舒服地晒在窗台上。

e.en: We sat {abask} in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 我们沐浴在午后的阳光中坐着。

e.en: The nuisance was clearly {abatable} by simple repairs.
e.zh: 通过简单的修缮就能消除这一妨害。

e.en: Lawyers argued the noise was {abatable} under the statute.
e.zh: 律师主张该噪声依法可予制止。

e.en: Soldiers built an {abatis} of felled trees before the trench.
e.zh: 士兵在战壕前用伐倒的树木筑起鹿砦。

e.en: The {abatis} slowed the cavalry charge.
e.zh: 鹿砦减缓了骑兵的冲锋。

abatised.t: 设有鹿砦的；以树障防御的

e.en: The {abatised} perimeter held off repeated attacks.
e.zh: 设有鹿砦的防线挡住了反复进攻。

e.en: They camped behind an {abatised} ridge.
e.zh: 他们在设有树障的山脊后扎营。

abator.t: 制止者；非法侵占遗产者

e.en: The court named him an {abator} of the nuisance.
e.zh: 法庭认定他是该妨害的制止者。

e.en: As {abator}, he wrongfully entered the heir's land.
e.zh: 作为非法侵占者，他擅自进入了继承人的土地。

e.en: Engineers reinforced the trench with an {abattis}.
e.zh: 工兵用鹿砦加固了战壕。

e.en: The {abattis} bristled with sharpened branches.
e.zh: 鹿砦上布满削尖的树枝。

e.en: The {abaxial} surface of the leaf is paler.
e.zh: 叶片的远轴面颜色较浅。

e.en: Hairs grow on the {abaxial} side of the petal.
e.zh: 绒毛长在花瓣的背轴面上。

abbacies.t: 修道院长的职位或辖区（复数）

e.en: Several {abbacies} were granted to the king's favorites.
e.zh: 几个修道院长职位被授予了国王的宠臣。

e.en: Medieval {abbacies} controlled vast tracts of land.
e.zh: 中世纪的修道院辖区控制着大片土地。

abbacy.t: 修道院长的职位或辖区

e.en: He was elevated to the {abbacy} of Cluny.
e.zh: 他被擢升为克吕尼修道院的院长。

e.en: The {abbacy} brought both prestige and revenue.
e.zh: 修道院长一职带来声望和收入。

e.en: He wore the {abbatial} ring as a mark of office.
e.zh: 他戴着修道院长的指环作为职位标志。

e.en: The {abbatial} church dominated the village.
e.zh: 修道院教堂俯视着整个村庄。

e.en: He resigned the {abbotcy} after twenty years.
e.zh: 他在担任修道院长二十年后辞去职位。

e.en: The {abbotcy} passed to his nephew by election.
e.zh: 经选举，修道院长之职传给了他的侄子。

abbotship.t: 修道院长的职务或任期

e.en: His {abbotship} was marked by reform and rebuilding.
e.zh: 他任修道院长期间以改革和重建著称。

e.en: She chronicled each {abbotship} of the monastery.
e.zh: 她记录了该修道院历任院长的任期。

e.en: The fund only buys {AAA-rated} bonds.
e.zh: 该基金只购买3A级债券。

e.en: Few companies remain {AAA-rated} after the downgrade.
e.zh: 评级下调后，仍保持3A评级的公司寥寥无几。

aaaargh.t: 啊啊啊（表示惊恐或挫败的叫声）

e.en: "{Aaaargh}!" he cried as the spider crawled up his arm.
e.zh: "啊啊啊！"蜘蛛爬上他手臂时他大叫起来。

e.en: {Aaaargh}, I forgot to save the file again.
e.zh: 啊啊啊，我又忘了保存文件。

aardwolf.t: 土狼（南非食蚁的鬣狗科动物）

e.en: The {aardwolf} feeds almost entirely on termites.
e.zh: 土狼几乎完全以白蚁为食。

e.en: We spotted an {aardwolf} slipping out of its burrow at dusk.
e.zh: 我们在黄昏时看见一只土狼从洞里溜出来。

e.en: {Aardwolves} are nocturnal and rarely seen by tourists.
e.zh: 土狼昼伏夜出，游客很少见到。

e.en: Two {aardwolves} were tracked across the savanna.
e.zh: 两只土狼被追踪着穿越大草原。

e.en: Rope made from {abaca} is famously strong and salt-resistant.
e.zh: 用马尼拉麻做的绳子以坚韧耐盐著称。

e.en: The Philippines remains the world's leading producer of {abaca}.
e.zh: 菲律宾仍是全球最大的蕉麻生产国。

e.en: Several wooden {abaci} were displayed in the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆里陈列着几把木制算盘。

e.en: Children learned arithmetic on small {abaci}.
e.zh: 孩子们用小算盘学习算术。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {abacterial} prostatitis.
e.zh: 该患者被诊断为非细菌性前列腺炎。

e.en: Doctors confirmed the inflammation was {abacterial}.
e.zh: 医生确认这种炎症是非细菌性的。

e.en: The captain pointed to a small island {abaft} the ship.
e.zh: 船长指向船尾方向的一座小岛。

e.en: They stowed the spare sails {abaft} the mainmast.
e.zh: 他们把备用帆收存在主桅之后。

e.en: The {abbreviator} trimmed the long article into a brief summary.
e.zh: 那位缩写者把长篇文章压缩成简短摘要。

e.en: Medieval {abbreviator} monks shortened official Church documents.
e.zh: 中世纪的缩写僧负责精简教会公文。

e.en: The {abbreviators} simplified the lengthy treaty for the public.
e.zh: 这些缩写者为公众简化了冗长的条约。

e.en: Papal {abbreviators} once drafted shortened versions of decrees.
e.zh: 教廷的缩写者曾为教令起草简本。

abcoulomb.t: 绝对库仑（电磁制电荷单位）

e.en: One {abcoulomb} equals ten ordinary coulombs of charge.
e.zh: 一绝对库仑等于十普通库仑的电荷。

e.en: Older physics texts measured charge in {abcoulombs}.
e.zh: 旧的物理教材以绝对库仑作为电荷单位。

e.en: The satirist mocked the senator as a hopeless {abderite}.
e.zh: 讽刺作家把那位参议员讥为不可救药的笨人。

e.en: In the old play, the {abderite} stumbled into every joke.
e.zh: 那部古老的戏剧里，那个呆子撞上了每个笑话。

e.en: Under the constitution, certain royal duties are not {abdicable}.
e.zh: 根据宪法，某些王室职责不可放弃。

e.en: Lawyers debated whether the inherited title was {abdicable}.
e.zh: 律师们就这一世袭头衔是否可放弃展开辩论。

e.en: The {abdicant} signed the formal renunciation before noon.
e.zh: 那位让位者在中午前签署了正式弃权书。

e.en: History remembered him as a willing {abdicant} of power.
e.zh: 史书把他记作甘愿放弃权力的人。

e.en: He delivered an {abdicative} speech before leaving the throne.
e.zh: 他在退位前发表了让位演说。

e.en: The letter carried a clearly {abdicative} tone.
e.zh: 那封信带着明显的让位口吻。

e.en: The {abdicator} retreated quietly to a country estate.
e.zh: 那位退位者悄悄隐退到一处乡间庄园。

e.en: History rarely treats royal {abdicators} with kindness.
e.zh: 史书对退位的君主很少有好评。

abdominoplasty.t: 腹部整形术；腹部除皱手术

e.en: She saved for years to afford an {abdominoplasty}.
e.zh: 她攒了好几年的钱才做得起腹部整形手术。

e.en: Recovery from {abdominoplasty} can take several weeks.
e.zh: 腹部整形术后的恢复期可能需要数周。

abdominous.t: 大腹便便的；肚子鼓胀的

e.en: An {abdominous} merchant waddled past the marketplace stalls.
e.zh: 一位大腹便便的商人摇摇摆摆地从集市摊位前走过。

e.en: The portrait depicted an {abdominous} country squire.
e.zh: 那幅肖像画的是一位大腹便便的乡绅。

e.en: The surgeon performed an emergency {abdominouterotomy} to save the mother.
e.zh: 外科医生紧急施行腹壁子宫切开术以挽救产妇。

e.en: Modern obstetrics rarely calls for an {abdominouterotomy}.
e.zh: 现代产科已极少需要做腹壁子宫切开术。

e.en: This muscle helps {abduce} the arm away from the body.
e.zh: 这块肌肉帮助将手臂从身体侧外展开来。

e.en: Old chronicles say raiders would {abduce} villagers at night.
e.zh: 古籍记载袭击者会在夜间把村民掳走。

e.en: The therapist gently {abduced} her injured leg sideways.
e.zh: 治疗师轻轻地把她受伤的腿向外侧展开。

e.en: A reflex {abduced} the patient's fingers without conscious effort.
e.zh: 反射使病人的手指不自主地外展。

e.en: Damage to the {abducens} nerve can cause double vision.
e.zh: 外展神经受损可引起复视。

e.en: The {abducens} controls the lateral rectus muscle of the eye.
e.zh: 外展神经控制眼球的外直肌。

e.en: The {abducent} nerve turns the eyeball outward.
e.zh: 外展神经使眼球向外转动。

e.en: Surgeons carefully avoid the {abducent} branch during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在术中小心避开外展神经的分支。

e.en: The trainer was slowly {abducing} the patient's shoulder.
e.zh: 训练师正在缓慢地外展病人的肩膀。

e.en: She felt a sharp pull while {abducing} her hip.
e.zh: 她外展髋部时感到一阵剧烈的牵拉。

e.en: I am much {afeared} of the dark woods.
e.zh: 我对那片黑暗的森林十分恐惧。

e.en: She seemed {afeared} to speak the truth aloud.
e.zh: 她似乎不敢把真相大声说出来。

a-flat.t: 降A调；音乐中的降A音符号

e.en: The sonata is written in {A-flat} major.
e.zh: 这首奏鸣曲是用降A大调写成的。

e.en: Please play an {A-flat} on the piano.
e.zh: 请在钢琴上弹一个降A音。

e.en: Her heart was {aflutter} with excitement.
e.zh: 她的心因兴奋而怦怦直跳。

e.en: The garden was {aflutter} with butterflies.
e.zh: 花园里到处是翩翩飞舞的蝴蝶。

e.en: They built an {A-frame} cabin in the woods.
e.zh: 他们在树林里建了一座A字形小木屋。

e.en: The ladder folds into a stable {A-frame}.
e.zh: 这把梯子可以折叠成稳固的A字形。

a-go-go.t: 尽情的；丰盛的；时髦舞曲风

e.en: The club had go-go dancers and music {a-go-go}.
e.zh: 那家俱乐部有摇摆舞者和热闹的舞曲。

e.en: There was food and fun {a-go-go} at the party.
e.zh: 派对上美食和乐趣应有尽有。

e.en: His account of the war was rather {ahistorical}.
e.zh: 他对那场战争的叙述相当不顾史实。

e.en: The novel takes a deliberately {ahistorical} approach.
e.zh: 这部小说刻意采取了非历史的视角。

e.en: Don't be such an {a-hole} about it.
e.zh: 别在这件事上犯浑了。

e.en: That guy is a total {a-hole} to everyone.
e.zh: 那家伙对谁都是个十足的混蛋。

e.en: She got top marks in her {A-levels}.
e.zh: 她在A-level考试中拿了最高分。

e.en: He's studying hard for his {A-level} exams.
e.zh: 他正在为A-level考试刻苦学习。

e.en: She prefers wearing {A-lines} to formal events.
e.zh: 出席正式场合时她更爱穿A字裙。

e.en: {A-lines} tend to flatter most body shapes.
e.zh: A字形剪裁通常很适合大多数身材。

e.en: She is now an {A-list} actress in Hollywood.
e.zh: 她现在是好莱坞的一线女演员。

e.en: Only {A-list} guests were invited to the gala.
e.zh: 只有顶级名流才被邀请参加这场盛会。

e.en: He has become a real {A-lister} this year.
e.zh: 今年他真正成了一线明星。

e.en: Every {A-lister} in town attended the premiere.
e.zh: 城里每一位顶级名流都出席了首映礼。

a-listers.t: 一线明星们；顶级名流们

e.en: Many {A-listers} showed up at the premiere.
e.zh: 许多一线明星都出现在首映礼上。

e.en: The party was packed with Hollywood {A-listers}.
e.zh: 派对上挤满了好莱坞的顶级名流。

e.en: Everything is {A-OK} on our end.
e.zh: 我们这边一切正常。

e.en: All systems are {A-OK} for the launch.
e.zh: 所有系统都已准备就绪可以发射。

a-okay.t: 一切顺利；非常好；好极了

e.en: The test results came back {A-okay}.
e.zh: 检查结果一切顺利。

e.en: He gave us the {A-okay} signal to proceed.
e.zh: 他给我们打了可以继续的手势。

e.en: She did an {A-one} job on the report.
e.zh: 她那份报告做得棒极了。

e.en: This little restaurant serves {A-one} food.
e.zh: 这家小餐馆的菜品堪称一流。

e.en: There was food and drink {aplenty} at the feast.
e.zh: 宴会上美酒佳肴一应俱全。

e.en: He had advice {aplenty} for the new students.
e.zh: 他给新生提了许许多多的建议。

e.en: She earned an {A-plus} on her history essay.
e.zh: 她的历史论文得了甲上的成绩。

e.en: His performance has been {A-plus} all season.
e.zh: 他整个赛季的表现都堪称一流。

a-political.t: 不关心政治的；非政治的

e.en: He claims to be entirely {apolitical} at work.
e.zh: 他声称自己在工作中完全不涉政治。

e.en: The organization remains strictly {apolitical}.
e.zh: 这个组织始终严格保持非政治立场。

a-share.t: A股；甲类股票；中国本土股

e.en: He invested heavily in Chinese {A-shares} last year.
e.zh: 去年他大量投资了中国A股。

e.en: {A-share} prices rose sharply this morning.
e.zh: 今天上午A股价格大幅上涨。

e.en: She knows the city {A-to-Z}.
e.zh: 她对这座城市了如指掌。

e.en: This book is an {A-to-Z} of home cooking.
e.zh: 这本书是一部详尽的家常菜指南。

e.en: The lighthouse appeared {abeam} of our yacht.
e.zh: 灯塔出现在我们游艇的正横方向。

e.en: A small fishing boat passed {abeam} as we sailed north.
e.zh: 我们向北航行时，一艘小渔船从正横方向经过。

abecedarian.t: 初学者；按字母顺序排列的

e.en: His questions revealed an {abecedarian} grasp of physics.
e.zh: 他的问题暴露出他对物理只有最初级的理解。

e.en: The teacher prepared an {abecedarian} list of vocabulary.
e.zh: 老师准备了一份按字母顺序排列的词汇表。

e.en: The museum displayed a medieval {abecedarium} for children.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一本中世纪的儿童识字读本。

e.en: She illustrated an {abecedarium} for her nephew.
e.zh: 她为侄子画了一本字母入门书。

e.en: An old {abele} shaded the farmhouse yard.
e.zh: 一棵老白杨为农舍的院子遮荫。

e.en: The wind turned the {abele} leaves silver.
e.zh: 风把白杨叶子翻成银色。

e.en: The garden featured an {abelmosk} with yellow blossoms.
e.zh: 花园里有一株开着黄花的黄葵。

e.en: Perfumers prize {abelmosk} seeds for their musky scent.
e.zh: 调香师珍视黄葵种子的麝香气味。

e.en: An {aberdevine} flitted through the alder branches.
e.zh: 一只黄雀在桤木枝间穿梭。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted an {aberdevine} near the feeder.
e.zh: 观鸟者在喂食器附近发现了一只黄雀。

e.en: The data showed clear {aberrance} from expected patterns.
e.zh: 数据显示出与预期模式明显的偏离。

e.en: Doctors investigated the {aberrance} in his heart rhythm.
e.zh: 医生调查了他心律的异常。

e.en: Astronomers noted an {aberrancy} in the comet's path.
e.zh: 天文学家注意到这颗彗星轨道的偏差。

e.en: The report flagged statistical {aberrancy} in the results.
e.zh: 报告指出结果中存在统计上的反常。

e.en: The lens produced an {aberrated} image at the edges.
e.zh: 这枚镜头在边缘处产生了像差图像。

e.en: His {aberrated} behavior worried close friends.
e.zh: 他反常的行为让密友们担心。

e.en: He was charged with the {abetment} of fraud.
e.zh: 他被指控教唆欺诈。

e.en: The court found clear evidence of her {abetment}.
e.zh: 法庭找到了她唆使犯罪的明确证据。

e.en: Police arrested the thief and his {abettor}.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了小偷和他的同伙。

e.en: She was named as an {abettor} in the indictment.
e.zh: 她在起诉书中被列为从犯。

e.en: The court may {abjudge} the property to another claimant.
e.zh: 法院可裁定将该财产判给另一索赔人。

e.en: They sought to {abjudge} him of his title.
e.zh: 他们试图通过判决剥夺他的头衔。

e.en: His public {abjuration} of the faith shocked the village.
e.zh: 他公开宣誓放弃信仰，震惊了整个村庄。

e.en: The treaty required a formal {abjuration} of all prior claims.
e.zh: 该条约要求正式宣誓放弃所有先前的主张。

e.en: He signed an {abjuratory} oath before the council.
e.zh: 他在议会面前签署了一份弃绝誓言。

e.en: The document contained {abjuratory} language about heresy.
e.zh: 这份文件包含了关于异端的弃绝性措辞。

e.en: Farmers usually {ablactate} calves at around six months.
e.zh: 农民通常在小牛约六个月大时给它们断奶。

e.en: It can be stressful to {ablactate} an infant too quickly.
e.zh: 过快地让婴儿断奶可能会带来压力。

e.en: Gradual {ablactation} reduces digestive problems in calves.
e.zh: 逐步断奶可以减少小牛的消化问题。

e.en: The pediatrician advised on healthy {ablactation} practices.
e.zh: 儿科医生就健康的断奶方法提出了建议。

e.en: Latin grammar features many {ablatival} constructions.
e.zh: 拉丁语语法中有许多夺格结构。

e.en: She struggled with the {ablatival} endings in her exam.
e.zh: 她在考试中对夺格词尾感到吃力。

e.en: The spacecraft's {ablator} burned away during reentry.
e.zh: 航天器的烧蚀防热层在再入大气层时烧毁。

e.en: Engineers tested a new {ablator} for the heat shield.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于隔热罩的新型烧蚀材料。

e.en: English irregular verbs often show {ablaut} patterns.
e.zh: 英语不规则动词常常表现出元音变换的规律。

e.en: Linguists study {ablaut} across Indo-European languages.
e.zh: 语言学家研究印欧语系中的元音变换现象。

able-bodied.t: 身强力壮的；体格健全的

e.zh: 每个身体健全的男人都被叫来帮忙。

e.en: The job requires {able-bodied} workers willing to lift heavy loads.
e.zh: 这份工作需要愿意搬运重物的健壮工人。

e.en: Only {able-minded} candidates were chosen for the program.
e.zh: 只有心智健全的候选人被选入该项目。

e.en: She remained {able-minded} well into her nineties.
e.zh: 她直到九十多岁仍然头脑清晰。

ablebodied.t: 身强力壮的；体格健全的

e.en: The army recruited every {ablebodied} young man.
e.zh: 军队招募了每一个身强力壮的年轻人。

e.en: Rescue work demands {ablebodied} volunteers.
e.zh: 救援工作需要身体健壮的志愿者。

e.en: The pope sent an {ablegate} to the coronation.
e.zh: 教皇派了一位特使出席加冕礼。

e.en: An {ablegate} delivered the official letter to the king.
e.zh: 一位教廷使节将正式信件交给了国王。

e.en: The campaign aims to combat {ableism} in workplaces.
e.zh: 该运动旨在消除职场中的残障歧视。

e.en: She wrote an essay about everyday {ableism}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于日常残障歧视的文章。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with sudden {ablepsia}.
e.zh: 病人被诊断为突发性失明。

e.en: Ancient texts described {ablepsia} as a divine punishment.
e.zh: 古代文献将失明描述为神的惩罚。

e.en: {Ablins} we'll see him at the fair tomorrow.
e.zh: 也许我们明天会在集市上见到他。

e.en: He'll {ablins} return before the rain starts.
e.zh: 他或许会在雨开始前回来。

e.en: The garden was {abloom} with roses in June.
e.zh: 六月里花园里玫瑰盛开。

e.en: Cherry trees stood {abloom} along the river.
e.zh: 沿河的樱花树繁花盛开。

e.en: The meadow lay {ablow} with wildflowers.
e.zh: 草地上野花盛开。

e.en: By April the orchard was fully {ablow}.
e.zh: 到了四月，果园已花开满枝。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a mild {abluent} for the wound.
e.zh: 医生为伤口开了一种温和的清洁剂。

e.en: Soap acts as an {abluent} on greasy surfaces.
e.zh: 肥皂在油腻表面上起到清洁剂的作用。

e.en: She stood {ablush} at the unexpected compliment.
e.zh: 听到突如其来的赞美，她羞红了脸。

e.en: His cheeks were {ablush} after the long run.
e.zh: 长跑之后他的脸颊红扑扑的。

e.en: Freshly {abluted}, the monks entered the temple.
e.zh: 刚刚沐浴完毕，僧人们走进了寺庙。

e.en: He felt renewed and {abluted} after the ritual bath.
e.zh: 经过仪式沐浴后，他感到焕然一新。

e.en: The temple has elaborate {ablutionary} facilities.
e.zh: 这座寺庙有讲究的沐浴设施。

e.en: He performed his morning {ablutionary} rites.
e.zh: 他进行了早晨的沐浴仪式。

e.en: Biologists tracked the duck's unusual {abmigration}.
e.zh: 生物学家追踪了这只鸭子不寻常的离群迁徙。

e.en: {Abmigration} can introduce new genes into a flock.
e.zh: 异群迁徙可能为种群带来新的基因。

e.en: The {abmortal} current flows away from injured tissue.
e.zh: 远离坏死区的电流从受伤组织向外流动。

e.en: Researchers measured the {abmortal} potential in the muscle.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了肌肉中远离坏死区的电位。

e.en: He lived as a strict {abnegator} of worldly pleasures.
e.zh: 他过着严格克己、舍弃世俗享乐的生活。

e.en: The monk became known as a true {abnegator}.
e.zh: 这位僧人被誉为真正的克己者。

e.en: The {abnerval} current moves away from the nerve.
e.zh: 远离神经方向的电流从神经向外流动。

e.en: Physiologists studied {abnerval} responses in the tissue.
e.zh: 生理学家研究了组织中远离神经方向的反应。

e.en: The country slowly returned from {abnormalcy} to routine.
e.zh: 国家慢慢地从反常状态恢复到日常。

e.en: Doctors noted the {abnormalcy} of his test results.
e.zh: 医生注意到他化验结果的异常。

e.en: The museum displayed several biological {abnormities}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几件生物畸形标本。

e.en: He catalogued the {abnormities} found in the specimens.
e.zh: 他对标本中发现的反常之物进行了编目。

e.en: The doctor described the growth as a rare {abnormity}.
e.zh: 医生形容这块增生为一种罕见的畸形。

e.en: Such an event is an {abnormity} in our community.
e.zh: 这种事件在我们社区里是反常之事。

e.en: The crystal had an {abnormous} shape unlike any other.
e.zh: 这块晶体形状反常，与众不同。

e.en: He noticed an {abnormous} pattern in the data.
e.zh: 他在数据中注意到一种反常的规律。

e.en: The dark sky seemed an {abodement} of disaster.
e.zh: 阴沉的天空仿佛是灾难的预兆。

e.en: He dismissed her warning as mere {abodement}.
e.zh: 他把她的警告当作不过是迷信的预兆而置之不理。

e.en: The lawsuit remained {abeyant} for years.
e.zh: 这场诉讼搁置了多年。

e.en: His ambitions lay {abeyant} during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间他的雄心暂时搁置。

e.en: They sprayed an {abherent} on the mold.
e.zh: 他们在模具上喷了防粘剂。

e.en: This coating is highly {abherent}.
e.zh: 这种涂层防粘性极佳。

e.en: Such cruelty is {abhominable}.
e.zh: 如此残忍令人发指。

e.en: He called the deed {abhominable} in his sermon.
e.zh: 他在讲道中称这行为可憎。

e.en: Her {abidance} by the rules impressed the judges.
e.zh: 她对规则的遵守令评委印象深刻。

e.en: We expect strict {abidance} with the contract.
e.zh: 我们要求严格遵守合同。

e.en: Faith {abideth} forever, the verse says.
e.zh: 经文说信念永存。

e.en: He that {abideth} in love shall find peace.
e.zh: 住在爱里的人必得平安。

e.en: Her thesis explored {abiochemistry} in deep-sea vents.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了深海热液口的非生物化学。

e.en: {Abiochemistry} examines reactions outside living cells.
e.zh: 非生物化学研究活细胞外的反应。

e.en: Scientists still debate the origins of {abiogenesis}.
e.zh: 科学家仍在争论生命自然发生的起源。

e.en: {Abiogenesis} proposes life arose from non-living matter.
e.zh: 无生源说认为生命由非生命物质产生。

abiogenetic.t: 自然发生的；非生物起源的

e.en: They studied {abiogenetic} pathways in early Earth.
e.zh: 他们研究了早期地球的非生物起源途径。

e.en: The model assumes an {abiogenetic} origin of amino acids.
e.zh: 该模型假设氨基酸源于非生物过程。

e.en: Some methane on Mars may be {abiogenic}.
e.zh: 火星上的一些甲烷可能是非生物成因的。

e.en: They proposed an {abiogenic} source for the oil.
e.zh: 他们提出该石油有非生物成因。

e.en: The minerals formed {abiogenically} under pressure.
e.zh: 这些矿物在压力下以非生物方式形成。

e.en: Hydrogen can be produced {abiogenically} in the mantle.
e.zh: 氢气可在地幔中以非生物方式产生。

e.en: The {abiogenist} defended his theory at the conference.
e.zh: 那位自然发生论者在会上为其理论辩护。

e.en: Early {abiogenists} clashed with Pasteur's followers.
e.zh: 早期自然发生论者与巴斯德的追随者发生冲突。

e.en: The crystals are entirely {abiogenous}.
e.zh: 这些晶体完全是非生物产生的。

e.en: They identified {abiogenous} carbon in the rock.
e.zh: 他们在岩石中发现了非生物来源的碳。

e.en: Nineteenth-century writers often discussed {abiogeny}.
e.zh: 十九世纪作家常讨论自然发生说。

e.en: {Abiogeny} was eventually displaced by germ theory.
e.zh: 自然发生说最终被细菌学说取代。

e.en: Erosion is an {abiological} process.
e.zh: 侵蚀是一种非生物过程。

e.en: They distinguished biological and {abiological} factors.
e.zh: 他们区分了生物因素与非生物因素。

e.en: The compound can form {abiologically} in space.
e.zh: 该化合物可在太空中以非生物方式形成。

e.en: Iron oxidizes {abiologically} when exposed to air.
e.zh: 铁接触空气时以非生物方式氧化。

e.en: His textbook covered both biology and {abiology}.
e.zh: 他的教材涵盖了生物学与非生物学。

e.en: {Abiology} deals with non-living natural phenomena.
e.zh: 非生物学研究非生命的自然现象。

e.en: The frozen sample entered a state of {abiosis}.
e.zh: 冷冻样本进入了无生命状态。

e.en: {Abiosis} can be reversed in some microorganisms.
e.zh: 某些微生物的无生命状态可被逆转。

e.en: The dog was diagnosed with cerebellar {abiotrophy}.
e.zh: 这只狗被诊断为小脑退化症。

e.en: {Abiotrophy} causes premature loss of vitality.
e.zh: 先天性退化导致活力过早丧失。

e.en: The cream acts as a mild {abirritant}.
e.zh: 这款乳膏可作温和的消炎剂。

e.en: Doctors prescribed an {abirritant} for the rash.
e.zh: 医生为皮疹开了舒缓剂。

e.en: The lotion helps {abirritate} inflamed skin.
e.zh: 这款洗剂有助于舒缓发炎的皮肤。

e.en: Cool compresses can {abirritate} the wound.
e.zh: 冷敷可减轻伤口的刺激。

acappella.t: 无伴奏合唱的；阿卡贝拉式的

e.en: The choir performed the entire piece {acappella}.
e.zh: 合唱团整首曲子都以无伴奏方式演唱。

e.en: Their {acappella} cover went viral online.
e.zh: 他们的无伴奏翻唱在网上爆红。

e.en: Farmers sprayed an {acaricide} to control the mite outbreak.
e.zh: 农民喷洒杀螨剂以控制螨虫的爆发。

e.en: This {acaricide} is safe for use on fruit trees.
e.zh: 这种杀螨剂可安全用于果树。

e.en: She is pursuing a doctorate in {acarology}.
e.zh: 她正在攻读螨虫学博士学位。

e.en: The lab is a leading center for {acarology} research.
e.zh: 该实验室是螨虫学研究的领先中心。

e.en: His {acarophobia} made him scrub the sheets daily.
e.zh: 他的螨虫恐惧症让他每天擦洗床单。

e.en: {Acarophobia} can interfere with normal sleep.
e.zh: 螨虫恐惧症可能会影响正常睡眠。

acatalectic.t: 音步完整的；不缺音节的

e.en: The poem's lines are perfectly {acatalectic}.
e.zh: 这首诗的诗行音步完全完整。

e.en: Scholars debate whether the verse is {acatalectic}.
e.zh: 学者们争论这一诗句是否音步完整。

e.en: He defended an {acataleptic} view of knowledge.
e.zh: 他为一种不可知论的知识观辩护。

e.en: Ancient skeptics held {acataleptic} positions.
e.zh: 古代的怀疑论者持不可知的立场。

e.en: The patient developed {acathisia} after starting the medication.
e.zh: 病人在开始服药后出现了静坐不能。

e.en: {Acathisia} is a known side effect of antipsychotics.
e.zh: 静坐不能是抗精神病药物的已知副作用。

e.en: Frogs are essentially {acaudal} as adults.
e.zh: 青蛙作为成体基本上是无尾的。

e.en: The specimen was unusually {acaudal}.
e.zh: 这一标本异常地没有尾巴。

e.en: Many violets are {acaulescent} plants.
e.zh: 许多紫罗兰是无茎植物。

e.en: The botanist labeled the rosette as {acaulescent}.
e.zh: 植物学家将这一叶丛标为无茎的。

e.en: Some desert species are entirely {acaulous}.
e.zh: 某些沙漠物种完全无茎。

e.en: The plant appeared {acaulous} in the dry season.
e.zh: 这种植物在旱季显得没有茎。

e.en: Politicians have turned this country into an {Absurdistan}.
e.zh: 政客们把这个国家变成了一个荒诞国。

e.en: Welcome to {Absurdistan}, where nothing makes sense.
e.zh: 欢迎来到荒诞国，这里毫无道理可言。

abubble.t: 沸腾的；冒泡的；嘈杂活跃的

e.en: The kettle was {abubble} on the hot stove.
e.zh: 水壶在热炉上沸腾冒泡。

e.en: The whole town was {abubble} with rumors.
e.zh: 整个小镇议论纷纷，谣言四起。

e.en: A new theater is {abuilding} downtown.
e.zh: 市中心有一座新剧院正在建造。

e.en: Several ships were {abuilding} at the yard.
e.zh: 船坞里有几艘船正在建造中。

e.en: Severe depression often brings on {abulia}.
e.zh: 重度抑郁常常引发意志缺失。

e.en: He suffered from {abulia} after the trauma.
e.zh: 创伤之后他患上了意志薄弱症。

abusable.t: 易被滥用的；易遭虐待的

e.en: Any system of power is {abusable}.
e.zh: 任何权力体系都可能被滥用。

e.en: This drug is highly {abusable} without supervision.
e.zh: 这种药物在无人监管下极易被滥用。

abusage.t: 误用；语言误用；不当使用

e.en: The dictionary lists common {abusage} of English words.
e.zh: 词典列出了英语单词的常见误用。

e.en: He warned students against {abusage} of legal terms.
e.zh: 他告诫学生不要误用法律术语。

e.en: The market was {abustle} with eager shoppers.
e.zh: 市场里熙熙攘攘，购物者络绎不绝。

e.en: The kitchen was {abustle} before the feast.
e.zh: 宴会前厨房里一片忙乱。

e.en: Their land {abutts} the wide river.
e.zh: 他们的土地紧邻那条宽阔的河流。

e.en: The garden {abutts} on a busy road.
e.zh: 花园紧靠着一条繁忙的街道。

e.en: The deed described the {abuttal} clearly.
e.zh: 契约清楚地描述了边界毗连处。

e.en: We met at the {abuttal} of the two farms.
e.zh: 我们在两家农场的接界处见面。

e.en: The map showed the {abuttals} of every lot.
e.zh: 地图标出了每块地的边界。

e.en: Old stones marked the {abuttals} of the field.
e.zh: 古老的石头标示着田地的地界。

abuzz.t: 嗡嗡作响的；议论纷纷的

e.en: The office was {abuzz} with the news.
e.zh: 办公室里议论纷纷，谈论着这则消息。

e.en: The hive was {abuzz} with thousands of bees.
e.zh: 蜂巢里成千上万只蜜蜂嗡嗡作响。

e.en: One volt equals one hundred million {abvolts}.
e.zh: 一伏特等于一亿绝对伏特。

e.en: Old physics texts still mention the {abvolt}.
e.zh: 旧的物理教材仍提到绝对伏特单位。

e.en: The {abwatt} is rarely used today.
e.zh: 绝对瓦特如今很少被使用。

e.en: Engineers once measured power in {abwatts}.
e.zh: 工程师们过去用绝对瓦特测量功率。

e.en: The {abweber} measures magnetic flux in CGS units.
e.zh: 绝对韦伯是CGS制下的磁通量单位。

e.en: Modern physics rarely uses the {abweber} anymore.
e.zh: 现代物理已很少使用绝对韦伯。

e.en: Thou shalt {aby} this dreadful betrayal!
e.zh: 你将为这次可怕的背叛付出代价！

e.en: He must {aby} the wrongs he committed.
e.zh: 他必须为自己犯下的过错付出代价。

e.en: Thou wilt {abye} thy reckless folly.
e.zh: 你将为自己鲁莽的愚行付出代价。

e.en: They must {abye} their cruel deeds someday.
e.zh: 他们终有一天要为残忍行径付出代价。

abyes.t: 偿还；付代价（古语第三人称单数）

e.en: He {abyes} his sins through quiet penance.
e.zh: 他通过默默的苦修赎清自己的罪。

e.en: She still {abyes} that ancient family wrong.
e.zh: 她仍在为那个古老的家族过错付出代价。

e.en: He spent his last years {abying} old crimes.
e.zh: 他余生都在为旧日罪行付出代价。

e.en: She is still {abying} that long betrayal.
e.zh: 她仍在为那次长久的背叛付出代价。

e.en: Many a man {abys} his deeds at last.
e.zh: 许多人最终都要为所作所为付出代价。

e.en: He {abys} his past with quiet shame.
e.zh: 他默默羞愧地为过去付出代价。

e.en: He gazed into the dark {abysm} of time.
e.zh: 他凝视着时间的黑暗深渊。

e.en: Their love sank into a hopeless {abysm}.
e.zh: 他们的爱情坠入了无望的深渊。

e.en: {Abyssopelagic} creatures live in total darkness.
e.zh: 深渊带的生物生活在完全的黑暗中。

e.en: The {abyssopelagic} zone begins around four thousand meters.
e.zh: 深渊层从约四千米深处开始。

e.en: She opened a new bank {ac-count} yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天开了一个新的银行账户。

e.en: Give me an {ac-count} of what happened.
e.zh: 把发生的事情给我说明一下。

academese.t: 学究腔；学术行话；学究式语言

e.en: The article was buried in dense {academese}.
e.zh: 文章被晦涩的学究腔淹没了。

e.en: She translated the {academese} into plain English.
e.zh: 她把学术行话译成了通俗英语。

e.en: His paintings showed strict {academicism}.
e.zh: 他的画作呈现严格的学院派风格。

e.en: Critics mocked the play's stuffy {academicism}.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑该剧迂腐的学究作风。

e.en: The novel is hampered by its {academism}.
e.zh: 这部小说受其学究气拖累。

e.en: She rebelled against rigid {academism} all her life.
e.zh: 她一生都在反抗僵化的学院派风格。

e.en: Don't {academize} every casual conversation.
e.zh: 别把每次闲聊都搞得学究气十足。

e.en: The reform tried to {academize} the training program.
e.zh: 改革试图让培训项目学术化。

acai.t: 巴西莓；阿萨伊果（一种浆果）

e.en: She added {acai} to her morning smoothie.
e.zh: 她在晨间果昔里加了巴西莓。

e.en: {Acai} bowls are very popular at this cafe.
e.zh: 这家咖啡店的巴西莓碗非常受欢迎。

e.en: Patients with {acalculia} cannot do simple arithmetic.
e.zh: 失算症患者无法做简单的算术。

e.en: Brain injury sometimes causes {acalculia}.
e.zh: 脑损伤有时会引发计算不能症。

e.en: Their formal {accedence} to the treaty was announced yesterday.
e.zh: 他们正式加入条约一事昨日公布。

e.en: She gave silent {accedence} to the proposal.
e.zh: 她默然同意了这项提议。

accelerando.t: 渐快地；逐渐加快地演奏

e.en: The conductor signaled an {accelerando} in the final movement.
e.zh: 指挥示意在末乐章渐快演奏。

e.en: Play that passage {accelerando} for greater excitement.
e.zh: 那段请渐快演奏以增强张力。

e.en: The drug had an {acceleratory} effect on the heart rate.
e.zh: 这种药物对心率有加速作用。

e.en: Researchers measured the {acceleratory} forces on the test vehicle.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了测试车辆所受的加速力。

accelerogram.t: 加速度图；地震加速度记录

e.en: Engineers analyzed the {accelerogram} from last night's quake.
e.zh: 工程师分析了昨夜地震的加速度记录。

e.en: Each {accelerogram} reveals how violently the ground shook.
e.zh: 每张加速度图都揭示了地面震动的剧烈程度。

e.en: An {accelerograph} was installed near the fault line.
e.zh: 断层附近安装了一台强震仪。

e.en: The {accelerograph} captured the tremor in remarkable detail.
e.zh: 加速度仪极为详细地记录了这次震动。

e.en: The orator's words seemed to {accend} the crowd's anger.
e.zh: 演说者的话语似乎点燃了人群的怒火。

e.en: Old texts say monks would {accend} the ritual lamps at dusk.
e.zh: 古籍记载僧侣黄昏时会点起法灯。

accendant.t: 燃烧的；引火物；点燃之物

e.en: The {accendant} fumes filled the small chamber quickly.
e.zh: 易燃的烟雾迅速充满了小室。

e.en: He kept an {accendant} cloth ready beside the lantern.
e.zh: 他在灯旁备好了引火布。

e.en: The {accension} of the beacon warned distant villages.
e.zh: 烽火点燃以警示远方的村庄。

e.en: Ancient records describe the {accension} of sacred fires.
e.zh: 古代记载描述了圣火的点燃过程。

e.en: Her English was clear and almost completely {accentless}.
e.zh: 她的英语清晰流利，几乎听不出口音。

e.en: The robotic voice sounded oddly {accentless} and flat.
e.zh: 机器人的声音听起来异常无口音且平淡。

e.en: A small {accentor} hopped along the old stone wall.
e.zh: 一只小岩鹨沿着老石墙跳跃。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted an alpine {accentor} at high altitude.
e.zh: 观鸟者在高海拔处发现了一只高山岩鹨。

e.en: Every syllable here is {accentuable} in formal poetry.
e.zh: 在正式诗歌中此处每个音节都可重读。

e.en: The point is easily {accentuable} with a brief pause.
e.zh: 稍作停顿即可强调这一要点。

e.en: Linguists study the {accentuality} of Russian verbs carefully.
e.zh: 语言学家仔细研究俄语动词的重音特性。

e.en: The poem's {accentuality} drives its restless rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗的重音特性推动了其急促的节奏。

e.en: Punctuation can act as a powerful {accentuator} of meaning.
e.zh: 标点可作为意义的有力强调者。

e.en: She was the team's chief {accentuator} of risks.
e.zh: 她是团队中风险问题的首席强调者。

acceptable-environmental-range.t: 可接受的环境范围；适生范围

e.en: The species thrives only within its {acceptable-environmental-range}.
e.zh: 该物种仅在其可接受环境范围内才能繁衍。

e.en: Climate change has shifted the {acceptable-environmental-range} for many crops.
e.zh: 气候变化改变了许多作物的可接受环境范围。

e.en: Public {acceptancy} of the new tax was very low.
e.zh: 公众对新税的接受度非常低。

e.en: He sought her quiet {acceptancy} of the change.
e.zh: 他寻求她对这一变化的默然认可。

e.en: She was {acceptant} of every criticism the panel offered.
e.zh: 她乐于接受评审团提出的每一条批评。

e.en: An {acceptant} smile briefly crossed his weary face.
e.zh: 他疲惫的脸上短暂掠过一丝接纳的笑意。

e.en: The word's common {acceptation} differs from its origin.
e.zh: 该词的公认含义与其本源大相径庭。

e.en: In its modern {acceptation}, freedom means much more.
e.zh: 在现代意义上，自由的内涵丰富得多。

e.en: Each {acceptee} received a welcome packet by mail.
e.zh: 每位录取者都通过邮寄收到了欢迎手册。

e.en: The {acceptee} signed the agreement with great relief.
e.zh: 被接受者如释重负地签署了协议。

e.en: Roman law allowed {acceptilation} as a way to discharge debts.
e.zh: 罗马法允许通过免债的方式消除债务。

e.en: The contract included an unusual clause of {acceptilation}.
e.zh: 合同含有一条罕见的豁免债务条款。

e.en: Old translations speak of {acception} of persons in judgment.
e.zh: 旧译本谈及审判时偏袒于人。

e.en: The judge showed no {acception} of either party involved.
e.zh: 法官对涉案双方均无偏袒。

acceptive.t: 易于接受的；乐于接纳的

e.en: He was {acceptive} of new ideas at every turn.
e.zh: 他时时乐于接受新观念。

e.en: Her {acceptive} attitude greatly pleased the whole team.
e.zh: 她接纳的态度让整个团队倍感欣慰。

e.en: He was charged {accessarily} with aiding the main crime.
e.zh: 他被以从犯身份指控协助主犯罪行。

e.en: The clause applies {accessarily} to all signing parties.
e.zh: 该条款附带地适用于所有签约方。

e.en: The court carefully considered the {accessariness} of his role.
e.zh: 法院仔细考虑了他角色的从属性质。

e.en: Proving {accessariness} requires clear and direct evidence.
e.zh: 证明从犯身份需要清楚而直接的证据。

e.en: The site presents complex data {accessibly} to all users.
e.zh: 该网站以易于理解的方式向所有用户呈现复杂数据。

e.en: He explains physics {accessibly} for absolute beginners.
e.zh: 他通俗易懂地为零基础者讲解物理。

accessional.t: 增加的；新加入的；附加的

e.en: The library reported {accessional} growth in rare books.
e.zh: 图书馆报告珍本藏书有所增加。

e.en: Each {accessional} member strengthens the alliance further.
e.zh: 每位新加入的成员都使联盟更加强大。

e.en: The carrier charged {accessorial} fees for special handling.
e.zh: 承运人收取了特殊处理的附加费用。

e.en: He played an {accessorial} role in the wider scheme.
e.zh: 他在整个计划中扮演了从属角色。

e.en: Costs were billed {accessorially} on the final invoice.
e.zh: 费用以附加方式列入最终发票。

e.en: He was implicated {accessorially} in the original offense.
e.zh: 他作为从犯牵涉到最初的罪行中。

e.en: She was charged {accessorily} alongside the main offender.
e.zh: 她与主犯一同被以从犯身份起诉。

e.en: These features are added {accessorily} to the contract.
e.zh: 这些条款附带地加入合同。

accessoriness.t: 附属性；从属性质；从属关系

e.en: The judge weighed the {accessoriness} of his recent actions.
e.zh: 法官权衡了他近来行为的从属性质。

e.en: Proving {accessoriness} can be surprisingly difficult in court.
e.zh: 在法庭上证明从属关系可能出奇地困难。

e.en: She loves to {accessorise} her outfits with bright scarves.
e.zh: 她喜欢用鲜艳的围巾搭配服装。

e.en: Don't forget to {accessorise} the dress with a belt.
e.zh: 别忘了用腰带搭配这条裙子。

e.en: She is a skilled {accessoriser} of casual streetwear.
e.zh: 她是搭配休闲街头装的高手。

e.en: Every fashion {accessoriser} carries a few reliable staples.
e.zh: 每位配饰达人都备有几件可靠的基本款。

e.en: An emergency {accessway} runs behind the entire building.
e.zh: 整栋大楼后方有一条应急通道。

e.en: Workers cleared the narrow {accessway} of fallen debris.
e.zh: 工人清除了狭窄通道上的落石碎屑。

e.en: The pianist added a quick {acciaccatura} to the phrase.
e.zh: 钢琴家在乐句中加入了一个快速的短倚音。

e.en: An {acciaccatura} embellishes the melody quite beautifully.
e.zh: 倚音相当美妙地修饰了旋律。

accidence.t: 词形变化；屈折变化规则

e.en: Latin {accidence} can be daunting for absolute beginners.
e.zh: 拉丁语的词形变化对零基础学习者颇具挑战。

e.en: The textbook covers basic {accidence} before syntax.
e.zh: 教材在句法之前先讲解基本的词形变化。

accident-prone.t: 易出事故的；易遭意外的

e.en: He has been {accident-prone} ever since early childhood.
e.zh: 他从幼年起就容易出事故。

e.en: That intersection is notoriously {accident-prone} after dark.
e.zh: 那个十字路口入夜后是出了名的事故多发地。

accident-proneness.t: 事故倾向；易出意外的特性

e.en: Researchers studied the {accident-proneness} of new drivers.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了新手司机的事故倾向。

e.en: Her {accident-proneness} deeply worried her aging parents.
e.zh: 她易出意外的特性让年迈的父母深感担忧。

acetification.t: 醋化作用；变成醋的过程

e.en: The {acetification} of wine produces vinegar.
e.zh: 葡萄酒的醋化作用产生食醋。

e.en: Brewers carefully control {acetification} during fermentation.
e.zh: 酿造师在发酵过程中谨慎地控制醋化作用。

e.en: The wine had {acetified} after months of neglect.
e.zh: 那瓶酒被忽视数月后已变成醋。

e.en: He found the {acetified} cider undrinkable.
e.zh: 他觉得变酸的苹果酒无法入口。

e.en: The bacteria slowly {acetifies} the alcohol.
e.zh: 细菌慢慢将酒精转化成醋。

e.en: Air exposure {acetifies} the open bottle of wine.
e.zh: 接触空气会使开瓶的葡萄酒变酸。

e.en: Time and oxygen will {acetify} the wine.
e.zh: 时间和氧气会使葡萄酒变成醋。

e.en: Special bacteria are used to {acetify} cider.
e.zh: 特殊细菌被用来将苹果酒酸化为醋。

e.en: The {acetifying} cask emitted a sharp smell.
e.zh: 正在醋化的木桶散发出刺鼻气味。

e.en: Workers monitored the {acetifying} liquid daily.
e.zh: 工人们每天检查正在变酸的液体。

e.en: The wine had turned {acetous} after being left open.
e.zh: 酒开瓶放久后变得带醋味。

e.en: He detected an {acetous} note in the old vinegar.
e.zh: 他在陈年醋里闻到一丝酸味。

e.en: Chemists {acetylate} the compound to improve its stability.
e.zh: 化学家将该化合物乙酰化以提升稳定性。

e.en: Enzymes can {acetylate} histones to regulate gene expression.
e.zh: 酶可使组蛋白乙酰化，以调控基因表达。

acetylated.t: 乙酰化的；经乙酰化处理的

e.en: The {acetylated} starch dissolves more easily in cold water.
e.zh: 乙酰化淀粉在冷水中更易溶解。

e.en: Researchers found highly {acetylated} regions on the chromosome.
e.zh: 研究人员发现染色体上有高度乙酰化的区段。

acetylates.t: 使乙酰化（动词第三人称单数）

e.en: This enzyme {acetylates} lysine residues on the protein.
e.zh: 这种酶会乙酰化该蛋白上的赖氨酸残基。

e.en: The catalyst {acetylates} the alcohol within minutes.
e.zh: 该催化剂能在几分钟内将这种醇乙酰化。

acetylating.t: 正在乙酰化；乙酰化的（动名词）

e.en: They are {acetylating} the wood to improve its durability.
e.zh: 他们正对木材进行乙酰化处理，以提升耐久性。

e.en: The lab focuses on {acetylating} natural fibers.
e.zh: 该实验室专注于天然纤维的乙酰化处理。

acetylcholinesterase.t: 乙酰胆碱酯酶（水解神经递质的酶）

e.en: Many nerve agents inhibit {acetylcholinesterase} in the synapse.
e.zh: 许多神经毒剂会抑制突触中的乙酰胆碱酯酶。

e.en: This drug blocks {acetylcholinesterase} to treat Alzheimer's disease.
e.zh: 该药物通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶来治疗阿尔茨海默病。

e.en: The molecule contains an {acetylenic} triple bond.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个乙炔型三键。

e.en: Chemists studied the reactivity of {acetylenic} compounds.
e.zh: 化学家研究了乙炔类化合物的反应性。

acetylglucosamine.t: 乙酰葡糖胺（糖蛋白与几丁质成分）

e.en: Chitin is built from chains of {acetylglucosamine} units.
e.zh: 几丁质由乙酰葡糖胺单元的长链构成。

e.en: The supplement contains N-{acetylglucosamine} for joint support.
e.zh: 这种补剂含有 N-乙酰葡糖胺以支持关节健康。

e.en: Every {account-holder} must verify their identity online.
e.zh: 每位账户持有人都必须在线验证身份。

e.en: The bank notified each {account-holder} about the new fees.
e.zh: 银行通知每位开户人有关新收费的事宜。

e.en: Public officials should act {accountably} at all times.
e.zh: 公职人员应当时刻负责任地行事。

e.en: The funds were spent transparently and {accountably}.
e.zh: 这些资金的支出公开透明且可问责。

e.en: She was offered an {accountantship} at the firm.
e.zh: 她获得了公司里的会计师职位。

e.en: His {accountantship} lasted nearly thirty years.
e.zh: 他担任会计师一职近三十年。

accountee.t: 账目报送对象；受报账人

e.en: The auditor reports findings to the {accountee}.
e.zh: 审计员将调查结果报送给受报账人。

e.en: Each {accountee} receives a quarterly statement.
e.zh: 每位受报账人都会收到季度报表。

e.en: They had to {accouter} the soldiers before dawn.
e.zh: 他们必须在黎明前给士兵们配齐装具。

e.en: The guides will {accouter} you for the climb.
e.zh: 向导会为你准备好攀登所需的装备。

accoutered.t: 装备齐全的；披挂整齐的

e.en: The knight rode out, fully {accoutered} for battle.
e.zh: 骑士全副武装地策马出战。

e.en: Hikers arrived {accoutered} with ropes and helmets.
e.zh: 徒步者们带着绳索和头盔装备齐全地到达。

e.en: The squires were {accoutering} the horses for war.
e.zh: 侍从们正在为战马披挂装具。

e.en: She spent the morning {accoutering} the climbing team.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在为攀登队配备装备。

e.en: His office had every {accouterment} of luxury.
e.zh: 他的办公室拥有各种奢华配件。
