e.en: The soldier polished each piece of his {accouterment}.
e.zh: 士兵把他的每件装备都擦得锃亮。

e.en: The quartermaster {accouters} new recruits weekly.
e.zh: 军需官每周为新兵配备装具。

e.en: This shop {accouters} hikers for high-altitude treks.
e.zh: 这家店为徒步者准备高海拔远足装备。

e.en: They had to {accoutre} the troops before sunrise.
e.zh: 他们必须在日出前给部队配齐装备。

e.en: The school will {accoutre} every student for the expedition.
e.zh: 学校会为每位学生准备好远征所需的装备。

accoutred.t: 装备齐全的；披挂整齐的

e.en: The cavalry was fully {accoutred} for parade.
e.zh: 骑兵队列队接受检阅，装备齐整。

e.en: Climbers arrived {accoutred} with the latest gear.
e.zh: 登山者们带着最新装备到达。

e.en: The shop {accoutres} divers with custom suits.
e.zh: 这家店为潜水员定制装备。

e.en: The army {accoutres} every recruit on arrival.
e.zh: 军队在新兵到达时即为其配齐装具。

e.en: He spent hours {accoutring} the horses.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时为马匹披挂装具。

e.en: The staff were {accoutring} guests for the safari.
e.zh: 工作人员正在为客人准备旅行装备。

e.en: The course is {accreditable} by the national board.
e.zh: 该课程可由国家委员会认证。

e.en: Few private programs are {accreditable} under the new rules.
e.zh: 新规之下能获得认证的私立项目寥寥无几。

e.en: The {accreditor} visited the lab last week.
e.zh: 认证机构上周来实验室考察。

e.en: Each university chooses its own external {accreditor}.
e.zh: 每所大学都自行选择外部认证机构。

e.en: Botanists noted the {accrescence} of the calyx after flowering.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到花后花萼的增大。

e.en: The slow {accrescence} of debt eventually crushed him.
e.zh: 债务的缓慢累积最终把他压垮了。

accrescent.t: 持续增大的；宿存增长的

e.en: The fruit is enclosed by an {accrescent} calyx.
e.zh: 果实被一个持续增大的花萼包裹。

e.en: Researchers measured the {accrescent} structures weekly.
e.zh: 研究人员每周测量这些不断增大的结构。

e.en: Geologists study the {accretionary} wedge offshore.
e.zh: 地质学家研究海面下的增积楔。

e.en: Knowledge grows in an {accretionary} way over years.
e.zh: 知识多年来以渐进累积的方式增长。

e.en: Interest is {accruable} from the date of deposit.
e.zh: 利息自存款之日起可应计。

e.en: Vacation days are {accruable} each month.
e.zh: 假期天数按月累计。

e.en: The {accruement} of interest doubled the loan.
e.zh: 利息的累积使贷款翻了一番。

e.en: He tracked the slow {accruement} of benefits.
e.zh: 他追踪着福利的缓慢累积。

acculturational.t: 文化适应的；文化涵化的

e.en: The study explores {acculturational} stress in immigrants.
e.zh: 该研究探讨移民的文化适应压力。

e.en: Schools provide {acculturational} support for refugees.
e.zh: 学校为难民提供文化适应方面的支持。

acculturize.t: 使文化同化；使适应新文化

e.en: The program aims to {acculturize} new arrivals quickly.
e.zh: 该项目旨在让新移民迅速适应当地文化。

e.en: It can take years to fully {acculturize} abroad.
e.zh: 在国外完全文化适应可能需要数年。

e.en: Roman dining featured the {accumbency} of guests.
e.zh: 罗马人的宴饮中宾客侧卧而食。

e.en: The painting depicts the {accumbency} of the gods.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了诸神侧卧的姿态。

e.en: Guests at Roman feasts were {accumbent} on couches.
e.zh: 罗马宴会上的宾客侧卧在长椅上。

e.en: The species has {accumbent} cotyledons inside the seed.
e.zh: 该物种种子内有偃卧的子叶。

e.en: The damage was {accumulational} rather than sudden.
e.zh: 这种损害是累积性的，而非突然发生的。

e.en: Researchers noted an {accumulational} effect over years.
e.zh: 研究人员注意到多年来的累积效应。

e.en: He paid a gunsmith to {accurize} his rifle.
e.zh: 他请枪械师为他的步枪提高精度。

e.en: They {accurize} target pistols for competitions.
e.zh: 他们为比赛对靶手枪进行精度调校。

e.en: The {accurst} ring brought ruin to its bearers.
e.zh: 那枚被诅咒的戒指给佩戴者带来毁灭。

e.en: He muttered about his {accurst} luck.
e.zh: 他嘟囔着自己倒霉透顶。

e.en: He is {accusable} of nothing more than poor judgment.
e.zh: 他至多只能被指责判断不当。

e.en: No one in the room was clearly {accusable}.
e.zh: 房间里没有人明显该受指责。

e.en: Her {accusal} stunned the entire courtroom.
e.zh: 她的指控震惊了整个法庭。

e.en: He denied every detail of the {accusal}.
e.zh: 他否认了指控的每一个细节。

e.en: The {accusant} took the stand first.
e.zh: 指控者首先出庭作证。

e.en: Lawyers questioned the {accusant} for hours.
e.zh: 律师们盘问了原告数小时。

e.en: Latin marks objects with an {accusatival} ending.
e.zh: 拉丁语用宾格词尾标记宾语。

e.en: The pronoun takes an {accusatival} form here.
e.zh: 该代词在此处采用宾格形式。

e.en: In German, the direct object takes the {accusative}.
e.zh: 在德语中，直接宾语使用宾格。

e.en: She corrected my {accusative} ending in class.
e.zh: 她在课上纠正了我的宾格词尾。

e.en: Russian {accusatives} differ for animate nouns.
e.zh: 俄语中有生命名词的宾格形式有所不同。

e.en: The textbook lists all the {accusatives} in a table.
e.zh: 课本用表格列出了所有宾格形式。

e.en: Her tone was sharp and {accusatorial}.
e.zh: 她的语气尖锐而带指责。

e.en: Common law uses an {accusatorial} system of justice.
e.zh: 普通法采用控告式诉讼制度。

acetylsalicylic.t: 乙酰水杨酸的（即阿司匹林的化学名）

e.en: Aspirin is chemically known as {acetylsalicylic} acid.
e.zh: 阿司匹林的化学名称是乙酰水杨酸。

e.en: She is allergic to {acetylsalicylic} acid and avoids aspirin.
e.zh: 她对乙酰水杨酸过敏，因此不吃阿司匹林。

acetyltransferase.t: 乙酰转移酶（一类催化乙酰基转移的酶）

e.en: Histone {acetyltransferase} enzymes regulate gene expression.
e.zh: 组蛋白乙酰转移酶调控基因的表达。

e.en: The drug inhibits a key {acetyltransferase} in the pathway.
e.zh: 该药物抑制了通路中关键的乙酰转移酶。

acey-deucey.t: 一种类似双陆棋的游戏；（扑克）一点和爱司（A）

e.en: The sailors played {acey-deucey} to pass the time.
e.zh: 水手们玩双陆棋打发时间。

e.en: He was dealt an {acey-deucey} on the first hand.
e.zh: 第一手他就拿到了一张A和一张2。

acey-deucy.t: 一种类似双陆棋的游戏（acey-deucey 的异体拼写）

e.en: They taught me how to play {acey-deucy} aboard the ship.
e.zh: 他们在船上教我玩这种双陆棋。

e.en: Grandpa still keeps his old {acey-deucy} board.
e.zh: 爷爷还保留着他那块旧的双陆棋盘。

achalasia.t: 贲门失弛缓症（食管下端括约肌无法松弛的疾病）

e.en: She was diagnosed with {achalasia} after months of swallowing problems.
e.zh: 在吞咽困难持续数月后，她被诊断为贲门失弛缓症。

e.en: Surgery can relieve the symptoms of {achalasia}.
e.zh: 手术可以缓解贲门失弛缓症的症状。

achene.t: 瘦果（一种小而干的不开裂果实）

e.en: A sunflower seed is technically an {achene}.
e.zh: 严格说来，葵花籽是一种瘦果。

e.en: Each strawberry surface dot is actually an {achene}.
e.zh: 草莓表面的每一颗小点其实都是一颗瘦果。

e.en: The botanist examined the {achenial} structure under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察了瘦果的结构。

e.en: Sunflowers display distinctive {achenial} features.
e.zh: 向日葵呈现出独特的瘦果特征。

achiest.t: 最酸痛的（achy 的最高级）

e.en: That marathon left me with the {achiest} legs of my life.
e.zh: 那场马拉松让我的双腿酸痛到前所未有的程度。

e.en: By day three of the flu, I felt {achiest} all over.
e.zh: 流感第三天，我浑身酸痛到了极点。

e.en: The team questioned the {achievability} of the deadline.
e.zh: 团队对这个截止日期能否完成提出了质疑。

e.en: We assessed the {achievability} of each goal before committing.
e.zh: 在承诺之前，我们评估了每个目标的可达成性。

e.en: A general {achiness} is often the first sign of flu.
e.zh: 全身酸痛常常是流感的最初征兆。

e.en: She complained of {achiness} in her shoulders after the long drive.
e.zh: 长途驾驶后，她抱怨肩膀酸痛。

achiote.t: 胭脂树；胭脂树红（一种橙红色食用色素）

e.en: The rice gets its orange color from {achiote}.
e.zh: 这道米饭的橙色来自胭脂树红。

e.en: She marinated the chicken in {achiote} paste.
e.zh: 她用胭脂树红酱腌制了鸡肉。

achlamydeous.t: （植物学）无花被的；无花萼花瓣的

e.en: Willows produce small, {achlamydeous} flowers.
e.zh: 柳树开的是细小的无花被花。

e.en: The species is notable for its {achlamydeous} blossoms.
e.zh: 该物种以其无花被的花朵而引人注目。

e.en: Patients with {achlorhydria} often have trouble digesting protein.
e.zh: 胃酸缺乏症患者往往难以消化蛋白质。

e.en: Long-term acid blockers can lead to {achlorhydria}.
e.zh: 长期服用抑酸药可能导致胃酸缺乏症。

achondrite.t: 无球粒陨石（一种不含球粒的石质陨石）

e.en: The meteorite was identified as a rare {achondrite}.
e.zh: 这块陨石被鉴定为罕见的无球粒陨石。

e.en: Scientists study {achondrite} samples to learn about planet formation.
e.zh: 科学家通过研究无球粒陨石样本来了解行星的形成。

e.en: She pointed her finger {accusatorially} at the suspect.
e.zh: 她指责地用手指指着嫌疑人。

e.en: He stared {accusatorially} across the table.
e.zh: 他隔着桌子带着指责的目光盯着对方。

e.en: In his book she was {ace-high}.
e.zh: 在他眼里她是头等人物。

e.en: That diner serves {ace-high} pancakes.
e.zh: 那家小餐馆做的煎饼一流。

e.en: The lawyer kept one witness as her {ace-in-the-hole}.
e.zh: 律师把一名证人作为她的秘密王牌。

e.en: Their new pitcher is the team's {ace-in-the-hole}.
e.zh: 新投手是球队的杀手锏。

e.en: The monk struggled with a deep {acedia}.
e.zh: 那位修士饱受深重的精神倦怠之苦。

e.en: Long winters can bring on a kind of {acedia}.
e.zh: 漫长的冬季会带来一种倦怠感。

e.en: The fragment was an {acentric} chromosome.
e.zh: 该片段是一条无着丝粒的染色体。

e.en: The painting has an unusual {acentric} composition.
e.zh: 这幅画的构图非常少见，没有中心。

e.en: The movement became {acephalous} after the leader's arrest.
e.zh: 领导人被捕后，这场运动群龙无首。

e.en: Some worms are essentially {acephalous}.
e.zh: 有些蠕虫基本上是无头的。

e.en: The plant has slender {acerate} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物长着细长的针状叶。

e.en: Pine needles are typically {acerate}.
e.zh: 松针通常呈针形。

e.en: His {acerb} remarks silenced the room.
e.zh: 他尖刻的言辞让全场安静下来。

e.en: The fruit had an {acerb} taste.
e.zh: 这果子尝起来又酸又涩。

e.en: Don't {acerbate} the situation with sarcasm.
e.zh: 别用讽刺让情况更糟。

e.en: His tone seemed designed to {acerbate} her.
e.zh: 他的语气似乎就是要惹恼她。

e.en: Her temper was {acerbated} by the long delay.
e.zh: 长时间的延误使她更加恼火。

e.en: The crisis was further {acerbated} by bad press.
e.zh: 负面报道进一步加剧了这场危机。

e.en: His silence only {acerbates} the tension.
e.zh: 他的沉默只会让紧张气氛更加剧烈。

e.en: Loud criticism {acerbates} her anxiety.
e.zh: 大声的批评加剧了她的焦虑。

e.en: He had a habit of {acerbating} every dispute.
e.zh: 他总爱让每一场争执变得更糟。

e.en: Such comments are merely {acerbating} the conflict.
e.zh: 这样的言论只会激化冲突。

e.en: She replied {acerbly} to his clumsy compliment.
e.zh: 她对他笨拙的恭维尖刻地回敬了一句。

e.en: The critic wrote {acerbly} about the new film.
e.zh: 那位评论家对这部新片写得十分辛辣。

e.en: {Acerola} is rich in vitamin C.
e.zh: 针叶樱桃富含维生素C。

e.en: She drank a glass of {acerola} juice.
e.zh: 她喝了一杯西印度樱桃汁。

e.en: Pines bear {acerose} leaves all year.
e.zh: 松树终年长着针状叶。

e.en: The shrub's {acerose} foliage felt prickly.
e.zh: 这种灌木的针状叶摸起来扎手。

e.en: The species is notable for being {acerous}.
e.zh: 该物种以无触角而著称。

e.en: They studied a small {acerous} insect.
e.zh: 他们研究了一种没有触角的小昆虫。

e.en: The fungus grows in {acervate} clusters.
e.zh: 这种真菌呈簇状成堆生长。

e.en: The spores form an {acervate} mass.
e.zh: 孢子聚集成一团。

e.en: The wine had turned faintly {acescent}.
e.zh: 这酒略微泛酸了。

e.en: An {acescent} smell rose from the jug.
e.zh: 罐子里散发出一股微酸的气味。

e.en: The surgeon examined both {acetabula} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了两侧髋臼。

e.en: The fossil's {acetabula} were unusually deep.
e.zh: 这件化石的髋臼异常深。

e.en: The flower has an {acetabuliform} cup.
e.zh: 这朵花长着一个杯状的花托。

e.en: The mushroom's {acetabuliform} cap caught his eye.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇的碟状菌盖引起了他的注意。

e.en: The femur head sits in the {acetabulum}.
e.zh: 股骨头嵌入髋臼之中。

e.en: A fracture of the {acetabulum} requires surgery.
e.zh: 髋臼骨折通常需要手术治疗。

acetacetate.t: 乙酰乙酸盐；乙酰乙酸酯

e.en: The body produces {acetacetate} during ketosis.
e.zh: 酮症时，人体会产生乙酰乙酸。

e.en: They measured {acetacetate} levels in the blood.
e.zh: 他们测量了血液中乙酰乙酸盐的水平。

e.en: The reaction produces an {acetal} as a byproduct.
e.zh: 该反应会产生缩醛作为副产物。

e.en: {Acetal} resins are used in precision parts.
e.zh: 缩醛树脂常用于精密零件。

e.en: {Acetaldehydase} helps metabolize alcohol.
e.zh: 乙醛酶有助于代谢酒精。

e.en: Low {acetaldehydase} activity causes flushing.
e.zh: 乙醛酶活性低会引起脸红反应。

e.en: {Acetamide} is used as a plasticizer.
e.zh: 乙酰胺常被用作增塑剂。

e.en: The lab synthesized pure {acetamide} crystals.
e.zh: 实验室合成了纯净的乙酰胺晶体。

e.en: Early painkillers contained {acetanilid}.
e.zh: 早期的止痛药含有乙酰苯胺。

e.en: {Acetanilid} was later replaced by safer drugs.
e.zh: 乙酰苯胺后来被更安全的药物取代。

e.en: {Acetanilide} once served as a fever reducer.
e.zh: 乙酰苯胺曾被用作退烧药。

e.en: They prepared {acetanilide} in the chemistry lab.
e.zh: 他们在化学实验室里制备了乙酰苯胺。

e.en: The lab counter is coated with an {acidproof} surface.
e.zh: 实验台表面涂有耐酸涂层。

e.en: They store the chemicals in {acidproof} containers.
e.zh: 他们将化学品存放在耐酸容器中。

e.en: {Acidulate} the water with a squeeze of lemon juice.
e.zh: 挤一点柠檬汁让水变得微酸。

e.en: Chefs often {acidulate} pear slices to keep them from browning.
e.zh: 厨师常给梨片加点酸以防变褐。

e.en: Soak the apple slices in {acidulated} water.
e.zh: 把苹果片浸在加了酸的水里。

e.en: She rinsed the artichokes in lightly {acidulated} water.
e.zh: 她用略带酸味的水冲洗洋蓟。

e.en: A splash of vinegar {acidulates} the broth nicely.
e.zh: 加少许醋能让汤汁微微变酸。

e.en: The recipe {acidulates} the cream with lemon before whipping.
e.zh: 这道食谱在打发奶油前先用柠檬使其微酸。

e.en: He kept {acidulating} the sauce until it tasted right.
e.zh: 他不断给酱汁加酸，直到味道合适。

e.en: {Acidulating} the milk produces a soft curd.
e.zh: 使牛奶微酸会形成柔软的凝乳。

e.en: Slight {acidulation} prevents the fruit from oxidizing.
e.zh: 轻度酸化可防止水果氧化。

e.en: The process requires careful {acidulation} of the mixture.
e.zh: 此工艺需要对混合物进行精细的酸化处理。

e.en: The wine had an {acidulous} aftertaste.
e.zh: 这酒带有微微的酸味余韵。

e.en: She made an {acidulous} remark about his lateness.
e.zh: 她对他迟到一事说了句尖酸的话。

e.en: There was a faint {acidulousness} in her tone.
e.zh: 她的语气中带着一丝刻薄。

e.en: The cheese is prized for its mild {acidulousness}.
e.zh: 这种奶酪因其淡淡的酸味而受推崇。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with methylmalonic {aciduria}.
e.zh: 婴儿被诊断为甲基丙二酸尿症。

e.en: {Aciduria} can indicate an underlying metabolic disorder.
e.zh: 酸尿症可能提示潜在的代谢紊乱。

e.en: The coffee tasted a bit {acidy} this morning.
e.zh: 今早的咖啡喝起来有点酸。

e.en: He didn't like the {acidy} flavor of the dressing.
e.zh: 他不喜欢这沙拉酱酸溜溜的味道。

e.en: Engravers used {acierage} to extend the life of copper plates.
e.zh: 雕版师用镀钢工艺延长铜版的寿命。

e.en: The plate underwent {acierage} before printing.
e.zh: 印版在印刷前经过了镀钢处理。

e.en: Old methods could {acierate} iron through carburization.
e.zh: 古法可通过渗碳使铁变成钢。

e.en: They used heat treatment to {acierate} the surface.
e.zh: 他们用热处理对表面进行钢化。

e.en: The crystals grew in long {aciform} clusters.
e.zh: 晶体长成细长的针状簇。

e.en: Under the microscope, the cells appeared {aciform}.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，这些细胞呈针状。

e.en: Grapes are a typical {acinaceous} fruit.
e.zh: 葡萄是典型的含小核果实。

e.en: The botanist described the berry as {acinaceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家将这种浆果描述为多核仁的。

e.en: The plant has distinctive {acinaciform} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有独特的弯刀形叶片。

e.en: Botanists call such curved leaves {acinaciform}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种弯曲的叶子称为弯刀形叶。

e.en: Severe {acinesia} can be a symptom of Parkinson's disease.
e.zh: 严重的运动不能可能是帕金森病的症状。

e.en: The patient experienced episodes of {acinesia}.
e.zh: 患者出现了几次运动不能发作。

e.en: The pancreas is composed largely of secretory {acini}.
e.zh: 胰腺主要由分泌性腺泡构成。

e.en: Each lobule contains many tiny {acini}.
e.zh: 每个小叶都包含许多微小的腺泡。

e.en: The gland has an {aciniform} structure.
e.zh: 该腺体呈葡萄状结构。

e.en: Spiders produce silk from {aciniform} glands.
e.zh: 蜘蛛通过葡萄状腺体产生丝。

e.en: Each {acinus} secretes digestive enzymes into the duct.
e.zh: 每个腺泡向导管分泌消化酶。

e.en: The histologist examined a single {acinus} under the microscope.
e.zh: 组织学家在显微镜下观察单个腺泡。

e.en: The bombers flew through heavy {ack-ack} over the city.
e.zh: 轰炸机穿过城市上空密集的高射炮火。

e.en: He served on an {ack-ack} battery during the war.
e.zh: 战时他在一支高射炮连服役。

acknowledgeable.t: 可以承认的；值得认可的

e.en: His contributions are clearly {acknowledgeable} by the team.
e.zh: 他的贡献显然是团队公认的。

e.en: The error was minor but still {acknowledgeable}.
e.zh: 这个错误虽小，但仍值得承认。

e.en: The desk was {aclutter} with old papers.
e.zh: 书桌上散乱地堆着旧文件。

e.en: Her mind was {aclutter} with worries.
e.zh: 她心里塞满了各种烦恼。

acmeism.t: 阿克梅派；高峰派诗歌运动

e.en: {Acmeism} rejected the vagueness of Russian Symbolism.
e.zh: 阿克梅派反对俄国象征主义的朦胧晦涩。

e.en: Akhmatova was a leading figure of {Acmeism}.
e.zh: 阿赫玛托娃是阿克梅派的代表人物。

e.en: This cleanser is gentle on {acne-prone} skin.
e.zh: 这款洁面乳对易长痘肌肤很温和。

e.en: She has {acne-prone} skin and avoids oily creams.
e.zh: 她皮肤易长痘，避免使用油腻的面霜。

acnode.t: 孤立点；孤点（数学曲线上的）

e.en: The curve has an {acnode} at the origin.
e.zh: 该曲线在原点有一个孤立点。

e.en: An {acnode} is an isolated point on a curve.
e.zh: 孤立点是曲线上的一个孤点。

e.en: He wore his hat {acock} at a jaunty angle.
e.zh: 他把帽子俏皮地歪戴在头上。

e.en: The rooster stood with its tail {acock}.
e.zh: 公鸡尾巴翘起地站着。

acold.t: 寒冷的；冷得发抖的（古语）

e.en: "Poor Tom's {acold}," he muttered miserably.
e.zh: "可怜的汤姆冻僵了，"他可怜地嘟囔着。

e.en: The beggar lay {acold} in the doorway.
e.zh: 乞丐冷得发抖地躺在门口。

e.en: {Aconitase} catalyzes a key step in the citric acid cycle.
e.zh: 乌头酸酶催化三羧酸循环中的关键一步。

e.en: Iron deficiency reduces {aconitase} activity.
e.zh: 缺铁会降低乌头酸酶的活性。

e.en: {Aconitine} is one of the most toxic plant alkaloids known.
e.zh: 乌头碱是已知毒性最强的植物生物碱之一。

e.en: Traces of {aconitine} were found in the victim's blood.
e.zh: 在受害者的血液中发现了微量乌头碱。

acosmism.t: 无世界论；否认世界实在性的学说

e.en: Hegel accused Spinoza's philosophy of {acosmism}.
e.zh: 黑格尔指责斯宾诺莎的哲学是无世界论。

e.en: {Acosmism} denies the reality of the material world.
e.zh: 无世界论否认物质世界的实在性。

acosmist.t: 无世界论者；主张世界非真实者

e.en: The {acosmist} sees the universe as mere illusion.
e.zh: 无世界论者把宇宙视为纯粹的幻象。

e.en: Critics labeled him an {acosmist} for denying material reality.
e.zh: 批评者因他否认物质实在而称他为无世界论者。

e.en: Ferns are {acotyledonous} plants that reproduce by spores.
e.zh: 蕨类是通过孢子繁殖的无子叶植物。

e.en: Mosses belong to the {acotyledonous} group.
e.zh: 苔藓属于无子叶植物类群。

acouchi.t: 小刺豚鼠（南美啮齿动物）

e.en: The {acouchi} is a small rodent native to South America.
e.zh: 小刺豚鼠是原产于南美洲的小型啮齿动物。

e.en: We spotted an {acouchi} foraging on the forest floor.
e.zh: 我们看到一只小刺豚鼠在林地上觅食。

acouchy.t: 小刺豚鼠（acouchi 的异体拼写）

e.en: The {acouchy} resembles a tiny agouti.
e.zh: 小刺豚鼠长得像缩小版的刺豚鼠。

e.en: Hunters rarely target the elusive {acouchy}.
e.zh: 猎人很少捕猎行踪诡秘的小刺豚鼠。

e.en: Engineers used an {acoustimeter} to measure the noise level.
e.zh: 工程师用声强计测量噪声水平。

e.en: The {acoustimeter} recorded readings above the safety threshold.
e.zh: 声强计测得的读数超过了安全阈值。

e.en: The {acoustoelectric} effect couples sound waves to electric currents.
e.zh: 声电效应将声波与电流耦合在一起。

e.en: They studied {acoustoelectric} interactions in semiconductors.
e.zh: 他们研究了半导体中的声电相互作用。

e.en: {Acoustoelectronics} combines acoustics with electronics.
e.zh: 声电子学将声学与电子学结合起来。

e.en: Surface-wave devices are central to {acoustoelectronics}.
e.zh: 表面波器件是声电子学的核心。

e.en: {Acoustooptics} studies the interaction of sound and light.
e.zh: 声光学研究声波与光波的相互作用。

e.en: Modern laser scanners rely on {acoustooptics}.
e.zh: 现代激光扫描仪依赖于声光学原理。

actinomycosis.t: 放线菌病（一种慢性感染）

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {actinomycosis} after the biopsy.
e.zh: 活检后患者被诊断为放线菌病。

e.en: {Actinomycosis} most often affects the jaw and neck.
e.zh: 放线菌病最常影响下颌和颈部。

actinomycotic.t: 放线菌病的；由放线菌引起的

e.en: The doctor identified an {actinomycotic} infection in his lung.
e.zh: 医生在他的肺部发现了放线菌引起的感染。

e.en: {Actinomycotic} lesions can be difficult to treat.
e.zh: 放线菌病变可能很难治疗。

e.en: In the past, doctors used {actinotherapy} to treat stubborn skin conditions.
e.zh: 过去医生用放射线疗法治疗顽固的皮肤病。

e.en: Modern medicine has largely replaced {actinotherapy} with newer techniques.
e.zh: 现代医学已基本用更新的技术取代了放射线疗法。

e.en: He collected every {action-figure} from the movie.
e.zh: 他收集了那部电影里的每一个动作人偶。

e.en: She gave her son a superhero {action-figure} for his birthday.
e.zh: 她送了儿子一个超级英雄玩具公仔作为生日礼物。

e.en: I watched a great {action-film} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我看了一部很棒的动作片。

e.en: The {action-film} was full of car chases and explosions.
e.zh: 这部动作片充满了飞车追逐和爆炸场面。

action-packed.t: 充满动作的；紧张刺激的

e.en: The movie was {action-packed} from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都紧张刺激。

e.en: We had an {action-packed} weekend in the mountains.
e.zh: 我们在山里度过了一个充满刺激活动的周末。

action-research.t: 行动研究（一种边实践边改进的研究法）

e.en: Teachers often use {action-research} to improve their classroom methods.
e.zh: 教师常用行动研究来改进自己的教学方法。

e.en: She published a paper based on her {action-research} project.
e.zh: 她根据自己的行动研究项目发表了一篇论文。

e.en: The film's opening {action-sequence} was absolutely breathtaking.
e.zh: 这部电影开头的动作场景实在令人屏息。

e.en: Choreographing a single {action-sequence} can take weeks.
e.zh: 编排一个动作场景可能要花上数周时间。

e.en: The director planned several {action-sequences} for the climax.
e.zh: 导演为高潮部分设计了好几段动作场景。

e.en: The actor trained for months to perform the {action-sequences} himself.
e.zh: 为了亲自演出那些动作场景，这位演员训练了好几个月。

actionably.t: 可付诸行动地；可起诉地

e.en: The report described each security flaw {actionably}.
e.zh: 报告以可付诸行动的方式描述了每个安全漏洞。

e.en: The complaint must be framed {actionably} for the court to accept it.
e.zh: 诉状必须写得可起诉，法庭才会受理。

actionless.t: 无所行动的；静止不动的

e.en: He sat in {actionless} silence by the window for hours.
e.zh: 他静止不动地在窗边坐了几个小时。

e.en: The afternoon passed in an {actionless} haze.
e.zh: 那个下午在毫无动静的恍惚中过去了。

e.en: This feature is {activable} from the settings menu.
e.zh: 这个功能可以在设置菜单中启用。

e.en: Each card is {activable} only once per turn.
e.zh: 每张卡牌每回合只能启动一次。

e.en: The filter contains {activated-carbon} to remove odors.
e.zh: 这个过滤器含有活性炭，可以去除异味。

e.en: Doctors give {activated-carbon} to patients who have swallowed poison.
e.zh: 医生给吞食了毒物的病人服用活性炭。

e.en: She bought a face mask with {activated-charcoal}.
e.zh: 她买了一款含活性炭的面膜。

e.en: {Activated-charcoal} is widely used in water filters.
e.zh: 活性炭被广泛用于净水器中。

e.en: The laptop has a sharp {active-matrix} display.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑配有清晰的主动矩阵显示屏。

e.en: {Active-matrix} screens generally offer better image quality than passive ones.
e.zh: 主动矩阵屏幕的画质通常比被动式屏幕更好。

e.en: The telescope uses {active-optics} to correct mirror distortions.
e.zh: 这台望远镜利用主动光学来校正镜面变形。

e.en: {Active-optics} systems adjust the mirror shape in real time.
e.zh: 主动光学系统实时调整镜面形状。

e.en: She bought new {activewear} for her yoga class.
e.zh: 她为瑜伽课买了新的运动服。

e.en: The brand specializes in {activewear} for long-distance runners.
e.zh: 该品牌专门生产长跑爱好者的运动服。

activistic.t: 行动主义的；积极行动派的

e.en: He took an {activistic} approach to environmental issues.
e.zh: 他对环境问题采取了行动派的姿态。

e.en: Her writing has a strongly {activistic} tone.
e.zh: 她的文章带有强烈的行动主义色彩。

e.en: The campaign aimed to {activize} young voters before the election.
e.zh: 该运动旨在选举前动员年轻选民。

e.en: We need to {activize} our supporters in the coming weeks.
e.zh: 我们需要在接下来几周里让支持者行动起来。

e.en: {Acquirability} of rare manuscripts depends on funding.
e.zh: 稀有手稿的可获得性取决于资金。

e.en: They debated the {acquirability} of the patent.
e.zh: 他们讨论了该专利的可取得性。

e.en: Many skills are {acquirable} through practice.
e.zh: 许多技能可以通过练习获得。

e.en: Few of these antiques remain {acquirable}.
e.zh: 这些古董已经很少有能买到的。

e.en: The {acquiree} was given a new brand name.
e.zh: 被收购方获得了新的品牌名称。

e.en: Employees of the {acquiree} feared layoffs.
e.zh: 被收购公司的员工担心裁员。

e.en: Her musical {acquirements} impressed everyone present.
e.zh: 她的音乐造诣令在场所有人印象深刻。

e.en: The {acquirement} of new skills takes time.
e.zh: 学习新技能需要时间。

acquis.t: 既得权利；现行法律体系

e.en: Candidate countries must adopt the EU {acquis}.
e.zh: 候选国必须采纳欧盟的现行法律体系。

e.en: The {acquis} covers thousands of legal acts.
e.zh: 这套法律体系涵盖数千项法案。

e.en: Children show different {acquisitional} patterns in language.
e.zh: 儿童在语言习得上呈现不同模式。

e.en: We studied the {acquisitional} stages of grammar.
e.zh: 我们研究了语法习得的各个阶段。

e.en: He signed an {acquittance} for the debt.
e.zh: 他签署了债务的清偿证明。

e.en: The receipt served as legal {acquittance}.
e.zh: 这张收据起到法律上的清偿凭证作用。

e.en: Philosophers have long debated {acrasia}.
e.zh: 哲学家长期讨论意志薄弱的问题。

e.en: He attributed his lapse to {acrasia}.
e.zh: 他把自己的失误归咎于自制力不足。

acrasin.t: 盘基菌素；变形菌信号物

e.en: {Acrasin} guides slime mold cells together.
e.zh: 盘基菌素引导黏菌细胞聚集。

e.en: Researchers identified {acrasin} as cyclic AMP.
e.zh: 研究者发现盘基菌素就是环磷酸腺苷。

e.en: The reservoir holds two million {acre-feet} of water.
e.zh: 这座水库可蓄两百万英亩英尺的水。

e.en: Allocations are measured in {acre-feet}.
e.zh: 配额以英亩英尺为单位计量。

e.en: Irrigation totaled fifty {acre-inches} this season.
e.zh: 本季灌溉量共五十英亩英寸。

e.en: One {acre-inch} equals about 27,154 gallons.
e.zh: 一英亩英寸约等于27154加仑。

acridine.t: 吖啶；一种含氮杂环化合物

e.en: {Acridine} dyes glow under ultraviolet light.
e.zh: 吖啶染料在紫外光下发光。

e.en: Many drugs contain an {acridine} core.
e.zh: 许多药物含有吖啶核心结构。

e.en: The {acridity} of the smoke made him cough.
e.zh: 浓烟的刺鼻气味让他咳嗽不止。

e.en: There was a hint of {acridity} in her tone.
e.zh: 她的语气中带有一丝尖刻。

e.en: Sailors used {acriflavine} as an antiseptic.
e.zh: 水手们用吖啶黄做消毒剂。

e.en: {Acriflavine} stains DNA in the lab.
e.zh: 吖啶黄在实验室中可染色DNA。

e.en: Avoid an {acritical} acceptance of online news.
e.zh: 不要不加批判地接受网络新闻。

e.en: His {acritical} support troubled the editor.
e.zh: 他不加批判的支持令编辑感到担忧。

e.en: Aristotle's {acroamatic} works targeted advanced students.
e.zh: 亚里士多德的秘传著作针对高级学生。

e.en: These teachings remained {acroamatic} for centuries.
e.zh: 这些教义几个世纪以来仅在内部口传。

acroanesthesia.t: 肢端感觉缺失；肢体麻木

e.en: Cold caused temporary {acroanesthesia} in his hands.
e.zh: 寒冷使他的双手暂时失去感觉。

e.en: {Acroanesthesia} can signal nerve damage.
e.zh: 肢端感觉缺失可能提示神经损伤。

e.en: Her {acrobacy} on the trapeze amazed everyone.
e.zh: 她在高空秋千上的杂技令所有人惊叹。

e.en: The circus showcased remarkable {acrobacy}.
e.zh: 这场马戏团展示了精彩的杂技技艺。

e.en: His verbal {acrobatism} dazzled the debaters.
e.zh: 他言辞上的高超技巧让辩手们叹服。

e.en: The film features impressive {acrobatism}.
e.zh: 这部电影包含令人印象深刻的杂技表演。

acrocarpous.t: 顶蒴的（苔藓）；顶生孢子体

e.en: Many {acrocarpous} mosses grow upright.
e.zh: 许多顶蒴苔藓直立生长。

e.en: Botanists distinguish {acrocarpous} from pleurocarpous species.
e.zh: 植物学家区分顶蒴和侧蒴苔藓。

e.en: Chromosomes 13, 14 and 15 are {acrocentric}.
e.zh: 13、14、15号染色体属于近端着丝粒型。

e.en: {Acrocentric} chromosomes can fuse during translocation.
e.zh: 近端着丝粒染色体在易位时可能融合。

e.en: The skeleton showed {acrocephalic} features.
e.zh: 该骨骼呈现出塔状颅的特征。

e.en: {Acrocephalic} skulls appear in anthropology texts.
e.zh: 人类学文献中常提到尖头颅骨。

e.en: Cold weather worsened her {acrocyanosis}.
e.zh: 寒冷的天气使她的肢端发绀加重。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed mild {acrocyanosis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断为轻度手足紫绀。

e.en: She was treated for childhood {acrodermatosis}.
e.zh: 她在儿童期接受过肢端皮肤病治疗。

e.en: {Acrodermatosis} often affects hands and feet.
e.zh: 肢端皮肤病常累及手和脚。

acrodont.t: 端生齿的；牙齿与颌骨相连

e.en: Lizards often have {acrodont} dentition.
e.zh: 蜥蜴常具有端生齿的牙齿排列。

e.en: {Acrodont} teeth fuse with the jawbone.
e.zh: 端生齿与颌骨融合。

e.en: These leaves show {acrodrome} venation.
e.zh: 这些叶片呈现顶端汇合的脉序。

e.en: {Acrodrome} patterns help identify plant families.
e.zh: 顶端脉序有助于识别植物科。

e.en: {Acrodynia} was once linked to mercury exposure.
e.zh: 肢端疼痛症曾被认为与汞接触有关。

e.en: Doctors rarely see classic {acrodynia} today.
e.zh: 如今医生很少见到典型的肢端疼痛症病例。

acrogen.t: 顶生植物；顶端生长植物

e.en: Ferns are classic {acrogens}.
e.zh: 蕨类是典型的顶生植物。

e.en: An {acrogen} grows from its tip.
e.zh: 顶生植物从顶端生长。

adaptationists.t: 适应论者（强调自然选择主导进化的学者）

e.en: Strict {adaptationists} argue every trait was shaped by natural selection.
e.zh: 严格的适应论者认为每个性状都是自然选择塑造的。

e.en: Critics say {adaptationists} ignore developmental constraints.
e.zh: 批评者说适应论者忽视了发育上的限制。

adaptative.t: 适应性的（adaptive 的较少用变体）

e.en: The paper used the older term {adaptative} instead of adaptive.
e.zh: 论文使用了较老的词adaptative，而非adaptive。

e.en: Some French-influenced texts prefer {adaptative}.
e.zh: 一些受法语影响的文本更喜欢用adaptative。

adaptive-optics.t: 自适应光学（实时校正像差的技术）

e.en: The telescope uses {adaptive-optics} to cancel atmospheric blur.
e.zh: 该望远镜利用自适应光学消除大气模糊。

e.en: {Adaptive-optics} revolutionized ground-based astronomy.
e.zh: 自适应光学彻底改变了地基天文学。

adaptogens.t: 适应原（帮助身体抗压的草本物质）

e.en: She drinks tea with {adaptogens} to manage stress.
e.zh: 她喝加了适应原的茶来缓解压力。

e.en: Ashwagandha is one of the most popular {adaptogens}.
e.zh: 南非醉茄是最流行的适应原之一。

adaptometer.t: 暗适应计（测量眼睛暗适应能力的仪器）

e.en: The clinic used an {adaptometer} to test night vision.
e.zh: 诊所用暗适应计来测试夜视能力。

e.en: Readings from the {adaptometer} indicated retinal damage.
e.zh: 暗适应计的读数显示视网膜受损。

adatom.t: 吸附原子（吸附在表面的单个原子）

e.en: Each {adatom} sits in a hollow site on the crystal surface.
e.zh: 每个吸附原子都位于晶体表面的凹位上。

e.en: They tracked the {adatom} hopping between lattice sites.
e.zh: 他们追踪吸附原子在晶格位点间的跳跃。

adatoms.t: 吸附原子（复数；附着于表面的单原子）

e.en: Gold {adatoms} diffused across the silicon surface.
e.zh: 金吸附原子在硅表面扩散。

e.en: Low temperatures slowed the migration of {adatoms}.
e.zh: 低温减缓了吸附原子的迁移。

adaxial.t: 近轴的；叶面的（朝向茎轴一侧）

e.en: The {adaxial} surface of the leaf is darker and waxy.
e.zh: 叶子的近轴面颜色较深且有蜡质。

e.en: Stomata are rare on the {adaxial} side of most leaves.
e.zh: 大多数叶子的近轴面气孔很少。

add-one.t: 加一（编程或统计中的加一操作或平滑法）

e.en: We applied {add-one} smoothing to avoid zero probabilities.
e.zh: 我们使用加一平滑来避免零概率。

e.en: The function performs a simple {add-one} on every element.
e.zh: 该函数对每个元素执行简单的加一操作。

add-up.t: 加起来；说得通；合乎情理

e.en: The numbers just don't {add-up}.
e.zh: 这些数字根本对不上。

e.en: Her story doesn't {add-up} at all.
e.zh: 她的说法完全说不通。

e.en: Only numeric fields are {addable} in this column.
e.zh: 此列中只有数值字段是可相加的。

e.en: Extra modules are easily {addable} to the system.
e.zh: 额外模块很容易加到系统中。

addax.t: 曲角羚羊（北非沙漠中的一种濒危羚羊）

e.en: The {addax} is critically endangered in the Sahara.
e.zh: 曲角羚羊在撒哈拉沙漠中极度濒危。

e.en: An {addax} can survive without drinking water for long periods.
e.zh: 曲角羚羊能长时间不喝水也能存活。

added-value.t: 附加值；增值（产品或服务的额外价值）

e.en: The training offers real {added-value} for new staff.
e.zh: 该培训为新员工提供了真正的附加值。

e.en: Customers pay more for the {added-value} of customization.
e.zh: 客户愿意为定制带来的附加值多付钱。

addend.t: 加数（加法运算中相加的数）

e.en: In 3+5, both 3 and 5 are an {addend}.
e.zh: 在3+5中，3和5都是加数。

e.en: The teacher asked the children to name each {addend}.
e.zh: 老师让孩子们说出每个加数。

addends.t: 加数（复数；加法中相加的数）

e.en: Rearrange the {addends} to make the sum easier.
e.zh: 重新排列加数，让求和更容易。

e.en: The {addends} in this problem are all even numbers.
e.zh: 这道题中的加数都是偶数。

e.en: The old textbook calls these quantities {addible}.
e.zh: 那本旧课本把这些量称为可加的。

e.en: Are these vectors {addible} in this space?
e.zh: 这些向量在该空间中可相加吗？

addictology.t: 成瘾学（研究成瘾的学科）

e.en: She specializes in {addictology} at the university hospital.
e.zh: 她在大学医院专攻成瘾学。

e.en: {Addictology} combines neuroscience and psychology.
e.zh: 成瘾学融合了神经科学和心理学。

e.en: Install the Excel {addin} to enable the new charts.
e.zh: 安装Excel插件以启用新的图表。

e.en: The {addin} crashed every time I opened the file.
e.zh: 每次打开文件时该插件都会崩溃。

addisonism.t: 艾迪生病症状群（肾上腺皮质功能减退表现）

e.en: The patient showed clear signs of {addisonism}.
e.zh: 病人表现出明显的艾迪生病症状。

e.en: Skin pigmentation is a hallmark of {addisonism}.
e.zh: 皮肤色素沉着是艾迪生病症的标志。

additament.t: 附加物；增添物（古旧用法）

e.en: The clause was a mere {additament} to the contract.
e.zh: 该条款只是合同的一个附加物。

e.en: He treated the footnote as an unnecessary {additament}.
e.zh: 他把那条脚注当作多余的附加物。

e.en: He proposed an {additory} clause to the treaty.
e.zh: 他提议在条约中加一条附加条款。

e.en: The fee included several {additory} charges.
e.zh: 费用中包含几项附加项。

e.en: Don't be such an {addle-head} about the directions.
e.zh: 别在路线问题上这么糊涂。

e.en: That {addle-head} forgot the keys again.
e.zh: 那个糊涂虫又忘带钥匙了。

e.en: He gave an {addlebrained} answer to a simple question.
e.zh: 对一个简单的问题他给出了糊涂的回答。

e.en: She felt {addlebrained} after staying up all night.
e.zh: 熬了一夜后她感觉头脑混乱。

e.en: Only an {addlehead} would lock the keys inside.
e.zh: 只有糊涂虫才会把钥匙锁在里面。

e.en: He called himself an {addlehead} for missing the deadline.
e.zh: 他说自己是个糊涂虫，错过了截止日期。

e.en: The {addlepated} clerk gave me the wrong change.
e.zh: 那位糊涂的店员找错了零钱。

e.en: He felt {addlepated} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他感到昏头昏脑。

e.en: This browser {addon} blocks tracking scripts.
e.zh: 这个浏览器附加组件可拦截追踪脚本。

e.en: The car has a roof rack as an {addon}.
e.zh: 那辆车配有一个车顶架作为附加件。

e.en: Her name is in my {address-book}.
e.zh: 她的名字在我的通讯录里。

e.en: Please update the office {address-book} this week.
e.zh: 请这周更新办公室通讯录。

addressograph.t: 地址印写机（旧式批量打印地址的机器）

e.en: The old office still kept an {addressograph} in the corner.
e.zh: 那间旧办公室角落里还放着一台地址印写机。

e.en: Mailing lists were once printed with an {addressograph}.
e.zh: 邮寄名单过去是用地址印写机打印的。

e.en: The {addressor} of the letter remained anonymous.
e.zh: 那封信的发函人保持匿名。

e.en: Please return the package to the {addressor}.
e.zh: 请把包裹退回给发件人。

e.en: No {adduceable} evidence supports the claim.
e.zh: 没有可援引的证据支持该说法。

e.en: Several {adduceable} precedents exist in case law.
e.zh: 判例法中存在多个可引证的先例。

e.en: She works at a top {ad-agency} in New York.
e.zh: 她在纽约一家顶级广告公司工作。

e.en: The {ad-agency} pitched three campaign ideas to the client.
e.zh: 这家广告公司向客户提出了三个营销方案。

ad-hoc.t: 临时的；特设的；专门为某事的

e.en: We set up an {ad-hoc} committee to handle the crisis.
e.zh: 我们成立了一个临时委员会来应对这次危机。

e.en: His decisions feel rather {ad-hoc} and unplanned.
e.zh: 他的决定显得相当随意,缺乏规划。

ad-hocracy.t: 临时管理体制；特设组织结构

e.en: The startup runs on pure {ad-hocracy} rather than rigid hierarchy.
e.zh: 这家初创公司完全靠临时调度运作,而非死板的层级制度。

e.en: Critics dismissed the agency as a chaotic {ad-hocracy}.
e.zh: 批评者把该机构贬为一种混乱的临时性组织。

e.en: The {ad-man} pitched a clever slogan in two minutes.
e.zh: 那位广告人两分钟内就想出了一句巧妙的广告语。

e.en: He spent his career as a Madison Avenue {ad-man}.
e.zh: 他一辈子在麦迪逊大道当广告人。

e.en: His advice carried an {adagial} tone of old wisdom.
e.zh: 他的建议带着古老智慧的格言味道。

e.en: She quoted an {adagial} saying about the value of patience.
e.zh: 她引用了一句关于耐心可贵的谚语式格言。

adagietto.t: 小柔板（音乐术语,速度比柔板稍快）

e.en: Mahler's Fifth Symphony features a famous {adagietto}.
e.zh: 马勒第五交响曲中有一段著名的小柔板。

e.en: The orchestra performed the {adagietto} with tender restraint.
e.zh: 乐团以柔和克制的方式演奏了这段小柔板。

e.en: Her {adamance} on the issue surprised everyone at the meeting.
e.zh: 她在这个问题上的坚定让会上每个人都感到意外。

e.en: He showed remarkable {adamance} in refusing the generous offer.
e.zh: 面对这份丰厚的提议,他表现出了非凡的坚决。

e.en: His {adamancy} eventually won him the long court case.
e.zh: 他的坚决最终让他赢得了这场漫长的官司。

e.en: She faced the criticism with quiet {adamancy}.
e.zh: 她以沉静的执拗面对所有的批评。

adamic.t: 亚当的；人类初始的；与原初纯真有关的

e.en: The poem evokes an {adamic} innocence before the fall.
e.zh: 这首诗唤起一种堕落之前、亚当般的纯真。

e.en: He longed for the {adamic} simplicity of country life.
e.zh: 他向往乡间生活那种亚当般的纯朴。

e.en: The body maintains a careful {acid-base} balance in the blood.
e.zh: 人体在血液中维持着精细的酸碱平衡。

e.en: We studied {acid-base} reactions in chemistry class.
e.zh: 我们在化学课上学习了酸碱反应。

acid-free.t: 无酸的；不含酸性物质的

e.en: Photographs should be stored in {acid-free} paper to prevent yellowing.
e.zh: 照片应存放在无酸纸中以防发黄。

e.en: The archive uses {acid-free} folders for old documents.
e.zh: 档案馆使用无酸文件夹保存旧文件。

acid-house.t: 迷幻浩室音乐（一种电子舞曲风格）

e.en: He grew up listening to {acid-house} music in the late eighties.
e.zh: 他在八十年代末听着迷幻浩室音乐长大。

e.en: The club played classic {acid-house} all night.
e.zh: 俱乐部整晚都在播放经典的迷幻浩室音乐。

acid-loving.t: 喜酸性的；适宜酸性土壤生长的

e.en: Blueberries are {acid-loving} plants that thrive in low-pH soil.
e.zh: 蓝莓是喜酸性植物，适合在低pH土壤中生长。

e.en: She added peat moss to nourish her {acid-loving} azaleas.
e.zh: 她加了泥炭藓来滋养她那些喜酸的杜鹃花。

e.en: Certain {acid-producing} bacteria contribute to tooth decay.
e.zh: 某些产酸细菌会导致蛀牙。

e.en: The stomach has {acid-producing} cells that aid digestion.
e.zh: 胃中有产酸细胞帮助消化。

e.en: The lab benches are coated with an {acid-proof} resin.
e.zh: 实验台表面涂有耐酸树脂。

e.en: Workers wore {acid-proof} gloves while handling the chemicals.
e.zh: 工人在处理这些化学品时戴着耐酸手套。

e.en: The pipes are made from {acid-resistant} stainless steel.
e.zh: 这些管道由耐酸不锈钢制成。

e.en: They used {acid-resistant} tiles in the factory floor.
e.zh: 他们在工厂地板上使用了耐酸瓷砖。

acid-tongued.t: 言辞尖刻的；说话刻薄的

e.en: The {acid-tongued} critic could ruin a play with one review.
e.zh: 这位毒舌评论家一篇评论就能毁掉一出戏。

e.en: Her {acid-tongued} remarks left everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她那些尖酸的话让大家都很不自在。

e.en: The newborn was monitored for signs of {acidaemia}.
e.zh: 医生密切观察这名新生儿是否有酸血症的迹象。

e.en: Severe {acidaemia} can damage vital organs.
e.zh: 严重的酸血症可能损害重要器官。

e.en: Tests revealed mild {acidemia} after the long surgery.
e.zh: 长时间手术后检查显示出轻度酸血症。

e.en: Untreated {acidemia} can lead to organ failure.
e.zh: 未经治疗的酸血症可能导致器官衰竭。

acidfast.t: 抗酸的（指能抵抗酸性脱色的微生物）

e.en: Tuberculosis bacteria are classified as {acidfast} organisms.
e.zh: 结核杆菌被归为抗酸性微生物。

e.en: The lab performed an {acidfast} stain on the sample.
e.zh: 实验室对样本进行了抗酸染色。

acidhead.t: 嗑迷幻药者；常服用LSD的人

e.en: In the sixties he was known as a hopeless {acidhead}.
e.zh: 六十年代他是个出了名的迷幻药瘾君子。

e.en: The novel features an aging {acidhead} reflecting on his youth.
e.zh: 小说讲述一个上了年纪的迷幻药瘾者回忆青春。

e.en: Lemon juice acts as a natural {acidifier} in cooking.
e.zh: 柠檬汁在烹饪中是天然的酸化剂。

e.en: Farmers added a soil {acidifier} to lower the pH.
e.zh: 农民加入土壤酸化剂以降低pH值。

e.en: The technician used an {acidimeter} to check the solution's strength.
e.zh: 技术员用酸定量计检测溶液的浓度。

e.en: An {acidimeter} measures the concentration of acid in a liquid.
e.zh: 酸定量计可测量液体中酸的浓度。

e.en: They performed an {acidimetric} titration on the wine sample.
e.zh: 他们对葡萄酒样品做了酸量滴定。

e.en: The lab uses {acidimetric} methods to determine purity.
e.zh: 实验室采用酸量滴定法测定纯度。

e.en: {Acidimetry} is a standard technique in analytical chemistry.
e.zh: 酸量滴定法是分析化学中的一项标准技术。

e.en: Students learn {acidimetry} early in lab training.
e.zh: 学生在实验培训初期就学习酸量滴定法。

e.en: The well underwent {acidization} to improve oil flow.
e.zh: 这口井经过酸化处理以提高出油量。

e.en: {Acidization} is common in petroleum engineering.
e.zh: 酸化处理在石油工程中很常见。

e.en: Engineers decided to {acidize} the well to boost production.
e.zh: 工程师决定对这口井进行酸化以提高产量。

e.en: They {acidize} the rock formation to dissolve blockages.
e.zh: 他们对岩层进行酸化处理以溶解堵塞物。

e.en: The {acidized} well produced significantly more crude.
e.zh: 酸化处理过的油井产出更多原油。

e.en: Samples from the {acidized} layer were sent for analysis.
e.zh: 从酸化层采集的样本被送去分析。

e.en: {Acidogenic} bacteria in the mouth contribute to cavities.
e.zh: 口腔中的产酸细菌会导致蛀牙。

e.en: The fermenter contained {acidogenic} microbes.
e.zh: 发酵罐中含有产酸微生物。

e.en: {Acidolysis} is used to modify the structure of fats.
e.zh: 酸解作用被用来改变脂肪的结构。

e.en: The reaction proceeds via {acidolysis} of the ester.
e.zh: 该反应通过酯的酸解进行。

e.en: The slide showed a cluster of {acidophil} cells.
e.zh: 载玻片上显示出一簇嗜酸性细胞。

e.en: {Acidophil} stains pink under standard dyes.
e.zh: 嗜酸性细胞在常规染色下呈粉红色。

acidophile.t: 嗜酸生物；适应酸性环境的生物

e.en: Some bacteria are {acidophile} organisms living in volcanic springs.
e.zh: 有些细菌是生活在火山温泉中的嗜酸生物。

e.en: Researchers study {acidophile} microbes for biotechnology uses.
e.zh: 研究人员研究嗜酸微生物以用于生物技术。

acidophilia.t: 嗜酸性；对酸性染料的亲和性

e.en: The cells displayed marked {acidophilia} under the microscope.
e.zh: 在显微镜下细胞显示出明显的嗜酸性。

e.en: {Acidophilia} helps pathologists identify certain tissues.
e.zh: 嗜酸性帮助病理学家识别某些组织。

e.en: {Acidophilic} bacteria thrive in environments with low pH.
e.zh: 嗜酸细菌在低pH环境中繁衍。

e.en: The tissue contained many {acidophilic} granules.
e.zh: 该组织含有许多嗜酸性颗粒。

e.en: She has worked in {adland} for over twenty years.
e.zh: 她在广告界工作了二十多年。

e.en: The campaign caused a stir throughout {adland}.
e.zh: 这场广告活动在整个广告界引起轰动。

e.en: Subscribers enjoy an {adless} streaming experience.
e.zh: 订阅用户可享受无广告的流媒体体验。

e.en: He prefers {adless} websites for reading news.
e.zh: 他更喜欢用无广告的网站看新闻。

e.en: Critics dismissed the show as pure {admass} entertainment.
e.zh: 评论家认为这个节目纯粹是迎合广告大众的娱乐。

e.en: He wrote about the rise of {admass} culture in postwar Britain.
e.zh: 他撰文论述战后英国广告大众文化的兴起。

e.en: The court will {admeasure} the damages owed to each party.
e.zh: 法庭将裁定应付给各方的赔偿金额。

e.en: Officials {admeasure} the land before granting titles.
e.zh: 官员在授予地契之前先丈量土地。

e.en: The estate was carefully {admeasured} among the heirs.
e.zh: 遗产在继承人之间被仔细分配。

e.en: Each plot was {admeasured} by the surveyor last spring.
e.zh: 每块地都由测量员在去年春天测定。

e.en: The {admeasurement} of dower was settled by the judge.
e.zh: 寡妇产的分配由法官裁定。

e.en: They disputed the {admeasurement} of the shared field.
e.zh: 他们对共有田地的分配测定有争议。

e.en: The {admeasurer} divided the catch among the fishermen.
e.zh: 分配员把渔获分给了各位渔民。

e.en: An official {admeasurer} oversaw the partition of the estate.
e.zh: 一位官方分配员监督了财产的分割。

e.en: The treaty {admeasures} water rights between the two states.
e.zh: 该条约在两州之间分配水权。

e.en: He {admeasures} each portion with great care.
e.zh: 他非常仔细地分配每一份。

e.en: They spent the morning {admeasuring} the disputed land.
e.zh: 他们花了一早上测定有争议的土地。

e.en: The clerk is {admeasuring} the share due to each tenant.
e.zh: 书记员正在分配每位租户应得的份额。

e.en: The letter served as an {adminicle} to the main testimony.
e.zh: 这封信作为主要证词的辅助证据。

e.en: Scots law treats this document as a useful {adminicle}.
e.zh: 苏格兰法律将这份文件视为有用的佐证。

e.en: The diary was offered as {adminicular} evidence at trial.
e.zh: 该日记在庭审中作为辅助证据提出。

e.en: Witness statements provided {adminicular} support to the contract.
e.zh: 证人陈述为该合同提供了佐证支持。

e.en: The notes were treated as {adminiculary} material.
e.zh: 这些笔记被当作辅助材料处理。

e.en: He cited {adminiculary} sources to back his claim.
e.zh: 他引用了佐证性资料来支持自己的主张。

e.en: She holds an {administerial} role in the ministry.
e.zh: 她在部里担任行政职务。

e.en: The reforms reduced {administerial} overhead significantly.
e.zh: 改革大幅削减了行政管理开支。

e.en: The new rule must be clear and {administrable}.
e.zh: 新规则必须清晰且可施行。

e.en: Judges prefer tests that are easily {administrable}.
e.zh: 法官偏好易于施行的判断标准。

e.en: He served as the chief {administrant} of the trust.
e.zh: 他担任该信托的主要管理者。

e.en: The {administrant} signed off on every disbursement.
e.zh: 管理者批准了每一笔支出。

e.en: She was appointed to the {administratorship} of the estate.
e.zh: 她被任命担任该遗产的管理者职位。

e.en: His {administratorship} lasted nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他的管理任期持续了将近十年。

e.en: The two {administratrices} jointly handled the estate.
e.zh: 两位女管理人共同处理这份遗产。

e.en: Court records list several {administratrices} from that period.
e.zh: 法院记录列出了那个时期的几位女管理人。

administratrix.t: 女管理人；女遗产管理人

e.en: She was named {administratrix} of her father's estate.
e.zh: 她被指定为父亲遗产的女管理人。

e.en: The {administratrix} filed the inventory with the court.
e.zh: 该女管理人向法院提交了财产清单。

e.en: Let's get the {administrivia} out of the way first.
e.zh: 我们先把行政琐事处理掉吧。

e.en: He's tired of dealing with daily {administrivia}.
e.zh: 他厌倦了处理每天的繁琐杂务。

e.en: The {admirability} of her conduct was widely noted.
e.zh: 她行为的可钦佩之处广受称道。

e.en: Few would dispute the {admirability} of his sacrifice.
e.zh: 很少有人会质疑他牺牲的可敬之处。

admiralship.t: 海军上将职位；海军统帅权

e.en: He was elevated to the {admiralship} after the war.
e.zh: 战后他被擢升至海军上将之职。

e.en: Her {admiralship} marked a milestone for the navy.
e.zh: 她担任海军上将是该海军的里程碑。

e.en: She gave him an {admirative} glance across the room.
e.zh: 她隔着房间朝他投去钦佩的目光。

e.en: His tone was clearly {admirative} rather than envious.
e.zh: 他的语气显然是钦佩而非嫉妒。

e.en: The court found his statement to be {admissive} of guilt.
e.zh: 法庭认定他的陈述属于认罪表示。

e.en: She wore an {admissive} smile after the question.
e.zh: 被问到后她露出了承认般的微笑。

e.en: Only {admittable} evidence may be presented to the jury.
e.zh: 只有可采纳的证据才能呈交陪审团。

e.en: His application was deemed {admittable} by the committee.
e.zh: 委员会认定他的申请可被接纳。

e.en: The new {admittees} gathered for orientation.
e.zh: 新录取者聚在一起参加迎新活动。

e.en: All {admittees} must complete the medical forms.
e.zh: 所有被录取者都必须填妥体检表。

admittible.t: 可接纳的；可采信的（admissible 异体）

e.en: The judge ruled the photos were {admittible} as evidence.
e.zh: 法官裁定这些照片作为证据可被采信。

e.en: His excuse was hardly {admittible} to the panel.
e.zh: 他的借口很难被评审组接受。

e.en: Slowly {admix} the flour with the warm milk.
e.zh: 慢慢将面粉与温牛奶掺和在一起。

e.en: The chemist {admix}ed two solvents to make the reagent.
e.zh: 化学家将两种溶剂混合制成试剂。

e.en: The sand was {admixed} with cement before pouring.
e.zh: 砂子在浇筑前已与水泥混合。

e.en: Joy {admixed} with sorrow filled her voice.
e.zh: 她的声音里夹杂着喜悦与悲伤。

e.en: The factory installed a new chemical {admixer}.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一台新的化学混合装置。

e.en: He works as the lead {admixer} on the production line.
e.zh: 他在生产线上担任主要的混合操作员。

admixes.t: 掺和；混合（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {admixes} herbs into the broth before serving.
e.zh: 她在上桌前把香草掺入高汤里。

e.en: The recipe {admixes} sweet and savory flavors well.
e.zh: 这道食谱将甜味与咸味巧妙地融合。

e.en: He spent hours {admixing} the pigments by hand.
e.zh: 他花了几个小时手工调和颜料。

e.en: They are {admixing} additives into the fuel.
e.zh: 他们正在将添加剂掺入燃料中。

admixt.t: 已掺和的（admixed 古旧形式）

e.en: His praise was {admixt} with subtle criticism.
e.zh: 他的赞美中夹杂着微妙的批评。

e.en: The wine was {admixt} with rare spices.
e.zh: 酒中掺有珍稀香料。

e.en: She wagged her finger {admonishingly} at the children.
e.zh: 她对孩子们告诫地摇着手指。

e.en: He spoke {admonishingly} about the dangers of speeding.
e.zh: 他以告诫的口吻讲述超速的危险。

e.en: The leaves are {adnate} to the stem.
e.zh: 叶片与茎贴生在一起。

e.en: Botanists describe the structure as {adnate}.
e.zh: 植物学家将该结构描述为贴生的。

e.en: The surgeon examined the uterine {adnexa}.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了子宫附件。

e.en: Inflammation of the {adnexa} caused her pain.
e.zh: 附件发炎让她感到疼痛。

e.en: The scan revealed an {adnexal} mass.
e.zh: 扫描显示存在附件肿块。

e.en: She was referred for {adnexal} surgery.
e.zh: 她被转诊接受附件手术。

e.en: She was treated for chronic {adnexitis}.
e.zh: 她接受了慢性附件炎的治疗。

e.en: Antibiotics helped control the {adnexitis}.
e.zh: 抗生素帮助控制了附件炎。

adnominal.t: 附加于名词的；定名词的

e.en: Linguists studied the {adnominal} modifiers.
e.zh: 语言学家研究了那些附加于名词的修饰语。

e.en: The phrase serves an {adnominal} function.
e.zh: 该短语起着定名词的作用。

e.en: Grammarians call it an {adnoun}.
e.zh: 语法学家称它为形容词转化的名词。

e.en: The poor as a group is an {adnoun}.
e.zh: "穷人"作为一个群体是形容词转化的名词。

adolesce.t: 步入青春期；进入青春期

e.en: Children begin to {adolesce} around twelve.
e.zh: 孩子大约在十二岁开始步入青春期。

e.en: He started to {adolesce} earlier than his peers.
e.zh: 他比同龄人更早进入青春期。

e.en: He recalled his turbulent {adolescency}.
e.zh: 他回忆起自己动荡的青春期。

e.en: Books about {adolescency} line the shelf.
e.zh: 书架上摆满了关于青春期的书。

adonai.t: 阿多奈（犹太教对上帝的尊称）

e.en: They prayed to {Adonai} every morning.
e.zh: 他们每天早晨向阿多奈祷告。

e.en: The hymn called upon {Adonai} for mercy.
e.zh: 赞美诗祈求阿多奈施以怜悯。

adonize.t: 打扮得花枝招展；精心修饰

e.en: He took hours to {adonize} before the party.
e.zh: 他在派对前花了几个小时精心打扮。

e.en: She watched him {adonize} in the mirror.
e.zh: 她看着他对着镜子精心修饰自己。

e.en: Shelters assess each dog's {adoptability}.
e.zh: 收容所会评估每只狗的可领养性。

e.en: The proposal's {adoptability} depends on cost.
e.zh: 该提案能否被采纳取决于成本。

e.en: The council condemned {adoptionism} as heresy.
e.zh: 大公会议谴责嗣子说为异端。

e.en: Scholars debated the origins of {adoptionism}.
e.zh: 学者们争论嗣子说的起源。

adoptionist.t: 嗣子说信奉者；嗣子说的

e.en: He was branded an {adoptionist} by the bishops.
e.zh: 他被主教们斥为嗣子说信奉者。

e.en: Their theology had {adoptionist} undertones.
e.zh: 他们的神学带有嗣子说的色彩。

e.en: The puppy's {adorability} won everyone over.
e.zh: 那只小狗的可爱征服了所有人。

e.en: Her smile had a quiet {adorability}.
e.zh: 她的微笑有一种安静的惹人怜爱。

e.en: They built an {adoratory} chapel on the hill.
e.zh: 他们在山上建了一座礼拜小教堂。

e.en: The crowd offered {adoratory} chants.
e.zh: 人群献上崇拜的吟唱。

e.en: The knight rode {adown} the valley.
e.zh: 骑士向山谷下方驰去。

e.en: Tears flowed {adown} her cheeks.
e.zh: 泪水顺着她的脸颊流下。

e.en: The cat lay {adoze} by the fire.
e.zh: 猫在炉火旁打着盹。

e.en: He sat {adoze} in his armchair.
e.zh: 他在扶手椅里昏昏欲睡。

e.en: The {adperson} pitched a clever campaign.
e.zh: 那位广告人提出了一个巧妙的方案。

e.en: She works as an {adperson} in Manhattan.
e.zh: 她在曼哈顿做广告人。

e.en: The petals {adpress} against the stem.
e.zh: 花瓣紧贴在茎上。

e.en: He saw the leaves {adpress} tightly.
e.zh: 他看到叶子紧紧贴附着。

e.en: The hairs are {adpressed} to the surface.
e.zh: 那些毛紧贴在表面上。

e.en: Note the {adpressed} scales on the leaf.
e.zh: 注意叶片上贴伏的鳞片。

e.en: She lay {adream} on the summer grass.
e.zh: 她在夏日的草地上做着梦。

e.en: The child fell {adream} by noon.
e.zh: 那孩子到中午就进入梦乡。

e.en: Surgeons had to {adrenalectomize} the patient.
e.zh: 外科医生不得不为病人切除肾上腺。

e.en: They will {adrenalectomize} the rat for the study.
e.zh: 他们将切除大鼠的肾上腺用于研究。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {adrenalectomy} to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生施行了肾上腺切除术以摘除肿瘤。

e.en: Recovery from an {adrenalectomy} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 肾上腺切除术后的恢复通常需要数周。

adrenalize.t: 使肾上腺素激增；使兴奋

e.en: The roaring crowd seemed to {adrenalize} the players.
e.zh: 观众的欢呼似乎让球员们肾上腺素飙升。

e.en: Loud music can {adrenalize} a tired runner.
e.zh: 响亮的音乐能让疲惫的跑者重新亢奋起来。

adrenalized.t: 肾上腺素激增的；亢奋的

e.en: He felt {adrenalized} before the championship match.
e.zh: 冠军赛前他感到肾上腺素飙升。

e.en: The crowd was {adrenalized} by the last-minute goal.
e.zh: 最后一分钟的进球让观众群情激昂。

e.en: Beta-blockers reduce {adrenergic} activity in the heart.
e.zh: β受体阻滞剂可降低心脏的肾上腺素能活性。

e.en: The drug targets {adrenergic} receptors in the lungs.
e.zh: 该药物作用于肺部的肾上腺素能受体。

e.en: {Adrenochrome} forms when adrenaline oxidizes in the body.
e.zh: 肾上腺素在体内氧化时会生成肾上腺色素。

e.en: Researchers studied the effects of {adrenochrome} on perception.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了肾上腺色素对感知的影响。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with an {adrenocortical} tumor.
e.zh: 该患者被诊断出患有肾上腺皮质肿瘤。

e.en: Stress affects {adrenocortical} hormone production.
e.zh: 压力会影响肾上腺皮质激素的分泌。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {adrenocorticoids} to reduce inflammation.
e.zh: 医生开肾上腺皮质激素以减轻炎症。

e.en: Long-term use of {adrenocorticoids} carries serious side effects.
e.zh: 长期使用肾上腺皮质激素会带来严重副作用。

e.en: The patient received an {adrenocorticosteroid} injection.
e.zh: 病人接受了一针肾上腺皮质类固醇注射。

e.en: {Adrenocorticosteroid} therapy can suppress the immune system.
e.zh: 肾上腺皮质类固醇治疗可能抑制免疫系统。

e.en: The pituitary releases an {adrenocorticotrophic} hormone under stress.
e.zh: 应激时垂体会释放一种促肾上腺皮质激素。

e.en: Doctors measured her {adrenocorticotrophic} hormone levels.
e.zh: 医生测量了她的促肾上腺皮质激素水平。

e.en: The lab synthesized {adrenocorticotrophin} for research use.
e.zh: 实验室合成了用于研究的促肾上腺皮质激素。

e.en: {Adrenocorticotrophin} stimulates cortisol production.
e.zh: 促肾上腺皮质激素能刺激皮质醇的分泌。

e.en: The {adrenocorticotropic} hormone regulates the stress response.
e.zh: 促肾上腺皮质激素调节应激反应。

e.en: Doctors test {adrenocorticotropic} levels to diagnose Addison's disease.
e.zh: 医生通过检测促肾上腺皮质激素水平来诊断艾迪生病。

e.en: {Adrenocorticotropin} is released by the anterior pituitary.
e.zh: 促肾上腺皮质激素由垂体前叶分泌。

e.en: Synthetic {adrenocorticotropin} is used in diagnostic tests.
e.zh: 合成的促肾上腺皮质激素用于诊断性检测。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {adrenogenital} syndrome.
e.zh: 该婴儿被诊断为肾上腺生殖器综合征。

e.en: {Adrenogenital} disorders can disrupt normal hormone balance.
e.zh: 肾上腺生殖器紊乱会破坏正常的激素平衡。

adrenoleukodystrophy.t: 肾上腺脑白质营养不良症

e.en: {Adrenoleukodystrophy} is a rare genetic disorder.
e.zh: 肾上腺脑白质营养不良症是一种罕见的遗传病。

e.en: The film 'Lorenzo's Oil' depicts a family fighting {adrenoleukodystrophy}.
e.zh: 电影《罗伦佐的油》讲述了一家人对抗肾上腺脑白质营养不良症的故事。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {adrenolytic} drug to lower blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生开了一种肾上腺素阻滞药物以降低血压。

e.en: {Adrenolytic} agents block adrenaline's effects on the body.
e.zh: 肾上腺素阻滞剂会阻断肾上腺素对身体的作用。

e.en: The hormone has an {adrenotrophic} effect on the cortex.
e.zh: 该激素对肾上腺皮质具有促进作用。

e.en: {Adrenotrophic} substances stimulate the adrenal glands.
e.zh: 促肾上腺物质能刺激肾上腺。

e.en: {Adrenotrophin} levels rise sharply under chronic stress.
e.zh: 在长期压力下促肾上腺激素水平会急剧上升。

e.en: Researchers measured the patient's {adrenotrophin} concentration.
e.zh: 研究者测量了该患者的促肾上腺激素浓度。

e.en: The pituitary secretes an {adrenotropic} hormone.
e.zh: 垂体分泌一种促肾上腺激素。

e.en: {Adrenotropic} compounds act directly on the adrenal glands.
e.zh: 促肾上腺化合物直接作用于肾上腺。

e.en: {Adrenotropin} stimulates the production of cortisol.
e.zh: 促肾上腺激素能刺激皮质醇的生成。

e.en: The lab isolated {adrenotropin} from pituitary extracts.
e.zh: 实验室从垂体提取物中分离出促肾上腺激素。

adscititious.t: 外加的；附加的；非固有的

e.en: The chapter contained much {adscititious} material unrelated to the thesis.
e.zh: 该章节包含许多与论点无关的附加材料。

e.en: He stripped the argument of all {adscititious} details.
e.zh: 他剥去了论证中所有附加的细节。

adscript.t: 附属的；依附土地的农奴

e.en: Medieval peasants were often {adscript} to the land they worked.
e.zh: 中世纪农民常常依附于他们耕种的土地。

e.en: An {adscript} serf could not legally leave the manor.
e.zh: 依附性农奴在法律上不得离开庄园。

e.en: The historian discussed the {adscription} of peasants to feudal estates.
e.zh: 史学家讨论了农民对封建庄园的依附关系。

e.en: Scholars debate the {adscription} of the manuscript to a single author.
e.zh: 学者们对该手稿归属于单一作者一事尚有争议。

e.en: The {adducent} muscles pull the limb toward the body.
e.zh: 内收肌将肢体拉向身体。

e.en: Surgeons examined the {adducent} fibers carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了内收肌纤维。

e.en: No evidence is {adducible} to support that claim.
e.zh: 没有可引证的证据支持那一说法。

e.en: Several documents are {adducible} in court.
e.zh: 有几份文件可在法庭上引用。

e.en: The {adductive} motion brings the arm inward.
e.zh: 内收动作使手臂向内移动。

e.en: Therapists trained her {adductive} muscles.
e.zh: 治疗师训练了她的内收肌。

e.en: The young {adeling} stood beside the king.
e.zh: 年轻的贵族子弟站在国王身旁。

e.en: An {adeling} was groomed for future rule.
e.zh: 一位王族子弟被培养以备将来执政。

e.en: The court ruled that {ademption} applied to the missing painting.
e.zh: 法院裁定该遗赠失效适用于这幅遗失的画作。

e.en: Lawyers debated whether {ademption} occurred.
e.zh: 律师们就是否发生遗赠撤销展开辩论。

e.en: The enzyme {adenase} converts adenine to hypoxanthine.
e.zh: 腺嘌呤酶将腺嘌呤转化为次黄嘌呤。

e.en: Researchers measured {adenase} activity in tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了组织中的腺嘌呤酶活性。

e.en: The patient underwent an {adenectomy} last year.
e.zh: 该患者去年接受了腺切除术。

e.en: Recovery from {adenectomy} took several weeks.
e.zh: 腺切除术后恢复花了好几周。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed cervical {adenitis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断为颈部淋巴腺炎。

e.en: Antibiotics cleared the {adenitis} quickly.
e.zh: 抗生素迅速治好了腺炎。

e.en: The biopsy revealed {adenoacanthoma} of the endometrium.
e.zh: 活检显示子宫内膜腺棘皮癌。

e.en: Treatment for {adenoacanthoma} requires surgery.
e.zh: 腺棘皮癌的治疗需要手术。

e.en: The tumor showed {adenocarcinomatous} features.
e.zh: 肿瘤显示出腺癌特征。

e.en: Pathologists noted {adenocarcinomatous} differentiation.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到腺癌样分化。

e.en: Hormones from the {adenohypophysis} regulate growth.
e.zh: 腺垂体分泌的激素调节生长。

e.en: The {adenohypophysis} releases several key hormones.
e.zh: 腺垂体释放数种关键激素。

e.en: His textbook on {adenology} became a standard reference.
e.zh: 他的腺学教科书成为标准参考书。

e.en: She specializes in {adenology} research.
e.zh: 她专攻腺学研究。

e.en: Several {adenomata} were removed during surgery.
e.zh: 手术中切除了几个腺瘤。

e.en: The colonoscopy revealed multiple {adenomata}.
e.zh: 结肠镜检查发现多个腺瘤。

e.en: The lesion had an {adenomatoid} appearance.
e.zh: 病灶呈腺瘤样外观。

e.en: Pathologists identified an {adenomatoid} tumor.
e.zh: 病理学家鉴定出一个腺瘤样肿瘤。

e.en: Each {adenomere} secretes a specific substance.
e.zh: 每个腺末房分泌特定物质。

e.en: The {adenomere} structure was visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见腺末房结构。

e.en: The {adenophyllous} plant secretes a sticky resin.
e.zh: 这种具腺叶植物分泌黏性树脂。

e.en: Botanists classified it as {adenophyllous}.
e.zh: 植物学家将它归为具腺叶类。

e.en: The tissue appeared distinctly {adenose}.
e.zh: 该组织呈明显的腺状。

e.en: Histology described an {adenose} structure.
e.zh: 组织学描述了一种腺状结构。

e.en: The biopsy showed sclerosing {adenosis}.
e.zh: 活检显示硬化性腺病。

e.en: {Adenosis} is usually benign.
e.zh: 腺病通常是良性的。

e.en: The {adenosyl} group transfers in many enzyme reactions.
e.zh: 腺苷基在许多酶反应中发生转移。

e.en: Scientists studied the {adenosyl} radical mechanism.
e.zh: 科学家研究了腺苷基的反应机制。

e.en: {Adenosylmethionine} donates methyl groups in cells.
e.zh: 腺苷甲硫氨酸在细胞中提供甲基。

e.en: Levels of {adenosylmethionine} affect liver function.
e.zh: 腺苷甲硫氨酸水平影响肝功能。

e.en: The {adenosyltransferase} enzyme is essential for B12 metabolism.
e.zh: 腺苷转移酶对维生素B12代谢至关重要。

e.en: Mutations in {adenosyltransferase} cause metabolic disease.
e.zh: 腺苷转移酶突变会导致代谢疾病。

e.en: The {adenyl} group plays a role in signaling.
e.zh: 腺苷基在信号传导中发挥作用。

e.en: Researchers examined {adenyl} cyclase activity.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了腺苷酸环化酶的活性。

e.en: The enzyme catalyzes {adenylate} formation.
e.zh: 该酶催化腺苷酸的生成。

e.en: {Adenylate} cyclase converts ATP to cyclic AMP.
e.zh: 腺苷酸环化酶将ATP转化为环磷酸腺苷。

e.en: {Adenylic} acid is a key nucleotide.
e.zh: 腺苷酸是一种重要的核苷酸。

e.en: They measured {adenylic} acid levels in muscle.
e.zh: 他们测量了肌肉中腺苷酸的水平。

e.en: The {adenylyl} cyclase pathway regulates many cells.
e.zh: 腺苷酰基环化酶通路调控许多细胞。

e.en: Drugs target the {adenylyl} cyclase enzyme.
e.zh: 药物以腺苷酰基环化酶为靶点。

e.en: Old pharmacopoeias list {adeps} as an ointment base.
e.zh: 旧药典将动物脂列为软膏基质。

e.en: The recipe called for purified {adeps}.
e.zh: 配方需要精炼过的动物脂。

e.en: The mountains stood in {aeonian} silence.
e.zh: 群山伫立在永恒的寂静中。

e.en: He spoke of {aeonian} truths beyond time.
e.zh: 他谈论着超越时间的永恒真理。

aequorin.t: 水母发光蛋白；钙离子探针

e.en: Scientists use {aequorin} to detect calcium in cells.
e.zh: 科学家用水母发光蛋白检测细胞中的钙离子。

e.en: The {aequorin} glowed faintly in the dish.
e.zh: 培养皿中的水母发光蛋白发出微光。

aerenchyma.t: 通气组织（植物茎根中的疏松组织）

e.en: Water lilies rely on {aerenchyma} to transport oxygen.
e.zh: 睡莲依靠通气组织输送氧气。

e.en: The roots developed {aerenchyma} when flooded.
e.zh: 根部在水淹后形成了通气组织。

e.en: The dancer moved with stunning {aeriality}.
e.zh: 舞者动作呈现出惊人的空灵感。

e.en: Her music has a delicate {aeriality}.
e.zh: 她的音乐带着一种细腻的空灵气质。

e.en: They chose the {aeriest} room in the house.
e.zh: 他们选了屋里最通风的那间房。

e.en: Her gown was the {aeriest} of all.
e.zh: 她的礼服是所有礼服中最轻盈的。

e.en: The plant has {aeriferous} tissue in its stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎中有含气组织。

e.en: Doctors examined the {aeriferous} passages of the lung.
e.zh: 医生检查了肺部的输气通道。

e.en: Greens require regular {aerification} for healthy turf.
e.zh: 果岭需要定期通气作业以保持草坪健康。

e.en: The pond's {aerification} improved water quality.
e.zh: 池塘的充气处理改善了水质。

aerified.t: 已充气的；已通气处理的

e.en: The crew {aerified} the lawn yesterday.
e.zh: 工人昨天给草坪做了通气处理。

e.en: Properly {aerified} soil drains better.
e.zh: 经过良好通气的土壤排水更好。

e.en: The pump {aerifies} the water in the tank.
e.zh: 水泵给水箱里的水充气。

e.en: He {aerifies} the soil every spring.
e.zh: 他每年春天都给土壤通气。

e.en: Steam is an {aeriform} substance.
e.zh: 水蒸气是一种气态物质。

e.en: His promises felt {aeriform} and unreal.
e.zh: 他的承诺感觉虚无缥缈，不真实。

e.en: We need to {aerify} the putting greens.
e.zh: 我们需要给推杆果岭通气。

e.en: They {aerify} the compost weekly.
e.zh: 他们每周给堆肥通气。

e.en: They are {aerifying} the fairway today.
e.zh: 他们今天正在给球道通气。

e.en: The machine kept {aerifying} the soil for hours.
e.zh: 机器持续给土壤通气好几个小时。

e.en: She danced {aerily} across the stage.
e.zh: 她轻盈地在舞台上起舞。

e.en: He spoke {aerily} of his big plans.
e.zh: 他轻飘飘地谈论着他的宏大计划。

aero-marine.t: 航空与海洋的；空海两用的

e.en: The company specializes in {aero-marine} engineering.
e.zh: 公司专注于空海两用工程。

e.en: They built {aero-marine} rescue equipment.
e.zh: 他们制造了空海两用的救援设备。

aero-space.t: 航空航天的；航空航天工业

e.en: He works in the {aero-space} industry.
e.zh: 他在航空航天行业工作。

e.en: The university offers {aero-space} engineering courses.
e.zh: 该大学开设航空航天工程课程。

e.en: Engineers studied the {aeroacoustic} noise of the jet.
e.zh: 工程师研究了喷气式飞机的气动声学噪声。

e.en: The wing's {aeroacoustic} design reduces wind noise.
e.zh: 机翼的气动声学设计降低了风噪。

aeroacoustics.t: 气动声学（研究气流产生噪声的学科）

e.en: She specializes in {aeroacoustics} at the lab.
e.zh: 她在实验室专攻气动声学。

e.en: {Aeroacoustics} helps engineers design quieter aircraft.
e.zh: 气动声学帮助工程师设计更安静的飞机。

e.en: Pollen is a common {aeroallergen} in spring.
e.zh: 花粉是春季常见的空气过敏原。

e.en: The clinic tests for every major {aeroallergen}.
e.zh: 诊所对各种主要空气过敏原都进行检测。

e.en: Indoor {aeroallergens} include dust mites and mold.
e.zh: 室内空气过敏原包括尘螨和霉菌。

e.en: Patients reacted to several {aeroallergens}.
e.zh: 患者对多种空气过敏原产生反应。

aerobacteria.t: 需氧细菌；空气中的细菌

e.en: They cultured {aerobacteria} from the air sample.
e.zh: 他们从空气样本中培养出需氧细菌。

e.en: Some {aerobacteria} thrive in oxygen-rich environments.
e.zh: 一些需氧细菌在富氧环境中繁衍。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on {aerobacteriology}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于空气细菌学的论文。

e.en: {Aerobacteriology} examines microbes carried by air.
e.zh: 空气细菌学研究空气中携带的微生物。

e.en: The missile follows an {aeroballistic} trajectory.
e.zh: 该导弹沿空气弹道飞行。

e.en: Engineers tested the {aeroballistic} model in the tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师在风洞中测试了空气弹道模型。

e.en: He teaches {aeroballistics} at the academy.
e.zh: 他在军校教授空气弹道学。

e.en: {Aeroballistics} is essential for missile design.
e.zh: 空气弹道学对导弹设计至关重要。

e.en: The {aerobat} performed daring stunts overhead.
e.zh: 特技飞行员在头顶表演大胆的特技。

e.en: She trained for years to become an {aerobat}.
e.zh: 她训练多年才成为特技飞行员。

e.en: Most fungi are obligate {aerobes}.
e.zh: 大多数真菌是专性需氧生物。

e.en: This bacterium is a strict {aerobe}.
e.zh: 这种细菌是严格的需氧菌。

aerobicize.t: 做有氧运动；进行有氧锻炼

e.en: They {aerobicize} every morning before work.
e.zh: 他们每天上班前都做有氧运动。

e.en: The class {aerobicized} to upbeat music.
e.zh: 全班伴着欢快的音乐做有氧运动。

e.en: The team conducted {aerobiological} surveys near the farm.
e.zh: 团队在农场附近进行了空气生物学调查。

e.en: Pollen counts are part of {aerobiological} research.
e.zh: 花粉计数是空气生物学研究的一部分。

e.en: The samples were analyzed {aerobiologically} for fungal spores.
e.zh: 这些样本以空气生物学方法分析真菌孢子。

e.en: They studied the pollen {aerobiologically} across seasons.
e.zh: 他们以空气生物学方式研究了不同季节的花粉。

aerobiology.t: 空气生物学；气传生物学

e.en: She specializes in {aerobiology} and airborne allergens.
e.zh: 她专攻空气生物学和气传过敏原。

e.en: {Aerobiology} helps predict pollen seasons.
e.zh: 空气生物学有助于预测花粉季节。

e.en: Most plants are {aerobionts} that need oxygen.
e.zh: 大多数植物是需要氧气的需氧生物。

e.en: The lab cultured several soil {aerobionts}.
e.zh: 实验室培养了几种土壤中的需氧生物。

aerobiosis.t: 需氧生活；有氧生命活动

e.en: {Aerobiosis} requires the presence of free oxygen.
e.zh: 需氧生活需要存在游离氧气。

e.en: Many bacteria depend on {aerobiosis} to survive.
e.zh: 许多细菌依赖有氧生命活动生存。

e.en: These microbes thrive in {aerobiotic} conditions.
e.zh: 这些微生物在需氧条件下繁衍。

e.en: The culture became strictly {aerobiotic}.
e.zh: 该培养物变成严格需氧的。

e.en: An {aerobium} cannot grow without oxygen.
e.zh: 需氧菌没有氧气就无法生长。

e.en: They isolated a soil {aerobium}.
e.zh: 他们分离出一种土壤需氧菌。

e.en: The plane carried a single {aerobomb}.
e.zh: 飞机携带了一枚航空炸弹。

e.en: An {aerobomb} struck the warehouse.
e.zh: 一枚航空炸弹击中了仓库。

e.en: The probe used {aerobraking} to enter Mars orbit.
e.zh: 探测器利用大气制动进入火星轨道。

e.en: {Aerobraking} saves a lot of fuel.
e.zh: 气动减速能节省大量燃料。

e.en: {Aerocartography} produces maps from aerial photos.
e.zh: 航空制图学根据航拍照片绘制地图。

e.en: He teaches {aerocartography} at the academy.
e.zh: 他在学院教授航空制图学。

e.en: The plant uses {aerochlorination} to treat water.
e.zh: 该工厂使用空气加氯法处理水。

e.en: {Aerochlorination} reduces bacterial loads efficiently.
e.zh: 空气加氯消毒能有效降低细菌量。

e.en: Various {aerocraft} were displayed at the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了各种飞行器。

e.en: He pilots a small {aerocraft}.
e.zh: 他驾驶一架小型航空器。

e.en: Pilots sometimes suffer from {aerodontalgia} at altitude.
e.zh: 飞行员有时在高空会出现航空性牙痛。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed {aerodontalgia}.
e.zh: 牙医诊断为航空性牙痛。

e.en: The {aerodynamicist} redesigned the wing.
e.zh: 这位空气动力学家重新设计了机翼。

e.en: She works as an {aerodynamicist} at the firm.
e.zh: 她在该公司担任空气动力学家。

e.en: An {aerodyne} relies on aerodynamic lift.
e.zh: 重航空器依赖空气动力升力。

e.en: Helicopters are a kind of {aerodyne}.
e.zh: 直升机是一种重航空器。

e.en: They studied {aeroelastic} effects on the wing.
e.zh: 他们研究了机翼的气动弹性效应。

e.en: {Aeroelastic} flutter can damage aircraft.
e.zh: 气动弹性颤振可能损坏飞机。

e.en: The {aeroelastician} flagged a flutter risk.
e.zh: 这位气动弹性专家指出了颤振风险。

e.en: He trained as an {aeroelastician}.
e.zh: 他接受过气动弹性专家的训练。

e.en: {Aeroelasticity} is crucial for aircraft design.
e.zh: 气动弹性学对飞机设计至关重要。

e.en: She lectures on {aeroelasticity}.
e.zh: 她讲授气动弹性学。

e.en: Divers risk {aeroembolism} when surfacing too fast.
e.zh: 潜水员上升过快时有空气栓塞的风险。

e.en: He was treated for {aeroembolism}.
e.zh: 他因减压病接受了治疗。

e.en: High-altitude pilots can develop {aeroemphysema}.
e.zh: 高空飞行员可能患上航空性气肿。

e.en: The doctor warned about {aeroemphysema}.
e.zh: 医生警告了航空性气肿的危险。

e.en: The {aeroengine} was overhauled last week.
e.zh: 这台航空发动机上周做了大修。

e.en: They manufacture {aeroengines} for jets.
e.zh: 他们为喷气机制造航空发动机。

e.en: The plant installed a new {aerofilter}.
e.zh: 该工厂安装了新的生物滤池。

e.en: An {aerofilter} treats the wastewater.
e.zh: 一台生物滤池处理这些废水。

e.en: The farm uses an {aerogenerator} for power.
e.zh: 农场使用一台风力发电机供电。

e.en: They installed several {aerogenerators} on the hill.
e.zh: 他们在山上安装了几台风力发电机。

e.en: She sent an {aerogram} to her family overseas.
e.zh: 她给海外的家人寄了一封航空邮简。

e.en: The old {aerogram} was folded into its own envelope.
e.zh: 那种旧式航空邮简折起来本身就是信封。

e.en: He bought an {aerogramme} at the post office.
e.zh: 他在邮局买了一张航空邮简。

e.en: The blue {aerogramme} arrived a month later.
e.zh: 那张蓝色的航空邮简一个月后才到。

e.en: She kept a stack of old {aerograms} in a drawer.
e.zh: 她在抽屉里收着一摞旧航空邮简。

e.en: They exchanged {aerograms} during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间他们靠航空邮简通信。

e.en: The museum displayed a small {aerolite} found in the desert.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块在沙漠里发现的石陨石。

e.en: Scientists analyzed the {aerolite} for traces of organic compounds.
e.zh: 科学家分析这块石陨石中是否含有有机化合物的痕迹。

e.en: An {aerolith} crashed into the field overnight.
e.zh: 一块陨石在夜里坠落到田地里。

e.en: The {aerolith} was darker than the surrounding stones.
e.zh: 这块石陨石比周围的石头颜色更深。

e.en: They launched balloons to gather {aerological} data.
e.zh: 他们放飞气球以收集高空气象数据。

e.en: The station publishes daily {aerological} reports.
e.zh: 该站每天发布高空气象观测报告。

e.en: The {aerologist} interpreted the upper-air soundings.
e.zh: 那位高空气象学家解读了高空探测数据。

e.en: Each ship carried a trained {aerologist} during the war.
e.zh: 战时每艘舰船都配有受过训练的高空气象学家。

e.en: He specialized in {aerology} during his graduate studies.
e.zh: 他研究生阶段专攻高空气象学。

e.en: Modern weather forecasting relies heavily on {aerology}.
e.zh: 现代天气预报在很大程度上依赖高空气象学。

e.en: They flew an {aeromagnetic} survey over the basin.
e.zh: 他们在该盆地上空进行了航空磁测调查。

e.en: The {aeromagnetic} map revealed a hidden fault.
e.zh: 航空磁测图揭示了一条隐伏断层。

e.en: Ancient priests practiced {aeromancy} to predict storms.
e.zh: 古代祭司用观气占卜术预测风暴。

e.en: The book described {aeromancy} as reading omens in the sky.
e.zh: 书中把观气占卜术描述为解读天象的预兆。

e.en: The {aeromechanic} inspected the engine before takeoff.
e.zh: 航空机械师在起飞前检查了发动机。

e.en: She trained as an {aeromechanic} in the air force.
e.zh: 她在空军接受了航空机械师的培训。

e.en: He took a course in {aeromechanical} engineering.
e.zh: 他选修了一门航空机械工程课程。

e.en: The lab tests {aeromechanical} components for fatigue.
e.zh: 实验室对航空机械部件进行疲劳测试。

e.en: Students studied {aeromechanics} alongside aerodynamics.
e.zh: 学生们同时学习航空力学和空气动力学。

e.en: The textbook covers the basics of {aeromechanics}.
e.zh: 这本教材涵盖了航空力学的基础知识。

e.en: He works at an {aeromedical} evacuation unit.
e.zh: 他在一个航空医疗后送队工作。

e.en: All pilots undergo regular {aeromedical} examinations.
e.zh: 所有飞行员都要定期接受航空医学体检。

e.en: She specializes in {aeromedicine} for high-altitude pilots.
e.zh: 她专攻面向高空飞行员的航空医学。

e.en: Advances in {aeromedicine} have made long flights safer.
e.zh: 航空医学的进步让长途飞行更加安全。

e.en: The chemist used an {aerometer} to measure gas density.
e.zh: 化学家用气体比重计测量气体密度。

e.en: An old brass {aerometer} sat on the shelf.
e.zh: 一只黄铜的旧式气体比重计摆在架子上。

e.en: He published a paper on early {aerometry} techniques.
e.zh: 他发表了一篇关于早期气体测定学技术的论文。

e.en: {Aerometry} laid the groundwork for modern gas analysis.
e.zh: 气体测定学为现代气体分析奠定了基础。

e.en: The {aeromodeller} spent weekends flying his planes.
e.zh: 这位航空模型爱好者周末都在放飞自己的飞机。

e.en: She joined a club for {aeromodeller} enthusiasts.
e.zh: 她加入了一个航空模型爱好者俱乐部。

aeromotor.t: 航空发动机；风力发动机

e.en: The vintage {aeromotor} still ran smoothly.
e.zh: 那台老式航空发动机仍能平稳运转。

e.en: Farms once relied on the {aeromotor} to pump water.
e.zh: 过去农场曾靠风力发动机抽水。

adware.t: 广告软件；附带广告的程序

e.en: Free apps often come bundled with {adware}.
e.zh: 免费应用常捆绑广告软件。

e.en: I removed the {adware} from my browser.
e.zh: 我从浏览器删除了广告软件。

adwoman.t: 女广告从业者；广告界女性

e.en: She became a respected {adwoman} on Madison Avenue.
e.zh: 她成为麦迪逊大道上备受尊敬的女广告人。

e.en: The award honored a pioneering {adwoman}.
e.zh: 该奖项表彰了一位开创性的女广告人。

adwriter.t: 广告文案撰稿人；广告写手

e.en: The agency hired a witty {adwriter}.
e.zh: 广告公司雇了一位风趣的文案撰稿人。

e.en: An experienced {adwriter} can sell almost anything.
e.zh: 经验丰富的广告写手几乎什么都能卖出去。

e.en: Severe {adynamia} kept the patient bedridden for weeks.
e.zh: 严重的衰弱使病人卧床数周。

e.en: Doctors noted {adynamia} as a key symptom.
e.zh: 医生注意到无力是一个主要症状。

adynamic.t: 无力的；衰弱的；缺乏活力的

e.en: The {adynamic} patient could barely lift his head.
e.zh: 那位虚弱的病人几乎抬不起头。

e.en: Her {adynamic} response worried the doctors.
e.zh: 她无力的反应令医生担忧。

e.en: Only priests could enter the temple's {adyta}.
e.zh: 只有祭司能进入神庙的内殿。

e.en: Ancient {adyta} held sacred relics hidden from view.
e.zh: 古代的圣所藏有不为人所见的圣物。

adytum.t: 内殿；至圣所；庙宇最神圣之处

e.en: The oracle spoke from within the {adytum}.
e.zh: 神谕从内殿中传出。

e.en: Pilgrims rarely glimpsed the temple's {adytum}.
e.zh: 朝圣者很少能瞥见神庙的内殿。

e.en: The carpenter shaped the beam with an {adz}.
e.zh: 木匠用扁斧将横梁削成形。

e.en: He swung the {adz} skillfully across the timber.
e.zh: 他熟练地挥动锛子加工木材。

adzuki.t: 红豆；赤小豆；日本红小豆

e.en: She made sweet paste from boiled {adzuki} beans.
e.zh: 她把煮好的红豆做成豆沙。

e.en: {Adzuki} is popular in Japanese desserts.
e.zh: 红豆在日本甜点中很受欢迎。

aedicule.t: 壁龛；小神龛；装饰性小阁

e.en: A stone {aedicule} framed the saint's statue.
e.zh: 一座石制小神龛环绕着圣人的雕像。

e.en: The chapel's {aedicule} dated to the Renaissance.
e.zh: 教堂的小神龛可追溯到文艺复兴时期。

aedicules.t: 壁龛；小神龛；建筑中的装饰小阁

e.en: Several {aedicules} adorned the marble façade.
e.zh: 几座小神龛装点着大理石外立面。

e.en: The architect designed ornate {aedicules} for the church.
e.zh: 建筑师为教堂设计了华丽的壁龛。

aedile.t: 古罗马营造官；管理公共建筑的官员

e.en: The {aedile} oversaw public games and markets.
e.zh: 营造官负责公共竞技和市场。

e.en: He served as {aedile} before becoming praetor.
e.zh: 他在出任执法官前曾担任营造官。

aedileship.t: 营造官的职位；营造官任期

e.en: His {aedileship} was marked by lavish festivals.
e.zh: 他任营造官期间以举办盛大节日闻名。

e.en: The {aedileship} required substantial personal funds.
e.zh: 担任营造官需要大量私人资金。

aegrotat.t: 因病缺考证明；因病免试学位

e.en: He received an {aegrotat} after missing his finals.
e.zh: 他错过期末考后获得了因病缺考证明。

e.en: An {aegrotat} degree was granted due to his illness.
e.zh: 因病情他被授予了因病免试学位。

aeneous.t: 古铜色的；黄铜色的；带金属光泽的

e.en: The beetle's {aeneous} shell glinted in the sunlight.
e.zh: 那甲虫古铜色的外壳在阳光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: She admired the vase's {aeneous} sheen.
e.zh: 她欣赏花瓶上黄铜般的光泽。

aeolipile.t: 汽转球；古希腊蒸汽旋转装置

e.en: Hero of Alexandria built an early {aeolipile}.
e.zh: 亚历山大港的希罗制造了早期的汽转球。

e.en: The {aeolipile} demonstrates rudimentary steam power.
e.zh: 汽转球展示了原始的蒸汽动力。

aeolipyle.t: 汽转球；古代蒸汽旋转装置

e.en: The {aeolipyle} is sometimes called the first steam engine.
e.zh: 汽转球有时被称为第一台蒸汽机。

e.en: Children watched the spinning {aeolipyle} in awe.
e.zh: 孩子们敬畏地看着旋转的汽转球。

aeolotropic.t: 各向异性的；性质随方向而变化的

e.en: Wood is an {aeolotropic} material with grain-dependent strength.
e.zh: 木材是各向异性的材料，其强度因纹理方向而异。

e.en: Engineers must account for {aeolotropic} stresses in composites.
e.zh: 工程师必须考虑复合材料中的各向异性应力。

aeolotropism.t: 各向异性；性质随方向变化的特性

e.en: Crystals exhibit {aeolotropism} along different axes.
e.zh: 晶体沿不同方向表现出各向异性。

e.en: {Aeolotropism} affects how light passes through the mineral.
e.zh: 各向异性影响光线穿过矿物的方式。

aeolotropy.t: 各向异性；性质因方向而异

e.en: The fabric's {aeolotropy} causes uneven stretching.
e.zh: 织物的各向异性导致拉伸不均。

e.en: Researchers measured the {aeolotropy} of the new alloy.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了新合金的各向异性。

e.en: Researchers measured the {adsorbability} of the new filter material.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了新过滤材料的吸附能力。

e.en: Activated carbon's high {adsorbability} makes it ideal for purification.
e.zh: 活性炭很强的吸附性使其非常适合用于净化。

e.en: Most heavy metals are {adsorbable} on activated carbon.
e.zh: 大多数重金属可以被活性炭吸附。

e.en: The dye proved {adsorbable} by the porous resin.
e.zh: 这种染料被证明可以被多孔树脂吸附。

e.en: The {adsorbate} forms a thin layer on the surface.
e.zh: 吸附质在表面形成一层薄膜。

e.en: Researchers identified the {adsorbate} using spectroscopy.
e.zh: 研究人员用光谱法识别了被吸附物。

e.en: Different {adsorbates} interact with the surface in different ways.
e.zh: 不同的吸附质与表面的相互作用各不相同。

e.en: The chamber held several {adsorbates} for comparison.
e.zh: 舱内放置了几种被吸附物以供比较。

e.en: Activated charcoal is a common {adsorbent} in water filters.
e.zh: 活性炭是水过滤器中常用的吸附剂。

e.en: They tested a new {adsorbent} for removing odors.
e.zh: 他们测试了一种用于去除异味的新型吸附剂。

e.en: The clay has strong {adsorptive} properties.
e.zh: 这种黏土具有很强的吸附性能。

e.en: Engineers exploit the {adsorptive} capacity of zeolites.
e.zh: 工程师利用沸石的吸附能力。

e.en: The recipe asks you to {adsperse} salt over the meat.
e.zh: 食谱要求你将盐撒在肉上。

e.en: Old herbalists would {adsperse} dried petals over linens.
e.zh: 古时的药草师会把干花瓣撒在亚麻布上。

e.en: The {adstringent} solution was applied to the wound.
e.zh: 这种收敛性溶液被涂在伤口上。

e.en: He used an {adstringent} herbal lotion after shaving.
e.zh: 刮胡后他用了一种收敛性的草本润肤液。

e.en: The fibers run in an {adterminal} direction along the muscle.
e.zh: 这些纤维沿肌肉朝末端方向延伸。

e.en: Anatomists noted the {adterminal} flow of the impulse.
e.zh: 解剖学家注意到神经冲动朝末端流动。

e.en: Strabismus may involve {adtorsion} of the eyeball.
e.zh: 斜视可能涉及眼球的内旋。

e.en: The surgeon corrected the slight {adtorsion}.
e.zh: 外科医生矫正了轻微的眼球内旋。

e.en: The collector showed off a clear piece of {adularia}.
e.zh: 收藏家展示了一块通透的冰长石。

e.en: {Adularia} is prized for its moonstone-like sheen.
e.zh: 冰长石因其类似月光石的光泽而备受珍视。

e.en: He despised the {adulator} who praised his every word.
e.zh: 他鄙视那个对他每句话都奉承的家伙。

e.en: The king was surrounded by {adulators} at court.
e.zh: 国王在宫廷中被一群马屁精围着。

adult-contemporary.t: 成人当代音乐（一种流行曲风）

e.en: The station plays {adult-contemporary} hits all day.
e.zh: 这家电台整天播放成人当代流行金曲。

e.en: Her new album leans {adult-contemporary}.
e.zh: 她的新专辑偏向成人当代风格。

e.en: The city banned new {adult-entertainment} venues downtown.
e.zh: 该市禁止市中心开设新的成人娱乐场所。

e.en: He briefly invested in the {adult-entertainment} industry.
e.zh: 他曾短暂投资过成人娱乐行业。

adult-like.t: 像成年人的；显得成熟的

e.en: Her response was surprisingly {adult-like}.
e.zh: 她的回应出乎意料地像成年人。

e.en: The child gave an {adult-like} explanation of the problem.
e.zh: 这个孩子对问题给出了一个大人般的解释。

e.en: The platform offers {adult-oriented} content only.
e.zh: 该平台只提供面向成年人的内容。

e.en: It's an {adult-oriented} comedy with crude humor.
e.zh: 这是一部带粗俗幽默、面向成年人的喜剧。

e.en: The film received an {adult-rated} classification.
e.zh: 这部电影被评定为成人级。

e.en: Parents avoided the {adult-rated} section of the bookstore.
e.zh: 家长们避开了书店里成人级的区域。

e.en: Inspectors detected an {adulterant} in the milk.
e.zh: 检查员在牛奶中检出一种掺杂物。

e.en: The flour contained chalk as an {adulterant}.
e.zh: 这种面粉中掺有粉笔作为掺假物。

e.en: Authorities arrested the {adulterator} of the wine.
e.zh: 当局逮捕了那名葡萄酒掺假者。

e.en: Food {adulterators} face heavy fines.
e.zh: 食品掺假者将面临高额罚款。

adulterine.t: 私生的；伪造的；未经许可的

e.en: The {adulterine} child was excluded from the inheritance.
e.zh: 这个私生子被排除在继承之外。

e.en: Medieval lords often built {adulterine} castles without royal license.
e.zh: 中世纪的贵族常常未经王室许可就建造私堡。

adultlike.t: 像成年人的；显得成熟的

e.en: The puppy already had {adultlike} markings.
e.zh: 这只小狗已经长出了像成犬一样的斑纹。

e.en: She wrote with surprisingly {adultlike} clarity.
e.zh: 她写得清晰得不像孩子。

e.en: The insect goes through an {adultoid} stage before molting.
e.zh: 这种昆虫在蜕皮前会经历一个准成虫阶段。

e.en: He's stuck in some {adultoid} phase of fake maturity.
e.zh: 他陷在一种假装成熟的伪成年阶段。

e.en: The resort has an {adults-only} pool area.
e.zh: 度假村设有仅限成人的泳池区。

e.en: It's an {adults-only} comedy show.
e.zh: 这是一场仅限成年人的喜剧表演。

e.en: An {adumbral} hush fell over the courtyard.
e.zh: 庭院里笼罩着一片阴影般的寂静。

e.en: She painted with {adumbral} grey tones.
e.zh: 她用阴影般的灰色调作画。

e.en: His remarks were {adumbrant} of bigger changes to come.
e.zh: 他的话预示着更大的变化即将到来。

e.en: An {adumbrant} shape moved behind the curtain.
e.zh: 帘子后面有一个隐约可见的身影在移动。

e.en: Her novel offers an {adumbration} of future events.
e.zh: 她的小说预示了未来的事件。

e.en: The sketch was just a faint {adumbration} of the design.
e.zh: 这张草图只是设计的一个模糊轮廓。

e.en: His speech was {adumbrative} of policy shifts.
e.zh: 他的演讲暗示着政策的转变。

e.en: The first chapter is {adumbrative} of the whole novel.
e.zh: 第一章预示了整部小说的走向。

e.en: The dream {adumbratively} hinted at his fate.
e.zh: 这个梦隐约地暗示了他的命运。

e.en: He spoke {adumbratively} of trouble ahead.
e.zh: 他隐晦地提到前方的麻烦。

e.en: The hawk has an {adunc} beak for tearing prey.
e.zh: 这只鹰有一个钩状的喙用于撕扯猎物。

e.en: An {adunc} nose dominated his face.
e.zh: 他脸上最显眼的就是那只钩鼻。

e.en: The fossil showed {aduncate} claws.
e.zh: 化石上显示出钩状的爪子。

e.en: Botanists noted the {aduncate} tip of the leaf.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶尖呈钩状。

e.en: The {aduncity} of his nose became a family trait.
e.zh: 他鼻子的钩状成了家族特征。

e.en: Naturalists measured the {aduncity} of the talons.
e.zh: 博物学家测量了爪子的钩曲度。

e.en: The bird's {aduncous} bill cracks open seeds easily.
e.zh: 这种鸟钩状的喙能轻易啄开种子。

e.en: He drew an {aduncous} curve at the ending.
e.zh: 他在结尾处画了一条钩状的曲线。

e.en: We arrived {adusk}, with the lamps just lit.
e.zh: 我们在黄昏时分到达，灯刚刚点亮。

e.en: Cattle wander home {adusk}.
e.zh: 牛群在黄昏时漫步回家。

e.en: His face was {adust} from years in the desert sun.
e.zh: 他的脸因多年在沙漠烈日下而变得焦黑。

e.en: An {adust} mood hung over the gathering.
e.zh: 聚会上弥漫着一种忧郁阴沉的气氛。

adustion.t: 灼烧；焦灼（古旧医学用语）

e.en: Doctors once feared the body's {adustion} from prolonged fever.
e.zh: 医生曾担心身体因长期发烧而焦灼。

e.en: Old texts describe the {adustion} of the humours.
e.zh: 古籍中描述了体液的焦灼。

advance-fee.t: 预付费用的（常用于诈骗语境）

e.en: The classic {advance-fee} scam preys on desperate people.
e.zh: 经典的预付费骗局专门针对绝望的人。

e.en: Never wire money to claim a prize—it's an {advance-fee} fraud.
e.zh: 千万别为领奖汇钱——那是预付费用诈骗。

e.en: The fare requires a 14-day {advance-purchase}.
e.zh: 这个票价要求提前14天预先购买。

e.en: {Advance-purchase} discounts apply to all routes.
e.zh: 预先购买的折扣适用于所有航线。

e.en: Despite his {advanced-age}, he still hikes daily.
e.zh: 尽管他年事已高，仍每天徒步。

e.en: Health risks rise with {advanced-age}.
e.zh: 健康风险会随着年龄的增长而上升。

advanced-level.t: 高级水平的（课程或考试）

e.en: She passed the {advanced-level} chemistry exam.
e.zh: 她通过了高级水平的化学考试。

e.en: This course is for {advanced-level} students only.
e.zh: 本课程仅面向高级水平的学生。

e.en: He took several {advanced-placement} classes in high school.
e.zh: 他在高中修了几门大学预修课程。

e.en: {Advanced-placement} credits transferred to the university.
e.zh: 大学预修课的学分被大学认可。

e.en: The old bronze statue had an {aeruginous} patina.
e.zh: 那座古老的青铜雕像上覆着一层铜绿。

e.en: He noticed the {aeruginous} stains on the copper roof.
e.zh: 他注意到铜屋顶上那些铜绿色的污痕。

e.en: A layer of {aerugo} covered the ancient coin.
e.zh: 那枚古币上覆盖着一层铜绿。

e.en: The {aerugo} gave the sculpture a greenish hue.
e.zh: 铜绿使雕塑呈现出一抹绿色。

aery.t: 轻盈的；空灵的；高踞的鹰巢

e.en: Her {aery} dance seemed to float across the stage.
e.zh: 她轻盈的舞步仿佛飘过舞台。

e.en: The eagle returned to its {aery} on the cliff.
e.zh: 那只鹰回到了悬崖上的鹰巢。

e.en: The patient regained {aesthesia} after the anesthesia wore off.
e.zh: 麻醉消退后病人恢复了感觉。

e.en: Loss of {aesthesia} can indicate nerve damage.
e.zh: 感觉丧失可能意味着神经受损。

e.en: He published a textbook on {aesthesiology}.
e.zh: 他出版了一本感觉学教材。

e.en: Her research focuses on {aesthesiology} and pain perception.
e.zh: 她的研究聚焦于感觉学与疼痛感知。

e.en: He was a devoted {aestheticist} who valued beauty above all.
e.zh: 他是一位将美置于一切之上的唯美主义者。

e.en: The {aestheticist} criticized the building's plain design.
e.zh: 那位美学家批评了这栋建筑朴素的设计。

e.en: Critics warned not to {aestheticize} the violence on screen.
e.zh: 评论家警告不要把银幕上的暴力美化。

e.en: The film tries to {aestheticize} urban decay.
e.zh: 这部电影试图将城市衰败艺术化。

e.en: He was accused of {aestheticizing} suffering in his photographs.
e.zh: 他被指责在照片中将苦难美化。

e.en: The director keeps {aestheticizing} every painful scene.
e.zh: 导演不断将每个痛苦场景加以美化。

e.en: His writing reflects a strong sense of {aesthetism}.
e.zh: 他的写作流露出浓厚的唯美主义色彩。

e.en: Victorian {aesthetism} celebrated art for art's sake.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期的唯美主义崇尚为艺术而艺术。

e.en: The {aestival} heat made the afternoons unbearable.
e.zh: 夏季的炎热让下午难以忍受。

e.en: They enjoyed the long {aestival} days by the lake.
e.zh: 他们在湖边享受漫长的夏日。

e.en: Some snails {aestivate} during the hottest months.
e.zh: 有些蜗牛会在最炎热的月份里夏眠。

e.en: Desert frogs {aestivate} underground to survive the heat.
e.zh: 沙漠青蛙在地下夏眠以熬过酷热。

e.en: The lungfish {aestivated} in the dried mud all summer.
e.zh: 那条肺鱼整个夏天都在干泥里夏眠。

e.en: Snails that {aestivated} emerged after the first rains.
e.zh: 夏眠过的蜗牛在初次降雨后出来活动。

e.en: The desert tortoise {aestivates} to escape the summer heat.
e.zh: 沙漠陆龟靠夏眠来躲避酷暑。

e.en: This species {aestivates} deep beneath the soil.
e.zh: 这一物种会在土壤深处夏眠。

e.en: Biologists study {aestivating} frogs buried in the mud.
e.zh: 生物学家研究埋在泥里夏眠的青蛙。

e.en: The {aestivating} animals barely move for weeks.
e.zh: 夏眠中的动物连续数周几乎不动。

e.en: Many desert species rely on {aestivation} to survive.
e.zh: 许多沙漠物种依靠夏眠来生存。

e.en: During {aestivation}, the lungfish forms a mucus cocoon.
e.zh: 夏眠期间，肺鱼会形成黏液茧。

e.en: Ancient philosophers believed the {aether} filled the heavens.
e.zh: 古代哲学家相信以太充满了天空。

e.en: The signal seemed to vanish into the {aether}.
e.zh: 信号似乎消失在了以太之中。

e.en: Her voice had an {aethereal} quality that mesmerized listeners.
e.zh: 她的嗓音有种空灵的特质，令听者着迷。

e.en: Mist gave the valley an {aethereal} appearance.
e.zh: 薄雾让山谷显得飘渺。

e.en: The painting captures the {aethereality} of dawn.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了黎明的空灵。

e.en: Critics praised the song's haunting {aethereality}.
e.zh: 评论家赞美这首歌挥之不去的空灵感。

e.en: The poet sought the {aetherealization} of everyday objects.
e.zh: 诗人追求把日常事物加以空灵化。

e.en: His art is a slow {aetherealization} of the human form.
e.zh: 他的艺术是对人体形态的逐步空灵化。

e.en: Soft lighting can {aetherealize} an ordinary scene.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光能让普通场景显得空灵。

e.en: The composer tries to {aetherealize} simple folk melodies.
e.zh: 作曲家试图让朴素的民谣旋律变得空灵。

e.en: The dancer moved {aethereally} across the moonlit stage.
e.zh: 舞者在月光下的舞台上空灵地舞动。

e.en: Her voice floated {aethereally} above the orchestra.
e.zh: 她的嗓音空灵地飘荡在乐队之上。

e.en: He described an {aetherial} realm beyond the stars.
e.zh: 他描述了星辰之外一个飘渺的领域。

e.en: The music had an {aetherial} sweetness.
e.zh: 那音乐有一种飘渺的甜美。

e.en: Early chemists experimented with the {aetherization} of alcohol.
e.zh: 早期化学家试验过酒精的乙醚化。

e.en: He wrote a paper on the {aetherization} process.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于以太化过程的论文。

e.en: Surgeons used to {aetherize} patients before operating.
e.zh: 外科医生过去会在手术前用乙醚麻醉病人。

e.en: The chemist had to {aetherize} the solution carefully.
e.zh: 化学家必须小心地用乙醚处理这种溶液。

e.en: The {aetiolation} of the seedlings showed they lacked sunlight.
e.zh: 幼苗的黄化表明它们缺乏阳光。

e.en: Researchers studied the {aetiolation} of the disease.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了这种疾病的成因。

e.en: The {aetiologist} traced the outbreak to contaminated water.
e.zh: 那位病因学家把这次疫情追溯到了受污染的水源。

e.en: As an {aetiologist}, she investigates the origins of illness.
e.zh: 作为病因学家，她研究疾病的起源。

e.en: Such tales would {afear} the bravest knight.
e.zh: 这样的故事会让最勇敢的骑士也感到惧怕。

e.en: Do not let the storm {afear} you.
e.zh: 别让这场风暴吓到你。

e.en: Be not {afeard}; the isle is full of noises.
e.zh: 不要害怕；这岛上充满了各种声响。

e.en: The child seemed {afeard} of the dark woods.
e.zh: 那孩子似乎害怕黑暗的树林。

e.en: He was sore {afeared} of the ghost.
e.zh: 他对那鬼魂深感恐惧。

e.en: The villagers were {afeared} to walk that road at night.
e.zh: 村民们害怕夜里走那条路。

e.en: The patient remained {afebrile} for three days.
e.zh: 该病人三天来一直没有发烧。

e.en: She was {afebrile} but still felt fatigued.
e.zh: 她不发烧，但仍感到疲倦。
