e.en: The study measured the {affectability} of mood by music.
e.zh: 该研究测量了情绪受音乐影响的程度。

e.en: Her unusual {affectability} made her a sensitive artist.
e.zh: 她异常的易感性使她成为一位敏感的艺术家。

e.en: The therapist assessed the patient's {affectivity}.
e.zh: 治疗师评估了病人的情感反应。

e.en: Reduced {affectivity} can be a sign of depression.
e.zh: 情感反应减弱可能是抑郁的征兆。

affenpinscher.t: 猴面犬；猩猩犬（小型犬种）

e.en: She adopted a tiny {affenpinscher} from the shelter.
e.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只小猴面犬。

e.en: The {affenpinscher} has a distinctive monkey-like face.
e.zh: 猴面犬有一张独特的猴子般的脸。

e.en: The pianist played the passage {affettuoso}.
e.zh: 钢琴家深情地演奏了这段乐章。

e.en: Mark the second movement {affettuoso}.
e.zh: 第二乐章标注为深情地演奏。

e.en: They were {affianced} by their families.
e.zh: 他们由家人安排订了婚。

e.en: He sought to {affiance} his daughter to a noble.
e.zh: 他想把女儿许配给一位贵族。

e.en: She was {affianced} to a young officer.
e.zh: 她已与一位年轻军官订婚。

e.en: The {affianced} couple announced their plans.
e.zh: 这对订了婚的情侣公布了他们的计划。

e.en: The {affiancer} signed the formal contract.
e.zh: 许婚人签署了正式婚约。

e.en: Each {affiancer} pledged their faith before witnesses.
e.zh: 双方订婚人在见证人面前立下誓言。

affiances.t: 订婚（动词第三人称单数）

e.en: He {affiances} his son to the heiress.
e.zh: 他把儿子许配给那位女继承人。

e.en: The novel ends as the king {affiances} his daughter.
e.zh: 小说以国王为女儿订下婚约结束。

e.en: They were {affiancing} their children at a young age.
e.zh: 他们在孩子年幼时就为他们订下婚约。

e.en: The custom of {affiancing} infants has long disappeared.
e.zh: 为婴儿订婚的习俗早已消失。

e.en: The {affiant} swore the statement was true.
e.zh: 宣誓人发誓声明属实。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the {affiant} in court.
e.zh: 律师在庭上询问了宣誓人。

e.en: A colorful {affiche} announced the new exhibition.
e.zh: 一张色彩鲜艳的海报宣告了新展览。

e.en: The vintage {affiche} sold for thousands at auction.
e.zh: 那张古董海报在拍卖会上卖了数千元。

e.en: He is a real wine {afficionado}.
e.zh: 他是一位真正的葡萄酒爱好者。

e.en: Jazz {afficionados} flock to the festival each year.
e.zh: 爵士乐迷每年都涌向这个音乐节。

e.en: Opera {afficionados} debated the soprano's performance.
e.zh: 歌剧爱好者们讨论着女高音的演出。

e.en: Cigar {afficionados} gathered in the lounge.
e.zh: 雪茄爱好者们聚集在休息室里。

e.en: Researchers tested the {affinability} of the two compounds.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了两种化合物的亲和性。

e.en: The metal's {affinability} with oxygen is high.
e.zh: 该金属与氧的亲和性很高。

e.en: Sugar {affination} removes the molasses coating.
e.zh: 洗糖工序去除了糖蜜外层。

e.en: The factory uses centrifuges for {affination}.
e.zh: 工厂使用离心机进行洗糖处理。

e.en: The two species share {affinitive} traits.
e.zh: 这两个物种有亲缘性的特征。

e.en: He felt an {affinitive} bond with her family.
e.zh: 他对她的家人感到一种亲近的纽带。

e.en: The hypothesis is not yet {affirmable}.
e.zh: 该假设目前尚不可肯定。

e.en: Only {affirmable} claims will be included in the report.
e.zh: 只有可断言的论断才会写入报告。

e.en: The result can {affirmably} be reproduced.
e.zh: 该结果可以确切地重现。

e.en: She spoke {affirmably} about the new policy.
e.zh: 她对新政策给出了肯定的回应。

e.en: The court issued an {affirmance} of the lower ruling.
e.zh: 法院维持了下级法院的判决。

e.en: His silence was taken as {affirmance}.
e.zh: 他的沉默被视为默认。

affirmant.t: 声明者；以非宣誓方式作证者

e.en: The {affirmant} signed the legal declaration.
e.zh: 声明人在法律声明上签了字。

e.en: As a Quaker, he served as an {affirmant} rather than swearing.
e.zh: 作为贵格会成员，他以郑重声明代替宣誓。

affirmative-action.t: 平权行动；扶持少数群体的政策

e.en: The university implemented {affirmative-action} in admissions.
e.zh: 该大学在招生中实施了平权行动。

e.en: Critics debated the merits of {affirmative-action}.
e.zh: 批评者争论平权行动的利弊。

e.en: He gave an {affirmatory} nod.
e.zh: 他点头表示肯定。

e.en: The letter was {affirmatory} of her appointment.
e.zh: 信件确认了她的任命。

e.en: The label is easily {affixable} to the box.
e.zh: 该标签很容易贴在盒子上。

e.en: They sell {affixable} stamps for the envelopes.
e.zh: 他们出售可贴在信封上的邮票。

e.en: English forms many words by {affixation}.
e.zh: 英语通过词缀法构成许多单词。

e.en: The {affixation} of the seal made it official.
e.zh: 加盖印章使其成为正式文件。

e.en: The book discusses {affixial} morphology.
e.zh: 该书讨论词缀形态学。

e.en: She studied {affixial} patterns in Turkish.
e.zh: 她研究土耳其语的词缀规律。

e.en: The {affixion} of the seal was witnessed.
e.zh: 印章的加盖有人见证。

e.en: He noted the {affixion} of new labels.
e.zh: 他注意到新标签的粘贴。

e.en: The {affixment} of the bracket required two screws.
e.zh: 安装这个支架需要两颗螺丝。

e.en: They inspected the {affixment} of the warning labels.
e.zh: 他们检查了警告标签的粘贴情况。

e.en: The handle was a later {affixture} to the chest.
e.zh: 那个把手是后来加到箱子上的。

e.en: He inspected each {affixture} to the machine.
e.zh: 他检查了机器上的每一个附加部件。

e.en: The poet wrote in a sudden {afflatus}.
e.zh: 诗人在灵感乍现中写下了诗篇。

e.en: She waited for the divine {afflatus} to strike.
e.zh: 她等待着神圣灵感的降临。

e.en: No life is entirely {afflictionless}.
e.zh: 没有人的一生是完全没有苦难的。

e.en: He longed for an {afflictionless} old age.
e.zh: 他渴望一个没有病痛的晚年。

e.en: He suffered an {afflictive} illness.
e.zh: 他患了一种折磨人的疾病。

e.en: The news was deeply {afflictive} to the family.
e.zh: 这消息让家人极为痛苦。

e.en: The wound throbbed {afflictively} all night.
e.zh: 伤口整夜痛苦地抽痛着。

e.en: She spoke {afflictively} of her loss.
e.zh: 她痛苦地谈起自己的丧亲之痛。

e.en: The town's {affluency} attracted new residents.
e.zh: 该镇的富裕吸引了新居民。

e.en: He grew up in considerable {affluency}.
e.zh: 他在相当富裕的环境中长大。

e.en: The book examines {affluenza} among the wealthy young.
e.zh: 该书研究富家青年中的富裕病现象。

e.en: Critics blamed his behavior on {affluenza}.
e.zh: 批评者把他的行为归咎于富裕病。

e.en: There was a sudden {afflux} of tourists to the island.
e.zh: 游客突然大量涌入该岛。

e.en: The dam caused an {afflux} of water upstream.
e.zh: 大坝导致上游水量上涨。

e.en: Doctors observed an {affluxion} of blood to the wound.
e.zh: 医生观察到血液涌向伤口。

e.en: The {affluxion} of refugees overwhelmed the camp.
e.zh: 难民的涌入使难民营不堪重负。

e.en: The medicine had an unpleasant {after-effect}.
e.zh: 这种药有令人不适的副作用。

e.en: Drowsiness is a common {after-effect} of the surgery.
e.zh: 嗜睡是手术后常见的后遗症。

e.en: He still suffers the {after-effects} of the accident.
e.zh: 他至今仍受那场事故后遗症的折磨。

e.en: The {after-effects} of the storm lasted for weeks.
e.zh: 风暴的后续影响持续了数周。

after-five.t: 下班后的；适合晚间穿着的

e.en: She bought an elegant {after-five} dress.
e.zh: 她买了一件优雅的晚间礼服。

e.en: The bar caters to an {after-five} crowd.
e.zh: 这家酒吧主要服务下班后的人群。

after-hours.t: 营业时间之后的；下班后的

e.en: They met at an {after-hours} club downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心一家深夜营业的俱乐部见面。

e.en: She often answers emails {after-hours}.
e.zh: 她经常在下班后回复邮件。

e.en: Staring at the light left a bright {after-image}.
e.zh: 盯着灯光看后留下了一个明亮的残像。

e.en: The {after-image} faded slowly when she closed her eyes.
e.zh: 她闭上眼睛后，那个残像慢慢消退。

e.en: Many religions teach about an {after-life}.
e.zh: 许多宗教都讲述来世的存在。

e.en: He wondered what the {after-life} might be like.
e.zh: 他想知道来世会是什么样子。

e.en: The party went on until well {after-midnight}.
e.zh: 派对一直持续到午夜过后。

e.en: She rarely stays up {after-midnight}.
e.zh: 她很少熬到后半夜。

e.en: We will meet this {after-noon} at three.
e.zh: 我们今天下午三点见面。

e.en: The {after-noon} sun was warm and bright.
e.zh: 下午的阳光温暖明亮。

e.en: The company offers excellent {after-sales} service.
e.zh: 该公司提供出色的售后服务。

e.en: Good {after-sales} support builds customer loyalty.
e.zh: 良好的售后支持能培养客户忠诚度。

e.en: She joined an {after-school} art club.
e.zh: 她参加了一个课后美术俱乐部。

e.en: The kids attend an {after-school} program.
e.zh: 孩子们参加了一个课后辅导项目。

e.en: He splashed some {after-shave} on his cheeks.
e.zh: 他往脸颊上拍了点须后水。

e.en: The {after-shave} had a fresh citrus scent.
e.zh: 那款须后水有清新的柑橘香气。

e.en: Her {after-tax} income rose this year.
e.zh: 她今年的税后收入有所增加。

e.en: They calculated the {after-tax} profit carefully.
e.zh: 他们仔细计算了税后利润。

e.en: His apology felt like an {after-the-fact} excuse.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来像是事后的借口。

e.en: The justification was made {after-the-fact}.
e.zh: 这个解释是事后才编出来的。

after-thought.t: 事后的想法；附加的考虑

e.en: The garden seemed like an {after-thought}.
e.zh: 那个花园看起来像是事后才加上去的。

e.en: She added the joke as an {after-thought}.
e.zh: 她事后才想起补上那个笑话。

e.en: The engine uses exhaust {after-treatment} systems.
e.zh: 这台发动机使用尾气后处理系统。

e.en: Patients require careful {after-treatment} for recovery.
e.zh: 患者需要细致的后续治疗以恢复健康。

e.en: We had dinner and went home {after-ward}.
e.zh: 我们吃了晚饭，之后就回家了。

e.en: She felt much better {after-ward}.
e.zh: 她之后感觉好多了。

e.en: They went for coffee {after-wards}.
e.zh: 他们之后去喝了咖啡。

e.en: Shortly {after-wards}, the rain began.
e.zh: 不久之后，雨就开始下了。

e.en: High-intensity workouts produce a strong {afterburn} effect.
e.zh: 高强度训练会产生显著的运动后燃脂效应。

e.en: The {afterburn} from the rocket lit up the sky.
e.zh: 火箭的余焰照亮了天空。

e.en: The jet engine uses {afterburning} for extra thrust.
e.zh: 喷气发动机利用加力燃烧获得额外推力。

e.en: {Afterburning} dramatically increases fuel consumption.
e.zh: 加力燃烧会显著增加燃油消耗。

e.en: The turbocharger feeds air through an {aftercooler}.
e.zh: 涡轮增压器把空气送入后冷却器。

e.en: An efficient {aftercooler} improves engine performance.
e.zh: 高效的中冷器能提升发动机性能。

e.en: {Aftercooling} reduces the temperature of compressed air.
e.zh: 后冷却能降低压缩空气的温度。

e.en: The system relies on {aftercooling} for efficiency.
e.zh: 该系统依靠后冷却来提高效率。

afterdamp.t: 煤矿爆炸后的窒息气体

e.en: Miners feared the deadly {afterdamp} following an explosion.
e.zh: 矿工们害怕爆炸后产生的致命窒息气体。

e.en: {Afterdamp} can suffocate survivors in a mine.
e.zh: 煤矿爆炸后的窒息气体可能会使幸存者窒息而死。

e.en: The crew gathered on the {afterdeck} at sunset.
e.zh: 船员们在日落时聚集在后甲板上。

e.en: Cargo was secured on the ship's {afterdeck}.
e.zh: 货物被固定在船的后甲板上。

e.en: The meadow's {aftergrowth} provided fresh grazing.
e.zh: 草地上再生的草木提供了新鲜的牧草。

e.en: Farmers harvested the {aftergrowth} in autumn.
e.zh: 农民在秋天收割再生的草木。

e.en: Reactor {afterheat} must be removed even after shutdown.
e.zh: 即使反应堆停堆后，余热仍必须导出。

e.en: Cooling systems handle the {afterheat} safely.
e.zh: 冷却系统能安全地处理这些余热。

e.en: The {afterlight} on the hills was breathtaking.
e.zh: 山丘上的余晖令人惊叹。

e.en: In the {afterlight} of the scandal, his motives seemed clearer.
e.zh: 丑闻过后回看，他的动机显得更清晰了。

e.en: Many religions describe different {afterlives}.
e.zh: 许多宗教描述了不同的来世。

e.en: These ideas had surprising {afterlives} in modern art.
e.zh: 这些观念在现代艺术中有出人意料的延续影响。

aftermentioned.t: 下文提及的；后文所述的

e.en: Please refer to the {aftermentioned} clauses.
e.zh: 请参阅下文所述的条款。

e.en: The {aftermentioned} parties signed the agreement.
e.zh: 下文提及的各方签署了协议。

e.en: He climbed to the {aftermost} deck of the ship.
e.zh: 他爬到了船最靠尾的甲板上。

e.en: The {aftermost} cabin was reserved for the captain.
e.zh: 最靠船尾的舱房留给船长使用。

e.en: She suffered mild {afterpains} for several days.
e.zh: 她产后宫缩痛持续了好几天。

e.en: Nursing can intensify {afterpains} in new mothers.
e.zh: 哺乳会加剧新妈妈的产后宫缩痛。

e.en: Water had collected in the {afterpeak}.
e.zh: 船尾尖舱里积了水。

e.en: The crew inspected the {afterpeak} for leaks.
e.zh: 船员检查船尾尖舱是否漏水。

e.en: A comic {afterpiece} followed the tragedy.
e.zh: 悲剧之后加演了一出喜剧短剧。

e.en: The theatre often staged a light {afterpiece}.
e.zh: 剧院常会加演一出轻松的短剧。

afterpulse.t: 后脉冲（光电探测器中的）

e.en: The detector showed an {afterpulse} a microsecond later.
e.zh: 探测器在一微秒后出现了后脉冲。

e.en: Engineers worked to suppress the {afterpulse} noise.
e.zh: 工程师设法抑制后脉冲噪声。

afterripening.t: 后熟（种子收获后的成熟过程）

e.en: Some seeds require {afterripening} before they will germinate.
e.zh: 有些种子需要后熟才能发芽。

e.en: Cold storage promotes {afterripening} in apple seeds.
e.zh: 低温储存可促进苹果种子的后熟。

e.en: Their {aftersales} support is excellent.
e.zh: 他们的售后支持非常出色。

e.en: She works in the {aftersales} department.
e.zh: 她在售后服务部门工作。

e.en: He joined an {afterschool} chess club.
e.zh: 他参加了一个课后象棋俱乐部。

e.en: The school offers many {afterschool} programs.
e.zh: 学校开设了许多课后活动项目。

e.en: A faint {aftersensation} of warmth lingered on her skin.
e.zh: 皮肤上残留着一丝温热的余感。

e.en: Psychologists studied the visual {aftersensation} carefully.
e.zh: 心理学家仔细研究了这种视觉后感觉。

aftershaft.t: 副羽（鸟类羽毛根部的小羽）

e.en: The bird's feather had a soft {aftershaft}.
e.zh: 这只鸟的羽毛带有一根柔软的副羽。

e.en: Ornithologists examined the {aftershaft} under a microscope.
e.zh: 鸟类学家在显微镜下观察这根副羽。

e.en: The bell's {aftersound} hung in the still air.
e.zh: 钟声的余音久久回荡在静止的空气中。

e.en: He listened for the {aftersound} of the explosion.
e.zh: 他细听爆炸后的余响。

e.en: His {aftertax} income barely covered rent.
e.zh: 他税后的收入几乎付不起房租。

e.en: They calculated the {aftertax} return on the investment.
e.zh: 他们计算了这项投资的税后回报。

e.en: His deeds were remembered in {aftertime}.
e.zh: 他的事迹在后世被人铭记。

e.en: Such mistakes can haunt one in {aftertime}.
e.zh: 这样的错误日后可能仍会困扰自己。

e.en: The diesel engine uses an exhaust {aftertreatment} system.
e.zh: 这台柴油发动机使用尾气后处理系统。

e.en: Effective {aftertreatment} reduces harmful emissions.
e.zh: 有效的后处理可减少有害排放。

e.en: His clever reply was mere {afterwit}.
e.zh: 他那句机智的回答不过是马后炮。

e.en: {Afterwit} is of little use in a real argument.
e.zh: 事后聪明在真正的争论中没什么用。

e.en: In {afteryears} she often recalled that summer.
e.zh: 在日后的岁月里她常回忆起那个夏天。

e.en: The decision shaped his {afteryears} profoundly.
e.zh: 这个决定深刻影响了他后来的岁月。

e.en: They stowed the gear in the {aftmost} compartment.
e.zh: 他们把装备放在最靠船尾的舱里。

e.en: The {aftmost} mast had snapped in the storm.
e.zh: 最靠船尾的桅杆在暴风中折断了。

e.en: It was an {against-the-odds} victory for the team.
e.zh: 这是球队一场逆境中的胜利。

e.en: She told an {against-the-odds} story of survival.
e.zh: 她讲述了一段不被看好的求生故事。

e.en: The mare suffered from {agalaxy} after foaling.
e.zh: 这匹母马产驹后患上了无乳症。

e.en: Veterinarians treated the ewe's {agalaxy} promptly.
e.zh: 兽医及时治疗了母羊的无乳症。

e.en: The chest was carved from fragrant {agalloch}.
e.zh: 这个箱子是用芬芳的沉香木雕成的。

e.en: Burning {agalloch} filled the temple with rich scent.
e.zh: 焚烧的沉香木让寺庙弥漫着浓郁的香气。

e.en: The figurine was carved from soft {agalmatolite}.
e.zh: 这尊小像是用质地柔软的寿山石雕成的。

e.en: Chinese artisans prized {agalmatolite} for delicate work.
e.zh: 中国工匠喜爱用寿山石做精细雕刻。

e.en: A bright orange {agama} basked on the rock.
e.zh: 一只橘红色的鬣蜥在岩石上晒太阳。

e.en: The {agama} darted away when we approached.
e.zh: 我们一靠近，那只鬣蜥就窜走了。

e.en: Several {agamas} sunned themselves on the wall.
e.zh: 几只鬣蜥在墙上晒太阳。

e.en: African {agamas} display vivid breeding colors.
e.zh: 非洲鬣蜥在繁殖期会展现鲜艳的体色。

agamete.t: 无配子（不经融合的繁殖细胞）

e.en: The organism reproduces by forming an {agamete}.
e.zh: 这种生物通过形成无配子来繁殖。

e.en: An {agamete} develops without fusing with another cell.
e.zh: 无配子无需与其他细胞融合即可发育。

e.en: An {agami} called loudly from the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 一只叫鹤在雨林树冠上高声鸣叫。

e.en: The {agami} heron has stunning iridescent plumage.
e.zh: 叫鹤鹭有着光彩夺目的虹彩羽毛。

e.en: Aphids often reproduce by {agamic} means.
e.zh: 蚜虫常以无性方式繁殖。

e.en: The plant spreads through {agamic} reproduction.
e.zh: 这种植物通过无性繁殖扩散。

e.en: The fungus spreads {agamically} through spores.
e.zh: 这种真菌通过孢子以无性方式扩散。

e.en: Many plants can reproduce {agamically} from cuttings.
e.zh: 许多植物可通过插条以无性方式繁殖。

e.en: The pet shop sold several {agamid} lizards.
e.zh: 那家宠物店出售好几种鬣蜥科蜥蜴。

e.en: This {agamid} species is native to Australia.
e.zh: 这种鬣蜥科物种原产于澳大利亚。

e.en: Several {agamis} foraged along the river bank.
e.zh: 几只叫鹤沿着河岸觅食。

e.en: The {agamis} vanished into the dense forest.
e.zh: 那几只叫鹤消失在茂密的森林中。

e.en: The {aeronaut} steered the balloon over the mountains.
e.zh: 飞艇驾驶员驾驶气球飞越群山。

e.en: Early {aeronauts} risked their lives in fragile airships.
e.zh: 早期的航空员驾驶脆弱的飞艇冒着生命危险。

aeronaval.t: 空军与海军联合的；空海军的

e.en: The country expanded its {aeronaval} forces during the war.
e.zh: 战时该国扩充了空海军部队。

e.en: Joint {aeronaval} exercises were held in the Pacific.
e.zh: 太平洋上举行了空海军联合演习。

aeroneurosis.t: 飞行员神经症；航空神经官能症

e.en: Long missions caused some pilots to develop {aeroneurosis}.
e.zh: 长时间任务令一些飞行员患上航空神经官能症。

e.en: Doctors treated his {aeroneurosis} with rest and counseling.
e.zh: 医生用休息和心理咨询治疗他的飞行员神经症。

aeronomic.t: 高层大气学的；超高层大气的

e.en: Scientists conducted {aeronomic} research using rockets.
e.zh: 科学家用火箭进行超高层大气学研究。

e.en: The satellite carried {aeronomic} instruments into orbit.
e.zh: 这颗卫星把高层大气学仪器送入轨道。

aeronomy.t: 高层大气物理学；超高层大气学

e.en: She studies {aeronomy} at the research institute.
e.zh: 她在研究所研究超高层大气学。

e.en: {Aeronomy} explores the ionosphere and beyond.
e.zh: 高层大气物理学探索电离层及其以外区域。

e.en: Climbers high in the Andes can suffer from {aeropathy}.
e.zh: 在安第斯山高处的登山者可能患上高空病。

e.en: {Aeropathy} affects pilots who fly at extreme altitudes.
e.zh: 气压性疾病影响在极高海拔飞行的飞行员。

aeropause.t: 大气层与外太空交界区

e.en: Aircraft cannot fly above the {aeropause}.
e.zh: 飞机无法在大气与外太空交界区之上飞行。

e.en: The {aeropause} marks the limit of conventional flight.
e.zh: 大气边界区标志着常规飞行的极限。

aeroperitoneum.t: 腹腔积气；气腹；腹膜腔气肿

e.en: The X-ray revealed {aeroperitoneum} after the injury.
e.zh: X光片显示伤后出现腹腔积气。

e.en: {Aeroperitoneum} can indicate a perforated bowel.
e.zh: 气腹可能提示肠穿孔。

e.en: Babies sometimes develop {aerophagia} during feeding.
e.zh: 婴儿哺乳时有时会出现吞气症。

e.en: Anxiety can trigger {aerophagia} and bloating.
e.zh: 焦虑可能引发过度吞咽空气和腹胀。

aerophagy.t: 吞气症；吞咽空气的习惯

e.en: Chronic {aerophagy} caused his constant burping.
e.zh: 慢性吞气症使他不停打嗝。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her discomfort as {aerophagy}.
e.zh: 医生将她的不适诊断为吞气症。

e.en: The bacteria classified as {aerophil} need oxygen to grow.
e.zh: 归类为好氧的细菌需要氧气才能生长。

e.en: Most {aerophil} species die without air contact.
e.zh: 多数好氧物种在缺乏空气接触时会死亡。

aerophilately.t: 航空邮票集邮；空邮邮品收集

e.en: He took up {aerophilately} after retiring from flying.
e.zh: 他退役后开始收藏航空邮票。

e.en: {Aerophilately} focuses on stamps from airmail flights.
e.zh: 航空集邮专注于航空邮政飞行的邮票。

aerophile.t: 航空爱好者；喜爱空气者

e.en: As an {aerophile}, he visited every air show in Europe.
e.zh: 作为航空爱好者，他参观了欧洲的每个航展。

e.en: True {aerophiles} read aviation magazines daily.
e.zh: 真正的航空迷每天阅读航空杂志。

aerophobe.t: 恐空气者；恐飞者；惧空患者

e.en: As an {aerophobe}, he refused to board the plane.
e.zh: 作为恐飞者，他拒绝登机。

e.en: Therapy helped the {aerophobe} overcome her fear.
e.zh: 治疗帮助这位惧空患者克服了恐惧。

aerophobia.t: 恐飞症；恐空气症；空气恐惧症

e.en: Her {aerophobia} prevented international travel.
e.zh: 她的恐飞症使她无法出国旅行。

e.en: Some animals show signs of {aerophobia} during storms.
e.zh: 一些动物在暴风雨期间表现出空气恐惧症的迹象。

e.en: Her {aerophobic} reactions made flying impossible.
e.zh: 她恐飞的反应使坐飞机成为不可能。

e.en: The dog seemed {aerophobic} during the windstorm.
e.zh: 暴风期间这只狗显得惧怕空气。

e.en: The flute is a classic {aerophone}.
e.zh: 长笛是典型的气鸣乐器。

e.en: Many {aerophones} are made of wood or metal.
e.zh: 许多管乐器由木头或金属制成。

aerophore.t: 呼吸器；供气装置；空气贮气筒

e.en: Firefighters used an {aerophore} to enter the smoke.
e.zh: 消防员用呼吸器进入烟雾中。

e.en: The diver checked his {aerophore} before descending.
e.zh: 潜水员下潜前检查了他的供气装置。

e.en: The {aerophoto} clearly showed the field boundaries.
e.zh: 航空照片清楚显示了田地的边界。

e.en: Surveyors compared old {aerophotos} of the area.
e.zh: 测量员对比了该地区的旧航摄相片。

e.en: Modern mapping relies heavily on {aerophotogeodesy}.
e.zh: 现代测绘高度依赖航空摄影大地测量学。

e.en: She specializes in {aerophotogeodesy} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学专攻航空摄影大地测量学。

aerophotogrammetry.t: 航空摄影测量学；航摄测量

e.en: Engineers used {aerophotogrammetry} to map the terrain.
e.zh: 工程师使用航空摄影测量学绘制地形图。

e.en: {Aerophotogrammetry} produces highly accurate maps.
e.zh: 航摄测量能制作高精度地图。

e.en: {Aerophotography} revolutionized military reconnaissance.
e.zh: 航空摄影革新了军事侦察。

e.en: He works in commercial {aerophotography}.
e.zh: 他从事商业空中摄影工作。

e.en: {Aerophototopography} is used for detailed terrain maps.
e.zh: 航空摄影地形测量用于绘制详细地形图。

e.en: The agency relies on {aerophototopography} for surveying.
e.zh: 该机构依靠航空摄影地形测量进行勘测。

aerophysics.t: 大气物理学；空气物理学

e.en: He researches {aerophysics} at the space institute.
e.zh: 他在航天研究所研究大气物理学。

e.en: {Aerophysics} examines how air behaves at high speeds.
e.zh: 空气物理学研究空气在高速下的行为。

e.en: Orchids are often classified as an {aerophyte}.
e.zh: 兰花常被归类为气生植物。

e.en: Many {aerophytes} grow on tree branches.
e.zh: 许多附生植物生长在树枝上。

aerophytobiont.t: 空中浮游生物；气生微生物

e.en: Researchers cataloged each {aerophytobiont} they collected.
e.zh: 研究者对采集到的每种气生微生物进行编目。

e.en: An {aerophytobiont} can survive on airborne nutrients.
e.zh: 一种空中浮游生物可依靠空气中的养分存活。

e.en: The young {aeroplanist} earned his license last year.
e.zh: 这位年轻的飞行员去年取得驾照。

e.en: Famous {aeroplanists} gathered for the centenary celebration.
e.zh: 著名飞行员齐聚百年纪念活动。

aeroplankton.t: 大气浮游生物；空气浮游体

e.en: Microscopes revealed the {aeroplankton} in the sample.
e.zh: 显微镜显示样本中的大气浮游生物。

e.en: Wind carries {aeroplankton} across continents.
e.zh: 风把空气浮游体带到各大陆。

aeroplethysmography.t: 气体体积描记法；空气流量描记

e.en: Doctors used {aeroplethysmography} to measure lung capacity.
e.zh: 医生用气体体积描记法测量肺活量。

e.en: The clinic offered {aeroplethysmography} for asthma patients.
e.zh: 诊所为哮喘患者提供空气流量描记检查。

e.en: {Aeropolitics} shapes international flight agreements.
e.zh: 航空政治学影响国际航班协议。

e.en: Experts in {aeropolitics} debated the new treaty.
e.zh: 空域政治专家就新条约展开辩论。

e.en: The farm uses {aeroponic} systems to grow lettuce.
e.zh: 这家农场使用气培系统种植生菜。

e.en: {Aeroponic} methods save water compared to soil farming.
e.zh: 与土壤种植相比，气雾栽培法节水。

aeroprojector.t: 空中投影仪；航空投影器

e.en: Engineers tested the {aeroprojector} for advertising flights.
e.zh: 工程师测试了用于广告飞行的空中投影仪。

e.en: The {aeroprojector} displayed images on the clouds.
e.zh: 航空投影器在云层上显示图像。

aeropropeller.t: 航空螺旋桨；飞机螺旋桨

e.en: The mechanic balanced the {aeropropeller} carefully.
e.zh: 机械师仔细给航空螺旋桨做平衡。

e.en: Wooden {aeropropellers} were common in early aviation.
e.zh: 木制飞机螺旋桨在早期航空业很常见。

e.en: The {aeropulse} engine produced a distinctive rattle.
e.zh: 脉冲式喷气发动机发出独特的颤动声。

e.en: Early drones often used an {aeropulse} for propulsion.
e.zh: 早期无人机常用脉冲式喷气发动机推进。

aeropulverizer.t: 气流粉碎机；空气粉碎装置

e.en: The factory installed an {aeropulverizer} for fine grinding.
e.zh: 工厂安装了气流粉碎机用于细磨。

e.en: Pharmaceutical plants use {aeropulverizers} for fine powders.
e.zh: 制药厂使用空气粉碎装置加工细粉。

aeropyle.t: 卵壳气孔；昆虫卵的呼吸孔

e.en: The {aeropyle} allows the embryo to breathe inside the egg.
e.zh: 卵壳气孔让胚胎在卵内呼吸。

e.en: Researchers counted each {aeropyle} on the insect egg.
e.zh: 研究人员数了昆虫卵上的每一个气孔。

aeroquay.t: 候机楼码头；机场登机栈桥

e.en: Passengers walked along the {aeroquay} to board the plane.
e.zh: 乘客沿登机栈桥走去登机。

e.en: The new airport features a covered {aeroquay}.
e.zh: 新机场设有带顶的候机栈桥。

aeroradio.t: 航空无线电；机载无线电

e.en: The pilot tuned the {aeroradio} to ground control.
e.zh: 飞行员把机载无线电调到地面控制频率。

e.en: Early {aeroradio} sets were heavy and unreliable.
e.zh: 早期航空无线电设备笨重且不稳定。

aeroradioactivity.t: 大气放射性；空气中的放射性

e.en: Scientists monitored {aeroradioactivity} after the test.
e.zh: 测试后科学家监测大气放射性。

e.en: Increased {aeroradioactivity} alarmed nearby residents.
e.zh: 空气中的放射性升高令附近居民担忧。

aeroscepsis.t: 空气感觉；触角空气感知

e.en: Insect antennae perform a function called {aeroscepsis}.
e.zh: 昆虫触角执行一种称为空气感知的功能。

e.en: Studies of {aeroscepsis} reveal how moths find mates.
e.zh: 对触角空气感知的研究揭示飞蛾如何寻偶。

e.en: Many insects depend on {aeroscepsy} to navigate.
e.zh: 许多昆虫依靠空气感知来导航。

e.en: {Aeroscepsy} helps bees track floral scents.
e.zh: 触角感觉帮助蜜蜂追踪花香。

aeroscope.t: 空气采样器；空气测试器

e.en: Technicians used an {aeroscope} to sample pollutants.
e.zh: 技术员用空气采样器采集污染物。

e.en: The {aeroscope} collected pollen from the air.
e.zh: 空气测试器从空气中收集花粉。

e.en: The vintage biplane was kept in the {aeroshed}.
e.zh: 这架老式双翼机被存放在飞机棚里。

e.en: Workers cleaned the {aeroshed} every Friday.
e.zh: 工人每周五打扫机库。

aeroshell.t: 再入大气层防热罩；防热外壳

e.en: The probe's {aeroshell} protected it during atmospheric entry.
e.zh: 探测器的防热罩在再入大气层时起保护作用。

e.en: Engineers tested the {aeroshell} in a hypersonic wind tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师在高超声速风洞中测试防热外壳。

aeroshells.t: 再入大气层防热罩；多个防热外壳

e.en: The factory builds {aeroshells} for Mars missions.
e.zh: 这家工厂为火星任务制造防热罩。

e.en: Multiple {aeroshells} were tested before final selection.
e.zh: 在最终选定之前测试了多个防热外壳。

e.en: Some lower organisms reproduce by {agamogenesis}.
e.zh: 一些低等生物通过无性生殖繁衍。

e.en: The textbook described {agamogenesis} in detail.
e.zh: 教科书详细描述了无配子生殖。

agamogenetic.t: 无性生殖的；无配子生殖的

e.en: Many fungi have an {agamogenetic} life cycle.
e.zh: 许多真菌具有无性生殖的生命周期。

e.en: She studied {agamogenetic} reproduction in plants.
e.zh: 她研究植物的无性生殖。

agamospecies.t: 无融合生殖种；无性繁殖种

e.en: Dandelions are often classified as {agamospecies}.
e.zh: 蒲公英常被归类为无融合生殖种。

e.en: Botanists debate the validity of {agamospecies}.
e.zh: 植物学家就无性繁殖种的有效性争论不休。

e.en: {Agamospermy} produces seeds without fertilization.
e.zh: 无融合生殖在没有受精的情况下产生种子。

e.en: The species reproduces through {agamospermy}.
e.zh: 该物种通过无配生殖繁衍。

e.en: The plant has {agamous} flowers.
e.zh: 这种植物开无性花。

e.en: Biologists distinguish {agamous} from sexual forms.
e.zh: 生物学家区分无性形态和有性形态。

e.en: Anthropologists studied {agamy} in remote tribes.
e.zh: 人类学家研究偏远部落的无婚制现象。

e.en: The term {agamy} refers to absence of marriage.
e.zh: 无婚制一词指没有婚姻关系。

e.en: The {aganglionic} segment caused severe constipation.
e.zh: 无神经节肠段导致严重便秘。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {aganglionic} bowel.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了无神经节的肠段。

agapae.t: 爱筵；早期基督徒的爱宴

e.en: Early Christians held {agapae} after worship.
e.zh: 早期基督徒在礼拜后举行爱筵。

e.en: Historians described the {agapae} in detail.
e.zh: 史学家详细描述了爱筵。

e.en: The garden burst with blue {agapanthus}.
e.zh: 花园里盛开着蓝色的百子莲。

e.en: She planted {agapanthus} along the path.
e.zh: 她沿着小路种了百子莲。

e.en: Tall {agapanthuses} lined the driveway.
e.zh: 高大的百子莲沿车道排列。

e.en: The {agapanthuses} bloomed all summer.
e.zh: 百子莲开了一整个夏天。

e.en: She used {agar-agar} to set the dessert.
e.zh: 她用琼脂来凝固甜点。

e.en: Microbiologists grow cultures on {agar-agar}.
e.zh: 微生物学家在琼脂上培养菌种。

e.en: The recipe calls for {agaragar} powder.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要琼脂粉。

e.en: {Agaragar} is a vegetarian gelatin substitute.
e.zh: 琼脂是素食者使用的明胶替代品。

e.en: The forest floor was dotted with {agaric}.
e.zh: 林地上点缀着伞菌。

e.en: He identified the {agaric} as edible.
e.zh: 他鉴定这种伞菌可以食用。

e.en: The book covers {agaricaceous} fungi.
e.zh: 这本书介绍了伞菌科真菌。

e.en: Most {agaricaceous} mushrooms have gills.
e.zh: 大多数伞菌科蘑菇都有菌褶。

agateware.t: 玛瑙陶器；纹理仿玛瑙的陶瓷

e.en: The museum displayed Victorian {agateware}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了维多利亚时代的玛瑙陶器。

e.en: She collects antique {agateware} bowls.
e.zh: 她收藏古董玛瑙陶碗。

e.en: They surveyed the {agatiferous} rock formations.
e.zh: 他们勘察了含玛瑙的岩层。

e.en: The region is famously {agatiferous}.
e.zh: 该地区以盛产玛瑙闻名。

e.en: Minerals slowly {agatize} over millennia.
e.zh: 矿物经过千年慢慢玛瑙化。

e.en: The wood began to {agatize} underground.
e.zh: 那块木头在地下开始玛瑙化。

e.en: The crowd stood {agaze} at the spectacle.
e.zh: 人群目不转睛地凝视着这场奇观。

e.en: Children sat {agaze} during the magic show.
e.zh: 孩子们在魔术表演时坐着出神地看。

e.en: He stood {agazed} at the apparition.
e.zh: 他惊呆地凝视着那幻影。

e.en: The villagers were {agazed} by the sight.
e.zh: 村民们被那景象惊得目瞪口呆。

e.en: The furniture is made of {agba} wood.
e.zh: 这家具是用阿格巴木做的。

e.en: Loggers harvested {agba} from the rainforest.
e.zh: 伐木工人从雨林中采伐阿格巴木。

agbada.t: 阿格巴达；西非男性长袍

e.en: He wore an embroidered {agbada} to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着绣花的阿格巴达去参加婚礼。

e.en: The chief's {agbada} was richly decorated.
e.zh: 酋长的阿格巴达装饰华丽。

age-adjusted.t: 年龄调整后的；按年龄校正的

e.en: The study reported {age-adjusted} mortality rates.
e.zh: 该研究报告了年龄调整后的死亡率。

e.en: They compared {age-adjusted} incidence across regions.
e.zh: 他们比较了各地区年龄校正后的发病率。

e.en: The survey targeted a specific {age-bracket}.
e.zh: 这项调查针对特定的年龄段。

e.en: Insurance premiums vary by {age-bracket}.
e.zh: 保险费根据年龄段而异。

e.en: Each {age-grade} had its own duties.
e.zh: 每个年龄等级都有自己的职责。

e.en: Anthropologists study tribal {age-grade} systems.
e.zh: 人类学家研究部落的年龄等级制度。

e.en: The society is organized into {age-grades}.
e.zh: 该社会按年龄等级组织。

e.en: Different {age-grades} performed distinct rituals.
e.zh: 不同的年龄等级举行不同的仪式。

e.en: The film appeals to a younger {age-group}.
e.zh: 这部电影吸引较年轻的年龄段观众。

e.en: Results were broken down by {age-group}.
e.zh: 结果按年龄组分类列出。

e.en: The two families had an {age-long} feud.
e.zh: 两家有长年累月的世仇。

e.en: He carried an {age-long} sense of duty.
e.zh: 他怀着一种古老而持久的责任感。

e.en: They debated the {age-old} question of free will.
e.zh: 他们辩论着自由意志这一古老的问题。

e.en: It is an {age-old} tradition in our village.
e.zh: 这是我们村由来已久的传统。

e.en: The toy suits a wide {age-range}.
e.zh: 这款玩具适合广泛的年龄范围。

e.en: Please specify the participants' {age-range}.
e.zh: 请说明参与者的年龄范围。

e.en: Each {age-set} undergoes initiation together.
e.zh: 每个同龄群一起接受成年礼。

e.en: The Maasai organize males into {age-set} groups.
e.zh: 马赛人将男性按同龄群组织起来。

e.en: The chart shows {age-sex} distribution.
e.zh: 图表显示了年龄与性别分布。

e.en: Researchers analyzed {age-sex} structures of populations.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了人口的年龄与性别结构。

e.en: The report includes {age-specific} death rates.
e.zh: 该报告包含分年龄的死亡率。

e.en: They calculated {age-specific} fertility rates.
e.zh: 他们计算了特定年龄的生育率。

e.en: She works in the {aged-care} sector.
e.zh: 她在养老护理行业工作。

e.en: The government funds {aged-care} services.
e.zh: 政府资助养老护理服务。

e.en: I {agnize} the truth of his claim.
e.zh: 我承认他主张属实。

e.en: She {agnized} her own faults at last.
e.zh: 她终于认清了自己的过失。

e.en: Romans often earned an {agnomen} for great deeds.
e.zh: 罗马人常因伟绩获得附加名。

e.en: His {agnomen} commemorated a famous victory.
e.zh: 他的附加名纪念了一场著名胜利。

e.en: Visual {agnosia} prevents recognizing familiar faces.
e.zh: 视觉失认症使人无法辨认熟人面孔。

e.en: The stroke caused a rare form of {agnosia}.
e.zh: 中风导致了一种罕见的失认症。

e.en: The play's central {agon} pits brother against brother.
e.zh: 剧作的核心冲突是兄弟反目。

e.en: Athletes prepared for the {agon} at Olympia.
e.zh: 运动员为奥林匹亚的竞赛做准备。

e.en: The patient showed {agonal} breathing.
e.zh: 患者出现了濒死呼吸。

e.en: Doctors recognized the {agonal} signs immediately.
e.zh: 医生立即识别出临终征象。

e.en: Many years {agone}, this castle stood proud.
e.zh: 许多年前，这座城堡巍然屹立。

e.en: Long {agone}, the river ran clear here.
e.zh: 很久以前，这里的河水清澈。

e.en: The {agonic} line marks zero magnetic declination.
e.zh: 无磁偏线表示磁偏角为零。

e.en: Ships crossing the {agonic} line need no compass correction.
e.zh: 船只穿越无磁偏线时无需修正罗盘。

e.en: Political {agonism} can strengthen democracy.
e.zh: 政治对抗性能够强化民主。

e.en: She studies the {agonism} between rival factions.
e.zh: 她研究敌对派系间的对抗关系。

e.en: His {agonistical} style alienated colleagues.
e.zh: 他好争辩的作风疏远了同事。

e.en: The debate took an {agonistical} turn.
e.zh: 辩论转向了对抗性。

e.en: They argued {agonistically} for hours.
e.zh: 他们对抗式地争论了数小时。

e.en: He responded {agonistically} to every question.
e.zh: 他对每个问题都针锋相对地回应。

e.en: Greek tragedies often featured stylized {agons}.
e.zh: 希腊悲剧常含程式化的冲突场面。

e.en: The festival hosted poetic {agons}.
e.zh: 该节庆举办诗歌竞赛。

e.en: Ancient {agorae} served as civic centers.
e.zh: 古代集市广场是城邦的公共中心。

e.en: Philosophers debated in the {agorae} of Athens.
e.zh: 哲学家在雅典的广场上辩论。

e.en: As an {agoraphobe}, he rarely left home.
e.zh: 作为广场恐惧症患者，他很少出门。

e.en: The {agoraphobe} dreaded crowded streets.
e.zh: 这位广场恐惧症患者害怕拥挤的街道。

e.en: He twisted off the {agraffe} and popped the cork.
e.zh: 他拧开铁丝扣，打开了瓶塞。

e.en: The dress fastened with a silver {agraffe}.
e.zh: 这件礼服用一只银钩扣固定。

e.en: His speech became {agrammatic} after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后他的话语失去了语法结构。

e.en: The patient produced {agrammatic} sentences.
e.zh: 患者说出无语法的句子。

e.en: Lymphocytes are a type of {agranulocyte}.
e.zh: 淋巴细胞是一种无颗粒白细胞。

e.en: The {agranulocyte} count was within normal range.
e.zh: 无颗粒白细胞计数在正常范围内。

e.en: The drug can cause {agranulocytosis} as a side effect.
e.zh: 该药物可能引起粒细胞缺乏症的副作用。

e.en: {Agranulocytosis} leaves patients vulnerable to infection.
e.zh: 粒细胞缺乏症使患者易受感染。

agrapha.t: 未录之言（耶稣未载于福音的语录）

e.en: Scholars study the {agrapha} preserved in early texts.
e.zh: 学者研究早期文献中保存的未录之言。

e.en: Some {agrapha} appear in patristic writings.
e.zh: 一些未录之言出现在教父著作中。

e.en: Brain damage left him with {agraphia}.
e.zh: 脑损伤使他患上失写症。

e.en: {Agraphia} affects the ability to write words.
e.zh: 失写症影响书写文字的能力。

e.en: The reforms aimed to {agrarianize} the economy.
e.zh: 改革旨在使经济农业化。

e.en: Settlers tried to {agrarianize} the frontier.
e.zh: 拓荒者试图把边疆变为农耕地。

e.en: Astronauts adapt to {agravic} conditions in orbit.
e.zh: 宇航员要适应轨道上的无重力环境。

e.en: Plants grow strangely in {agravic} environments.
e.zh: 植物在无重力环境中生长异常。

e.en: We met at the {agreed-on} location.
e.zh: 我们在约定的地点见面。

e.en: Both sides honored the {agreed-on} terms.
e.zh: 双方都遵守了商定的条款。

e.en: The {agreed-upon} deadline is next Friday.
e.zh: 约定的截止日期是下周五。

e.en: They followed the {agreed-upon} procedure.
e.zh: 他们按照商定的程序行事。

e.en: The book describes {agrestial} weeds and crops.
e.zh: 该书描写田野中的杂草与作物。

e.en: He preferred the {agrestial} life of the village.
e.zh: 他偏爱乡野的村居生活。

e.en: Her manners were charmingly {agrestic}.
e.zh: 她的举止带着可爱的乡野气。

e.en: The poem evokes an {agrestic} simplicity.
e.zh: 这首诗唤起一种乡村的质朴。

e.en: The sheriff moved to {afforce} the jury with additional members.
e.zh: 郡长提议为陪审团增补成员以加强其阵容。

e.en: They sought to {afforce} the council during the crisis.
e.zh: 他们设法在危机期间增强议会的力量。

e.en: The {afforcement} of the assize was recorded in the rolls.
e.zh: 巡回法庭的增援情况被记录在卷宗中。

e.en: Medieval courts often required {afforcement} for difficult cases.
e.zh: 中世纪法庭遇到疑难案件时常需要增援人员。

affordable-housing.t: 经济适用房；可负担住房

e.en: The city promised more {affordable-housing} for young families.
e.zh: 市政府承诺为年轻家庭提供更多经济适用房。

e.en: Activists demanded investment in {affordable-housing} downtown.
e.zh: 活动人士要求在市中心投资建设可负担住房。

e.en: A door handle's shape signals its {affordance} for pulling.
e.zh: 门把手的形状暗示了它可以被拉动的功能。

e.en: Designers study the {affordance} of every interface element.
e.zh: 设计师研究每个界面元素的可供性。

e.en: The government plans to {afforest} barren hillsides.
e.zh: 政府计划在荒山上植树造林。

e.en: Volunteers helped {afforest} the abandoned farmland.
e.zh: 志愿者帮助在废弃农田上造林。

afforested.t: 已植树造林的；造林后的

e.en: The once-bare slopes are now fully {afforested}.
e.zh: 曾经光秃秃的山坡如今已被树林覆盖。

e.en: Wildlife returned to the newly {afforested} valley.
e.zh: 野生动物回到了新近造林的山谷。

e.en: They are {afforesting} large stretches of degraded land.
e.zh: 他们正在大片退化的土地上植树造林。

e.en: {Afforesting} the desert margins is a long-term project.
e.zh: 在沙漠边缘造林是一项长期工程。

afforests.t: 植树造林（第三人称单数）

e.en: The agency {afforests} thousands of hectares each year.
e.zh: 该机构每年要在数千公顷的土地上植树造林。

e.en: Whenever a fire passes, the team {afforests} the site again.
e.zh: 每当火灾过后,该团队都会重新对该地点进行植树造林。

e.en: The reformers fought to {affranchise} the serfs.
e.zh: 改革者们为解放农奴而斗争。

e.en: The new law would {affranchise} thousands of bondsmen.
e.zh: 新法律将解放数千名奴隶。

e.en: The {affranchised} laborers celebrated their freedom.
e.zh: 获得解放的劳工们庆祝着他们的自由。

e.en: Once {affranchised}, they could own property.
e.zh: 一旦获得解放,他们就可以拥有财产了。

e.en: The decree of {affranchisement} ended centuries of bondage.
e.zh: 这份解放令终结了数百年的奴役。

e.en: Their {affranchisement} came after long political struggle.
e.zh: 经过长期的政治斗争,他们终于获得了解放。

affranchises.t: 解放；释放（第三人称单数）

e.en: The charter formally {affranchises} every resident of the borough.
e.zh: 该宪章正式解放了该自治市的每一位居民。

e.en: This act {affranchises} those bound to the estate.
e.zh: 该法令解放了所有受束于这片庄园的人。

e.en: The lord was reluctant about {affranchising} his vassals.
e.zh: 领主对解放他的臣属心存犹豫。

e.en: {Affranchising} the workers required royal approval.
e.zh: 解放这些工人需要得到王室的批准。

e.en: The merchant agreed to {affreight} a vessel for the voyage.
e.zh: 该商人同意租用一艘船完成此次航行。

e.en: They will {affreight} the ship with grain bound for Lisbon.
e.zh: 他们将租船装运谷物运往里斯本。

affreightment.t: 租船运货合同；包船契约

e.en: The contract of {affreightment} stipulated the freight rate.
e.zh: 该租船合同规定了运费费率。

e.en: Disputes about {affreightment} are common in maritime law.
e.zh: 关于租船合同的纠纷在海商法中很常见。

e.en: The 'ch' in 'church' is an English {affricate}.
e.zh: 'church' 中的 'ch' 是一个英语塞擦音。

e.en: Phonologists distinguish each {affricate} from simple stops.
e.zh: 音系学家会将每个塞擦音与单纯的爆破音区分开来。

e.en: Mandarin has several distinct {affricates} not found in English.
e.zh: 普通话拥有几个英语中没有的塞擦音。

e.en: The textbook lists all the {affricates} of Standard German.
e.zh: 该教材列出了标准德语中的所有塞擦音。

affrication.t: 塞擦音化；产生塞擦音的过程

e.en: Historical {affrication} turned earlier stops into modern 'ts' sounds.
e.zh: 历史上的塞擦音化使早期的爆破音演变为现代的 'ts' 音。

e.en: Some dialects show {affrication} of /t/ before high vowels.
e.zh: 某些方言中,/t/ 在高元音前会发生塞擦音化。

affricative.t: 塞擦音的；具有塞擦音性质的

e.en: The consonant has a clearly {affricative} quality.
e.zh: 该辅音具有明显的塞擦音性质。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the sound was truly {affricative}.
e.zh: 研究者们就该音是否真属塞擦音展开了讨论。

e.en: The howling wind did {affright} the weary travelers.
e.zh: 呼啸的风声惊吓到了疲惫的旅人们。

e.en: A sudden {affright} seized the village at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时分,村庄突遭惊恐袭来。

e.en: The {affrighted} children clung to their mother.
e.zh: 受惊的孩子们紧紧抓住母亲不放。

e.en: He stared with {affrighted} eyes at the apparition.
e.zh: 他用惊恐的目光凝视着那个幻影。

e.en: She glanced {affrightedly} over her shoulder.
e.zh: 她惊恐地回头瞥了一眼。

e.en: The horse whinnied {affrightedly} at the thunder.
e.zh: 那匹马因雷声而惊恐地嘶鸣。

e.en: Stories of ghosts can {affrighten} the youngest listeners.
e.zh: 鬼故事会吓到年纪最小的听众。

e.en: Nothing seemed to {affrighten} the seasoned soldier.
e.zh: 似乎没有什么能吓倒这位老兵。

e.en: The masked figure proved a notorious {affrighter} of children.
e.zh: 那位戴面具的家伙是个臭名昭著的吓唬小孩者。

e.en: The old tale named the wolf as the chief {affrighter}.
e.zh: 古老的传说中,狼被称为最主要的恐吓者。

e.en: The storm produced an {affrightful} roar over the cliffs.
e.zh: 暴风雨在悬崖上方发出令人恐惧的咆哮。

e.en: Medieval chronicles describe an {affrightful} comet.
e.zh: 中世纪编年史记载了一颗令人恐惧的彗星。

e.en: The cave gave off an {affrighting} echo.
e.zh: 洞穴中传出令人惊恐的回声。

e.en: It was an {affrighting} sight to behold.
e.zh: 那是一幕令人惊恐的景象。

e.en: A great {affrightment} fell upon the camp.
e.zh: 营地上下笼罩着巨大的恐惧。

e.en: He cried out in sudden {affrightment}.
e.zh: 他突然惊恐地大叫起来。

affrights.t: 惊吓（第三人称单数或复数）

e.en: That terrible specter {affrights} every passerby.
e.zh: 那可怕的幽灵会吓到每一个路人。

e.en: The poem catalogues the {affrights} of war.
e.zh: 这首诗罗列了战争带来的种种恐怖。

e.en: His tone was deliberately {affrontive}.
e.zh: 他的语气带着故意的冒犯。

e.en: They found the gesture both rude and {affrontive}.
e.zh: 他们觉得那个手势既粗鲁又带有侮辱性。

e.en: The {affrontiveness} of his remarks shocked the panel.
e.zh: 他言论中的冒犯性让评审小组感到震惊。

e.en: She apologized for the {affrontiveness} of the letter.
e.zh: 她为信件的无礼之处道了歉。

e.en: The priest would {affuse} water on the infant's head.
e.zh: 神父会将水浇在婴儿的头上。

e.en: Doctors used to {affuse} cold water to revive patients.
e.zh: 医生过去常用冷水浇灌病人以使其苏醒。

e.en: Water was {affused} upon the candidate during baptism.
e.zh: 洗礼时,水被浇在受礼者身上。

e.en: The wound, gently {affused}, began to heal.
e.zh: 伤口经轻柔冲洗后开始愈合。

e.en: The minister was {affusing} water as he spoke the blessing.
e.zh: 牧师一边念着祝祷词,一边将水浇下。

e.en: {Affusing} cool liquid soothed the burn.
e.zh: 浇上凉爽的液体能缓解烧伤的疼痛。

e.en: Baptism by {affusion} is common in many denominations.
e.zh: 通过浇水进行的洗礼在许多教派中很常见。

e.en: The doctor recommended {affusion} of cold water on the limb.
e.zh: 医生建议在该肢体上浇冷水进行治疗。

e.en: She is a true {aficionada} of flamenco dancing.
e.zh: 她是一位真正的弗拉门戈舞蹈狂热爱好者。

e.en: As an opera {aficionada}, she attends every premiere.
e.zh: 作为一位歌剧迷,她每场首演都不会错过。

e.en: The torches were all {aflare} along the castle walls.
e.zh: 城墙上的火炬全都熊熊燃烧着。

e.en: Her cheeks were {aflare} with embarrassment.
e.zh: 她的双颊因尴尬而泛红发烫。

e.en: Her face was {aflush} after the long run.
e.zh: 长跑过后,她的脸涨得通红。

e.en: The children stood {aflush} with excitement.
e.zh: 孩子们兴奋得满脸通红地站着。

e.en: The whole town was {aflutter} over the royal visit.
e.zh: 整个小镇都因王室来访而激动不已。

e.en: Flags were {aflutter} in the morning breeze.
e.zh: 旗帜在晨风中飘动。

afocal.t: 无焦点的；无焦距的（光学）

e.en: The telescope uses an {afocal} lens system.
e.zh: 该望远镜采用无焦透镜系统。

e.en: Photographers experimented with {afocal} attachments on their phones.
e.zh: 摄影师们尝试在手机上加装无焦镜头配件。

e.en: Her family runs a successful {agri-business} in Iowa.
e.zh: 她家在爱荷华州经营着一家成功的农业综合企业。

e.en: Investors are pouring money into {agri-business} ventures.
e.zh: 投资者正大量资金投入农业综合企业。

e.en: The factory produces various {agri-chemical} products.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产多种农用化学品。

e.en: Stricter rules govern {agri-chemical} use near rivers.
e.zh: 更严格的规定限制了河流附近农用化学品的使用。

e.en: The {agribusinessman} expanded into Asian markets.
e.zh: 这位农业企业家把业务扩展到了亚洲市场。

e.en: He became a wealthy {agribusinessman} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后他成了一位富有的农业企业家。

e.en: Several {agribusinessmen} attended the policy summit.
e.zh: 几位农业企业家出席了政策峰会。

e.en: The {agribusinessmen} lobbied for lower export tariffs.
e.zh: 这些农业企业家游说降低出口关税。

e.en: The lab tests soil for {agrichemical} residues.
e.zh: 实验室检测土壤中的农用化学品残留。

e.en: This {agrichemical} is banned in the European Union.
e.zh: 这种农用化学品在欧盟被禁止使用。

e.en: Overuse of {agrichemicals} has polluted groundwater.
e.zh: 农用化学品的过度使用污染了地下水。

e.en: Farmers are switching from {agrichemicals} to organic methods.
e.zh: 农民正从农用化学品转向有机方法。

e.en: She brewed tea from dried {agrimony} leaves.
e.zh: 她用干龙牙草叶泡茶。

e.en: {Agrimony} grows wild along the country lanes.
e.zh: 龙牙草在乡间小路边野生生长。

e.en: {Agritourism} brings extra income to small farms.
e.zh: 农业旅游为小农场带来额外收入。

e.en: They opened their vineyard to {agritourism} visitors.
e.zh: 他们的葡萄园向农业旅游游客开放。

e.en: The company invests in {agro} technology start-ups.
e.zh: 该公司投资于农业科技初创企业。

e.en: They run an {agro} processing plant in Brazil.
e.zh: 他们在巴西经营一家农产品加工厂。

e.en: The {agro-chemical} industry faces tougher regulations.
e.zh: 农用化学品行业面临更严格的监管。

e.en: He works for an {agro-chemical} multinational.
e.zh: 他在一家跨国农用化学品公司工作。

e.en: The project promotes {agro-ecological} farming practices.
e.zh: 该项目推广农业生态种植方法。

e.en: They mapped the region's {agro-ecological} zones.
e.zh: 他们绘制了该地区的农业生态区。

e.en: The town's economy depends on {agro-industrial} complexes.
e.zh: 这座城镇的经济依赖于农工业综合体。

e.en: Government policy supports {agro-industrial} development.
e.zh: 政府政策支持农工业发展。

e.en: The team published {agrobiological} research findings.
e.zh: 该团队发表了农业生物学研究成果。

e.en: She specializes in {agrobiological} pest control.
e.zh: 她专攻农业生物学病虫害防治。

e.en: The {agrobiologist} studied soil microbe interactions.
e.zh: 这位农业生物学家研究土壤微生物的相互作用。

e.en: An {agrobiologist} advised on the new crop rotation.
e.zh: 一位农业生物学家就新的轮作方案提供了建议。

e.en: She earned a degree in {agrobiology}.
e.zh: 她获得了农业生物学学位。

e.en: {Agrobiology} explores how plants respond to soil chemistry.
e.zh: 农业生物学研究植物对土壤化学的反应。

e.en: Foreign investors dominate the local {agrobusiness}.
e.zh: 外国投资者主导着当地的农业综合企业。

e.en: He built a small {agrobusiness} from a family farm.
e.zh: 他从家庭农场起步建立了一家小型农业综合企业。

e.en: {Agroclimatology} helps predict crop yields.
e.zh: 农业气候学有助于预测作物产量。

e.en: He teaches {agroclimatology} at the university.
e.zh: 他在大学教授农业气候学。

e.en: The farm follows strict {agroecological} principles.
e.zh: 这家农场遵循严格的农业生态原则。

e.en: They evaluated the {agroecological} impact of the project.
e.zh: 他们评估了项目的农业生态影响。

e.en: Different {agroecologies} require different farming methods.
e.zh: 不同的农业生态体系需要不同的耕作方法。

e.en: Researchers compared {agroecologies} across the continent.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了整个大陆的农业生态体系。

e.en: Pesticides can disrupt the entire {agroecosystem}.
e.zh: 农药可能扰乱整个农业生态系统。

e.en: They studied the {agroecosystem} of the rice paddies.
e.zh: 他们研究了稻田的农业生态系统。

e.en: The {agroforester} planted nut trees among the crops.
e.zh: 这位农林业从业者在庄稼间种植了坚果树。

e.en: An experienced {agroforester} advised the village.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的农林业从业者为村庄提供了指导。

e.en: The region became an {agroindustrial} powerhouse.
e.zh: 该地区成为了农工业强区。

e.en: They invested in {agroindustrial} machinery.
e.zh: 他们投资了农工业机械。

e.en: {Agroindustry} now employs millions worldwide.
e.zh: 农业工业如今在全球雇佣了数百万人。

e.en: The country's {agroindustry} is rapidly modernizing.
e.zh: 该国的农业工业正在迅速现代化。

e.en: The {agrologist} tested the field for nutrients.
e.zh: 这位农学家检测了田地的养分。

e.en: She trained as an {agrologist} in Canada.
e.zh: 她在加拿大接受农学家培训。

e.en: He studied {agrology} at a Canadian university.
e.zh: 他在一所加拿大大学学习农业土壤学。

e.en: {Agrology} examines soil suitability for crops.
e.zh: 农业土壤学研究土壤对作物的适宜性。

e.en: Farmers rely on {agrometeorological} forecasts for planting.
e.zh: 农民依靠农业气象预报来安排播种。

e.en: The {agrometeorological} data showed a drought risk.
e.zh: 农业气象数据显示存在干旱风险。

e.en: They conducted {agronomical} trials on new wheat varieties.
e.zh: 他们对新小麦品种进行了农艺学试验。

e.en: The report covered {agronomical} aspects of the harvest.
e.zh: 报告涵盖了收成的农艺学方面。

e.en: The {agrostologist} catalogued native grass species.
e.zh: 这位禾草学家对本土草种进行了编目。

e.en: An {agrostologist} advised on pasture restoration.
e.zh: 一位禾草学家就牧场恢复提供了建议。

e.en: The manuscript had an {agelike} patina that fascinated scholars.
e.zh: 那份手稿带着一种似年代久远的光泽，令学者们着迷。

e.en: She wore an {agelike} expression of weariness.
e.zh: 她脸上挂着一种仿佛苍老的疲惫神情。

e.en: They engaged in an {agelong} debate about morality.
e.zh: 他们就道德问题展开了一场旷日持久的辩论。

e.en: The {agelong} traditions of the village remain unchanged.
e.zh: 这个村庄亘古的传统至今未变。

e.en: The media plays a powerful {agenda-setting} role in democracies.
e.zh: 媒体在民主社会中扮演着重要的议程设置角色。

e.en: Her speech had clear {agenda-setting} intentions.
e.zh: 她的演讲带有明显的议程设置意图。

e.en: The meeting felt {agendaless} and wasted everyone's time.
e.zh: 这次会议毫无议程，浪费了大家的时间。

e.en: He claimed to be an {agendaless} observer.
e.zh: 他自称是一位毫无私心目的的旁观者。

e.en: They identify as {agender} and use neutral pronouns.
e.zh: 他们认同自己为无性别者，使用中性代词。

e.en: The community welcomes {agender} members openly.
e.zh: 这个社群公开欢迎无性别认同的成员。

e.en: Each {agendum} was discussed in turn.
e.zh: 每一项议程都依次进行了讨论。

e.en: The chairman added a new {agendum} to the list.
e.zh: 主席在清单上加入了一项新的议事内容。

e.en: Several {agendums} were postponed to next week.
e.zh: 几项议程被推迟到下周讨论。

e.en: The committee reviewed all the {agendums}.
e.zh: 委员会审议了所有议程项目。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with renal {agenesis}.
e.zh: 该婴儿被诊断出肾脏发育不全。

e.en: {Agenesis} of the corpus callosum is rare.
e.zh: 胼胝体不发育是一种罕见的病症。

e.en: Bakers used to {agenize} flour to whiten it.
e.zh: 过去面包师常用三氯化氮处理面粉以使其变白。

e.en: It is illegal to {agenize} flour today.
e.zh: 如今用三氯化氮处理面粉已属违法。

e.en: He served as {agent-general} for the colony in London.
e.zh: 他在伦敦担任该殖民地的驻外总代表。

e.en: The {agent-general} promoted trade between regions.
e.zh: 这位总代理促进了各地区之间的贸易。

agential.t: 行为主体的；具能动性的

e.en: The theory emphasizes the {agential} role of individuals.
e.zh: 该理论强调个体的能动作用。

e.en: Her writing explores {agential} power in social systems.
e.zh: 她的著作探讨了社会系统中的能动性力量。

e.en: The suffix '-er' often forms {agentive} nouns.
e.zh: 后缀'-er'常用于构成施事名词。

e.en: She analyzed the {agentive} structures in the sentence.
e.zh: 她分析了句中的施事结构。

e.en: The chemist added an {agglomerant} to bind the particles.
e.zh: 化学家加入凝聚剂以使颗粒结合在一起。

e.en: This {agglomerant} improves the powder's flow.
e.zh: 这种附聚剂改善了粉末的流动性。

e.en: The algorithm uses an {agglomerative} clustering approach.
e.zh: 该算法采用凝聚式聚类方法。

e.en: Cities grow through {agglomerative} processes.
e.zh: 城市通过聚集过程不断扩张。

e.en: The factory installed a new {agglomerator} for the powder line.
e.zh: 工厂为粉末生产线安装了新的团聚机。

e.en: The {agglomerator} compacts loose particles into pellets.
e.zh: 这台造粒机将松散颗粒压制成小球。

e.en: Researchers tested the cells' {agglutinability} in serum.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了细胞在血清中的凝集性。

e.en: The bacteria's {agglutinability} indicated infection.
e.zh: 细菌的凝集反应表明存在感染。

e.en: The lab added an {agglutinant} to the sample.
e.zh: 实验室向样本中加入了凝集剂。

e.en: This {agglutinant} causes red blood cells to clump.
e.zh: 这种凝集剂会使红细胞聚集成团。

e.en: The antibodies cause the cells to {agglutinate}.
e.zh: 抗体使细胞发生凝集。

e.en: Heat can {agglutinate} the proteins together.
e.zh: 加热会使蛋白质黏结在一起。

e.en: The {agglutinated} cells appeared as visible clumps.
e.zh: 凝集的细胞形成肉眼可见的团块。

e.en: He examined the {agglutinated} sample under the microscope.
e.zh: 他在显微镜下检查了凝集的样本。

e.en: The serum quickly {agglutinates} the bacteria.
e.zh: 血清迅速使细菌发生凝集。

e.en: This protein {agglutinates} blood cells of certain types.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质使某些类型的血细胞凝集。

e.en: Turkish is an {agglutinating} language with rich morphology.
e.zh: 土耳其语是一种形态丰富的黏着语。

e.en: They observed the {agglutinating} reaction in the dish.
e.zh: 他们在培养皿中观察到了凝集反应。

e.en: Japanese is considered an {agglutinative} language.
e.zh: 日语被认为是一种黏着语。

e.en: The suffixes follow an {agglutinative} pattern.
e.zh: 这些后缀遵循黏着语式的构词模式。

e.en: The blood test detected a specific {agglutinin}.
e.zh: 血液检测发现了一种特定的凝集素。

e.en: {Agglutinin} levels rise during certain infections.
e.zh: 在某些感染期间凝集素水平会升高。

e.en: Blood types depend on the {agglutinogen} on red cells.
e.zh: 血型取决于红细胞表面的凝集原。

e.en: The {agglutinogen} reacts with corresponding antibodies.
e.zh: 凝集原会与相应的抗体发生反应。

e.en: The substance is mildly {agglutinogenic} in mice.
e.zh: 该物质在小鼠体内具有轻度致凝集原性。

e.en: Researchers studied the {agglutinogenic} properties of the antigen.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了该抗原的致凝集原特性。

e.en: The {aggradated} riverbed has risen over centuries.
e.zh: 经过数世纪沉积加积，河床已抬升。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {aggradated} plain in detail.
e.zh: 地质学家详细绘制了这片加积平原。

e.en: River {aggradation} can flood nearby farmland.
e.zh: 河流的加积作用可能淹没附近的农田。

e.en: Sediment {aggradation} reshaped the valley floor.
e.zh: 沉积加积重塑了谷底地形。

e.en: The river enters an {aggradational} phase during floods.
e.zh: 洪水期间，河流进入加积阶段。

e.en: They studied {aggradational} landforms in the delta.
e.zh: 他们研究了三角洲的加积地貌。

e.en: Sediments slowly {aggrade} the channel floor.
e.zh: 沉积物使河道底部缓慢抬升。

e.en: The dam caused the river to {aggrade} upstream.
e.zh: 水坝导致上游河床发生加积。

e.en: The {aggraded} stream had a much higher bed.
e.zh: 加积后的河流河床抬升了许多。

e.en: Sediment {aggraded} the valley over millennia.
e.zh: 千百年来沉积物使河谷不断抬升。

e.en: The river {aggrades} its channel each spring.
e.zh: 每到春季，这条河都会使河道抬升。

e.en: Heavy sediment load {aggrades} the streambed quickly.
e.zh: 大量泥沙迅速使河床加积升高。

aggrading.t: 加积的；正在沉积升高的

e.en: The {aggrading} river deposits gravel along its banks.
e.zh: 这条加积中的河流在两岸沉积了砾石。

e.en: They observed an {aggrading} channel after the storm.
e.zh: 风暴过后他们观察到一条正在加积的河道。

e.en: He sought to {aggrandise} his power at every turn.
e.zh: 他时时刻刻试图扩大自己的权势。

e.en: The king tried to {aggrandise} his realm by conquest.
e.zh: 国王试图通过征战扩大自己的疆域。

e.en: His critics accused him of self-{aggrandisement}.
e.zh: 批评者指责他自我膨胀、抬高自己。

e.en: The war was driven by territorial {aggrandisement}.
e.zh: 这场战争源于对领土扩张的渴望。

e.en: Government spending boosts {aggregate-demand} in a recession.
e.zh: 政府支出可在经济衰退时提振总需求。

e.en: The model shows how {aggregate-demand} affects employment.
e.zh: 该模型显示总需求如何影响就业。

e.en: The report uses {aggregational} data from many sources.
e.zh: 该报告使用了来自多方的汇总数据。

e.en: They studied the {aggregational} behavior of the particles.
e.zh: 他们研究了这些粒子的聚集行为。

e.en: The fish display {aggregatory} behavior near reefs.
e.zh: 这些鱼在礁石附近表现出聚集性行为。

e.en: Researchers noted the {aggregatory} tendency of the cells.
e.zh: 研究人员注意到这些细胞的聚集倾向。

aggressive-growth.t: 激进增长；高风险高增长

e.en: She invests in an {aggressive-growth} mutual fund.
e.zh: 她投资了一只激进增长型共同基金。

e.en: The company pursued an {aggressive-growth} strategy abroad.
e.zh: 该公司在海外推行激进增长战略。

e.en: She voiced her {aggrievement} at the unfair ruling.
e.zh: 她对这一不公裁决表达了不满。

e.en: His letter expressed deep {aggrievement} over the decision.
e.zh: 他的信中对该决定深表委屈。

e.en: She is the {agilest} climber on the team.
e.zh: 她是队里最敏捷的攀岩者。

e.en: That cat is the {agilest} animal I've ever seen.
e.zh: 那只猫是我见过最灵活的动物。

e.en: Banks profit from the {agio} charged on foreign exchange.
e.zh: 银行从外汇兑换的溢价中获利。

e.en: The {agio} between the two currencies was small.
e.zh: 两种货币之间的兑换溢价很小。

agios.t: 货币兑换溢价（复数）；汇水

e.en: Traders track {agios} closely during volatile sessions.
e.zh: 交易员在市场波动时密切关注汇水。

e.en: The {agios} on these notes have widened recently.
e.zh: 这些票据的兑换溢价最近扩大了。

agiotage.t: 货币投机；股票投机买卖

e.en: He grew rich through risky {agiotage}.
e.zh: 他靠高风险的货币投机发了财。

e.en: Regulators tried to curb rampant {agiotage}.
e.zh: 监管机构试图遏制猖獗的投机买卖。

e.en: Workplace {agism} affects older job seekers.
e.zh: 职场中的年龄歧视影响着年长的求职者。

e.en: She wrote a column condemning {agism} in hiring.
e.zh: 她写专栏抨击招聘中的年龄歧视。

agist.t: 代人放牧（收费寄养牲畜）

e.en: Local farmers {agist} cattle for nearby ranchers.
e.zh: 当地农民为附近的牧场主代牧牛只。

e.en: He earns extra income by agreeing to {agist} sheep.
e.zh: 他通过代人寄养绵羊来增加收入。

e.en: The {agister} fed and watered the boarded horses.
e.zh: 代牧人给寄养的马匹喂食饮水。

e.en: An experienced {agister} oversees the forest grazing.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的代牧人监管森林放牧。

e.en: They paid weekly {agistment} fees for their horses.
e.zh: 他们每周为马匹支付寄养费。

e.en: {Agistment} rates have risen with the drought.
e.zh: 代牧费率随着干旱而上涨。

agita.t: 心烦；焦躁不安；胃部不适

e.en: All this paperwork is giving me {agita}.
e.zh: 这堆文件让我心烦意乱。

e.en: Heavy traffic always causes him real {agita}.
e.zh: 严重的交通堵塞总让他焦躁不已。

e.en: The solution is easily {agitable} with a stirrer.
e.zh: 该溶液用搅拌棒就能轻易搅动。

e.en: Children can be {agitable} when overtired.
e.zh: 孩子过度疲劳时容易激动。

e.en: The pamphlet was openly {agitational} in tone.
e.zh: 这本小册子的语气明显带有煽动性。

e.en: He delivered an {agitational} speech to the workers.
e.zh: 他向工人们发表了一篇鼓动性的演讲。

e.en: Her column took an unusually {agitative} stance.
e.zh: 她的专栏采取了异常激进的鼓动立场。

e.en: The film has an {agitative} effect on viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影对观众有激动人心的效果。

e.en: The score is marked {agitato} at this passage.
e.zh: 乐谱在此段标记为激动地演奏。

e.en: She played the finale {agitato} and breathless.
e.zh: 她以激动而紧凑的方式演奏终曲。

e.en: Her eyes were {aglare} with anger.
e.zh: 她的双眼因愤怒而炯炯发光。

e.en: The desert sand lay {aglare} in the noon sun.
e.zh: 沙漠的沙子在正午阳光下耀眼地闪光。

e.en: The lake was {agleam} under the moon.
e.zh: 湖面在月光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: His eyes were {agleam} with excitement.
e.zh: 他的眼睛因兴奋而闪闪发光。

aglet.t: 鞋带末端的金属或塑料套

e.en: The plastic {aglet} on his shoelace had cracked.
e.zh: 他鞋带头上的塑料套已经裂开了。

e.en: Without an {aglet}, the lace started to fray.
e.zh: 没有了鞋带套,鞋带开始磨损散开。

agley.t: 出错地；偏离地（苏格兰用法）

e.en: The best-laid plans often go {agley}.
e.zh: 再周密的计划也常常会出岔子。

e.en: Everything went {agley} on the day of the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼那天一切都乱了套。

aglimmer.t: 微微闪光的；隐约发光的

e.en: Candles were {aglimmer} on every table.
e.zh: 每张桌上的蜡烛都微微闪烁着。

e.en: The harbor was {aglimmer} with distant lights.
e.zh: 港口因远处的灯火而微微泛光。

e.en: Her gown was {aglitter} with tiny sequins.
e.zh: 她的礼服上点缀的小亮片闪闪发光。

e.en: The city skyline was {aglitter} after dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏后的城市天际线闪烁着光芒。

e.en: Certain frogs are classified as {aglossal} species.
e.zh: 某些蛙类被归为无舌物种。

e.en: The textbook described several {aglossal} amphibians.
e.zh: 教科书描述了几种无舌两栖动物。

e.en: The enzyme releases the {aglucone} from the glycoside.
e.zh: 该酶将配基从糖苷中释放出来。

e.en: Researchers analyzed the {aglucone} structure carefully.
e.zh: 研究人员仔细分析了配基的结构。

agly.t: 出错地；歪斜地（agley 的变体）

e.en: Things went {agly} despite our preparations.
e.zh: 尽管我们做了准备,事情还是出了岔子。

e.en: His careful schemes ran {agly} in the end.
e.zh: 他周密的计划最终还是出错了。

e.en: Chemists isolated the {aglycon} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出了配基。

e.en: The {aglycon} determines much of the compound's activity.
e.zh: 配基在很大程度上决定了化合物的活性。

aglycone.t: 配基；糖苷水解后的非糖部分

e.en: Hydrolysis releases the {aglycone} from the sugar moiety.
e.zh: 水解可将配基从糖基部分中释放出来。

e.en: The {aglycone} was identified using mass spectrometry.
e.zh: 研究者使用质谱法鉴定了配基。

e.en: {Agmatine} occurs naturally in mammalian tissues.
e.zh: 胍丁胺天然存在于哺乳动物组织中。

e.en: Some athletes take {agmatine} as a supplement.
e.zh: 一些运动员服用胍丁胺作为补充剂。

e.en: The intestine contains {agminate} lymph nodules.
e.zh: 肠道内含有聚集成群的淋巴小结。

e.en: Pathologists noted {agminate} clusters of cells.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到聚集成群的细胞团。

e.en: She picked at an {agnail} on her thumb.
e.zh: 她抠着大拇指上的一个倒刺。

e.en: A painful {agnail} kept catching on her sleeve.
e.zh: 一个疼痛的倒刺总是勾到她的袖子。

e.en: Lampreys are a familiar example of an {agnathan}.
e.zh: 七鳃鳗是无颌类动物的一个常见例子。

e.en: Each {agnathan} lacks true jaws and paired fins.
e.zh: 每种无颌类动物都缺乏真正的颌和成对的鳍。

e.en: Hagfish are {agnathous} marine creatures.
e.zh: 盲鳗是无颌的海洋生物。

e.en: The fossil belongs to an early {agnathous} fish.
e.zh: 这块化石属于一种早期的无颌鱼。

agnation.t: 父系亲属关系；同宗关系

e.en: Roman law placed great weight on {agnation}.
e.zh: 罗马法非常重视父系亲属关系。

e.en: Inheritance often passed through {agnation} alone.
e.zh: 继承权常常仅通过父系传承。

e.en: The knight set off {ahorse} at dawn.
e.zh: 骑士黎明时分策马出发。

e.en: They traveled {ahorse} across the moor.
e.zh: 他们骑马穿越荒原。

e.en: The ship lay {ahull} during the storm.
e.zh: 船在风暴中落帆任其漂流。

e.en: They left the boat {ahull} until the wind eased.
e.zh: 他们让船落帆漂流，直到风势减弱。

e.en: The room was {ahum} with quiet conversation.
e.zh: 房间里轻声细语，嗡嗡作响。

e.en: The hive was {ahum} all afternoon.
e.zh: 蜂巢整个下午都嗡嗡作响。

e.en: The travelers arrived {ahungered} after days on the road.
e.zh: 旅人们经过数日跋涉，饥肠辘辘地抵达。

e.en: He was {ahungered} for news of home.
e.zh: 他渴望听到家乡的消息。

e.en: He'll {aiblins} come tomorrow if the rain stops.
e.zh: 如果雨停了，他明天也许会来。

e.en: {Aiblins} we'll meet again at the fair.
e.zh: 也许我们会在集市上再相见。

e.en: They sought {aidance} from their neighbors.
e.zh: 他们向邻居寻求援助。

e.en: Without his {aidance}, the work would have failed.
e.zh: 若无他的援助，这项工作早就失败了。

e.en: She offered an {aidant} hand to the weary traveler.
e.zh: 她向疲惫的旅人伸出援助之手。

e.en: His {aidant} efforts saved the harvest.
e.zh: 他援助性的努力挽救了收成。

e.en: The general's {aide-de-camp} delivered the orders.
e.zh: 将军的副官送达了命令。

e.en: He served as {aide-de-camp} during the campaign.
e.zh: 他在战役中担任副官。

e.en: She kept a brief {aide-memoire} for the meeting.
e.zh: 她为会议准备了一份简短的备忘录。

e.en: The diplomat passed an {aide-memoire} to his counterpart.
e.zh: 那位外交官把一份备忘录交给了对方。

aidedecamp.t: 副官；侍从武官（aide-de-camp 的连写形式）

e.en: The {aidedecamp} accompanied the commander everywhere.
e.zh: 副官随侍指挥官出入各处。

e.en: He was promoted to {aidedecamp} after the battle.
e.zh: 战役之后他被擢升为副官。

e.en: Two {aides-de-camp} stood behind the general.
e.zh: 两位副官站在将军身后。

e.en: The {aides-de-camp} relayed every order swiftly.
e.zh: 副官们迅速传达了每一道命令。

e.en: Her notes proved most {aidful} during revision.
e.zh: 她的笔记在复习时极有帮助。

e.en: He gave a few {aidful} suggestions.
e.zh: 他提了几条有助益的建议。

e.en: The {aidman} rushed to bandage the wounded soldier.
e.zh: 卫生兵冲过去为受伤士兵包扎。

e.en: Every platoon had its own {aidman}.
e.zh: 每个排都有自己的医务兵。

e.en: The {aidmen} worked through the night to save lives.
e.zh: 卫生兵们彻夜抢救伤员。

e.en: Several {aidmen} were decorated for bravery.
e.zh: 几位卫生兵因勇敢而获嘉奖。

e.en: He researches {aids-related} illnesses at the hospital.
e.zh: 他在医院研究与艾滋病有关的疾病。

e.en: The clinic offers {aids-related} counseling free of charge.
e.zh: 诊所免费提供与艾滋病相关的咨询服务。

aiglet.t: 鞋带头；金属包头（绳带末端的金属或塑料套）

e.en: The {aiglet} on his shoelace had cracked off.
e.zh: 他鞋带上的金属包头已经裂掉了。

e.en: Tudor doublets were trimmed with shining {aiglet}s.
e.zh: 都铎时期的紧身上衣常以闪亮的金属带头作装饰。

e.en: She wore an {aigret} pinned to her evening gown.
e.zh: 她在晚礼服上别了一支白鹭羽饰。

e.en: The hat was crowned with a tall {aigret}.
e.zh: 那顶帽子顶端饰有一支高高的羽毛头饰。

e.en: She specializes in {agrostology} at the agricultural institute.
e.zh: 她在农业研究所专攻禾草学。

e.en: The textbook on {agrostology} describes hundreds of grass species.
e.zh: 这本禾草学教材介绍了数百种草类植物。

e.en: The farm adopted new {agrotechnical} methods to boost yields.
e.zh: 这家农场采用了新的农业技术方法来提高产量。

e.en: He attended an {agrotechnical} conference last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他参加了一场农业技术会议。

e.en: The {agrotechnician} advised farmers on irrigation systems.
e.zh: 这位农业技术员就灌溉系统向农民提供建议。

e.en: She trained as an {agrotechnician} after college.
e.zh: 大学毕业后她接受了农业技术员的培训。

e.en: Modern {agrotechnique} has transformed rural productivity.
e.zh: 现代农业技术已经改变了农村生产力。

e.en: They studied the {agrotechnique} used in dryland farming.
e.zh: 他们研究了旱地农业中使用的农艺方法。

e.en: Settlers brewed {agueweed} tea to treat fevers.
e.zh: 早期移民会煮退热草茶来治疗发烧。

e.en: The herbalist pointed out an {agueweed} growing in the meadow.
e.zh: 草药师指出草地上长着一株退热草。

e.en: He felt {aguish} after the long trek through the swamp.
e.zh: 穿越沼泽长途跋涉后,他感到忽冷忽热,像染了疟疾。

e.en: The traveler's {aguish} symptoms worried the villagers.
e.zh: 旅人疟疾般的症状让村民们担心。

e.en: Tears came {agush} down her cheeks at the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息,泪水夺眶而出,顺着她的脸颊涌流而下。

e.en: The spring was {agush} after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后,泉水奔涌而出。

e.en: "{Ah-choo}!" he sneezed into his elbow.
e.zh: “阿嚏!”他对着臂弯打了个喷嚏。

e.en: The dusty attic made her go {ah-choo} repeatedly.
e.zh: 满是灰尘的阁楼让她不停地“阿嚏阿嚏”地打喷嚏。

e.en: She let out a loud {ahchoo} during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议中大声打了个“阿嚏”。

e.en: The pollen made him say {ahchoo} all afternoon.
e.zh: 花粉害得他整个下午都在“阿嚏阿嚏”地打喷嚏。

e.en: Researchers tested an {ahemeral} lighting schedule on laying hens.
e.zh: 研究人员对蛋鸡使用了非24小时周期的光照方案。

e.en: The farm switched to an {ahemeral} cycle to improve egg quality.
e.zh: 为提高蛋的品质,农场改用了非24小时光照周期。

ahimsa.t: 非暴力;不杀生(印度教与佛教教义)

e.en: Gandhi made {ahimsa} the cornerstone of his philosophy.
e.zh: 甘地把不杀生作为他思想的基石。

e.en: Practicing {ahimsa} means avoiding harm to all living beings.
e.zh: 奉行非暴力意味着避免伤害一切众生。

ahistoric.t: 非历史的;脱离历史背景的

e.en: Critics called the film's portrayal of the era {ahistoric}.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影对那个时代的描绘脱离了历史事实。

e.en: His analysis is {ahistoric} and ignores key context.
e.zh: 他的分析脱离历史背景,忽略了关键的语境。

e.en: Her hat was decorated with a delicate {aigrette}.
e.zh: 她的帽子上饰有精致的白鹭羽饰。

e.en: The dancer wore a jeweled {aigrette} in her hair.
e.zh: 舞者头发上戴着一枚镶宝石的羽饰。

e.en: Climbers gazed up at the towering {aiguille}.
e.zh: 登山者仰望着高耸的针状岩峰。

e.en: The {aiguille} pierced the morning clouds.
e.zh: 那座尖峰刺破了清晨的云层。

e.en: The officer's uniform bore a gold {aiguillette}.
e.zh: 军官的制服上佩有金色穗带。

e.en: He polished the {aiguillette} before the parade.
e.zh: 他在阅兵前擦亮了肩穗。

e.en: An {ailanthus} grew stubbornly in the cracked sidewalk.
e.zh: 一棵臭椿顽强地长在裂开的人行道上。

e.en: The {ailanthus} spreads quickly in disturbed soil.
e.zh: 臭椿在被扰动的土壤中迅速蔓延。

e.en: Rows of {ailanthuses} lined the abandoned lot.
e.zh: 一排排臭椿生长在废弃的空地上。

e.en: The city removed several invasive {ailanthuses}.
e.zh: 市政移除了几棵入侵性的臭椿。

e.en: As an {ailurophile}, she has rescued many strays.
e.zh: 作为一名爱猫者，她救助过许多流浪猫。

e.en: The bookshop owner is a self-proclaimed {ailurophile}.
e.zh: 书店老板自称是个爱猫者。

e.en: Her {ailurophilia} fills the house with cats.
e.zh: 她对猫的痴迷让家里满是猫。

e.en: The internet has fueled widespread {ailurophilia}.
e.zh: 互联网助长了普遍的爱猫风潮。

e.en: As an {ailurophobe}, he avoids cat cafés.
e.zh: 作为一个怕猫的人，他从不去猫咖。

e.en: The {ailurophobe} flinched when the kitten approached.
e.zh: 小猫靠近时，那个怕猫的人吓得后退。

e.en: Her {ailurophobia} makes visiting friends difficult.
e.zh: 她的猫恐惧症让她很难去朋友家做客。

e.en: Therapy helped him overcome his {ailurophobia}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他克服了对猫的恐惧。

ain't.t: 不是；没有（口语，非标准用法）

e.en: It {ain't} over till it's over.
e.zh: 不到最后没结束。

e.en: I {ain't} got time for that.
e.zh: 我没空管那个。

aint.t: 不是；没有（ain't 的无撇号写法）

e.en: That {aint} how it works.
e.zh: 事情可不是那样的。

e.en: I {aint} mad at all.
e.zh: 我一点都不生气。

air-atomic.t: 空中核打击的；空基核武的

e.en: The country expanded its {air-atomic} capabilities during the Cold War.
e.zh: 该国在冷战期间扩充了空基核打击能力。

e.en: Generals debated the role of {air-atomic} forces.
e.zh: 将军们辩论着空中核力量的作用。

e.en: Fighters took off from the {air-base} at dawn.
e.zh: 战斗机黎明时分从空军基地起飞。

e.en: The {air-base} houses thousands of personnel.
e.zh: 该空军基地驻有数千名人员。

air-based.t: 以空中为基础的；空基的

e.en: They developed an {air-based} missile defense system.
e.zh: 他们开发了一套空基导弹防御系统。

e.en: The mission relies on {air-based} reconnaissance.
e.zh: 该任务依靠空中侦察。

e.en: We slept on an {air-bed} in the living room.
e.zh: 我们睡在客厅的充气床上。

e.en: The {air-bed} slowly deflated overnight.
e.zh: 充气床一夜之间慢慢漏气了。

air-breather.t: 用空气呼吸的动物；吸气式发动机

e.en: Whales are mammals and {air-breathers}.
e.zh: 鲸鱼是哺乳动物，用空气呼吸。

e.en: The engineers tested a new {air-breather} engine.
e.zh: 工程师们测试了一台新的吸气式发动机。

e.en: She used an {air-brush} to paint the model car.
e.zh: 她用喷枪给模型车上色。

e.en: The magazine {air-brushed} every cover photo.
e.zh: 杂志对每张封面照都做了喷绘修图。

e.en: An {air-bubble} rose to the surface of the pond.
e.zh: 一个气泡升到了池塘水面。

e.en: The syringe contained a small {air-bubble}.
e.zh: 注射器里有一个小气泡。

e.en: Sci-fi novels often feature flying {air-cars}.
e.zh: 科幻小说里经常出现飞行汽车。

e.en: Engineers prototyped an {air-car} powered by compressed air.
e.zh: 工程师们试制了一辆压缩空气驱动的气动汽车。

e.en: The egg has an {air-cell} at its blunt end.
e.zh: 鸡蛋的钝端有一个气室。

e.en: Each {air-cell} in the mattress can be adjusted.
e.zh: 床垫里的每个气囊都可以单独调节。

e.en: The office installed {air-cleaning} units in every room.
e.zh: 办公室在每个房间都安装了空气净化设备。

e.en: Indoor plants offer modest {air-cleaning} benefits.
e.zh: 室内植物有一定的空气净化作用。

air-condition.t: 给…装空调；进行空调调节

e.en: They decided to {air-condition} the entire warehouse.
e.zh: 他们决定给整个仓库装上空调。

e.en: It costs a lot to {air-condition} an old house.
e.zh: 给老房子装空调要花不少钱。

air-conditioned.t: 装有空调的；有空调调节的

e.en: We took refuge in an {air-conditioned} café.
e.zh: 我们躲进了一家有空调的咖啡馆。

e.en: Every room in the hotel is {air-conditioned}.
e.zh: 酒店每个房间都装有空调。

e.en: The {air-conditioner} hummed quietly through the night.
e.zh: 空调整夜静静地嗡嗡作响。

e.en: Our {air-conditioner} broke down during the heat wave.
e.zh: 热浪期间我们的空调坏了。

e.en: She trained as an {airwoman} in the air force.
e.zh: 她在空军接受了女飞行员的训练。

e.en: The veteran {airwoman} shared her wartime stories.
e.zh: 这位资深女飞行员分享了她的战时经历。

airwomen.t: 女飞行员们；女机组人员们

e.en: Several {airwomen} were honored at the ceremony.
e.zh: 几位女飞行员在典礼上受到了表彰。

e.en: The {airwomen} flew dangerous missions during the war.
e.zh: 这些女飞行员在战争中执行了危险的任务。

e.en: His plans sound a bit {airy-fairy} to me.
e.zh: 我觉得他的计划有点不切实际。

e.en: She dismissed the proposal as {airy-fairy} nonsense.
e.zh: 她把这个提案斥为不切实际的胡言乱语。

aisle-sitter.t: 喜欢坐过道座位的人；剧评人

e.en: As an {aisle-sitter}, he always asked for the end seat.
e.zh: 作为一个喜欢坐过道的人，他总是要求要靠边的座位。

e.en: The {aisle-sitter} wrote a scathing review of the play.
e.zh: 那位剧评人为这出戏写了一篇尖锐的评论。

e.en: They rowed out to the small {ait} in the Thames.
e.zh: 他们划船到泰晤士河中的那个小洲上。

e.en: Birds nested undisturbed on the wooded {ait}.
e.zh: 鸟儿在那片林木茂盛的河洲上安然筑巢。

e.en: The butcher trimmed the {aitchbone} carefully.
e.zh: 屠夫小心地修整着那块牛臀骨。

e.en: She roasted an {aitchbone} of beef for Sunday dinner.
e.zh: 她烤了一块牛臀肉作为周日晚餐。

e.en: Small {aits} dotted the slow-moving river.
e.zh: 几个小河洲点缀着缓缓流淌的河面。

e.en: The {aits} provided shelter for nesting waterfowl.
e.zh: 这些河洲为筑巢的水禽提供了庇护。

e.en: Water shot from the fountain's {ajutage} in a fine arc.
e.zh: 水从喷泉的喷嘴中以优美的弧线射出。

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {ajutage} to change the spray pattern.
e.zh: 工程师调整喷管以改变喷洒形态。

e.en: The medication caused severe {akathisia} in some patients.
e.zh: 该药物在一些患者身上引起了严重的静坐不能。

e.en: Doctors recognized her restlessness as {akathisia}.
e.zh: 医生们将她的烦躁不安诊断为静坐不能症。

e.en: The {akee} is the national fruit of Jamaica.
e.zh: 阿开果是牙买加的国果。

e.en: She tasted ripe {akee} for the first time.
e.zh: 她第一次品尝成熟的阿开果。

aketon.t: 中世纪填料战袍；铠下衬袍

e.en: The knight wore a padded {aketon} beneath his mail.
e.zh: 骑士在锁子甲下穿着填料战袍。

e.en: Museums display surviving {aketons} from the medieval period.
e.zh: 博物馆展出从中世纪保留下来的填料战袍。

e.en: Patients with Parkinson's disease often experience {akinesia}.
e.zh: 帕金森病患者常常出现运动不能。

e.en: The neurologist documented signs of {akinesia} during the examination.
e.zh: 神经科医生在检查中记录下了不动症的体征。

alabastrine.t: 雪花石膏般的；洁白光滑的

e.en: Her {alabastrine} skin glowed in the candlelight.
e.zh: 她那雪花石膏般的肌肤在烛光下闪着光。

e.en: The statue had a smooth, {alabastrine} finish.
e.zh: 那尊雕像表面光滑如雪花石膏。

e.en: We ordered {alacarte} instead of the set menu.
e.zh: 我们没点套餐，而是单点了几道菜。

e.en: The restaurant offers an extensive {alacarte} selection.
e.zh: 这家餐厅提供丰富的单点菜式。

alack.t: 哎呀；唉（旧时表惊讶或遗憾的感叹词）

e.en: "{Alack}, the day is lost!" he cried.
e.zh: "唉，今天全完了！"他叹道。

e.en: {Alack}, our hopes were dashed once more.
e.zh: 哎呀，我们的希望又一次破灭了。

e.en: "{Alackaday}!" the old man sighed wearily.
e.zh: "唉，可叹啊！"老人疲惫地叹息道。

e.en: {Alackaday}, those golden years are gone.
e.zh: 唉，那些黄金岁月一去不返了。

e.en: She gave an {alacritous} response to the request.
e.zh: 她对这个请求作出了爽快的回应。

e.en: His {alacritous} manner impressed the new manager.
e.zh: 他那敏捷利落的作风给新经理留下了深刻印象。

e.en: I'll have apple pie {alamode}, please.
e.zh: 请给我一份加冰淇淋的苹果派。

e.en: Her dress was utterly {alamode} that season.
e.zh: 那个季节她的连衣裙极为时髦。

e.en: The sky took on an {albescent} glow before dawn.
e.zh: 黎明前天空泛起了一层微白的光晕。

e.en: Botanists noted the {albescent} hue of the new leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到新叶呈现出渐白的色调。

e.en: They photographed an {albinistic} deer in the forest.
e.zh: 他们在森林里拍到一只白化的鹿。

e.en: The {albinistic} snake had pale pink eyes.
e.zh: 这条白化的蛇长着淡粉色的眼睛。

e.en: The granite contains visible crystals of {albite}.
e.zh: 这块花岗岩中可见钠长石晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {albite} in the rock sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在岩石样本中鉴定出钠长石。

e.en: The vein shows clear {albitic} alteration.
e.zh: 这条矿脉显示出明显的钠长石化蚀变。

e.en: They studied the {albitic} composition of the rock.
e.zh: 他们研究了这块岩石的钠长石成分。

airdrome.t: 机场，旧式美式英语说法

e.en: The old {airdrome} on the edge of town has been turned into a museum.
e.zh: 镇边那座老机场已经改建成了博物馆。

e.en: Pilots gathered at the {airdrome} before dawn.
e.zh: 飞行员们在天亮前聚集到机场。

airdromes.t: 机场（复数），旧式美式英语用法

e.en: Several small {airdromes} dot the countryside.
e.zh: 乡间散布着几座小型机场。

e.en: Wartime {airdromes} were often hastily built.
e.zh: 战时的机场往往是匆忙修建起来的。

airfall.t: 火山灰空中沉降；空降沉积物

e.en: Volcanic {airfall} blanketed the village in ash.
e.zh: 火山空降灰烬覆盖了整个村庄。

e.en: Geologists studied the {airfall} deposits around the crater.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了火山口周围的空降沉积物。

e.en: We sent the parts by {airfreight} to save time.
e.zh: 我们用空运寄送零件以节省时间。

e.en: {Airfreight} costs have risen sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年的航空货运费用大幅上涨。

e.en: A massive {airfreighter} landed at the cargo terminal.
e.zh: 一架巨型货运飞机降落在货运航站楼。

e.en: The company operates a fleet of {airfreighters}.
e.zh: 这家公司运营着一支货运飞机机队。

e.en: Astronauts photographed the green {airglow} from orbit.
e.zh: 宇航员从轨道上拍下了绿色的大气辉光。

e.en: A faint {airglow} can sometimes be seen on dark nights.
e.zh: 在漆黑的夜晚有时能看到微弱的大气辉光。

airgraph.t: 二战时期的航空缩微邮件

e.en: Soldiers sent home letters via {airgraph} during the war.
e.zh: 战时士兵通过缩微航空邮件给家人写信。

e.en: The {airgraph} system saved precious cargo space.
e.zh: 缩微航空邮件系统节省了宝贵的货舱空间。

airholes.t: 通气孔；用于透气的小孔

e.en: She poked {airholes} in the lid for the insects.
e.zh: 她在盖子上戳了几个通气孔让昆虫呼吸。

e.en: Make sure the box has plenty of {airholes}.
e.zh: 一定要让盒子上有足够的通气孔。

e.en: He attached the {airhose} to the compressor.
e.zh: 他把输气软管接到压缩机上。

e.en: A leak in the {airhose} brought work to a halt.
e.zh: 输气软管漏气让工作停了下来。

e.en: The {airhostess} smiled as she handed out drinks.
e.zh: 那位空姐微笑着发放饮料。

e.en: She trained for two years to become an {airhostess}.
e.zh: 她接受了两年培训才成为一名空姐。

airiest.t: 最通风的；最轻盈的（airy 的最高级）

e.en: This is the {airiest} room in the whole house.
e.zh: 这是整间屋子里最通风的房间。

e.en: She picked the {airiest} corner of the café to sit.
e.zh: 她挑了咖啡馆里最通风的角落坐下。

airjacket.t: 充气救生衣；气垫救生衣

e.en: Each passenger received an inflatable {airjacket}.
e.zh: 每位乘客都领到了一件充气救生衣。

e.en: The diver checked his {airjacket} before descending.
e.zh: 潜水员下水前检查了自己的气囊救生衣。

airland.t: 空地一体作战的；陆空协同的

e.en: The {airland} doctrine combines air and ground forces.
e.zh: 空地一体作战理论将空中与地面部队结合起来。

e.en: Modern armies emphasize {airland} coordination.
e.zh: 现代军队重视陆空协同作战。

e.en: She folded the {airletter} carefully and posted it.
e.zh: 她仔细折好航空邮简后寄了出去。

e.en: An {airletter} arrived from her cousin abroad.
e.zh: 一封航空邮简从国外的表姐处寄来。

airlike.t: 像空气一样的；空气般的

e.en: The substance has an almost {airlike} lightness.
e.zh: 这种物质轻盈得几乎像空气一样。

e.en: Scientists discovered an {airlike} gas in the cave.
e.zh: 科学家在洞穴里发现了一种类似空气的气体。

e.en: Engineers calculated the {airload} on the wing.
e.zh: 工程师计算了机翼承受的气动负载。

e.en: Stronger materials handle higher {airload}.
e.zh: 更坚固的材料能承受更高的气流载荷。

e.en: His skilled {airmanship} saved the crippled plane.
e.zh: 他高超的飞行技术救下了那架受损的飞机。

e.en: Young pilots learn the basics of {airmanship}.
e.zh: 年轻飞行员要学习驾机的基本功。

airmobile.t: 空中机动的；空降突击的

e.en: The {airmobile} division deployed within hours.
e.zh: 这支空中机动师在几小时内便完成了部署。

e.en: {Airmobile} units rely on helicopters for transport.
e.zh: 空中机动部队依靠直升机进行运输。

airpark.t: 小型机场；私人飞机停靠场

e.en: The retired pilot built a house near the {airpark}.
e.zh: 那位退休的飞行员在小型机场旁盖了房子。

e.en: Several light planes were parked at the {airpark}.
e.zh: 几架轻型飞机停在这座小型机场。

e.en: The {airphoto} clearly showed the river's course.
e.zh: 这张航拍照片清晰地显示了河流的走向。

e.en: Surveyors used {airphotos} to map the region.
e.zh: 测绘员使用航拍照片来绘制该地区的地图。

e.en: She sent the parcel by {airpost}.
e.zh: 她通过航空邮政寄出了包裹。

e.en: {Airpost} was much faster than sea mail.
e.zh: 航空邮政比海运邮件快得多。

airproof.t: 不透气的；密封防漏气的

e.en: Store the powder in an {airproof} container.
e.zh: 把粉末存放在密封不透气的容器里。

e.en: The seals must be completely {airproof}.
e.zh: 这些密封件必须做到完全不透气。

e.en: The painter captured a stunning {airscape} above the cliffs.
e.zh: 画家描绘了悬崖上方一幅壮丽的空中景观。

e.en: Drone footage offers a fresh {airscape} of the city.
e.zh: 无人机镜头呈现出城市全新的空中景观。

e.en: The car has an {airscoop} on its hood for engine cooling.
e.zh: 这辆车的引擎盖上有一个进气口用于发动机散热。

e.en: Warm air rushed through the {airscoop}.
e.zh: 暖空气从进气口涌入。

airscrew.t: 飞机螺旋桨；空气螺旋桨

e.en: The mechanic carefully balanced the {airscrew}.
e.zh: 机械师仔细地校平了那只飞机螺旋桨。

e.en: Early planes used wooden {airscrews}.
e.zh: 早期的飞机使用木质螺旋桨。

airscrews.t: 飞机螺旋桨；空气螺旋桨（复数）

e.en: The bomber was powered by four large {airscrews}.
e.zh: 这架轰炸机由四个大型螺旋桨驱动。

e.en: {Airscrews} spun lazily in the morning breeze.
e.zh: 螺旋桨在晨风中懒洋洋地转动。

e.en: The valley forms a single {airshed} that traps pollution.
e.zh: 这个山谷形成了单一气域，容易困住污染物。

e.en: Regulators monitor the {airshed} for harmful emissions.
e.zh: 监管机构监测该气域中的有害排放。

airsheds.t: 共享气域；大气流域（复数）

e.en: Mountainous regions often contain isolated {airsheds}.
e.zh: 山区常常包含相互隔离的气域。

e.en: Different cities may share overlapping {airsheds}.
e.zh: 不同城市可能共享重叠的气域。

e.en: Cement plants use an {airslide} to move powder.
e.zh: 水泥厂使用气力输送槽来运送粉料。

e.en: The {airslide} carried fine ash to the silo.
e.zh: 气力输送槽把细灰送往储料筒仓。

e.en: The old shepherd knew every {airt} of the wind.
e.zh: 老牧人熟知风向的每一个方位。

e.en: We headed in a westerly {airt}.
e.zh: 我们朝西的方向走去。

e.en: The balloon drifted slowly {airward}.
e.zh: 气球缓缓朝天空飘升。

e.en: She turned her face {airward} to feel the breeze.
e.zh: 她仰起脸朝向天空感受微风。

e.en: He owned several {alchemistical} manuscripts from the Renaissance.
e.zh: 他拥有几本文艺复兴时期的炼金术手稿。

e.en: The lab had an almost {alchemistical} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那间实验室几乎弥漫着炼金术般的氛围。

alchemize.t: 用炼金术转化；点石成金

e.en: She seemed able to {alchemize} grief into art.
e.zh: 她似乎能把悲痛点化成艺术。

e.en: No process can truly {alchemize} lead into gold.
e.zh: 没有任何方法能真正把铅变成黄金。

e.en: Her pain was {alchemized} into a powerful novel.
e.zh: 她的痛苦被点化成一部有力的小说。

e.en: The chef {alchemized} simple vegetables into a feast.
e.zh: 厨师把普通蔬菜化成了一桌盛宴。

e.en: Time often {alchemizes} regret into wisdom.
e.zh: 时间常把悔恨化作智慧。

e.en: This director {alchemizes} ordinary stories into magic.
e.zh: 这位导演能把平凡的故事化为魔法。

e.en: She spent years {alchemizing} her trauma into music.
e.zh: 她花了多年把创伤化作音乐。

e.en: He is {alchemizing} scrap metal into sculpture.
e.zh: 他正把废金属化作雕塑。

e.en: The clinic specializes in treating {alcohol-abuse} among teenagers.
e.zh: 该诊所专门治疗青少年酗酒问题。

e.en: Years of {alcohol-abuse} damaged his liver.
e.zh: 多年酗酒损坏了他的肝脏。

e.en: They served only {alcohol-free} drinks at the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼上他们只供应无酒精饮料。

e.en: This mouthwash is {alcohol-free} and gentle.
e.zh: 这种漱口水不含酒精，性质温和。

e.en: The chemist isolated a sodium {alcoholate} from the mixture.
e.zh: 化学家从混合物中分离出钠醇盐。

e.en: This {alcoholate} reacts vigorously with water.
e.zh: 这种醇盐遇水反应剧烈。

alcoholic-beverage.t: 酒精饮料；含酒精的饮品

e.en: You must be eighteen to buy any {alcoholic-beverage} here.
e.zh: 在这里买含酒精饮料必须年满十八岁。

e.en: Wine is the most popular {alcoholic-beverage} in France.
e.zh: 葡萄酒是法国最受欢迎的酒精饮料。

alcoholically.t: 酒精地；以含酒精的方式

e.en: The dessert was {alcoholically} flavoured with rum.
e.zh: 这道甜点用朗姆酒以含酒精的方式调味。

e.en: He spoke {alcoholically}, slurring every word.
e.zh: 他醉醺醺地说话，每个字都含糊不清。

e.en: The officer used an {alcoholimeter} to test the driver.
e.zh: 警察用酒精计检测司机。

e.en: A modern {alcoholimeter} gives readings within seconds.
e.zh: 现代酒精计能在几秒内得出读数。

e.en: The recipe asks you to {alcoholise} the cherries first.
e.zh: 食谱要求先把樱桃浸入酒精。

e.en: They {alcoholise} the fruit to preserve it.
e.zh: 他们把水果浸酒以便保存。

e.en: The {alcoholization} of the tincture took several days.
e.zh: 酊剂的酒精化过程花了好几天。

e.en: Doctors warned against the {alcoholization} of society.
e.zh: 医生们警告社会酒精化的趋势。

e.en: Pharmacists {alcoholize} certain herbs to make tinctures.
e.zh: 药剂师将某些草药用酒精浸泡以制成酊剂。

e.en: Don't {alcoholize} the cake too much.
e.zh: 别给蛋糕加太多酒。

e.en: The {alcoholized} extract was stored in dark bottles.
e.zh: 酒精化的提取液被装在深色瓶中保存。

e.en: He gave us an {alcoholized} fruit cake.
e.zh: 他给我们一个浸过酒的水果蛋糕。

e.en: This factory {alcoholizes} thousands of liters of liquid daily.
e.zh: 这家工厂每天将数千升液体酒精化。

e.en: He {alcoholizes} the mixture before bottling.
e.zh: 他在装瓶前把混合液酒精化。

alcoholizing.t: 正在酒精化；正在用酒浸泡

e.en: They are {alcoholizing} the herbs for medicinal use.
e.zh: 他们正把草药酒精化以供药用。

e.en: {Alcoholizing} fruit is a traditional preservation method.
e.zh: 用酒浸泡水果是一种传统的保存方法。

e.en: He floated an {alcoholmeter} in the wine to check strength.
e.zh: 他把酒精计放入酒中测度数。

e.en: The {alcoholmeter} showed an unusually high reading.
e.zh: 酒精计显示出异常高的读数。

e.en: He studied {alcoholmetry} as part of his chemistry degree.
e.zh: 他在化学学位课程中学习酒精计量法。

e.en: Accurate {alcoholmetry} matters for tax purposes.
e.zh: 准确的酒精计量法对征税很重要。

e.en: Distillers rely on an {alcoholometer} to gauge purity.
e.zh: 蒸馏师靠酒精比重计判断纯度。

e.en: The {alcoholometer} sank deeper in weaker spirit.
e.zh: 酒精比重计在度数较低的酒中沉得更深。

alcoholometric.t: 酒精测定的；酒精比重计的

e.en: They published {alcoholometric} tables for industrial use.
e.zh: 他们发布了供工业使用的酒精测定表。

e.en: An {alcoholometric} reading is taken at standard temperature.
e.zh: 酒精测定读数需在标准温度下进行。

alcoholometrical.t: 酒精测定的；酒精浓度测量的

e.en: Old textbooks include {alcoholometrical} charts for distillers.
e.zh: 旧教科书中收录了酒精测定图表供蒸馏师使用。

e.en: He kept {alcoholometrical} records of every batch.
e.zh: 他保留每一批次的酒精测定记录。

e.en: The reaction proceeds via {alcoholysis} of the ester.
e.zh: 该反应通过酯的醇解进行。

e.en: {Alcoholysis} is widely used in biodiesel production.
e.zh: 醇解被广泛用于生物柴油的生产。

alcopop.t: 果味甜酒；预调酒精饮料

e.en: Teenagers often start drinking with sweet {alcopop} brands.
e.zh: 青少年常常从甜味的预调酒入门饮酒。

e.en: The shop has a wide selection of {alcopop}.
e.zh: 这家店有各式各样的果味甜酒。

alcyonarian.t: 软珊瑚的；软珊瑚类动物

e.en: The reef was covered with colourful {alcyonarian} corals.
e.zh: 礁石上覆盖着色彩缤纷的软珊瑚。

e.en: Divers photographed an unusual {alcyonarian} species.
e.zh: 潜水员拍下了一种罕见的软珊瑚。

e.en: {Alanine} is a non-essential amino acid found in proteins.
e.zh: 丙氨酸是蛋白质中常见的非必需氨基酸。

e.en: Bodybuilders sometimes supplement with beta-{alanine}.
e.zh: 健美爱好者有时会补充β-丙氨酸。

e.en: The peptide contained an {alanyl} residue at its core.
e.zh: 这条多肽的核心含有一个丙氨酰残基。

e.en: The enzyme cleaves the protein at the {alanyl} bond.
e.zh: 该酶在丙氨酰键处切割蛋白质。

alarm-monitoring.t: 警报监控；安保监控服务

e.en: The company offers round-the-clock {alarm-monitoring} for businesses.
e.zh: 该公司为企业提供全天候的警报监控服务。

e.en: Their {alarm-monitoring} center notifies the police within seconds.
e.zh: 他们的警报监控中心数秒内便会通知警方。

alarmable.t: 易受惊的；容易触发警报的

e.en: Wild deer are highly {alarmable} when humans approach.
e.zh: 野生鹿在人类靠近时非常容易受惊。

e.en: The sensor is {alarmable} by even tiny vibrations.
e.zh: 这种传感器即使被微小震动也会触发警报。

e.en: An {alarum} of trumpets sounded as the army approached.
e.zh: 军队逼近时，号角警报声大作。

e.en: Shakespeare's plays often call for an {alarum} offstage.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的剧作中常需要幕后的号角警报声。

e.en: The scene opened with sudden {alarums} and clashing swords.
e.zh: 这一场以突然的号角警报和兵刃交击声开始。

e.en: Critics dismissed his warnings as empty {alarums}.
e.zh: 评论家把他的警告斥为空洞的虚惊。

e.en: The insect's {alary} muscles powered its rapid flight.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的翼肌为它的快速飞行提供动力。

e.en: Anatomists examined the {alary} ligaments of the joint.
e.zh: 解剖学家检查了关节的翼状韧带。

alaskite.t: 浅色花岗岩；阿拉斯加岩

e.en: Geologists classified the outcrop as {alaskite}.
e.zh: 地质学家将这处露头归类为浅色花岗岩。

e.en: {Alaskite} typically contains quartz and feldspar with little dark mineral.
e.zh: 阿拉斯加岩通常含有石英和长石，暗色矿物极少。

e.en: Doctors initially mistook the rash for {alastrim}.
e.zh: 医生最初将这种皮疹误认为类天花。

e.en: {Alastrim} produces much milder symptoms than classic smallpox.
e.zh: 类天花的症状比经典天花要轻得多。

e.en: The {alate} forms of termites swarm after heavy rain.
e.zh: 白蚁的有翅型在大雨后大量飞出。

e.en: Botanists described the seed as {alate} along its margins.
e.zh: 植物学家描述这种种子边缘具翼。

e.en: The {alated} stem helps the plant catch more sunlight.
e.zh: 带翅的茎有助于植物获得更多阳光。

e.en: She found an {alated} insect specimen in the field.
e.zh: 她在野外发现了一只带翅的昆虫标本。

e.en: Hundreds of {alates} emerged from the termite mound at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时分，数百只有翅蚁从白蚁巢中飞出。

e.en: Biologists collected the {alates} during the swarming season.
e.zh: 生物学家在群飞季节收集这些有翅繁殖蚁。

e.en: The {alation} of the dragonfly amazed the watching children.
e.zh: 蜻蜓的翅膀让围观的孩子们惊叹不已。

e.en: Researchers compared the {alation} patterns of related species.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了近缘物种的翅形结构。

e.en: The priest put on his white {alb} before mass.
e.zh: 弥撒前，神父穿上了他的白色长袍。

e.en: She carefully ironed the {alb} hanging in the sacristy.
e.zh: 她仔细熨烫了挂在圣器室里的白色法衣。

albedometer.t: 反照率计；测反射率仪器

e.en: Scientists deployed an {albedometer} on the glacier surface.
e.zh: 科学家在冰川表面布设了一台反照率计。

e.en: The {albedometer} recorded a sharp drop in surface reflectivity.
e.zh: 反照率计记录到地表反射率的急剧下降。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {aleukemia} after blood tests.
e.zh: 血液检查后病人被诊断为非白血性白血病。

e.en: {Aleukemia} can be harder to detect in routine screening.
e.zh: 非白血性白血病在常规筛查中较难发现。

e.en: The {aleurone} layer is rich in protein and minerals.
e.zh: 糊粉层富含蛋白质和矿物质。

e.en: Wheat bran contains the {aleurone} of the grain.
e.zh: 麦麸含有谷粒的糊粉层。

e.en: The seed has a thin {aleuronic} layer beneath the husk.
e.zh: 种子壳下方有一层薄薄的糊粉层。

e.en: Botanists studied the {aleuronic} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下研究糊粉细胞。

e.en: The {alevin} still carries its yolk sac under the gravel.
e.zh: 幼鲑仍带着卵黄囊藏在砾石下。

e.en: Hatchery workers counted each tiny {alevin} carefully.
e.zh: 孵化场工人小心地清点每条小鱼苗。

e.en: Schools of {alewives} migrated up the river each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天成群的灰西鲱沿河洄游。

e.en: Local gulls feast on the spawning {alewives}.
e.zh: 当地海鸥饱食产卵的灰西鲱。
