e.en: {Alexanders} grow wild along the coastal cliffs.
e.zh: 亚历山大草在沿海悬崖野生生长。

e.en: She added young {alexanders} stems to the salad.
e.zh: 她把嫩马芹茎加进沙拉里。

e.en: Her ring features a rare {alexandrite} that changes color.
e.zh: 她的戒指镶有一颗会变色的稀有变石。

e.en: {Alexandrite} appears green in daylight and red under lamps.
e.zh: 变石在日光下呈绿色，在灯光下呈红色。

e.en: After the stroke he developed {alexia} and could not read.
e.zh: 中风后他患上失读症，无法阅读。

e.en: {Alexia} is often studied alongside other language disorders.
e.zh: 失读症常与其他语言障碍一起研究。

e.en: Early immunologists called complement {alexin}.
e.zh: 早期免疫学家把补体称为防御素。

e.en: The term {alexin} appears in older medical textbooks.
e.zh: 防御素一词出现在较旧的医学教科书中。

e.en: The herbalist prescribed an {alexipharmic} brew for the bite.
e.zh: 草药师为咬伤开了一剂解毒汤。

e.en: Ancient texts list many {alexipharmic} plants.
e.zh: 古籍列举了许多解毒植物。

alexithymia.t: 述情障碍；情感表达不能

e.en: People with {alexithymia} struggle to name their feelings.
e.zh: 述情障碍患者难以说出自己的情感。

e.en: Therapy helped him work through his {alexithymia}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助他逐步克服述情障碍。

e.en: She brewed a tea from dried {alfalfa-leaf}.
e.zh: 她用干苜蓿叶泡了一壶茶。

e.en: {Alfalfa-leaf} powder is sold as a nutritional supplement.
e.zh: 苜蓿叶粉作为营养补充剂出售。

e.en: Cattle grazed on the dry {alfilaria} along the hillside.
e.zh: 牛群在山坡上啃食干枯的针叶草。

e.en: {Alfilaria} thrives in arid Western rangelands.
e.zh: 针叶草在西部干旱牧场生长茂盛。

e.en: Spring rains bring up green carpets of {alfileria}.
e.zh: 春雨过后针叶草铺成绿毯。

e.en: Sheep fattened quickly on the early {alfileria}.
e.zh: 羊群靠早春的针叶草迅速长肥。

e.en: We had an {alfresco} dinner in the garden.
e.zh: 我们在花园里享用了一顿露天晚餐。

e.en: The café offers {alfresco} seating in summer.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆夏天提供户外座位。

e.en: He added {algaecide} to clear the pond.
e.zh: 他往池塘里加了杀藻剂以净化水质。

e.en: The pool needs {algaecide} every two weeks.
e.zh: 这个泳池每两周需要投放一次除藻剂。

e.en: She solved the {algebraical} equation easily.
e.zh: 她轻松地解出了那道代数方程。

e.en: He prefers {algebraical} methods to geometric ones.
e.zh: 比起几何方法，他更喜欢代数方法。

algebraist.t: 代数学家；研究代数的人

e.en: The {algebraist} published a new theorem.
e.zh: 这位代数学家发表了一条新定理。

e.en: As an {algebraist}, she studies abstract structures.
e.zh: 作为一名代数学家，她研究抽象结构。

algebraization.t: 代数化；用代数表示的过程

e.en: The {algebraization} of geometry transformed mathematics.
e.zh: 几何的代数化彻底改变了数学。

e.en: He proposed an {algebraization} of the logical system.
e.zh: 他提出了对该逻辑系统的代数化方法。

algebraize.t: 使代数化；用代数方式表达

e.en: We can {algebraize} this geometric problem.
e.zh: 我们可以将这个几何问题代数化。

e.en: The professor showed how to {algebraize} the equations.
e.zh: 教授展示了如何将这些方程代数化。

e.en: The young {algebrist} won a major prize.
e.zh: 这位年轻的代数学家获得了一项大奖。

e.en: Every {algebrist} should know this identity.
e.zh: 每个代数学家都应该知道这个恒等式。

e.en: The patient showed increased {algesia} after surgery.
e.zh: 患者术后表现出痛觉增强。

e.en: Doctors test {algesia} to assess nerve function.
e.zh: 医生通过测试痛觉来评估神经功能。

e.en: The neurologist used an {algesimeter} on the patient.
e.zh: 神经科医生用测痛仪检查了病人。

e.en: An {algesimeter} measures sensitivity to pain.
e.zh: 测痛仪用于测量对疼痛的敏感度。

e.en: The drug reduces {algetic} responses in patients.
e.zh: 该药物可减轻患者的疼痛反应。

e.en: She studied {algetic} stimuli in the lab.
e.zh: 她在实验室研究致痛刺激。

algicidal.t: 杀藻的；具有杀藻作用的

e.en: The compound has strong {algicidal} properties.
e.zh: 这种化合物具有很强的杀藻特性。

e.en: They tested an {algicidal} treatment for the lake.
e.zh: 他们测试了一种用于该湖的杀藻处理方法。

e.en: The farmer applied {algicide} to the irrigation pond.
e.zh: 农民向灌溉池塘施用了杀藻剂。

e.en: This {algicide} is safe for fish.
e.zh: 这种杀藻剂对鱼类无害。

e.en: The patient entered an {algid} phase of the illness.
e.zh: 病人进入了该疾病的发冷期。

e.en: His skin felt {algid} to the touch.
e.zh: 他的皮肤摸上去冰冷。

e.en: The doctor noted the patient's {algidity}.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人的体寒症状。

e.en: {Algidity} can indicate circulatory shock.
e.zh: 体温过低可能预示着循环性休克。

e.en: The {algidness} of his hands worried the nurse.
e.zh: 他双手的冰冷让护士感到担忧。

e.en: She shivered from the sudden {algidness}.
e.zh: 她因突如其来的寒意而颤抖。

e.en: {Algin} is used as a thickener in foods.
e.zh: 褐藻胶被用作食品中的增稠剂。

e.en: She extracted {algin} from brown seaweed.
e.zh: 她从褐藻中提取了海藻酸。

e.en: {Alginates} are widely used in dental impressions.
e.zh: 海藻酸盐被广泛用于牙科取模。

e.en: The lab studies the properties of {alginates}.
e.zh: 该实验室研究海藻酸盐的特性。

alginic.t: 海藻酸的；与藻酸有关的

e.en: {Alginic} acid comes from brown algae.
e.zh: 海藻酸来自褐藻。

e.en: They isolated {alginic} compounds from seaweed.
e.zh: 他们从海藻中分离出藻酸类化合物。

e.en: Various {algins} serve as food stabilizers.
e.zh: 各种褐藻胶可用作食品稳定剂。

e.en: The factory produces {algins} for industrial use.
e.zh: 该工厂生产工业用海藻胶。

e.en: An {alderfly} hovered just above the stream.
e.zh: 一只鱼蛉在溪流上方盘旋。

e.en: Anglers often imitate the {alderfly} when tying flies.
e.zh: 垂钓者绑制鱼饵时常模仿鱼蛉。

aldermancy.t: 市议员的职务；议员任职

e.en: He pursued {aldermancy} late in his career.
e.zh: 他在职业生涯后期投身市议员之职。

e.en: Her family had a long history of {aldermancy}.
e.zh: 她家族长期世代担任市议员。

e.en: He spoke with {aldermanic} gravity.
e.zh: 他以市议员般的庄重语气讲话。

e.en: The {aldermanic} robes hung in the closet.
e.zh: 市议员的长袍挂在衣橱里。

e.en: The boundaries of his {aldermanry} were redrawn.
e.zh: 他所辖的市议员区界被重新划定。

e.en: Each {aldermanry} elects its own representative.
e.zh: 每个市议员区选出自己的代表。

e.en: He held his {aldermanship} for two decades.
e.zh: 他担任市议员一职长达二十年。

e.en: She resigned her {aldermanship} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻爆发后她辞去市议员职务。

e.en: Each {alderperson} represents a single ward.
e.zh: 每位市议员代表一个选区。

e.en: She was elected {alderperson} last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天当选市议员。

e.en: The new {alderwoman} pledged to fight corruption.
e.zh: 新任女市议员承诺打击腐败。

e.en: Our {alderwoman} held a town hall last night.
e.zh: 我们这位女市议员昨晚召开了市民议政会。

e.en: The {aldol} condensation is a classic organic reaction.
e.zh: 羟醛缩合是经典的有机反应。

e.en: They isolated the {aldol} product after workup.
e.zh: 后处理之后他们分离出了醛醇产物。

e.en: {Aldolase} catalyzes a key step in glycolysis.
e.zh: 醛缩酶催化糖酵解中的关键一步。

e.en: Elevated {aldolase} levels can indicate muscle damage.
e.zh: 醛缩酶水平升高可能提示肌肉损伤。

e.en: Glucose is the most abundant {aldose} in nature.
e.zh: 葡萄糖是自然界含量最丰富的醛糖。

e.en: An {aldose} contains an aldehyde group.
e.zh: 醛糖含有一个醛基。

e.en: {Aldosterone} regulates sodium and potassium balance.
e.zh: 醛固酮调节钠和钾的平衡。

e.en: The adrenal gland secretes {aldosterone}.
e.zh: 肾上腺会分泌醛固酮。

e.en: They warmed themselves at the village {ale-house}.
e.zh: 他们在村里的麦酒馆里取暖。

e.en: The old {ale-house} dated back to the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 那家古老的小酒馆可追溯至十七世纪。

e.en: The old boat sprang {aleak} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中那艘旧船开始漏水。

e.en: He found the roof {aleak} after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后他发现屋顶在渗水。

aleatoric.t: 偶然的；不确定性的（音乐）

e.en: The composer wrote an {aleatoric} piece for piano.
e.zh: 作曲家为钢琴写了一首偶然音乐作品。

e.en: Modern art sometimes embraces {aleatoric} processes.
e.zh: 现代艺术有时采用偶然性的创作过程。

e.en: His later works leaned heavily on {aleatorism}.
e.zh: 他后期的作品大量运用偶然主义。

e.en: Critics dismissed the show as mere {aleatorism}.
e.zh: 评论家将这场演出贬为单纯的偶然主义。

e.en: The town's {aleconner} fined the brewer for selling sour ale.
e.zh: 镇上的啤酒检验员对售卖酸啤酒的酿酒师处以罚款。

e.en: In medieval England, every borough had an {aleconner}.
e.zh: 中世纪英格兰每个自治市都设有啤酒检验员。

e.en: She grew {alecost} in her herb garden.
e.zh: 她在自家香草园里种植香艾菊。

e.en: The leaves of {alecost} were once used to flavor ale.
e.zh: 香艾菊的叶子从前被用来给麦芽酒调味。

e.en: Ancient priests practiced {alectryomancy} to predict the future.
e.zh: 古代祭司用雄鸡占卜术预测未来。

e.en: The book described {alectryomancy} in surprising detail.
e.zh: 书中出人意料地详细描述了雄鸡占卜术。

e.en: The boat heeled as the wind drove it {alee}.
e.zh: 风把船吹向背风一侧，船随之倾斜。

e.en: He kept the dinghy {alee} of the larger vessel.
e.zh: 他让小艇始终待在大船的下风处。

alegar.t: 麦芽醋；由发酸啤酒制成的醋

e.en: He poured a splash of {alegar} into the stew.
e.zh: 他往炖菜里倒了一点麦芽醋。

e.en: In old recipes, {alegar} often replaced wine vinegar.
e.zh: 在古旧食谱中，麦芽醋常常取代葡萄酒醋。

alembic.t: 蒸馏器；（喻）提炼或转化之物

e.en: The alchemist heated water in his {alembic}.
e.zh: 炼金术士在蒸馏器里加热清水。

e.en: Memory is an {alembic} that transforms raw experience.
e.zh: 记忆是一座蒸馏器，把原始经验提炼转化。

alembicated.t: 过分雕琢的；矫揉造作的

e.en: His prose was {alembicated} and hard to read.
e.zh: 他的文风过分雕琢，读来费力。

e.en: Critics dismissed the speech as {alembicated} nonsense.
e.zh: 评论家认为那篇演讲矫揉造作，毫无意义。

e.en: The {alembication} of his ideas drained them of force.
e.zh: 他对思想的过度提炼反而使其失去了力量。

e.en: Long {alembication} produced only a few drops of essence.
e.zh: 长时间的蒸馏只得到几滴精华。

aleph-null.t: 阿列夫零（最小的无穷基数）

e.en: The set of natural numbers has cardinality {aleph-null}.
e.zh: 自然数集的基数是阿列夫零。

e.en: Cantor proved that {aleph-null} is the smallest infinity.
e.zh: 康托尔证明阿列夫零是最小的无穷。

e.en: Mathematicians sometimes write {aleph-zero} instead of aleph-null.
e.zh: 数学家有时写作阿列夫零，而不写 aleph-null。

e.en: All countable sets have size {aleph-zero}.
e.zh: 所有可数集合的大小都是阿列夫零。

alephnull.t: 阿列夫零（最小的无穷基数，连写形式）

e.en: Some textbooks use {alephnull} as a single token.
e.zh: 有些教材把阿列夫零写成一个连写词。

e.en: The cardinality of the integers is {alephnull}.
e.zh: 整数集的基数是阿列夫零。

aletheia.t: 真理；去蔽（希腊哲学概念）

e.en: Heidegger wrote at length about {aletheia} as unconcealment.
e.zh: 海德格尔大量论述将真理理解为去蔽。

e.en: Greek philosophers contrasted {aletheia} with mere opinion.
e.zh: 古希腊哲学家将真理与单纯的意见相对照。

aletophyte.t: 路旁植物；适应人为扰动生境的植物

e.en: Dandelions are a classic {aletophyte}, thriving along roadsides.
e.zh: 蒲公英是典型的路旁植物，在路边茂盛生长。

e.en: Botanists study how an {aletophyte} adapts to human disturbance.
e.zh: 植物学家研究路旁植物如何适应人类干扰。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {aleucocytosis}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为白细胞缺乏症。

e.en: Severe {aleucocytosis} leaves the body open to infection.
e.zh: 严重的白细胞缺乏症会使身体极易受到感染。

aleukaemia.t: 非白血性白血病；血液白细胞不增高型白血病

e.en: Doctors describe the rare condition as {aleukaemia}.
e.zh: 医生把这种罕见情况称为非白血性白血病。

e.en: In {aleukaemia}, leukemic cells stay in the marrow rather than the blood.
e.zh: 在非白血性白血病中，白血病细胞滞留于骨髓，而非血液。

albs.t: 白色法衣；神职人员所穿的白长袍

e.en: The priests donned their {albs} before the procession.
e.zh: 神父们在游行前穿上了白色法衣。

e.en: Several {albs} hung in the sacristy closet.
e.zh: 圣器收藏室的衣柜里挂着几件白色法衣。

albugineous.t: 白色的；类似白膜的；白翳的

e.en: The {albugineous} layer surrounds the testis.
e.zh: 白膜层包绕着睾丸。

e.en: Anatomists noted the {albugineous} tissue beneath the skin.
e.zh: 解剖学家注意到皮下的白色膜状组织。

albumate.t: 蛋白盐；白蛋白与金属形成的化合物

e.en: The chemist isolated an iron {albumate} from the solution.
e.zh: 化学家从溶液中分离出一种铁蛋白盐。

e.en: Old textbooks describe various metal {albumate} compounds.
e.zh: 旧教科书描述了多种金属蛋白盐化合物。

e.en: Beat the {albumen} until stiff peaks form.
e.zh: 把蛋白打发至硬性发泡。

e.en: The recipe calls for the {albumen} of three eggs.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要三个鸡蛋的蛋清。

e.en: Photographers used to {albumenize} paper for printing.
e.zh: 摄影师过去会在相纸上涂蛋白用于冲印。

e.en: The technique requires you to {albumenize} the surface first.
e.zh: 这项技术要求先在表面涂上一层蛋白。

albumenized.t: 涂以蛋白的；用蛋白处理过的

e.en: He developed prints on {albumenized} paper.
e.zh: 他在涂蛋白的相纸上冲印照片。

e.en: The {albumenized} sheets dried overnight.
e.zh: 涂过蛋白的纸张晾了一整夜。

albumenizing.t: 正在涂蛋白；进行蛋白涂覆

e.en: The technician was {albumenizing} the slides for the experiment.
e.zh: 技师正在为实验给玻片涂蛋白。

e.en: Workers spent hours {albumenizing} photographic paper.
e.zh: 工人们花了好几小时给相纸涂蛋白。

albuminate.t: 金属与白蛋白形成的化合物

e.en: Iron {albuminate} was once used as a supplement.
e.zh: 白蛋白铁化合物曾被用作营养补品。

e.en: The pharmacist prepared a silver {albuminate} solution.
e.zh: 药剂师配制了一种银白蛋白溶液。

albuminoid.t: 类蛋白；类似蛋白质的物质

e.en: Keratin is classified as an {albuminoid}.
e.zh: 角蛋白被归类为类蛋白质。

e.en: The cell wall contains an {albuminoid} substance.
e.zh: 细胞壁中含有一种类蛋白物质。

e.en: The tissue showed {albuminoidal} characteristics under analysis.
e.zh: 该组织在分析下显示出类蛋白特征。

e.en: Researchers studied the {albuminoidal} component of horn.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了牛角的类蛋白成分。

albuminolysis.t: 白蛋白分解作用；蛋白裂解

e.en: {Albuminolysis} occurs during certain digestive processes.
e.zh: 白蛋白分解发生在某些消化过程中。

e.en: The enzyme catalyzes {albuminolysis} in the intestine.
e.zh: 这种酶在肠道中催化白蛋白的分解。

albuminose.t: 白蛋白胨；蛋白胨样物质

e.en: The reaction produced {albuminose} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 反应产生了白蛋白胨作为中间产物。

e.en: Old chemistry texts mention {albuminose} formation during digestion.
e.zh: 旧化学教科书提到消化过程中白蛋白胨的形成。

e.en: She avoids {albuminous} foods due to her allergy.
e.zh: 由于过敏，她避免食用含蛋白质的食物。

e.en: The seed has an {albuminous} endosperm.
e.zh: 这种种子有富含蛋白的胚乳。

albuminuria.t: 蛋白尿；尿中含白蛋白的症状

e.en: The test revealed mild {albuminuria}.
e.zh: 检验显示出轻度蛋白尿。

e.en: {Albuminuria} can indicate kidney problems.
e.zh: 蛋白尿可能提示肾脏出现问题。

e.en: Doctors once used an {albumoscope} to test urine.
e.zh: 医生过去用蛋白镜来检测尿液。

e.en: The {albumoscope} has been replaced by modern lab tests.
e.zh: 蛋白镜已被现代实验室检测取代。

albumose.t: 白蛋白胨；蛋白消化的中间产物

e.en: Pepsin breaks proteins into {albumose} fragments.
e.zh: 胃蛋白酶将蛋白质分解为白蛋白胨片段。

e.en: The chemist identified {albumose} in the digestive sample.
e.zh: 化学家在消化样本中鉴定出白蛋白胨。

e.en: Researchers proposed that {albumosease} cleaves albumose into peptones.
e.zh: 研究人员提出该酶将白蛋白胨分解为蛋白胨。

e.en: The activity of {albumosease} was studied in early biochemistry.
e.zh: 早期生物化学研究了该酶的活性。

e.en: The tree shows {alburnous} layers near the bark.
e.zh: 这棵树靠近树皮处有边材层。

e.en: Carpenters often discard the {alburnous} portion of the log.
e.zh: 木匠常常丢弃原木的边材部分。

alburnum.t: 边材；树干外层的白木质

e.en: The {alburnum} is softer than the heartwood.
e.zh: 边材比心材更柔软。

e.en: Insects often attack the {alburnum} first.
e.zh: 昆虫常常首先侵袭边材。

alcahest.t: 炼金术中传说的万能溶剂

e.en: Paracelsus claimed the {alcahest} could dissolve any substance.
e.zh: 帕拉塞尔苏斯声称万能溶剂可以溶解任何物质。

e.en: Alchemists searched for the legendary {alcahest}.
e.zh: 炼金术士们寻找着传说中的万能溶剂。

e.en: The {alcaide} surrendered the citadel after a long siege.
e.zh: 在长期围攻后，要塞司令交出了城堡。

e.en: Records mention an {alcaide} appointed by the king.
e.zh: 史料提到一位由国王任命的城堡总督。

alcanna.t: 散沫花；指甲花（染料植物）

e.en: Travelers brought {alcanna} dye from the East.
e.zh: 旅行者从东方带来了散沫花染料。

e.en: The roots of {alcanna} produce a red pigment.
e.zh: 散沫花的根能产生一种红色色素。

alcapton.t: 尿黑酸；引发尿黑酸症的物质

e.en: {Alcapton} accumulates in patients with the genetic disorder.
e.zh: 这种遗传病患者体内会积累尿黑酸。

e.en: Doctors detected {alcapton} in the urine sample.
e.zh: 医生在尿样中检测到了尿黑酸。

e.en: Bunsen studied {alcarsin} in the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 本生在十九世纪研究过二甲胂氧。

e.en: {Alcarsin} has a notoriously unpleasant odor.
e.zh: 二甲胂氧有一种臭名昭著的难闻气味。

alcatras.t: 鹈鹕；信天翁的古旧称呼

e.en: Old sailors spoke of the {alcatras} circling overhead.
e.zh: 老水手们谈论着头顶盘旋的鹈鹕。

e.en: The {alcatras} appears in early travel narratives.
e.zh: 这一古称出现在早期的游记之中。

alcayde.t: 城堡总督；要塞长官（旧拼法）

e.en: The {alcayde} of the castle welcomed the envoy.
e.zh: 城堡的总督热情地接待了使者。

e.en: An {alcayde} commanded each Moorish stronghold.
e.zh: 每座摩尔人要塞都由一位长官指挥。

alcazar.t: 西班牙王宫；摩尔式城堡

e.en: We toured the {alcazar} in Seville.
e.zh: 我们参观了塞维利亚的王宫城堡。

e.en: The {alcazar} dominates the old quarter of the city.
e.zh: 这座王宫城堡俯瞰着城市的老城区。

e.en: He performed strange {alchemic} experiments in the cellar.
e.zh: 他在地窖里进行奇怪的炼金术实验。

e.en: Medieval texts describe many {alchemic} formulas.
e.zh: 中世纪文献记载了许多炼金术配方。

alchemise.t: 用炼金术变化；点化转化

e.en: She seemed to {alchemise} ordinary words into poetry.
e.zh: 她仿佛能将普通的词语点化成诗歌。

e.en: The director hoped to {alchemise} the script into a hit film.
e.zh: 导演希望把剧本点化成一部卖座电影。

alchemistic.t: 炼金术士的；炼金术风格的

e.en: His writings have an {alchemistic} flavor.
e.zh: 他的著作带有炼金术的味道。

e.en: The room was filled with {alchemistic} apparatus.
e.zh: 房间里摆满了炼金术士的器具。

e.en: The {alienee} took possession of the land.
e.zh: 受让人取得了该地块。

e.en: As the {alienee}, she assumed all rights to the property.
e.zh: 作为受让人，她获得了该财产的全部权利。

alienism.t: 精神病学旧称；外侨身份

e.en: He studied {alienism} in nineteenth-century Paris.
e.zh: 他在十九世纪的巴黎研究精神病学。

e.en: The doctor was a respected expert in {alienism}.
e.zh: 这位医生是当时备受尊敬的精神病学专家。

e.en: The {alienor} signed the deed of transfer.
e.zh: 转让人签署了转让契据。

e.en: As {alienor}, he relinquished all claims.
e.zh: 作为转让人，他放弃了所有权利主张。

e.en: The leaf had an {aliform} shape.
e.zh: 那片叶子呈翼状形态。

e.en: Anatomists noted the {aliform} process on the bone.
e.zh: 解剖学家注意到骨头上的翼状突起。

e.en: The bird's {alightment} on the branch was graceful.
e.zh: 那只鸟优雅地落在了树枝上。

e.en: Passengers awaited the {alightment} of the helicopter.
e.zh: 乘客们等待着直升机降落。

e.en: She wears clear {aligners} to straighten her teeth.
e.zh: 她戴着透明牙套来矫正牙齿。

e.en: The dentist fitted new {aligners} last week.
e.zh: 牙医上周为她装配了新的矫正器。

e.en: Bread was their main {aliment} during the journey.
e.zh: 旅途中面包是他们的主要食物。

e.en: The court ordered him to pay {aliment} to his children.
e.zh: 法庭判令他向子女支付赡养费。

e.en: Milk has great {alimental} value for infants.
e.zh: 牛奶对婴儿具有很高的营养价值。

e.en: The diet lacked {alimental} substance.
e.zh: 这种饮食缺乏营养物质。

e.en: The food was {alimentally} sufficient for soldiers.
e.zh: 这种食物在营养上足够士兵食用。

e.en: Fruits contribute {alimentally} to growth.
e.zh: 水果在营养方面有助于生长。

e.en: Proper {alimentation} is essential for recovery.
e.zh: 适当的营养摄取对康复至关重要。

e.en: The hospital monitored the patient's {alimentation}.
e.zh: 医院监测病人的营养摄入。

e.en: Soup is highly {alimentative} for the sick.
e.zh: 汤对病人非常有营养。

e.en: He recommended {alimentative} herbs for digestion.
e.zh: 他推荐使用助消化的草药。

e.en: The orphans were {alimented} by the church.
e.zh: 这些孤儿由教会供养。

e.en: Plants {alimented} by rich soil grew rapidly.
e.zh: 由肥沃土壤滋养的植物长得很快。

e.en: He served as the family's chief {alimenter}.
e.zh: 他是这个家庭的主要供养者。

e.en: Rivers act as natural {alimenter} of the valley.
e.zh: 河流是山谷天然的滋养者。

e.en: He is responsible for {alimenting} his elderly parents.
e.zh: 他负责赡养年迈的父母。

e.en: The river is {alimenting} the surrounding farmland.
e.zh: 这条河滋养着周围的农田。

e.en: They survived on simple {aliments} from the land.
e.zh: 他们靠土地上简单的食物维生。

e.en: The doctor prescribed nourishing {aliments}.
e.zh: 医生开了滋养身体的食物。

e.en: The wheels need proper {alinement}.
e.zh: 车轮需要适当对准。

e.en: Their political {alinement} surprised observers.
e.zh: 他们的政治结盟令观察人士惊讶。

alingual.t: 无语言能力的；不会说话的

e.en: The patient remained {alingual} after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后这位病人失去了语言能力。

e.en: Some infants are temporarily {alingual}.
e.zh: 有些婴儿暂时不会说话。

e.en: Bats are {aliped} mammals capable of true flight.
e.zh: 蝙蝠是能真正飞行的翼足哺乳动物。

e.en: The {aliped} species fascinated zoologists.
e.zh: 这种翼足物种令动物学家着迷。

e.en: Methane is the simplest {aliphatic} compound.
e.zh: 甲烷是最简单的脂肪族化合物。

e.en: Chemists studied the {aliphatic} hydrocarbons.
e.zh: 化学家研究了这些脂肪族碳氢化合物。

e.en: The lab analyzed several {aliphatics} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室分析了样品中的几种脂肪族化合物。

e.en: Petroleum contains many {aliphatics}.
e.zh: 石油中含有许多脂肪族化合物。

e.en: Five is an {aliquant} part of seven.
e.zh: 五是七的非约数部分。

e.en: Mathematicians distinguish aliquot from {aliquant} divisors.
e.zh: 数学家区分约数和非约数。

e.en: Metallurgists used {aliquation} to separate the metals.
e.zh: 冶金学家使用熔析法来分离金属。

e.en: Lead can be purified by {aliquation}.
e.zh: 铅可以通过熔析法提纯。

e.en: The {alisphenoidal} bone forms part of the skull.
e.zh: 蝶骨大翼构成颅骨的一部分。

e.en: He examined the {alisphenoidal} region carefully.
e.zh: 他仔细检查了蝶骨大翼区域。

e.en: The butterfly {alit} on a yellow flower.
e.zh: 蝴蝶落在了一朵黄花上。

e.en: She {alit} from the carriage gracefully.
e.zh: 她优雅地从马车上下来。

aliteracy.t: 有读写能力却不愿阅读的现象

e.en: Educators worry about rising {aliteracy} among teens.
e.zh: 教育者担心青少年中日益严重的不愿阅读现象。

e.en: {Aliteracy} differs from illiteracy in important ways.
e.zh: 不愿阅读与文盲有重要区别。

e.en: The patient developed {alkalosis} after prolonged vomiting.
e.zh: 病人长期呕吐后出现碱中毒。

e.en: Hyperventilation can cause respiratory {alkalosis}.
e.zh: 过度换气可能导致呼吸性碱中毒。

e.en: Methane is the simplest {alkane}.
e.zh: 甲烷是最简单的烷烃。

e.en: Crude oil contains many different {alkanes}.
e.zh: 原油中含有多种不同的烷烃。

alkanet.t: 紫朱草；染色用红根植物

e.en: They used {alkanet} root to dye the fabric red.
e.zh: 他们用紫朱草根把布料染成红色。

e.en: The dye comes from the {alkanet} plant.
e.zh: 这种染料来自紫朱草。

alkene.t: 烯烃；含双键碳氢化合物

e.en: Ethylene is the simplest {alkene}.
e.zh: 乙烯是最简单的烯烃。

e.en: The {alkene} reacts readily with bromine.
e.zh: 该烯烃容易与溴反应。

alkoxy.t: 烷氧基的；含烷氧基团的

e.en: The molecule contains an {alkoxy} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个烷氧基。

e.en: They studied the {alkoxy} substituent's effect.
e.zh: 他们研究了烷氧基取代基的作用。

e.en: He turned into an {alky} after losing his job.
e.zh: 失业后他变成了一个酒鬼。

e.en: The old {alky} hung around the bar all day.
e.zh: 那个老酒鬼整天泡在酒吧里。

e.en: Chemists can {alkylate} the benzene ring.
e.zh: 化学家可以使苯环烷基化。

e.en: They tried to {alkylate} the compound selectively.
e.zh: 他们试图选择性地对该化合物进行烷基化。

alkylated.t: 烷基化的；经烷基化处理的

e.en: The {alkylated} product was purified by distillation.
e.zh: 烷基化产物经蒸馏纯化。

e.en: They analyzed the {alkylated} DNA strands.
e.zh: 他们分析了烷基化的DNA链。

alkylating.t: 烷基化的；进行烷基化的

e.en: Chemotherapy often uses {alkylating} agents.
e.zh: 化疗常使用烷基化药物。

e.en: The {alkylating} reaction proceeded slowly.
e.zh: 烷基化反应进行得很慢。

alkylation.t: 烷基化反应；烷基化作用

e.en: {Alkylation} is a key step in petroleum refining.
e.zh: 烷基化是炼油的关键步骤。

e.en: DNA {alkylation} can damage genes.
e.zh: DNA烷基化可能损伤基因。

alkyne.t: 炔烃；含三键碳氢化合物

e.en: Acetylene is the simplest {alkyne}.
e.zh: 乙炔是最简单的炔烃。

e.en: The {alkyne} underwent a hydrogenation reaction.
e.zh: 该炔烃发生了加氢反应。

all-action.t: 动作十足的；充满动作场面的

e.en: It's an {all-action} thriller from start to finish.
e.zh: 这是一部从头到尾动作十足的惊悚片。

e.en: He's known as an {all-action} midfielder.
e.zh: 他以拼抢全能的中场球员著称。

all-american.t: 典型美国式的；全美最佳的

e.en: He looked like an {all-american} boy next door.
e.zh: 他看起来像个典型的美国邻家男孩。

e.en: She made the {all-american} college team.
e.zh: 她入选了全美大学最佳阵容。

algo.t: 算法（口语缩写）；算法交易策略

e.en: Many hedge funds rely on {algo} trading strategies.
e.zh: 许多对冲基金依赖算法交易策略。

e.en: She wrote a quick {algo} to sort the data.
e.zh: 她写了一个快速排序数据的算法。

e.en: The pond contained a strange {algoid} growth.
e.zh: 池塘里长着一种奇怪的藻状物。

e.en: Scientists examined the {algoid} structure under the microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下检查了这种藻状结构。

algolagnia.t: 痛感性欲；性受虐快感倾向

e.en: The textbook briefly discussed cases of {algolagnia}.
e.zh: 教科书简单讨论了痛感性欲的案例。

e.en: Psychologists once studied {algolagnia} as a paraphilia.
e.zh: 心理学家曾把痛感性欲作为一种性偏好研究。

algolagniac.t: 痛感性欲者；性受虐倾向者

e.en: The novel portrayed him as an {algolagniac}.
e.zh: 小说把他描绘成一个痛感性欲者。

e.en: The therapist worked carefully with the {algolagniac}.
e.zh: 治疗师谨慎地与这位痛感性欲者合作。

algolagnic.t: 痛感性欲的；与性受虐有关的

e.en: Doctors noted clear {algolagnic} tendencies in the patient.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人明显的痛感性欲倾向。

e.en: The film explored {algolagnic} themes with restraint.
e.zh: 这部电影克制地探讨了痛感性欲主题。

algological.t: 藻类学的；藻类研究相关的

e.en: She presented an {algological} paper at the conference.
e.zh: 她在会议上发表了一篇藻类学论文。

e.en: The institute focuses on {algological} research methods.
e.zh: 该研究所专注于藻类学研究方法。

algologist.t: 藻类学家；研究海藻的人

e.en: The {algologist} collected samples from the coastal reef.
e.zh: 藻类学家从沿岸礁石采集了样本。

e.en: A famous {algologist} identified the new species.
e.zh: 一位著名的藻类学家鉴定了这个新物种。

algology.t: 藻类学；研究海藻的学科

e.en: She specializes in marine {algology} at the institute.
e.zh: 她在研究所专攻海洋藻类学。

e.en: The university now offers a course in {algology}.
e.zh: 这所大学如今开设了藻类学课程。

algometer.t: 测痛仪；痛觉敏感度测量器

e.en: The doctor pressed the {algometer} against her arm.
e.zh: 医生把测痛仪按在她的手臂上。

e.en: Researchers calibrated the {algometer} before each test.
e.zh: 研究人员每次测试前都校准测痛仪。

e.en: They recorded {algometric} readings every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 他们每隔十五分钟记录一次测痛数据。

e.en: The study relied on {algometric} data for analysis.
e.zh: 该研究依靠测痛数据进行分析。

algometrical.t: 测痛的；痛觉测量相关的

e.en: The {algometrical} method proved surprisingly reliable.
e.zh: 这种测痛方法证明出乎意料地可靠。

e.en: Her thesis included extensive {algometrical} measurements.
e.zh: 她的论文包含大量痛觉测量数据。

e.en: Modern {algometry} greatly aids in pain assessment.
e.zh: 现代测痛学极大地辅助了疼痛评估。

e.en: She studied {algometry} during her medical residency.
e.zh: 她在医学住院培训期间学习了测痛学。

e.en: Many reef fish are highly {algophagous} creatures.
e.zh: 许多礁岩鱼类是高度食藻的生物。

e.en: The {algophagous} snails kept the tank perfectly clean.
e.zh: 食藻蜗牛把鱼缸保持得非常干净。

e.en: The therapist explored possible signs of {algophilia}.
e.zh: 治疗师探查了嗜痛癖的可能迹象。

e.en: Few clinical studies have addressed {algophilia} directly.
e.zh: 很少有临床研究直接探讨嗜痛癖。

e.en: Severe {algophobia} can complicate routine medical care.
e.zh: 严重的疼痛恐惧症会使常规医疗变得复杂。

e.en: She developed mild {algophobia} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后她出现了轻度的疼痛恐惧症。

algorism.t: 阿拉伯数字记数法；十进位算术

e.en: Medieval scholars learned {algorism} from Arabic texts.
e.zh: 中世纪学者从阿拉伯文献中学习算术。

e.en: The book introduced European merchants to {algorism}.
e.zh: 这本书向欧洲商人介绍了阿拉伯数字记数法。

e.en: The old textbook briefly mentioned {algoscopy}.
e.zh: 那本旧教科书简单提到了疼痛检查法。

e.en: Modern clinics rarely employ {algoscopy} anymore.
e.zh: 现代诊所如今很少使用疼痛检查法。

e.en: The pond gave off an {algous} smell each summer.
e.zh: 每到夏天池塘都散发着藻类气味。

e.en: They scraped the {algous} layer off the rocks.
e.zh: 他们把岩石上的藻类层刮掉。

alguacil.t: 西班牙警官；斗牛场司仪

e.en: The {alguacil} led the parade into the bullring.
e.zh: 司仪引领队伍进入斗牛场。

e.en: An {alguacil} kept order in the colonial town.
e.zh: 一名警官维持着殖民地小镇的秩序。

e.en: The {alguazil} arrested the suspect at dawn.
e.zh: 警官在黎明时逮捕了嫌犯。

e.en: Old Spanish novels often feature an {alguazil}.
e.zh: 西班牙旧小说常出现衙役的形象。

algum.t: 圣经中的檀香木；阿勒姆木

e.en: Solomon imported {algum} timber for the temple.
e.zh: 所罗门为圣殿进口了檀香木。

e.en: Craftsmen carved harps from {algum} wood.
e.zh: 工匠用阿勒姆木雕刻竖琴。

e.en: The surveyor adjusted the {alhidade} carefully.
e.zh: 测量员仔细地调整了照准仪。

e.en: An old brass {alhidade} sat on the workbench.
e.zh: 工作台上放着一台古老的黄铜照准仪。

e.en: Scientists tested the {alibility} of the new substance.
e.zh: 科学家测试了这种新物质的可营养性。

e.en: The diet's {alibility} was carefully assessed in trials.
e.zh: 该饮食的滋养能力在试验中得到仔细评估。

alible.t: 有营养的；滋养的；具滋补作用的

e.en: The broth was simple yet remarkably {alible}.
e.zh: 这道汤虽简单却富有营养。

e.en: He prepared an {alible} meal for the recovering patient.
e.zh: 他为康复中的病人准备了一顿滋养的饭菜。

alicyclic.t: 脂环的；脂环化合物的（化学）

e.en: The lecture covered {alicyclic} compounds in detail.
e.zh: 讲座详细介绍了脂环化合物。

e.en: Cyclohexane is a typical {alicyclic} hydrocarbon.
e.zh: 环己烷是典型的脂环烃。

alidad.t: 照准仪；测量游标；测角器

e.en: The geologist used an {alidad} on the slope.
e.zh: 地质学家在斜坡上使用了照准仪。

e.en: An {alidad} helps determine angles in the field.
e.zh: 照准仪有助于在野外测定角度。

e.en: Surveyors aligned the {alidade} with the distant target.
e.zh: 测量员将照准仪对准远处的目标。

e.en: A small brass {alidade} sat atop the plane table.
e.zh: 平板仪上放着一台小型黄铜照准仪。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {alienability} of the property.
e.zh: 律师们就该财产的可转让性展开辩论。

e.en: The contract sharply limited the {alienability} of shares.
e.zh: 合同严格限制了股票的可转让性。

e.en: Her {alienage} affected her right to vote.
e.zh: 她的外侨身份影响了投票权。

e.en: The court considered his {alienage} very carefully.
e.zh: 法庭非常仔细地考虑了他的外侨身份。

alienative.t: 使疏远的；产生异化作用的

e.en: The job had a deeply {alienative} effect on him.
e.zh: 这份工作让他深感异化。

e.en: Critics described the new policy as {alienative}.
e.zh: 评论家形容这项新政策使人疏离。

alienator.t: 让渡者；使他人疏远的人

e.en: The {alienator} signed over the deed yesterday afternoon.
e.zh: 让渡者昨天下午签字转让了产权。

e.en: He became an unintentional {alienator} of close friends.
e.zh: 他无意中疏远了亲密的朋友。

e.en: Many students become {aliterate} adults who can read but choose not to.
e.zh: 许多学生长大后成为有读写能力却不愿阅读的人。

e.en: The teacher worried about her {aliterate} class.
e.zh: 老师为班上不爱阅读的学生感到忧心。

aliturgical.t: 无圣礼仪式的；非礼拜日的

e.en: Good Friday is an {aliturgical} day in the Catholic tradition.
e.zh: 在天主教传统中，耶稣受难日是无弥撒之日。

e.en: The priest explained the meaning of {aliturgical} days.
e.zh: 神父解释了无圣礼日的意义。

aliunde.t: 来自他处的；从外部的（法律用语）

e.en: The court accepted evidence {aliunde} the contract itself.
e.zh: 法庭采纳了合同之外的其他证据。

e.en: Proof {aliunde} was needed to clarify the will.
e.zh: 需要外部证据来澄清遗嘱。

e.en: The chemist studied the reactions of {alkadiene} compounds.
e.zh: 化学家研究了二烯烃化合物的反应。

e.en: Rubber polymers can be made from {alkadiene} monomers.
e.zh: 橡胶聚合物可由二烯烃单体合成。

alkahest.t: 万能溶剂（炼金术中传说之物）

e.en: Alchemists once searched for the {alkahest} that could dissolve anything.
e.zh: 炼金术士曾追寻能溶解一切的万能溶剂。

e.en: The {alkahest} was a fabled universal solvent.
e.zh: 万能溶剂是传说中的通用溶剂。

alkahestic.t: 万能溶剂的；具有强溶解力的

e.en: He claimed his potion had {alkahestic} powers.
e.zh: 他声称自己的药剂具有万能溶剂般的威力。

e.en: The legend describes an {alkahestic} liquid.
e.zh: 传说描述了一种万能溶剂般的液体。

e.en: The soil's {alkalescence} affected plant growth.
e.zh: 土壤的微碱性影响了植物生长。

e.en: They measured the {alkalescence} of the solution.
e.zh: 他们测量了溶液的微碱性。

e.en: The water was slightly {alkalescent} after the test.
e.zh: 测试后水显示出轻微的碱性。

e.en: Many natural springs are mildly {alkalescent}.
e.zh: 许多天然泉水呈微碱性。

e.en: Calcium is an {alkali-earth} metal.
e.zh: 钙是一种碱土金属。

e.en: The {alkali-earth} elements share similar properties.
e.zh: 碱土族元素具有相似的性质。

e.en: Sodium is a common {alkali-metal} found in salt.
e.zh: 钠是盐中常见的碱金属。

e.en: The {alkali-metal} group reacts vigorously with water.
e.zh: 碱金属族遇水会剧烈反应。

e.en: The volcano produced {alkalic} lava flows.
e.zh: 这座火山喷出碱性熔岩流。

e.en: Geologists identified the rock as {alkalic}.
e.zh: 地质学家将这块岩石鉴定为碱性岩。

e.en: The water was {alkalified} by adding lime.
e.zh: 加入石灰后水被碱化了。

e.en: He drank {alkalified} water for his health.
e.zh: 他为了健康喝碱化水。

e.en: The substance {alkalifies} the soil over time.
e.zh: 该物质会逐渐使土壤碱化。

e.en: This compound {alkalifies} the solution rapidly.
e.zh: 这种化合物会迅速使溶液碱化。

e.en: They use this powder to {alkalify} drinking water.
e.zh: 他们用这种粉末来碱化饮用水。

e.en: Adding ash will {alkalify} the soil.
e.zh: 加入草木灰会使土壤变碱。

e.en: The {alkalifying} agent changed the pH quickly.
e.zh: 碱化剂迅速改变了酸碱值。

e.en: She is {alkalifying} the mixture for the experiment.
e.zh: 她正在为实验把混合物碱化。

e.en: The lab used an {alkalimeter} to measure base content.
e.zh: 实验室用碱量计测量碱含量。

e.en: He calibrated the {alkalimeter} before the test.
e.zh: 他在测试前校准了碱量计。

e.en: They performed an {alkalimetric} analysis on the sample.
e.zh: 他们对样品进行了碱量测定分析。

e.en: The {alkalimetric} method gave precise results.
e.zh: 碱量测定法给出了精确的结果。

e.en: The textbook described {alkalimetrical} procedures.
e.zh: 教科书介绍了碱量测定的步骤。

e.en: He preferred {alkalimetrical} techniques in his work.
e.zh: 他在工作中偏好使用碱量测定技术。

e.en: The acid content was determined {alkalimetrically}.
e.zh: 酸含量是通过碱量测定法测出的。

e.en: They analyzed the solution {alkalimetrically}.
e.zh: 他们用碱量测定法分析了溶液。

e.en: {Alkalimetry} is taught in advanced chemistry courses.
e.zh: 碱量测定法在高级化学课程中讲授。

e.en: She specialized in {alkalimetry} and titration.
e.zh: 她专攻碱量测定法和滴定。

e.en: They use lime to {alkalinise} acidic farmland.
e.zh: 他们用石灰来碱化酸性农田。

e.en: The treatment helps {alkalinise} the body's pH.
e.zh: 该疗法有助于碱化身体的酸碱值。

e.en: Soil {alkalinization} reduces crop yields in arid regions.
e.zh: 土壤碱化会降低干旱地区的作物产量。

e.en: Doctors monitored the urinary {alkalinization}.
e.zh: 医生监测了尿液的碱化情况。

e.en: Bicarbonate can {alkalinize} the urine effectively.
e.zh: 碳酸氢盐能有效地碱化尿液。

e.en: Farmers sometimes {alkalinize} acidic fields.
e.zh: 农民有时会碱化酸性田地。

e.en: The {alkalinized} water tasted slightly bitter.
e.zh: 碱化后的水尝起来略带苦味。

e.en: Patients drank {alkalinized} fluids during treatment.
e.zh: 患者在治疗期间饮用碱化液体。

e.en: The drug has an {alkalinizing} effect on urine.
e.zh: 该药对尿液具有碱化作用。

e.en: They tested various {alkalinizing} agents.
e.zh: 他们测试了多种碱化剂。

e.en: The pond water had a faintly {alkalinous} taste.
e.zh: 池塘水有一丝淡淡的碱味。

e.en: Some minerals give the soil an {alkalinous} quality.
e.zh: 某些矿物使土壤呈碱性。

e.en: The factory used {alkaliproof} coatings on its tanks.
e.zh: 工厂在储罐上使用了耐碱涂层。

e.en: They wore {alkaliproof} gloves for safety.
e.zh: 为安全起见他们戴了耐碱手套。

e.en: He took an {alkaliser} to settle his stomach.
e.zh: 他服了一片碱化剂来缓解胃部不适。

e.en: The {alkaliser} neutralized the excess acid.
e.zh: 碱化剂中和了多余的酸。

e.en: Soil {alkalization} is a serious environmental problem.
e.zh: 土壤碱化是一个严重的环境问题。

e.en: The process of {alkalization} took several hours.
e.zh: 碱化过程持续了好几个小时。

e.en: You can {alkalize} water by adding minerals.
e.zh: 加入矿物质可以使水碱化。

e.en: Some diets claim to {alkalize} the body.
e.zh: 有些饮食声称能让身体碱化。

e.en: They drank {alkalized} water every morning.
e.zh: 他们每天早晨喝碱化水。

e.en: The {alkalized} cocoa has a milder flavor.
e.zh: 碱化可可的风味较为温和。

e.en: This supplement {alkalizes} the bloodstream gradually.
e.zh: 这种补充剂会逐渐碱化血液。

e.en: The additive {alkalizes} the soil over months.
e.zh: 该添加剂会在数月内使土壤碱化。

e.en: Lemons are surprisingly {alkalizing} once digested.
e.zh: 柠檬经消化后竟具有碱化作用。

e.en: She follows an {alkalizing} diet plan.
e.zh: 她遵循一种碱化饮食方案。

e.en: She is an {all-around} athlete who excels in five sports.
e.zh: 她是一名在五项运动中都出色的全能运动员。

e.en: This tool offers {all-around} protection for your phone.
e.zh: 这款工具为你的手机提供全方位的保护。

e.en: He's a true {all-arounder} on the basketball court.
e.zh: 他在篮球场上是个真正的全能球员。

e.en: The team needed an {all-arounder} who could play any position.
e.zh: 球队需要一名能胜任任何位置的多面手。

e.en: The sirens sounded the {all-clear} after the drill.
e.zh: 演习结束后警报响起解除信号。

e.en: Doctors gave him the {all-clear} after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后医生宣布他已无大碍。

all-comers.t: 所有挑战者；任何参加者

e.en: The champion is ready to take on {all-comers}.
e.zh: 冠军准备迎战所有挑战者。

e.en: The tournament is open to {all-comers} regardless of rank.
e.zh: 该赛事不分等级，向所有参赛者开放。

all-conquering.t: 战无不胜的；所向披靡的

e.en: The {all-conquering} team won every match this season.
e.zh: 这支战无不胜的球队本赛季赢得了每场比赛。

e.en: She returned with an {all-conquering} smile.
e.zh: 她带着所向披靡的笑容回来了。

all-consuming.t: 全身心投入的；占据全部精力的

e.en: Writing the novel became an {all-consuming} passion.
e.zh: 写这部小说成了她全身心投入的热情。

e.en: His {all-consuming} ambition left no room for family.
e.zh: 他全身心的野心使他无暇顾及家庭。

e.en: We bought an {all-day} pass to the amusement park.
e.zh: 我们买了游乐园的全天通票。

e.en: The conference includes an {all-day} workshop.
e.zh: 会议包括一个全天的研讨会。

e.en: The festival was a proper {all-dayer} with twelve bands.
e.zh: 这个音乐节是个名副其实的全天活动，有十二支乐队演出。

e.en: Saturday's drinking session turned into an {all-dayer}.
e.zh: 周六的小酌变成了一整天的畅饮。

all-electric.t: 全电动的；纯电力驱动的

e.en: They launched a new {all-electric} sedan last year.
e.zh: 他们去年推出了一款新的纯电动轿车。

e.en: The factory will produce only {all-electric} vehicles by 2030.
e.zh: 该工厂到2030年将只生产纯电动汽车。

all-embracing.t: 包罗万象的；无所不包的

e.en: The theory offers an {all-embracing} view of human behavior.
e.zh: 该理论对人类行为提出了无所不包的观点。

e.en: Her love seemed {all-embracing} and unconditional.
e.zh: 她的爱似乎包容一切且毫无条件。

e.en: They won an {all-expense} paid trip to Hawaii.
e.zh: 他们赢得了一次费用全包的夏威夷之旅。

e.en: The company offers an {all-expense} relocation package.
e.zh: 公司提供费用全包的搬迁套餐。

all-fired.t: 非常的；极度的（口语强调）

e.en: What's your {all-fired} hurry this morning?
e.zh: 你今天早上急急忙忙的到底是为什么？

e.en: Why are you in such an {all-fired} rush?
e.zh: 你为什么这么火急火燎的？

e.en: The team adopted an {all-for-one} attitude.
e.zh: 团队秉持着人人为我、我为人人的态度。

e.en: Their motto was simple and {all-for-one}.
e.zh: 他们的座右铭简单又强调团结一心。

e.en: The toddler crawled on {all-fours} across the rug.
e.zh: 幼儿四肢着地爬过地毯。

e.en: He got down on {all-fours} to look under the bed.
e.zh: 他四肢着地查看床底下。

e.en: The architect designed an {all-glass} facade for the tower.
e.zh: 建筑师为这座塔楼设计了通体玻璃的外立面。

e.en: They built an {all-glass} conservatory in the garden.
e.zh: 他们在花园里建了一间全玻璃的温室。

e.en: The CEO called an {all-hands} meeting on Friday.
e.zh: 首席执行官召开了周五的全员大会。

e.en: This crisis requires an {all-hands} response.
e.zh: 这场危机需要全员动员应对。

e.en: The launch is tomorrow, so it's {all-hands-on-deck}.
e.zh: 明天就要发布了，所以全员上阵。

e.en: This project demands an {all-hands-on-deck} effort.
e.zh: 这个项目需要全员全力以赴。

e.en: He missed the {all-important} final exam.
e.zh: 他错过了那场至关重要的期末考试。

e.en: Timing is the {all-important} factor in comedy.
e.zh: 时机是喜剧中至关重要的因素。

e.en: He went {all-in} on his new business venture.
e.zh: 他全力投入到他的新创业项目中。

e.en: The hotel package is {all-in}, including meals and drinks.
e.zh: 酒店套餐是全包的，包括餐食和饮料。

e.en: {All-in-all}, it was a successful trip.
e.zh: 总的来说，这是一次成功的旅行。

e.en: {All-in-all}, the project exceeded our expectations.
e.zh: 总而言之，这个项目超出了我们的预期。

all-in-one.t: 多功能合一的；一体式的

e.en: This {all-in-one} printer also scans and copies.
e.zh: 这台多功能合一打印机还能扫描和复印。

e.en: She bought an {all-in-one} shampoo and conditioner.
e.zh: 她买了一瓶洗护合一的洗发水。

all-inclusive.t: 一价全包的；包括一切的

e.en: We booked an {all-inclusive} resort in Cancun.
e.zh: 我们预订了坎昆的一价全包度假村。

e.en: The fee is {all-inclusive}, with no hidden charges.
e.zh: 该费用包含一切，没有隐藏收费。

e.en: The policy aims for {all-inclusiveness} in hiring.
e.zh: 该政策旨在招聘中实现完全包容性。

e.en: Their charm lies in their genuine {all-inclusiveness}.
e.zh: 他们的魅力在于真正的全方位包容。

e.en: Caribbean {all-inclusives} are popular with families.
e.zh: 加勒比海的一价全包度假套餐很受家庭欢迎。

e.en: She prefers {all-inclusives} to backpacking trips.
e.zh: 比起背包旅行，她更喜欢一价全包的度假套餐。

e.en: He spoke with an {all-knowing} smirk.
e.zh: 他带着一副无所不知的笑容说话。

e.en: She is not the {all-knowing} oracle you imagine.
e.zh: 她并不是你想象中无所不知的先知。

e.en: The watch features an {all-metal} body.
e.zh: 这款手表采用全金属机身。

e.en: He prefers {all-metal} kitchen utensils to plastic ones.
e.zh: 他更喜欢全金属厨房用具而不是塑料的。

e.en: They had an {all-night} party in the dorm.
e.zh: 他们在宿舍里开了个通宵派对。

e.en: The pharmacy offers an {all-night} service.
e.zh: 这家药房提供通宵服务。

e.en: I pulled an {all-nighter} to finish the essay.
e.zh: 我熬了个通宵把论文写完。

e.en: Three {all-nighters} in a row left him exhausted.
e.zh: 连续三个通宵让他筋疲力尽。

e.en: Neurons fire on an {all-or-none} principle.
e.zh: 神经元按照全有或全无的原则放电。

e.en: It's an {all-or-none} decision—no middle ground.
e.zh: 这是一个非全即无的决定，没有中间地带。

all-or-nothing.t: 孤注一掷的；非此即彼的

e.en: He took an {all-or-nothing} approach to negotiations.
e.zh: 他在谈判中采取孤注一掷的方法。

e.en: Her {all-or-nothing} attitude makes compromise difficult.
e.zh: 她非此即彼的态度使妥协变得困难。

all-out.t: 全力以赴的；竭尽全力的

e.en: They launched an {all-out} attack at dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明发动了全面进攻。

e.en: She made an {all-out} effort to win the prize.
e.zh: 她竭尽全力去赢得这个奖项。

all-overish.t: 浑身不适的；隐约不舒服的

e.en: I felt {all-overish} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后我感觉浑身不适。

e.en: She came down with an {all-overish} feeling before the flu.
e.zh: 她在感冒前出现了一种浑身不舒服的感觉。

e.en: An {all-party} committee will review the bill.
e.zh: 一个各党派联合的委员会将审议该法案。

e.en: They reached an {all-party} agreement on climate policy.
e.zh: 他们就气候政策达成了各党派共识。

all-pass.t: 全通过的（通常指滤波器）

e.en: The engineer used an {all-pass} filter to adjust phase.
e.zh: 工程师使用全通滤波器来调整相位。

e.en: An {all-pass} network preserves signal amplitude.
e.zh: 全通网络保持信号幅度不变。

e.en: There was an {all-pervading} smell of fish at the dock.
e.zh: 码头上弥漫着无处不在的鱼腥味。

e.en: An {all-pervading} sense of fear gripped the city.
e.zh: 一种无处不在的恐惧笼罩着这座城市。

all-pervasive.t: 无所不在的；普遍渗透的

e.en: Social media has become {all-pervasive} in modern life.
e.zh: 社交媒体在现代生活中已无所不在。

e.en: The {all-pervasive} influence of advertising shapes our choices.
e.zh: 广告无所不在的影响力塑造着我们的选择。

e.en: The tournament uses an {all-play-all} format.
e.zh: 该比赛采用循环赛制。

e.en: In an {all-play-all} group, every team faces every other team.
e.zh: 在循环赛小组中，每支球队都要与其他所有球队交手。

e.en: He worked like {all-possessed} to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 他像着了魔似的赶在截止日期前工作。

e.en: She danced like {all-possessed} all night.
e.zh: 她整晚像着了魔似的跳舞。

e.en: They believed in an {all-powerful} god.
e.zh: 他们信仰一位全能的神。

e.en: The CEO is not the {all-powerful} figure he pretends to be.
e.zh: 首席执行官并非他自己装出来的那种万能人物。

all-pro.t: 全明星级的；最佳阵容的

e.en: He was named an {all-pro} quarterback this season.
e.zh: 他本赛季入选最佳阵容四分卫。

e.en: She delivered an {all-pro} performance in the finals.
e.zh: 她在决赛中展现了全明星级的表现。

e.en: Five {all-pros} appeared in the championship game.
e.zh: 五位最佳阵容球员出现在了冠军赛中。

e.en: The team boasts three {all-pros} on defense.
e.zh: 球队在防守端拥有三位最佳阵容球员。

e.en: This {all-purpose} cleaner works on any surface.
e.zh: 这款多用途清洁剂适用于任何表面。

e.en: She bought a bag of {all-purpose} flour.
e.zh: 她买了一袋通用面粉。

all-red.t: 全程英属（旧时电缆术语）；通体红色的

e.en: The Victorians dreamed of an {all-red} cable route around the world.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的人梦想建立一条环绕世界的全英属电缆线路。

e.en: She wore an {all-red} outfit to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一身红色服装出席晚会。

all-right.t: 还行的；可以的；没问题的

e.en: The movie was {all-right}, but not memorable.
e.zh: 那部电影还行，但不算难忘。

e.en: Are you feeling {all-right} today?
e.zh: 你今天感觉还好吗？

e.en: He's a fine {all-round} student in every subject.
e.zh: 他是各科都优秀的全面型学生。

e.en: The phone offers {all-round} performance at a low price.
e.zh: 这款手机以低价提供全面的性能。

e.en: She's a true {all-rounder} who excels in academics and sports.
e.zh: 她是一位在学业和运动上都出色的真正多面手。

e.en: The team needs an {all-rounder} who can bat and bowl.
e.zh: 球队需要一位既能击球又能投球的全能选手。

e.en: He installed {all-season} tires on his car.
e.zh: 他给车装上了全季节轮胎。

e.en: This jacket is an {all-season} essential.
e.zh: 这件夹克是四季皆宜的必备品。

e.en: The facts were barely {allegeable} in court.
e.zh: 这些事实在法庭上几乎难以指控。

e.en: No {allegeable} motive surfaced during the inquiry.
e.zh: 调查期间未浮现任何可指称的动机。

e.en: His {allegement} lacked any supporting evidence.
e.zh: 他的指控缺乏任何佐证。

e.en: The judge dismissed the wild {allegement}.
e.zh: 法官驳回了那个荒唐的指控。

e.en: The knights remained {allegiant} to their king.
e.zh: 骑士们对国王始终忠诚。

e.en: She is fiercely {allegiant} to her family.
e.zh: 她对家人极其忠心。

e.en: The painting has clear {allegoric} elements.
e.zh: 这幅画带有明显的寓言色彩。

e.en: He wrote in an {allegoric} style.
e.zh: 他以讽喻的风格写作。

allegoriser.t: 寓言作者；用寓言表达者

e.en: Spenser was a masterful {allegoriser} of virtue.
e.zh: 斯宾塞是描绘美德的寓言高手。

e.en: The medieval {allegoriser} hid meaning beneath images.
e.zh: 中世纪的寓言作家把含义藏在意象之下。

e.en: Bunyan is the most famous English {allegorist}.
e.zh: 班扬是英国最著名的寓言作家。

e.en: The {allegorist} cloaks ideas in story.
e.zh: 寓言作家以故事包裹思想。

e.en: Her reading is overly {allegoristic}.
e.zh: 她的解读过于寓言化。

e.en: Critics rejected the {allegoristic} interpretation.
e.zh: 评论家否定了那种寓言式解读。

e.en: The text invites {allegorization} of every detail.
e.zh: 这段文字诱使人对每个细节作寓言化解读。

e.en: Such {allegorization} can distort the original.
e.zh: 这种寓言化可能扭曲原意。

allegretto.t: 小快板；稍快地（音乐术语）

e.en: The second movement is an {allegretto}.
e.zh: 第二乐章是一段小快板。

e.en: Play this passage {allegretto}.
e.zh: 这段请以小快板演奏。

e.en: Researchers studied {allelic} variation in mice.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了小鼠的等位基因变异。

e.en: The trait shows clear {allelic} differences.
e.zh: 该性状显示明显的等位基因差异。

e.en: The team confirmed {allelism} between two mutations.
e.zh: 团队证实了两个突变之间的等位关系。

e.en: {Allelism} tests revealed shared loci.
e.zh: 等位测试揭示了共同的基因位点。

e.en: Plants release {allelochemic} compounds to deter rivals.
e.zh: 植物释放化感物质以抑制竞争者。

e.en: The study mapped {allelochemic} effects on neighboring crops.
e.zh: 研究描绘了化感作用对邻近作物的影响。

e.en: Walnut trees produce a powerful {allelochemical}.
e.zh: 胡桃树产生一种强效的化感物质。

e.en: Researchers isolated the active {allelochemical} agent.
e.zh: 研究人员分离出了活性化感成分。

e.en: He lectures on {allelochemics} at the institute.
e.zh: 他在该研究所讲授化感化学。

e.en: {Allelochemics} explores chemical interactions among species.
e.zh: 化感化学研究物种间的化学交互。

e.en: Early geneticists called alleles {allelomorphs}.
e.zh: 早期遗传学家把等位基因称作allelomorph。

e.en: The {allelomorph} determined eye color.
e.zh: 该等位基因决定了眼睛的颜色。

e.en: The textbook discusses {allelomorphism} at length.
e.zh: 教科书详细讨论了等位现象。

e.en: {Allelomorphism} underlies Mendelian inheritance.
e.zh: 等位现象是孟德尔遗传的基础。

e.en: Sunflowers exert {allelopathic} effects on weeds.
e.zh: 向日葵对杂草产生化感作用。

e.en: The plant has strong {allelopathic} properties.
e.zh: 该植物具有强烈的化感特性。

e.en: The lab analyzed the tumor's {allelotype}.
e.zh: 实验室分析了肿瘤的等位基因型。

e.en: Each sample has a distinct {allelotype}.
e.zh: 每个样本都有独特的等位基因型。

e.en: The choir sang a joyful {alleluiah}.
e.zh: 唱诗班高唱欢欣的哈利路亚。

e.en: She whispered {alleluiah} in gratitude.
e.zh: 她以感恩之心低声说哈利路亚。

allemande.t: 阿勒曼德舞曲；方块舞步

e.en: Bach composed many elegant {allemande} pieces.
e.zh: 巴赫创作了许多优雅的阿勒曼德舞曲。

e.en: The dancers performed an {allemande} step.
e.zh: 舞者跳起阿勒曼德舞步。

e.en: The land passed to him {allenarly}.
e.zh: 那块地仅传给他一人。

e.en: Use this term {allenarly} in legal Scots.
e.zh: 该词仅用于苏格兰法律文书。

e.en: Chemists synthesized a new {allene} derivative.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种新的丙二烯衍生物。

e.en: The {allene} structure features cumulated double bonds.
e.zh: 丙二烯结构含有累积双键。

e.en: Pollen is a common {allergin} in spring.
e.zh: 花粉是春季常见的过敏原。

e.en: Doctors identified the offending {allergin}.
e.zh: 医生找出了致敏的过敏原。

e.en: The spray contains {allethrin} as its active ingredient.
e.zh: 该喷雾以丙烯菊酯为有效成分。

e.en: {Allethrin} kills mosquitoes on contact.
e.zh: 丙烯菊酯接触即能杀灭蚊虫。

e.en: Music can be a powerful {alleviant} of stress.
e.zh: 音乐能有力地缓解压力。

e.en: The drug acts as an {alleviant} for pain.
e.zh: 该药物可作止痛缓解剂。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {alleviative} therapy first.
e.zh: 医生首先开出缓解性疗法。

e.en: The measures were merely {alleviative}.
e.zh: 这些措施只是缓解性的。

e.en: Humor is a great {alleviator} of tension.
e.zh: 幽默是缓解紧张的良方。

e.en: She became an {alleviator} of suffering.
e.zh: 她成了苦难的缓解者。

e.en: The bill includes {alleviatory} provisions for tenants.
e.zh: 该法案为租户提供减轻性条款。

e.en: They sought {alleviatory} rather than curative measures.
e.zh: 他们寻求缓解而非根治的措施。

alley-oop.t: 空中接力扣篮（篮球术语）

e.en: He finished the play with a thunderous {alley-oop}.
e.zh: 他以一记震撼的空接扣篮结束了进攻。

e.en: The point guard threw a perfect {alley-oop}.
e.zh: 控卫送出一记完美的空中接力。

e.en: They practiced {alley-oops} all afternoon.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都在练空接扣篮。

e.en: His highlight reel features many {alley-oops}.
e.zh: 他的精彩集锦里有很多空接扣篮。

e.en: They believed in an {allpowerful} god.
e.zh: 他们信仰一位全能的神。

e.en: The CEO acted like an {allpowerful} ruler.
e.zh: 那位首席执行官表现得像个万能的统治者。

e.en: She is an {allround} athlete.
e.zh: 她是一位全能型运动员。

e.en: We need an {allround} improvement in service.
e.zh: 我们需要服务的全面提升。

e.en: He is a true {allrounder} in the team.
e.zh: 他是队里真正的多面手。

e.en: The school values {allrounders} over specialists.
e.zh: 这所学校更看重全能型人才而非专才。

e.en: She bought a bag of liquorice {allsorts}.
e.zh: 她买了一袋什锦甘草糖。

e.en: The kids fought over the last {allsorts}.
e.zh: 孩子们抢着最后几颗杂拌糖。

e.en: Sales reached an {alltime} high.
e.zh: 销售额达到了空前的高峰。

e.en: It is one of my {alltime} favourite films.
e.zh: 这是我有史以来最喜欢的电影之一。

e.en: Geologists studied the river {alluvia}.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了河流冲积层。

e.en: Fertile {alluvia} cover the valley floor.
e.zh: 肥沃的冲积物覆盖着河谷底部。

e.en: {Alluviation} reshaped the delta over centuries.
e.zh: 几个世纪以来，冲积作用重塑了三角洲。

e.en: Heavy rains accelerated {alluviation} downstream.
e.zh: 暴雨加速了下游的淤积过程。

e.en: The farm sits on rich {alluvion}.
e.zh: 那座农场坐落在肥沃的冲积地上。

e.en: Property law treats {alluvion} as natural accretion.
e.zh: 财产法将冲积地视为自然增积。

e.en: Garlic contains an {allyl} compound.
e.zh: 大蒜含有一种烯丙基化合物。

e.en: The lab synthesised an {allyl} derivative.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种烯丙基衍生物。

e.en: He donated generously to his {almamater}.
e.zh: 他向母校慷慨捐款。

e.en: She returned to her {almamater} for the reunion.
e.zh: 她回到母校参加同学聚会。

e.en: He consulted an old farmer's {almanack}.
e.zh: 他翻阅了一本古老的农夫年鉴。

e.en: The {almanack} predicted a harsh winter.
e.zh: 那本历书预言了严冬。

e.en: The library kept antique {almanacks}.
e.zh: 图书馆保存着古老的年鉴。

e.en: Sailors relied on nautical {almanacks}.
e.zh: 水手们依靠航海年鉴。

e.en: The ring features a deep red {almandine}.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶嵌着深红色的贵榴石。

e.en: Geologists identified the gem as {almandine}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定这颗宝石为铁铝榴石。

e.en: The stadium became {all-seater} after the renovation.
e.zh: 翻修后体育场变成了全座位场馆。

e.en: New regulations required {all-seater} venues for top matches.
e.zh: 新规定要求顶级赛事使用全座位场馆。

e.en: They wanted an {all-sided} education for their children.
e.zh: 他们希望让孩子接受全面的教育。

e.en: The report gave an {all-sided} view of the issue.
e.zh: 报告对该问题给出了多方面的看法。

e.en: The committee examined the proposal {all-sidedly}.
e.zh: 委员会全面地审查了该提案。

e.en: He approached the problem {all-sidedly} before deciding.
e.zh: 他在做决定前从多方面考虑了这个问题。

e.en: The {all-sidedness} of her analysis impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她分析的全面性给所有人留下了深刻印象。

e.en: They valued the {all-sidedness} of his character.
e.zh: 他们看重他性格的多面性。

all-singing.t: 功能齐全的；样样俱全的

e.en: They launched an {all-singing}, all-dancing new app.
e.zh: 他们推出了一款功能样样俱全的新应用。

e.en: The car comes in an {all-singing} luxury version.
e.zh: 这款车有一个功能齐全的豪华版本。

e.en: He played in the {all-star} game last season.
e.zh: 上赛季他参加了全明星赛。

e.en: The film boasts an {all-star} cast.
e.zh: 这部电影拥有明星云集的演员阵容。

all-state.t: 全州最佳的（学生运动员）

e.en: She earned {all-state} honors in basketball.
e.zh: 她获得了篮球项目的全州最佳荣誉。

e.en: He was named {all-state} in two sports.
e.zh: 他在两个项目中被评为全州最佳。

e.en: Her son became an {all-stater} in track.
e.zh: 她儿子成为田径项目的全州最佳运动员。

e.en: Three {all-staters} signed with the university.
e.zh: 三名全州最佳运动员与该大学签约。

e.en: They built an {all-steel} bridge across the river.
e.zh: 他们在河上建造了一座全钢大桥。

e.en: The factory produced {all-steel} furniture.
e.zh: 那家工厂生产全钢家具。

e.en: They stayed at an {all-suite} hotel downtown.
e.zh: 他们住在市中心一家全套房式酒店。

e.en: The chain operates {all-suite} properties nationwide.
e.zh: 该连锁集团在全国经营全套房式酒店。

e.en: The {all-suites} resort welcomed families on vacation.
e.zh: 这家全套房式度假村欢迎度假家庭入住。

e.en: Business travelers prefer {all-suites} accommodations.
e.zh: 商务旅客更喜欢全套房式的住宿。

e.en: He is an {all-the-time} kind of friend.
e.zh: 他是那种始终如一的朋友。

e.en: She wants an {all-the-time} commitment, not occasional help.
e.zh: 她要的是持续的承诺，而不是偶尔的帮忙。

e.en: He is an {all-the-way} supporter of the project.
e.zh: 他是这个项目彻底的支持者。

e.en: They ordered an {all-the-way} hot dog with everything.
e.zh: 他们点了一份全配料的热狗。

e.en: Sales reached an {all-time} high last quarter.
e.zh: 销售额在上季度达到了历史新高。

e.en: She is one of my {all-time} favorite singers.
e.zh: 她是我一直以来最喜欢的歌手之一。

e.en: That movie is a real {all-timer}.
e.zh: 那部电影绝对是经典之作。

e.en: His performance tonight was an {all-timer}.
e.zh: 他今晚的表演堪称史上最佳。

e.en: The family sang the song {all-together}.
e.zh: 全家人一起唱了这首歌。

e.en: Let's push the boxes {all-together} on three.
e.zh: 我们数到三一起推这些箱子。

e.en: The mistakes were {all-too} obvious.
e.zh: 那些错误太过明显了。

e.en: Such delays are {all-too} familiar to commuters.
e.zh: 这种延误对通勤者来说太过熟悉。

all-too-common.t: 司空见惯的；太过常见的

e.en: Such accidents are {all-too-common} on this road.
e.zh: 这种事故在这条路上太过常见。

e.en: Office burnout has become {all-too-common} lately.
e.zh: 近来办公室过劳已经司空见惯。

all-too-often.t: 屡见不鲜地；时常发生地

e.en: {All-too-often}, good ideas get ignored in meetings.
e.zh: 好点子在会议上时常被忽视。

e.en: She is {all-too-often} the last to know.
e.zh: 她屡屡是最后一个知道的人。

e.en: The {all-up} weight of the aircraft exceeded limits.
e.zh: 飞机的总重超过了限制。

e.en: The {all-up} cost came to two million dollars.
e.zh: 总费用达到了两百万美元。

all-volunteer.t: 全志愿的；全部由志愿者组成的

e.en: The country has an {all-volunteer} military force.
e.zh: 该国拥有一支全志愿的军队。

e.en: The festival relies on an {all-volunteer} crew.
e.zh: 这个节日依靠一支全志愿团队运作。

e.en: He bought an {all-wave} radio for shortwave listening.
e.zh: 他买了一台全波段收音机用来收听短波。

e.en: The old {all-wave} receiver still works perfectly.
e.zh: 那台旧的全波段接收机仍能完美运作。

e.en: The intersection has an {all-way} stop sign.
e.zh: 这个路口设有四向停车标志。

e.en: Drivers must yield at an {all-way} stop.
e.zh: 司机在四向停车路口必须让行。

all-weather.t: 全天候的；适合各种天气的

e.en: She bought an {all-weather} jacket for hiking.
e.zh: 她买了一件适合各种天气的徒步外套。

e.en: The track has an {all-weather} surface.
e.zh: 这条跑道是全天候的路面。

e.en: The ship has an {all-welded} steel hull.
e.zh: 这艘船配有全焊接的钢制船体。

e.en: Engineers preferred an {all-welded} frame for strength.
e.zh: 工程师偏好采用全焊接框架以增强强度。

e.en: The embryo develops an {allantoic} membrane early on.
e.zh: 胚胎在早期发育出尿囊膜。

e.en: Researchers studied {allantoic} fluid in chick embryos.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了鸡胚中的尿囊液。

e.en: The structure appeared {allantoid} under the microscope.
e.zh: 该结构在显微镜下呈尿囊状。

e.en: They identified an {allantoid} formation in the tissue.
e.zh: 他们在组织中辨认出一个尿囊状结构。

e.en: The {allantoidal} sac plays a role in respiration.
e.zh: 尿囊在呼吸过程中起一定作用。

e.en: Scientists examined the {allantoidal} membrane closely.
e.zh: 科学家仔细检查了尿囊膜。

e.en: This cream contains {allantoin} to soothe skin.
e.zh: 这款面霜含有尿囊素以舒缓肌肤。

e.en: {Allantoin} is widely used in cosmetic products.
e.zh: 尿囊素被广泛用于化妆品中。

e.en: The {allantois} forms part of the umbilical cord.
e.zh: 尿囊构成脐带的一部分。

e.en: In birds, the {allantois} stores embryonic waste.
e.zh: 在鸟类中，尿囊储存胚胎的代谢废物。

e.en: The conductor signaled the orchestra to play {allargando}.
e.zh: 指挥示意乐队渐慢渐强地演奏。

e.en: The score is marked {allargando} near the finale.
e.zh: 乐谱在接近尾声处标有渐慢渐强的指示。

e.en: He is an {allaround} athlete admired by all.
e.zh: 他是一位备受赞誉的全能运动员。

e.en: She gave an {allaround} excellent performance tonight.
e.zh: 她今晚的表演各方面都非常出色。

e.en: His words brought an {allayment} of her fears.
e.zh: 他的话减轻了她的恐惧。

e.en: The treaty offered some {allayment} of tensions.
e.zh: 该条约在一定程度上缓解了紧张局势。

e.en: The race was open to {allcomers} that day.
e.zh: 那天的比赛向所有参加者开放。

e.en: The champion was willing to face {allcomers}.
e.zh: 这位冠军愿意迎战任何来者。

e.en: A cat darted into the dark {alley-way}.
e.zh: 一只猫窜进了黑漆漆的小巷。

e.en: Their shop sits at the end of a narrow {alley-way}.
e.zh: 他们的店铺位于一条窄巷的尽头。

e.en: A scruffy {alleycat} was rummaging through the bins.
e.zh: 一只邋遢的野猫正在翻垃圾桶。

e.en: He took in the skinny {alleycat} and named her Luna.
e.zh: 他收留了那只瘦弱的流浪猫，给她取名叫露娜。

e.en: The point guard threw a perfect {alleyoop} to the center.
e.zh: 控球后卫给中锋送出一记完美的空中接力。

e.en: That {alleyoop} dunk brought the crowd to its feet.
e.zh: 那记空接扣篮让观众全场起立。

e.en: Old herbalists prized {allheal} for treating wounds.
e.zh: 古时的草药师珍视缬草用来治疗伤口。

e.en: She brewed a calming tea from dried {allheal}.
e.zh: 她用晒干的缬草泡了一杯安神茶。

e.en: Few of the rival factions were genuinely {alliable}.
e.zh: 敌对派系中真正能结盟的没几个。

e.en: The treaty listed states deemed {alliable} with the empire.
e.zh: 条约列出了被视为可与帝国结盟的国家。

e.en: The soup had a strong {alliaceous} aroma.
e.zh: 那道汤散发着浓郁的葱蒜香气。

e.en: Botanists group these plants among the {alliaceous} species.
e.zh: 植物学家把这些植物归入葱蒜类。

e.en: Crushing garlic releases {allicin}, its key active compound.
e.zh: 碾碎大蒜会释放出其主要活性成分大蒜素。

e.en: Studies suggest {allicin} has antimicrobial properties.
e.zh: 研究表明大蒜素具有抗菌作用。

e.en: The old text uses 'to {alligate}' where we'd say 'bind'.
e.zh: 古文用 'alligate' 一词，相当于今天说的'捆绑'。

e.en: Ropes were used to {alligate} the beams together.
e.zh: 用绳子把那些梁捆系在一起。

e.en: He showed off a polished {alligator-skin} wallet.
e.zh: 他炫耀着一只光亮的鳄鱼皮钱包。

e.en: The boots were made of genuine {alligator-skin}.
e.zh: 这双靴子是用真正的鳄鱼皮做的。

e.en: The {alligatorfish} hides among rocks on cold seabeds.
e.zh: 鳄形鱼藏匿在寒冷海底的岩石之间。

e.en: We spotted an {alligatorfish} during the dive.
e.zh: 潜水时我们看到了一条鳄形鱼。

e.en: Intact garlic cloves contain {alliin} but not allicin.
e.zh: 完整的蒜瓣含有蒜氨酸，但不含大蒜素。

e.en: Cutting the bulb converts {alliin} into pungent compounds.
e.zh: 切开蒜头会把蒜氨酸转化成辛辣的成分。

e.en: Trust is the {allimportant} factor in this partnership.
e.zh: 信任是这段合作中至关重要的因素。

e.en: She missed the {allimportant} deadline by an hour.
e.zh: 她迟了一小时错过了那个至关重要的截止时间。

e.en: He went {allin} on the river card.
e.zh: 他在最后一张牌时全押了。

e.en: The team is {allin} on the new strategy.
e.zh: 团队对这套新策略全力以赴。

e.en: {Allinase} catalyzes the reaction that produces allicin.
e.zh: 蒜氨酸酶催化生成大蒜素的反应。

e.en: Heat denatures {allinase} and kills garlic's pungency.
e.zh: 加热会使蒜氨酸酶变性，破坏大蒜的辛辣味。

e.en: The report classified the incident as an {allision}, not a collision.
e.zh: 报告将该事故定性为船舶触碰，而非船只相撞。

e.en: The barge's {allision} with the bridge caused minor damage.
e.zh: 驳船触碰桥墩造成了轻微损坏。

e.en: Poe was a notorious {alliterator} in his darker verse.
e.zh: 坡在他较为阴郁的诗作中是出了名的押头韵高手。

e.en: As an {alliterator}, she peppered her prose with crisp consonants.
e.zh: 作为押头韵的好手，她在散文中点缀了大量清脆的辅音。

e.en: The patient developed {alloantibodies} after the transfusion.
e.zh: 患者在输血后产生了同种抗体。

e.en: Screening for {alloantibodies} is routine before transplantation.
e.zh: 移植前筛查同种抗体是常规步骤。

e.en: An {alloantibody} can complicate future blood transfusions.
e.zh: 同种抗体可能给日后的输血带来麻烦。

e.en: The lab identified the specific {alloantibody} responsible.
e.zh: 实验室鉴定出了那种特定的同种抗体。

e.en: Recipients may react to a donor's {alloantigen} markers.
e.zh: 受体可能会对供体的同种抗原标记产生反应。

e.en: Mismatched {alloantigen} types raise the risk of rejection.
e.zh: 同种抗原类型不匹配会增加排异反应的风险。

e.en: Only a small share of the budget is {allocable} this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度只有一小部分预算可供分配。

e.en: These costs are not directly {allocable} to one project.
e.zh: 这些费用无法直接划归到某一个项目上。

e.en: The remaining funds are {allocatable} to either team.
e.zh: 剩下的资金可以分配给任一团队。

e.en: Memory marked {allocatable} can be reserved at runtime.
e.zh: 被标记为可分配的内存可以在运行时申请。

e.en: Each {allocatee} signed a receipt for the supplies.
e.zh: 每位受配人都签收了相应的物资。

e.en: The contract names the {allocatee} of the disputed shares.
e.zh: 合同载明了那批有争议股份的受配人。

e.en: The mineral is {allochroic}, shifting hue under different light.
e.zh: 这种矿物会变色，在不同光线下色调会改变。

e.en: Some {allochroic} gems are prized for their shimmering effect.
e.zh: 一些会变色的宝石因其闪烁效果而备受珍视。

allochromatic.t: 他色的；因杂质致色的（矿物）

e.en: Pure quartz is {allochromatic}, colored only by trace impurities.
e.zh: 纯石英是他色矿物，仅因微量杂质而显色。

e.en: Geologists distinguish idiochromatic from {allochromatic} minerals.
e.zh: 地质学家区分自色矿物与他色矿物。

e.en: The boulders are clearly {allochthonous}, hauled in by glaciers.
e.zh: 这些巨砾显然是外来的，由冰川搬运而来。

e.en: Geologists labeled the layer {allochthonous} sediment.
e.zh: 地质学家把这一层标注为外来沉积物。

allophonic.t: 音位变体的；同位异音的

e.en: The two sounds show {allophonic} variation.
e.zh: 这两个音呈现音位变体的差异。

e.en: She studied the {allophonic} rules of English.
e.zh: 她研究了英语的同位异音规则。

e.en: Many crops are {allopolyploids} formed by hybridization.
e.zh: 许多作物是杂交形成的异源多倍体。

e.en: Wheat and cotton are classic {allopolyploids}.
e.zh: 小麦和棉花是典型的异源多倍体。

allopolyploidy.t: 异源多倍性；异源多倍化

e.en: {Allopolyploidy} drives plant speciation.
e.zh: 异源多倍化推动植物物种形成。

e.en: Researchers traced the origin of {allopolyploidy} in wheat.
e.zh: 研究者追溯了小麦中异源多倍性的起源。

allopurinol.t: 别嘌呤醇（一种治疗痛风的药物）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {allopurinol} for his gout.
e.zh: 医生为他的痛风开了别嘌呤醇。

e.en: {Allopurinol} lowers uric acid levels effectively.
e.zh: 别嘌呤醇能有效降低尿酸水平。

allosaur.t: 异特龙（一种侏罗纪肉食恐龙）

e.en: The museum displays a huge {allosaur} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具巨大的异特龙骨架。

e.en: An {allosaur} could weigh over two tons.
e.zh: 一只异特龙体重可超过两吨。

e.en: {Allosaurs} hunted in the Late Jurassic period.
e.zh: 异特龙在侏罗纪晚期猎食。

e.en: Several {allosaurs} were found at the site.
e.zh: 该遗址发现了几只异特龙化石。

e.en: The drug binds to an {allosteric} site.
e.zh: 该药物结合在变构位点上。

e.en: They studied the enzyme's {allosteric} regulation.
e.zh: 他们研究了这种酶的变构调节。

e.en: The protein is {allosterically} activated by ATP.
e.zh: 该蛋白通过变构方式被ATP激活。

e.en: This compound {allosterically} inhibits the receptor.
e.zh: 此化合物以变构方式抑制该受体。

e.en: {Allostery} explains how hemoglobin binds oxygen.
e.zh: 变构作用解释了血红蛋白如何结合氧气。

e.en: He lectured on enzyme {allostery}.
e.zh: 他讲授了酶的变构现象。

allotransplanted.t: 异体移植的；进行同种异体移植的

e.en: The {allotransplanted} kidney functioned well.
e.zh: 这枚异体移植的肾脏功能良好。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {allotransplanted} tissue closely.
e.zh: 医生密切监测了异体移植的组织。

e.en: Diamond is an {allotrope} of carbon.
e.zh: 金刚石是碳的一种同素异形体。

e.en: Graphene is another fascinating {allotrope}.
e.zh: 石墨烯是另一种令人着迷的同素异形体。

e.en: Sulfur exhibits {allotropic} forms.
e.zh: 硫表现出同素异形形式。

e.en: Carbon has several {allotropic} structures.
e.zh: 碳具有若干同素异形结构。

allotropism.t: 同素异形性；同素异形现象

e.en: Carbon's {allotropism} fascinated early chemists.
e.zh: 碳的同素异形性令早期化学家着迷。

e.en: He wrote a paper on {allotropism}.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于同素异形性的论文。

e.en: {Allotropy} explains why carbon takes many forms.
e.zh: 同素异形性解释了碳为何有多种形态。

e.en: Sulfur's {allotropy} is well documented.
e.zh: 硫的同素异形性已被充分记载。

e.en: Only a small budget is {allottable} this year.
e.zh: 今年只有一小笔预算可供分配。

e.en: The {allottable} shares were quickly claimed.
e.zh: 可分配的股份很快被认购完毕。

e.en: The female specimen serves as the {allotype}.
e.zh: 该雌性标本作为副模标本。

e.en: Each antibody {allotype} differs slightly between individuals.
e.zh: 每种抗体异型在个体之间略有差异。

e.en: The proteins differ {allotypically} among populations.
e.zh: 这些蛋白质在不同种群间以异型方式存在差异。

e.en: Antibodies vary {allotypically} between donors.
e.zh: 抗体在不同供体之间表现出异型差异。

allover.t: 满铺的；遍布全身的（图案）

e.en: She wore a dress with an {allover} floral print.
e.zh: 她穿着一条满铺花卉图案的连衣裙。

e.en: The wallpaper has an {allover} geometric design.
e.zh: 这款墙纸采用满铺几何图案。

e.en: You may {allowably} claim travel expenses.
e.zh: 你可以在容许范围内申报差旅费用。

e.en: He had {allowably} bent the rules.
e.zh: 他在容许范围内变通了规则。

e.en: Researchers used {alloxan} to induce diabetes in mice.
e.zh: 研究人员使用阿脲在小鼠中诱发糖尿病。

e.en: {Alloxan} damages pancreatic beta cells.
e.zh: 阿脲会损伤胰腺β细胞。

e.en: They detected an {allozyme} variant in the population.
e.zh: 他们在该种群中检测到一种等位酶变体。

e.en: Each {allozyme} reflects allelic variation at one locus.
e.zh: 每种等位酶反映了一个位点的等位基因变异。

e.en: {Allozymes} were once key markers in population genetics.
e.zh: 等位酶曾是种群遗传学的重要标记。

e.en: They compared {allozymes} across fish populations.
e.zh: 他们比较了不同鱼类种群的等位酶。

e.en: The judge delivered a stern {allocution} before sentencing.
e.zh: 法官在量刑前作了严厉的训诫。

e.en: Her opening {allocution} set the tone for the ceremony.
e.zh: 她的开场致辞为整个典礼定下了基调。

allod.t: 完全自主的土地；自由地产

e.en: The family farm was held as an {allod}.
e.zh: 这座家庭农场作为完全自主的地产持有。

e.en: Few estates remained an {allod} after the conquest.
e.zh: 征服之后几乎没有庄园仍属自由地产。

allodial.t: 完全自主拥有的；不附封建义务的

e.en: He claimed {allodial} title to the farm.
e.zh: 他主张对该农场拥有完全自主的所有权。

e.en: Few states still recognize truly {allodial} land.
e.zh: 如今很少有国家仍承认真正的自主地产。

allodially.t: 以完全自主的方式持有

e.en: The land was held {allodially} by the family.
e.zh: 这块地由该家族以完全自主的方式持有。

e.en: Property owned {allodially} owes no feudal duties.
e.zh: 以完全自主方式拥有的财产不承担封建义务。

allodium.t: 完全自主的土地；自由产业

e.en: The estate passed down as an {allodium}.
e.zh: 这处产业作为完全自主的地产代代相传。

e.en: An {allodium} carries no obligation to a lord.
e.zh: 自由地产不对任何领主承担义务。

e.en: Patients with {allodynia} feel pain from light touch.
e.zh: 异常性疼痛的患者轻轻触碰就会感到疼痛。

e.en: Migraine often triggers {allodynia} on the scalp.
e.zh: 偏头痛常引起头皮的触摸痛。

e.en: Most fruit trees are {allogamous} by nature.
e.zh: 大多数果树天然都是异花受精的。

e.en: {Allogamous} plants rely on pollinators for fertilization.
e.zh: 异花授粉的植物依赖传粉者完成受精。

e.en: {Allogamy} promotes greater genetic diversity in plants.
e.zh: 异花受精促进植物更大的基因多样性。

e.en: Bees facilitate {allogamy} among flowering crops.
e.zh: 蜜蜂促进开花作物之间的异花受精。

allogeneity.t: 同种异体性；遗传差异性

e.en: Tissue {allogeneity} complicates organ transplantation outcomes.
e.zh: 组织同种异体性使器官移植的结果更复杂。

e.en: Doctors must address {allogeneity} during bone marrow transplants.
e.zh: 医生在骨髓移植中必须处理同种异体差异。

e.en: The patient received an {allogenic} stem cell transplant.
e.zh: 该患者接受了同种异体干细胞移植。

e.en: {Allogenic} grafts can trigger rejection responses.
e.zh: 同种异体移植物可能引发排斥反应。

e.en: The contract bore an {allograph} from her assistant.
e.zh: 合同上有她助手的代笔签名。

e.en: Courts sometimes question the validity of an {allograph}.
e.zh: 法院有时会质疑代笔签名的效力。

e.en: Linguists studied the {allographic} variants of the letter.
e.zh: 语言学家研究了该字母的异写形式。

e.en: Notaries must detect {allographic} signatures on wills.
e.zh: 公证员须辨认遗嘱上的代笔签名。

e.en: The newborn developed an {alloimmune} reaction to maternal antibodies.
e.zh: 新生儿对母体抗体产生了同种免疫反应。

e.en: {Alloimmune} thrombocytopenia requires prompt clinical attention.
e.zh: 同种免疫性血小板减少症需要及时治疗。

e.en: Repeated transfusions can cause {alloimmunization} in patients.
e.zh: 反复输血可能在患者体内引发同种免疫。

e.en: Doctors monitor pregnancies for signs of {alloimmunization}.
e.zh: 医生监测妊娠期是否出现同种免疫迹象。

e.en: The patient exhibited mild {allokinesis} after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后患者表现出轻微的不随意运动。

e.en: {Allokinesis} can complicate fine motor tasks.
e.zh: 不随意运动会使精细动作变得困难。

e.en: The neurologist diagnosed her with {allolalia} after testing.
e.zh: 经过检查神经科医生诊断她患有异语症。

e.en: Therapy gradually reduced his episodes of {allolalia}.
e.zh: 治疗逐渐减少了他的异语症发作。

e.en: The crystals turned out to be an {allomer}.
e.zh: 这些晶体原来是同形异质体。

e.en: Chemists distinguished the {allomer} by its composition.
e.zh: 化学家通过组成区分出该同形异质体。

e.en: The two minerals share an {allomeric} relationship.
e.zh: 这两种矿物存在同形异质关系。

e.en: {Allomeric} substances confuse novice mineralogists.
e.zh: 同形异质的物质常令新手矿物学家困惑。

e.en: {Allomerism} explains why these crystals look identical.
e.zh: 同形异质现象解释了这些晶体为何看起来相同。

e.en: Researchers documented {allomerism} among related minerals.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了相关矿物间的同形异质现象。

e.en: {Allomerization} altered the pigment without changing its shape.
e.zh: 同形异质化作用改变了色素却未改变其形状。

e.en: Storage caused gradual {allomerization} of the chlorophyll.
e.zh: 储存导致叶绿素逐渐发生同形异质化。

e.en: The team identified an {allomerous} mineral pair.
e.zh: 研究团队鉴定出一对同形异质矿物。

e.en: {Allomerous} compounds share form but differ chemically.
e.zh: 同形异质化合物形态相同但化学组成不同。

e.en: Biologists measured each {allometron} during growth analysis.
e.zh: 生物学家在生长分析中测量了每个异速生长单位。

e.en: The skull's {allometron} shifted as juveniles matured.
e.zh: 幼体成熟时颅骨的异速生长单位发生了变化。

e.en: The optometrist detected {allometropia} during the exam.
e.zh: 验光师在检查中发现了双眼屈光参差。

e.en: {Allometropia} can cause headaches and eye strain.
e.zh: 双眼屈光参差可能导致头痛和眼疲劳。

e.en: The orchid releases an {allomone} to attract wasps.
e.zh: 这种兰花释放异种信息素以吸引黄蜂。

e.en: Predators sometimes use an {allomone} to confuse prey.
e.zh: 捕食者有时利用异种信息素迷惑猎物。

e.en: The plural ending has several {allomorph} forms in English.
e.zh: 英语中复数词尾有几种语素变体形式。

e.en: Calcite and aragonite are an {allomorph} pair.
e.zh: 方解石与文石是一对同质异形体。

allomorphic.t: 语素变体的；同质异形的

e.en: She analyzed the {allomorphic} variations in the suffix.
e.zh: 她分析了该后缀的语素变体差异。

e.en: Crystals showed clear {allomorphic} differences under the microscope.
e.zh: 晶体在显微镜下显出明显的同质异形差异。

allomorphism.t: 同质异形现象；语素变体现象

e.en: {Allomorphism} produces strikingly different crystal habits.
e.zh: 同质异形现象可产生差异显著的晶习。

e.en: Phonological {allomorphism} fascinates many linguistics students.
e.zh: 音系上的语素变体现象令许多语言学学生着迷。

e.en: Diamond and graphite are {allomorphous} forms of carbon.
e.zh: 金刚石和石墨是碳的同质异形体。

e.en: Geologists collected several {allomorphous} samples for study.
e.zh: 地质学家收集了几个同质异形的样本以供研究。

allomorphy.t: 同质异形性；语素变体性

e.en: English plural {allomorphy} depends on the final sound.
e.zh: 英语复数的语素变体性取决于词尾发音。

e.en: The mineral's {allomorphy} surprised the field crew.
e.zh: 该矿物的同质异形性令野外考察队惊讶。

e.en: The endorsements continued onto an {allonge} attached behind.
e.zh: 背书延续到后面附加的黏单上。

e.en: Lawyers carefully reviewed the {allonge} for valid signatures.
e.zh: 律师仔细审查黏单上的签名是否有效。

e.en: The author published the novel under an {allonym}.
e.zh: 作者用借名出版了这部小说。

e.en: Scholars eventually traced the {allonym} to a real historian.
e.zh: 学者们最终查出该借名属于一位真实历史学家。

e.en: She consulted an {allopath} after trying herbal remedies.
e.zh: 试过草药后她去看了对抗疗法医师。

e.en: The {allopath} prescribed antibiotics for the infection.
e.zh: 那位西医为感染开了抗生素。

e.en: The disease was treated {allopathically} with strong drugs.
e.zh: 该病用对抗疗法以强效药物治疗。

e.en: He prefers handling colds {allopathically} rather than herbally.
e.zh: 他偏爱用对抗疗法而非草药处理感冒。

e.en: The {allopathist} dismissed homeopathy as ineffective.
e.zh: 那位对抗疗法医师认为顺势疗法毫无效果。

e.en: Her father trained as an {allopathist} in Vienna.
e.zh: 她父亲在维也纳接受了对抗疗法医师的训练。

e.en: Modern {allopathy} relies heavily on pharmaceuticals.
e.zh: 现代对抗疗法极依赖药物。

e.en: He combines {allopathy} with traditional Chinese medicine.
e.zh: 他把西医与中医结合起来使用。

allopatric.t: 异域分布的；地理隔离的

e.en: The two species evolved through {allopatric} speciation.
e.zh: 这两个物种通过异域物种形成而进化。

e.en: Mountain ranges create {allopatric} populations of birds.
e.zh: 山脉形成了鸟类的异域种群。

e.en: The lizards diverged {allopatrically} on separate islands.
e.zh: 这些蜥蜴在不同岛屿上以异域分布方式分化。

e.en: Populations evolved {allopatrically} after the river shifted.
e.zh: 河流改道后种群以异域分布方式演化。

allopelagic.t: 广深海生的；任意深海层栖的

e.en: Some {allopelagic} fish migrate vertically each night.
e.zh: 一些广深海层鱼类每晚作垂直洄游。

e.en: The squid is an {allopelagic} predator of small fish.
e.zh: 这种鱿鱼是捕食小鱼的广深海层捕食者。

e.en: The chemist synthesized an {allophanate} from urea.
e.zh: 化学家用尿素合成了一种脲基甲酸酯。

e.en: {Allophanate} bonds strengthen certain polyurethane materials.
e.zh: 脲基甲酸酯键能增强某些聚氨酯材料。

e.en: Volcanic soils often contain abundant {allophane} clay.
e.zh: 火山土壤常含有大量水铝英石黏土。

e.en: {Allophane} can absorb high amounts of phosphate.
e.zh: 水铝英石能吸附大量磷酸盐。

e.en: The molecule contains an {allophanyl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个脲基甲酰基。

e.en: Researchers studied how the {allophanyl} unit reacts.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了脲基甲酰基的反应方式。

e.en: The aspirated p is an {allophone} of /p/.
e.zh: 送气的 p 是 /p/ 的一个音位变体。

e.en: Speakers rarely notice an {allophone} in their language.
e.zh: 说话者很少察觉自己语言中的音位变体。

e.en: English /t/ has several {allophones} in different positions.
e.zh: 英语 /t/ 在不同位置有几种音位变体。

e.en: Phoneticians transcribe {allophones} using detailed symbols.
e.zh: 语音学家用细致的符号转写音位变体。

alphabetism.t: 按字母顺序的偏见；字母歧视

e.en: Some critics call ballot order a form of {alphabetism}.
e.zh: 有些评论者把选票顺序称为一种字母歧视。

e.en: Hiring decisions should not suffer from {alphabetism}.
e.zh: 招聘决定不应受字母顺序偏见的影响。

alphabetization.t: 按字母顺序排列；字母排序

e.en: The {alphabetization} of the index took an entire afternoon.
e.zh: 索引的字母排序花了整整一个下午。

e.en: Strict {alphabetization} makes the glossary easy to scan.
e.zh: 严格按字母排序使词汇表便于查阅。

alphametic.t: 字母算式；字母数字谜题

e.en: The puzzle page featured a tricky {alphametic} this week.
e.zh: 本周的谜题版刊登了一道棘手的字母算式。

e.en: Solving an {alphametic} requires careful logical deduction.
e.zh: 破解字母算式需要细致的逻辑推理。

e.en: The files are sorted {alphanumerically} for quick lookup.
e.zh: 文件按字母数字顺序排列以便快速查找。

e.en: Please label the boxes {alphanumerically}.
e.zh: 请按字母数字方式给箱子贴标签。

alphorn.t: 阿尔卑斯长号；木制长号

e.en: A shepherd played the {alphorn} on the misty hillside.
e.zh: 一位牧羊人在雾蒙蒙的山坡上吹着阿尔卑斯长号。

e.en: The festival opened with a haunting {alphorn} call.
e.zh: 音乐节以一段悠远的阿尔卑斯长号声开场。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed a rare case of {alphosis}.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生诊断出一例罕见的色素缺乏症。

e.en: {Alphosis} can leave noticeable pale patches on the skin.
e.zh: 色素缺乏症会在皮肤上留下明显的浅色斑块。

alpine-style.t: 阿尔卑斯式（轻装快速登山）

e.en: They climbed the peak {alpine-style}, carrying minimal gear.
e.zh: 他们以阿尔卑斯式攀登顶峰，只带最少的装备。

e.en: An {alpine-style} ascent demands speed and stamina.
e.zh: 阿尔卑斯式登顶需要速度与耐力。

also-ran.t: 落选者；竞争中的失败者

e.en: He was just an {also-ran} in the primary election.
e.zh: 他在初选中只是个落选者。

e.en: The startup quickly went from rising star to {also-ran}.
e.zh: 那家初创公司很快从新星沦为陪跑者。

e.en: The headlines ignored the {also-rans} of the race.
e.zh: 头条新闻忽略了比赛中的陪跑者。

e.en: History rarely remembers political {also-rans}.
e.zh: 历史很少记住政治上的落选者。

alsoran.t: 落选者；陪跑者（also-ran 的连写）

e.en: In the headlines he was branded an {alsoran} again.
e.zh: 在头条中他再次被贴上陪跑者的标签。

e.en: Few sponsors back an {alsoran} in such a tough field.
e.zh: 在如此激烈的赛场上，很少有赞助商支持落选者。

altiport.t: 高山机场；山地简易机场

e.en: The rescue plane landed at a tiny {altiport} in the Alps.
e.zh: 救援飞机降落在阿尔卑斯山的一个小型高山机场。

e.en: Only experienced pilots can use that {altiport}.
e.zh: 只有经验丰富的飞行员才能使用那个高山机场。

e.en: His speech was full of {altisonant} phrases that impressed nobody.
e.zh: 他的演讲满是华而不实的辞藻，却没打动任何人。

e.en: The poet preferred plain words to {altisonant} ones.
e.zh: 这位诗人宁愿用平实的字眼，也不爱浮夸之词。

e.en: The saxophonist hit a clear {altissimo} note.
e.zh: 萨克斯手吹出了一个清亮的超高音。

e.en: Playing in the {altissimo} register takes years of practice.
e.zh: 吹奏超高音区需要多年的练习。

altithermal.t: 高温期的；全新世气候最暖期

e.en: Sediments record the {altithermal} climate of prehistoric times.
e.zh: 沉积物记录了史前的高温期气候。

e.en: During the {altithermal} period, forests expanded northward.
e.zh: 在高温期，森林向北扩展。

e.en: From the {altitudinous} peak we could see three countries.
e.zh: 从那高耸的山峰上，我们能看到三个国家。

e.en: He spoke with an {altitudinous} air of authority.
e.zh: 他说话带着一种居高临下的权威感。

e.en: The temple wall is decorated with intricate {alto-relievo} carvings.
e.zh: 庙宇的墙壁上装饰着精美的高浮雕。

e.en: He studied the {alto-relievo} on the cathedral facade.
e.zh: 他研究了大教堂正面上的高浮雕。

e.en: Layers of {altocumuli} drifted across the afternoon sky.
e.zh: 一层层高积云飘过午后的天空。

e.en: The forecaster pointed at the {altocumuli} on the satellite image.
e.zh: 预报员指着卫星图上的高积云。

e.en: A bank of {altocumulus} signaled changing weather.
e.zh: 一片高积云预示着天气变化。

e.en: Pilots watched for turbulence near the {altocumulus} layer.
e.zh: 飞行员留心高积云层附近的颠簸。

e.en: The famous {altoist} played a long, soulful solo.
e.zh: 那位著名的中音萨克斯手吹了一段悠长动情的独奏。

e.en: She trained for years to become a respected {altoist}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年，成为一位受人尊敬的中音萨克斯演奏家。

e.en: The museum displays a Renaissance {altorilievo} of saints.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一件文艺复兴时期描绘圣徒的高浮雕。

e.en: He admired the depth of the {altorilievo} on the door.
e.zh: 他赞叹门上高浮雕的雕刻深度。

e.en: Thick {altostrati} dimmed the afternoon light.
e.zh: 厚厚的高层云使午后的阳光变得昏暗。

e.en: The {altostrati} stretched from horizon to horizon.
e.zh: 高层云从地平线一端延伸到另一端。

e.en: A grey sheet of {altostratus} covered the sky.
e.zh: 一层灰色的高层云遮住了整个天空。

e.en: Light rain often falls from {altostratus} clouds.
e.zh: 高层云常常带来小雨。

altricial.t: 晚成的；雏鸟需亲鸟哺育的

e.en: Songbirds are {altricial} and need their parents for weeks.
e.zh: 鸣禽是晚成性的，幼鸟需要父母照顾数周。

e.en: {Altricial} chicks hatch blind and helpless.
e.zh: 晚成性的雏鸟出壳时眼盲且无助。

e.en: The alchemist heated mercury in an {aludel}.
e.zh: 炼金术士在升华罐中加热水银。

e.en: Old {aludel} jars are displayed in the science museum.
e.zh: 科学博物馆展出了一些古老的升华罐。

e.en: The {alula} helps a bird control its flight at low speeds.
e.zh: 小翼羽帮助鸟在低速飞行时保持稳定。

e.en: You can see the {alula} flick up when the sparrow lands.
e.zh: 麻雀降落时，可以看到小翼羽向上翘起。

e.en: The hawk spread its {alulae} as it slowed for landing.
e.zh: 老鹰减速着陆时张开了小翼羽。

e.en: Both {alulae} were damaged in the accident.
e.zh: 两侧的小翼羽都在事故中受损。

e.en: The {alular} feathers act like an aircraft slat.
e.zh: 小翼羽的作用类似飞机的前缘缝翼。

e.en: He examined the {alular} structure under a microscope.
e.zh: 他在显微镜下检查小翼羽的结构。

e.en: The thermocouple uses an {alumel} wire paired with chromel.
e.zh: 该热电偶使用镍铝合金丝与镍铬合金丝配对。

e.en: {Alumel} is valued for its stability at high temperatures.
e.zh: 镍铝合金因在高温下稳定而备受重视。

alumel-chromel.t: 镍铝-镍铬合金（K 型热电偶）

e.en: They calibrated the furnace using an {alumel-chromel} thermocouple.
e.zh: 他们用镍铝-镍铬热电偶校准了炉子。

e.en: {Alumel-chromel} pairs are common in industrial sensors.
e.zh: 镍铝-镍铬组合在工业传感器中很常见。

e.en: The old recipe calls for a pinch of {alumen}.
e.zh: 这份古老的配方需要加一小撮明矾。

e.en: Tanners once treated hides with {alumen}.
e.zh: 鞣革匠曾用明矾处理兽皮。

e.en: Sodium {aluminate} is used in water treatment.
e.zh: 铝酸钠被用于水处理。

e.en: The cement contains calcium {aluminate} compounds.
e.zh: 这种水泥含有铝酸钙化合物。

e.en: Several {aluminates} were tested as catalysts.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了几种铝酸盐作为催化剂。

e.en: Calcium {aluminates} give the cement its strength.
e.zh: 铝酸钙化合物赋予水泥强度。

e.en: The mineral has a high {aluminic} content.
e.zh: 这种矿物含铝量很高。

e.en: They studied the {aluminic} compounds in the soil.
e.zh: 他们研究了土壤中的含铝化合物。

e.en: Nickel {aluminide} coatings protect turbine blades.
e.zh: 镍铝化物涂层用于保护涡轮叶片。

e.en: The alloy forms a hard {aluminide} layer when heated.
e.zh: 该合金加热后会形成坚硬的铝化物层。

e.en: The region has rich {aluminiferous} deposits.
e.zh: 该地区有丰富的含铝矿藏。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {aluminiferous} layers carefully.
e.zh: 地质学家仔细绘制了含铝矿层的分布图。

e.en: The boat pulled up {along-side} the dock.
e.zh: 船停靠在码头旁边。

e.en: She worked {along-side} her colleagues all night.
e.zh: 她和同事们一起工作了一整夜。

e.en: Fishing boats drifted {alongshore} at dawn.
e.zh: 渔船在黎明时分沿岸漂行。

e.en: They walked {alongshore} collecting shells.
e.zh: 他们沿着海岸边走边捡贝壳。

e.en: The {alongshoreman} unloaded crates from the freighter.
e.zh: 那名码头工人从货船上卸下木箱。

e.en: Every {alongshoreman} on the pier joined the strike.
e.zh: 码头上每一位装卸工都加入了罢工。

e.en: Bring your passport {alongwith} the application.
e.zh: 请携带护照连同申请表一起。

e.en: She came {alongwith} her two sisters.
e.zh: 她和两个姐妹一起来了。

alot.t: 许多（a lot 的常见误拼）

e.en: He talks {alot} about his old job.
e.zh: 他经常谈起以前的工作。

e.en: Thanks {alot} for helping me move.
e.zh: 非常感谢你帮我搬家。

alow.t: 在下方；在船舱底部（航海术语）

e.en: The sailors stowed the cargo {alow}.
e.zh: 水手们把货物堆放在船舱底部。

e.en: Sails were set both aloft and {alow}.
e.zh: 船帆在上下方都张起。

alpenhorn.t: 阿尔卑斯长号；高山号角

e.en: A herdsman played the {alpenhorn} at sunset.
e.zh: 一位牧人在日落时吹响阿尔卑斯长号。

e.en: The deep tone of the {alpenhorn} echoed across the valley.
e.zh: 阿尔卑斯长号低沉的乐声在山谷中回荡。

alpenstock.t: 登山杖；阿尔卑斯登山手杖

e.en: He leaned on his {alpenstock} as he climbed.
e.zh: 他一边攀登一边拄着登山杖。

e.en: Every hiker carried a sturdy {alpenstock}.
e.zh: 每位登山者都拿着一根结实的登山杖。

alpestrine.t: 亚高山带的；生长于高山地区的

e.en: Botanists collected several {alpestrine} flowers.
e.zh: 植物学家采集了几种亚高山带的花卉。

e.en: The slope was covered in {alpestrine} vegetation.
e.zh: 山坡上长满了亚高山带的植被。

e.en: The drug blocks {alpha-adrenergic} receptors.
e.zh: 该药物可阻断α-肾上腺素能受体。

e.en: Doctors study {alpha-adrenergic} responses in patients.
e.zh: 医生研究患者的α-肾上腺素能反应。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {alpha-blocker} for hypertension.
e.zh: 医生开了一种α受体阻滞剂治疗高血压。

e.en: He takes an {alpha-blocker} every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早晨服用一片α受体阻滞剂。

e.en: The reaction occurs at the {alpha-carbon} of the molecule.
e.zh: 反应发生在该分子的α碳原子上。

e.en: Substituents on the {alpha-carbon} affect chirality.
e.zh: α碳原子上的取代基会影响手性。

e.en: The crystal exists in an {alpha-form} at low temperature.
e.zh: 该晶体在低温下以α型存在。

e.en: Researchers compared the {alpha-form} with the beta variant.
e.zh: 研究人员将α型与β型进行了对比。

e.en: The protein has an {alpha-helical} structure.
e.zh: 该蛋白质具有α螺旋结构。

e.en: Many membrane proteins contain {alpha-helical} segments.
e.zh: 许多膜蛋白都含有α螺旋片段。

e.en: Patients received {alpha-interferon} as part of the trial.
e.zh: 患者在试验中接受了α干扰素治疗。

e.en: {Alpha-interferon} can help fight certain viral infections.
e.zh: α干扰素有助于对抗某些病毒感染。

e.en: The lab synthesized {alpha-naphthol} from naphthalene.
e.zh: 实验室用萘合成出α-萘酚。

e.en: {Alpha-naphthol} is used in chemical assays.
e.zh: α-萘酚被用于化学检测。

alpha-numeric.t: 字母数字的；含字母与数字的

e.en: Choose an {alpha-numeric} password for security.
e.zh: 为了安全请选择一个字母数字组合的密码。

e.en: The code uses an {alpha-numeric} format.
e.zh: 该代码采用字母数字混合格式。

e.en: {Alpha-oxidation} removes one carbon from the fatty acid.
e.zh: α氧化作用从脂肪酸中除去一个碳原子。

e.en: Defects in {alpha-oxidation} can cause disease.
e.zh: α氧化作用的缺陷可能会引发疾病。

e.en: The detector measures every incoming {alpha-particle}.
e.zh: 该探测器会测量每一个射入的α粒子。

e.en: An {alpha-particle} consists of two protons and two neutrons.
e.zh: 一个α粒子由两个质子和两个中子组成。

e.en: The medication targets the {alpha-receptor} in blood vessels.
e.zh: 该药物作用于血管中的α受体。

e.en: {Alpha-receptor} activity influences blood pressure.
e.zh: α受体的活性会影响血压。

e.en: The software is still in {alpha-test} stage.
e.zh: 该软件仍处于α测试阶段。

e.en: Engineers ran an {alpha-test} before the public release.
e.zh: 工程师在公开发布前进行了α测试。

alphabet-soup.t: 字母汤；杂乱难懂的缩略语堆砌

e.en: The report was an {alphabet-soup} of agency acronyms.
e.zh: 报告里满是各机构缩写，让人一头雾水。

e.en: Children love eating {alphabet-soup} for lunch.
e.zh: 孩子们午餐喜欢吃字母汤。

e.en: The teacher patiently helped each {alphabetarian}.
e.zh: 老师耐心地辅导每一位刚学字母的小学生。

e.en: He felt like an {alphabetarian} starting a new language.
e.zh: 开始学新语言时，他觉得自己像个刚入门的初学者。

e.en: The {alphabetisation} of the catalogue took weeks.
e.zh: 将目录按字母顺序排列花了好几周。

e.en: Rural {alphabetisation} programs reduced illiteracy.
e.zh: 农村扫盲项目降低了文盲率。

e.en: Please {alphabetise} these files before lunch.
e.zh: 请在午饭前把这些文件按字母顺序排好。

e.en: She likes to {alphabetise} her bookshelf every spring.
e.zh: 她喜欢每年春天把书架按字母顺序整理一遍。

e.en: The {alphabetised} list made searching easy.
e.zh: 这份按字母顺序排列的清单查找起来很方便。

e.en: He handed me a neatly {alphabetised} folder.
e.zh: 他递给我一个按字母顺序整理整齐的文件夹。

alphabetiser.t: 按字母顺序排序者；字母排序工具

e.en: She is a meticulous {alphabetiser} of every shelf.
e.zh: 她对每个书架都按字母顺序细致地整理。

e.en: The online {alphabetiser} sorted my list instantly.
e.zh: 在线字母排序工具立刻把我的列表排好了。

alphabetises.t: 按字母顺序排列（第三人称单数）

e.en: The librarian {alphabetises} new arrivals each morning.
e.zh: 图书管理员每天早上把新到的书按字母顺序排好。

e.en: He always {alphabetises} his spice rack.
e.zh: 他总是把香料架按字母顺序摆放。

e.en: He served as an {altar-boy} at the local church.
e.zh: 他在当地教堂担任辅祭男童。

e.en: The {altar-boy} carefully lit the candles before mass.
e.zh: 辅祭男童在弥撒前小心地点燃蜡烛。

e.en: The medieval {altar-piece} depicted the Last Supper.
e.zh: 这件中世纪祭坛画描绘了最后的晚餐。

e.en: Tourists admired the gilded {altar-piece} in the cathedral.
e.zh: 游客们欣赏大教堂内镀金的祭坛装饰画。

e.en: The priest's income came partly from {altarage}.
e.zh: 神父的收入部分来自祭坛奉献金。

e.en: Medieval records list the {altarage} of each parish.
e.zh: 中世纪的记录列出了每个教区的祭坛收益。

e.en: Clark Kent is Superman's mild-mannered {alter-ego}.
e.zh: 克拉克·肯特是超人温和的另一个身份。

e.en: On stage she becomes her wild {alter-ego}.
e.zh: 在舞台上她变成了她狂野的另一个自我。

e.en: The contract's {alterability} depends on both parties' consent.
e.zh: 合同的可变更性取决于双方的同意。

e.en: Engineers tested the material's {alterability} under heat.
e.zh: 工程师测试了该材料在高温下的可改变性。

e.en: The terms were written {alterably} to allow future updates.
e.zh: 条款写得可以变更，以便将来更新。

e.en: The settings remain {alterably} configured by the user.
e.zh: 这些设置仍可由用户更改配置。

e.en: Chemists added an {alterant} to modify the solution's color.
e.zh: 化学家加入一种改变剂以调整溶液的颜色。

e.en: The dye acted as an {alterant} on the fabric.
e.zh: 这种染料对织物起到了变性剂的作用。

e.en: Herbalists prescribed an {alterative} tonic for chronic fatigue.
e.zh: 草药师开了一种调理体质的补剂治疗慢性疲劳。

e.en: The tea has gentle {alterative} effects on digestion.
e.zh: 这种茶对消化有温和的调理作用。

e.en: The neighbors began to {altercate} over the fence line.
e.zh: 邻居们开始就栅栏的界线激烈争吵。

e.en: It is unwise to {altercate} with strangers in public.
e.zh: 在公共场合与陌生人争吵是不明智的。

e.en: They {altercated} loudly before the meeting started.
