e.zh: 研究人员从这种植物中提取了阿拉伯半乳聚糖。

aracari.t: 小巨嘴鸟（南美的一种小型巨嘴鸟）

e.en: We spotted a colorful {aracari} in the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 我们在雨林的树冠层中发现了一只色彩鲜艳的小巨嘴鸟。

e.en: The {aracari} has a smaller bill than other toucans.
e.zh: 小巨嘴鸟的喙比其他巨嘴鸟要小。

e.en: Spiders and scorpions are both {arachnidan} creatures.
e.zh: 蜘蛛和蝎子都是蛛形纲动物。

e.en: He studies {arachnidan} anatomy at the university.
e.zh: 他在大学研究蛛形纲动物的解剖结构。

arachnidian.t: 蛛形纲动物的；属于蛛形纲

e.en: Mites belong to the {arachnidian} group.
e.zh: 螨虫属于蛛形纲一类。

e.en: The book illustrates many {arachnidian} species.
e.zh: 这本书绘有许多蛛形纲物种。

arachnodactylia.t: 蜘蛛指（畸形）；指趾细长症

e.en: Patients with Marfan syndrome often show {arachnodactylia}.
e.zh: 马凡综合征患者常表现出蜘蛛指。

e.en: The doctor noted clear signs of {arachnodactylia}.
e.zh: 医生注意到明显的蜘蛛指症状。

e.en: The surgeon carefully avoided damaging the {arachnoid} membrane.
e.zh: 外科医生小心避免损伤蛛网膜。

e.en: The leaves had a fine {arachnoid} fuzz on their surface.
e.zh: 叶片表面长着细密如蛛网的绒毛。

arachnoiditis.t: 蛛网膜炎；脊髓蛛网膜炎症

e.en: Chronic back pain may indicate {arachnoiditis}.
e.zh: 慢性背痛可能提示蛛网膜炎。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with adhesive {arachnoiditis}.
e.zh: 该患者被诊断为粘连性蛛网膜炎。

arachnologist.t: 蛛形动物学家；研究蜘蛛的学者

e.en: The {arachnologist} cataloged dozens of new spider species.
e.zh: 这位蛛形动物学家记录了数十个新蜘蛛物种。

e.en: She became a renowned {arachnologist} after years of fieldwork.
e.zh: 经过多年的野外考察，她成为了知名的蛛形动物学家。

e.en: He published his first paper on {arachnology} last year.
e.zh: 他去年发表了第一篇蛛形动物学论文。

e.en: The museum's {arachnology} department holds thousands of specimens.
e.zh: 博物馆的蛛形动物学部收藏着数千件标本。

arachnophobia.t: 蜘蛛恐惧症；对蜘蛛的恐惧

e.en: Her {arachnophobia} kept her out of the basement.
e.zh: 她的蜘蛛恐惧症让她不敢去地下室。

e.en: Many people suffer from mild {arachnophobia}.
e.zh: 许多人都有轻度的蜘蛛恐惧症。

araeometer.t: 比重计；液体密度计；测密度的仪器

e.en: The chemist read the liquid's density with an {araeometer}.
e.zh: 化学家用比重计测量了液体的密度。

e.en: An old brass {araeometer} sat on the shelf.
e.zh: 架子上放着一只古老的黄铜比重计。

araeostyle.t: 疏柱式（柱距宽阔的建筑样式）

e.en: The temple was built in the {araeostyle} arrangement.
e.zh: 这座神殿采用了疏柱式布局。

e.en: Vitruvius described the {araeostyle} as widely spaced columns.
e.zh: 维特鲁威把疏柱式描述为柱间距很宽的样式。

araeosystyle.t: 疏密交替柱式（古典建筑用语）

e.en: The portico used an {araeosystyle} column rhythm.
e.zh: 这座柱廊采用了疏密交替的柱距节奏。

e.en: Few surviving buildings illustrate the {araeosystyle} clearly.
e.zh: 现存建筑中很少能清晰展示疏密交替柱式。

aragonite.t: 霰石；文石（碳酸钙的一种矿物形式）

e.en: Coral skeletons are largely made of {aragonite}.
e.zh: 珊瑚的骨骼主要由霰石构成。

e.en: The cave glittered with delicate {aragonite} crystals.
e.zh: 洞穴中闪烁着精致的霰石晶体。

aragonitic.t: 霰石的；霰石组成的；含霰石矿物的

e.en: The reef has an {aragonitic} composition.
e.zh: 这片礁石具有霰石的成分。

e.en: Some shells form thin {aragonitic} layers.
e.zh: 有些贝壳会形成薄薄的霰石层。

aragotite.t: 沥青蜡石（一种烃类矿物）

e.en: Geologists rarely encounter {aragotite} in the field.
e.zh: 地质学家在野外很少遇到沥青蜡石。

e.en: The sample turned out to be {aragotite}.
e.zh: 样本最终被鉴定为沥青蜡石。

arahant.t: 阿罗汉（佛教中已证悟的圣者）

e.en: In Theravada Buddhism, an {arahant} has reached liberation.
e.zh: 在上座部佛教中，阿罗汉已达至解脱。

e.en: The monk aspired to become an {arahant}.
e.zh: 这位僧人立志成为阿罗汉。

arak.t: 亚力酒（中东地区的一种烈酒）

e.en: He poured a small glass of {arak} for each guest.
e.zh: 他为每位客人倒了一小杯亚力酒。

e.en: The {arak} turned cloudy when water was added.
e.zh: 加水后亚力酒变得浑浊。

aralia.t: 楤木属植物；五加科观赏植物

e.en: The garden featured several flowering {aralia} shrubs.
e.zh: 花园里种着几丛开花的楤木。

e.en: She placed a potted {aralia} by the window.
e.zh: 她把一盆楤木放在窗边。

e.en: Ancient {Aramaean} kingdoms once flourished in Syria.
e.zh: 古代阿拉米王国曾在叙利亚兴盛一时。

e.en: The inscription is written in an {Aramaean} dialect.
e.zh: 这段铭文是用一种阿拉米方言写成的。

e.en: She added soaked {arame} to the salad.
e.zh: 她把泡发的荒布加进沙拉里。

e.en: {Arame} has a mild, slightly sweet flavor.
e.zh: 荒布味道温和，略带甜味。

e.en: The {Aramean} traders spread their language widely.
e.zh: 阿拉米商人把他们的语言传播得很广。

e.en: He researches ancient {Aramean} culture.
e.zh: 他研究古代阿拉米人的文化。

aramid.t: 芳纶纤维（一种高强度合成纤维）

e.en: Bulletproof vests often contain {aramid} fibers.
e.zh: 防弹背心通常含有芳纶纤维。

e.en: The cable is reinforced with {aramid}.
e.zh: 这根缆绳用芳纶纤维加固。

e.en: The dark {araneiform} markings on Mars puzzled scientists.
e.zh: 火星上那些蜘蛛状的暗色斑纹让科学家百思不解。

e.en: He sketched several {araneiform} figures in his notebook.
e.zh: 他在笔记本上画了几个蜘蛛状的图形。

e.en: The climbers traversed a narrow {arete} between two peaks.
e.zh: 登山者沿着两座山峰之间的狭窄刃岭横切前进。

e.en: A sharp {arete} rose against the morning sky.
e.zh: 一道锋利的刃岭在晨空中拔地而起。

e.en: The {argali} grazed on the high mountain slopes.
e.zh: 盘羊在高山坡上吃草。

e.en: Hunters prize the curved horns of the {argali}.
e.zh: 猎人珍视盘羊弯曲的犄角。

argent.t: 银色；银白色（纹章学用语）

e.en: The shield was emblazoned with a lion {argent}.
e.zh: 盾牌上绘有一头银色狮子。

e.en: The moon cast an {argent} glow over the lake.
e.zh: 月亮在湖面上洒下银白色的光辉。

e.en: The chemist prepared an {argentic} oxide compound.
e.zh: 化学家制备了一种氧化银化合物。

e.en: {Argentic} salts are used in some photographic processes.
e.zh: 银盐被用于某些摄影工艺。

e.en: They discovered {argentiferous} ore in the abandoned mine.
e.zh: 他们在废弃的矿井中发现了含银矿石。

e.en: The region is famous for its {argentiferous} deposits.
e.zh: 该地区以其含银矿藏而闻名。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare specimen of {argentite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块罕见的辉银矿标本。

e.en: {Argentite} is an important ore of silver.
e.zh: 辉银矿是一种重要的银矿石。

e.en: The Latin word {argentum} gives silver its chemical symbol Ag.
e.zh: 拉丁文 argentum 给了银化学符号 Ag。

e.en: Alchemists referred to silver as {argentum}.
e.zh: 炼金术士把银称为 argentum。

e.en: The valley contains thick layers of {argillaceous} rock.
e.zh: 该山谷蕴藏着厚厚的泥质岩层。

e.en: Geologists studied the {argillaceous} sediments along the riverbed.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了河床沿岸的泥质沉积物。

e.en: The artisan carved figures from black {argillite}.
e.zh: 工匠用黑色泥板岩雕刻人像。

e.en: {Argillite} forms when mudstone undergoes mild metamorphism.
e.zh: 当泥岩经历轻微变质时便形成泥板岩。

e.en: {Arginase} catalyzes the breakdown of arginine in the urea cycle.
e.zh: 精氨酸酶催化精氨酸在尿素循环中的分解。

e.en: Researchers measured {arginase} activity in liver tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了肝组织中精氨酸酶的活性。

e.en: The window had an {arciform} top.
e.zh: 那扇窗户的顶部呈弓形。

e.en: Engineers admired the {arciform} bridge.
e.zh: 工程师们欣赏那座弓形桥。

e.en: The stage was lit by an {arclight}.
e.zh: 舞台被一盏弧光灯照亮。

e.en: Old cinemas used a hot {arclight} projector.
e.zh: 老电影院使用炽热的弧光灯放映机。

arcologies.t: 建筑生态城；巨型生态建筑群

e.en: The novel imagined vast {arcologies} housing millions.
e.zh: 小说想象出容纳数百万人的巨型生态城。

e.en: Architects sketched futuristic {arcologies} for the desert.
e.zh: 建筑师为沙漠设计未来主义的生态建筑群。

arctically.t: 北极地寒冷地；冷冰冰地

e.en: She greeted him {arctically} and turned away.
e.zh: 她冷冰冰地跟他打了个招呼便转身离开。

e.en: The wind blew {arctically} across the plains.
e.zh: 寒风像北极一样掠过平原。

e.en: The doctor noted an {arcuate} scar.
e.zh: 医生注意到一道弧形疤痕。

e.en: The temple has {arcuate} doorways.
e.zh: 那座庙宇有弧形的门洞。

e.en: The branches grew {arcuately} over the path.
e.zh: 树枝呈弧形横过小径生长。

e.en: The veins ran {arcuately} along the leaf.
e.zh: 叶脉沿叶片呈弧形分布。

e.en: The cathedral's {arcuation} drew our gaze upward.
e.zh: 大教堂的拱形结构吸引我们仰望。

e.en: He studied the {arcuation} of Roman aqueducts.
e.zh: 他研究罗马水道桥的拱形构造。

e.en: He spoke with surprising {ardency}.
e.zh: 他说话时带着惊人的热情。

e.en: Her {ardency} for the cause inspired others.
e.zh: 她对这项事业的炽烈热忱激励了他人。

areaway.t: 地下室通道；房屋间的天井

e.en: Steps led down to the basement {areaway}.
e.zh: 台阶通向地下室的天井。

e.en: Trash cans stood in the narrow {areaway}.
e.zh: 垃圾桶立在狭窄的地下通道里。

e.en: They chewed {areca} nuts after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们嚼槟榔。

e.en: An {areca} palm stood in the corner.
e.zh: 角落里立着一棵槟榔棕。

e.en: The herbalist hung the leaves for {arefaction}.
e.zh: 草药师把叶子挂起来风干。

e.en: Slow {arefaction} preserved the petals' color.
e.zh: 缓慢的脱水使花瓣的颜色得以保留。

areligious.t: 无宗教信仰的；与宗教无关的

e.en: She grew up in an {areligious} household.
e.zh: 她在一个没有宗教信仰的家庭中长大。

e.en: Many {areligious} people still celebrate cultural holidays.
e.zh: 许多没有宗教信仰的人仍然庆祝传统节日。

arena-rock.t: 体育场摇滚（一种气势恢宏的摇滚乐风格）

e.en: Queen perfected the {arena-rock} sound in the seventies.
e.zh: 皇后乐队在七十年代将体育场摇滚的风格推向了顶峰。

e.en: His band plays loud, anthemic {arena-rock}.
e.zh: 他的乐队演奏震耳欲聋、激昂高亢的体育场摇滚。

e.en: The cliffs are made of {arenaceous} rock.
e.zh: 这些悬崖由砂质岩石构成。

e.en: Geologists noted the {arenaceous} layers in the canyon wall.
e.zh: 地质学家注意到峡谷壁中含沙的地层。

areolae.t: 乳晕（areola的复数）；环状色素区

e.en: The doctor checked the {areolae} for any changes.
e.zh: 医生检查了乳晕是否有任何变化。

e.en: The cactus has small spiny {areolae} along its ribs.
e.zh: 这种仙人掌的棱上长着带刺的小芽座。

e.en: {Areolar} tissue connects the skin to underlying muscle.
e.zh: 蜂窝组织将皮肤与下层肌肉相连。

e.en: The slide showed loose {areolar} connective fibers.
e.zh: 切片上显示出疏松的蜂窝结缔纤维。

e.en: She filled the warm {arepa} with cheese and avocado.
e.zh: 她在温热的玉米饼里夹上奶酪和牛油果。

e.en: A Venezuelan breakfast often features a stuffed {arepa}.
e.zh: 委内瑞拉早餐经常少不了一份夹馅玉米饼。

e.en: The soprano sang a delicate {arietta} between the acts.
e.zh: 女高音在两幕之间唱了一首精致的小咏叹调。

e.en: He composed a brief {arietta} for the opening scene.
e.zh: 他为开场写了一首简短的小咏叹调。

e.en: The opera featured a charming {ariette} in the second act.
e.zh: 这部歌剧在第二幕中有一段迷人的小咏叹调。

e.en: She practiced the {ariette} until it sounded effortless.
e.zh: 她反复练习这首小咏叹调直到唱得毫不费力。

aril.t: 假种皮（包裹种子的肉质外层）

e.en: The bright red {aril} of the yew is its only non-toxic part.
e.zh: 紫杉鲜红色的假种皮是它唯一无毒的部分。

e.en: Birds are attracted to the fleshy {aril} surrounding the seed.
e.zh: 鸟类被种子外那层肉质的假种皮所吸引。

e.en: The botanist examined several {ariled} seeds under the microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家用显微镜检查了几粒带假种皮的种子。

e.en: Many tropical plants produce {ariled} fruits to attract birds.
e.zh: 许多热带植物产生带假种皮的果实以吸引鸟类。

e.en: The seeds are {arillate}, with a fleshy red coating.
e.zh: 这些种子具有假种皮，外层是肉质的红色覆盖物。

e.en: Botanists classified the species as {arillate} based on its seed structure.
e.zh: 植物学家根据种子结构将该物种归类为具有假种皮的。

arillode.t: 假假种皮（由珠孔发育的覆盖物）

e.en: The nutmeg's mace is technically an {arillode}, not a true aril.
e.zh: 肉豆蔻的肉豆蔻皮严格来说是假假种皮，而非真正的假种皮。

e.en: The {arillode} develops from the micropyle rather than the funiculus.
e.zh: 假假种皮由珠孔而非珠柄发育而来。

e.en: The melody had an {ariose} quality that moved the audience.
e.zh: 这段旋律带有咏叹调般的特质，深深打动了观众。

e.en: He preferred the {ariose} passages to the recitative sections.
e.zh: 比起宣叙调段落，他更喜欢咏叹调式的乐段。

arioso.t: 咏叙调（介于咏叹调与宣叙调之间）

e.en: The cantata opens with a tender {arioso}.
e.zh: 这部康塔塔以一段温柔的咏叙调开场。

e.en: Bach often used {arioso} to highlight emotional moments.
e.zh: 巴赫常用咏叙调来突出情感性的时刻。

e.en: The recital featured several {ariosos} from Bach's cantatas.
e.zh: 独唱会演唱了几首巴赫康塔塔中的咏叙调。

e.en: She studied the {ariosos} of the Baroque repertoire intensively.
e.zh: 她深入研究了巴洛克曲目中的咏叙调。

e.en: The children ran {ariot} through the empty house.
e.zh: 孩子们在空荡的屋子里撒野般地奔跑。

e.en: His imagination ran {ariot} as he wrote the story.
e.zh: 他写故事时想象力肆意奔放。

e.en: The lake was {aripple} in the evening breeze.
e.zh: 湖面在晚风中泛起涟漪。

e.en: Her dress was {aripple} with silver beads.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙上银珠闪烁，波光粼粼。

arista.t: 芒（禾本科植物的刚毛状附属物）

e.en: Each grain of wheat is tipped with a slender {arista}.
e.zh: 每粒麦子的顶端都长着一根细长的芒。

e.en: The botanist measured the length of the {arista} on each specimen.
e.zh: 植物学家测量了每个标本上芒的长度。

e.en: He played the role of literary {aristarch} at every gathering.
e.zh: 他在每次聚会上都扮演着文学界严厉批评家的角色。

e.en: Critics feared the old {aristarch}'s sharp pen.
e.zh: 评论家们都惧怕这位老批评家的犀利笔锋。

aristarchian.t: 严苛批评的；吹毛求疵的

e.en: His {aristarchian} review left no detail unscrutinized.
e.zh: 他那篇严苛挑剔的评论没有放过任何细节。

e.en: She adopted an {aristarchian} stance toward modern poetry.
e.zh: 她对现代诗歌持一种吹毛求疵的态度。

e.en: The {aristate} grasses swayed in the wind.
e.zh: 长着芒的禾草在风中摇曳。

e.en: Botanists noted the {aristate} tips of the leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶尖具有芒状刚毛。

e.en: He spoke with an {aristocratical} drawl.
e.zh: 他说话带着一种贵族式的拖腔。

e.en: The mansion had an unmistakably {aristocratical} air.
e.zh: 这座宅邸散发着不容置疑的贵族气息。

e.en: She nodded {aristocratically} to the waiting servants.
e.zh: 她贵族般地向等候的仆人们颔首致意。

e.en: He carried himself {aristocratically} despite his humble origins.
e.zh: 尽管出身平凡，他举止仍有贵族风范。

e.en: Her {aristocratism} alienated her from working-class colleagues.
e.zh: 她的贵族作风使她与工人阶级同事疏远。

e.en: The novel critiques the {aristocratism} of pre-revolutionary society.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了革命前社会的贵族作风。

aristogenics.t: 良种繁育学（优生学的一支）

e.en: Early twentieth-century {aristogenics} has been thoroughly discredited.
e.zh: 二十世纪初的良种繁育学已被彻底否定。

e.en: The lecture traced the troubled history of {aristogenics}.
e.zh: 讲座梳理了良种繁育学颇具争议的历史。

e.en: His essays on {aristology} celebrate the art of fine dining.
e.zh: 他关于饮食艺术学的文章赞颂了精致用餐的艺术。

e.en: Victorian gentlemen treated {aristology} as a serious pursuit.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的绅士们把饮食艺术学视为一项严肃的追求。

e.en: Ancient scholars practiced {arithmancy} to predict future events.
e.zh: 古代学者通过数字占卜术来预测未来。

e.en: She found {arithmancy} more compelling than astrology.
e.zh: 她觉得数字占卜术比占星术更引人入胜。

e.en: As a young {arithmetician}, she could multiply huge numbers in her head.
e.zh: 作为一名年轻的算术家，她能心算巨大数字的乘法。

e.en: The {arithmetician} demonstrated his speed at the chalkboard.
e.zh: 这位算术家在黑板上展示了他的运算速度。

e.en: His {arithmomania} compelled him to count every step he took.
e.zh: 他的计数癖迫使他数出自己走的每一步。

e.en: Doctors recognized her habit as a form of {arithmomania}.
e.zh: 医生认为她的习惯是一种计数癖的表现。

e.en: They tried to {arm-twist} him into signing the deal.
e.zh: 他们试图施压逼他签下这笔交易。

e.en: No one had to {arm-twist} her to join the trip.
e.zh: 根本不用劝说她就答应参加旅行了。

e.en: He was {arm-twisted} into accepting the new role.
e.zh: 他被迫接受了这个新职位。

e.en: The senator {arm-twisted} colleagues for their votes.
e.zh: 那位参议员向同僚施压索要选票。

arm-twisting.t: 强行施压；软硬兼施的劝说

e.en: It took some {arm-twisting} to get the budget approved.
e.zh: 费了一番施压才让预算获得批准。

e.en: The deal was sealed after weeks of {arm-twisting}.
e.zh: 经过数周的强行游说，这笔交易才达成。

e.en: The two friends decided to {arm-wrestle} after dinner.
e.zh: 两个朋友决定饭后扳手腕一较高下。

e.en: He challenged his brother to {arm-wrestle} for the last slice.
e.zh: 他向哥哥发起扳手腕比赛，争最后一块。

e.en: They {arm-wrestled} for nearly a minute before he gave up.
e.zh: 他们扳手腕扳了将近一分钟，他才认输。

e.en: We {arm-wrestled} at the bar just for fun.
e.zh: 我们在酒吧里扳手腕纯粹为了好玩。

e.en: He won the {arm-wrestling} championship two years in a row.
e.zh: 他连续两年赢得了扳手腕冠军。

e.en: The bar hosts {arm-wrestling} contests every Friday.
e.zh: 这家酒吧每周五举办扳手腕比赛。

arch-support.t: 足弓支撑；鞋内的足弓支托设计

e.en: These insoles offer excellent {arch-support} for runners.
e.zh: 这些鞋垫为跑步者提供出色的足弓支撑。

e.en: She bought sneakers with strong {arch-support} for her flat feet.
e.zh: 她为扁平足买了足弓支撑性强的运动鞋。

archaea.t: 古菌；生命三域之一的微生物

e.en: Scientists discovered {archaea} thriving in hot springs.
e.zh: 科学家在温泉中发现茁壮生长的古菌。

e.en: {Archaea} represent one of the three domains of life.
e.zh: 古菌是生命三大域之一。

e.en: Researchers once classified {archaebacteria} as a type of bacteria.
e.zh: 研究者曾把古细菌归为细菌的一种。

e.en: Some {archaebacteria} can survive in boiling water.
e.zh: 有些古细菌能在沸水中生存。

archaebacterium.t: 古细菌单体；古菌旧称的单数形式

e.en: Each {archaebacterium} has a unique cell wall structure.
e.zh: 每种古细菌都有独特的细胞壁结构。

e.en: The biologist isolated a single {archaebacterium} for study.
e.zh: 生物学家分离出一个古细菌单体进行研究。

archaeoastronomer.t: 考古天文学家；研究古代天文的学者

e.en: An {archaeoastronomer} studies how ancient peoples viewed the sky.
e.zh: 考古天文学家研究古人如何看待天空。

e.en: The {archaeoastronomer} examined alignments at Stonehenge.
e.zh: 这位考古天文学家研究了巨石阵的天文方位。

archaeoastronomers.t: 考古天文学家们；研究古代天文的学者们

e.en: {Archaeoastronomers} reconstructed the Mayan calendar systems.
e.zh: 考古天文学家们还原了玛雅历法系统。

e.en: Many {archaeoastronomers} attended the international conference.
e.zh: 许多考古天文学家出席了国际会议。

archaeobotanist.t: 考古植物学家；研究古代植物遗存的学者

e.en: The {archaeobotanist} identified ancient grain seeds.
e.zh: 这位考古植物学家鉴别出了古代谷物种子。

e.en: She works as an {archaeobotanist} at the museum.
e.zh: 她在博物馆担任考古植物学家。

archaeobotany.t: 考古植物学；研究古代植物遗存的学科

e.en: {Archaeobotany} reveals what ancient peoples ate.
e.zh: 考古植物学揭示了古人的饮食结构。

e.en: He specializes in the {archaeobotany} of the Bronze Age.
e.zh: 他专攻青铜时代的考古植物学。

archaeologic.t: 考古学的；考古的（archaeological 的旧式形式）

e.en: The {archaeologic} survey took several months.
e.zh: 这次考古调查持续了数月。

e.en: They reviewed {archaeologic} evidence from the site.
e.zh: 他们审阅了该遗址的考古证据。

archaeologize.t: 从事考古；进行考古发掘活动

e.en: He loves to {archaeologize} on his weekend trips.
e.zh: 他喜欢在周末出游时搞考古。

e.en: The professor encouraged students to {archaeologize} responsibly.
e.zh: 教授鼓励学生负责任地进行考古活动。

archaeomagnetism.t: 考古地磁学；古地磁测年的研究方法

e.en: {Archaeomagnetism} helps date ancient hearths and kilns.
e.zh: 考古地磁学有助于确定古代火塘和窑炉的年代。

e.en: Scholars use {archaeomagnetism} to study Earth's past field.
e.zh: 学者们用考古地磁学研究地球过去的磁场。

archaeometry.t: 考古测量学；用科学方法研究考古遗存

e.en: {Archaeometry} applies physics and chemistry to archaeology.
e.zh: 考古测量学把物理化学方法应用于考古。

e.en: Her thesis focuses on advanced {archaeometry} techniques.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于先进的考古计量学方法。

archaeopteryx.t: 始祖鸟；连接恐龙与鸟类的史前化石

e.en: The {archaeopteryx} fossil bridges dinosaurs and modern birds.
e.zh: 始祖鸟化石将恐龙与现代鸟类联系起来。

e.en: An {archaeopteryx} specimen sold for millions at auction.
e.zh: 一件始祖鸟标本在拍卖会上以数百万美元成交。

archaeus.t: 隐能；炼金术中调控身体的生命本原

e.en: Paracelsus believed the {archaeus} governed bodily functions.
e.zh: 帕拉塞尔苏斯相信隐能掌管身体的各项功能。

e.en: Old alchemical texts often mention the {archaeus}.
e.zh: 古老的炼金术文献常提及隐能这一概念。

archaian.t: 太古代的；地质太古宙的旧式拼法

e.en: The {archaian} rocks are billions of years old.
e.zh: 太古代的岩石有数十亿年历史。

e.en: Geologists study {archaian} formations in Greenland.
e.zh: 地质学家研究格陵兰的太古代地层。

archaise.t: 使古旧；使具古风（archaize 的英式拼写）

e.en: Writers sometimes {archaise} their style for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 作家有时让文风显得古朴以制造戏剧效果。

e.en: He tried to {archaise} the dialogue in his novel.
e.zh: 他试图让小说对白带上古风。

archaist.t: 仿古者；好古者；崇尚古风的人

e.en: The {archaist} preferred Latin to modern English.
e.zh: 这位好古者偏爱拉丁语而非现代英语。

e.en: As an {archaist}, he collected medieval manuscripts.
e.zh: 作为一名好古者，他收藏中世纪手稿。

archaistic.t: 仿古的；带有古风的；好古风格的

e.en: The poem has an {archaistic} tone throughout.
e.zh: 这首诗通篇带有仿古的语气。

e.en: She admired his {archaistic} prose style.
e.zh: 她欣赏他古风式的散文笔调。

archaize.t: 使古旧；模仿古风；让语言显得陈旧

e.en: Some translators {archaize} biblical texts deliberately.
e.zh: 有些译者刻意把圣经文本译得古朴。

e.en: He chose to {archaize} the language for atmosphere.
e.zh: 他选择用古风语言营造氛围。

archaized.t: 使古旧的；做了仿古处理（过去式）

e.en: She {archaized} the spelling to evoke old letters.
e.zh: 她把拼写改得古朴，以唤起旧信件的感觉。

e.en: The script was carefully {archaized} for the period play.
e.zh: 剧本为这出年代戏特意做了仿古处理。

archaizes.t: 使古旧；仿古化（第三人称单数形式）

e.en: He {archaizes} every line he writes.
e.zh: 他把自己写的每一行都做仿古处理。

e.en: The author {archaizes} dialogue in her historical fiction.
e.zh: 这位作者在历史小说中让对白显得古朴。

archaizing.t: 仿古的；正在使古旧；做仿古处理的

e.en: {Archaizing} can make a text feel pretentious.
e.zh: 刻意仿古可能让文本显得做作。

e.en: She avoided {archaizing} her translation of the play.
e.zh: 她避免让剧本译文显得古旧生硬。

archangelic.t: 大天使的；大天使般的；崇高神圣的

e.en: The painting depicts {archangelic} figures with golden wings.
e.zh: 画中描绘了金翼的大天使形象。

e.en: Her singing voice had an {archangelic} purity.
e.zh: 她的歌声有一种大天使般的纯净。

archangelical.t: 大天使的；大天使般的（少用变体）

e.en: Medieval texts often speak of {archangelical} hosts.
e.zh: 中世纪文献常提到大天使军团。

e.en: He felt an {archangelical} presence in the chapel.
e.zh: 他在小教堂里感觉到一种大天使的临在。

archanthropine.t: 古人类的；直立人时期的人科特征

e.en: Scientists examined the {archanthropine} skull fragments closely.
e.zh: 科学家们仔细研究了这些古人类的颅骨碎片。

e.en: {Archanthropine} traits include heavy brow ridges.
e.zh: 古人类的特征包括粗壮的眉脊。

archcompetitor.t: 头号对手；最大的竞争者；劲敌

e.en: Apple is Samsung's longtime {archcompetitor} in smartphones.
e.zh: 在智能手机领域，苹果是三星长期的头号对手。

e.en: He defeated his {archcompetitor} in the final match.
e.zh: 他在决赛中击败了头号对手。

archconservative.t: 极端保守的；极端保守派人士

e.en: The senator is known as an {archconservative}.
e.zh: 这位参议员以极端保守著称。

e.en: Her {archconservative} views surprised her colleagues.
e.zh: 她极端保守的观点令同事们吃惊。

archconservatives.t: 极端保守派人士们；保守至极者们

e.en: {Archconservatives} dominated the party meeting last night.
e.zh: 极端保守派人士主导了昨晚的党内会议。

e.en: The bill was strongly opposed by {archconservatives}.
e.zh: 该法案遭到极端保守派的强烈反对。

archdeaconship.t: 副主教职位；副主教的职务任期

e.en: He was promoted to the {archdeaconship} last spring.
e.zh: 他去年春天升任副主教一职。

e.en: The {archdeaconship} carries significant administrative duties.
e.zh: 副主教一职承担着重要的行政职责。

archducal.t: 大公的；大公爵的；大公国的

e.en: The {archducal} palace dates from the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 这座大公宫殿可追溯到十七世纪。

e.en: She wore an {archducal} crown for the ceremony.
e.zh: 她在典礼上戴着大公冠冕。

archduchess.t: 女大公；大公夫人；大公的女儿

e.en: The {archduchess} hosted a grand state dinner.
e.zh: 女大公主持了一场盛大的国宴。

e.en: An {archduchess} of Austria signed the treaty herself.
e.zh: 一位奥地利女大公亲自签署了条约。

archduchy.t: 大公国；大公统治的领土

e.en: The {archduchy} of Austria once ruled vast lands.
e.zh: 奥地利大公国曾统治广袤的领土。

e.en: Tourists visit the former {archduchy} every summer.
e.zh: 游客每年夏天都参观这个昔日的大公国。

archdukedom.t: 大公爵位；大公国；大公的领地

e.en: He inherited the {archdukedom} from his late father.
e.zh: 他从已故的父亲那里继承了大公爵位。

e.en: The {archdukedom} dissolved soon after the war.
e.zh: 战后这个大公国不久便解体了。

archecentric.t: 以原型为中心的；以本源为中心的视角

e.en: The theory takes an {archecentric} view of language origins.
e.zh: 该理论从原型中心的视角看待语言起源。

e.en: His analysis is unmistakably {archecentric} in approach.
e.zh: 他的分析方法明显以本源为中心。

archegone.t: 颈卵器的旧式拼法；植物雌性生殖结构

e.en: He found the word {archegone} in an old textbook.
e.zh: 他在一本旧课本里发现了这个旧式拼法的颈卵器术语。

e.en: Some nineteenth-century botanists wrote {archegone} instead.
e.zh: 一些十九世纪的植物学家改用这种旧式拼法。

archegonia.t: 颈卵器（复数）；植物雌性生殖器官

e.en: Mosses produce {archegonia} on their tips.
e.zh: 苔藓在顶端长出颈卵器。

e.en: The {archegonia} contain the egg cells.
e.zh: 颈卵器内含有卵细胞。

archegonial.t: 颈卵器的；与颈卵器相关的

e.en: The {archegonial} structure is barely visible without magnification.
e.zh: 颈卵器结构若无放大几乎不可见。

e.en: Botanists study {archegonial} development in ferns.
e.zh: 植物学家研究蕨类植物中颈卵器的发育。

archegoniate.t: 有颈卵器的；具颈卵器的植物类群

e.en: Mosses are classic {archegoniate} plants.
e.zh: 苔藓是典型的有颈卵器植物。

e.en: Most {archegoniate} species reproduce via spores.
e.zh: 大多数有颈卵器的植物通过孢子繁殖。

archegoniophore.t: 颈卵器柄；托起颈卵器的伞状结构

e.en: The liverwort raises its {archegoniophore} on a stalk.
e.zh: 苔类植物用一根柄托起颈卵器柄。

e.en: Scientists examined the {archegoniophore} under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家们在显微镜下观察颈卵器柄。

archegonium.t: 颈卵器；植物的雌性生殖器官

e.en: Each {archegonium} contains a single egg cell.
e.zh: 每个颈卵器内含有一个卵细胞。

e.en: Fertilization occurs inside the {archegonium}.
e.zh: 受精在颈卵器内进行。

archenteric.t: 原肠的；与胚胎原肠腔相关的

e.en: The {archenteric} cavity forms during gastrulation.
e.zh: 原肠腔在原肠胚形成期间出现。

e.en: Embryologists study {archenteric} development closely.
e.zh: 胚胎学家密切研究原肠的发育过程。

e.en: The {archenteron} eventually develops into the gut.
e.zh: 原肠最终发育成消化道。

e.en: During gastrulation, the {archenteron} begins to form.
e.zh: 原肠胚形成时，原肠开始出现。

archeocyte.t: 原细胞；海绵动物的变形细胞

e.en: Sponges contain {archeocyte} cells with multiple functions.
e.zh: 海绵体内含有功能多样的原细胞。

e.en: An {archeocyte} can transform into other cell types.
e.zh: 原细胞可转化为其他类型的细胞。

e.en: He served in the {armed forces} for ten years.
e.zh: 他在武装部队服役了十年。

e.en: The country's {armed forces} were put on high alert.
e.zh: 该国军队进入高度戒备状态。

e.en: She joined the {armed services} after college.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后参军了。

e.en: The bill increases funding for the {armed services}.
e.zh: 该法案增加了对各军种的拨款。

armet.t: 阿米特头盔（中世纪全包式头盔）

e.en: The knight lowered the visor of his {armet} before the joust.
e.zh: 骑士在比武前放下了头盔的面甲。

e.en: The museum displayed a finely crafted {armet} from the 15th century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一顶十五世纪精工制作的全包式头盔。

e.en: The archer wore a leather {armguard} to protect her wrist.
e.zh: 那位弓箭手戴着皮制护臂以保护手腕。

e.en: He strapped on his {armguard} before training.
e.zh: 他在训练前系好了护臂。

armiger.t: 有权佩戴纹章的人；持盾侍从

e.en: As an {armiger}, he was entitled to bear a coat of arms.
e.zh: 作为一名持纹章者，他有权佩戴族徽。

e.en: The young {armiger} attended the knight into battle.
e.zh: 年轻的持盾侍从随骑士奔赴战场。

armigeral.t: 有纹章的；属于持纹章者的

e.en: The family held {armigeral} status for centuries.
e.zh: 该家族数百年来持有纹章贵族身份。

e.en: He researched the {armigeral} traditions of medieval Europe.
e.zh: 他研究了中世纪欧洲的纹章传统。

e.en: Only {armigerous} families could display such heraldry.
e.zh: 只有有权佩戴纹章的家族才能展示这种族徽。

e.en: The clan was officially recognized as {armigerous}.
e.zh: 该家族被正式认定为持纹章家族。

e.en: The astronomer demonstrated the planets using an {armillary} sphere.
e.zh: 天文学家用浑天仪演示行星运行。

e.en: An ornate {armillary} stood in the center of the garden.
e.zh: 花园中央立着一座华丽的浑天仪。

e.en: The ancient empire was renowned for its {armipotence}.
e.zh: 那个古老帝国以其强大的军力闻名。

e.en: His writings praised the king's {armipotence}.
e.zh: 他的著作赞颂了国王的武力威权。

e.en: The poet hailed the {armipotent} hero of the battle.
e.zh: 诗人赞颂这位战场上武力强大的英雄。

e.en: Mars was depicted as an {armipotent} god of war.
e.zh: 战神玛尔斯被描绘成一位武力强盛的神祇。

e.en: The robot extended an {armlike} appendage to grip the box.
e.zh: 机器人伸出一根形似手臂的部件抓住箱子。

e.en: The tree had several {armlike} branches reaching outward.
e.zh: 那棵树有几根像手臂一样向外伸展的枝条。

armlock.t: 锁臂动作（摔跤、柔术招式）

e.en: He forced his opponent to submit with a tight {armlock}.
e.zh: 他用一个紧紧的锁臂动作迫使对手认输。

e.en: The instructor demonstrated how to escape an {armlock}.
e.zh: 教练示范了如何挣脱锁臂招式。

e.en: Benjamin Franklin invented the glass {armonica} in 1761.
e.zh: 本杰明·富兰克林于1761年发明了玻璃琴。

e.en: She played a haunting melody on the {armonica}.
e.zh: 她用玻璃琴演奏了一段萦绕心头的旋律。

e.en: The young {armor-bearer} carried his master's shield into battle.
e.zh: 年轻的持盾兵将主人的盾牌带上了战场。

e.en: In the Bible, Jonathan's {armor-bearer} stood loyally by his side.
e.zh: 在《圣经》中，约拿单的持盾兵忠诚地守在他身旁。

e.en: The {armor-clad} knights charged across the field.
e.zh: 披甲的骑士们冲过原野。

e.en: An {armor-clad} vehicle rolled into the city.
e.zh: 一辆装甲车驶入城中。

e.en: The tank's hull is reinforced with thick {armor-plate}.
e.zh: 坦克的车体用厚实的装甲钢板加固。

e.en: They needed to {armor-plate} the new patrol vehicle.
e.zh: 他们需要给新的巡逻车加装装甲。

e.en: The president travels in an {armor-plated} limousine.
e.zh: 总统乘坐装甲豪华轿车出行。

e.en: The bank used {armor-plated} doors for the vault.
e.zh: 银行的金库装有装甲门。

e.en: The faithful {armorbearer} never left the king's side.
e.zh: 忠诚的持盾侍从从未离开国王身旁。

e.en: He served as {armorbearer} to a famous knight.
e.zh: 他曾担任一位著名骑士的持盾侍从。

e.en: The cash was transported in an {armored-car}.
e.zh: 现金由运钞车运送。

e.en: An {armored-car} blocked the entrance to the embassy.
e.zh: 一辆装甲车封锁了大使馆的入口。

e.en: The {armorist} carefully described each coat of arms.
e.zh: 那位纹章学家细致地描述了每一枚族徽。

e.en: A skilled {armorist} forged the king's new breastplate.
e.zh: 一位技艺高超的制甲师为国王锻造了新的胸甲。

e.en: The {armorless} soldiers were vulnerable to arrows.
e.zh: 没有甲胄的士兵很容易被箭矢射伤。

e.en: He stood {armorless} before his enemy.
e.zh: 他无甲在身地站在敌人面前。

e.en: The {armour-clad} warship sailed into the harbour.
e.zh: 那艘装甲战舰驶入港口。

e.en: He emerged in {armour-clad} splendor.
e.zh: 他披着甲胄威风凛凛地现身。

e.en: The tank fired {armour-piercing} rounds at the bunker.
e.zh: 坦克向碉堡发射了穿甲弹。

e.en: They developed new {armour-piercing} ammunition.
e.zh: 他们研制了新的穿甲弹药。

e.en: The hull was reinforced with thick {armour-plate}.
e.zh: 船体用厚实的装甲钢板加固。

e.en: They will {armour-plate} the new transport vehicle.
e.zh: 他们将给新型运输车加装装甲钢板。

e.en: The minister rode in an {armour-plated} car.
e.zh: 部长乘坐一辆装甲车出行。

e.en: The vault has an {armour-plated} door.
e.zh: 金库装有装甲门。

e.en: His loyal {armourbearer} followed him into every battle.
e.zh: 他忠诚的持盾侍从随他奔赴每一场战斗。

e.en: The young {armourbearer} polished his master's sword.
e.zh: 年轻的持盾侍从擦亮了主人的剑。

e.en: The book contained detailed {armourial} illustrations.
e.zh: 这本书收录了详细的纹章插图。

e.en: He inherited the family's {armourial} bearings.
e.zh: 他继承了家族的纹章。

e.en: The two superpowers were locked in an {arms-race}.
e.zh: 两个超级大国陷入了军备竞赛。

e.en: Critics warned that the policy would trigger a new {arms-race}.
e.zh: 批评者警告说该政策将引发新一轮军备竞赛。

e.en: The boxer has an impressive {armspan} of two meters.
e.zh: 这位拳击手的臂展达两米，相当惊人。

e.en: Her {armspan} gives her an advantage in swimming.
e.zh: 她的臂展使她在游泳中占有优势。

e.en: It took some {armtwisting} to get him to agree.
e.zh: 费了一番功夫施压才让他同意。

e.en: The bill passed only after a lot of political {armtwisting}.
e.zh: 这项法案经过大量政治施压后才得以通过。

armure.t: 阿尔莫尔织物（一种花纹织物）

e.en: Her dress was made of fine silk {armure}.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙用上等丝质阿尔莫尔织物制成。

e.en: The upholsterer chose a heavy {armure} for the chairs.
e.zh: 室内装潢师为椅子选用了厚重的阿尔莫尔织物。

e.en: The committee dissolved into pointless {argle-bargle}.
e.zh: 委员会陷入毫无意义的争吵。

e.en: I have no patience for political {argle-bargle}.
e.zh: 我对政治上的口舌之争毫无耐心。

e.en: They scraped the {argol} from the inside of the wine cask.
e.zh: 他们从酒桶内壁刮下酒石。

e.en: Crude {argol} is refined to make cream of tartar.
e.zh: 粗酒石经精炼可制成塔塔粉。

argonautic.t: 阿尔戈号船员的；远航探险的

e.en: The novel borrows heavily from {argonautic} legend.
e.zh: 这部小说大量借鉴了阿尔戈英雄的传说。

e.en: They set off on an {argonautic} voyage across the Pacific.
e.zh: 他们踏上了横跨太平洋的探险航行。

e.en: Helium is classified as an {argonon}.
e.zh: 氦被归类为惰性气体。

e.en: Each {argonon} sits in the rightmost column of the periodic table.
e.zh: 每一种惰性气体都位于周期表最右一列。

argosies.t: 大型商船；满载货物的船队

e.en: The harbor was crowded with Venetian {argosies}.
e.zh: 港口里挤满了威尼斯的大商船。

e.en: Spanish {argosies} returned laden with silver.
e.zh: 西班牙商船满载白银归来。

e.en: A merchant {argosy} sailed into the Adriatic.
e.zh: 一艘大商船驶入亚得里亚海。

e.en: The library is an {argosy} of rare manuscripts.
e.zh: 这座图书馆藏有大量珍稀手稿。

e.en: They {argufied} for hours over a trivial matter.
e.zh: 他们为一件小事争辩了好几个小时。

e.en: The neighbors {argufied} across the fence again.
e.zh: 邻居们又隔着篱笆吵了起来。

argufier.t: 好争辩的人；爱拌嘴的人

e.en: Her uncle was a notorious {argufier}.
e.zh: 她叔叔是出了名的爱抬杠的人。

e.en: Every village has its resident {argufier}.
e.zh: 每个村子都有那么一个爱争辩的人。

e.en: He {argufies} with anyone who disagrees with him.
e.zh: 凡是不同意他的人,他都要争上一番。

e.en: She {argufies} over the smallest details.
e.zh: 她为最微不足道的细节也要争论。

e.en: Don't {argufy} with your grandmother.
e.zh: 别跟你奶奶顶嘴。

e.en: They love to {argufy} about politics at dinner.
e.zh: 他们喜欢在晚餐时为政治争得不可开交。

e.en: Stop {argufying} and finish your chores.
e.zh: 别再拌嘴了,把家务做完。

e.en: They were {argufying} loudly in the kitchen.
e.zh: 他们在厨房里大声争辩。

e.en: Her essay rests on a single {argumental} thread.
e.zh: 她的文章建立在一条论证主线之上。

e.en: The treatise is intensely {argumental} in style.
e.zh: 这部论著风格极具论辩色彩。

e.en: He gets {argumentive} after a few drinks.
e.zh: 他喝几杯之后就变得爱争辩起来。

e.en: Don't be so {argumentive} about every little thing.
e.zh: 别为每件小事都这么爱抬杠。

e.en: The {argus-eyed} guards missed nothing.
e.zh: 目光锐利的卫兵不放过任何细节。

e.en: She kept an {argus-eyed} watch over the children.
e.zh: 她警觉地看护着孩子们。

e.en: His {argute} criticism cut to the heart of the matter.
e.zh: 他敏锐的批评直指问题核心。

e.en: An {argute} whistle pierced the morning air.
e.zh: 一声尖利的哨声划破清晨的空气。

e.en: She {argutely} pointed out the flaw in his logic.
e.zh: 她敏锐地指出了他逻辑上的漏洞。

e.en: The bird called {argutely} from the rafters.
e.zh: 那只鸟在椽子上尖声鸣叫。

e.en: His {arguteness} as a critic earned him many enemies.
e.zh: 他作为评论家的犀利为他树敌无数。

e.en: There is an {arguteness} to her remarks that startles people.
e.zh: 她的言谈带有一种令人惊讶的锋利。

e.en: There was a bit of {argy-bargy} at the pub last night.
e.zh: 昨晚酒吧里发生了一点小争吵。

e.en: Spare me the political {argy-bargy}.
e.zh: 别跟我讲那些政治上的口水战。

e.en: Long-term silver exposure can cause {argyria}.
e.zh: 长期接触银会引起银中毒。

e.en: His skin turned bluish-grey from {argyria}.
e.zh: 他的皮肤因银中毒而变成青灰色。

e.en: Germanium was first isolated from {argyrodite}.
e.zh: 锗最早是从硫银锗矿中分离出来的。

e.en: The mine yielded a rare specimen of {argyrodite}.
e.zh: 这座矿山出产过一块罕见的硫银锗矿标本。

e.en: The vein was rich in {argyrose}.
e.zh: 这条矿脉富含辉银矿。

e.en: Miners prized {argyrose} for its silver content.
e.zh: 矿工们因辉银矿含银量高而珍视它。

e.en: The temple houses statues of every {arhat}.
e.zh: 这座寺庙供奉着每一位罗汉的塑像。

e.en: In Theravada tradition, an {arhat} has attained liberation.
e.zh: 在上座部佛教中,阿罗汉是已证得解脱的圣者。

e.en: He devoted his life to attaining {arhatship}.
e.zh: 他终其一生致力于证得阿罗汉果位。

e.en: The text describes the path to {arhatship}.
e.zh: 这部经书描述了通往罗汉境界的道路。

e.en: The philosopher distinguished {arheism} from atheism.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把非有神论与无神论区分开来。

e.en: Her position is closer to {arheism} than to denial of God.
e.zh: 她的立场更接近非有神论,而非否定神的存在。

e.en: The patient's heartbeat became {arhythmic}.
e.zh: 病人的心跳变得不规则。

e.en: His footsteps were {arhythmic} and uneven.
e.zh: 他的脚步杂乱无节奏。

arianism.t: 阿里乌教派；阿里乌主义

e.en: The Council of Nicaea condemned {arianism} as heresy.
e.zh: 尼西亚公会议谴责阿里乌主义为异端。

e.en: {Arianism} once spread widely among Germanic tribes.
e.zh: 阿里乌教派曾在日耳曼部落中广泛流传。

e.en: Missionaries tried to {arianize} the Visigoths.
e.zh: 传教士试图让西哥特人皈依阿里乌派。

e.en: Several kings sought to {arianize} their subjects.
e.zh: 数位国王曾试图让臣民信奉阿里乌教派。

ariboflavinosis.t: 核黄素缺乏症；维生素B2缺乏症

e.en: Cracked lips can be a sign of {ariboflavinosis}.
e.zh: 嘴唇皲裂可能是核黄素缺乏症的表现。

e.en: Poor diet led to widespread {ariboflavinosis} in the region.
e.zh: 饮食不良导致该地区普遍出现核黄素缺乏症。

e.en: Chemists isolated {aricine} from cinchona bark.
e.zh: 化学家从金鸡纳树皮中分离出阿日辛碱。

e.en: {Aricine} is structurally related to quinine.
e.zh: 阿日辛碱在结构上与奎宁相关。

army-civilian.t: 军民两用的；涉及军人与平民的

e.en: The base hosts {army-civilian} cooperation drills each spring.
e.zh: 该基地每年春天举办军民合作演练。

e.en: They studied {army-civilian} relations after the war.
e.zh: 他们研究了战后军民关系。

e.en: Her brother is a proud {armyman} stationed abroad.
e.zh: 她哥哥是一名驻外的军人，引以为豪。

e.en: The {armyman} saluted his commanding officer.
e.zh: 那名军人向他的指挥官敬礼。

armyworm.t: 黏虫；行军虫（农作物害虫）

e.en: An {armyworm} infestation destroyed the maize crop.
e.zh: 一场黏虫灾害毁掉了玉米作物。

e.en: Farmers spray pesticide to control the {armyworm}.
e.zh: 农民喷洒农药来控制黏虫。

e.en: Swarms of {armyworms} marched across the field.
e.zh: 成群的黏虫在田野上爬行。

e.en: The {armyworms} stripped the leaves overnight.
e.zh: 黏虫一夜之间把叶子啃光了。

e.en: The cheese gets its orange color from {arnatto}.
e.zh: 这种奶酪的橙色来自胭脂树红。

e.en: Cooks use {arnatto} to tint rice yellow.
e.zh: 厨师用胭脂树红把米饭染成黄色。

arnis.t: 阿尼斯（菲律宾棍棒武术）

e.en: He trains in {arnis} every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都练习阿尼斯棍术。

e.en: {Arnis} uses rattan sticks for sparring.
e.zh: 阿尼斯用藤棍进行对练。

arnotto.t: 胭脂树红色素；红木染料

e.en: The butter is colored with {arnotto}.
e.zh: 这种黄油用胭脂树红染色。

e.en: {Arnotto} gives the dish its golden hue.
e.zh: 胭脂树红让这道菜呈现金黄色。

aroid.t: 天南星科植物；天南星科的

e.en: The greenhouse displays many tropical {aroid} species.
e.zh: 温室里展示着许多热带天南星科植物。

e.en: Collectors prize this rare {aroid} for its leaves.
e.zh: 收藏者因叶片珍奇而推崇这种天南星科植物。

aroint.t: 走开！滚开！（古英语感叹词）

e.en: "{Aroint} thee, witch!" cried the old man.
e.zh: "走开吧，女巫！"老人喊道。

e.en: Shakespeare uses {aroint} to dismiss evil spirits.
e.zh: 莎士比亚用 aroint 一词驱赶邪灵。

aromatic-free.t: 无芳香烃的；不含芳香化合物的

e.en: They sell an {aromatic-free} solvent for sensitive work.
e.zh: 他们出售一种用于精密作业的无芳香烃溶剂。

e.en: The lab requires {aromatic-free} cleaning fluids.
e.zh: 实验室要求使用无芳香烃的清洁液。

e.en: Benzene's {aromaticity} stabilizes its ring structure.
e.zh: 苯的芳香性稳定了它的环状结构。

e.en: Chemists measure the {aromaticity} of various compounds.
e.zh: 化学家测量各种化合物的芳香性。

e.en: Brewers {aromatise} the beer with hops.
e.zh: 酿酒师用啤酒花给啤酒增香。

e.en: Enzymes can {aromatise} testosterone into estrogen.
e.zh: 酶可以将睾酮芳香化为雌激素。

e.en: The {aromatization} of androgens produces estrogen.
e.zh: 雄激素的芳香化反应会产生雌激素。

e.en: Catalysts speed up the {aromatization} reaction.
e.zh: 催化剂能加快芳构化反应的进行。

e.en: Certain enzymes {aromatize} steroids in the body.
e.zh: 某些酶会在体内将类固醇芳香化。

e.en: They {aromatize} the oil with herbs.
e.zh: 他们用香草给油增添香气。

aromatized.t: 已芳香化的；加了香味的

e.en: He drank {aromatized} wine after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他喝了加香葡萄酒。

e.en: The compound was {aromatized} during synthesis.
e.zh: 该化合物在合成过程中被芳构化了。

e.en: This enzyme {aromatizes} testosterone efficiently.
e.zh: 这种酶能高效地使睾酮芳香化。

e.en: The chef {aromatizes} the broth with spices.
e.zh: 厨师用香料给汤底增添香气。

e.en: The {aromatizing} process changes the molecule's structure.
e.zh: 芳构化过程会改变分子结构。

e.en: She is {aromatizing} the oil with rosemary.
e.zh: 她正用迷迭香给油增添香气。

e.en: Nurses provided {around-the-clock} care for patients.
e.zh: 护士们为病人提供全天候的护理。

e.en: The factory runs {around-the-clock} during peak season.
e.zh: 工厂在旺季时昼夜不停地运转。

e.en: They booked an {around-the-world} cruise.
e.zh: 他们预订了一趟环球邮轮之旅。

e.en: He dreams of an {around-the-world} sailing trip.
e.zh: 他梦想着进行一次环球航海。

e.en: Researchers measured the patient's {arousability} during sleep.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了病人睡眠时的可唤醒程度。

e.en: Stress affects emotional {arousability} in adolescents.
e.zh: 压力会影响青少年的情绪激发能力。

e.en: The patient was barely {arousable} after surgery.
e.zh: 病人术后几乎难以唤醒。

e.en: His curiosity is easily {arousable} by puzzles.
e.zh: 谜题很容易激起他的好奇心。

e.en: The collector kept a golden {arowana} in his tank.
e.zh: 那位收藏家在鱼缸里养了一条金龙鱼。

e.en: An {arowana} can leap to catch insects.
e.zh: 龙鱼能跃出水面捕食昆虫。

e.en: "{Aroynt} thee, witch!" he cried.
e.zh: "滚开，女巫！"他喊道。

e.en: The old man muttered "{aroynt}" at the stray dog.
e.zh: 老人对着流浪狗咕哝着"滚开"。

e.en: Pianists often {arpeggiate} chords for effect.
e.zh: 钢琴家常以琶音弹奏和弦以增强效果。

e.en: She learned to {arpeggiate} smoothly across the strings.
e.zh: 她学会了在琴弦上流畅地弹奏琶音。

e.en: The harp's {arpeggiated} chords filled the hall.
e.zh: 竖琴的琶音和弦充满了大厅。

e.en: He played an {arpeggiated} introduction on the guitar.
e.zh: 他用吉他弹奏了一段琶音引子。

e.en: The pianist {arpeggiates} the chord softly.
e.zh: 钢琴家轻柔地以琶音弹奏出和弦。

e.en: This passage {arpeggiates} a minor seventh.
e.zh: 这一段以琶音弹出小七和弦。

e.en: The {arpeggiation} added warmth to the melody.
e.zh: 琶音演奏为旋律增添了温暖感。

e.en: He studied the {arpeggiation} patterns of Bach.
e.zh: 他研究了巴赫的琶音模式。

arpent.t: 阿庞（旧法制土地面积单位）

e.en: The settler owned ten {arpents} of fertile land.
e.zh: 这位移民拥有十阿庞的肥沃土地。

e.en: An {arpent} is roughly equivalent to an acre.
e.zh: 一阿庞大致相当于一英亩。

arquebus.t: 火绳枪（古代轻型滑膛枪）

e.en: The soldier loaded his {arquebus} carefully.
e.zh: 士兵小心地为他的火绳枪装弹。

e.en: An {arquebus} could pierce armor at close range.
e.zh: 火绳枪在近距离能穿透盔甲。

arracacha.t: 阿拉卡恰（南美根茎类蔬菜）

e.en: Farmers harvested {arracacha} roots for market.
e.zh: 农民们收获阿拉卡恰根块拿去卖。

e.en: {Arracacha} tastes like a mix of celery and carrot.
e.zh: 阿拉卡恰的味道像芹菜和胡萝卜的混合。

e.en: They sipped {arrack} after the meal.
e.zh: 饭后他们品尝了亚力酒。

e.en: Sri Lankan {arrack} is distilled from coconut sap.
e.zh: 斯里兰卡亚力酒由椰子汁蒸馏而成。

arrastra.t: 碾矿磨（旧式磨矿石装置）

e.en: Miners used an {arrastra} to crush gold ore.
e.zh: 矿工们用碾矿磨来粉碎金矿石。

e.en: The old {arrastra} still stood beside the creek.
e.zh: 那台旧碾矿磨仍立在小溪旁。

e.en: Shippers paid the {arrastre} charges at the port.
e.zh: 托运人在港口支付了码头装卸费。

e.en: An {arrastre} ground the ore into fine powder.
e.zh: 碾矿磨将矿石碾成细粉。

e.en: His rent fell into {arrear} last month.
e.zh: 他上个月的房租出现拖欠。

e.en: Interest is charged on payments in {arrear}.
e.zh: 逾期未付的款项要收取利息。

e.en: The tenant cleared his rent {arrearage} in May.
e.zh: 房客在五月还清了拖欠的房租。

e.en: Tax {arrearage} can lead to property liens.
e.zh: 拖欠的税款可能导致财产被留置。

artemisinin.t: 青蒿素，一种抗疟疾药物

e.en: {Artemisinin} revolutionized the treatment of malaria.
e.zh: 青蒿素彻底改变了疟疾的治疗。

e.en: She won the Nobel Prize for discovering {artemisinin}.
e.zh: 她因发现青蒿素而获得诺贝尔奖。

e.en: The lungs {arterialise} the blood by adding oxygen.
e.zh: 肺通过加入氧气使血液动脉化。

e.en: Doctors study how tissues {arterialise} venous blood.
e.zh: 医生研究组织如何使静脉血动脉化。

e.en: {Arterialization} of venous blood occurs in the lungs.
e.zh: 静脉血的动脉化发生在肺部。

e.en: The procedure improves {arterialization} of the limb.
e.zh: 该手术改善了肢体的动脉化。

e.en: Oxygen helps {arterialize} the dark venous blood.
e.zh: 氧气帮助使深色静脉血动脉化。

e.en: The lungs {arterialize} blood with each breath.
e.zh: 肺每次呼吸时都使血液动脉化。

e.en: Samples of {arterialized} capillary blood were collected.
e.zh: 采集了动脉化的毛细血管血样。

e.en: The {arterialized} blood appeared bright red.
e.zh: 动脉化的血液呈鲜红色。

arterializes.t: 使动脉化（第三人称单数）

e.en: The lung {arterializes} blood very efficiently.
e.zh: 肺非常高效地使血液动脉化。

e.en: Each breath {arterializes} the venous return.
e.zh: 每次呼吸都使静脉回流的血液动脉化。

e.en: The alveoli are {arterializing} the incoming blood.
e.zh: 肺泡正在使流入的血液动脉化。

e.en: {Arterializing} venous blood requires healthy lungs.
e.zh: 使静脉血动脉化需要健康的肺。

e.en: He was diagnosed with an {arterio-venous} malformation.
e.zh: 他被诊断出动静脉畸形。

e.en: The surgeon repaired the {arterio-venous} fistula.
e.zh: 外科医生修复了动静脉瘘。

e.en: The {arteriogram} revealed a serious blockage.
e.zh: 动脉造影显示有严重阻塞。

e.en: Doctors ordered an {arteriogram} of his legs.
e.zh: 医生为他的腿部安排了动脉造影。

e.en: {Arteriolar} constriction raises blood pressure significantly.
e.zh: 小动脉收缩会显著升高血压。

e.en: The drug acts on {arteriolar} smooth muscle.
e.zh: 该药物作用于小动脉的平滑肌。

e.en: Each {arteriole} branches into many capillaries.
e.zh: 每条小动脉都分支成许多毛细血管。

e.en: The {arteriole} narrowed in response to cold.
e.zh: 小动脉因受冷而收缩。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {arteriotomy} to remove the clot.
e.zh: 外科医生施行动脉切开术取出血栓。

e.en: {Arteriotomy} is sometimes needed in vascular surgery.
e.zh: 血管外科有时需要做动脉切开术。

e.en: She was treated for giant cell {arteritis}.
e.zh: 她接受了巨细胞动脉炎的治疗。

e.en: Untreated {arteritis} can lead to vision loss.
e.zh: 未经治疗的动脉炎可能导致失明。

e.en: {Artesunate} is now the preferred treatment for severe malaria.
e.zh: 青蒿琥酯现在是治疗重症疟疾的首选药物。

e.en: The clinic stocked {artesunate} for emergencies.
e.zh: 诊所储备了青蒿琥酯以备急用。

e.en: Patients often report {arthralgia} after the infection.
e.zh: 患者在感染后常报告有关节痛。

e.en: Persistent {arthralgia} should be evaluated by a doctor.
e.zh: 持续性关节痛应由医生评估。

e.en: She experienced {arthralgic} symptoms in her knees.
e.zh: 她膝盖出现关节痛的症状。

e.en: {Arthralgic} pain worsened in cold weather.
e.zh: 关节痛在寒冷天气中加剧。

e.en: An {arthrectomy} was performed on the damaged joint.
e.zh: 对受损关节进行了关节切除术。

e.en: {Arthrectomy} is rarely chosen as a first option.
e.zh: 关节切除术很少作为首选方案。

e.en: Her grandmother's {arthritical} fingers ached every winter.
e.zh: 她祖母患关节炎的手指每年冬天都疼。

e.en: He walked with an {arthritical} stiffness.
e.zh: 他走路带着关节炎般的僵硬感。

e.en: He moved {arthritically} across the room.
e.zh: 他僵硬地走过房间。

e.en: The old man bent {arthritically} to pick it up.
e.zh: 老人僵硬地弯腰把它捡起来。

e.en: The textbook covers various inflammatory {arthritides}.
e.zh: 这本教科书涵盖了各种炎症性关节炎。

e.en: Different {arthritides} require different treatments.
e.zh: 不同的关节炎需要不同的治疗方法。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {arthrodesis} to relieve the pain.
e.zh: 外科医生建议做关节融合术以缓解疼痛。

e.en: Ankle {arthrodesis} can restore stability after injury.
e.zh: 踝关节融合术可在受伤后恢复稳定性。

e.en: {Arsenous} oxide is extremely toxic to humans.
e.zh: 亚砷氧化物对人体毒性极强。

e.en: The water contained traces of {arsenous} compounds.
e.zh: 水中含有微量的含砷化合物。

e.en: Don't get {arsey} with me about the delay.
e.zh: 别为这点延误冲我发火。

e.en: He's been a bit {arsey} since he lost the match.
e.zh: 输了比赛以后他一直有点暴躁。

e.en: {Arsine} is a colorless and highly poisonous gas.
e.zh: 砷化氢是一种无色剧毒气体。

e.en: The lab tested for traces of {arsine} in the air.
e.zh: 实验室检测了空气中的微量胂。

e.en: The {arsis} marks the stressed beat in the line.
e.zh: 扬音节标示诗行中的重读拍。

e.en: Greek meter alternates {arsis} and thesis.
e.zh: 希腊韵律在扬音和抑音之间交替。

arsy-varsy.t: 颠三倒四的；乱七八糟的

e.en: The whole office went {arsy-varsy} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并之后整个办公室乱成一团。

e.en: His explanation came out all {arsy-varsy}.
e.zh: 他的解释说得颠三倒四。

e.en: She signed up for an {art-appreciation} class this term.
e.zh: 她这学期报了一门艺术鉴赏课。

e.en: The museum offers free {art-appreciation} workshops.
e.zh: 博物馆提供免费的艺术鉴赏讲习班。

e.en: The hotel lobby has a stunning {art-deco} design.
e.zh: 酒店大堂有令人惊艳的装饰艺术设计。

e.en: She collects {art-deco} jewelry from the 1920s.
e.zh: 她收藏二十世纪二十年代的装饰艺术风格首饰。

e.en: {Art-education} is being cut from many schools.
e.zh: 许多学校的艺术教育课程正在被削减。

e.en: He has a degree in {art-education}.
e.zh: 他拥有艺术教育学位。

e.en: That cinema mostly screens {art-films} from Europe.
e.zh: 那家影院主要放映欧洲艺术电影。

e.en: The director made his name with quiet {art-films}.
e.zh: 那位导演靠安静的艺术电影出名。

e.en: Comics are now treated as a serious {art-form}.
e.zh: 漫画现在被视为一种严肃的艺术形式。

e.en: Tea ceremony is a refined {art-form} in Japan.
e.zh: 茶道是日本一种精致的艺术形式。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {art-glass} from Murano.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自穆拉诺的手工艺术玻璃。

e.en: Her studio specializes in stained {art-glass}.
e.zh: 她的工作室专门制作彩绘艺术玻璃。

art-historical.t: 艺术史的；艺术史方面的

e.en: The painting has great {art-historical} significance.
e.zh: 这幅画具有重要的艺术史意义。

e.en: She published an {art-historical} study of icons.
e.zh: 她发表了一项关于圣像的艺术史研究。

e.en: The film became an {art-house} hit overseas.
e.zh: 这部电影在海外成了文艺片热门。

e.en: They met at a small {art-house} cinema downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市区一家小型艺术影院相识。

e.en: The exhibit drew {art-lovers} from all over Europe.
e.zh: 这次展览吸引了来自全欧洲的艺术爱好者。

e.en: As an {art-lover}, she visits galleries every weekend.
e.zh: 作为艺术爱好者,她每个周末都去画廊。

e.en: The school provides {art-materials} for every student.
e.zh: 学校为每位学生提供美术用品。

e.en: She bought new {art-materials} before the term started.
e.zh: 开学前她买了新的美术用品。

e.en: Several {art-works} were damaged in the flood.
e.zh: 洪水中有几件艺术作品受损。

e.en: The gallery displays {art-works} by local painters.
e.zh: 画廊展出本地画家的艺术作品。

e.en: His debut shocked the New York {art-world}.
e.zh: 他的首次亮相震惊了纽约艺术界。

e.en: Scandals like this rarely shake the {art-world}.
e.zh: 这样的丑闻很少能撼动艺术界。

arrow-poison.t: 箭毒；涂在箭头上的毒药

e.en: Tribesmen tipped their darts with {arrow-poison} from tree frogs.
e.zh: 部落人用从树蛙身上提取的箭毒涂在飞镖上。

e.en: The museum displayed bamboo tubes of ancient {arrow-poison}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出装着古代箭毒的竹管。

e.en: The leaves had a sharp, {arrowlike} shape.
e.zh: 那些叶子呈尖锐的箭状。

e.en: She shot him an {arrowlike} glance across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头朝他投来箭一般的目光。

e.en: A row of {arrowwood} bushes lined the garden path.
e.zh: 花园小径两旁种着一排荚蒾灌木。

e.en: Native craftsmen carved straight shafts from {arrowwood}.
e.zh: 原住民工匠用箭木雕刻笔直的箭杆。

arrowworm.t: 箭虫；毛颚类海洋浮游动物

e.en: Plankton samples contained dozens of tiny {arrowworms}.
e.zh: 浮游生物样本里有几十只小箭虫。

e.en: An {arrowworm} darts forward to seize its prey.
e.zh: 箭虫像箭一样射向前方捕食。

e.en: The river rushed past in {arrowy} currents.
e.zh: 河水以箭一般的速度奔流而过。

e.en: He cast her an {arrowy} look and turned away.
e.zh: 他向她投去锐利如箭的一瞥，便转身走开。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with a mild {arrythmia}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有轻度心律不齐。

e.en: Caffeine sometimes triggers a brief {arrythmia} in him.
e.zh: 咖啡因有时会让他短暂出现心律失常。

e.en: Don't be such an {arse-hole} about the bill.
e.zh: 别为账单的事这么混蛋。

e.en: He muttered that his boss was a complete {arse-hole}.
e.zh: 他低声说老板就是个十足的混蛋。

arse-licking.t: 拍马屁；阿谀奉承（粗俗用语）

e.en: I'm sick of his constant {arse-licking} at meetings.
e.zh: 我受够了他在会上没完没了地拍马屁。

e.en: Promotion only came after months of shameless {arse-licking}.
e.zh: 靠着几个月不要脸的拍马屁，他才得到晋升。

e.en: Workers used to {arsenicate} timber to keep insects away.
e.zh: 工人过去用砷处理木材以驱虫。

e.en: Victorian wallpapers were sometimes {arsenicated} for vivid green hues.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的壁纸有时经过砷化处理以获得鲜艳的绿色。

e.en: {Arsenious} acid is extremely toxic if ingested.
e.zh: 亚砷酸如果误食毒性极强。

e.en: The soil contained traces of {arsenious} compounds.
e.zh: 土壤中含有微量含砷化合物。

e.en: Long-term exposure to the well water caused {arsenism}.
e.zh: 长期饮用井水导致慢性砷中毒。

e.en: Doctors documented several cases of {arsenism} in the village.
e.zh: 医生在该村记录了多起慢性砷中毒病例。

e.en: The lab tested the river for {arsenite} contamination.
e.zh: 实验室对河水进行了亚砷酸盐污染检测。

e.en: Sodium {arsenite} was once used as a herbicide.
e.zh: 亚砷酸钠曾被用作除草剂。

e.en: The shop sold {artsy-craftsy} handmade soaps.
e.zh: 那家店卖些故作艺术范的手工皂。

e.en: I find his decor a bit too {artsy-craftsy}.
e.zh: 我觉得他的装饰风格有点太过附庸风雅。

artsy-fartsy.t: 装腔作势文艺范的；故作艺术的

e.en: He gave an {artsy-fartsy} speech about the painting.
e.zh: 他对那幅画发表了一通装腔作势的高谈阔论。

e.en: The film was too {artsy-fartsy} for my taste.
e.zh: 那部电影对我来说太矫情做作了。

arty-crafty.t: 附庸风雅的；故作艺术腔的

e.en: Her studio has an {arty-crafty} vibe.
e.zh: 她的工作室有种附庸风雅的氛围。

e.en: He dismissed the cafe as {arty-crafty}.
e.zh: 他嫌那家咖啡馆太装文艺。

arty-farty.t: 假装高雅的；装腔作势的

e.en: Stop being so {arty-farty} about it.
e.zh: 别再为这事故作高雅了。

e.en: It's an {arty-farty} indie magazine.
e.zh: 这是本装文艺的独立杂志。

e.en: The plant has tall, {arundinaceous} stems.
e.zh: 那种植物长着芦苇般高高的茎秆。

e.en: Botanists noted its {arundinaceous} appearance.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到它呈芦苇状的外形。

e.en: The {aruspex} examined the animal's liver.
e.zh: 占卜师查看了那只牲畜的肝脏。

e.en: Generals once consulted an {aruspex} before battle.
e.zh: 将军们从前会在战前咨询脏卜师。

aruspices.t: 古罗马占卜师们（aruspex的复数）

e.en: The {aruspices} interpreted the omens carefully.
e.zh: 占卜师们仔细地解读那些征兆。

e.en: Senate sometimes summoned the {aruspices}.
e.zh: 元老院有时会召来占卜师们。

e.en: Ancient Romans practiced {aruspicy} before war.
e.zh: 古罗马人在战前进行脏卜术。

e.en: He wrote a paper on Etruscan {aruspicy}.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于伊特鲁里亚脏卜术的论文。

e.en: See you this {arvo} at the beach.
e.zh: 今天下午海滩见。

e.en: We had a beer in the {arvo}.
e.zh: 我们下午喝了杯啤酒。

aryanize.t: 使雅利安化；纳粹时期没收犹太人财产转交雅利安人

e.en: The regime tried to {aryanize} Jewish-owned businesses.
e.zh: 该政权企图将犹太人的企业雅利安化。

e.en: Historians study how the Nazis {aryanized} property.
e.zh: 史学家研究纳粹如何将财产雅利安化。

e.en: The museum displays a Corinthian {aryballos}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一只科林斯式古希腊小油瓶。

e.en: Athletes carried oil in an {aryballos}.
e.zh: 运动员把油装在小油瓶里随身带着。

e.en: The molecule contains an {aryl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个芳基。

e.en: They synthesized a new {aryl} compound.
e.zh: 他们合成了一种新的芳基化合物。

e.en: The reagent is highly effective at {arylating} amines.
e.zh: 该试剂对胺类的芳基化反应非常有效。

e.en: They studied {arylating} agents in solution.
e.zh: 他们研究了溶液中的芳基化试剂。

e.en: Palladium catalyzes the {arylation} step.
e.zh: 钯催化了这一步芳基化反应。

e.en: Direct {arylation} simplifies the synthesis.
e.zh: 直接芳基化简化了合成过程。

e.en: The dye contains an {arylidene} linkage.
e.zh: 这种染料含有芳亚基连接。

e.en: They prepared an {arylidene} derivative.
e.zh: 他们制备了一种芳亚基衍生物。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {arytaenoid} cartilage.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了杓状软骨。

e.en: Inflammation affected the {arytaenoid} region.
e.zh: 炎症影响到了杓状软骨区域。

e.en: She underwent an {arytenoidectomy} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月做了杓状软骨切除术。

e.en: Recovery from {arytenoidectomy} can take weeks.
e.zh: 杓状软骨切除术的恢复可能需要数周。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a mild {arythmia}.
e.zh: 医生诊断为轻度心律不齐。

e.en: Stress can trigger an {arythmia}.
e.zh: 压力可能诱发心律不齐。

as-built.t: 竣工的；按实际建造状态的

e.en: The contractor submitted the {as-built} drawings.
e.zh: 承包商提交了竣工图纸。

e.en: We compared the design to the {as-built} condition.
e.zh: 我们把设计与实际建成的状态进行了对比。

e.en: The cliff is barely {ascendable} without ropes.
e.zh: 没有绳索几乎无法攀登这座悬崖。

e.en: They sought an {ascendable} route to the summit.
e.zh: 他们寻找一条可攀登至顶峰的路线。

e.en: The party's {ascendence} lasted a decade.
e.zh: 该党的支配地位持续了十年。

e.en: Her {ascendence} in the field was undeniable.
e.zh: 她在该领域的优势地位无可否认。

e.en: He is the {ascendent} star of the team.
e.zh: 他是队中冉冉升起的明星。

e.en: Her career is clearly {ascendent}.
e.zh: 她的事业明显处于上升期。

e.en: The tower is {ascendible} by a narrow staircase.
e.zh: 这座塔可经一条窄楼梯登上。

e.en: Few peaks here are easily {ascendible}.
e.zh: 这里少有易于攀登的山峰。

e.en: The balloon's {ascensional} force surprised them.
e.zh: 气球的上升力让他们感到惊讶。

e.en: He calculated the {ascensional} rate of the rocket.
e.zh: 他计算了火箭的上升速率。

e.en: The veteran {ascensionist} led the expedition.
e.zh: 那位资深登山者率领了这次远征。

e.en: Each {ascensionist} carried oxygen tanks.
e.zh: 每位攀登者都携带了氧气瓶。

e.en: The word adds an {ascensive} emphasis.
e.zh: 这个词起到加强语气的作用。

e.en: Smoke moved in an {ascensive} spiral.
e.zh: 烟雾呈上升的螺旋状飘动。

e.en: Monastic life demands strict {ascesis}.
e.zh: 修道生活要求严格的苦修。

e.en: He embraced {ascesis} as a path to clarity.
e.zh: 他把苦行视为通往清明的途径。

e.en: He led an {ascetical} life in the mountains.
e.zh: 他在山中过着苦行的生活。

e.en: Her {ascetical} habits surprised the visitors.
e.zh: 她苦修式的习惯让访客们惊讶。

e.en: The diver photographed a bright {ascidian} on the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石上拍到了一只鲜艳的海鞘。

e.en: Each {ascidian} filters seawater for food.
e.zh: 每只海鞘都通过过滤海水来摄食。

e.en: Colonies of {ascidians} cling to the pier pilings.
e.zh: 成群的海鞘附着在码头桩柱上。

e.en: Many {ascidians} are sensitive to pollution.
e.zh: 许多海鞘对污染十分敏感。

e.en: The {asciferous} fungi were mounted for study.
e.zh: 这些具子囊的真菌被制成标本以供研究。

e.en: Many {asciferous} species fruit in autumn.
e.zh: 许多具子囊的物种在秋季结实。

e.en: The {ascigerous} stage releases the spores.
e.zh: 产囊阶段会释放孢子。

e.en: Researchers cultured the {ascigerous} fungus.
e.zh: 研究者培养了这种产囊真菌。

e.en: The patient showed {ascitical} swelling.
e.zh: 该患者出现腹水性肿胀。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {ascitical} fluid carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细监测腹水液。

asclepiad.t: 萝藦科植物；阿斯克勒庇阿德斯诗体

e.en: The {asclepiad} flowers attracted many butterflies.
e.zh: 这种萝藦科植物的花朵吸引了许多蝴蝶。

e.en: Horace wrote odes in {asclepiad} meter.
e.zh: 贺拉斯曾以阿斯克勒庇阿德斯诗体写颂歌。

e.en: Several {asclepiadaceous} species grow on the prairie.
e.zh: 草原上生长着多种萝藦科植物。

e.en: He studied {asclepiadaceous} pollination.
e.zh: 他研究萝藦科植物的授粉过程。

e.en: The {ascocarp} contains many spore sacs.
e.zh: 子囊果内含有许多孢子囊。

e.en: They sliced the {ascocarp} for microscopy.
e.zh: 他们切开子囊果以做显微观察。

e.en: Many {ascocarpous} fungi appear after rain.
e.zh: 许多具子囊果的真菌在雨后出现。

e.en: The slide showed an {ascocarpous} structure.
e.zh: 切片显示出子囊果结构。

e.en: The {ascogonial} cells divide rapidly.
e.zh: 产囊器细胞迅速分裂。

e.en: He sketched the {ascogonial} stage in detail.
e.zh: 他详细描绘了产囊器阶段的形态。

e.en: The {ascogonium} fuses with the male organ.
e.zh: 产囊器与雄性器官融合。

e.en: Each {ascogonium} gives rise to ascogenous hyphae.
e.zh: 每个产囊器都会形成产囊菌丝。

ascolichen.t: 子囊衣（含子囊菌的地衣）

e.en: An {ascolichen} thrives on the damp bark.
e.zh: 一种子囊衣在潮湿的树皮上生长良好。

e.en: They catalogued every {ascolichen} on the ridge.
e.zh: 他们记录了山脊上每一种子囊衣。

e.en: Yeast is a familiar {ascomycete}.
e.zh: 酵母是一种常见的子囊菌。

e.en: This {ascomycete} infects the wheat crop.
e.zh: 这种子囊菌会感染小麦作物。

e.en: Truffles and morels are prized {ascomycetes}.
e.zh: 松露和羊肚菌都是珍贵的子囊菌。

e.en: Most {ascomycetes} reproduce via ascospores.
e.zh: 大多数子囊菌通过子囊孢子繁殖。

e.en: The lab studies {ascomycetous} fungi.
e.zh: 实验室研究子囊菌类真菌。

e.en: An {ascomycetous} blight ruined the orchard.
e.zh: 一种子囊菌枯萎病毁了果园。

e.en: Sodium {ascorbate} is added as a preservative.
e.zh: 抗坏血酸钠被用作防腐剂。

e.en: The drink contains calcium {ascorbate}.
e.zh: 该饮料含有抗坏血酸钙。

e.en: Oranges are rich in {ascorbic} acid.
e.zh: 橙子富含抗坏血酸。

e.en: The label lists {ascorbic} acid as an ingredient.
e.zh: 标签上列出了抗坏血酸作为成分。

e.en: Each {ascospore} can germinate in damp soil.
e.zh: 每个子囊孢子都能在湿润土壤中萌发。

e.en: The {ascospore} count rises after rain.
e.zh: 雨后子囊孢子数量上升。

e.en: The {ascosporic} stage is short-lived.
e.zh: 子囊孢子阶段持续时间很短。

e.en: They tracked the {ascosporic} release peaks.
e.zh: 他们追踪了子囊孢子释放的高峰期。

e.en: Many {ascosporous} fungi cause crop disease.
e.zh: 许多具子囊孢子的真菌会引起作物病害。

e.en: The species is strictly {ascosporous}.
e.zh: 该物种严格依靠子囊孢子繁殖。

e.en: The error is {ascribable} to a software bug.
e.zh: 这个错误可归因于软件漏洞。

e.en: Her success is largely {ascribable} to hard work.
e.zh: 她的成功主要归功于努力工作。

e.en: Each {ascus} contains eight spores.
e.zh: 每个子囊内含八个孢子。

e.en: The {ascus} ruptures to release the spores.
e.zh: 子囊破裂以释放孢子。

aseasonal.t: 无季节性的；不分季节的

e.en: Sales of the product are largely {aseasonal}.
e.zh: 该产品的销量基本不分季节。

e.en: Tropical rainforests support {aseasonal} growth.
e.zh: 热带雨林支持着不分季节的生长。

e.en: Engineers designed an {aseismatic} foundation.
e.zh: 工程师设计了抗震的地基。

e.en: The building uses {aseismatic} bearings.
e.zh: 这座建筑采用了抗震支座。

e.en: Engineers designed an {aseismic} foundation for the tower.
e.zh: 工程师为这座塔设计了抗震地基。

e.en: The region is considered geologically {aseismic}.
e.zh: 该地区在地质上被认为是无地震的。

e.en: Theologians debate the {aseity} of God.
e.zh: 神学家们讨论上帝的自存性。

e.en: The doctrine of {aseity} holds that God depends on nothing.
e.zh: 自存性教义认为上帝不依赖任何事物。

asemia.t: 符号理解不能；象征失认症

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {asemia} after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后患者被诊断为符号理解不能。

e.en: {Asemia} affects the ability to interpret signs.
e.zh: 象征失认症影响识别符号的能力。

e.en: Surgical {asepsis} prevents infection during operations.
e.zh: 手术无菌技术可防止术中感染。

e.en: Strict {asepsis} is essential in the operating room.
e.zh: 手术室必须严格保持无菌。

e.en: The fungus has {aseptate} hyphae.
e.zh: 这种真菌具有无隔的菌丝。

e.en: {Aseptate} cells lack internal partitions.
e.zh: 无隔细胞没有内部分隔。

e.en: Nurses {asepticize} the wound before bandaging.
e.zh: 护士在包扎前对伤口进行消毒。

e.en: You must {asepticize} all instruments first.
e.zh: 你必须先把所有器械消毒。

e.en: She openly discussed her {asexuality} in the interview.
e.zh: 她在采访中坦率谈论自己的无性恋取向。

e.en: {Asexuality} is common among certain plants.
e.zh: 无性生殖在某些植物中很常见。

e.en: The procedure can {asexualize} the animal humanely.
e.zh: 该手术能够人道地使动物丧失生殖能力。

e.en: Critics argued the policy aimed to {asexualize} the patients.
e.zh: 批评者认为该政策意在使患者去性化。

e.en: He emptied the cinders into the {ash-bin}.
e.zh: 他把煤渣倒进了垃圾箱。

e.en: An old {ash-bin} stood by the back door.
e.zh: 后门旁立着一个旧煤灰桶。

ash-blond.t: 灰金色的；浅金灰色头发的

e.en: She dyed her hair {ash-blond} last week.
e.zh: 她上周把头发染成了灰金色。

e.en: The {ash-blond} child waved from the doorway.
e.zh: 那个灰金发的孩子在门口挥手。

e.en: The sky turned {ash-colored} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨前天空变成了灰白色。

e.en: He wore an {ash-colored} coat.
e.zh: 他穿着一件灰色的外套。

e.en: Children gathered {ash-keys} in the autumn wind.
e.zh: 孩子们在秋风中捡拾白蜡树的翅果。

e.en: An {ash-key} spun down from the branch.
e.zh: 一颗白蜡翅果从树枝上旋落。

e.en: He stubbed his cigarette in the {ash-tray}.
e.zh: 他把烟头摁在烟灰缸里。

e.en: Please pass me the {ash-tray}.
e.zh: 请把烟灰缸递给我。

e.en: She tossed the wrapper into the {ashbin}.
e.zh: 她把包装纸扔进了垃圾箱。

e.en: The {ashbin} was overflowing again.
e.zh: 垃圾箱又满出来了。

e.en: Grandma baked {ashcake} on the hearth.
e.zh: 奶奶在炉膛里烤灰烤玉米饼。

e.en: The settlers ate {ashcake} every morning.
e.zh: 拓荒者每天早上都吃灰烤玉米饼。

e.en: He kicked the {ashcan} in frustration.
e.zh: 他懊恼地踢了垃圾桶一脚。

e.en: Stray cats slept beside the {ashcan}.
e.zh: 流浪猫睡在垃圾桶旁边。

e.en: The alley was lined with rusty {ashcans}.
e.zh: 巷子里排着一溜生锈的垃圾桶。

e.en: Raccoons knocked over the {ashcans} again.
e.zh: 浣熊又把垃圾桶撞翻了。

e.en: The old {ashery} once produced potash for soap.
e.zh: 这家旧制碱厂曾生产做肥皂用的钾碱。

e.en: Workers labored long hours at the {ashery}.
e.zh: 工人们在制碱厂里长时间劳作。

e.en: She carried the roast on a heavy {ashet}.
e.zh: 她端着烤肉放在一个沉重的大浅盘上。

e.en: An old willow-pattern {ashet} sat on the dresser.
e.zh: 碗柜上放着一个旧的柳纹大浅盘。

e.en: Heavy {ashfall} blanketed the nearby villages.
e.zh: 厚厚的火山灰覆盖了附近的村庄。

e.en: Flights were canceled due to the {ashfall}.
e.zh: 由于火山灰降落，航班被取消。

e.en: He shoveled cinders out of the {ashhole}.
e.zh: 他把煤渣从炉灰坑里铲出来。

e.en: The {ashhole} beneath the grate was full.
e.zh: 炉箅下面的炉灰坑装满了。

e.en: Her eyes were {ashine} with excitement.
e.zh: 她的眼睛因兴奋而熠熠生辉。

e.en: The lake was {ashine} under the moon.
e.zh: 湖面在月光下闪闪发光。

e.en: The lotion reduced the {ashiness} of her skin.
e.zh: 润肤露减轻了她皮肤的灰暗。

e.en: He noticed an unusual {ashiness} in her face.
e.zh: 他注意到她脸上有种异样的灰白。

ashler.t: 琢石；方石（建筑用方形石块）

e.en: The wall was built from finely cut {ashler} blocks.
e.zh: 这堵墙是用精细切割的方石砌成的。

e.en: Masons prized {ashler} for its smooth, even surfaces.
e.zh: 石匠们因方石表面平整光滑而格外珍视它。

ashlering.t: 阁楼矮墙；琢石砌筑工艺

e.en: The attic's {ashlering} hid the awkward roof angles.
e.zh: 阁楼的矮墙巧妙遮住了别扭的屋顶斜角。

e.en: Traditional {ashlering} requires patient, precise stonework.
e.zh: 传统的琢石砌筑工艺需要耐心而精确的石作。

e.en: The lab uses {ashless} filter paper for accurate measurements.
e.zh: 实验室使用无灰滤纸以确保测量准确。

e.en: Engineers prefer {ashless} fuels for cleaner combustion.
e.zh: 工程师偏好无灰燃料，因为燃烧更清洁。

ashpan.t: 灰盘；接灰盘（炉下接灰的容器）

e.en: Empty the {ashpan} before lighting a new fire.
e.zh: 生新火之前先把接灰盘清空。

e.en: The stove's {ashpan} slides out for easy cleaning.
e.zh: 炉子的灰盘可以抽出来方便清理。

e.en: Coal dust collected in the {ashpit} below the grate.
e.zh: 煤灰积在炉栅下方的灰坑里。

e.en: He shoveled clinkers out of the {ashpit}.
e.zh: 他从灰坑里把煤渣铲出来。

e.en: The old farmer leaned on his sturdy {ashplant}.
e.zh: 老农夫拄着他那根结实的白蜡木手杖。

e.en: Joyce's Stephen carries an {ashplant} through Dublin.
e.zh: 乔伊斯笔下的斯蒂芬拄着白蜡木手杖穿行都柏林。

ashura.t: 阿舒拉节（伊斯兰教斋戒纪念日）

e.en: Many Muslims fast on the day of {Ashura}.
e.zh: 许多穆斯林在阿舒拉节那天禁食。

e.en: Processions marking {Ashura} filled the city streets.
e.zh: 纪念阿舒拉节的游行队伍挤满了街道。

asiago.t: 阿夏戈奶酪（意大利产硬质奶酪）

e.en: She grated {asiago} over the warm pasta.
e.zh: 她把阿夏戈奶酪刨在热意面上。

e.en: Aged {asiago} has a sharp, nutty flavor.
e.zh: 陈年阿夏戈奶酪有浓郁的坚果香味。

e.en: Many {Asian-Americans} celebrate both Lunar New Year and Thanksgiving.
e.zh: 许多亚裔美国人既过农历新年也过感恩节。

e.en: The exhibit highlighted {Asian-Americans} in science and the arts.
e.zh: 展览着重介绍了科学与艺术领域的亚裔美国人。

asianization.t: 亚洲化（文化或经济上的亚洲影响过程）

e.en: Scholars debate the {Asianization} of global pop culture.
e.zh: 学者们在讨论全球流行文化的亚洲化现象。

e.en: The neighborhood's {Asianization} brought new restaurants and markets.
e.zh: 这一带的亚洲化带来了新的餐馆和市场。

e.en: She rolled her eyes at his sheer {asininity}.
e.zh: 面对他纯粹的蠢话，她翻了个白眼。

e.en: The proposal's {asininity} was clear to everyone.
e.zh: 这个提案的愚蠢之处大家都看得出来。

e.en: He looked {askant} at the stranger's offer.
e.zh: 他斜着眼怀疑地打量陌生人的提议。

e.en: The villagers eyed the newcomer {askant}.
e.zh: 村民们用怀疑的目光打量这位新来者。

e.en: The monks practiced strict {askesis} year-round.
e.zh: 僧侣们终年坚持严格的苦行修炼。

e.en: Philosophers viewed {askesis} as training of the soul.
e.zh: 哲学家把苦行视为灵魂的训练。

e.en: The old fence leaned {aslope} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，老围栏歪斜地立着。

e.en: His hat sat {aslope} on his head.
e.zh: 他的帽子歪歪斜斜地戴在头上。

e.en: After the stroke he developed {asomatognosia} and ignored his left arm.
e.zh: 中风后他出现身体失认症，忽视自己的左臂。

e.en: Neurologists study {asomatognosia} to understand body awareness.
e.zh: 神经学家研究身体失认症以了解身体感知。

e.en: Ancient texts describe spirits as {asomatous} beings.
e.zh: 古籍将灵体描述为无形的存在。

e.en: He imagined an {asomatous} consciousness drifting in space.
e.zh: 他想象着一种无形体的意识在太空中飘荡。

e.en: Chronic {asomnia} left her exhausted every morning.
e.zh: 长期失眠使她每天早上都筋疲力尽。

e.en: Doctors prescribed therapy for his {asomnia}.
e.zh: 医生为他的失眠开了治疗方案。

e.en: The poet used {asonant} lines for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 诗人用不和谐的诗句来制造戏剧效果。

e.en: Their voices sounded oddly {asonant} together.
e.zh: 他们的声音合在一起显得很不协调。

e.en: Doctors use {asparaginase} to treat childhood leukemia.
e.zh: 医生用天冬酰胺酶治疗儿童白血病。

e.en: The drug {asparaginase} breaks down a key amino acid.
e.zh: 天冬酰胺酶药物可分解一种关键氨基酸。

e.en: {Asparagine} was first isolated from asparagus juice.
e.zh: 天冬酰胺最初是从芦笋汁中分离出来的。

e.en: The protein contains many {asparagine} residues.
e.zh: 该蛋白质含有许多天冬酰胺残基。

e.en: The chain has several {asparagines} in a row.
e.zh: 该链上连续有几个天冬酰胺残基。

e.en: Researchers measured the {asparagines} in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了样品中的天冬酰胺含量。

asparaginous.t: 含天冬酰胺的；芦笋状的

e.en: The plant produces an {asparaginous} compound.
e.zh: 该植物产生一种含天冬酰胺的化合物。

e.en: He noted the {asparaginous} taste of the soup.
e.zh: 他注意到这汤有股芦笋般的味道。

e.en: The enzyme cleaves the {asparaginyl} bond.
e.zh: 该酶切断天冬酰胺基键。

e.en: They identified an {asparaginyl} residue at position five.
e.zh: 他们在第五位鉴定出一个天冬酰胺基残基。

e.en: {Aspartase} catalyzes the deamination of aspartate.
e.zh: 天冬氨酸酶催化天冬氨酸的脱氨反应。

e.en: Bacteria use {aspartase} in nitrogen metabolism.
e.zh: 细菌利用天冬氨酸酶进行氮代谢。

e.en: {Aspartate} acts as a neurotransmitter in the brain.
e.zh: 天冬氨酸盐在大脑中作为神经递质起作用。

e.en: The reaction produces {aspartate} as a byproduct.
e.zh: 该反应产生天冬氨酸盐作为副产物。

e.en: {Aspartic} acid is a common amino acid in proteins.
e.zh: 天冬氨酸是蛋白质中常见的氨基酸。

e.en: They studied an {aspartic} protease in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室研究一种天冬氨酸蛋白酶。

e.en: {Aspartokinase} is the first enzyme in lysine biosynthesis.
e.zh: 天冬氨酸激酶是赖氨酸生物合成中的首个酶。

e.en: Mutations in {aspartokinase} alter amino acid levels.
e.zh: 天冬氨酸激酶的突变会改变氨基酸水平。

e.en: The drug targets an {aspartyl} protease.
e.zh: 该药物靶向一种天冬氨酰基蛋白酶。

e.en: An {aspartyl} group sits at the active site.
e.zh: 天冬氨酰基位于活性位点上。

e.en: The shield bore two lions {aspectant}.
e.zh: 盾牌上绘有两头相向而立的狮子。

e.en: Heralds describe the figures as {aspectant}.
e.zh: 纹章官将这些图形描述为相向的。

e.en: Russian verbs carry rich {aspectual} information.
e.zh: 俄语动词带有丰富的体貌信息。

e.en: The textbook explains {aspectual} differences in detail.
e.zh: 教科书详细解释了动词体的差异。

e.en: Wind and sand {asperate} the rock surface over centuries.
e.zh: 经年累月，风沙使岩石表面变得粗糙。

e.en: The treatment {asperates} the metal before painting.
e.zh: 该工艺在喷漆前使金属表面变粗糙。

e.en: The {asperated} surface gripped the paint better.
e.zh: 粗糙化的表面更能附着油漆。

e.en: He ran his finger over the {asperated} edge.
e.zh: 他用手指划过粗糙的边缘。

e.en: The machine is {asperating} the tiles for grip.
e.zh: 机器正在把瓷砖打磨粗糙以增加摩擦。

e.en: Constant friction kept {asperating} the wood.
e.zh: 持续的摩擦不断使木头变粗糙。

e.en: Surface {asperation} improves adhesion.
e.zh: 表面粗糙化能提高附着力。

e.en: The report described the {asperation} of the coating.
e.zh: 报告描述了涂层的粗糙化过程。

e.en: The priest moved through the church to {asperge} the congregation.
e.zh: 神父在教堂里走动，向会众洒圣水。

e.en: He paused to {asperge} the altar.
e.zh: 他停下来向祭坛洒圣水。

e.en: He was diagnosed with {Asperger}'s syndrome as a child.
e.zh: 他童年时被诊断患有阿斯伯格综合征。

e.en: Many people with {Asperger}'s excel at detailed work.
e.zh: 许多阿斯伯格综合征患者擅长精细的工作。

e.en: The Mass began with the traditional {asperges}.
e.zh: 弥撒以传统的洒圣水礼开始。

e.en: The choir sang during the {asperges}.
e.zh: 唱诗班在洒圣水礼时歌唱。

e.en: The priest dipped the {aspergill} into the holy water.
e.zh: 神父把洒圣水器浸入圣水中。

e.en: An ornate {aspergill} lay on the altar.
e.zh: 祭坛上放着一只华丽的洒圣水器。

e.en: He shook the {aspergillum} over the kneeling crowd.
e.zh: 他向跪着的人群挥洒圣水器。

e.en: The silver {aspergillum} caught the candlelight.
e.zh: 银制的洒圣水器在烛光下闪烁。

e.en: Borage is an {asperifoliate} herb with rough leaves.
e.zh: 琉璃苣是一种叶面粗糙的草本植物。

e.en: Botanists grouped these {asperifoliate} plants together.
e.zh: 植物学家将这些叶面粗糙的植物归为一类。

e.en: The clinic treats men diagnosed with {aspermia}.
e.zh: 该诊所治疗被诊断为无精症的男性。

e.en: {Aspermia} can be caused by surgery or illness.
e.zh: 无精症可能由手术或疾病引起。

e.en: The fruit is naturally {aspermous} and easy to eat.
e.zh: 这种水果天生无籽，易于食用。

e.en: They cultivated an {aspermous} variety of grape.
e.zh: 他们培育了一种无籽葡萄品种。

e.en: He {aspers} his rival in every speech.
e.zh: 他在每次演讲中都诋毁对手。

e.en: The columnist {aspers} the mayor's record.
e.zh: 专栏作家诋毁市长的执政记录。

e.en: He tried to {asperse} her good name.
e.zh: 他试图诋毁她的名声。

e.en: It is wrong to {asperse} someone without evidence.
e.zh: 在没有证据的情况下诋毁他人是不对的。

e.en: The {aspersed} official sued for defamation.
e.zh: 被诋毁的官员提起了诽谤诉讼。

e.en: She felt deeply {aspersed} by the rumors.
e.zh: 她因谣言感到深受中伤。

e.en: The {asperser} hid behind an anonymous account.
e.zh: 那个诋毁者躲在匿名账号背后。

e.en: Few took the {asperser}'s claims seriously.
e.zh: 很少有人把这位诋毁者的说法当真。

e.en: He {asperses} anyone who disagrees with him.
e.zh: 他诋毁任何与他意见不合的人。

e.en: The article unfairly {asperses} her work.
e.zh: 那篇文章不公正地诋毁她的工作。

e.en: They accused him of {aspersing} their reputation.
e.zh: 他们指控他诋毁了他们的名誉。

e.en: Stop {aspersing} colleagues behind their backs.
e.zh: 别再背后诋毁同事了。

e.en: His {aspersive} remarks shocked the audience.
e.zh: 他诋毁性的言论令听众震惊。

e.en: The editorial took an {aspersive} tone.
e.zh: 那篇社论带有中伤的口吻。

e.en: Several antique {aspersoria} were on display.
e.zh: 几件古董洒圣水器陈列在那里。

e.en: The museum cataloged the bronze {aspersoria}.
e.zh: 博物馆为这些铜制洒圣水器编了目录。

e.en: A marble {aspersorium} stood by the church door.
e.zh: 教堂门口立着一个大理石圣水盘。

e.en: He dipped his fingers into the {aspersorium}.
e.zh: 他把手指浸入圣水盘中。

e.en: Critics dismissed the review as merely {aspersory}.
e.zh: 评论家认为那篇评论只是诋毁性的。

e.en: He carried the silver {aspersory} into the chapel.
e.zh: 他把银制的洒圣水器带进了礼拜堂。

e.en: {Asphaltene} clogs pipelines if it precipitates.
e.zh: 沥青质若沉淀会堵塞管道。

e.en: Engineers studied the {asphaltene} content of the crude.
e.zh: 工程师研究了原油中的沥青质含量。

e.en: The road has a thick {asphaltic} surface.
e.zh: 这条路面铺着厚厚的沥青层。

e.en: They tested the {asphaltic} concrete for durability.
e.zh: 他们测试了沥青混凝土的耐久性。

e.en: Miners extracted {asphaltite} from the desert deposit.
e.zh: 矿工们从沙漠矿床中开采沥青岩。

e.en: The {asphaltite} burned with a smoky flame.
e.zh: 那块沥青岩燃烧时冒出浓烟。

e.en: {Asphaltization} occurs as light hydrocarbons evaporate.
e.zh: 轻烃挥发后会发生沥青化作用。

e.en: The geologist explained the {asphaltization} process.
e.zh: 地质学家解释了沥青化的过程。

e.en: The fortress walls were not easily {assaultable} from the south.
e.zh: 这座堡垒的城墙从南面不易攻陷。

e.en: His reputation seemed {assaultable} once the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻曝光后，他的名誉似乎不堪一击。

e.en: The {assaulters} were caught on security cameras.
e.zh: 袭击者被监控摄像头拍了下来。

e.en: Police are still searching for the {assaulters}.
e.zh: 警方仍在搜捕那些袭击者。

e.en: Only {assayable} ore samples were sent to the lab.
e.zh: 只有可化验的矿石样本被送到实验室。

e.en: The compound is readily {assayable} using standard methods.
e.zh: 该化合物用标准方法即可化验。

e.en: The warrior raised his {assegai} above his head.
e.zh: 那名战士将短矛高举过头。

e.en: Museums display the {assegai} alongside other tribal weapons.
e.zh: 博物馆把这种短矛和其他部落武器一同陈列。

assemblagist.t: 集合艺术家；拼贴雕塑家

e.en: The {assemblagist} turned junkyard scraps into striking sculptures.
e.zh: 这位集合艺术家把废料场的零件做成了惊艳的雕塑。

e.en: As an {assemblagist}, she preferred found objects to fresh materials.
e.zh: 作为一名集合艺术家，她更喜欢现成物件而非新材料。

e.en: He still writes drivers in {assembly-language} for speed.
e.zh: 为了追求速度，他仍然用汇编语言写驱动。

e.en: Learning {assembly-language} taught me how the CPU really works.
e.zh: 学汇编语言让我明白了 CPU 的真正工作原理。

e.en: Cars roll off the {assembly-line} every two minutes.
e.zh: 每两分钟就有一辆汽车从装配线上下线。

e.en: The factory introduced robots on the {assembly-line}.
e.zh: 工厂在流水线上引入了机器人。

e.en: Two {assemblywomen} co-sponsored the childcare bill.
e.zh: 两位女议员共同发起了这项托育法案。

e.en: The {assemblywomen} demanded equal speaking time.
e.zh: 这些女议员要求获得同等的发言时间。

e.en: His constant {assentation} made his advice worthless.
e.zh: 他一味附和别人，让他的建议毫无价值。

e.en: Courtiers practiced {assentation} to stay in royal favor.
e.zh: 朝臣们靠曲意逢迎来保住宠信。

e.en: She gave an {assentient} nod and signed the form.
e.zh: 她点头表示同意，便在表格上签了字。

e.en: A faint, {assentient} murmur rose from the audience.
e.zh: 听众中传出一阵轻微的赞同声。

e.en: He wore an {assentive} smile throughout the meeting.
e.zh: 会上他始终面带赞同的微笑。

e.en: Her {assentive} reply put an end to the debate.
e.zh: 她表示赞同的回答结束了这场辩论。

e.en: Each candidate needs ten {assentor} signatures.
e.zh: 每位候选人都需要十名连署人的签名。

e.en: He served as an {assentor} for his neighbor's nomination.
e.zh: 他为邻居的提名担任了附议人。

e.en: The right is legally {assertable} in any state court.
e.zh: 该权利在任何州法院都可依法主张。

e.en: His claim is hardly {assertable} without evidence.
e.zh: 没有证据，他的主张几乎站不住脚。

e.en: She spoke in an {assertative} tone that silenced the room.
e.zh: 她用坚定自信的语气让全场安静下来。

e.en: His {assertative} manner won the negotiation.
e.zh: 他果断坚定的态度赢得了这场谈判。

e.en: He became a fierce {assertor} of free speech.
e.zh: 他成了言论自由的坚定主张者。

e.en: As an {assertor} of his rights, he refused to back down.
e.zh: 作为权利的主张者，他拒不退让。

e.en: The {assertors} of the new theory faced harsh criticism.
e.zh: 这一新理论的主张者们遭到了严厉批评。

e.en: Early {assertors} of women's suffrage were often jailed.
e.zh: 早期争取妇女选举权的维护者常被关押。

e.en: The treaty contains an {assertory} clause about borders.
e.zh: 该条约包含一项关于边界的断言条款。

e.en: His {assertory} oath bound him to tell the truth.
e.zh: 他立下的肯定誓言使他必须说出真相。

assessee.t: 被评估人；纳税评定对象

e.en: The {assessee} may appeal the tax decision within thirty days.
e.zh: 被评估人可在三十天内对税务决定提出上诉。

e.en: Each {assessee} received a detailed feedback report.
e.zh: 每位被评估者都收到了一份详细的反馈报告。

e.en: The judge sought {assessorial} advice on technical points.
e.zh: 法官在技术问题上征求陪审评议员的意见。

e.en: Her {assessorial} duties included reviewing tax appeals.
e.zh: 她作为评估员的职责包括审核税务上诉。

assessorship.t: 评估员职位；陪审员职务

e.en: He resigned his {assessorship} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻发生后，他辞去了评估员的职务。

e.en: The {assessorship} carries a modest annual stipend.
e.zh: 该评估员职位每年有一笔微薄的津贴。

e.en: Smart {asset-allocation} balances risk and return.
e.zh: 明智的资产配置能平衡风险与收益。

e.en: She reviews her {asset-allocation} every quarter.
e.zh: 她每季度都会检视一次自己的资产配置。

e.en: He invested heavily in {asset-backed} securities.
e.zh: 他大量投资于资产担保证券。

e.en: The bank issued an {asset-backed} bond last week.
e.zh: 该银行上周发行了一只资产担保债券。

asset-stripping.t: 剥离资产；拆卖资产获利

e.en: Critics accused the firm of crude {asset-stripping}.
e.zh: 批评者指责这家公司粗暴地剥离资产套现。

e.en: {Asset-stripping} left the factory an empty shell.
e.zh: 资产被拆卖一空后，工厂只剩下一副空壳。

e.en: He continued to {asseverate} his innocence in court.
e.zh: 他在法庭上继续郑重声明自己无罪。

e.en: Witnesses {asseverate} that they saw nothing unusual.
e.zh: 证人们郑重表示他们没看到任何异常。

e.en: She {asseverated} her loyalty to the cause.
e.zh: 她郑重声明自己对这项事业的忠诚。

e.en: He {asseverated} that the documents were genuine.
e.zh: 他庄严断言这些文件是真实的。

asseverates.t: 郑重声明（第三人称单数）

e.en: The minister {asseverates} that no laws were broken.
e.zh: 部长郑重声明没有违反任何法律。

e.en: He {asseverates} his version of events at every chance.
e.zh: 他一有机会就郑重重申自己的说法。

e.en: He stood at the podium {asseverating} his commitment.
e.zh: 他站在讲台上郑重宣告自己的承诺。

e.en: She kept {asseverating} that the rumor was false.
e.zh: 她一再郑重声明那个传闻是假的。

e.en: His repeated {asseveration} of innocence finally swayed the jury.
e.zh: 他一再郑重声明自己无罪，终于打动了陪审团。

e.en: The treaty opens with a solemn {asseveration} of peace.
e.zh: 该条约以一项庄严的和平宣言开篇。

e.en: She replied in an {asseverative} tone that left no doubt.
e.zh: 她用斩钉截铁的语气作答，毫无疑义。

e.en: The clause is {asseverative} rather than conditional.
e.zh: 该条款是肯定性的，而非附条件的。

e.en: His speech was full of {asseveratory} statements about reform.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了关于改革的郑重声明。

e.en: The contract opens with an {asseveratory} preamble.
e.zh: 合同以一段声明性的序言开始。

e.en: In some dialects, speakers {assibilate} the t before i.
e.zh: 在某些方言里，说话者会把 i 前的 t 齿擦音化。

e.en: Latin t tends to {assibilate} in many Romance languages.
e.zh: 拉丁语的 t 在许多罗曼语中倾向于齿擦音化。

e.en: The {assibilated} consonants mark this regional accent.
e.zh: 齿擦音化的辅音是这种地方口音的特征。

e.en: Old forms have {assibilated} into modern pronunciations.
e.zh: 古老的发音形式已齿擦音化为现代读法。

assibilates.t: 使齿擦音化（第三人称单数）

e.en: This dialect {assibilates} the final consonant of the verb.
e.zh: 这种方言会把动词末尾的辅音齿擦音化。

e.en: Her speech naturally {assibilates} every t before i.
e.zh: 她说话时会自然把 i 前的每个 t 齿擦音化。

e.en: Speakers were {assibilating} the consonant without realizing it.
e.zh: 说话者在不知不觉中将辅音齿擦音化。

e.en: The language is gradually {assibilating} certain stops.
e.zh: 该语言正在逐步将某些塞音齿擦音化。

e.en: The textbook devotes a chapter to {assibilation} in Quebec French.
e.zh: 教科书用一整章讲解魁北克法语中的齿擦音化。

e.en: {Assibilation} explains why 'tu' sounds like 'tsu' here.
e.zh: 齿擦音化解释了为什么这里的 tu 听起来像 tsu。

e.en: Fever was an {assident} symptom of the rare illness.
e.zh: 发烧是这种罕见疾病的伴随症状。

e.en: Doctors noted several {assident} signs alongside the rash.
e.zh: 医生在皮疹之外还记录了几项伴随体征。

e.en: The knights prepared to {assiege} the castle at dawn.
e.zh: 骑士们准备拂晓时围攻这座城堡。

e.en: Old chronicles describe how rebels would {assiege} the keep.
e.zh: 古代编年史记载叛军如何围困主堡。

e.en: Don't let bad television {assify} your children.
e.zh: 别让劣质电视节目把你的孩子弄傻。

e.en: He claimed social media was beginning to {assify} debate.
e.zh: 他声称社交媒体正在让公共讨论变得愚蠢。

e.en: The contract limits the {assignability} of the lease.
e.zh: 合同限制了该租约的可转让性。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {assignability} of the patent rights.
e.zh: 律师们就专利权的可转让性展开了辩论。

assignat.t: 指券（法国大革命时期纸币）

e.en: By 1796 the {assignat} was nearly worthless.
e.zh: 到 1796 年，这种指券几乎一文不值。

e.en: Peasants refused to accept the {assignat} as payment.
e.zh: 农民拒绝接受指券作为付款。

asphaltogenic.t: 形成沥青的；产生沥青的

e.en: Geologists study {asphaltogenic} processes in oil reservoirs.
e.zh: 地质学家研究油藏中形成沥青的过程。

e.en: The shale displayed clear {asphaltogenic} properties.
e.zh: 这种页岩表现出明显的生沥青特性。

e.en: The road was coated thickly with {asphaltum}.
e.zh: 路面厚厚地涂了一层沥青。

e.en: Ancient peoples used {asphaltum} as a sealant.
e.zh: 古人用沥青作密封材料。

e.en: The lens has an {aspheric} front surface.
e.zh: 该镜片正面为非球面。

e.en: Modern cameras rely on {aspheric} elements.
e.zh: 现代相机依赖非球面元件。

e.en: The telescope features an {aspherical} mirror.
e.zh: 望远镜采用非球面反射镜。

e.en: {Aspherical} lenses reduce visible distortion.
e.zh: 非球面镜片可降低明显的畸变。

e.en: Modern eyeglasses often include {aspherics}.
e.zh: 现代眼镜常采用非球面镜片。

e.en: These {aspherics} improve image clarity noticeably.
e.zh: 这些非球面镜片显著提高了成像清晰度。

e.en: Greek myths describe fields of {asphodel}.
e.zh: 希腊神话描述了日光兰花田。

e.en: A single {asphodel} bloomed by the path.
e.zh: 小路旁开着一株日光兰。

e.en: Pale {asphodels} covered the open meadow.
e.zh: 苍白的日光兰铺满了空旷的草地。

e.en: The dead wandered through fields of {asphodels}.
e.zh: 亡灵在日光兰花田中游荡。

e.en: The doctor noted clear {asphyxial} symptoms.
e.zh: 医生记录了明显的窒息症状。

e.en: He died from {asphyxial} injuries.
e.zh: 他死于窒息性损伤。

asphyxiant.t: 窒息剂；使人窒息的物质

e.en: Carbon monoxide is a deadly {asphyxiant}.
e.zh: 一氧化碳是致命的窒息剂。

e.en: The leaking gas acted as an {asphyxiant}.
e.zh: 泄漏的气体起到了窒息剂的作用。

e.en: Police identified the {asphyxiator} in the case.
e.zh: 警方查明了案件中的施害者。

e.en: The device functions as a chemical {asphyxiator}.
e.zh: 该装置作为化学窒息装置使用。

e.en: The old medical text refers to {asphyxy}.
e.zh: 这本古旧医书中提到「窒息」一词。

e.en: Doctors once routinely called it {asphyxy}.
e.zh: 医生过去常把它称为「窒息」。

e.en: The dentist used an {aspirator} to clear saliva.
e.zh: 牙医用吸引器清除口水。

e.en: Surgeons rely on the {aspirator} during operations.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中使用吸引器。

e.en: The patient showed {aspiratory} difficulties.
e.zh: 患者出现了吸气困难。

e.en: Doctors examined his {aspiratory} muscles.
e.zh: 医生检查了他的吸气肌。

e.en: She gave him an {aspish} sidelong glance.
e.zh: 她阴险地斜眼瞥了他一下。

e.en: His {aspish} smile unsettled everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他蛇一般的笑容让在场所有人都不安。

e.en: Scientists isolated an {asporogenic} bacterial strain.
e.zh: 科学家分离出一株不产芽孢的菌株。

e.en: This mutation makes the bacteria {asporogenic}.
e.zh: 该突变使细菌不再产生芽孢。

e.en: The charge included {asportation} of stolen property.
e.zh: 指控包括非法带走赃物。

e.en: Larceny generally requires {asportation} of the goods.
e.zh: 盗窃罪通常要求带走财物。

e.en: He lay {asprawl} across the worn couch.
e.zh: 他四肢摊开躺在那张旧沙发上。

e.en: The cat slept {asprawl} in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 猫四肢摊开睡在午后的阳光里。

e.en: The hunter waited {asquat} in the bushes.
e.zh: 猎人蹲伏在灌木丛中等候。

e.en: She sat {asquat} beside the small fire.
e.zh: 她蹲坐在小火堆旁。

e.en: He looked {asquint} into the harsh light.
e.zh: 他斜眼望向刺眼的光。

e.en: She glanced {asquint} at the stranger.
e.zh: 她斜眼瞥了那陌生人一眼。

e.en: The team gave their rivals a real {ass-kicking}.
e.zh: 那支队伍把对手痛打了一顿。

e.en: She's an {ass-kicking} performer on stage.
e.zh: 她在台上是个超猛的表演者。

e.en: Nobody likes a shameless {ass-kisser}.
e.zh: 没人喜欢厚颜无耻的马屁精。

e.en: He's known as the office {ass-kisser}.
e.zh: 他在办公室是出了名的马屁精。

e.en: She got promoted by {ass-kissing} the boss.
e.zh: 她靠拍老板马屁升了职。

e.en: All that {ass-kissing} disgusted his colleagues.
e.zh: 他那番拍马屁让同事们非常反感。

e.en: The recipe calls for a pinch of {assafetida}.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要一小撮阿魏。

e.en: {Assafetida} has a strong, pungent smell.
e.zh: 阿魏有强烈刺鼻的气味。

e.en: The warrior carried a slender {assagai}.
e.zh: 战士手持一支细长的轻矛。

e.en: He hurled the {assagai} with great force.
e.zh: 他奋力掷出那支标枪。

e.en: The score was marked allegro {assai}.
e.zh: 乐谱上标着「极快板」。

e.en: Play this passage adagio {assai}.
e.zh: 这段请奏得非常慢。

e.en: His argument is highly {assailable}.
e.zh: 他的论点非常容易被质疑。

e.en: The fortress proved {assailable} from the north.
e.zh: 事实证明这座堡垒从北面可以攻破。

e.en: The {assailment} on the city lasted for hours.
e.zh: 对该城市的猛攻持续了数小时。

e.en: He endured constant {assailment} from his critics.
e.zh: 他承受着评论家持续不断的攻击。

e.en: Medieval lords granted rights to {assart}.
e.zh: 中世纪领主曾授予开垦林地的权利。

e.en: The settlers began to {assart} the woodland.
e.zh: 拓荒者开始开垦那片林地。

e.en: The {assassinator} fled into the dark night.
e.zh: 暗杀者消失在漆黑的夜色中。

e.en: Historians searched for the {assassinator}'s true identity.
e.zh: 历史学家追查暗杀者的真实身份。

e.en: Her {assumptive} tone annoyed the panel.
e.zh: 她那种自以为是的语气让评审组很反感。

e.en: Avoid {assumptive} questions during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时要避免带有预设的提问。

e.en: Only {assurable} risks qualify for this policy.
e.zh: 只有可承保的风险才符合这份保单。

e.en: The cargo is fully {assurable} under maritime law.
e.zh: 按照海事法这批货物完全可以投保。

e.en: The plant has {assurgent} stems that curve upward.
e.zh: 这种植物的茎向上弯曲生长。

e.en: Botanists noted the {assurgent} growth pattern.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种向上的生长方式。

e.en: The {assuror} agreed to cover the shipment.
e.zh: 承保人同意为这批货物投保。

e.en: Each {assuror} signed the indemnity clause.
e.zh: 每位承保人都签署了赔偿条款。

e.en: She published an {assyriological} study of cuneiform.
e.zh: 她发表了一篇关于楔形文字的亚述学研究。

e.en: The museum hosts {assyriological} conferences yearly.
e.zh: 该博物馆每年举办亚述学会议。

e.en: The circuit uses an {astable} multivibrator.
e.zh: 该电路使用了一个无稳态多谐振荡器。

e.en: An {astable} oscillator generates a square wave.
e.zh: 非稳态振荡器会产生方波信号。

e.en: The captain ordered the helm hard {astarboard}.
e.zh: 船长下令舵向右舷急转。

e.en: They spotted land {astarboard} at dawn.
e.zh: 破晓时他们在右舷方向发现了陆地。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {astasia}.
e.zh: 该患者被诊断为站立不能症。

e.en: {Astasia} often accompanies certain neurological disorders.
e.zh: 站立不能常伴随某些神经系统疾病出现。

e.en: An {astatic} galvanometer ignores Earth's magnetic field.
e.zh: 无定向电流计不受地磁场影响。

e.en: The needle remained {astatic} during testing.
e.zh: 测试中指针保持无定向状态。

e.en: The coils are wound {astatically} to cancel interference.
e.zh: 线圈以无定向方式绕制以消除干扰。

e.en: He arranged the magnets {astatically}.
e.zh: 他把磁铁按无定向方式排列。

e.en: The instrument's {astaticism} improves its sensitivity.
e.zh: 该仪器的无定向性提高了它的灵敏度。

e.en: Engineers test {astaticism} before deployment.
e.zh: 工程师在部署前会测试无定向性。

e.en: {Astatine} is the rarest naturally occurring element.
e.zh: 砹是自然界中最稀有的元素。

e.en: Researchers studied {astatine} for cancer therapy.
e.zh: 研究人员将砹用于癌症治疗研究。
