e.en: The control system exhibits perfect {astatism}.
e.zh: 该控制系统表现出完全的无静差特性。

e.en: {Astatism} eliminates steady-state error.
e.zh: 无静差性可消除稳态误差。

e.en: Engineers performed {astatization} on the gravimeter.
e.zh: 工程师对重力仪进行了无定向化处理。

e.en: {Astatization} reduces external magnetic effects.
e.zh: 无定向化处理可减少外部磁场影响。

e.en: Salmon get their pink color from {astaxanthin}.
e.zh: 三文鱼的粉红色来自虾青素。

e.en: {Astaxanthin} is sold as an antioxidant supplement.
e.zh: 虾青素被作为抗氧化保健品出售。

e.en: The fossil showed clear {asterial} markings.
e.zh: 这块化石上有清晰的星形纹路。

e.en: She admired the {asterial} pattern in the gem.
e.zh: 她欣赏宝石中那道星状纹理。

e.en: The jeweler showed me an {asteriated} sapphire.
e.zh: 珠宝商给我看了一颗星光蓝宝石。

e.en: {Asteriated} stones display a six-rayed star.
e.zh: 星彩宝石会呈现六道星芒。

e.en: Surgeons located the {asterion} before drilling.
e.zh: 外科医生在钻孔前先定位星点。

e.en: The {asterion} marks a key skull junction.
e.zh: 星点标示着颅骨上一个关键的交汇处。

e.en: The ruby's {asterismal} effect dazzled buyers.
e.zh: 红宝石的星彩效应让买家惊艳不已。

e.en: He photographed several {asterismal} formations.
e.zh: 他拍摄了几组星群图样。

e.en: The lower ribs are called {asternal} ribs.
e.zh: 下方的几对肋骨被称为非胸骨肋。

e.en: {Asternal} cartilage links indirectly to the sternum.
e.zh: 非胸骨肋的软骨与胸骨间接相连。

e.en: Patients often complain of severe {asthenia}.
e.zh: 患者常抱怨有严重的虚弱乏力。

e.en: {Asthenia} can follow a long viral illness.
e.zh: 长期病毒感染后可能出现乏力症状。

e.en: He has an {asthenic} build and pale complexion.
e.zh: 他体型瘦长，脸色苍白。

e.en: The patient appeared {asthenic} after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后病人显得虚弱无力。

e.en: Long screen time causes {asthenopia}.
e.zh: 长时间盯屏幕会导致视疲劳。

e.en: She took breaks to relieve her {asthenopia}.
e.zh: 她不时休息以缓解眼疲劳。

e.en: He developed {asthenopic} symptoms after editing all night.
e.zh: 他通宵剪辑后出现了眼疲劳症状。

e.en: {Asthenopic} complaints are common among programmers.
e.zh: 程序员中眼疲劳的抱怨很常见。

e.en: Tectonic plates float on the {asthenosphere}.
e.zh: 地壳板块漂浮在软流圈之上。

e.en: The {asthenosphere} behaves like a viscous fluid.
e.zh: 软流圈表现得像一种粘稠流体。

assigned-risk.t: 指定风险；分配风险（保险）

e.en: High-risk drivers are often placed in an {assigned-risk} pool.
e.zh: 高风险驾驶员常被纳入指定风险共保池。

e.en: The {assigned-risk} program guarantees coverage for those rejected elsewhere.
e.zh: 该指定风险计划为被其他公司拒保的人提供保障。

e.en: The {assignor} transferred all rights to the buyer.
e.zh: 转让人把全部权利让渡给了买方。

e.en: Both the {assignor} and assignee signed the contract.
e.zh: 让与人和受让人都在合同上签了字。

e.en: The {assimilability} of the nutrients depends on cooking method.
e.zh: 营养素的可吸收性取决于烹饪方式。

e.en: Critics questioned the {assimilability} of the new immigrant group.
e.zh: 批评者质疑这一新移民群体的可同化程度。

e.en: The school promoted a strict policy of {assimilationism}.
e.zh: 该校推行严格的同化主义政策。

e.en: Many activists rejected {assimilationism} in favor of cultural pluralism.
e.zh: 许多活动人士拒绝同化主义，转而支持文化多元主义。

assimilationist.t: 同化主义者；主张同化的

e.en: He was criticized for his {assimilationist} views on minority cultures.
e.zh: 他对少数民族文化的同化主义观点遭到批评。

e.en: The {assimilationist} model dominated mid-century policy debates.
e.zh: 同化主义模式主导了上世纪中叶的政策辩论。

e.en: Early {assimilationists} urged immigrants to abandon their traditions.
e.zh: 早期的同化主义者敦促移民放弃自己的传统。

e.en: Critics accused the {assimilationists} of erasing minority identities.
e.zh: 批评者指责同化主义者抹杀了少数族群的身份。

e.en: The empire was a powerful {assimilator} of conquered cultures.
e.zh: 该帝国是被征服文化的强大同化者。

e.en: Plants are remarkable {assimilator}s of carbon dioxide.
e.zh: 植物是出色的二氧化碳吸收者。

e.en: Cities have historically been great {assimilators} of newcomers.
e.zh: 历史上，城市一直是新来者的强大同化者。

e.en: These bacteria are efficient {assimilators} of nitrogen.
e.zh: 这些细菌能高效地吸收氮元素。

e.en: The country pursued strongly {assimilatory} education policies.
e.zh: 该国推行了强烈的同化性教育政策。

e.en: Plants carry out {assimilatory} processes during photosynthesis.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用中进行同化过程。

e.en: The country legalized {assisted-suicide} for the terminally ill.
e.zh: 该国将协助自杀合法化，适用于绝症患者。

e.en: Debate over {assisted-suicide} continues to divide doctors.
e.zh: 关于协助自杀的争论仍在医生中引发分歧。

e.en: Each volunteer was paired with an {assistor} during the event.
e.zh: 活动中每位志愿者都配有一位协助者。

e.en: The court appointed an {assistor} to help the witness.
e.zh: 法院指派了一名协助者帮助证人。

e.en: Researchers measured the {associability} of paired stimuli in the experiment.
e.zh: 研究者测量了实验中成对刺激的可联想程度。

e.en: The molecule's {associability} affects how it bonds with proteins.
e.zh: 该分子的可结合性影响其与蛋白质的结合方式。

e.en: The two events are easily {associable} in the public mind.
e.zh: 这两件事在公众心目中很容易联系起来。

e.en: Certain odors are strongly {associable} with childhood memories.
e.zh: 某些气味与童年记忆紧密相联。

e.en: He wrote about the {associableness} of music and emotion.
e.zh: 他撰文论述音乐与情感的可联想性。

e.en: The {associableness} of the symbols made the design memorable.
e.zh: 这些符号的关联性使该设计令人难忘。

associate-degree.t: 副学士学位（两年制大专）

e.en: She earned an {associate-degree} in nursing before transferring.
e.zh: 她在转学前取得了护理副学士学位。

e.en: An {associate-degree} usually takes two years to complete.
e.zh: 副学士学位通常需要两年完成。

e.en: Hume is often cited as a founder of {associationism}.
e.zh: 休谟常被视为联想主义的奠基人之一。

e.en: Modern psychology moved beyond classical {associationism}.
e.zh: 现代心理学已超越了古典的联想主义。

e.en: He served as an {associator} in the colonial militia.
e.zh: 他曾在殖民地民兵中担任联合者。

e.en: The neural {associator} links sensory inputs with stored memories.
e.zh: 神经关联器将感觉输入与存储的记忆相连。

e.en: The priest would {assoil} the penitent of his sins.
e.zh: 神父会赦免忏悔者的罪。

e.en: May heaven {assoil} him for his trespasses.
e.zh: 愿上天赦免他的过错。

e.en: The dying knight was {assoiled} by the chaplain.
e.zh: 濒死的骑士由随军牧师赦免了罪。

e.en: Once {assoiled}, the sinner felt at peace.
e.zh: 一旦获得赦免，罪人便感到心安。

e.en: The bishop spent the morning {assoiling} the pilgrims.
e.zh: 主教整个上午都在为朝圣者赦罪。

e.en: He knelt before the priest, who began {assoiling} him.
e.zh: 他跪在神父面前，神父开始为他赦罪。

e.en: He sought {assoilment} for his many transgressions.
e.zh: 他祈求对自己诸多过犯的赦免。

e.en: The pilgrim received full {assoilment} at the shrine.
e.zh: 朝圣者在圣地获得了完全的赦免。

e.en: The Church {assoils} those who repent sincerely.
e.zh: 教会赦免那些诚心悔改的人。

e.en: Only true contrition {assoils} the soul of guilt.
e.zh: 唯有真心懊悔才能洗去灵魂的罪愆。

assoilzie.t: 宣告无罪；释放（苏格兰法律古语）

e.en: The court did {assoilzie} the defender of all charges.
e.zh: 法庭宣告被告所有指控均不成立。

e.en: The judge moved to {assoilzie} the accused after deliberation.
e.zh: 经过审议，法官决定宣告被告无罪。

e.en: The poem uses {assonant} vowels to create a haunting rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗用半谐音元音营造出萦绕心头的节奏。

e.en: "Lake" and "fate" are {assonant} rather than rhyming.
e.zh: lake 与 fate 属于半谐音而非押韵。

e.en: The poet chose words that {assonate} with one another.
e.zh: 诗人选择了彼此元音相谐的词。

e.en: Lines that {assonate} subtly can feel more musical than rhymed verse.
e.zh: 巧妙押半谐音的诗行可比纯押韵的诗更有乐感。

e.en: Workers {assort} the apples by size and color.
e.zh: 工人按大小和颜色把苹果分类。

e.en: She helped {assort} the donated clothes into bins.
e.zh: 她帮忙把捐赠的衣服分类装入箱子。

assortative.t: 选型的；同型择偶的（生物学）

e.en: {Assortative} mating tends to increase trait variance in populations.
e.zh: 同型择偶往往会扩大群体的性状方差。

e.en: Studies show strong {assortative} pairing by education level.
e.zh: 研究显示按教育程度的同型择偶现象十分明显。

e.en: Birds in this species mate {assortatively} by plumage color.
e.zh: 该物种的鸟类按羽色进行同型择偶。

e.en: People often choose partners {assortatively} on values and interests.
e.zh: 人们常按价值观和兴趣同型择偶。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {assorting} buttons by color.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在按颜色分类纽扣。

e.en: The machine handles {assorting} packages by destination.
e.zh: 这台机器负责按目的地分拣包裹。

assortive.t: 分类的；选型的（assortative 的少用变体）

e.en: He used the term {assortive} instead of the more common variant.
e.zh: 他使用 assortive 一词，而非更常见的变体。

e.en: The data revealed an {assortive} pattern of friendships.
e.zh: 数据揭示出一种同型化的友谊模式。

e.en: The post office {assorts} letters by zip code.
e.zh: 邮局按邮政编码对信件分类。

e.en: He carefully {assorts} the seeds into small jars.
e.zh: 他小心地把种子分类装进小罐里。

e.en: Her beauty did {assot} the young knight's wits.
e.zh: 她的美貌令年轻骑士神魂颠倒。

e.en: Wine and flattery did {assot} him utterly.
e.zh: 美酒与奉承彻底令他昏了头。

e.en: Music brought him some {assuagement} of his grief.
e.zh: 音乐为他的悲伤带来些许慰藉。

e.en: The medicine offered only temporary {assuagement} of the pain.
e.zh: 这种药对疼痛只能起短暂的缓解作用。

e.en: Her {assuasive} tone calmed the frightened child.
e.zh: 她舒缓的语调安抚了受惊的孩子。

e.en: He spoke {assuasive} words to the grieving widow.
e.zh: 他对悲恸的寡妇说了几句安慰的话。

e.en: Long {assuetude} had dulled his sense of danger.
e.zh: 长久习以为常已让他对危险麻木了。

e.en: Through sheer {assuetude}, the noise no longer bothered her.
e.zh: 由于纯粹的习以为常，那噪音已不再困扰她。

e.en: Lenders evaluated the loan's {assumability} before approving the sale.
e.zh: 在批准这笔交易前，贷款方评估了贷款的可承接性。

e.en: The contract's {assumability} made it attractive to new buyers.
e.zh: 该合同的可承接性使其对新买家颇具吸引力。

assumable.t: 可承担的；可假定的（贷款可由他人承接）

e.en: The mortgage is {assumable} by qualified buyers.
e.zh: 这笔房贷可由合格买家承接。

e.en: He looked specifically for homes with {assumable} loans.
e.zh: 他专门寻找带可承接贷款的房子。

e.en: The package was {assumably} delivered yesterday afternoon.
e.zh: 那个包裹大概是昨天下午送到的。

e.en: He was {assumably} unaware of the policy change.
e.zh: 他可能并不知道政策变了。

e.en: The plaintiff brought an action of {assumpsit} for unpaid wages.
e.zh: 原告就拖欠工资提起了承诺之诉。

e.en: {Assumpsit} historically covered breaches of informal contracts.
e.zh: 承诺之诉历来涵盖非正式合同的违约。

e.en: He breathed {asthmatically} after climbing the stairs.
e.zh: 爬完楼梯后他气喘吁吁。

e.en: The old engine wheezed {asthmatically} as it started.
e.zh: 老旧的引擎启动时呼哧作响。

e.en: The lens focuses light {astigmatically}, causing blur.
e.zh: 这枚镜片像散地聚焦光线，造成模糊。

e.en: Without correction he saw the world {astigmatically}.
e.zh: 没有矫正时他看到的世界是散光的。

e.en: The optometrist used an {astigmatometer} to measure my eyes.
e.zh: 验光师用散光计测量我的眼睛。

e.en: An {astigmatometer} reveals the degree of corneal curvature.
e.zh: 散光计能显示角膜的曲率程度。

e.en: She examined the patient with an {astigmatoscope}.
e.zh: 她用散光检查镜为病人做检查。

e.en: An {astigmatoscope} helps diagnose visual irregularities.
e.zh: 散光镜有助于诊断视觉异常。

e.en: Modern {astigmatoscopy} relies on automated equipment.
e.zh: 现代散光检查法依赖自动化设备。

e.en: He learned {astigmatoscopy} during his residency.
e.zh: 他在住院医师培训期间学习了散光检查法。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with mild {astigmia}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她有轻度散光。

e.en: {Astigmia} can usually be corrected with glasses.
e.zh: 散光通常可以用眼镜矫正。

e.en: He stood {astonied} at the dreadful sight.
e.zh: 他被那可怕的景象惊得呆若木鸡。

e.en: The villagers were {astonied} by the news.
e.zh: 村民们听到这消息惊愕不已。

e.en: Her face showed pure {astoundment} at the result.
e.zh: 她对结果露出十足震惊的神情。

e.en: The magician's trick produced gasps of {astoundment}.
e.zh: 魔术师的把戏引来阵阵惊叹。

astrachan.t: 羔皮；阿斯特拉罕羔羊毛

e.en: She wore a coat trimmed with {astrachan}.
e.zh: 她穿着一件镶有羔皮的大衣。

e.en: The hat was made of black {astrachan}.
e.zh: 那顶帽子是用黑色羔皮做的。

e.en: He sat {astraddle} the fence watching the parade.
e.zh: 他跨坐在围栏上看游行。

e.en: The boy rode {astraddle} on his father's shoulders.
e.zh: 小男孩跨坐在父亲的肩膀上。

e.en: The carpenter carved an {astragal} along the door frame.
e.zh: 木匠沿门框雕刻了一道半圆线饰。

e.en: A small {astragal} decorated the column's base.
e.zh: 柱基上装饰着一道小圆线脚。

e.en: The surgeon studied the {astragalar} joint carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细研究了距骨关节。

e.en: An {astragalar} fracture can be hard to heal.
e.zh: 距骨骨折可能很难愈合。

e.en: Ancient peoples used animal {astragali} as dice.
e.zh: 古人用动物距骨当作骰子。

e.en: The museum displayed several Roman {astragali}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几枚罗马时代的距骨。

e.en: Greek priests practiced {astragalomancy} to foretell events.
e.zh: 希腊祭司用距骨占卜预言未来。

e.en: {Astragalomancy} was once a respected divination method.
e.zh: 距骨占卜曾是一种受尊崇的占卜方法。

e.en: Her dog suffers from severe {astraphobia} during storms.
e.zh: 她的狗在暴风雨时患有严重的雷电恐惧症。

e.en: Children with {astraphobia} often hide under blankets.
e.zh: 有雷电恐惧症的孩子常会躲到被子下。

e.en: The contract may {astrict} the parties to silence.
e.zh: 合同可能约束双方保持沉默。

e.en: Custom can {astrict} behavior more than law.
e.zh: 习俗对行为的约束有时比法律更强。

e.en: He felt {astricted} by the strict regulations.
e.zh: 他感到被严格的规定束缚住了。

e.en: Their movements were {astricted} by tradition.
e.zh: 他们的行动被传统所约束。

e.en: The new policy is {astricting} our freedom of choice.
e.zh: 新政策正在限制我们的选择自由。

e.en: She resented the {astricting} rules of the club.
e.zh: 她讨厌俱乐部那些束缚人的规定。

e.en: The herb has a mild {astriction} on the tissues.
e.zh: 这种草药对组织有轻微的收敛作用。

e.en: Legal {astriction} prevented him from speaking.
e.zh: 法律上的约束使他不能开口。

e.en: The ointment has an {astrictive} effect on wounds.
e.zh: 这种药膏对伤口有收敛作用。

e.en: Old contracts often used {astrictive} clauses.
e.zh: 旧合同常使用具约束力的条款。

e.en: Cold water can {astringe} the skin's pores.
e.zh: 冷水可以使皮肤毛孔收缩。

e.en: Tannins {astringe} the tissues of the mouth.
e.zh: 单宁会使口腔组织收敛。

e.en: The lotion {astringed} her irritated skin.
e.zh: 乳液收敛了她受刺激的皮肤。

e.en: His pores {astringed} after the cold rinse.
e.zh: 冷水冲洗后他的毛孔收缩了。

e.en: The wine has a pleasant {astringency} on the palate.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒入口带有怡人的涩感。

e.en: Her tone carried a hint of {astringency}.
e.zh: 她的语气中带着一丝严厉。

e.en: The toner is {astringing} her oily skin.
e.zh: 爽肤水正在收敛她的油性皮肤。

e.en: Cold air kept {astringing} the open wound.
e.zh: 冷空气不断让伤口收紧。

e.en: Engineers in {astrionics} design spacecraft electronics.
e.zh: 航天电子学工程师设计航天器电子设备。

e.en: {Astrionics} combines astronautics and electronics.
e.zh: 航天电子学结合了航天学与电子学。

astro.t: 天文的；星际的（前缀/缩略）

e.en: He's an {astro} enthusiast who loves stargazing.
e.zh: 他是个热爱观星的天文爱好者。

e.en: The kids attended an {astro} camp last summer.
e.zh: 孩子们去年夏天参加了一个天文营。

e.en: She studies {astro-physics} at a top university.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖大学学习天体物理学。

e.en: {Astro-physics} explores how stars are born.
e.zh: 天体物理学研究恒星是如何诞生的。

e.en: {Astroarchaeology} studies ancient observatories like Stonehenge.
e.zh: 天文考古学研究像巨石阵这样的古代天文遗址。

e.en: Her interest in {astroarchaeology} took her to Peru.
e.zh: 对天文考古学的兴趣把她带到了秘鲁。

e.en: The mission has clear {astrobiological} objectives.
e.zh: 该任务有明确的天体生物学目标。

e.en: Mars rovers gather {astrobiological} data.
e.zh: 火星车收集天体生物学数据。

e.en: {Astrobionics} studies life-support systems for spaceflight.
e.zh: 航天生物电子学研究太空飞行的生命维持系统。

e.en: Researchers in {astrobionics} design wearable space sensors.
e.zh: 航天生物电子学研究人员设计可穿戴的太空传感器。

e.en: Geologists identified the crater as an ancient {astrobleme}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定该陨石坑为远古星疤。

e.en: The {astrobleme} preserves evidence of a massive impact.
e.zh: 这个星疤保留了一次巨大撞击的证据。

astrobotany.t: 天体植物学；外空植物学

e.en: Researchers in {astrobotany} study how plants grow in space.
e.zh: 天体植物学研究人员探究植物在太空中的生长。

e.en: {Astrobotany} could help feed astronauts on Mars.
e.zh: 天体植物学或能帮助火星上的宇航员获得食物。

astrochemical.t: 天体化学的；宇宙化学的

e.en: They detected {astrochemical} signatures in the nebula.
e.zh: 他们在星云中检测到天体化学特征。

e.en: New telescopes enable detailed {astrochemical} analysis.
e.zh: 新望远镜使精细的天体化学分析成为可能。

e.en: The {astrochemist} studies molecules in interstellar clouds.
e.zh: 这位天体化学家研究星际云中的分子。

e.en: She trained as an {astrochemist} after her PhD.
e.zh: 她博士毕业后成为一名天体化学家。

e.en: {Astrochemistry} explores the chemical makeup of stars.
e.zh: 天体化学探究恒星的化学组成。

e.en: He published a textbook on {astrochemistry}.
e.zh: 他出版了一本天体化学教科书。

e.en: The {astrochemists} traced water molecules in deep space.
e.zh: 这些天体化学家在深空中追踪水分子。

e.en: Several {astrochemists} attended the conference.
e.zh: 数位天体化学家出席了会议。

e.en: {Astrochronology} dates rock layers using orbital cycles.
e.zh: 天文年代学利用轨道周期为岩层断代。

e.en: Her research advanced techniques in {astrochronology}.
e.zh: 她的研究推进了天文年代学的技术。

e.en: Pilots once relied on the {astrocompass} near the poles.
e.zh: 飞行员曾在极地附近依靠天文罗盘。

e.en: The {astrocompass} uses celestial bodies for direction.
e.zh: 天文罗盘借助天体来确定方向。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with a low-grade {astrocytoma}.
e.zh: 该患者被诊断为低级别星形细胞瘤。

e.en: Surgery removed most of the {astrocytoma}.
e.zh: 手术切除了大部分星形细胞瘤。

e.en: Brain scans revealed signs of {astrocytosis}.
e.zh: 脑部扫描显示出星形细胞增生的迹象。

e.en: {Astrocytosis} often follows neural injury.
e.zh: 星形细胞增生常发生在神经损伤之后。

e.en: Engineers use {astrodynamics} to plan satellite orbits.
e.zh: 工程师用天体动力学规划卫星轨道。

e.en: He teaches a graduate course in {astrodynamics}.
e.zh: 他讲授一门天体动力学的研究生课程。

e.en: The crew learned to {astrogate} between distant planets.
e.zh: 船员学会在遥远的行星之间进行太空导航。

e.en: Computers help pilots {astrogate} accurately.
e.zh: 电脑帮助飞行员精确地进行太空导航。

e.en: {Astrogation} requires precise knowledge of stellar positions.
e.zh: 太空导航需要精确掌握恒星位置。

e.en: He studied {astrogation} at the academy.
e.zh: 他在学院学习太空导航。

e.en: The {astrogator} plotted a course around the asteroid belt.
e.zh: 太空导航员规划了一条绕过小行星带的航线。

e.en: Every starship needs a skilled {astrogator}.
e.zh: 每艘星舰都需要一位熟练的太空导航员。

e.en: {Astrogeodynamics} links Earth's rotation to celestial motions.
e.zh: 天文地球动力学将地球自转与天体运动相联系。

e.en: She specializes in {astrogeodynamics}.
e.zh: 她专攻天文地球动力学。

astrogeology.t: 天体地质学；行星地质学

e.en: {Astrogeology} examines the surfaces of moons and planets.
e.zh: 天体地质学考察卫星和行星的表面。

e.en: He works in the {astrogeology} division of NASA.
e.zh: 他在美国航空航天局的天体地质学部门工作。

e.en: {Astrogeophysics} merges astronomy with geophysical methods.
e.zh: 天体地球物理学将天文学与地球物理方法相结合。

e.en: Her dissertation focused on {astrogeophysics}.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于天体地球物理学。

e.en: {Astrogony} examines how stars are born.
e.zh: 恒星起源学研究恒星是如何诞生的。

e.en: Ancient texts contained primitive ideas of {astrogony}.
e.zh: 古代文献中包含了原始的恒星起源学思想。

astrograph.t: 天体照相仪；星象照相仪

e.en: The observatory installed a new {astrograph}.
e.zh: 天文台安装了一台新的天体照相仪。

e.en: He photographed comets with a wide-field {astrograph}.
e.zh: 他用广视场天体照相仪拍摄彗星。

astrographic.t: 天体照相的；星图绘制的

e.en: They consulted an {astrographic} catalogue of stars.
e.zh: 他们查阅了一份天体照相星表。

e.en: The project produced an {astrographic} sky map.
e.zh: 该项目绘制了一幅星图照相天图。

e.en: {Astrography} dates back to the late nineteenth century.
e.zh: 天体照相术可追溯至十九世纪末。

e.en: Modern {astrography} relies on digital sensors.
e.zh: 现代天体照相术依靠数字传感器。

e.en: The curve traced by the point is an {astroid}.
e.zh: 该点描绘出的曲线是一条星形线。

e.en: Students plotted an {astroid} in geometry class.
e.zh: 学生在几何课上绘制了一条星形线。

e.en: The ancient {astrolater} prayed to the night sky.
e.zh: 古代的拜星者向夜空祷告。

e.en: He was branded an {astrolater} by the church.
e.zh: 他被教会斥为拜星者。

e.en: {Astrolatry} was common in many ancient cultures.
e.zh: 星辰崇拜在许多古代文化中很常见。

e.en: The temple was dedicated to {astrolatry}.
e.zh: 这座神庙是为星辰崇拜而建的。

e.en: {Astrolithology} studies the composition of meteorites.
e.zh: 陨石学研究陨石的成分。

e.en: She lectures on {astrolithology} at the museum.
e.zh: 她在博物馆讲授陨石学。

e.en: The court {astrologian} advised the king daily.
e.zh: 宫廷占星师每日向国王进言。

e.en: He styled himself an {astrologian} of repute.
e.zh: 他自封为颇有名望的占星师。

e.en: She made an {astrologic} prediction about the harvest.
e.zh: 她对收成做出了占星预测。

e.en: The book contains {astrologic} charts.
e.zh: 这本书包含占星图表。

e.en: The {astrologist} read his birth chart carefully.
e.zh: 占星师仔细解读了他的出生星盘。

e.en: She consults an {astrologist} every new year.
e.zh: 她每年新年都会咨询占星师。

e.en: Many {astrologists} gathered for the eclipse.
e.zh: 许多占星家齐聚观看日食。

e.en: Famous {astrologists} appeared on the talk show.
e.zh: 知名占星家出现在脱口秀节目中。

e.en: The shaman performed an {astromantic} ritual at midnight.
e.zh: 萨满在午夜举行了星占仪式。

e.en: His {astromantic} predictions worried the villagers.
e.zh: 他的星占预言让村民担忧。

e.en: {Astrometeorology} claims stars influence the weather.
e.zh: 星象气象学主张星辰会影响天气。

e.en: He dismissed {astrometeorology} as pseudoscience.
e.zh: 他将星象气象学视为伪科学而不予理会。

e.en: The {astrometer} measures the brightness of stars.
e.zh: 测星仪用于测量恒星的亮度。

e.en: They calibrated the {astrometer} before the experiment.
e.zh: 实验前他们校准了测星仪。

e.en: The novel features a brave {astronautess} on Mars.
e.zh: 小说中有一位勇敢的女宇航员登上火星。

e.en: She was the first {astronautess} of her country.
e.zh: 她是该国第一位女宇航员。

e.en: The lab specializes in {astronautic} engineering.
e.zh: 该实验室专攻航天工程。

e.en: He attended an {astronautic} congress in Paris.
e.zh: 他出席了在巴黎举行的航天大会。

e.en: Sailors once relied on {astronavigation} at sea.
e.zh: 水手过去在海上依靠天文导航。

e.en: {Astronavigation} requires clear skies and accurate clocks.
e.zh: 天文导航需要晴朗的天空和精确的时钟。

e.en: Amateur {astrophotographers} captured stunning images of the comet.
e.zh: 业余天文摄影师拍下了彗星的惊艳图像。

e.en: Skilled {astrophotographers} chase clear, dark skies.
e.zh: 熟练的天文摄影师追逐晴朗黑暗的天空。

e.en: The magazine features {astrophotographic} prints each month.
e.zh: 该杂志每月刊登天文摄影作品。

e.en: He bought new {astrophotographic} equipment.
e.zh: 他购买了新的天文摄影设备。

e.en: Her {astrophotographs} of nebulae won an award.
e.zh: 她拍摄的星云天文照片获了奖。

e.en: The exhibition displayed dozens of {astrophotographs}.
e.zh: 展览展出了数十张天文照片。

e.en: They used an {astrophotometer} to gauge stellar brightness.
e.zh: 他们用天体光度计测量恒星的亮度。

e.en: The {astrophotometer} sits atop the observatory dome.
e.zh: 天体光度计安放在天文台圆顶之上。

e.en: {Astrophotometry} measures the light of celestial bodies.
e.zh: 天体光度学测量天体的光强。

e.en: Modern {astrophotometry} uses CCD detectors.
e.zh: 现代天体光度学使用CCD探测器。

e.en: Probes ventured deep into {astrospace}.
e.zh: 探测器深入宇宙空间。

e.en: The novel imagines colonies in {astrospace}.
e.zh: 小说设想了在宇宙空间中的殖民地。

e.en: Biologists noted the {astrosphere} around the dividing cell.
e.zh: 生物学家注意到分裂细胞周围的星状体。

e.en: The {astrosphere} forms during mitosis.
e.zh: 星状体在有丝分裂期间形成。

e.en: The photographer mounted his camera on an {astrotracker}.
e.zh: 摄影师将相机架在赤道仪上。

e.en: An {astrotracker} compensates for Earth's rotation.
e.zh: 赤道仪可以抵消地球自转的影响。

astroturfing.t: 伪草根运动；假民意营销

e.en: The campaign was accused of {astroturfing} on social media.
e.zh: 该活动被指控在社交媒体上搞伪草根营销。

e.en: Regulators are cracking down on {astroturfing}.
e.zh: 监管机构正打击伪民意行为。

e.en: The probe carried an {astrovelocimeter} to measure stellar speeds.
e.zh: 探测器搭载了一台天体测速仪以测量恒星速度。

e.en: Engineers tested the {astrovelocimeter} in orbit.
e.zh: 工程师在轨道上测试了天体测速仪。

astrut.t: 昂首阔步地；趾高气扬地

e.en: The peacock walked {astrut} across the lawn.
e.zh: 孔雀昂首阔步地走过草坪。

e.en: He went {astrut} after his promotion.
e.zh: 升职后他趾高气扬地走着。

e.en: The {astucious} negotiator outmaneuvered everyone at the table.
e.zh: 那位机敏的谈判者在桌上让所有人都甘拜下风。

e.en: Her {astucious} reply silenced the critics.
e.zh: 她机敏的回答让批评者哑口无言。

e.en: He handled the crisis with remarkable {astucity}.
e.zh: 他以非凡的机敏处理了这场危机。

e.en: Her political {astucity} won her many allies.
e.zh: 她的政治机敏为她赢得了许多盟友。

e.en: The facade is {astylar}, lacking any columns or pilasters.
e.zh: 这座建筑的立面是无柱式的，没有任何柱子或壁柱。

e.en: Many modernist buildings adopt an {astylar} design.
e.zh: 许多现代主义建筑采用无柱式设计。

e.en: In Hindu mythology, an {asura} battles the gods for power.
e.zh: 在印度神话中，阿修罗与众神争夺权力。

e.en: The temple wall depicts an {asura} wielding a weapon.
e.zh: 庙宇墙上描绘了一个手持武器的阿修罗。

e.en: The square was {aswarm} with tourists.
e.zh: 广场上挤满了游客。

e.en: The garden was {aswarm} with bees in spring.
e.zh: 春天花园里蜜蜂成群飞舞。

e.en: The leaves were {aswirl} in the autumn wind.
e.zh: 树叶在秋风中飞舞旋转。

e.en: Her mind was {aswirl} with possibilities.
e.zh: 她的脑海里翻腾着各种可能性。

e.en: She fell {aswoon} at the sight of him.
e.zh: 她一看到他便神魂颠倒。

e.en: The audience was {aswoon} over the singer's performance.
e.zh: 观众为这位歌手的演唱如痴如醉。

e.en: He stood {aswooned} before the masterpiece.
e.zh: 他陶醉地站在那幅杰作前。

e.en: She lay {aswooned} on the velvet couch.
e.zh: 她昏然倒在天鹅绒沙发上。

asylee.t: 获得庇护者；庇护申请人

e.en: The {asylee} was granted permanent residency last year.
e.zh: 那位庇护申请人去年获得了永久居留权。

e.en: Many {asylee} families settle in border cities first.
e.zh: 许多获得庇护的家庭最初在边境城市定居。

e.en: Local nonprofits help {asylees} find housing and jobs.
e.zh: 当地非营利组织帮助庇护者找到住房和工作。

e.en: The agency processed thousands of {asylees} this year.
e.zh: 该机构今年处理了数千名庇护申请者。

e.en: The glide is treated as an {asyllabic} consonant here.
e.zh: 在这里滑音被视为非成节辅音。

e.en: Some dialects have {asyllabic} variants of this vowel.
e.zh: 某些方言中这个元音有非成节的变体。

e.en: Many people carry the virus {asymptomatically}.
e.zh: 许多人携带这种病毒却没有症状。

e.en: The disease can spread {asymptomatically} for weeks.
e.zh: 这种疾病可以在无症状的情况下传播数周。

e.en: The curve approaches the {asymptote} but never touches it.
e.zh: 曲线趋近于渐近线但永远不会接触它。

e.en: Find the horizontal {asymptote} of this rational function.
e.zh: 求出这个有理函数的水平渐近线。

e.en: {Asynapsis} during meiosis often leads to sterility.
e.zh: 减数分裂中的联会缺失常导致不育。

e.en: Researchers studied {asynapsis} in hybrid plants.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了杂交植物中的联会缺失现象。

e.en: The {asynchronism} between the audio and video was distracting.
e.zh: 音频与视频之间的不同步令人分心。

e.en: Cultural {asynchronism} can complicate global negotiations.
e.zh: 文化上的不同步可能使全球谈判变得复杂。

e.en: Caesar's famous phrase is a classic {asyndetic} construction.
e.zh: 凯撒那句名言是经典的无连词结构。

e.en: The poem uses {asyndetic} listing for dramatic effect.
e.zh: 这首诗使用无连词罗列以营造戏剧效果。

e.en: The clauses are joined {asyndetically} for rhetorical force.
e.zh: 这些分句以无连词方式连接以增强修辞力度。

e.en: He listed his accomplishments {asyndetically}.
e.zh: 他不用连词地一一列出自己的成就。

e.en: "I came, I saw, I conquered" is a famous example of {asyndeton}.
e.zh: "我来，我见，我征服"是连词省略法的著名例子。

e.en: The speaker's use of {asyndeton} added urgency.
e.zh: 演讲者使用连词省略法增添了紧迫感。

e.en: The patient's {asynergia} suggested cerebellar damage.
e.zh: 患者的协同失调提示可能存在小脑损伤。

e.en: {Asynergia} makes coordinated movement difficult.
e.zh: 协同失调使得协调动作变得困难。

e.en: Cerebellar {asynergy} affects fine motor control.
e.zh: 小脑协同失调会影响精细动作控制。

e.en: The team's {asynergy} doomed the project.
e.zh: 团队的协同性缺失注定了项目的失败。

e.en: Toddlers often produce {asyntactic} utterances.
e.zh: 幼儿常常说出不合句法的话语。

e.en: The poem's {asyntactic} lines challenge readers.
e.zh: 这首诗不合句法的诗行挑战着读者。

e.en: The monitor showed {asystole}, and the team began CPR.
e.zh: 监护仪显示心搏停止，团队立即开始心肺复苏。

e.en: {Asystole} requires immediate medical intervention.
e.zh: 心搏停止需要立即医疗干预。

at-a-glance.t: 一目了然的；一眼可看的

e.en: The dashboard provides {at-a-glance} information about sales.
e.zh: 该仪表板提供有关销售的一目了然的信息。

e.en: We need an {at-a-glance} summary of the quarterly results.
e.zh: 我们需要一份季度业绩的一目了然摘要。

e.en: The {at-fault} driver had to pay for the damages.
e.zh: 有过错的司机必须赔偿损失。

e.en: Insurance rates increase for {at-fault} accidents.
e.zh: 对于有责任的事故，保险费率会上涨。

at-grade.t: 平面相交的；同一平面的

e.en: The {at-grade} crossing slows traffic considerably.
e.zh: 平面交叉道口大大减缓了交通。

e.en: Engineers replaced the {at-grade} junction with an overpass.
e.zh: 工程师把平面交叉口改建成了立交桥。

e.en: They hosted an {at-home} reception after the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼后他们举办了一场居家招待会。

e.en: {At-home} workouts have become very popular.
e.zh: 居家锻炼已经变得非常流行。

e.en: The suspect remains {at-large} after escaping custody.
e.zh: 嫌疑人逃脱羁押后仍然在逃。

e.en: She was elected as an {at-large} council member.
e.zh: 她当选为不限选区的议员。

e.en: The ritual symbolized {at-one-ment} with the divine.
e.zh: 这种仪式象征着与神灵的合一。

e.en: He sought {at-one-ment} with his estranged family.
e.zh: 他寻求与疏远的家人重归于好。

at-risk.t: 处于危险中的；高风险的

e.en: The program supports {at-risk} youth in the community.
e.zh: 该项目为社区中的高风险青少年提供支持。

e.en: {At-risk} patients should receive the vaccine first.
e.zh: 高风险患者应优先接种疫苗。

e.en: He felt completely {at-sea} during the technical discussion.
e.zh: 他在技术讨论中感到完全不知所措。

e.en: Without instructions, the new hire was {at-sea}.
e.zh: 没有指示，那位新员工茫然无措。

e.en: The {atabal} provided rhythm for the festival dance.
e.zh: 摩尔小鼓为节日舞蹈提供节奏。

e.en: He played the {atabal} with practiced hands.
e.zh: 他用熟练的手法敲打着摩尔小鼓。

e.en: Bright green {atacamite} crystals lined the cavity.
e.zh: 鲜绿色的氯铜矿晶体衬满了空腔。

e.en: {Atacamite} forms in arid copper-rich environments.
e.zh: 氯铜矿形成于富含铜的干旱环境中。

atactic.t: 共济失调的；无规立构的

e.en: The patient showed an {atactic} gait after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后患者出现共济失调的步态。

e.en: {Atactic} polymers have randomly arranged side groups.
e.zh: 无规立构聚合物的侧基排列是随机的。

e.en: The warrior drew his {ataghan} from its silver sheath.
e.zh: 武士从银色刀鞘中拔出了他的土耳其弯刀。

e.en: An ornate {ataghan} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 一把华丽的土耳其弯刀挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {ataractic} drug to calm her nerves.
e.zh: 医生开了一种镇静药来安抚她的神经。

e.en: He spoke in an oddly {ataractic} tone despite the chaos around him.
e.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱，他的语调却出奇地平静。

ataraxia.t: 心神宁静；不动心的状态

e.en: The Stoics pursued {ataraxia} as the highest goal of philosophy.
e.zh: 斯多葛派将心神宁静视为哲学的最高目标。

e.en: Meditation can help one approach a state of {ataraxia}.
e.zh: 冥想能帮助人接近心神宁静的境界。

e.en: The patient was given an {ataraxic} to ease his anxiety.
e.zh: 医生给病人服用镇静药以缓解焦虑。

e.en: Her {ataraxic} composure unsettled the interrogators.
e.zh: 她那镇定自若的神情让审讯者感到不安。

e.en: He achieved a kind of {ataraxy} after years of practice.
e.zh: 经过多年修行，他达到了一种心境平和的状态。

e.en: Their philosophy prized {ataraxy} above worldly success.
e.zh: 他们的哲学把内心宁静看得高于世俗的成功。

e.en: The child showed {atavic} traits from a great-grandfather.
e.zh: 这孩子表现出曾祖父的隔代遗传特征。

e.en: His fear of fire seemed almost {atavic}.
e.zh: 他对火的恐惧近乎一种返祖本能。

e.en: Critics called him an {atavist} clinging to outdated customs.
e.zh: 批评者称他是固守过时风俗的返祖论者。

e.en: The novel features an {atavist} who hunts in the old ways.
e.zh: 小说的主角是一位用古法狩猎的返祖者。

atavistically.t: 返祖地；带有原始本能地

e.en: He {atavistically} reached for the spear when threatened.
e.zh: 受到威胁时，他出于原始本能去抓长矛。

e.en: Crowds sometimes behave {atavistically} under stress.
e.zh: 人群在压力下有时会表现出原始本能的行为。

ataxic.t: 共济失调的；运动失调患者

e.en: The patient showed an {ataxic} gait after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后这位病人出现了共济失调的步态。

e.en: He suffers from an {ataxic} disorder affecting balance.
e.zh: 他患有一种影响平衡的共济失调症。

e.en: The X-ray revealed {atelectasis} in the left lung.
e.zh: X光检查显示左肺出现肺不张。

e.en: Postoperative {atelectasis} is a common complication.
e.zh: 术后肺不张是一种常见并发症。

e.en: The scan showed an {atelectatic} region at the lung base.
e.zh: 扫描显示肺底部出现肺不张区域。

e.en: Physiotherapy helps reopen {atelectatic} segments.
e.zh: 理疗有助于使肺不张的肺段重新张开。

e.en: Verbs like "run" are typically {atelic} in aspect.
e.zh: 像"run"这样的动词通常具有非终结性体貌。

e.en: He distinguished telic from {atelic} actions in the analysis.
e.zh: 他在分析中区分了终结性动作与非终结性动作。

atemoya.t: 阿特莫亚果；释迦凤梨杂交果

e.en: We tasted a sweet {atemoya} at the tropical fruit stand.
e.zh: 我们在热带水果摊上尝了一个香甜的阿特莫亚果。

e.en: The {atemoya} is a hybrid of cherimoya and sugar apple.
e.zh: 阿特莫亚果是冷子番荔枝与番荔枝的杂交品种。

e.en: The film is {atmospherically} stunning.
e.zh: 这部电影在氛围营造上令人惊艳。

e.en: Mars differs {atmospherically} from Earth.
e.zh: 火星在大气层方面与地球不同。

e.en: The {atom-bomb} tests devastated the island.
e.zh: 原子弹试验摧毁了那座岛屿。

e.en: He wrote a book about {atom-bomb} survivors.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于原子弹幸存者的书。

e.en: They imagined {atom-powered} cars in the future.
e.zh: 他们设想未来会有原子能驱动的汽车。

e.en: The {atom-powered} submarine could stay submerged for months.
e.zh: 那艘原子能潜艇能在水下停留数月。

e.en: Scientists used an {atom-probe} to analyze the alloy.
e.zh: 科学家使用原子探针分析该合金。

e.en: The {atom-probe} reveals atomic-level structures.
e.zh: 原子探针能揭示原子级别的结构。

atom-smasher.t: 原子粉碎机；粒子加速器

e.en: The {atom-smasher} accelerates particles to enormous speeds.
e.zh: 这台粒子加速器把粒子加速到极高的速度。

e.en: Cern operates the world's largest {atom-smasher}.
e.zh: 欧洲核子研究中心运营着世界上最大的粒子加速器。

e.en: The country invested heavily in {atomic-energy} research.
e.zh: 该国对原子能研究投入巨资。

e.en: He worked at the {atomic-energy} commission.
e.zh: 他在原子能委员会工作。

e.en: She majored in {atomic-physics} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学主修原子物理学。

e.en: {Atomic-physics} explains how electrons behave.
e.zh: 原子物理学解释电子如何运动。

e.en: The {atomic-powered} icebreaker reached the North Pole.
e.zh: 那艘原子能破冰船抵达了北极。

e.en: Engineers designed an {atomic-powered} aircraft prototype.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一架原子能飞机的原型。

e.en: The bunker was advertised as {atomic-proof}.
e.zh: 那个地堡被宣传为防原子辐射的。

e.en: No structure is truly {atomic-proof}.
e.zh: 没有任何建筑真的能防得住原子弹。

e.en: The microscope captures images at the {atomic-scale}.
e.zh: 这台显微镜能拍摄原子尺度的图像。

e.en: They study {atomic-scale} interactions in metals.
e.zh: 他们研究金属中原子尺度的相互作用。

e.en: The chemist described an {atomical} structure.
e.zh: 那位化学家描述了一种原子结构。

e.en: Such {atomical} differences barely matter.
e.zh: 如此微小的差异几乎无关紧要。

e.en: Database transactions must guarantee {atomicity}.
e.zh: 数据库事务必须保证原子性。

e.en: Chemists discussed the {atomicity} of the element.
e.zh: 化学家们讨论了该元素的原子价。

e.en: Dust {atomies} danced in the sunbeam.
e.zh: 尘埃微粒在阳光中飞舞。

e.en: He called the children tiny {atomies}.
e.zh: 他把孩子们称作小不点。

e.en: The sprayer {atomises} the perfume into a fine mist.
e.zh: 喷雾器把香水雾化成细小的水珠。

e.en: Modern life can {atomise} communities.
e.zh: 现代生活可能使社区分崩离析。

e.en: She filled the perfume {atomiser} with rosewater.
e.zh: 她把玫瑰水装进香水喷雾器里。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a nasal {atomiser}.
e.zh: 医生开了一支鼻腔喷雾器。

e.en: Democritus was an ancient Greek {atomist}.
e.zh: 德谟克利特是古希腊的原子论者。

e.en: Modern physics owes much to early {atomist} thinkers.
e.zh: 现代物理学很大程度上得益于早期的原子论思想家。

e.en: He took an {atomistical} view of society.
e.zh: 他对社会持有原子化的观点。

e.en: The theory has an {atomistical} basis.
e.zh: 该理论建立在原子论的基础上。

atomistically.t: 以原子论方式；个体化地

e.en: The author treats characters {atomistically}.
e.zh: 作者把人物当作彼此孤立的个体来塑造。

e.en: Modern cities often function {atomistically}.
e.zh: 现代城市常常以原子化的方式运作。

e.en: In theory, an {atomless} vacuum is impossible to achieve.
e.zh: 理论上,完全没有原子的真空是无法实现的。

e.en: The poet imagined an {atomless} void.
e.zh: 诗人想象出一个空无一物的虚空。

e.en: Tiny {atomy} of dust floated through the air.
e.zh: 细小的尘粒在空气中飘浮。

e.en: The boy was a mere {atomy} compared to his brothers.
e.zh: 和哥哥们相比,这男孩简直是个小不点。

e.en: Some mistakes are simply not {atonable}.
e.zh: 有些错误根本无法弥补。

e.en: He believed his sins were {atonable}.
e.zh: 他相信自己的罪孽是可以赎的。

e.en: Schoenberg championed {atonalism} in modern music.
e.zh: 勋伯格倡导现代音乐中的无调性主义。

e.en: Critics initially rejected {atonalism} as harsh.
e.zh: 评论家起初认为无调性主义刺耳难听。

e.en: He is regarded as a leading {atonalist} composer.
e.zh: 他被视为主要的无调性主义作曲家。

e.en: The {atonalist} avoided traditional keys entirely.
e.zh: 那位无调性作曲家完全避开传统调性。

e.en: The piece has a strikingly {atonalistic} quality.
e.zh: 这首作品有着鲜明的无调性特征。

e.en: Her {atonalistic} compositions divided audiences.
e.zh: 她的无调性作品让听众意见分化。

e.en: Such grave offenses are hardly {atoneable}.
e.zh: 如此严重的过错几乎无法弥补。

e.en: He saw his betrayal as {atoneable} through service.
e.zh: 他认为自己的背叛可以通过服务来弥补。

e.en: The patient suffered from muscular {atonia}.
e.zh: 患者出现肌张力缺失的症状。

e.en: REM sleep is characterized by {atonia}.
e.zh: 快速眼动睡眠期的特点是肌肉张力缺失。

e.en: The patient experienced an {atonic} seizure.
e.zh: 患者出现了无张力性发作。

e.en: Linguists note that some syllables are {atonic}.
e.zh: 语言学家指出有些音节是非重读的。

e.en: Bowel {atonicity} can cause digestive problems.
e.zh: 肠道无张力可能导致消化问题。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed muscle {atonicity}.
e.zh: 医生诊断出肌肉无张力。

e.en: Stomach {atony} can lead to chronic indigestion.
e.zh: 胃张力缺失可能导致慢性消化不良。

e.en: The patient showed signs of muscular {atony}.
e.zh: 患者出现了肌肉张力缺失的迹象。

e.en: The neurologist tested the patient for {atopognosis}.
e.zh: 神经科医生检查患者是否有位置觉缺失。

e.en: {Atopognosis} can result from cortical damage.
e.zh: 位置觉缺失可能由皮层损伤引起。

e.en: Children with {atopy} often develop asthma.
e.zh: 有特应性体质的儿童常会发展成哮喘。

e.en: {Atopy} runs in families.
e.zh: 特应性过敏症具有家族遗传倾向。

e.en: The crew secured an {athwartship} beam across the deck.
e.zh: 船员在甲板上横向固定了一根横梁。

e.en: An {athwartship} bulkhead divided the lower hold.
e.zh: 一道横向的舱壁把下货舱分隔开来。

athwartships.t: 横跨船身地；与船身成直角地

e.en: The cargo was stowed {athwartships} for stability.
e.zh: 为了稳定，货物被横向堆放在船身上。

e.en: He laid the plank {athwartships} between the rails.
e.zh: 他把木板横向架在两边栏杆之间。

e.en: Researchers used {athymic} mice to study tumor growth.
e.zh: 研究人员使用无胸腺小鼠来研究肿瘤生长。

e.en: The {athymic} animal lacked a functional immune response.
e.zh: 这只无胸腺的动物缺乏正常的免疫反应。

e.en: His hat sat {atilt} on his head.
e.zh: 他的帽子歪斜地戴在头上。

e.en: The old fence leaned {atilt} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，那道旧栅栏歪斜地倾斜着。

e.en: Her skin was {atingle} with anticipation.
e.zh: 她的皮肤因期待而微微发麻。

e.en: The cold air left his fingers {atingle}.
e.zh: 冷空气让他的手指刺刺地发麻。

e.en: "{Atishoo}!" she sneezed into her handkerchief.
e.zh: “阿嚏！”她对着手帕打了个喷嚏。

e.en: He let out a loud {atishoo} before reaching for tissues.
e.zh: 他大声地“阿嚏”一下，然后去拿纸巾。

atlantes.t: 男像柱（用作建筑支柱的男性雕像）

e.en: Massive {atlantes} supported the entrance of the temple.
e.zh: 巨大的男像柱支撑着神庙的入口。

e.en: The carved {atlantes} bore the weight of the marble balcony.
e.zh: 雕刻的男像柱承担着大理石阳台的重量。

atmogenic.t: 大气成因的；源于空气的

e.en: Some minerals form through {atmogenic} processes in volcanic vents.
e.zh: 有些矿物是通过火山口中的大气成因过程形成的。

e.en: The deposit had a clearly {atmogenic} origin.
e.zh: 该矿床显然源自大气作用。

atmolysis.t: 分气法；气体扩散分离法

e.en: {Atmolysis} separates gases by their differing rates of diffusion.
e.zh: 分气法依据气体扩散速率的差异来分离气体。

e.en: The lab demonstrated {atmolysis} using a porous clay tube.
e.zh: 实验室用多孔陶管演示了分气法。

e.en: They tried to {atmolyze} the gas mixture through a porous membrane.
e.zh: 他们尝试通过多孔膜对气体混合物进行分气分离。

e.en: You can {atmolyze} hydrogen from heavier gases fairly easily.
e.zh: 你可以相对容易地将氢气从较重的气体中分气分离出来。

e.en: The farmer checked the {atmometer} to estimate water loss.
e.zh: 农场主查看蒸发计来估算水分损失。

e.en: An {atmometer} measures the rate at which water evaporates.
e.zh: 蒸发计用来测量水分蒸发的速率。

e.en: {Atmometry} helps researchers track evaporation in dry climates.
e.zh: 蒸发量测定法可帮助研究人员追踪干旱气候中的蒸发情况。

e.en: Modern {atmometry} relies on electronic sensors for precision.
e.zh: 现代蒸发量测定法依靠电子传感器来提高精度。

e.en: The instruments measured several {atmospherical} variables at once.
e.zh: 这些仪器同时测量多个大气变量。

e.en: Old texts describe {atmospherical} phenomena like halos and auroras.
e.zh: 古籍描述了光晕和极光等大气现象。

atrabilious.t: 忧郁易怒的；脾气阴沉的

e.en: Grandfather grew {atrabilious} whenever politics came up.
e.zh: 一谈到政治，爷爷就变得阴郁暴躁。

e.en: Her {atrabilious} mood ruined the dinner party.
e.zh: 她郁郁寡欢的情绪毁了这场晚宴。

e.en: His chronic {atrabiliousness} eventually drove his friends away.
e.zh: 他长期的阴郁性情最终把朋友都赶跑了。

e.en: The novel captures the {atrabiliousness} of its aging hero.
e.zh: 小说刻画了年迈主角的忧郁性情。

e.en: He stared into the {atramentous} water of the old well.
e.zh: 他凝视着古井中漆黑如墨的水。

e.en: An {atramentous} stain spread slowly across the page.
e.zh: 一团墨黑的污渍在纸页上慢慢晕开。

e.en: She stood {atremble} with fear by the doorway.
e.zh: 她在门口吓得浑身颤抖。

e.en: His hands were {atremble} as he opened the letter.
e.zh: 他拆信时双手不停颤抖。

e.en: The hotel boasted two grand {atria} filled with palms.
e.zh: 这家酒店有两座种满棕榈的宏伟中庭。

e.en: Blood enters the heart through the upper {atria}.
e.zh: 血液经由上部的心房流入心脏。

e.en: The bosun shouted that the anchor was {atrip}.
e.zh: 水手长高喊锚已经离底。

e.en: With the anchor {atrip}, the schooner began to drift seaward.
e.zh: 锚一离底，那艘纵帆船便开始向海漂去。

e.en: Make sure the strap is easily {attachable} to the backpack.
e.zh: 确保这条肩带能轻松地装到背包上。

e.en: The file is too large to be {attachable} to a single email.
e.zh: 这个文件太大，没法作为一封邮件的附件发送。

attackable.t: 易受攻击的；可被驳斥的

e.en: His argument was full of holes and easily {attackable}.
e.zh: 他的论点漏洞百出，很容易被驳倒。

e.en: From the ridge, the fortress looked highly {attackable}.
e.zh: 从山脊上看，这座堡垒似乎很容易被攻陷。

e.en: The young {attackman} scored three goals in the final.
e.zh: 这位年轻攻击手在决赛中攻入三球。

e.en: Their star {attackman} was sidelined by a knee injury.
e.zh: 他们的明星攻击手因膝伤无法上场。

attagirl.t: 好样的（对女性的赞叹语）

e.en: "{Attagirl}!" he shouted as she crossed the finish line.
e.zh: "好样的！"她冲过终点线时他喊道。

e.en: {Attagirl}, you nailed that presentation.
e.zh: 干得漂亮，你那场演讲太精彩了。

e.en: We questioned the {attainability} of the sales target.
e.zh: 我们质疑了销售目标的可实现性。

e.en: The {attainability} of true happiness is debated by philosophers.
e.zh: 真正幸福的可达成性是哲学家们争论的话题。

e.en: The traitor was {attaint} by act of Parliament.
e.zh: 该叛徒被议会法案褫夺公权。

e.en: No scandal could {attaint} her reputation.
e.zh: 没有任何丑闻能玷污她的名誉。

attainted.t: 被褫夺公权的；被玷污的

e.en: The {attainted} nobleman lost his lands and titles.
e.zh: 那位被褫夺公权的贵族失去了土地和爵位。

e.en: His honor was {attainted} by the false accusation.
e.zh: 他的名誉因不实指控而蒙污。

e.en: The crown was {attainting} rebels after the uprising.
e.zh: 起义之后王室正在褫夺叛军公权。

e.en: They feared {attainting} the family name forever.
e.zh: 他们害怕永久玷污家族的名誉。

attaints.t: 褫夺公权；玷污（第三人称单数）

e.en: The verdict {attaints} him of high treason.
e.zh: 该裁决判定他犯有叛国大罪并褫夺其公权。

e.en: Nothing {attaints} her gentle reputation.
e.zh: 没有任何事能玷污她温和的名声。

e.en: Wise counsel can {attemper} a hot temper.
e.zh: 明智的劝告可以缓和暴躁的性情。

e.en: They {attemper} the wine with a little water.
e.zh: 他们在酒里掺一点水以调和口感。

e.en: The {attemperation} of justice with mercy is essential.
e.zh: 以仁慈调和正义至关重要。

e.en: Proper {attemperation} of the brewing temperature improves the beer.
e.zh: 对酿造温度的恰当调节能让啤酒更出色。

attemperator.t: 温度调节器（旧用，啤酒酿造）

e.en: The brewery installed a copper {attemperator} in each tank.
e.zh: 啤酒厂在每个发酵罐里都装了铜制温度调节器。

e.en: An old {attemperator} kept the wort at the right temperature.
e.zh: 一台老式温度调节器使麦汁保持在适宜温度。

e.en: His anger was {attempered} by her gentle words.
e.zh: 他的怒气被她温柔的话语缓和了。

e.en: She spoke in {attempered} tones to soothe the child.
e.zh: 她以缓和的语气安抚孩子。

e.en: {Attempering} steel requires careful control of heat.
e.zh: 调质钢材需要仔细控制温度。

e.en: She has a way of {attempering} bad news with humor.
e.zh: 她有种用幽默缓和坏消息的本事。

attempers.t: 调和；缓和（第三人称单数）

e.en: Time {attempers} even the deepest grief.
e.zh: 时间能缓和最深的悲痛。

e.en: She {attempers} her criticism with kind encouragement.
e.zh: 她在批评中夹带善意的鼓励以缓和语气。

e.en: Only the easier routes are {attemptable} in winter.
e.zh: 冬天只有较容易的路线才可尝试攀登。

e.en: Is this puzzle even {attemptable} without a hint?
e.zh: 这道谜题没有提示能尝试解开吗？

attention-focusing.t: 集中注意力的；引起关注的

e.en: The teacher used {attention-focusing} questions to engage the class.
e.zh: 老师用引导注意力的问题来吸引全班。

e.en: Bright colors are an {attention-focusing} design element.
e.zh: 鲜艳的色彩是一种聚焦注意力的设计元素。

attention-getter.t: 吸引注意的事物或手段

e.en: The bright red dress was a real {attention-getter}.
e.zh: 那条鲜红色的裙子非常引人注目。

e.en: A surprising statistic makes a great {attention-getter} in a speech.
e.zh: 出人意料的数据是演讲中绝佳的吸睛点。

attention-getters.t: 吸引注意的事物或手段（复数）

e.en: Good headlines are powerful {attention-getters}.
e.zh: 好的标题是强有力的吸睛工具。

e.en: Her quirky earrings are always {attention-getters}.
e.zh: 她那对古怪的耳环总是引人注目。

e.en: The campaign used {attention-getting} graphics on every poster.
e.zh: 该活动在每张海报上都使用了吸睛的图案。

e.en: His {attention-getting} antics annoyed the teacher.
e.zh: 他那些哗众取宠的举动惹恼了老师。

attenuant.t: 稀释剂；减弱剂（医学用语）

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {attenuant} to thin the patient's blood.
e.zh: 医生开了一种稀释剂以稀释病人的血液。

e.en: Certain herbs act as natural {attenuant} agents.
e.zh: 某些草药可作为天然的稀释药剂。

attercop.t: 蜘蛛（古英语）；脾气暴躁的人

e.en: In Tolkien's tale, Bilbo taunts the spiders with cries of "{attercop}!"
e.zh: 在托尔金的故事中，比尔博高喊"蜘蛛！"嘲弄那些蜘蛛。

e.en: The old man was a grumpy {attercop} who scared the children.
e.zh: 那老头是个吓唬小孩的暴脾气家伙。

e.en: The {attestant} signed the document before the notary.
e.zh: 证明人在公证人面前签署了文件。

e.en: Two {attestant} witnesses were required by law.
e.zh: 法律要求需要两名证明人在场作证。

e.en: Each will requires an {attestor} to confirm the signature.
e.zh: 每份遗嘱都需要一位见证人确认签名。

e.en: The {attestor} swore that the document was genuine.
e.zh: 见证人发誓该文件是真实的。

atticism.t: 雅典风格；典雅简洁的措辞

e.en: His prose is admired for its elegant {atticism}.
e.zh: 他的散文因典雅简洁的雅典风格而备受推崇。

e.en: Roman orators studied Greek {atticism} as a model.
e.zh: 罗马演说家把希腊雅典风格作为典范来学习。

atticize.t: 使具雅典风格；模仿雅典人

e.en: He tried to {atticize} his writing by imitating classical models.
e.zh: 他通过模仿古典范式让自己的文章具雅典风格。

e.en: Some Roman authors chose to {atticize} their speeches.
e.zh: 一些罗马作家选择让自己的演讲带有雅典韵味。

e.en: Her royal {attirement} dazzled the entire court.
e.zh: 她的王室装束令满朝惊艳。

e.en: The actor's {attirement} was authentic to the period.
e.zh: 演员的服饰忠实再现了那个时代。

attitudinarian.t: 装腔作势的人；爱摆姿态者

e.en: He's a pompous {attitudinarian} who loves to lecture others.
e.zh: 他是个装腔作势的人，爱对别人指手画脚。

e.en: The critic dismissed him as a self-righteous {attitudinarian}.
e.zh: 评论家将他斥为自以为是的装腔作势者。

e.en: Politicians often {attitudinize} for the cameras.
e.zh: 政客们常常对着镜头装腔作势。

e.en: Stop trying to {attitudinize} and just speak honestly.
e.zh: 别再摆姿态了，老实说话吧。

e.en: He {attitudinized} on stage instead of giving a real performance.
e.zh: 他在台上装腔作势，没有真正的表演。

e.en: She {attitudinized} before the mirror for hours.
e.zh: 她在镜子前摆姿态摆了好几个小时。

attitudinizer.t: 装腔作势者；爱摆姿态的人

e.en: He's a notorious {attitudinizer} who craves the spotlight.
e.zh: 他是个出了名的装腔作势者，渴望成为焦点。

e.en: Don't trust that {attitudinizer}—he's all show.
e.zh: 别相信那个爱摆姿态的人，他全是花架子。

attitudinizes.t: 装腔作势（第三人称单数）

e.en: Whenever cameras appear, he {attitudinizes} for the public.
e.zh: 每当镜头出现，他就对公众装腔作势。

e.en: She {attitudinizes} as if she were royalty.
e.zh: 她摆出一副皇室般的姿态。

attitudinizing.t: 装腔作势（动名词/现在分词）

e.en: His constant {attitudinizing} annoys his colleagues.
e.zh: 他不断地装腔作势让同事们很反感。

e.en: Stop {attitudinizing} and do some real work.
e.zh: 别再摆姿态了，做点实事吧。

e.en: The therapist used {auditive} cues to help the patient.
e.zh: 治疗师使用听觉提示帮助病人。

e.en: Children rely on {auditive} learning in early years.
e.zh: 孩子们在幼年时期依赖听觉学习。

auditoria.t: 礼堂；观众席（auditorium 的复数）

e.en: The campus has three modern {auditoria} for lectures.
e.zh: 校园里有三座现代化的礼堂用于讲座。

e.en: Both {auditoria} were filled to capacity.
e.zh: 两个礼堂都坐满了人。

e.en: The hall's {auditorial} acoustics impressed every guest.
e.zh: 大厅的礼堂音效令每位来宾印象深刻。

e.en: They studied {auditorial} response to the speech.
e.zh: 他们研究了听众对演讲的反应。

auditorship.t: 审计员的职位；审计任期

e.en: She accepted the {auditorship} of the city council.
e.zh: 她接受了市议会审计员一职。

e.en: His {auditorship} lasted only two years.
e.zh: 他的审计员任期只持续了两年。

augite.t: 辉石（一种深色硅酸盐矿物）

e.en: The rock contains crystals of {augite} and feldspar.
e.zh: 这块岩石含有辉石和长石的晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {augite} in the volcanic sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在火山样本中鉴定出辉石。

e.en: The cliff is made of {augitic} basalt.
e.zh: 悬崖由含辉石的玄武岩构成。

e.en: They mapped the {augitic} layers carefully.
e.zh: 他们仔细绘制了含辉石岩层的地图。

e.en: The system's {augmentability} makes future upgrades easy.
e.zh: 该系统的可扩充性使未来升级变得容易。

e.en: Engineers praised the platform's {augmentability}.
e.zh: 工程师们称赞该平台的可扩充性。

e.en: The basic plan is fully {augmentable} with add-ons.
e.zh: 基础套餐可通过附加服务完全扩充。

e.en: Memory in this device is {augmentable} up to 64 GB.
e.zh: 该设备的内存可扩充至 64 GB。

e.en: She uses an {augmentative} communication device.
e.zh: 她使用一种辅助沟通设备。

e.en: Spanish has many {augmentative} suffixes.
e.zh: 西班牙语有许多表示扩大的后缀。

e.en: The jet engine fires its {augmentor} for takeoff.
e.zh: 喷气发动机在起飞时启动加力燃烧室。

e.en: This signal {augmentor} boosts weak transmissions.
e.zh: 这个信号增强器可放大微弱传输。

e.en: Roman priests performed {augural} ceremonies before battles.
e.zh: 罗马祭司在战前举行占卜仪式。

e.en: The book describes ancient {augural} practices.
e.zh: 这本书描述了古代的占卜活动。

e.en: He was elected to the {augurship} of Rome.
e.zh: 他被选任为罗马的占卜师。

e.en: The {augurship} carried great religious authority.
e.zh: 占卜师一职拥有极大的宗教权威。

auklet.t: 小海雀（北太平洋的一种小型海鸟）

e.en: A tiny {auklet} dove beneath the waves.
e.zh: 一只小海雀潜入海浪下。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {auklet} colonies in Alaska.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了阿拉斯加的小海雀群落。

e.en: The {aulic} council advised the emperor.
e.zh: 宫廷会议为皇帝出谋划策。

e.en: He held an {aulic} office for many years.
e.zh: 他多年担任宫廷职务。

aulos.t: 奥洛斯管（古希腊双管乐器）

e.en: The musician played a haunting tune on the {aulos}.
e.zh: 乐师用奥洛斯管吹奏出萦绕心头的曲调。

e.en: Ancient vases often depict players of the {aulos}.
e.zh: 古代花瓶上常描绘奥洛斯管演奏者。

e.en: The tenants agreed to {attorn} to the new landlord.
e.zh: 租户们同意承认新房东的地位。

e.en: Vassals were required to {attorn} after the lord's death.
e.zh: 领主去世后，封臣须向新主效忠。

attorned.t: 已转移效忠；已承认新业主

e.en: The tenants {attorned} to the buyer at closing.
e.zh: 租户在交割时承认了买方为新业主。

e.en: Once they had {attorned}, rent was paid to the new owner.
e.zh: 他们一旦认主，租金就交给新业主。

e.en: She works as an {attorney-at-law} in Boston.
e.zh: 她在波士顿做执业律师。

e.en: Only an {attorney-at-law} may represent you in court.
e.zh: 只有执业律师才能在法庭上代表你。

e.en: The {attorney-general} announced new charges today.
e.zh: 总检察长今日宣布了新的指控。

e.en: Each state has its own {attorney-general}.
e.zh: 每个州都有自己的司法部长。

attorney-in-fact.t: 事实代理人；受托代理人

e.en: He signed the deed as her {attorney-in-fact}.
e.zh: 他作为她的事实代理人签署了契约。

e.en: An {attorney-in-fact} acts under a power of attorney.
e.zh: 事实代理人依据授权委托书行事。

e.en: He held the {attorneyship} for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他担任律师职务将近十年。

e.en: Her {attorneyship} ended when the firm dissolved.
e.zh: 事务所解散后她的律师职务也告终。

e.en: By {attorning} to the buyer, the tenant accepted the change.
e.zh: 租户通过认买方为主，接受了变更。

e.en: The clause requires {attorning} to any successor landlord.
e.zh: 该条款要求向任何继任房东承认其身份。

e.en: The tenant {attorns} to whoever holds the title.
e.zh: 租户承认任何持有产权者为业主。

e.en: He {attorns} formally at the signing ceremony.
e.zh: 他在签约仪式上正式认主。

e.en: Lasers can now pulse on an {attosecond} timescale.
e.zh: 激光现在能以阿秒级别脉冲。

e.en: An {attosecond} is a billionth of a billionth of a second.
e.zh: 一阿秒等于十亿分之一的十亿分之一秒。

e.en: The pulse lasted only a few hundred {attoseconds}.
e.zh: 脉冲只持续了几百阿秒。

e.en: Electron motion is measured in {attoseconds}.
e.zh: 电子运动以阿秒为单位测量。

attractability.t: 可吸引性；易被吸引的特性

e.en: The metal's {attractability} to magnets is well known.
e.zh: 这种金属对磁铁的可吸引性人尽皆知。

e.en: Researchers measured the {attractability} of each particle.
e.zh: 研究者测量了每种粒子的可吸引性。

e.en: Iron filings are easily {attractable} by magnets.
e.zh: 铁屑很容易被磁铁吸引。

e.en: Not all metals are {attractable} to a magnet.
e.zh: 并非所有金属都能被磁铁吸引。

e.en: The ointment acts as an {attrahent} to draw out fluid.
e.zh: 这种药膏作为吸引剂可引出液体。

e.en: Magnets exert an {attrahent} force on iron.
e.zh: 磁铁对铁产生吸引力。

e.en: The software acts as an {attributor} of each edit.
e.zh: 该软件充当每次编辑的归因者。

e.en: As an {attributor}, she traced each quote to its source.
e.zh: 作为归因者，她追溯了每条引文的出处。

e.en: The army sought to {attrit} enemy forces over time.
e.zh: 军队设法逐步消耗敌军。

e.en: Constant raids {attrit} the supply lines.
e.zh: 持续突袭消耗了补给线。

e.en: The stones were {attrite} from centuries of footsteps.
e.zh: 这些石头被几个世纪的脚步磨损了。

e.en: Years of friction had left the gear {attrite}.
e.zh: 多年的摩擦让齿轮磨损不堪。

e.en: The unit was severely {attrited} after the campaign.
e.zh: 部队在战役后损耗严重。

e.en: Our staff has been {attrited} by years of layoffs.
e.zh: 多年裁员让我们的员工流失严重。

e.en: The match became an {attritional} battle in midfield.
e.zh: 比赛在中场演变为消耗战。

e.en: They settled in for {attritional} trench warfare.
e.zh: 他们准备打消耗性的堑壕战。

e.en: His sword cleaved the shield {atwain}.
e.zh: 他的剑把盾牌劈成两半。

e.en: The veil was torn {atwain} at that moment.
e.zh: 那一刻幔帐被撕成两半。

e.en: She stood {atween} the two old oaks.
e.zh: 她站在两棵老橡树之间。

e.en: There's little love lost {atween} them.
e.zh: 他们之间没什么情分。

e.en: Leaves were {atwirl} in the autumn wind.
e.zh: 树叶在秋风中打着转。

e.en: Her skirts went {atwirl} as she danced.
e.zh: 她跳舞时裙摆飞旋。

e.en: His fingers were {atwitch} with nerves.
e.zh: 他的手指因紧张而抽动。

e.en: The horse's ears were {atwitch} at every sound.
e.zh: 马的耳朵每听到声响就抽动。

atwitter.t: 叽叽喳喳的；兴奋激动的

e.en: The class was {atwitter} with rumors of a snow day.
e.zh: 班里因停课传闻而兴奋不已。

e.en: Birds were {atwitter} in the morning light.
e.zh: 群鸟在晨光中啁啾。

e.en: He stood {atwixt} hope and fear.
e.zh: 他徘徊于希望与恐惧之间。

e.en: A small stream ran {atwixt} the cottages.
e.zh: 一条小溪在小屋之间流过。

e.en: The biopsy showed mild cellular {atypia}.
e.zh: 活检显示轻度细胞异型性。

e.en: {Atypia} can be a precursor to malignancy.
e.zh: 细胞异型性可能是恶性病变的前兆。

e.en: The patient showed an {atypic} reaction to the drug.
e.zh: 患者对该药物出现了非典型反应。

e.en: It was an {atypic} case from the start.
e.zh: 这从一开始就是个非典型病例。

e.en: The {atypicality} of his symptoms puzzled the doctors.
e.zh: 他症状的非典型性让医生们困惑。

e.en: Researchers noted the {atypicality} of the data.
e.zh: 研究者注意到数据的非典型性。

e.en: He composed an {aubade} for his lover at dawn.
e.zh: 他为爱人在黎明谱写了一首晨歌。

e.en: The poem is a tender {aubade} of parting.
e.zh: 这首诗是首温柔的离别晨歌。

e.en: We stayed at a charming {auberge} in Provence.
e.zh: 我们住在普罗旺斯一家迷人的小客栈。

e.en: The {auberge} served homemade bread and stew.
e.zh: 这家小客栈供应自制面包和炖菜。

auspicate.t: 为…揭幕；以吉利仪式开启

e.en: The mayor will {auspicate} the new bridge tomorrow.
e.zh: 市长明天将为新桥揭幕。

e.en: They {auspicate} every voyage with a small ceremony.
e.zh: 他们以小型仪式为每次航行讨个好彩头。

auspicated.t: 已为…揭幕；已以吉礼开启

e.en: The queen {auspicated} the festival with a speech.
e.zh: 女王以一席演讲为节日揭幕。

e.en: Their partnership was formally {auspicated} last spring.
e.zh: 他们的合作关系于去年春天正式揭幕。

e.en: The director always {auspicates} a project with tea.
e.zh: 导演总是以茶礼为项目开启好兆头。

e.en: A blessing {auspicates} every village wedding here.
e.zh: 这里每场乡村婚礼都以一段祝祷开启。

auspicating.t: 正在为…揭幕；以吉礼开启

e.en: The elders are {auspicating} the harvest with songs.
e.zh: 长老们正以歌声为丰收讨个好彩头。

e.en: She spoke briefly while {auspicating} the new clinic.
e.zh: 她在为新诊所揭幕时简短致辞。

austenite.t: 奥氏体（钢铁中的一种相）

e.en: Heating the steel forms {austenite} above 727°C.
e.zh: 加热到727℃以上时，钢中会形成奥氏体。

e.en: The microscope revealed grains of pure {austenite}.
e.zh: 显微镜下显示出纯奥氏体的晶粒。

e.en: This pipe is made of {austenitic} stainless steel.
e.zh: 这根管子由奥氏体不锈钢制成。

e.en: {Austenitic} alloys resist corrosion well.
e.zh: 奥氏体合金的耐腐蚀性能良好。

austenitize.t: 奥氏体化；加热使形成奥氏体

e.en: We {austenitize} the bar at 900°C before quenching.
e.zh: 我们在淬火前将钢条在900℃下奥氏体化。

e.en: The furnace must {austenitize} the steel evenly.
e.zh: 炉子必须均匀地将钢奥氏体化。

australite.t: 澳大利亚陨石玻璃；澳洲玻陨石

e.en: The collector showed me a small black {australite}.
e.zh: 收藏家给我看了一块小小的黑色澳洲玻陨石。

e.en: Each {australite} formed from a meteorite impact.
e.zh: 每一块澳洲玻陨石都源自陨石撞击。

austro-hungarians.t: 奥匈帝国人；奥匈帝国国民

e.en: The {Austro-Hungarians} ruled a vast multiethnic empire.
e.zh: 奥匈帝国人统治着一个多民族的庞大帝国。

e.en: Many {Austro-Hungarians} emigrated before the war.
e.zh: 许多奥匈帝国人在战前移民海外。

e.en: Histamine acts as a powerful {autacoid} in tissues.
e.zh: 组胺在组织中是一种强效的局部激素。

e.en: Each {autacoid} works near where it is released.
e.zh: 每种局部激素都在其释放处附近发挥作用。

autacoidal.t: 局部激素的；内分泌素的

e.en: The drug mimics an {autacoidal} signal in the gut.
e.zh: 该药物模拟肠道中的一种局部激素信号。

e.en: Researchers studied its {autacoidal} effects on vessels.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了它对血管的局部激素作用。

e.en: The aging {autarch} refused to name a successor.
e.zh: 年迈的独裁者拒绝指定继承人。

e.en: Citizens lived in fear of the cruel {autarch}.
e.zh: 民众生活在残暴独裁者的恐惧之下。

e.en: The country slid into {autarchic} rule after the coup.
e.zh: 政变之后，该国陷入了独裁统治。

e.en: His {autarchic} style alienated even close allies.
e.zh: 他独断专行的作风连亲密盟友都疏远了。

e.en: Critics denounced the regime's {autarchical} tendencies.
e.zh: 批评人士谴责该政权的独裁倾向。

e.en: He governs in an unmistakably {autarchical} manner.
e.zh: 他以一种明显独裁的方式进行统治。

e.en: Several Cold War {autarchies} eventually collapsed.
e.zh: 冷战时期数个独裁政体最终垮台。

e.en: History shows that {autarchies} rarely last forever.
e.zh: 历史表明独裁政体很少能长盛不衰。

e.en: The country drifted from democracy toward {autarchy}.
e.zh: 这个国家从民主逐渐滑向独裁。

e.en: Reformers vowed to end decades of {autarchy}.
e.zh: 改革者誓言要结束数十年的独裁统治。

autarkical.t: 自给自足的；经济自足的

e.en: The island pursued an {autarkical} economic policy.
e.zh: 该岛奉行自给自足的经济政策。

e.en: Few modern states are truly {autarkical} today.
e.zh: 如今真正经济自足的国家寥寥无几。

e.en: The {autarkist} argued for closing all foreign trade.
e.zh: 那位经济自给主义者主张关闭一切对外贸易。

e.en: He became an outspoken {autarkist} after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机之后，他成了一个直言不讳的自给主义者。

e.en: The {autarkists} wanted to ban all imported grain.
e.zh: 自给主义者们想要禁止一切进口谷物。

e.en: Few {autarkists} hold influential positions today.
e.zh: 如今很少有自给主义者身居要职。

autarky.t: 自给自足；经济自足政策

e.en: The regime pursued {autarky} to resist sanctions.
e.zh: 该政权推行自给自足以抵抗制裁。

e.en: Complete {autarky} is almost impossible in a global economy.
e.zh: 在全球经济中，彻底的自给自足几乎是不可能的。

e.en: Some rust fungi are {autecious}, needing only one host.
e.zh: 有些锈菌属于单主寄生，仅需一种寄主。

e.en: An {autecious} parasite completes its cycle on one species.
e.zh: 单主寄生的寄生虫在一种物种上完成其生命周期。

e.en: Botanists noted clear {autecism} in this rust species.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到该锈菌种存在明显的单主寄生现象。

e.en: {Autecism} simplifies the parasite's life cycle.
e.zh: 单主寄生现象简化了寄生虫的生命周期。

e.en: She published an {autecologic} study of one moss species.
e.zh: 她发表了一项关于某种苔藓的个体生态学研究。

e.en: The chapter offers an {autecologic} view of the frog.
e.zh: 该章节从个体生态学角度考察这种青蛙。

e.en: They conducted {autecological} fieldwork on alpine plants.
e.zh: 他们对高山植物开展了个体生态学的野外研究。

e.en: An {autecological} approach focuses on a single species.
e.zh: 个体生态学方法专注于单一物种的研究。

e.en: The team analyzed the lizard {autecologically} for years.
e.zh: 研究小组多年来从个体生态学角度分析这种蜥蜴。

e.en: {Autecologically}, this beetle prefers cool, damp logs.
e.zh: 从个体生态学上看，这种甲虫偏爱阴凉潮湿的朽木。

auriculated.t: 有耳状附属物的；具耳廓的

e.en: The botanist noted the {auriculated} leaves at the stem's base.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到茎基部那些有耳状附属物的叶片。

e.en: Some shells are distinctly {auriculated} near the hinge.
e.zh: 有些贝壳在铰合部附近明显呈耳状。

e.en: Prospectors flocked to the {auriferous} gravels along the river.
e.zh: 淘金者涌向河边那些含金的砂砾层。

e.en: The region is famous for its {auriferous} quartz veins.
e.zh: 该地区以其含金石英脉而闻名。

e.en: The artisan carved an {auriform} handle onto the vase.
e.zh: 工匠在花瓶上雕了一个耳形的把手。

e.en: Certain fungi develop {auriform} caps when mature.
e.zh: 某些真菌成熟时会长出耳形的菌盖。

auriscope.t: 耳镜（检查耳道的医疗器械）

e.en: The doctor used an {auriscope} to examine the child's ear.
e.zh: 医生用耳镜检查孩子的耳朵。

e.en: A clean {auriscope} tip is essential for accurate diagnosis.
e.zh: 干净的耳镜头端对准确诊断至关重要。

e.en: Routine {auriscopy} can detect early signs of infection.
e.zh: 常规耳镜检查可以发现感染的早期迹象。

e.en: The student practiced {auriscopy} on a model of the ear.
e.zh: 学生在耳朵模型上练习耳镜检查。

e.en: In the nineteenth century an {aurist} treated all manner of ear ailments.
e.zh: 在十九世纪，耳科医生治疗各种耳部疾病。

e.en: She consulted a renowned {aurist} about her hearing loss.
e.zh: 她就听力损失问题咨询了一位著名的耳科医生。

aurochs.t: 原牛（已灭绝的欧洲野牛）

e.en: The {aurochs} once roamed the forests of Europe.
e.zh: 原牛曾经在欧洲的森林中漫游。

e.en: Cave paintings depict hunters chasing an {aurochs}.
e.zh: 洞穴壁画描绘了猎人追赶原牛的场景。

e.en: The {aurorae} shimmered green across the polar sky.
e.zh: 极光在极地天空中闪着绿光。

e.en: Scientists study how solar storms produce {aurorae}.
e.zh: 科学家研究太阳风暴如何产生极光。

e.en: An {aurorean} glow filled the eastern horizon.
e.zh: 一片曙光般的光辉充满了东方的地平线。

e.en: Her face had an {aurorean} freshness in the morning light.
e.zh: 在晨光中，她的脸有一种黎明般的清新。

e.en: The chemist prepared an {aurous} chloride solution.
e.zh: 化学家制备了氯化亚金溶液。

e.en: {Aurous} compounds are less stable than auric ones.
e.zh: 亚金化合物的稳定性不如金化合物。

aurum.t: 金（金的拉丁名，化学符号 Au）

e.en: The chemical symbol Au derives from the Latin {aurum}.
e.zh: 化学符号 Au 源自拉丁语 aurum（金）。

e.en: Alchemists long sought to transmute lead into {aurum}.
e.zh: 炼金术士长久以来都试图把铅变成金。

e.en: The physician will {auscultate} your chest with a stethoscope.
e.zh: 医生会用听诊器给你的胸部听诊。

e.en: Nurses learn to {auscultate} bowel sounds during training.
e.zh: 护士在培训中学习对肠鸣音进行听诊。

e.en: The doctor {auscultated} the patient's lungs carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细听诊了病人的肺部。

e.en: She {auscultated} his heart and noted a faint murmur.
e.zh: 她听诊了他的心脏，注意到一阵轻微的杂音。

auscultates.t: 听诊（auscultate 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The intern {auscultates} every patient on morning rounds.
e.zh: 实习医生在晨间查房时给每位病人听诊。

e.en: He always {auscultates} the abdomen before palpating.
e.zh: 他总是先听诊腹部，再进行触诊。

e.en: While {auscultating} the chest, she heard a wheeze.
e.zh: 在给胸部听诊时，她听到了喘鸣声。

e.en: The student practiced {auscultating} heart sounds in the lab.
e.zh: 学生在实验室练习听诊心音。

e.en: A skilled {auscultator} can detect subtle valve abnormalities.
e.zh: 熟练的听诊者能够发现细微的瓣膜异常。

e.en: The old textbook describes the doctor as a careful {auscultator}.
e.zh: 那本旧教科书把这位医生描述为一位细心的听诊者。

e.en: The {auscultatory} findings suggested early pneumonia.
e.zh: 听诊结果提示早期肺炎。

e.en: Blood pressure can be measured by an {auscultatory} method.
e.zh: 血压可以通过听诊法来测量。

aunthood.t: 姨妈或姑妈的身份；当姑姑的状态

e.en: She embraced {aunthood} after her sister had twins.
e.zh: 姐姐生了双胞胎后，她欣然接受了当姨妈的身份。

e.en: He joked that {aunthood} suited her better than motherhood.
e.zh: 他打趣说当姑姑比当母亲更适合她。

auntlike.t: 像姑妈或姨妈一样的；慈爱亲切的

e.en: She gave him an {auntlike} pat on the cheek.
e.zh: 她像姑姑一样在他脸颊上轻拍了一下。

e.en: The old neighbor showed an {auntlike} concern for the kids.
e.zh: 那位老邻居对孩子们流露出姨妈般的关心。

aupair.t: 互惠生；以家务换食宿的外籍青年

e.en: They hired a French {aupair} to help with the kids.
e.zh: 他们雇了一位法国互惠生帮忙带孩子。

e.en: Working as an {aupair} let her improve her English.
e.zh: 做互惠生让她的英语水平有所提高。

aural-oral.t: 听说的；口耳相传的（教学法）

e.en: The class used an {aural-oral} method to teach Spanish.
e.zh: 这门课用听说法教授西班牙语。

e.en: Her training emphasized {aural-oral} drills over reading.
e.zh: 她的训练重视听说练习而非阅读。

auralize.t: 在脑中想象声音；进行听觉模拟

e.en: Composers learn to {auralize} a score before playing it.
e.zh: 作曲家学会在演奏前在脑中想象乐谱的声音。

e.en: Engineers can {auralize} how a hall will sound.
e.zh: 工程师能够模拟出音乐厅的声学效果。

e.en: The chemist prepared a sodium {aurate} solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一份金酸钠溶液。

e.en: This pigment contains a small amount of {aurate}.
e.zh: 这种颜料中含有少量金酸盐。

e.en: The sunset cast an {aureate} glow on the lake.
e.zh: 夕阳在湖面上洒下一片金色的光辉。

e.en: His {aureate} prose felt overdone for a casual letter.
e.zh: 他那华丽的文风对一封随笔来说显得过于雕琢。

aureola.t: 光环；圣像头顶的金色光晕

e.en: The saint was painted with a golden {aureola}.
e.zh: 那位圣人被画上了一圈金色的光环。

e.en: A faint {aureola} surrounded the moon that night.
e.zh: 那晚月亮周围环绕着一圈淡淡的光晕。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {aureomycin} for the infection.
e.zh: 医生开了金霉素来治疗这次感染。

e.en: {Aureomycin} was widely used in mid-century medicine.
e.zh: 金霉素在二十世纪中期的医学上被广泛使用。

e.en: The painter mixed an {aureous} tint for the halo.
e.zh: 画家调出一种金色的色调来画光环。

e.en: Autumn leaves turned an {aureous} shade in the sun.
e.zh: 秋叶在阳光下泛出金色的光泽。

e.en: The solution contained {auric} chloride for the experiment.
e.zh: 该溶液含有用于实验的氯化金。

e.en: {Auric} compounds are sometimes used in medicine.
e.zh: 含金化合物有时被用于医药领域。

auricula.t: 耳状物；报春花属的一种园艺花

e.en: Her garden featured a row of bright {auricula}.
e.zh: 她的花园里有一排鲜艳的耳叶报春花。

e.en: The anatomist labeled the {auricula} of the heart.
e.zh: 解剖学家标注出了心脏的耳状结构。

e.en: She grew {auriculas} in clay pots on the porch.
e.zh: 她在门廊的陶盆里种着耳叶报春花。

e.en: The show featured rare {auriculas} from old varieties.
e.zh: 展览展出了一些来自古老品种的稀有耳叶报春。

e.en: The leaf is {auriculate} at its base.
e.zh: 这片叶子在基部呈耳状。

e.en: Botanists describe the petal as distinctly {auriculate}.
e.zh: 植物学家形容这片花瓣有明显的耳状突起。

e.en: The system runs an {autocycle} every morning.
e.zh: 该系统每天早晨自动循环一次。

e.en: Engineers studied the engine's {autocycle} behavior.
e.zh: 工程师研究了发动机的自循环特性。

e.en: Pathologists noted signs of {autocytolysis} in the sample.
e.zh: 病理学家在样本中发现了自体细胞溶解的迹象。

e.en: After death, {autocytolysis} begins almost immediately.
e.zh: 死亡后，自体细胞溶解几乎立即开始。

e.en: The therapy relies on a kind of {autodesensitization}.
e.zh: 该疗法依赖于一种自体脱敏作用。

e.en: Researchers measured {autodesensitization} in the immune cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了免疫细胞的自体脱敏反应。

e.en: The device entered {autodestruction} mode after the breach.
e.zh: 系统遭入侵后，设备进入了自毁模式。

e.en: Some cells undergo {autodestruction} when damaged.
e.zh: 一些细胞在受损时会发生自毁。

e.en: The lab installed an {autodetector} for radiation.
e.zh: 实验室安装了一台辐射自动检测器。

e.en: This {autodetector} flags abnormal signals instantly.
e.zh: 这台自动检测器能即时标记异常信号。

e.en: Telemarketers used an {autodialler} to call thousands.
e.zh: 电话推销员用自动拨号器拨打了数千个号码。

e.en: The new law restricts {autodialler} use.
e.zh: 新法律限制了自动拨号器的使用。

e.en: The phone supports {autodialling} for emergency contacts.
e.zh: 这部电话支持紧急联系人自动拨号。

e.en: Robocalls rely on {autodialling} technology.
e.zh: 骚扰电话依赖自动拨号技术。

e.en: She has an {autodidactic} approach to programming.
e.zh: 她以自学的方式钻研编程。

e.en: Many great writers were {autodidactic} thinkers.
e.zh: 许多伟大的作家都是自学型的思想者。

e.en: Modern frameworks use {autodifferentiation} to train networks.
e.zh: 现代框架利用自动微分来训练神经网络。

e.en: {Autodifferentiation} simplifies gradient calculations enormously.
e.zh: 自动微分大大简化了梯度计算。

e.en: The {autodispatcher} routes calls to nearby drivers.
e.zh: 自动调度器把订单分派给附近的司机。

e.en: Their {autodispatcher} handles thousands of jobs hourly.
e.zh: 他们的自动调度器每小时处理数千个任务。

e.en: The car switched to {autodrive} on the highway.
e.zh: 在高速公路上，这辆车切换到了自动驾驶。

e.en: He trusted the {autodrive} feature completely.
e.zh: 他完全信任自动驾驶功能。

autodriver.t: 自动驾驶装置；自动驱动器

e.en: Engineers tested the new {autodriver} on closed roads.
e.zh: 工程师在封闭道路上测试了新的自动驾驶装置。

e.en: The {autodriver} kept the truck centered in its lane.
e.zh: 自动驾驶装置使卡车始终保持在车道中央。

e.en: They watched the race at the famous {autodrome}.
e.zh: 他们在那座著名的赛车场观看了比赛。

e.en: The {autodrome} was packed with cheering fans.
e.zh: 赛车场里挤满了欢呼的车迷。

e.en: The vintage radio used an {autodyne} circuit.
e.zh: 这台老式收音机使用了自差式电路。

e.en: Engineers preferred the {autodyne} for simple receivers.
e.zh: 工程师在简易接收机中偏好使用自差式电路。

e.en: This rust fungus is strictly {autoecious}.
e.zh: 这种锈菌是严格的单主寄生菌。

e.en: Botanists classified the parasite as {autoecious}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种寄生物归为单主寄生类。

e.en: The fungus reproduces {autoeciously} on one host.
e.zh: 这种真菌以单主寄生的方式在一个寄主上繁殖。

e.en: Many rusts behave {autoeciously} in the wild.
e.zh: 许多锈菌在野外都以单主寄生的方式生存。

e.en: {Autoecism} is common in certain rust fungi.
e.zh: 单主寄生现象在某些锈菌中很常见。

e.en: The textbook explained {autoecism} with clear diagrams.
e.zh: 教科书用清晰的图示解释了单主寄生现象。

autoelectronic.t: 自动电子的；场致电子发射的

e.en: They studied {autoelectronic} emission from cold cathodes.
e.zh: 他们研究了冷阴极的场致电子发射。

e.en: The lab uses {autoelectronic} sensors for detection.
e.zh: 实验室使用自动电子传感器进行检测。

e.en: Strong fields cause {autoemission} from the metal tip.
e.zh: 强电场会引起金属尖端的场致发射。

e.en: Physicists measured {autoemission} currents at low temperatures.
e.zh: 物理学家在低温下测量了场致发射电流。

e.en: The book discussed {autoeroticism} in clinical terms.
e.zh: 该书以临床用语讨论了自体性欲现象。

e.en: Freud wrote extensively about {autoeroticism}.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德对自体性欲有大量论述。

e.en: Psychoanalysts have long studied {autoerotism}.
e.zh: 精神分析学家长期研究自体性欲现象。

e.en: The article distinguished {autoerotism} from related concepts.
e.zh: 文章把自体性欲与相关概念加以区分。

e.en: The grapes underwent {autofermentation} in the vat.
e.zh: 葡萄在大桶里发生了自发酵作用。

e.en: Brewers controlled the {autofermentation} carefully.
e.zh: 酿酒师小心地控制着自发酵过程。

e.en: The refinery uses an {autofining} process for sulfur removal.
e.zh: 这家炼油厂采用自精制工艺脱硫。

e.en: {Autofining} reduces impurities in the crude.
e.zh: 自精制工艺可降低原油中的杂质。

e.en: The aircraft executed an {autoflare} just before touchdown.
e.zh: 飞机在接地前执行了自动拉平动作。

e.en: Pilots rely on {autoflare} during low-visibility landings.
e.zh: 飞行员在低能见度着陆时依靠自动拉平功能。

e.en: The camera's {autoflash} fired in the dark room.
e.zh: 在昏暗的房间里相机自动闪光。

e.en: Turn off {autoflash} to avoid red-eye.
e.zh: 关掉自动闪光可以避免红眼。

e.en: The yeast strain shows strong {autoflocculation}.
e.zh: 该酵母菌株表现出很强的自絮凝特性。

e.en: {Autoflocculation} helps separate cells from the broth.
e.zh: 自絮凝作用有助于把细胞从发酵液中分离。

autogamic.t: 自花授粉的；自体受精的

e.en: Many garden peas are {autogamic} plants.
e.zh: 许多豌豆是自花授粉的植物。

e.en: The species shows {autogamic} reproduction in isolation.
e.zh: 该物种在隔离条件下采取自花授粉繁殖。

e.en: Wheat is largely an {autogamous} crop.
e.zh: 小麦基本上是一种自花授粉作物。

e.en: Some {autogamous} flowers never fully open.
e.zh: 有些自花授粉的花朵从不完全开放。

e.en: {Autogamy} ensures seed set without pollinators.
e.zh: 自花授粉可在没有传粉者时保证结实。

e.en: Botanists studied {autogamy} in this rare orchid.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了这种珍稀兰花的自花授粉机制。

e.en: The {autogate} opened as the car approached.
e.zh: 汽车驶近时，自动闸门打开了。

e.en: Residents use a card to operate the {autogate}.
e.zh: 住户用卡操作自动闸门。

e.en: Early biologists once believed in {autogenesis}.
e.zh: 早期生物学家曾相信自生发生说。

e.en: The theory of {autogenesis} has long been disproved.
e.zh: 自生发生说早已被证伪。

e.en: They proposed an {autogenetic} origin for the minerals.
e.zh: 他们提出这些矿物为内成成因。

e.en: The river follows an {autogenetic} drainage pattern.
e.zh: 这条河流呈现出自生的水系格局。

e.en: Surgeons used an {autogenous} bone graft.
e.zh: 外科医生使用了自体骨移植。

e.en: The plant uses {autogenous} fertilization in dry seasons.
e.zh: 该植物在旱季采用自体受精方式。

e.en: The tissue regenerated {autogenously} after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后，组织以自体方式再生。

e.en: The species reproduces {autogenously} when isolated.
e.zh: 该物种在被隔离时以自体方式繁殖。

e.en: Old textbooks discussed {autogeny} as a serious theory.
e.zh: 老教科书曾把自生发生说作为严肃理论讨论。

e.en: Modern biology rejects the idea of {autogeny}.
e.zh: 现代生物学否定自生发生的观点。

e.en: Geologists mapped the basin as an {autogeosyncline}.
e.zh: 地质学家把该盆地划为自源地槽。

e.en: The {autogeosyncline} model explains the local sediments.
e.zh: 自源地槽模型可以解释当地的沉积。

e.en: The factory was run under workers' {autogestion}.
e.zh: 这家工厂在工人自治下运营。

e.en: {Autogestion} became a key political slogan in the 1970s.
e.zh: 工人自治在1970年代成为重要的政治口号。

e.en: Early aviators experimented with {autogiration} for landing.
e.zh: 早期飞行员尝试用自转旋翼方式着陆。

e.en: The craft descended slowly through {autogiration}.
e.zh: 飞行器通过自转旋翼缓慢下降。

autecology.t: 个体生态学；单种生态学

e.en: Researchers study the {autecology} of rare orchids.
e.zh: 研究人员研究稀有兰花的个体生态学。

e.en: Her thesis focused on the {autecology} of desert beetles.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦沙漠甲虫的个体生态学。

autemesia.t: 自发性呕吐；非诱发性呕吐

e.en: The patient suffered from {autemesia} for several days.
e.zh: 患者持续数日出现自发性呕吐。

e.en: Doctors rarely encounter true {autemesia} in clinical practice.
e.zh: 医生在临床上很少遇到真正的自发性呕吐。

e.en: Film critics often debate the merits of {auteurism}.
e.zh: 影评人常争论作者论的优劣。

e.en: Her course explored the rise of {auteurism} in 1960s cinema.
e.zh: 她的课程探讨六十年代电影中作者论的兴起。

e.en: The system requires two-factor {authentification}.
e.zh: 该系统要求双因素身份验证。

e.en: Document {authentification} took several weeks.
e.zh: 文件认证花了好几周。

authigene.t: 自生矿物；原地生成的矿物

e.en: Geologists identified an unusual {authigene} in the core sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在岩芯样本中发现了一种特殊的自生矿物。

e.en: That clay layer contains a rare iron {authigene}.
e.zh: 那层黏土含有一种罕见的自生铁矿物。

e.en: The sandstone is rich in {authigenic} quartz.
e.zh: 这种砂岩富含自生石英。

e.en: They studied {authigenic} minerals in the seabed.
e.zh: 他们研究海底的自生矿物。

e.en: Children often imitate {authority-figures} they admire.
e.zh: 孩子们常模仿他们崇拜的权威人物。

e.en: He has trouble respecting {authority-figures} at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中很难尊重权威人物。

e.en: Only {authorizable} expenses can be reimbursed.
e.zh: 只有可授权的开支才能报销。

e.en: This action is not {authorizable} under current policy.
e.zh: 在现行政策下，此操作不可授权。

authorless.t: 无作者的；佚名的；匿名作品

e.en: The library shelved several {authorless} manuscripts.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏了几份无作者的手稿。

e.en: An {authorless} poem circulated online for years.
e.zh: 一首佚名的诗在网上流传多年。

e.en: He stared {autistically} at the spinning wheel.
e.zh: 他自闭地盯着旋转的轮子。

e.en: She rocked {autistically} when overwhelmed by noise.
e.zh: 她被噪音淹没时会自闭地前后摇晃。

e.en: The software can {auto-abstract} long reports quickly.
e.zh: 该软件能快速自动生成长报告的摘要。

e.en: We tested an {auto-abstract} feature in the new editor.
e.zh: 我们测试了新编辑器的自动摘要功能。

e.en: The phone {auto-answers} after three rings.
e.zh: 电话响三声后自动应答。

e.en: Her assistant {auto-answers} routine emails overnight.
e.zh: 她的助手在夜间自动回复常规邮件。

auto-changer.t: 自动换片机；唱片自动换片器

e.en: His old stereo had a sturdy record {auto-changer}.
e.zh: 他的旧音响有一台结实的自动换片机。

e.en: Few people remember CD {auto-changer} units anymore.
e.zh: 没多少人还记得CD自动换片机了。

e.en: The editor's {auto-complete} saves a lot of time.
e.zh: 编辑器的自动补全功能能省下大量时间。

e.en: I disabled {auto-complete} in my browser settings.
e.zh: 我在浏览器设置中关闭了自动补全。

e.en: My phone's {auto-correction} keeps misspelling names.
e.zh: 我手机的自动更正老是把名字写错。

e.en: She turned off {auto-correction} while typing code.
e.zh: 她写代码时关掉了自动更正。

auto-da-fe.t: 宗教裁判所的火刑；信仰判决仪式

e.en: The painting depicts a notorious {auto-da-fe}.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一场臭名昭著的宗教火刑仪式。

e.en: Historians described the {auto-da-fe} in vivid detail.
e.zh: 历史学家生动描述了那场信仰判决仪式。

e.en: He studies {auto-design} at a Milan academy.
e.zh: 他在米兰一所学院学习汽车设计。

e.en: The team uses {auto-design} software for layouts.
e.zh: 团队使用自动设计软件做布局。

e.en: The spy device will {auto-destruct} on command.
e.zh: 该间谍装置一收到指令就会自毁。

e.en: Old satellites sometimes {auto-destruct} on reentry.
e.zh: 老旧卫星有时会在再入大气层时自毁。

auto-dialer.t: 自动拨号器；自动外呼系统

e.en: The call center installed a new {auto-dialer}.
e.zh: 呼叫中心安装了新的自动拨号系统。

e.en: Telemarketers rely heavily on {auto-dialer} software.
e.zh: 电话推销员严重依赖自动拨号软件。

auto-exposure.t: 自动曝光；相机自动曝光

e.en: Her camera's {auto-exposure} works well in low light.
e.zh: 她相机的自动曝光在弱光下表现不错。

e.en: I disabled {auto-exposure} for the studio shoot.
e.zh: 棚拍时我关闭了自动曝光。

e.en: This lens has remarkably fast {auto-focus}.
e.zh: 这支镜头自动对焦非常快。

e.en: {Auto-focus} struggles in dim light conditions.
e.zh: 在弱光条件下自动对焦容易出问题。

e.en: Diesel engines depend on {auto-ignition} of fuel.
e.zh: 柴油机依赖燃料的自动点火。

e.en: The oil's {auto-ignition} temperature is surprisingly low.
e.zh: 这种油的自燃温度低得出奇。

auto-immune.t: 自身免疫的；自体免疫的

e.en: She has an {auto-immune} disorder affecting her joints.
e.zh: 她患有一种影响关节的自身免疫疾病。

e.en: Doctors suspect an {auto-immune} response to the medication.
e.zh: 医生怀疑是对药物的自身免疫反应。

auto-jigger.t: 自动量酒器；自动配料器

e.en: The bartender installed an {auto-jigger} for accuracy.
e.zh: 调酒师为了精准装了自动量酒器。

e.en: An {auto-jigger} ensures consistent cocktails every time.
e.zh: 自动量酒器确保每杯鸡尾酒都一致。

e.en: He runs a small {auto-parts} store downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心开了一家小汽车配件店。

e.en: We ordered {auto-parts} from a Japanese supplier.
e.zh: 我们从日本供应商订购了汽车零件。

e.en: My uncle owns an {auto-repair} shop.
e.zh: 我叔叔有一家汽车修理店。

e.en: She studied {auto-repair} at a community college.
e.zh: 她在社区学院学过汽车维修。

auto-rickshaw.t: 三轮机动车；机动三轮车

e.en: We hailed an {auto-rickshaw} outside the station.
e.zh: 我们在车站外叫了一辆机动三轮车。

e.en: An {auto-rickshaw} weaved through Mumbai traffic.
e.zh: 一辆机动三轮车在孟买车流中穿梭。

auto-rickshaws.t: 机动三轮车；多辆三轮机动车

e.en: Hundreds of {auto-rickshaws} crowded the market street.
e.zh: 数百辆机动三轮车挤满了集市街道。

e.en: {Auto-rickshaws} are common in many South Asian cities.
e.zh: 机动三轮车在许多南亚城市很常见。

e.en: {Auto-sales} dropped sharply last quarter.
e.zh: 上季度汽车销量大幅下滑。

e.en: He works in {auto-sales} downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心做汽车销售。

auto-suggestions.t: 自动建议；自动提示；联想推荐

e.en: The search bar shows {auto-suggestions} as you type.
e.zh: 搜索栏在输入时会显示自动建议。

e.en: I usually ignore {auto-suggestions} from my keyboard.
e.zh: 我通常无视键盘的自动提示。

e.en: We took the {auto-train} from Virginia to Florida.
e.zh: 我们坐载车列车从弗吉尼亚到佛罗里达。

e.en: An overnight {auto-train} service runs through the Alps.
e.zh: 有一趟夜间载车列车穿越阿尔卑斯山。

auto-transformer.t: 自耦变压器；单线圈变压器

e.en: The lab uses an {auto-transformer} to step down voltage.
e.zh: 实验室用自耦变压器降压。

e.en: An {auto-transformer} is cheaper than two separate windings.
e.zh: 自耦变压器比两个独立绕组便宜。

e.en: The pop song relied heavily on {auto-tune}.
e.zh: 这首流行歌严重依赖变声修音。

e.en: She refused to use {auto-tune} on her new album.
e.zh: 她拒绝在新专辑里使用自动调音。

e.en: Polymerization showed sudden {autoacceleration} at high conversion.
e.zh: 聚合反应在高转化率下出现突然的自动加速。

e.en: Engineers worry about {autoacceleration} in runaway reactions.
e.zh: 工程师担心失控反应中的自动加速。

autoalarm.t: 自动报警器；汽车警报器

e.en: His car's {autoalarm} blares every windy night.
e.zh: 每个有风的夜晚他车上的警报器都狂响。

e.en: The factory installed an {autoalarm} for fire safety.
e.zh: 工厂为消防安全装了自动报警器。

autoalloploid.t: 自体异源多倍体；同源异源多倍体

e.en: Botanists discovered an {autoalloploid} variety of wheat.
e.zh: 植物学家发现了一种自体异源多倍体小麦。

e.en: An {autoalloploid} plant combines features of both parents.
e.zh: 自体异源多倍体植物兼具双亲特征。

e.en: The lab relies on {autoanalysis} for routine samples.
e.zh: 实验室常规样本靠自动分析。

e.en: His diary became a tool of constant {autoanalysis}.
e.zh: 他的日记成了不断自我分析的工具。

autoanalyzer.t: 自动分析仪；全自动分析仪

e.en: The hospital purchased a new blood {autoanalyzer}.
e.zh: 医院购置了一台新的血液自动分析仪。

e.en: An {autoanalyzer} processes hundreds of samples per hour.
e.zh: 一台自动分析仪每小时可处理数百个样本。

autoantibiosis.t: 自体抗生作用；自身抑菌现象

e.en: Researchers reported an unusual case of {autoantibiosis}.
e.zh: 研究人员报告了一例罕见的自体抗生作用。

e.en: Some fungi exhibit {autoantibiosis} during dense growth.
e.zh: 某些真菌在密集生长时表现出自体抗生作用。

e.en: The coroner ruled the death an accidental {autoasphyxiation}.
e.zh: 法医裁定死因是意外自我窒息。

e.en: Therapists warn teens about the risks of {autoasphyxiation}.
e.zh: 治疗师警告青少年自我窒息的危险。

e.en: The hotel lobby features a sleek {autobar}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂有一台时髦的自助酒吧机。

e.en: An {autobar} dispensed drinks without a bartender.
e.zh: 自动售酒机不需要调酒师就能出酒。

autobicycle.t: 机动自行车；老式摩托车

e.en: His grandfather rode an early {autobicycle} to work.
e.zh: 他祖父骑过一辆早期的机动自行车上班。

e.en: The museum displays a 1900 {autobicycle}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一辆1900年的机动自行车。

autobike.t: 机动脚踏车；摩托自行车

e.en: He fixed up an old {autobike} in the garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修好了一辆旧的机动脚踏车。

e.en: The kid wants an electric {autobike} for his birthday.
e.zh: 那孩子想要一辆电动摩托自行车当生日礼物。

autobio.t: 自传；自传简称；个人自述

e.en: She's writing her {autobio} during the sabbatical.
e.zh: 她在休假期间写自传。

e.en: His {autobio} is surprisingly funny and honest.
e.zh: 他的自传出奇地有趣又坦诚。

e.en: The novel has clear {autobiographic} elements.
e.zh: 这部小说有明显的自传成分。

e.en: Her debut album feels deeply {autobiographic}.
e.zh: 她的首张专辑充满浓厚的自传色彩。

autobiotic.t: 自养生物的；自营生命的

e.en: Some bacteria thrive in extreme {autobiotic} conditions.
e.zh: 某些细菌在极端的自养环境下繁衍。

e.en: An {autobiotic} system needs no external food source.
e.zh: 一个自养生命系统不需要外部食物来源。

e.en: I set up {autopay} for my electricity bill.
e.zh: 我为电费账单设置了自动扣款。

e.en: Most subscriptions now use {autopay} by default.
e.zh: 现在大多数订阅默认使用自动付款。

autopen.t: 自动签名机；机械签字装置

e.en: The president signed the bill using an {autopen}.
e.zh: 总统用自动签名机签署了这项法案。

e.en: Critics questioned whether an {autopen} signature was valid.
e.zh: 批评者质疑机器签名是否有效。

autophagy.t: 自噬作用；细胞自我消化

e.en: Fasting can trigger cellular {autophagy}.
e.zh: 禁食可以触发细胞自噬。

e.en: Researchers study {autophagy} for its anti-aging potential.
e.zh: 研究人员研究自噬作用的抗衰老潜力。

e.en: The kinase undergoes {autophosphorylation} when activated.
e.zh: 该激酶被激活时会发生自磷酸化。

e.en: {Autophosphorylation} regulates many signaling pathways.
e.zh: 自磷酸化调节多种信号通路。

autoplastic.t: 自体移植的；自体成形的

e.en: The surgeon performed an {autoplastic} skin graft.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了自体皮肤移植。

e.en: {Autoplastic} repair uses tissue from the same patient.
e.zh: 自体成形修复使用同一病人的组织。

autoplasty.t: 自体移植术；自体成形术

e.en: {Autoplasty} avoids the risk of immune rejection.
e.zh: 自体成形术可避免免疫排斥风险。

e.en: Burn victims often benefit from {autoplasty}.
e.zh: 烧伤患者常受益于自体移植术。

e.en: Living cells exhibit {autopoiesis} by maintaining themselves.
e.zh: 活细胞通过自我维持表现出自创生特性。

e.en: The theory of {autopoiesis} reshaped systems biology.
e.zh: 自创生理论重塑了系统生物学。

autopolymer.t: 自固化聚合物；自凝聚合物

e.en: The dentist used an {autopolymer} resin for the filling.
e.zh: 牙医用自固化聚合物树脂做了填充。

e.en: {Autopolymer} materials harden without external heat.
e.zh: 自凝聚合物材料无需外部加热即可硬化。

autoprotolysis.t: 自递质子作用；自身质子转移

e.en: Water undergoes {autoprotolysis} to form hydronium and hydroxide.
e.zh: 水发生自递质子作用，形成水合氢离子和氢氧根。

e.en: {Autoprotolysis} explains why pure water conducts slightly.
e.zh: 自递质子作用解释了纯水为何具有微弱导电性。

e.en: Journaling can be a form of {autopsychotherapy}.
e.zh: 写日记可以是一种自我心理治疗。

e.en: He practiced {autopsychotherapy} to manage his anxiety.
e.zh: 他通过自我心理治疗来缓解焦虑。

autoptic.t: 亲眼目睹的；亲自观察的

e.en: She gave an {autoptic} account of the accident.
e.zh: 她提供了亲眼目睹事故的陈述。

e.en: The judge valued {autoptic} evidence over hearsay.
e.zh: 法官重视亲眼目睹的证据胜过传闻。

e.en: Rivers have a natural capacity for {autopurification}.
e.zh: 河流具有天然的自净能力。

e.en: Pollution can overwhelm a lake's {autopurification} processes.
e.zh: 污染可能压垮湖泊的自净过程。

e.en: Amino acids slowly undergo {autoracemization} after death.
e.zh: 氨基酸在死亡后会缓慢发生自动外消旋化。

e.en: Scientists date fossils using {autoracemization} rates.
e.zh: 科学家利用自动外消旋化速率为化石断代。

e.en: The {autoradiogram} revealed the labeled DNA bands.
e.zh: 放射自显影图显示了标记的DNA条带。

e.en: She analyzed the {autoradiogram} under a microscope.
e.zh: 她在显微镜下分析放射自显影图。

e.en: The {autoradiograph} showed where the isotope had bound.
e.zh: 放射自显影照片显示了同位素结合的位置。

e.en: They produced an {autoradiograph} of the labeled protein.
e.zh: 他们制作了标记蛋白质的放射自显影照片。

e.en: The gel was {autoradiographed} overnight.
e.zh: 凝胶被放射自显影曝光了一整夜。

e.en: They {autoradiographed} the membrane to detect the signal.
e.zh: 他们对膜做了放射自显影以检测信号。

e.en: Daily {autoreflection} helps her grow as a leader.
e.zh: 每日的自我反思帮助她作为领导者成长。

e.en: The mirror caused {autoreflection} of the laser beam.
e.zh: 镜子引起了激光束的自动反射。

e.en: Liquid gas cools itself through {autorefrigeration}.
e.zh: 液态气体通过自动制冷作用使自身冷却。

e.en: Engineers exploit {autorefrigeration} in cryogenic systems.
e.zh: 工程师在低温系统中利用自动制冷作用。

e.en: The model uses {autoregression} to forecast prices.
e.zh: 该模型使用自回归来预测价格。

e.en: {Autoregression} is common in time-series analysis.
e.zh: 自回归在时间序列分析中很常见。

e.en: The body can {autoregulate} blood pressure.
e.zh: 身体能够自动调节血压。

e.en: Cells {autoregulate} their gene expression.
e.zh: 细胞自我调控其基因表达。

e.en: Cerebral {autoregulation} keeps blood flow steady.
e.zh: 脑部自动调节使血流保持稳定。

e.en: The market lacks effective {autoregulation}.
e.zh: 市场缺乏有效的自我调控。

autoregulative.t: 自动调节的；自我调控的

e.en: The system has {autoregulative} feedback loops.
e.zh: 该系统具有自我调控的反馈回路。

e.en: Hormones play an {autoregulative} role in metabolism.
e.zh: 激素在新陈代谢中起自动调节作用。

autobivalent.t: 自体二价染色体；常染色体二价体

e.en: The {autobivalents} pair correctly during meiosis.
e.zh: 减数分裂时这些自体二价染色体正确配对。

e.en: Researchers tracked each {autobivalent} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下追踪每个自体二价染色体。

autoblast.t: 自生细胞；自分裂形成的细胞

e.en: The lab studied each {autoblast} carefully.
e.zh: 实验室仔细研究了每个自生细胞。

e.en: We observed an {autoblast} dividing rapidly.
e.zh: 我们观察到一个自生细胞迅速分裂。

autoblood.t: 自体血液；自身血液疗法用血

e.en: The doctor injected {autoblood} into the patient.
e.zh: 医生为患者注射了自体血液。
