e.en: His {arrogancy} alienated all his colleagues.
e.zh: 他的傲慢疏远了所有同事。

e.en: The king's {arrogancy} sparked the rebellion.
e.zh: 国王的傲慢引发了叛乱。

e.en: The senator condemned the king's {arrogation} of new powers.
e.zh: 参议员谴责国王擅自攫取新权力。

e.en: Their {arrogation} of authority angered the board.
e.zh: 他们擅自行使权力激怒了董事会。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {arthroendoscopy} to inspect the joint.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了关节内窥镜检查以查看关节。

e.en: {Arthroendoscopy} revealed minor cartilage damage.
e.zh: 关节内窥镜检查发现了轻微的软骨损伤。

e.en: The {arthrogram} showed a torn ligament.
e.zh: 关节造影片显示韧带撕裂。

e.en: She reviewed the {arthrogram} before recommending surgery.
e.zh: 她在建议手术前查看了关节造影片。

e.en: {Arthrography} helps diagnose joint disorders.
e.zh: 关节造影术有助于诊断关节疾病。

e.en: The clinic offers MRI {arthrography} services.
e.zh: 该诊所提供磁共振关节造影服务。

arthrogryposis.t: 关节弯曲；多发性关节挛缩症

e.en: The infant was born with {arthrogryposis}.
e.zh: 该婴儿出生时患有多发性关节挛缩症。

e.en: Therapy can ease symptoms of {arthrogryposis}.
e.zh: 治疗可缓解关节挛缩症的症状。

e.en: He specializes in {arthrology} and joint surgery.
e.zh: 他专攻关节学和关节外科手术。

e.en: {Arthrology} is a branch of anatomy.
e.zh: 关节学是解剖学的一个分支。

e.en: Each {arthromere} of the insect bears a pair of legs.
e.zh: 昆虫的每个体节都长有一对腿。

e.en: Scientists examined the {arthromere} structure under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下观察体节结构。

e.en: {Arthrometry} measures joint laxity after injury.
e.zh: 关节测量法用于测量损伤后的关节松弛度。

e.en: The doctor used {arthrometry} to assess the knee.
e.zh: 医生用关节测量法评估膝盖。

e.en: Diabetic {arthropathy} can affect the feet.
e.zh: 糖尿病性关节病可能影响足部。

e.en: He suffers from inflammatory {arthropathy}.
e.zh: 他患有炎症性关节病。

e.en: Surgeons removed an {arthrophyte} from the joint.
e.zh: 外科医生从关节中取出了一个游离体。

e.en: An {arthrophyte} can cause locking of the knee.
e.zh: 关节内游离体可导致膝关节交锁。

e.en: The surgeon inserted an {arthroscope} into the knee.
e.zh: 外科医生将关节镜插入膝盖。

e.en: An {arthroscope} allows minimally invasive surgery.
e.zh: 关节镜使微创手术成为可能。

e.en: The tear was repaired {arthroscopically}.
e.zh: 撕裂处通过关节镜进行了修复。

e.en: They examined the joint {arthroscopically}.
e.zh: 他们用关节镜检查了关节。

e.en: Several {arthroses} were affected by the disease.
e.zh: 多个关节受到该疾病的影响。

e.en: The textbook lists common {arthroses} of the spine.
e.zh: 教科书列出了脊柱常见的关节病。

e.en: She was diagnosed with hip {arthrosis}.
e.zh: 她被诊断患有髋关节病。

e.en: {Arthrosis} often worsens with age.
e.zh: 关节病常随年龄增长而恶化。

e.en: The fungus reproduces by forming {arthrospores}.
e.zh: 该真菌通过形成节孢子来繁殖。

e.en: {Arthrospores} can survive harsh conditions.
e.zh: 节孢子能在恶劣条件下存活。

e.en: The species shows {arthrosporic} reproduction.
e.zh: 该物种以节孢子方式繁殖。

e.en: They identified an {arthrosporic} fungus.
e.zh: 他们鉴定出一种节孢子真菌。

e.en: This is an {arthrosporous} species of mold.
e.zh: 这是一种产节孢子的霉菌。

e.en: {Arthrosporous} fungi are common in soil.
e.zh: 产节孢子的真菌在土壤中很常见。

e.en: An {arthrotomy} was performed to drain the infection.
e.zh: 为引流感染进行了关节切开术。

e.en: {Arthrotomy} requires careful postoperative care.
e.zh: 关节切开术需要仔细的术后护理。

e.en: The bacteria are highly {arthrotropic}.
e.zh: 这种细菌具有强烈的亲关节性。

e.en: {Arthrotropic} viruses target joint tissue.
e.zh: 亲关节病毒以关节组织为目标。

artiad.t: 偶价的；具偶数原子价的

e.en: Carbon is an {artiad} element with valence four.
e.zh: 碳是一种具有偶数原子价的元素，化合价为四。

e.en: Chemists once classified elements as perissad or {artiad}.
e.zh: 化学家曾将元素分为奇价和偶价。

articulable.t: 可表达的；能清楚说出的

e.en: His feelings were not easily {articulable}.
e.zh: 他的感受难以清晰表达。

e.en: She had clear, {articulable} reasons for leaving.
e.zh: 她有清楚可表达的离职理由。

e.en: Speech therapy improved her {articulative} skills.
e.zh: 言语治疗提升了她的发音能力。

e.en: The actor's {articulative} clarity was remarkable.
e.zh: 那位演员的吐字清晰度令人惊叹。

artifical.t: 人造的（artificial 的常见拼写错误）

e.en: He wrote {artifical} instead of artificial in his essay.
e.zh: 他在论文里把 artificial 误拼成了 artifical。

e.en: Spell-check flagged the word {artifical} as a typo.
e.zh: 拼写检查将 artifical 标记为拼写错误。

artificialize.t: 使人工化；使变得不自然

e.en: Modern cities tend to {artificialize} the landscape.
e.zh: 现代城市往往使自然景观变得人工化。

e.en: Don't {artificialize} your writing style.
e.zh: 不要让你的写作风格变得做作。

e.en: They criticized the {artificializing} of rural life.
e.zh: 他们批评乡村生活的人工化。

e.en: Over-editing risks {artificializing} the photo.
e.zh: 过度修图有让照片变得不自然的风险。

e.en: The {artillerist} aimed the cannon carefully.
e.zh: 那名炮兵仔细瞄准了大炮。

e.en: He served as an {artillerist} during the war.
e.zh: 他在战争期间担任炮兵。

e.en: The {artillerists} loaded their guns at dawn.
e.zh: 炮兵们在黎明时分装填了大炮。

e.en: Several {artillerists} were decorated for bravery.
e.zh: 几名炮兵因英勇表现获得勋章。

e.en: Cows and pigs are {artiodactyls}.
e.zh: 牛和猪都是偶蹄动物。

e.en: The {artiodactyl} group includes deer and giraffes.
e.zh: 偶蹄目动物包括鹿和长颈鹿。

e.en: The town's {artisanate} thrived in the 18th century.
e.zh: 该镇的手工业者阶层在十八世纪十分兴盛。

e.en: Government policy supported the local {artisanate}.
e.zh: 政府政策支持当地的工匠群体。

e.en: The chair shows exceptional {artisanry}.
e.zh: 这把椅子展现了非凡的工匠技艺。

e.en: She admired the {artisanry} of the silver bowl.
e.zh: 她赞叹这只银碗的精湛工艺。

e.en: The room had a quaint, {artistical} feel.
e.zh: 那个房间有种古雅的艺术气息。

e.en: Her writing has a distinctly {artistical} flair.
e.zh: 她的写作带有鲜明的艺术风格。

artizan.t: 工匠；手艺人（artisan 的旧式拼写）

e.en: The old text refers to a skilled {artizan}.
e.zh: 古籍中提到一位技艺娴熟的工匠。

e.en: He was admired as a master {artizan}.
e.zh: 他作为大师级工匠备受敬仰。

e.en: The museum's {artmobile} visited rural schools.
e.zh: 博物馆的流动美术馆车访问了乡村学校。

e.en: Children climbed aboard the {artmobile} to see the paintings.
e.zh: 孩子们登上流动美术馆车观赏画作。

e.en: The book was illustrated with fine {artotypes}.
e.zh: 该书配有精美的珂罗版印刷插图。

e.en: Collectors prize a well-preserved {artotype}.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视保存完好的珂罗版印刷品。

e.en: The kids enjoyed the {arts-and-crafts} session.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢手工艺课。

e.en: The house was built in the {arts-and-crafts} style.
e.zh: 这座房子采用工艺美术风格建造。

artsier.t: 更艺术腔的；更装艺术范儿的

e.en: Her new film is {artsier} than her last.
e.zh: 她的新片比上一部更装艺术范儿。

e.en: They moved to an {artsier} neighborhood downtown.
e.zh: 他们搬到了市中心一个更具艺术气息的街区。

e.en: The catalog was full of pretentious {artspeak}.
e.zh: 展览图录里满是装腔作势的艺术圈行话。

e.en: He cut through the {artspeak} with a plain question.
e.zh: 他用一个直白的问题打破了那套艺评腔。

e.en: They examined the {archeologic} evidence carefully.
e.zh: 他们仔细检查了考古证据。

e.en: The site has great {archeologic} significance.
e.zh: 该遗址具有重大的考古意义。

e.en: The {archespore} divides to form spore mother cells.
e.zh: 造孢细胞分裂形成孢子母细胞。

e.en: Botanists studied the {archespore} under the microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下研究造孢细胞。

e.en: The {archesporial} cells differentiate early.
e.zh: 造孢细胞很早就开始分化。

e.en: He described the {archesporial} tissue in detail.
e.zh: 他详细描述了造孢组织。

e.en: The {archesporium} gives rise to spores.
e.zh: 造孢组织产生孢子。

e.en: Each anther contains an {archesporium}.
e.zh: 每个花药都含有造孢组织。

e.en: In the legend, the {archfiend} ruled the underworld.
e.zh: 传说中，魔王统治着冥界。

e.en: He was painted as the {archfiend} of the regime.
e.zh: 他被描绘成该政权的头号恶人。

e.en: The emperor's {archiater} attended him daily.
e.zh: 皇帝的御医每日侍奉他。

e.en: He was appointed {archiater} to the court.
e.zh: 他被任命为宫廷首席医师。

e.en: They sampled the {archibenthic} zone of the ocean.
e.zh: 他们取样了海洋的次深海底带。

e.en: Strange creatures inhabit the {archibenthic} layer.
e.zh: 奇异的生物栖息于半深海层。

e.en: The {archiblast} forms early in development.
e.zh: 原胚在发育早期形成。

e.en: Embryologists studied the {archiblast} structure.
e.zh: 胚胎学家研究了原胚结构。

e.en: The {archicarp} develops into the fruiting body.
e.zh: 产囊体发育成子实体。

e.en: Each ascomycete produces an {archicarp}.
e.zh: 每种子囊菌都会产生产囊体。

e.en: The {archicerebrum} is found in primitive invertebrates.
e.zh: 原脑见于原始的无脊椎动物。

e.en: Researchers examined the {archicerebrum} of the worm.
e.zh: 研究者检查了这种蠕虫的原脑。

e.en: He held an {archidiaconal} office in the diocese.
e.zh: 他在教区担任副主教职务。

e.en: The {archidiaconal} visit took two weeks.
e.zh: 这次副主教视察持续了两周。

archidiaconate.t: 副主教职位；总执事辖区

e.en: He was appointed to the {archidiaconate} last spring.
e.zh: 他于去年春天被任命为副主教。

e.en: The {archidiaconate} covers several parishes.
e.zh: 该副主教辖区涵盖数个堂区。

e.en: The {archiepiscopacy} dates back centuries.
e.zh: 大主教制可追溯到数个世纪以前。

e.en: He defended the institution of {archiepiscopacy}.
e.zh: 他为大主教制度辩护。

e.en: The cathedral is the {archiepiscopal} seat.
e.zh: 这座大教堂是大主教的所在地。

e.en: He wore his {archiepiscopal} robes for the ceremony.
e.zh: 他穿着大主教的法衣参加仪式。

archiepiscopally.t: 以大主教身份；大主教式地

e.en: He acted {archiepiscopally} in the matter.
e.zh: 他以大主教的身份处理此事。

e.en: The decision was made {archiepiscopally}.
e.zh: 该决定由大主教作出。

e.en: His {archiepiscopate} lasted twenty years.
e.zh: 他的大主教任期持续了二十年。

e.en: She wrote a history of the {archiepiscopate}.
e.zh: 她写了一部大主教制史。

e.en: Several {archiepiscopates} were created that century.
e.zh: 那个世纪设立了数个大主教职位。

e.en: The two {archiepiscopates} merged into one.
e.zh: 这两个大主教辖区合并为一个。

e.en: The {archikaryon} is a primitive cell nucleus.
e.zh: 原核是一种原始的细胞核。

e.en: He studied the {archikaryon} of protozoa.
e.zh: 他研究了原生动物的原核。

e.en: They dyed the cloth with {archil}.
e.zh: 他们用地衣紫给布染色。

e.en: {Archil} produces a rich purple hue.
e.zh: 地衣紫能产生浓郁的紫色色调。

e.en: The poem follows an {archilochian} meter.
e.zh: 这首诗采用阿基洛科斯诗体的格律。

e.en: Scholars debated the {archilochian} structure.
e.zh: 学者们对阿基洛科斯诗体结构展开讨论。

e.en: The {archimage} cast a powerful spell.
e.zh: 大法师施展了一道强大的法术。

e.en: Only the {archimage} could open the gate.
e.zh: 只有大法师才能打开那道门。

e.en: The {archimandrite} blessed the new church.
e.zh: 修道院院长为新教堂祝圣。

e.en: He served as {archimandrite} for many years.
e.zh: 他担任修道院院长多年。

e.en: The cloth measured three {archines} long.
e.zh: 这块布有三俄尺长。

e.en: An {archine} equals about 28 inches.
e.zh: 一俄尺约合二十八英寸。

e.en: Indonesia has a vast {archipelagic} territory.
e.zh: 印度尼西亚拥有广阔的群岛领土。

e.en: The country signed an {archipelagic} treaty.
e.zh: 该国签署了一项群岛条约。

e.en: Linguists posit an {archiphoneme} in this position.
e.zh: 语言学家认为此位置存在一个原音位。

e.en: The {archiphoneme} represents neutralized contrast.
e.zh: 原音位代表中和化的音位对立。

e.en: The book describes {architective} principles.
e.zh: 这本书阐述了建造性原则。

e.en: He admired the {architective} skill of the builders.
e.zh: 他赞叹建造者的建筑技艺。

e.en: The essay explores {architectonical} ideas.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨建筑学方面的思想。

e.en: His work shows {architectonical} mastery.
e.zh: 他的作品展现出建筑学上的造诣。

e.en: The piece is {architectonically} balanced.
e.zh: 这部作品在结构上十分平衡。

e.en: She analyzed the symphony {architectonically}.
e.zh: 她从结构层面分析了这部交响曲。

archivism.t: 档案主义；档案保存原则

e.en: His writings shaped modern {archivism}.
e.zh: 他的著作塑造了现代档案主义。

e.en: {Archivism} emphasizes preserving original records.
e.zh: 档案主义强调保存原始记录。

e.en: The {archivolt} above the door was richly carved.
e.zh: 门上方的拱门饰雕刻精美。

e.en: Sculpted figures decorate the {archivolt}.
e.zh: 雕刻的人像装饰着拱门饰。

e.en: He played a Baroque piece on the {archlute}.
e.zh: 他用大鲁特琴演奏了一首巴洛克乐曲。

e.en: The {archlute} has a long extended neck.
e.zh: 大鲁特琴有一根延长的长颈。

e.en: The {archmage} sealed the demon away.
e.zh: 大法师将恶魔封印起来。

e.en: Apprentices revered the {archmage}.
e.zh: 学徒们都敬仰这位大法师。

archmonetarist.t: 极端货币主义者；首席货币主义者

e.en: He was the {archmonetarist} of his generation.
e.zh: 他是他那一代的首席货币主义者。

e.en: The {archmonetarist} criticized fiscal stimulus.
e.zh: 这位极端货币主义者批评财政刺激政策。

e.en: In ancient Athens, an {archon} held supreme office.
e.zh: 在古雅典，执政官拥有最高职位。

e.en: Gnostic texts describe an evil {archon}.
e.zh: 诺斯替文献中描述了一位邪恶的统治者。

archonship.t: 执政官职位；执政官任期

e.en: His {archonship} lasted only one year.
e.zh: 他的执政官任期只持续了一年。

e.en: She wrote about Solon's {archonship}.
e.zh: 她写到了梭伦的执政官任期。

archontate.t: 执政官职位；执政官辖区

e.en: The {archontate} was an honored position.
e.zh: 执政官职位是一个备受尊崇的职位。

e.en: Records of his {archontate} survive.
e.zh: 他任执政官期间的记录保存了下来。

e.en: The text describes {archontic} powers.
e.zh: 该文本描述了统治者的权力。

e.en: Gnostics warned of {archontic} influence.
e.zh: 诺斯替派警告人们防范统治者的影响。

e.en: Crocodiles and birds are living {archosaurs}.
e.zh: 鳄鱼和鸟类是现存的主龙类动物。

e.en: Paleontologists found a new {archosaur} fossil.
e.zh: 古生物学家发现了一种新的主龙类化石。

e.en: The {archpriest} led the solemn procession.
e.zh: 大祭司带领庄严的队列前行。

e.en: He was promoted to {archpriest} last year.
e.zh: 他去年晋升为总司铎。

e.en: The two {archpriests} disagreed on doctrine.
e.zh: 两位大祭司在教义上意见不合。

e.en: Several {archpriests} attended the synod.
e.zh: 数位总司铎出席了主教会议。

e.en: The {as-cast} surface was rough and needed machining.
e.zh: 铸态表面粗糙，需要机加工。

e.en: Engineers tested the {as-cast} aluminum for porosity.
e.zh: 工程师检测铸态铝件的气孔率。

e.en: The {as-heat-treated} steel showed higher hardness.
e.zh: 热处理后的钢材硬度更高。

e.en: We measured the {as-heat-treated} samples for tensile strength.
e.zh: 我们测量了热处理后试样的抗拉强度。

e.en: The car was sold {as-is} with no warranty.
e.zh: 这辆车按现状出售，不提供保修。

e.en: You'll have to take the apartment {as-is}.
e.zh: 你只能按现状接受这间公寓。

e.en: She passed her {as-level} exams last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天通过了AS级考试。

e.en: Most students take three {as-level} subjects.
e.zh: 大多数学生选修三门AS级科目。

as-of-right.t: 依法享有的；当然有权的

e.en: Citizens have the vote {as-of-right}.
e.zh: 公民依法当然享有投票权。

e.en: Planning permission was granted {as-of-right}.
e.zh: 规划许可作为法定权利获得批准。

as-welded.t: 焊接态的；未经处理的焊件

e.en: The {as-welded} joint failed under stress.
e.zh: 焊接态接头在受力下失效。

e.en: They tested the pipe in its {as-welded} condition.
e.zh: 他们对管道焊接态进行了测试。

e.en: A pinch of {asafetida} flavors the lentil stew.
e.zh: 一小撮阿魏给扁豆炖菜增添风味。

e.en: She kept {asafetida} in an airtight jar.
e.zh: 她把阿魏放在密封罐里保存。

asafoetida.t: 阿魏（印度料理常用香料）

e.en: Indian cooks use {asafoetida} sparingly.
e.zh: 印度厨师使用阿魏时量很少。

e.en: The {asafoetida} smelled strong but mellowed in oil.
e.zh: 阿魏气味强烈，但在油中变得柔和。

e.en: She held the {asana} for a full minute.
e.zh: 她保持这个瑜伽体式整整一分钟。

e.en: The teacher demonstrated a difficult {asana}.
e.zh: 老师示范了一个高难度的瑜伽体式。

e.en: Beginners learn basic {asanas} first.
e.zh: 初学者先学习基础瑜伽体式。

e.en: The class practiced standing {asanas} together.
e.zh: 全班一起练习站立瑜伽体式。

e.en: The lab analyzed the {asbestic} fibers in the dust.
e.zh: 实验室分析了灰尘中的石棉纤维。

e.en: Workers must avoid {asbestic} materials.
e.zh: 工人必须避免接触含石棉的材料。

asbestiform.t: 石棉状的（呈纤维形态的矿物）

e.en: The mineral has an {asbestiform} structure.
e.zh: 这种矿物具有石棉状结构。

e.en: Some {asbestiform} minerals pose health risks.
e.zh: 一些石棉状矿物有健康风险。

e.en: The rock had an {asbestine} texture.
e.zh: 这块岩石有似石棉的质地。

e.en: Researchers studied the {asbestine} samples carefully.
e.zh: 研究人员仔细研究了这些石棉样的样品。

e.en: The fibers showed {asbestoid} characteristics.
e.zh: 这些纤维表现出类石棉的特性。

e.en: Geologists identified an {asbestoid} mineral in the sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在样品中识别出一种类石棉矿物。

e.en: The deposit contained {asbestoidal} fibers.
e.zh: 矿床中含有类石棉状纤维。

e.en: They tested the {asbestoidal} material for safety.
e.zh: 他们对这种类石棉材料进行了安全测试。

e.en: The patient developed {asbestotic} lung lesions.
e.zh: 患者出现了石棉沉着病的肺部病变。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {asbestotic} changes over years.
e.zh: 医生多年来持续监测石棉沉着病的变化。

e.en: The old building used {asbestous} insulation.
e.zh: 这栋老建筑使用了含石棉的隔热材料。

e.en: Removing {asbestous} tiles requires special equipment.
e.zh: 拆除石棉瓦需要专用设备。

e.en: Old texts referred to the mineral as {asbestus}.
e.zh: 古籍把这种矿物称为asbestus。

e.en: The label still used the spelling {asbestus}.
e.zh: 标签上仍使用asbestus这种拼写。

e.en: Miners extracted {asbolite} from the hillside.
e.zh: 矿工从山坡中开采钴土矿。

e.en: The {asbolite} sample was rich in cobalt.
e.zh: 这个钴土矿样本富含钴。

e.en: Children in rural areas often contract {ascariasis}.
e.zh: 农村地区的儿童常感染蛔虫病。

e.en: Doctors treat {ascariasis} with antiparasitic drugs.
e.zh: 医生用抗寄生虫药治疗蛔虫病。

e.en: The vet prescribed an {ascaricide} for the puppy.
e.zh: 兽医给小狗开了杀蛔虫药。

e.en: This {ascaricide} works within twenty-four hours.
e.zh: 这种杀蛔虫药在二十四小时内起效。

e.en: The lab identified an {ascarid} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室在样本中检出一条蛔虫。

e.en: {Ascarid} infections are common in livestock.
e.zh: 蛔虫感染在牲畜中很常见。

e.en: We stayed at small {auberges} along the route.
e.zh: 我们一路住在小客栈里。

e.en: Rural {auberges} often serve homemade meals.
e.zh: 乡村小旅馆常常提供家常饭菜。

e.en: Purple {aubrietia} cascaded over the wall.
e.zh: 紫色的南庭芥垂挂在墙上。

e.en: She planted {aubrietia} in the rockery.
e.zh: 她在岩石园里种了南庭芥。

e.en: The painting sold at a London {auction-house}.
e.zh: 这幅画在伦敦的一家拍卖行售出。

e.en: She works at a famous {auction-house}.
e.zh: 她在一家著名的拍卖行工作。

e.en: He follows {auctionary} trends closely.
e.zh: 他密切关注拍卖行业的动态。

e.en: Their {auctionary} catalogue listed rare coins.
e.zh: 他们的拍卖目录列出了稀有钱币。

e.en: The novel has a strong {auctorial} voice.
e.zh: 这部小说有强烈的作者声音。

e.en: She analysed his {auctorial} intent.
e.zh: 她分析了他的作者意图。

e.en: An {aucuba} thrives in shaded gardens.
e.zh: 桃叶珊瑚在阴凉的花园里生长茂盛。

e.en: The spotted leaves of {aucuba} brighten dim corners.
e.zh: 桃叶珊瑚的斑点叶子点亮了昏暗的角落。

aucubin.t: 桃叶珊瑚苷；桃叶珊瑚素

e.en: Researchers studied {aucubin} for its healing properties.
e.zh: 研究人员研究桃叶珊瑚苷的疗愈性质。

e.en: Plantain leaves contain {aucubin}.
e.zh: 车前草叶中含有桃叶珊瑚苷。

e.en: He prefers {audial} learning to reading.
e.zh: 他更喜欢听觉式学习而非阅读。

e.en: The film offers a rich {audial} experience.
e.zh: 这部电影提供了丰富的听觉体验。

audience-centered.t: 以观众为中心的；以受众为本的

e.en: Good speakers take an {audience-centered} approach.
e.zh: 优秀的演讲者采取以观众为中心的方式。

e.en: Her teaching style is highly {audience-centered}.
e.zh: 她的教学风格非常以学生为中心。

e.en: A small {audient} gathered at the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座上聚集了少数听众。

e.en: He stood silent, an attentive {audient}.
e.zh: 他静静地站着,做一个专注的听者。

audile.t: 听觉型的人；以听觉记忆为主的

e.en: As an {audile}, he remembers tunes easily.
e.zh: 作为听觉型的人,他很容易记住旋律。

e.en: {Audile} learners benefit from lectures.
e.zh: 听觉型学习者从讲课中受益。

e.en: {Auding} skills are essential for language students.
e.zh: 听解能力对语言学生至关重要。

e.en: Teachers tested the children's {auding} ability.
e.zh: 老师测试了孩子们的听力理解能力。

audio-animatronic.t: 音像电动人偶的;声控机械模型的

e.en: The ride features {audio-animatronic} pirates.
e.zh: 这个游乐设施以音像电动海盗人偶为特色。

e.en: Disney pioneered {audio-animatronic} figures.
e.zh: 迪士尼率先开发了声控机械人偶。

e.en: The doctor explained the {audio-gram} results.
e.zh: 医生解释了听力图的结果。

e.en: Her {audio-gram} showed mild hearing loss.
e.zh: 她的听力图显示有轻度听力损失。

e.en: The school uses an {audio-lingual} method.
e.zh: 该校采用听说教学法。

e.en: {Audio-lingual} drills focus on repetition.
e.zh: 听说法练习注重反复操练。

e.en: He archived old {audio-recordings} of interviews.
e.zh: 他把旧的访谈录音存档了。

e.en: The court reviewed the {audio-recordings}.
e.zh: 法院审查了那些录音。

e.en: She works as an {audio-typist} in a law firm.
e.zh: 她在一家律所做听打员。

e.en: An experienced {audio-typist} types very quickly.
e.zh: 一位熟练的听打员打字非常快。

audio-typists.t: 听打员;录音打字员(复数)

e.en: The firm hired three {audio-typists}.
e.zh: 该公司雇用了三名听打员。

e.en: {Audio-typists} transcribe dictated notes.
e.zh: 听打员把口述笔记转录下来。

e.en: They installed new {audio-video} equipment.
e.zh: 他们安装了新的视听设备。

e.en: The classroom has full {audio-video} support.
e.zh: 教室配有完整的视听支持。

e.en: The library has many {audio-visual} resources.
e.zh: 图书馆有许多视听资料。

e.en: They prepared an {audio-visual} presentation.
e.zh: 他们准备了一场视听演示。

e.en: He found an old {audiocassette} in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里找到一盘旧录音带。

e.en: The course came with an {audiocassette}.
e.zh: 这门课程附带一盘录音带。

e.en: The device operates at low {audiofrequency} ranges.
e.zh: 该设备工作在低音频范围。

e.en: Engineers tested the {audiofrequency} signal.
e.zh: 工程师测试了音频信号。

audiogenic.t: 声源性的;由声音引起的

e.en: The mice suffered {audiogenic} seizures.
e.zh: 这些小鼠出现了声源性癫痫发作。

e.en: Researchers study {audiogenic} stress responses.
e.zh: 研究人员研究声源性应激反应。

e.en: The clinic printed her {audiograph} for review.
e.zh: 诊所把她的听力图打印出来供查阅。

e.en: He recorded the lecture on an {audiograph}.
e.zh: 他用录音机录下了讲座。

e.en: They adopted an {audiolingual} approach to teaching French.
e.zh: 他们采用听说法教授法语。

e.en: {Audiolingual} drills emphasise spoken practice.
e.zh: 听说法练习强调口语操练。

e.en: The {audiometrist} fitted him with hearing aids.
e.zh: 听力测试师为他配了助听器。

e.en: She trained as a clinical {audiometrist}.
e.zh: 她受训成为临床听力测试师。

audiomonitor.t: 音频监听器;声音监控装置

e.en: The studio installed a new {audiomonitor}.
e.zh: 录音棚安装了新的音频监听器。

e.en: Nurses use an {audiomonitor} to check infants.
e.zh: 护士使用声音监控装置查看婴儿状况。

e.en: De Forest invented the {audion} in 1906.
e.zh: 德弗雷斯特于1906年发明了三极真空管。

e.en: The early radio used an {audion} tube.
e.zh: 早期收音机使用三极真空管。

e.en: The exhibit offers an {audiotactile} experience.
e.zh: 该展览提供听触觉结合的体验。

e.en: Children learn through {audiotactile} games.
e.zh: 孩子们通过听触觉游戏学习。

e.en: He used an {audiphone} before modern hearing aids existed.
e.zh: 在现代助听器出现前,他使用骨导听音器。

e.en: The {audiphone} pressed against the teeth conducts sound.
e.zh: 这种助听器贴在牙齿上传导声音。

e.en: The poets dreamed of {athanasia} beyond the grave.
e.zh: 诗人们梦想着死后的不朽。

e.en: Ancient myths often promise {athanasia} to the gods.
e.zh: 古代神话常将永生赋予众神。

e.en: He sought {athanasy} through his great writings.
e.zh: 他企图通过伟大的著作获得不朽。

e.en: The philosopher denied any possibility of {athanasy}.
e.zh: 这位哲学家否认任何永生的可能性。

e.en: The alchemist tended his {athanor} through the night.
e.zh: 炼金术士彻夜照看着他的炼金炉。

e.en: A medieval {athanor} maintained steady heat for days.
e.zh: 中世纪的恒温炉能持续数日保持稳定温度。

e.en: His {atheistical} views shocked the village priest.
e.zh: 他无神论的观点令村里的牧师震惊。

e.en: She wrote an openly {atheistical} pamphlet.
e.zh: 她写了一本公开宣扬无神论的小册子。

e.en: He argued {atheistically} against the existence of miracles.
e.zh: 他以无神论立场反驳奇迹的存在。

e.en: The book is written {atheistically} but with great respect.
e.zh: 这本书以无神论视角写成，但充满敬意。

e.en: The young {atheling} would soon claim the throne.
e.zh: 年轻的王子很快将继承王位。

e.en: An {atheling} of royal Saxon blood led the army.
e.zh: 一位拥有撒克逊王室血统的王子率领着军队。

athematic.t: 无主题的；无词干元音的

e.en: The composer wrote a deliberately {athematic} piece.
e.zh: 作曲家刻意创作了一首无主题的乐曲。

e.en: Some Sanskrit verbs follow an {athematic} conjugation.
e.zh: 部分梵语动词遵循无词干元音的变位方式。

e.en: The town's {atheneeum} held lectures every Friday.
e.zh: 镇上的文艺学会每周五举办讲座。

e.en: He spent hours reading at the {atheneeum}.
e.zh: 他在文艺学会图书馆里阅读了好几个小时。

e.en: The {atheneum} housed a vast collection of rare books.
e.zh: 该文艺学会收藏着大量珍稀书籍。

e.en: Scholars gathered nightly at the local {atheneum}.
e.zh: 学者们每晚都在当地的文艺学会聚会。

e.en: Several {atheneums} were founded in nineteenth-century Boston.
e.zh: 十九世纪的波士顿建立了数家文艺学会。

e.en: These old {atheneums} still host literary readings.
e.zh: 这些古老的文艺学会仍在举办文学朗诵会。

e.en: His book outlines a systematic {atheology}.
e.zh: 他的书阐述了一套系统的无神论神学。

e.en: Some philosophers now teach {atheology} at universities.
e.zh: 一些哲学家现已在大学教授无神论神学。

e.en: Her approach is deliberately {atheoretical} and empirical.
e.zh: 她的方法刻意采取非理论的、纯经验的取向。

e.en: The study is largely {atheoretical} in its design.
e.zh: 该研究在设计上基本不依赖任何理论。

e.en: The cardiologist performed an {atherectomy} on the patient.
e.zh: 心脏科医生为病人做了动脉粥样斑块切除术。

e.en: An {atherectomy} can restore blood flow in clogged arteries.
e.zh: 动脉粥样斑块切除术可恢复阻塞动脉的血流。

e.en: Schools of {atherine} flickered in the shallow bay.
e.zh: 成群的银汉鱼在浅海湾中闪烁游动。

e.en: The fisherman netted dozens of {atherine} at dawn.
e.zh: 渔夫黎明时捞起了几十条银汉鱼。

athermal.t: 非热的；不受温度影响的

e.en: The reaction proceeds via an {athermal} pathway.
e.zh: 该反应通过非热路径进行。

e.en: Engineers designed an {athermal} optical fiber.
e.zh: 工程师们设计出一种不受温度影响的光纤。

e.en: The material's {athermancy} blocks infrared radiation.
e.zh: 这种材料的不透热性能阻挡红外辐射。

e.en: Scientists measured the {athermancy} of various glasses.
e.zh: 科学家测量了各种玻璃的不透热性。

e.en: The wall was lined with an {athermanous} layer.
e.zh: 墙壁内衬有一层隔热材料。

e.en: Lead is highly {athermanous} to infrared rays.
e.zh: 铅对红外线有极强的隔热性。

e.en: The procedure uses an {athermic} laser to avoid burns.
e.zh: 该手术采用不发热激光以避免灼伤。

e.en: An {athermic} reaction releases no measurable heat.
e.zh: 无热反应不会释放可测量的热量。

e.en: The {athermous} screen protected the sensors.
e.zh: 那块不透热屏蔽板保护着传感器。

e.en: This coating renders the glass nearly {athermous}.
e.zh: 这种涂层使玻璃近乎不透热。

e.en: The patient suffered {atheroembolism} after the procedure.
e.zh: 该患者术后发生了动脉粥样硬化栓塞。

e.en: {Atheroembolism} can cause sudden pain in the toes.
e.zh: 动脉粥样硬化栓塞可引起脚趾突然剧痛。

e.en: Inflammation plays a key role in {atherogenesis}.
e.zh: 炎症在动脉粥样硬化形成中起关键作用。

e.en: Researchers study how diet influences {atherogenesis}.
e.zh: 研究人员探讨饮食如何影响动脉粥样硬化的形成。

e.en: Trans fats are highly {atherogenic} foods.
e.zh: 反式脂肪是极易致动脉粥样硬化的食物。

e.en: Doctors monitor {atherogenic} cholesterol levels closely.
e.zh: 医生密切监测致动脉粥样硬化的胆固醇水平。

e.en: An {atheroma} had narrowed the coronary artery.
e.zh: 一块粥样硬化斑块使冠状动脉变窄。

e.en: Surgeons removed the dangerous {atheroma}.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了那块危险的粥样硬化斑块。

e.en: Multiple {atheromas} were found along the aorta.
e.zh: 沿主动脉发现了多个粥样硬化斑块。

e.en: Imaging revealed several {atheromas} in his arteries.
e.zh: 影像显示他的动脉中有几处粥样硬化斑块。

e.en: The autopsy revealed widespread {atheromatosis}.
e.zh: 尸检显示存在广泛的动脉粥样硬化病变。

e.en: Diabetes accelerates the progression of {atheromatosis}.
e.zh: 糖尿病会加速动脉粥样硬化病的进程。

e.en: The scan showed an {atheromatous} plaque rupturing.
e.zh: 扫描显示一处动脉粥样硬化斑块正在破裂。

e.en: He has extensive {atheromatous} disease in his legs.
e.zh: 他的腿部存在广泛的动脉粥样硬化病变。

e.en: Early {atherosis} can develop without symptoms.
e.zh: 早期动脉粥样化可能毫无症状。

e.en: The lab detected signs of {atherosis} in samples.
e.zh: 实验室在样本中检测到了动脉粥样化的迹象。

e.en: The child showed {athetoid} movements of the hands.
e.zh: 这个孩子的手出现手足徐动型的动作。

e.en: He was diagnosed with {athetoid} cerebral palsy.
e.zh: 他被诊断为手足徐动型脑瘫。

e.en: {Athetosis} causes slow, writhing involuntary movements.
e.zh: 手足徐动症会引起缓慢扭动的不自主动作。

e.en: The neurologist explained the cause of her {athetosis}.
e.zh: 神经科医生解释了她患手足徐动症的原因。

e.en: The patient exhibited {athetotic} finger movements.
e.zh: 病人出现了手足徐动的手指动作。

e.en: His {athetotic} gait made walking very difficult.
e.zh: 他手足徐动的步态使行走十分困难。

e.en: Severe {athiaminosis} can cause beriberi.
e.zh: 严重的硫胺素缺乏症可引起脚气病。

e.en: Vets occasionally diagnose {athiaminosis} in cats.
e.zh: 兽医偶尔会在猫身上诊断出硫胺素缺乏症。

e.en: He was {athirst} for adventure and new lands.
e.zh: 他渴望冒险，渴望踏足新的土地。

e.en: The travelers stood {athirst} beneath the desert sun.
e.zh: 旅人们在沙漠烈日下口渴难耐。

e.en: The missile is powered by an {athodyd}.
e.zh: 这枚导弹由冲压式喷气发动机提供动力。

e.en: Engineers tested the {athodyd} at supersonic speeds.
e.zh: 工程师在超音速条件下测试了该冲压式喷气发动机。

e.en: The audience sat {athrill} as the curtain rose.
e.zh: 幕布升起时，观众激动得屏息以待。

e.en: She was {athrill} with anticipation before the journey.
e.zh: 启程前她兴奋得心潮澎湃。

e.en: His heart was {athrob} with sudden joy.
e.zh: 他的心因突如其来的喜悦而怦怦跳动。

e.en: The whole city seemed {athrob} with festival music.
e.zh: 整座城市似乎都随着节日音乐而悸动。

e.en: The tissue contained numerous active {athrocyte} cells.
e.zh: 组织中含有大量活跃的吞噬细胞。

e.en: Each {athrocyte} engulfs particles from the bloodstream.
e.zh: 每个积粒细胞都从血流中吞噬颗粒物。

e.en: {Athrocytosis} occurs in the proximal renal tubules.
e.zh: 细胞吞粒作用发生于近端肾小管。

e.en: Researchers observed {athrocytosis} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察到了细胞吞粒作用。

applicatively.t: 应用地；适用地；以适用的方式

e.en: The theory was {applicatively} extended to new fields.
e.zh: 该理论被适用地扩展到新的领域。

e.en: She framed the rule {applicatively} for our case.
e.zh: 她针对我们的情形以适用的方式表述了规则。

applicatorily.t: 实用地；可应用地；以实用方式

e.en: The professor explained the concept {applicatorily} to students.
e.zh: 教授以实用的方式向学生讲解了这一概念。

e.en: He approached every theorem {applicatorily}, hunting for uses.
e.zh: 他对每条定理都从实用角度入手，寻找用途。

applicatory.t: 适用的；实用的；可应用的

e.en: We need {applicatory} rules, not just abstract theory.
e.zh: 我们需要可应用的规则，而不只是抽象理论。

e.en: Her advice was strictly {applicatory} to our problem.
e.zh: 她的建议完全切合我们的问题。

e.en: She was the first {applier} for the new grant.
e.zh: 她是这项新拨款的首位申请人。

e.en: The nurse used a sterile {applier} on the wound.
e.zh: 护士用一根无菌涂抹棒处理伤口。

e.en: The crowd began to {applud} as she finished.
e.zh: 她讲完后人群开始鼓掌喝彩。

e.en: They would {applud} every brave performance loudly.
e.zh: 他们会为每一场勇敢的演出大声喝彩。

e.en: I've got a doctor's {appo} this afternoon.
e.zh: 我下午有个看医生的预约。

e.en: Can we book an {appo} for next week?
e.zh: 我们能不能约下周见一面？

e.en: The pianist hit the {appoggiatura} very delicately.
e.zh: 钢琴家非常轻柔地弹出那个倚音。

e.en: An {appoggiatura} adds expressive color to the melody.
e.zh: 倚音为旋律增添了富于表现力的色彩。

e.en: Only judges are {appointable} to this special committee.
e.zh: 只有法官才有资格被任命到这个特别委员会。

e.en: He is the most {appointable} candidate so far.
e.zh: 他是目前最适合任命的人选。

e.en: The {appointor} reserves the right to revoke later.
e.zh: 任命人保留日后撤销的权利。

e.en: As {appointor}, she chose her successor very carefully.
e.zh: 作为任命人，她非常谨慎地挑选了继任者。

e.en: The medium claimed to produce an {apport} during the séance.
e.zh: 灵媒声称在降神会上变出了一件灵物。

e.en: Skeptics dismissed every alleged {apport} as a trick.
e.zh: 怀疑者把所谓的显形物全都当作戏法。

e.en: The costs are {apportionable} among the four partners.
e.zh: 费用可在四位合伙人之间分摊。

e.en: Damages are {apportionable} based on each party's fault.
e.zh: 损害赔偿可根据各方的过错加以分摊。

e.en: Human thumbs are {apposable} to the other fingers.
e.zh: 人类的拇指可与其他手指对合。

e.en: The two clauses are easily {apposable} for comparison.
e.zh: 这两个分句很容易并置以便比较。

e.en: Editors often {appose} similar texts for close analysis.
e.zh: 编辑常把相似的文本并置以便细致分析。

e.en: The artist chose to {appose} bright and dark colors.
e.zh: 艺术家选择把明色与暗色并置在一起。

e.en: The two leaves were neatly {apposed} on the page.
e.zh: 两片叶子整齐地并置在书页上。

e.en: Their arguments stood {apposed} but never reconciled.
e.zh: 他们的论点并列摆放却从未调和。

apposes.t: 并置；并列摆放；并排放置

e.en: The author {apposes} two contrasting case studies.
e.zh: 作者将两个对比鲜明的案例并置在一起。

e.en: Her essay {apposes} myth and history quite skillfully.
e.zh: 她的文章相当巧妙地把神话与历史并置。

apposing.t: 并置；并列摆放；将其对置

e.en: By {apposing} the photographs, she revealed the change.
e.zh: 通过将照片并置，她揭示了其中的变化。

e.en: The curator was {apposing} ancient and modern works.
e.zh: 策展人正在把古代作品与现代作品并置展出。

e.en: The phrase plays an {appositional} role in this sentence.
e.zh: 该短语在这句话中起同位语的作用。

e.en: Bones grow by {appositional} deposition of new tissue.
e.zh: 骨骼通过新组织的附加性沉积而生长。

e.en: In 'my brother John', 'John' is an {appositive}.
e.zh: 在 my brother John 中，John 是同位语。

e.en: She added an {appositive} to clarify the noun.
e.zh: 她加了一个同位语来使该名词更清楚。

e.en: The name appears {appositively} after the official title.
e.zh: 姓名以同位语的方式出现在正式头衔之后。

e.en: Two clauses sit {appositively} in this odd construction.
e.zh: 在这种特殊结构中两个分句并列摆放。

e.en: Antique watches are easily {appraisable} by trained experts.
e.zh: 古董手表很容易由受过培训的专家估价。

e.en: Not every contribution is neatly {appraisable} in numbers.
e.zh: 并非每项贡献都能用数字干净利落地评估。

e.en: The {appraisee} must prepare a self-review first.
e.zh: 被评估者必须先准备一份自我评价。

e.en: Each {appraisee} meets with their manager once annually.
e.zh: 每位被考核者每年与经理面谈一次。

e.en: The estate underwent careful {appraisement} for tax purposes.
e.zh: 该房产为税务目的进行了仔细的估价。

e.en: He requested a fresh {appraisement} of the painting.
e.zh: 他要求对那幅画重新进行鉴定估价。

appraisive.t: 评估性的；带有评价意味的

e.en: She gave him an {appraisive} look across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头投来一个评估性的目光。

e.en: His tone was politely {appraisive} of my proposal.
e.zh: 他对我的提议语气客气却带评价意味。

e.en: He sent an {appreciatory} note to the chef.
e.zh: 他给厨师送去一张表示赞赏的便条。

e.en: The audience burst into {appreciatory} applause at once.
e.zh: 观众立刻爆发出表示赞赏的掌声。

e.en: The text's {apprehensibility} depends on prior knowledge.
e.zh: 该文本的可理解性取决于读者已有的知识。

e.en: Scientists greatly value the {apprehensibility} of their models.
e.zh: 科学家非常重视其模型的可理解性。

e.en: The argument is barely {apprehensible} without proper context.
e.zh: 没有适当的背景，这一论点几乎无法理解。

e.en: Make your main point clearly {apprehensible} to readers.
e.zh: 让你的要点对读者清晰易懂。

e.en: She explained the rules {apprehensibly} to the children.
e.zh: 她以易懂的方式向孩子们解释了规则。

e.en: He spoke {apprehensibly} despite the very noisy room.
e.zh: 尽管房间嘈杂，他说话依然清晰易懂。

appressorium.t: 附着胞；侵染垫；菌附着器

e.en: The fungus forms an {appressorium} to penetrate the leaf.
e.zh: 真菌形成附着胞以穿透叶片。

e.en: Each {appressorium} sticks firmly to the host surface.
e.zh: 每个附着胞都牢牢吸附在宿主表面。

e.en: Please {apprize} the committee of any further delays.
e.zh: 请将任何进一步的延误情况告知委员会。

e.en: He hurried to {apprize} her of the news.
e.zh: 他赶忙把这个消息告诉她。

apprized.t: 已告知；通知过（古旧拼法）

e.en: She {apprized} her boss of the risk yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天已把那项风险告知老板。

e.en: We were duly {apprized} of the schedule change.
e.zh: 我们已被正式告知了时间变更。

e.en: His {apprizement} of the situation came too late.
e.zh: 他对情况的告知来得太迟。

e.en: The official {apprizement} reached us by post.
e.zh: 正式的通知通过邮寄送到了我们手中。

e.en: The {apprizer} delivered the bad news at dawn.
e.zh: 通知者在拂晓时分送来了坏消息。

e.en: An independent {apprizer} valued the family property.
e.zh: 一名独立估价人对这家人的房产进行了估价。

e.en: He {apprizes} his clients of every market shift.
e.zh: 他会把每一次市场变动都告知客户。

e.en: She always {apprizes} the team before any changes.
e.zh: 她总是在任何变动之前告知团队。

apprizing.t: 正在通知；告知（古旧拼法）

e.en: He spent the morning {apprizing} staff of layoffs.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在告知员工裁员的消息。

e.en: The lawyer is {apprizing} her of her rights.
e.zh: 律师正在告知她应有的权利。

e.en: She took the necklace home on {appro}.
e.zh: 她以试用的方式把项链带回了家。

e.en: The dealer offered the watch on {appro} for a week.
e.zh: 商家提供这只手表试用一周。

approachless.t: 无法接近的；难以接近的

e.en: The cliff face seemed utterly {approachless} from below.
e.zh: 从下方看，那处崖壁似乎完全无法接近。

e.en: She had a cold, {approachless} air at the party.
e.zh: 在派对上她带着一股冷淡难近的气场。

e.en: The senate may {approbate} the new policy tomorrow.
e.zh: 参议院明天可能会批准这项新政策。

e.en: Critics rarely {approbate} such bold experiments in art.
e.zh: 评论家很少认可这类大胆的艺术实验。

e.en: The bill was finally {approbated} after long debate.
e.zh: 该法案经长时间辩论后终获批准。

e.en: Her appointment was unanimously {approbated} yesterday afternoon.
e.zh: 她的任命昨天下午获得一致认可。

e.en: The board {approbates} every major expenditure carefully.
e.zh: 董事会会仔细批准每一项重大支出。

e.en: He grudgingly {approbates} her unconventional methods.
e.zh: 他勉强认可她那些非传统的方法。

approbating.t: 正在批准；认可；表示赞同

e.en: The committee is {approbating} the revised charter today.
e.zh: 委员会今天正在审批修订后的章程。

e.en: She kept {approbating} every decision he made.
e.zh: 她对他作出的每一个决定都不断表示认可。

e.en: He gave an {approbative} nod at her proposal.
e.zh: 他对她的提议点头表示赞许。

e.en: Her {approbative} smile encouraged the young pianist.
e.zh: 她赞许的微笑鼓舞了那位年轻钢琴家。

approbativeness.t: 渴求赞许；爱好称赞之心

e.en: His excessive {approbativeness} made him seek constant praise.
e.zh: 他过度的求赞之心使他不断寻求称赞。

e.en: Genuine artists resist mere {approbativeness} from the crowd.
e.zh: 真正的艺术家会抵制单纯求众人称赞的心理。

approbator.t: 批准者；赞许者；认可之人

e.en: The chief {approbator} signed off on the project.
e.zh: 首席批准者签字通过了这个项目。

e.en: Every loyal {approbator} attended the closing ceremony.
e.zh: 每一位忠实的赞许者都出席了闭幕式。

e.en: She received an {approbatory} letter from the dean.
e.zh: 她收到了院长一封表示赞许的信。

e.en: His tone turned {approbatory} after seeing the results.
e.zh: 看到结果后他的语气转为赞许。

e.en: She nodded in silent {approof} of his plan.
e.zh: 她默默点头对他的计划表示赞同。

e.en: The king's {approof} was needed before they could proceed.
e.zh: 事情推进之前需要国王的批准。

e.en: The travelers slowly {appropinquate} the ancient city gate.
e.zh: 旅人们缓缓接近那道古老的城门。

e.en: Spring begins to {appropinquate} the weary northern lands.
e.zh: 春天开始向疲惫的北方土地靠近。

e.en: Their cautious {appropinquation} alarmed the watchful guards.
e.zh: 他们谨慎的靠近惊动了警觉的守卫。

e.en: We sensed the storm's slow {appropinquation} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午我们都感到风暴在缓缓接近。

e.en: The two villages share an unusual {appropinquity}.
e.zh: 这两个村子相距异常地近。

e.en: Their {appropinquity} bred a deep, lasting friendship.
e.zh: 他们的相邻促成了一段深厚而持久的友谊。

appropriable.t: 可占用的；可拨用的；可挪用的

e.en: The funds are {appropriable} only for genuine emergencies.
e.zh: 这些资金只能拨用于真正的紧急情况。

e.en: Cultural symbols are not freely {appropriable} by outsiders.
e.zh: 文化符号不可由外人随意挪用。

e.en: The circuit uses an {autotransformer} to step down voltage.
e.zh: 该电路使用自耦变压器来降压。

e.en: An {autotransformer} is lighter than a conventional transformer.
e.zh: 自耦变压器比传统变压器更轻便。

e.en: The surgeon used {autotransfusion} during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中采用了自体输血。

e.en: {Autotransfusion} reduces the risk of infection.
e.zh: 自体输血能降低感染风险。

e.en: Doctors performed an {autotransplant} of bone marrow.
e.zh: 医生进行了骨髓自体移植。

e.en: The {autotransplant} healed quickly.
e.zh: 这次自体移植愈合得很快。

e.en: {Autotransplantation} avoids immune rejection issues.
e.zh: 自体移植可以避免免疫排斥问题。

e.en: She underwent kidney {autotransplantation}.
e.zh: 她接受了肾脏自体移植手术。

e.en: Plants are classic {autotrophs} that make their own food.
e.zh: 植物是典型的自养生物，能自己制造食物。

e.en: An {autotroph} synthesizes nutrients from inorganic matter.
e.zh: 自养生物能从无机物合成营养。

e.en: Algae are {autotrophic} organisms.
e.zh: 藻类是自养型生物。

e.en: {Autotrophic} bacteria thrive near deep-sea vents.
e.zh: 自养细菌在深海热液口附近繁衍。

e.en: These cells grow {autotrophically} in sunlight.
e.zh: 这些细胞在阳光下以自养方式生长。

e.en: The microbe lives {autotrophically} on carbon dioxide.
e.zh: 这种微生物靠二氧化碳自养生存。

e.en: {Autotrophs} form the base of most food chains.
e.zh: 自养生物构成了大多数食物链的基础。

e.en: Many {autotrophs} rely on photosynthesis.
e.zh: 许多自养生物依赖光合作用。

e.en: {Autotrophy} allows plants to feed themselves.
e.zh: 自养作用使植物能够自给自足。

e.en: Some bacteria switch between {autotrophy} and heterotrophy.
e.zh: 某些细菌在自养与异养之间切换。

autotune.t: 自动音准修正；自动调谐

e.en: The singer's voice was processed with {autotune}.
e.zh: 歌手的声音经过了自动音准修正处理。

e.en: Many pop tracks rely heavily on {autotune}.
e.zh: 许多流行歌曲都大量使用自动调音。

e.en: The museum displayed an {autotype} of the original drawing.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了原画的碳素复制版。

e.en: He collected {autotypes} of famous paintings.
e.zh: 他收藏了名画的碳素复制本。

e.en: The clinic prepared an {autovaccine} from the patient's own bacteria.
e.zh: 诊所用患者自身的细菌制备了自体疫苗。

e.en: {Autovaccines} are tailored to individual patients.
e.zh: 自体疫苗是为个别患者量身定制的。

e.en: The camera has an {autowind} feature for fast shooting.
e.zh: 这台相机带有自动卷片功能，便于快速拍摄。

e.en: His watch uses an {autowind} mechanism.
e.zh: 他的手表使用自动上弦装置。

e.en: He attached an {autowinder} to his film camera.
e.zh: 他给胶片相机装上了自动卷片器。

e.en: The {autowinder} advances frames automatically.
e.zh: 自动卷片器会自动推进胶片帧。

e.en: {Autoxidation} causes oils to turn rancid.
e.zh: 自动氧化会使油脂变质发臭。

e.en: Antioxidants slow the {autoxidation} of fats.
e.zh: 抗氧化剂能减缓脂肪的自动氧化。

e.en: The geologist found a sample of {autunite} in the mine.
e.zh: 地质学家在矿中发现了一块钙铀云母样品。

e.en: {Autunite} fluoresces a bright green under UV light.
e.zh: 钙铀云母在紫外光下会发出亮绿色荧光。

e.en: The botanist set up an {auxanometer} to measure the seedling.
e.zh: 植物学家架设了生长测定仪来测量幼苗。

e.en: An {auxanometer} records minute changes in stem length.
e.zh: 生长测定仪能记录茎长的微小变化。

e.en: {Auxesis} explains the rapid growth of young leaves.
e.zh: 细胞增大解释了嫩叶的快速生长。

e.en: The poet used {auxesis} to heighten the drama.
e.zh: 诗人运用夸张法来增强戏剧效果。

e.en: {Auxetic} materials become thicker when stretched.
e.zh: 拉胀材料在被拉伸时反而会变厚。

e.en: Engineers are testing an {auxetic} foam for body armor.
e.zh: 工程师正在测试用于防弹衣的拉胀泡沫。

e.en: The {auxetophone} amplified gramophone sound using compressed air.
e.zh: 气流增音器利用压缩空气放大留声机的声音。

e.en: Few working {auxetophones} survive today.
e.zh: 如今仍能使用的气流增音器寥寥无几。

aptly-named.t: 名副其实的；恰如其名的

e.en: He works at the {aptly-named} Sunshine Café, which has huge windows.
e.zh: 他在那家名副其实的阳光咖啡馆工作，店里有巨大的窗户。

e.en: The {aptly-named} Heartbreak Hotel is where many tourists end their day.
e.zh: 那家恰如其名的心碎酒店是许多游客一天行程的终点。

aptote.t: 无格变化名词；不变格名词

e.en: Latin grammar lists certain nouns as an {aptote} with no case changes.
e.zh: 拉丁语法把某些名词列为无格变化名词，没有格的变化。

e.en: An {aptote} keeps the same form across all syntactic positions.
e.zh: 无格变化名词在所有句法位置都保持相同的形式。

e.en: Some ancient languages contain {aptotic} nouns that never inflect.
e.zh: 某些古代语言中存在从不发生词形变化的无格变化名词。

e.en: He described the word as {aptotic} because it lacked declension.
e.zh: 他把这个词形容为无格变化的，因为它没有词形变化。

apurpose.t: 故意地；有意地；有意为之

e.en: She left the door open {apurpose} so the cat could enter.
e.zh: 她故意把门开着，好让猫进得来。

e.en: He stumbled {apurpose}, hoping to draw a foul from the defender.
e.zh: 他故意绊了一跤，希望能让防守球员吃个犯规。

apyrase.t: 三磷酸腺苷酶；一种水解酶

e.en: The lab purifies {apyrase} to study nucleotide hydrolysis.
e.zh: 实验室纯化三磷酸腺苷酶以研究核苷酸水解过程。

e.en: Researchers added {apyrase} to remove leftover ATP from the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员加入三磷酸腺苷酶以去除样品中残留的 ATP。

apyretic.t: 无热的；不发烧的；退热的

e.en: After two days of treatment, the patient was finally {apyretic}.
e.zh: 经过两天的治疗后，病人终于不再发烧了。

e.en: An {apyretic} interval may still hide an underlying infection.
e.zh: 无发热的间歇期仍可能掩盖潜在的感染。

e.en: Doctors recorded a brief {apyrexia} between her fever spikes.
e.zh: 医生记录到她两次发烧高峰之间出现了短暂的无热期。

e.en: The chart shows long stretches of {apyrexia} during recovery.
e.zh: 病历图显示恢复期间出现了长时间的无热期。

e.en: The rare mineral is {apyrous} and survives in volcanic furnaces.
e.zh: 这种稀有矿物耐火，能在火山高温下保存下来。

e.en: Asbestos was once prized as an {apyrous} insulating material.
e.zh: 石棉曾因其耐火性能而被视为珍贵的绝缘材料。

e.en: She wore an {aqua-blue} dress to the summer party.
e.zh: 她穿着一件水蓝色的连衣裙参加夏日派对。

e.en: The pool tiles were a soothing {aqua-blue} colour.
e.zh: 泳池的瓷砖是一种令人舒缓的水蓝色。

aquacade.t: 水上歌舞表演秀；水上表演

e.en: The resort hosted a nightly {aquacade} with synchronized swimmers.
e.zh: 度假村每晚都会上演一场由花样游泳运动员表演的水上歌舞秀。

e.en: Old Hollywood films often featured a glamorous {aquacade}.
e.zh: 早期好莱坞电影中常出现华丽的水上歌舞表演。

aquaculturist.t: 水产养殖业者；水族养殖人员

e.en: The {aquaculturist} monitors oxygen levels in every fish tank.
e.zh: 这位水产养殖业者密切监测每个鱼池的氧气水平。

e.en: She trained as an {aquaculturist} after studying marine biology.
e.zh: 她在攻读海洋生物学之后接受了水产养殖业者的培训。

aquafarm.t: 水产养殖场；水生养殖场

e.en: Their family runs a small shrimp {aquafarm} on the coast.
e.zh: 他们家在海岸边经营一个小型对虾养殖场。

e.en: The new {aquafarm} produces ten tons of salmon each year.
e.zh: 这家新建的水产养殖场每年生产十吨三文鱼。

e.en: Drilling reached the underground {aquafer} after fifty meters.
e.zh: 钻探在五十米深处到达地下含水层。

e.en: The town draws all its drinking water from a single {aquafer}.
e.zh: 全镇的饮用水都取自同一个含水层。

e.en: The wound dressing contains a soft {aquagel} layer.
e.zh: 这种伤口敷料含有一层柔软的水凝胶。

e.en: Plant roots grow well in the moisture-retaining {aquagel}.
e.zh: 植物的根在保湿的水凝胶中生长良好。

aquagun.t: 水枪；玩具水枪；高压水枪

e.en: The kids chased each other with a plastic {aquagun} in the yard.
e.zh: 孩子们拿着一把塑料水枪在院子里互相追逐。

e.en: Lifeguards used an {aquagun} to clear algae from the pool walls.
e.zh: 救生员用高压水枪清除泳池壁上的藻类。

e.en: The textbook devotes a chapter to {aquakinetics} and turbine design.
e.zh: 这本教科书专门用一章讨论水动力学和涡轮机设计。

e.en: Engineers apply {aquakinetics} principles to the new dam.
e.zh: 工程师把水动力学原理应用到这座新大坝上。

aqualung.t: 水下呼吸器；潜水呼吸装置

e.en: He strapped on his {aqualung} and dove off the boat.
e.zh: 他绑好水下呼吸器，从船上跳入水中。

e.en: The diver checked the {aqualung} before descending into the wreck.
e.zh: 潜水员在下潜到沉船之前仔细检查了水下呼吸器。

aqualungs.t: 水下呼吸器；潜水呼吸装置（复数）

e.en: They rented two {aqualungs} for the weekend dive trip.
e.zh: 他们为周末的潜水之旅租了两套水下呼吸器。

e.en: The shop displayed several modern {aqualungs} in the window.
e.zh: 商店橱窗里陈列着几套现代的水下呼吸器。

aquamanile.t: 中世纪洗手用水罐；动物形水罐

e.en: The museum exhibits a bronze {aquamanile} shaped like a lion.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一只造型为狮子的青铜洗手水罐。

e.en: Medieval guests rinsed their hands using an ornate {aquamanile}.
e.zh: 中世纪的客人用装饰华丽的洗手水罐冲洗双手。

aquamarsh.t: 水生沼泽；湿地；水洼湿地

e.en: Birds rest in the {aquamarsh} along the river's edge.
e.zh: 鸟类在河边的水生沼泽里栖息。

e.en: The reserve protects a fragile {aquamarsh} ecosystem.
e.zh: 这个保护区守护着脆弱的水生沼泽生态系统。

aquanautics.t: 潜水学；水下航行学；水下作业学

e.en: Her career in {aquanautics} took her to deep-sea research stations.
e.zh: 她在水下航行学领域的职业生涯让她来到了深海研究站工作。

e.en: The institute teaches {aquanautics} alongside marine engineering.
e.zh: 该研究所同时教授水下航行学和海洋工程。

aquaplane.t: 滑水板；水上滑橇；滑水运动

e.en: He stood on the {aquaplane} as the boat sped away.
e.zh: 船加速驶离时，他稳稳地站在滑水板上。

e.en: Cars can {aquaplane} dangerously on flooded roads.
e.zh: 在被水淹没的路面上，汽车可能会危险地打滑。

aquaplaned.t: 滑水；车辆在湿滑路面上打滑

e.en: The truck {aquaplaned} across the wet motorway.
e.zh: 卡车在湿滑的高速公路上一路打滑。

e.en: She {aquaplaned} behind the speedboat all afternoon.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在快艇后面玩滑水。

aquaplanes.t: 滑水板；车辆在湿滑路面上打滑

e.en: The shop rents {aquaplanes} for tourists at the lake.
e.zh: 湖边的店铺向游客出租滑水板。

e.en: Whenever it rains heavily, his old car {aquaplanes} on the highway.
e.zh: 每当大雨滂沱，他的旧车都会在高速公路上打滑。

aquaplaning.t: 车辆在湿滑路面上打滑；滑水运动

e.en: Worn tyres make {aquaplaning} much more likely in heavy rain.
e.zh: 磨损的轮胎在暴雨中更容易让车辆打滑。

e.en: He took up {aquaplaning} during his beach holiday.
e.zh: 他在海滩度假期间迷上了滑水运动。

aquaponics.t: 鱼菜共生系统；养鱼种菜法

e.en: Their greenhouse uses {aquaponics} to grow lettuce above tilapia tanks.
e.zh: 他们的温室采用鱼菜共生系统，在罗非鱼池上方种植生菜。

e.en: {Aquaponics} combines fish farming with hydroponic vegetables.
e.zh: 鱼菜共生系统将养鱼与水培蔬菜结合在一起。

aquarelle.t: 水彩画；水彩画法；水彩作品

e.en: She painted a delicate {aquarelle} of the misty harbour.
e.zh: 她画了一幅描绘雾气弥漫港口的细腻水彩画。

e.en: The gallery's new exhibit features French {aquarelle} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 画廊的新展览展出了 19 世纪的法国水彩画作品。

aquarial.t: 水族馆的；水池的；养鱼缸的

e.en: The aquarium runs an {aquarial} education program for schools.
e.zh: 这家水族馆为学校开设了水族馆教育项目。

e.en: He photographed the {aquarial} plants under blue lighting.
e.zh: 他在蓝色灯光下拍摄了水族箱里的水生植物。

aquarist.t: 水族饲养者；水族馆管理员

e.en: An experienced {aquarist} can keep delicate corals alive for years.
e.zh: 经验丰富的水族饲养者能让娇贵的珊瑚存活多年。

e.en: She works as an {aquarist} at the city's largest aquarium.
e.zh: 她在该市最大的水族馆担任水族馆管理员。

aquarobics.t: 水中健身操；水中有氧操

e.en: My grandmother attends {aquarobics} class twice a week.
e.zh: 我奶奶每周参加两次水中健身操课程。

e.en: The gym added an evening {aquarobics} session for beginners.
e.zh: 健身房为初学者增设了一节晚间水中健身操课。

aquascape.t: 水景；水族箱造景；水下景观

e.en: He spent months building an underwater {aquascape} with live plants.
e.zh: 他花了好几个月用活体水草搭建了一个水族箱造景。

e.en: The garden centre offers tutorials on creating a backyard {aquascape}.
e.zh: 园艺中心提供如何打造后院水景的教学课程。

aquashow.t: 水上表演秀；水中歌舞表演

e.en: The resort's evening {aquashow} drew crowds every weekend.
e.zh: 度假村的晚间水上表演秀每个周末都吸引大量观众。

e.en: Performers in the {aquashow} dove from a fifteen-meter platform.
e.zh: 水上表演秀的演员从十五米高的平台上跳水。

aquastat.t: 水温调节器；水温自动控制器

e.en: The plumber installed a new {aquastat} on the hot-water heater.
e.zh: 管道工在热水器上安装了一个新的水温调节器。

e.en: The {aquastat} keeps the boiler from overheating during winter.
e.zh: 水温调节器防止锅炉在冬天过热。

aquatel.t: 水上酒店；浮动旅馆；船屋旅馆

e.en: They booked a houseboat at the {aquatel} for their anniversary.
e.zh: 他们为结婚周年在那家水上酒店订了一间船屋。

e.en: The new {aquatel} on the lake offers private balconies over the water.
e.zh: 湖上新开的水上酒店提供俯瞰水面的私人阳台。

e.en: The biologist studied {aquatical} creatures in the swamp.
e.zh: 这位生物学家研究沼泽中的水生生物。

e.en: Some plants display surprising {aquatical} adaptations.
e.zh: 某些植物展现出令人惊奇的水生适应特征。

aquatically.t: 水生地；在水中地；水栖地

e.en: Frogs live both on land and {aquatically} during their lives.
e.zh: 青蛙的一生既生活在陆地上，也生活在水中。

e.en: These insects develop {aquatically} before emerging as adults.
e.zh: 这些昆虫先在水中发育，然后蜕变为成虫。

aquatintist.t: 凹版腐蚀版画家；飞尘版画家

e.en: The {aquatintist} prepared the copper plate with rosin dust.
e.zh: 这位飞尘版画家用松香粉处理铜版。

e.en: Goya was a celebrated {aquatintist} of his era.
e.zh: 戈雅是他那个时代著名的飞尘版画家。

aquation.t: 水化作用；水合反应；水合作用

e.en: The chemist explained the {aquation} of the metal complex.
e.zh: 化学家详细解释了这种金属配合物的水合反应。

e.en: {Aquation} replaces ligands with water molecules in the structure.
e.zh: 水合反应用水分子取代结构中的配体。

aquatone.t: 胶版印刷工艺；水彩色调印刷

e.en: The printer used an {aquatone} process to reproduce the painting.
e.zh: 印刷厂采用胶版印刷工艺复制这幅画作。

e.en: She admired the rich blues in the {aquatone} print.
e.zh: 她欣赏那幅胶版印刷作品中浓郁的蓝色调。

aquiclude.t: 隔水层；不透水层；阻水层

e.en: Clay layers act as an {aquiclude} above the deeper aquifer.
e.zh: 粘土层在较深含水层之上充当隔水层。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {aquiclude} to predict groundwater flow.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了隔水层图，以预测地下水流向。

aquicultural.t: 水产养殖的；水生养殖的

e.en: The region invested heavily in {aquicultural} infrastructure.
e.zh: 该地区在水产养殖基础设施方面投入了大量资金。

e.en: She studies {aquicultural} techniques for sustainable shrimp farming.
e.zh: 她研究用于可持续对虾养殖的水产养殖技术。

aquiculture.t: 水产养殖；水栽法；水生养殖

e.en: {Aquiculture} provides nearly half of the world's seafood today.
e.zh: 如今，水产养殖提供了世界上近一半的海产品。

e.en: The country's {aquiculture} industry has grown rapidly in recent years.
e.zh: 该国的水产养殖业近年来增长迅速。

e.en: The {autogiro} hovered briefly above the field.
e.zh: 那架自转旋翼机在田野上方短暂悬停。

e.en: Early {autogiros} paved the way for the helicopter.
e.zh: 早期的旋翼机为直升机的发明铺平了道路。

e.en: True {autognosis} requires brutal honesty with oneself.
e.zh: 真正的自我认知需要对自己绝对诚实。

e.en: The therapist guided him toward {autognosis}.
e.zh: 治疗师引导他走向自我认知。

autograft.t: 自体移植；自体组织移植

e.en: The surgeon performed a skin {autograft} on the burn victim.
e.zh: 外科医生为烧伤患者实施了皮肤自体移植。

e.en: An {autograft} reduces the risk of immune rejection.
e.zh: 自体移植可降低免疫排斥的风险。

e.en: Bone {autografts} are commonly used in spinal surgery.
e.zh: 骨自体移植物常用于脊柱手术。

e.en: Surgeons prefer {autografts} when possible.
e.zh: 外科医生在可能时优先选择自体移植。

e.en: She showed me an {autographic} letter from the poet.
e.zh: 她给我看了一封那位诗人的亲笔信。

e.en: The instrument produces an {autographic} record of pressure.
e.zh: 该仪器能自动记录压力变化。

e.en: The museum displays several {autographical} manuscripts.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几份亲笔手稿。

e.en: His {autographical} notes are highly valued.
e.zh: 他的亲笔笔记十分珍贵。

autographism.t: 亲笔签名癖；签名收藏热

e.en: His {autographism} filled the study with signed photographs.
e.zh: 他对亲笔签名的痴迷让书房堆满了签名照。

e.en: Critics dismissed the trend as mere {autographism}.
e.zh: 评论家把这股潮流贬为单纯的签名癖。

e.en: The expert used an {autographometer} to verify the signature.
e.zh: 专家用笔迹测量仪核验那个签名。

e.en: An old {autographometer} sat on the forensic desk.
e.zh: 鉴定桌上摆着一台旧的笔迹测量仪。

e.en: The book reproduces the manuscript by {autography}.
e.zh: 该书用自写石印术复制了手稿。

e.en: Scholars studied his {autography} for clues.
e.zh: 学者们研究他的亲笔字迹寻找线索。

e.en: The illustrations were printed by {autogravure}.
e.zh: 这些插图采用照相凹版印刷工艺。

e.en: {Autogravure} produces remarkably fine tonal gradations.
e.zh: 照相凹版能呈现极其细腻的色调层次。

e.en: The {autogyro} landed on the small grass strip.
e.zh: 那架旋翼机降落在小小的草地跑道上。

e.en: He flies a vintage {autogyro} on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末驾驶一架老式旋翼机飞行。

e.en: She strummed a folk tune on her {autoharp}.
e.zh: 她用自鸣筝弹奏了一首民谣。

e.en: The {autoharp} is easy for beginners to play.
e.zh: 自鸣筝对初学者来说很容易上手。

e.en: The farmer hitched the {autoheader} to the tractor.
e.zh: 农夫把自动割穗机挂在拖拉机后面。

e.en: An {autoheader} can harvest grain much faster.
e.zh: 自动割穗机能更快地收割谷物。

e.en: The lab detected {autohemagglutination} in the patient's sample.
e.zh: 实验室在患者样本中检出自体血凝集。

e.en: {Autohemagglutination} can complicate blood typing.
e.zh: 自体血凝集可能干扰血型鉴定。

e.en: Researchers measured {autohemopsonin} levels in serum.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了血清中自体血调理素的水平。

e.en: {Autohemopsonin} promotes phagocytosis of one's own cells.
e.zh: 自体血调理素可促进对自身细胞的吞噬作用。

e.en: The radio used an {autoheterodyne} circuit for detection.
e.zh: 该收音机采用自差式电路进行检波。

e.en: {Autoheterodyne} reception was common in early receivers.
e.zh: 自差式接收在早期收音机中十分常见。

e.en: He uses {autohypnosis} to manage chronic pain.
e.zh: 他用自我催眠来缓解慢性疼痛。

e.en: {Autohypnosis} can help reduce performance anxiety.
e.zh: 自我催眠有助于减轻表演焦虑。

e.en: She practiced {autohypnotism} every night before bed.
e.zh: 她每晚睡前都练习自我催眠。

e.en: The book teaches basic {autohypnotism} techniques.
e.zh: 这本书介绍了基本的自我催眠技巧。

e.en: This moss species is strictly {autoicous}.
e.zh: 这种苔藓严格属于同株异苞型。

e.en: Botanists noted the plant's {autoicous} arrangement.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到该植物的同株异苞排列。

e.en: Diesel fuel will {autoignite} under high compression.
e.zh: 柴油在高压缩比下会自燃。

e.en: The oily rags can {autoignite} in hot weather.
e.zh: 沾油的抹布在高温下可能自燃。

e.en: Each fuel has its own {autoignition} temperature.
e.zh: 每种燃料都有各自的自燃温度。

e.en: Engineers designed the engine to prevent premature {autoignition}.
e.zh: 工程师将发动机设计为可防止过早自燃。

e.en: {Autoimmunization} can trigger a range of disorders.
e.zh: 自体免疫可能引发多种疾病。

e.en: The study examined mechanisms of {autoimmunization}.
e.zh: 该研究探讨了自体免疫的机制。

e.en: Poor hygiene can lead to {autoinfection} with parasites.
e.zh: 卫生不良可能导致寄生虫的自体感染。

e.en: The doctor warned her about the risk of {autoinfection}.
e.zh: 医生警告她注意自体感染的风险。

autoinflation.t: 自动充气；自体咽鼓管充气

e.en: The life vest features {autoinflation} on contact with water.
e.zh: 这件救生衣遇水即可自动充气。

e.en: {Autoinflation} relieved the pressure in his middle ear.
e.zh: 自体咽鼓管充气缓解了他中耳的压力。

e.en: She always carries an {autoinjector} in case of allergy.
e.zh: 她随身携带自动注射器以防过敏发作。

e.en: The {autoinjector} delivers a fixed dose of epinephrine.
e.zh: 该自动注射器可注射固定剂量的肾上腺素。

e.en: Scratching the rash caused {autoinoculation} on his arm.
e.zh: 抓挠皮疹导致他手臂上发生自体接种。

e.en: {Autoinoculation} spread the virus to other body sites.
e.zh: 自体接种把病毒传到了身体其他部位。

e.en: The body normally clears such {autointoxicants} via the liver.
e.zh: 身体通常通过肝脏清除这类自体中毒物。

e.en: Buildup of an {autointoxicant} can cause fatigue.
e.zh: 自体中毒物的积累可能导致疲劳。

e.en: Old wellness theories blamed many ills on {autointoxication}.
e.zh: 旧的养生理论将许多疾病归咎于自体中毒。

e.en: Modern medicine largely rejects the concept of {autointoxication}.
e.zh: 现代医学大多否定自体中毒这一概念。

e.en: The geologist identified an {autointrusion} within the pluton.
e.zh: 地质学家在该深成岩体中发现了一处自侵入。

e.en: {Autointrusion} occurs when residual magma cuts earlier rock.
e.zh: 残余岩浆切穿早期岩石时便形成自侵入。

e.en: Water undergoes slight {autoionization} at room temperature.
e.zh: 水在室温下会发生轻微的自电离。

e.en: The {autoionization} constant is denoted Kw.
e.zh: 自电离常数用Kw表示。

e.en: Early {autoists} braved muddy, unpaved roads.
e.zh: 早期的汽车驾驶者要忍受泥泞未铺装的道路。

e.en: The newspaper warned {autoists} about icy bridges.
e.zh: 报纸提醒驾车人当心结冰的桥面。

e.en: The hospital tested a new {autojector} for emergencies.
e.zh: 医院测试了一款用于急救的新型自动注射装置。

e.en: An {autojector} ensures a precise dose every time.
e.zh: 自动注射装置每次都能保证剂量精准。

e.en: The pilot mistook {autokinesis} for an actual moving light.
e.zh: 飞行员把自动现象误认成真正移动的灯光。

e.en: {Autokinesis} is common when staring at a single point.
e.zh: 长时间凝视一点时常会出现自动现象。

e.en: Researchers studied the {autokinetic} effect in dark rooms.
e.zh: 研究人员在暗室里研究自动效应。

e.en: He reported an {autokinetic} illusion during the night flight.
e.zh: 他报告说夜航中出现了自动错觉。

e.en: The aircraft engaged {autoland} in heavy fog.
e.zh: 飞机在浓雾中启用了自动着陆。

e.en: Modern airliners feature reliable {autoland} capability.
e.zh: 现代客机配备了可靠的自动着陆功能。

e.en: His memoir slid into shameless {autolatry}.
e.zh: 他的回忆录沦为毫不掩饰的自我崇拜。

e.en: Critics accused the leader of pure {autolatry}.
e.zh: 评论家指责这位领导人完全是在自我崇拜。

e.en: The clinic offered experimental {autoleukocytotherapy}.
e.zh: 该诊所提供试验性的自体白细胞疗法。

e.en: {Autoleukocytotherapy} aims to modulate the immune response.
e.zh: 自体白细胞疗法旨在调节免疫反应。

e.en: The granite contained several dark {autoliths}.
e.zh: 花岗岩中含有几块深色的同源包体。

e.en: An {autolith} forms from earlier crystallized magma.
e.zh: 同源包体由先期结晶的岩浆形成。

e.en: The artist signed each {autolithograph} in pencil.
e.zh: 艺术家用铅笔在每张亲笔石版画上签了名。

e.en: This {autolithograph} was drawn directly onto the stone.
e.zh: 这幅亲笔石版画是直接画在石板上的。

e.en: The book contains {autolithographed} plates by the author.
e.zh: 书中收有作者亲笔石版印刷的图版。

e.en: Each {autolithographed} sheet bears subtle imperfections.
e.zh: 每张亲笔石版印刷品都有细微的不完美之处。

e.en: The studio specialized in {autolithographic} reproductions.
e.zh: 该工作室专门从事亲笔石版复制。

e.en: Her {autolithographic} prints sold quickly.
e.zh: 她的亲笔石版画很快就售罄。

autolithography.t: 亲笔石版术；自写石版术

e.en: The course covered the history of {autolithography}.
e.zh: 这门课介绍了亲笔石版术的历史。

e.en: Many illustrators learned {autolithography} in art school.
e.zh: 许多插画家在艺术学校学过亲笔石版术。

e.en: The truck has an {autoload} system for pallets.
e.zh: 这辆卡车配有托盘自动装载系统。

e.en: Set the rifle to {autoload} the next round.
e.zh: 把步枪设为自动装填下一发子弹。

autoloading.t: 自动装填的；自动装载的

e.en: He owns an {autoloading} shotgun for hunting.
e.zh: 他有一支自动装填的猎枪。

e.en: The factory installed an {autoloading} conveyor.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一条自动装载传送带。

e.en: The recorder's {autolocator} jumps to any cue point.
e.zh: 这台录音机的自动定位器可跳转到任意指示点。

e.en: Engineers relied on the {autolocator} during long sessions.
e.zh: 工程师在长时间录音中依赖自动定位器。

e.en: His essays read like exercises in {autology}.
e.zh: 他的随笔读起来像是自我研究的练习。

e.en: True {autology} demands relentless introspection.
e.zh: 真正的自我研究需要不懈的内省。

e.en: Certain deep-sea creatures exhibit striking {autoluminescence}.
e.zh: 某些深海生物展现出引人注目的自发光现象。

e.en: The mineral's faint {autoluminescence} surprised the geologists.
e.zh: 这种矿物微弱的自发光让地质学家感到惊讶。

e.en: The captain sent an {aviso} to the fleet.
e.zh: 船长向舰队发出了一份通报。

e.en: A small {aviso} carried the urgent dispatch.
e.zh: 一艘小型通报船传递了紧急公文。

e.en: Severe {avitaminosis} can cause serious health problems.
e.zh: 严重的维生素缺乏症会导致严重的健康问题。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed him with {avitaminosis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断他患有维生素缺乏症。

e.en: The judge took the case to {avizandum} for further consideration.
e.zh: 法官将案件延期审议以便进一步考量。

e.en: After arguments, the matter was made {avizandum}.
e.zh: 辩论结束后，此事被宣告延期审议。

e.en: He paid the small fee in {avos}.
e.zh: 他用仙支付了那笔小额费用。

e.en: One pataca equals one hundred {avos}.
e.zh: 一澳门元等于一百仙。

e.en: The king issued {avocatory} letters to recall his ambassador.
e.zh: 国王发出召回函以召回大使。

e.en: An {avocatory} order was sent immediately.
e.zh: 一道撤回令立即被送出。

e.en: An elegant {avocet} waded through the shallow water.
e.zh: 一只优雅的反嘴鹬在浅水中涉行。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted an {avocet} on the mudflat.
e.zh: 观鸟者在泥滩上发现了一只反嘴鹬。

e.en: Several {avocets} fed along the lagoon's edge.
e.zh: 几只反嘴鹬在潟湖边觅食。

e.en: The {avocets} returned to the marsh each spring.
e.zh: 反嘴鹬每年春天都会回到这片沼泽。

avogram.t: 阿伏伽德罗克（极小质量单位）

e.en: One {avogram} equals roughly one over Avogadro's number of grams.
e.zh: 一阿伏伽德罗克约等于阿伏伽德罗常数分之一克。

e.en: Physicists rarely measure mass in {avograms}.
e.zh: 物理学家很少用阿伏伽德罗克来计量质量。

e.en: Many accidents happen {avoidably} due to carelessness.
e.zh: 许多事故本可因避免疏忽而不发生。

e.en: The delay was {avoidably} caused by poor planning.
e.zh: 这场延误本可因更好的规划而避免。

e.en: He has an {avoidant} attachment style in relationships.
e.zh: 他在感情中属于回避型依恋。

e.en: She became {avoidant} whenever the topic arose.
e.zh: 每当话题出现时她就变得回避起来。

e.en: His fate seemed {avoidless} from the start.
e.zh: 他的命运从一开始就似乎无可避免。

e.en: They faced an {avoidless} confrontation.
e.zh: 他们面临着一场无法避免的对抗。

e.en: The technician checked the circuit with an {avometer}.
e.zh: 技术员用万用电表检查了电路。

e.en: An old {avometer} sat on the workbench.
e.zh: 工作台上放着一台旧式万用电表。

e.en: The vendor handed back a few {avos} in change.
e.zh: 小贩找回了几个仙作为零钱。

e.en: Coins worth ten {avos} are common here.
e.zh: 面值十仙的硬币在这里很常见。

e.en: An {avoset} probed the mud for tiny crustaceans.
e.zh: 一只反嘴鹬在泥中觅食小型甲壳动物。

e.en: Old field guides spell the bird as {avoset}.
e.zh: 旧版野外图鉴把这种鸟拼作 avoset。

e.en: His motives were entirely {avowable}.
e.zh: 他的动机完全可以公开承认。

e.en: Few of his dealings were {avowable} in court.
e.zh: 他的交易很少是能在法庭上公开承认的。

e.en: He was {avowably} on the side of reform.
e.zh: 他公然站在改革派一边。

e.en: She {avowably} supported the new policy.
e.zh: 她公开声明支持这项新政策。

e.en: The accident threatened to {avulse} the tendon from the bone.
e.zh: 这起事故有可能将肌腱从骨头上撕脱。

e.en: Storms can {avulse} entire trees from the soil.
e.zh: 风暴能把整棵树从土里连根扯出。

e.en: The dentist replanted the {avulsed} tooth.
e.zh: 牙医把脱落的牙齿重新植入。

e.en: His finger was nearly {avulsed} in the accident.
e.zh: 事故中他的手指几乎被撕脱。

e.en: The river slowly {avulses} land from one bank to the other.
e.zh: 河流慢慢地把陆地从一岸冲卷到另一岸。

e.en: A sudden jerk {avulses} the ligament.
e.zh: 突然的猛拉会把韧带撕脱。

e.en: The flood was {avulsing} chunks of riverbank.
e.zh: 洪水正撕扯着大块的河岸。

e.en: He felt the muscle {avulsing} from the bone.
e.zh: 他感到肌肉正从骨头上撕脱。

e.en: His {avuncularity} put the children at ease.
e.zh: 他叔伯般的和蔼让孩子们感到放松。

e.en: The mentor's {avuncularity} made him beloved.
e.zh: 这位导师的长辈式亲切让他广受爱戴。

aw-shucks.t: 羞怯憨厚的；故作谦逊的

e.en: He gave an {aw-shucks} grin when praised.
e.zh: 被夸奖时他露出一脸憨厚的笑容。

e.en: Her {aw-shucks} manner hid a sharp mind.
e.zh: 她那副羞怯憨厚的样子下藏着敏锐的头脑。

e.en: Poets can be powerful {awakeners} of conscience.
e.zh: 诗人可以是良知的有力唤醒者。

e.en: These books served as {awakeners} for a generation.
e.zh: 这些书是一代人的觉醒者。

e.en: The novel describes a slow spiritual {awakenment}.
e.zh: 这部小说描述了一场缓慢的精神觉醒。

e.en: Her {awakenment} came after years of doubt.
e.zh: 她在多年的怀疑之后终于醒悟。

e.en: She is an {award-winning} novelist.
e.zh: 她是一位获奖小说家。

e.en: The restaurant is famous for its {award-winning} chef.
e.zh: 这家餐厅因其屡获殊荣的主厨而闻名。

e.en: The scholarship is {awardable} to any qualified student.
e.zh: 该奖学金可授予任何符合条件的学生。

e.en: Damages are {awardable} under the contract.
e.zh: 根据合同可以判予损害赔偿。

e.en: Each {awardee} received a certificate and a medal.
e.zh: 每位获奖者都获得了证书和奖牌。

e.en: The {awardee} delivered a short acceptance speech.
e.zh: 这位获奖者发表了简短的获奖感言。

e.en: This year's {awardees} came from twelve countries.
e.zh: 今年的获奖者来自十二个国家。

e.en: The {awardees} posed together for a photograph.
e.zh: 获奖者们一起合影留念。

e.en: The {abovementioned} documents must be signed today.
e.zh: 上述文件必须今天签署。

e.en: She denied making the {abovementioned} statement.
e.zh: 她否认说过前面提到的那番话。

e.en: The trail climbed through a rocky {abra}.
e.zh: 小路穿过一个多石的狭窄山口向上延伸。

e.en: Fishing boats rested inside the quiet {abra}.
e.zh: 渔船停在宁静的小海湾里。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {abrachia}.
e.zh: 这个婴儿被诊断为先天无臂症。

e.en: Doctors discussed possible prosthetic care for {abrachia}.
e.zh: 医生讨论了先天无臂症可能需要的义肢护理。

e.en: Engineers tested the coating's {abradability} under pressure.
e.zh: 工程师测试了涂层在压力下的可磨耗性。

e.en: Low {abradability} helps the surface last longer.
e.zh: 较低的磨耗性有助于表面更耐用。

e.en: The seal uses an {abradable} material around the blade.
e.zh: 密封件在叶片周围使用可磨耗材料。

e.en: An {abradable} layer protects the harder metal beneath.
e.zh: 可磨去的表层保护下面更硬的金属。

e.en: The cleaner contains a mild {abradant}.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂含有温和的研磨剂。

e.en: Sand can act as an {abradant} in machinery.
e.zh: 沙子在机器中可能起到磨蚀物的作用。

e.en: Rough stone can {abraid} the leather quickly.
e.zh: 粗糙的石头会很快磨损皮革。

e.en: Do not {abraid} the painted surface while cleaning.
e.zh: 清洁时不要擦伤油漆表面。

e.en: The specimen showed an {abranchial} body form.
e.zh: 这个标本呈现出无鳃的体形。

e.en: Researchers described the larva as {abranchial}.
e.zh: 研究人员将这种幼体描述为缺鳃。

e.en: Some worms are {abranchiate} throughout life.
e.zh: 有些蠕虫终生没有鳃。

e.en: The {abranchiate} animal absorbs oxygen through its skin.
e.zh: 这种无鳃动物通过皮肤吸收氧气。

e.en: The label is printed on an {abrasable} coating.
e.zh: 标签印在可擦掉的涂层上。

e.en: An {abrasable} surface may wear under repeated contact.
e.zh: 可磨损的表面在反复接触下可能会损耗。

e.en: The tool can {abrase} the old paint.
e.zh: 这个工具可以磨掉旧漆。

e.en: Sand began to {abrase} the glass surface.
e.zh: 沙子开始磨损玻璃表面。

e.en: Collectors value the subtle {abrash} in the rug.
e.zh: 收藏者看重这块地毯细微的色差。

e.en: The blue field shows natural {abrash}.
e.zh: 蓝色区域呈现出自然的色泽变化。

e.en: Several {abrashes} give the carpet character.
e.zh: 几处色差让这张地毯更有个性。

e.en: The dealer pointed out the rug's {abrashes}.
e.zh: 商贩指出了地毯上的几处色泽变化。

e.en: The technician replaced the worn {abrator}.
e.zh: 技术员更换了磨损的研磨器。

e.en: An {abrator} removes the rough outer layer.
e.zh: 研磨工具会去掉粗糙的外层。

e.en: The sudden bell did {abray} the sleeping guard.
e.zh: 突响的铃声惊醒了睡着的守卫。

e.en: Old poems say dawn can {abray} the soul.
e.zh: 古诗中说黎明能唤醒灵魂。

e.en: He greeted his uncle with an {abrazo}.
e.zh: 他用一个拥抱问候叔叔。

e.en: The dancers ended with a formal {abrazo}.
e.zh: 舞者以一个正式的拉美式拥抱收尾。

e.en: The reunion was full of {abrazos}.
e.zh: 重逢时大家不断拥抱。

e.en: They exchanged quick {abrazos} after the dance.
e.zh: 舞后他们互相短暂拥抱。

e.en: Therapy helped her {abreact} the old fear.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她宣泄了旧日恐惧。

e.en: He began to {abreact} during the session.
e.zh: 他在治疗过程中开始释放情绪。

e.en: She {abreacted} years of buried anger.
e.zh: 她宣泄了多年埋藏的愤怒。

e.en: The patient {abreacted} after recalling the accident.
e.zh: 病人回忆事故后释放了压抑情绪。

e.en: He was {abreacting} painful childhood memories.
e.zh: 他正在宣泄童年痛苦记忆带来的情绪。

e.en: The therapist stayed calm while she was {abreacting}.
e.zh: 她宣泄情绪时，治疗师保持冷静。

e.en: The session produced a powerful {abreaction}.
e.zh: 那次治疗引发了强烈的情绪宣泄。

e.en: Freud discussed {abreaction} in early psychoanalysis.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德在早期精神分析中谈到过情绪释放。

e.en: The doctor used an {abreactive} method cautiously.
e.zh: 医生谨慎地使用了一种情绪宣泄疗法。

e.en: His {abreactive} response surprised the group.
e.zh: 他的宣泄性反应让小组很意外。

e.en: She {abreacts} when the memory returns.
e.zh: 那段记忆浮现时，她会宣泄情绪。

e.en: The patient {abreacts} more easily under hypnosis.
e.zh: 病人在催眠下更容易释放压抑情绪。

e.en: The archaeologists found tools in the {abri}.
e.zh: 考古学家在岩棚住处发现了工具。

e.en: A shallow {abri} sheltered the hunters.
e.zh: 一个浅岩厦庇护了猎人。

e.en: The recipe calls it an {abricock}, not an apricot.
e.zh: 这份食谱称它为旧称abricock，而不是apricot。

e.en: An {abricock} tree grew by the wall.
e.zh: 墙边长着一棵杏树。

e.en: She served {abricotine} after dinner.
e.zh: 她饭后端上了杏味利口酒。

e.en: The cake was scented with {abricotine}.
e.zh: 蛋糕带着杏味利口酒的香气。

e.en: The editor marked the chapter as {abridgable}.
e.zh: 编辑把这一章标为可删节。

e.en: Only the final report was {abridgable}.
e.zh: 只有最终报告可以缩写。

e.en: {Abrin} is a highly poisonous plant toxin.
e.zh: 相思豆毒蛋白是一种剧毒植物毒素。

e.en: The lab tested the sample for {abrin}.
e.zh: 实验室检测样本中是否含有相思豆毒蛋白。

abrine.t: 相思豆中的有毒物质；阿布林碱

e.en: The chemist tested the sample for {abrine}.
e.zh: 化学师检测样本中是否含有阿布林碱。

e.en: Old toxicology texts sometimes mention {abrine}.
e.zh: 旧的毒理学文献有时会提到阿布林碱。

e.en: The innkeeper set the ale {abroach}.
e.zh: 店主开桶取用了麦酒。

e.en: Once the question was {abroach}, everyone argued.
e.zh: 这个问题一提出来，大家就争论起来。

e.en: The slide was {achromatized} before inspection.
e.zh: 载玻片在检查前被去色处理。

e.en: The lens was carefully {achromatized}.
e.zh: 这个镜头经过仔细校正以消除色差。

e.en: The fracture involved the {acromion}.
e.zh: 骨折涉及肩峰部位。

e.en: He felt pain near his {acromion}.
e.zh: 他感觉肩峰附近疼痛。

actinal.t: 口面的；靠近放射中心的

e.en: The starfish moved its {actinal} surface downward.
e.zh: 海星把口面朝下移动。

e.en: Researchers examined the {actinal} plates closely.
e.zh: 研究人员仔细检查了口面板片。

e.en: The patient developed {adiaphoresis} after nerve damage.
e.zh: 患者神经受损后出现无汗症。

e.en: Severe {adiaphoresis} can affect body temperature.
e.zh: 严重无汗症会影响体温。

e.en: They exchanged their {adieux} at dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明时互相道别。

e.en: The novel ends with quiet {adieux}.
e.zh: 这部小说以平静的告别收尾。

e.en: Thousands attended the weekend {aeroshow}.
e.zh: 数千人参加了周末的航空表演。

e.en: The {aeroshow} featured vintage fighter planes.
e.zh: 这场飞行展展出了老式战斗机。

e.en: The museum displayed a polished {aerosiderite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块抛光的铁陨石。

e.en: Scientists classified the fragment as {aerosiderite}.
e.zh: 科学家把这块碎片归类为铁陨石。

e.en: The {aerosiderolite} contained both metal and silicate.
e.zh: 这块石铁陨石同时含有金属和硅酸盐。

e.en: Collectors value a well-cut {aerosiderolite}.
e.zh: 收藏者看重切割良好的石铁陨石。

aerosinusitis.t: 航空性鼻窦炎；气压性鼻窦痛

e.en: The pilot reported {aerosinusitis} after descent.
e.zh: 飞行员在下降后报告出现航空性鼻窦炎。

e.en: A cold can make {aerosinusitis} more likely.
e.zh: 感冒会增加气压性鼻窦痛的可能性。

aerosis.t: 体内积气；气体异常增多

e.en: The scan suggested intestinal {aerosis}.
e.zh: 扫描提示肠道内气体异常增多。

e.en: Doctors monitored the infant for {aerosis}.
e.zh: 医生监测婴儿是否出现体内积气。

e.en: The farmer found a dark {aerosite} in the field.
e.zh: 农民在田里发现了一块深色陨石。

e.en: An {aerosite} may preserve early solar material.
e.zh: 陨石可能保存早期太阳系物质。

e.en: The device can {aerosolise} the medication.
e.zh: 这个装置能把药物雾化。

e.en: Coughing may {aerosolise} tiny droplets.
e.zh: 咳嗽可能使微小飞沫气溶胶化。

e.en: The sprayer will {aerosolize} the disinfectant.
e.zh: 喷雾器会把消毒剂雾化。

e.en: Certain procedures can {aerosolize} infectious particles.
e.zh: 某些操作可能使感染性颗粒气溶胶化。

aerosoloscope.t: 气溶胶检测仪；气溶胶观察器

e.en: The lab calibrated the {aerosoloscope} before testing.
e.zh: 实验室在测试前校准了气溶胶检测仪。

e.en: An {aerosoloscope} helped measure airborne particles.
e.zh: 气溶胶检测仪帮助测量空气中的颗粒。

aerosonator.t: 气声共鸣器；空气声发生器

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {aerosonator} carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细调节了气声共鸣器。

e.en: A small {aerosonator} produced a steady tone.
e.zh: 一个小型空气声发生器发出稳定的声音。

e.en: She works in the {aerospace-industry} supply chain.
e.zh: 她在航空航天产业供应链工作。

e.en: The {aerospace-industry} needs highly precise parts.
e.zh: 航空航天产业需要高精度零部件。

e.en: The prototype {aerospacecraft} reached the upper atmosphere.
e.zh: 这架原型航空航天飞行器到达了高层大气。

e.en: Engineers designed the {aerospacecraft} for runway launches.
e.zh: 工程师把这款航空航天飞行器设计为可从跑道起飞。

e.en: Dust spread through the lower {aerosphere}.
e.zh: 尘埃扩散到低层大气中。

e.en: The model treats the {aerosphere} as layered.
e.zh: 这个模型把大气层视为分层结构。

e.en: The farmer used an {aerosprayer} over the fields.
e.zh: 农民在田地上方使用航空喷雾器。

e.en: A clogged {aerosprayer} can waste pesticide quickly.
e.zh: 堵塞的喷药机会很快浪费农药。

e.en: The balloon depends on {aerostatic} lift.
e.zh: 气球依靠空气静力升力。

e.en: Engineers tested the craft's {aerostatic} stability.
e.zh: 工程师测试了飞行器的浮空稳定性。

e.en: The old paper used the term {aerostatical} pressure.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文使用了空气静力压力这个说法。

e.en: An {aerostatical} machine was proposed for flight.
e.zh: 有人提出用浮空装置来飞行。

e.en: She studied {aerostatics} before designing balloons.
e.zh: 她在设计气球前研究了空气静力学。

e.en: Early flight experiments relied on {aerostatics}.
e.zh: 早期飞行实验依赖浮空学。

e.en: Victorian writers were fascinated by {aerostation}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的作家对气球飞行很着迷。

e.en: The museum has a gallery on {aerostation}.
e.zh: 博物馆有一个关于浮空术的展厅。

e.en: The wing is a critical {aerostructure}.
e.zh: 机翼是关键的飞机结构件。

e.en: The company supplies composite {aerostructures} to manufacturers.
e.zh: 这家公司向制造商供应复合材料航空结构件。

e.en: The team completed an {aerosurvey} of the coastline.
e.zh: 团队完成了海岸线的航空测量。

e.en: An {aerosurvey} revealed hidden drainage channels.
e.zh: 一次空中勘测发现了隐藏的排水沟。

e.en: The bacteria showed an {aerotactic} response.
e.zh: 这些细菌表现出趋氧反应。

e.en: Scientists measured {aerotactic} movement under the microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下测量趋氧性运动。

e.en: {Aerotaxis} helps microbes find oxygen-rich areas.
e.zh: 趋氧性帮助微生物找到富氧区域。

e.en: The experiment tracked {aerotaxis} in a thin fluid layer.
e.zh: 实验追踪了薄液层中的趋氧性。

e.en: Nineteenth-century clinics promoted {aerotherapeutics}.
e.zh: 十九世纪的诊所推广空气疗法。

e.en: The book discusses {aerotherapeutics} for lung disease.
e.zh: 这本书讨论了用于肺病的空气治疗学。

e.en: The patient was sent to the mountains for {aerotherapy}.
e.zh: 病人被送到山里接受空气疗法。

e.en: Modern doctors rarely prescribe {aerotherapy} alone.
e.zh: 现代医生很少单独开空气疗法。

e.en: An {aerothermochemist} analyzed the reentry gases.
e.zh: 一名航空热化学家分析了再入气体。

e.en: The lab hired an {aerothermochemist} for engine research.
e.zh: 实验室聘请了一名航空热化学家研究发动机。

e.en: The capsule faced severe {aerothermodynamic} heating.
e.zh: 太空舱面临严重的气动热加热。

e.en: They built an {aerothermodynamic} model of the missile.
e.zh: 他们建立了导弹的气动热力学模型。

e.en: {Aerothermodynamics} is vital in spacecraft design.
e.zh: 气动热力学对航天器设计至关重要。

e.en: The course covers hypersonic {aerothermodynamics}.
e.zh: 这门课讲授高超声速气动热力学。

e.en: {Aerothermoelasticity} affects panels at hypersonic speeds.
e.zh: 气动热弹性会影响高超声速下的面板。

e.en: The simulation included structural {aerothermoelasticity}.
e.zh: 仿真纳入了结构气动热弹性。

e.en: The plant tested a small {aerothermopressor}.
e.zh: 工厂测试了一台小型空气热压缩器。

e.en: An {aerothermopressor} uses heat to raise air pressure.
e.zh: 空气热压缩器利用热量提高空气压力。

e.en: The mechanic inspected each {aerotire} carefully.
e.zh: 机械师仔细检查了每个航空轮胎。

e.en: A damaged {aerotire} can delay the flight.
e.zh: 受损的航空轮胎可能会延误航班。

e.en: The researcher calibrated the {aerotonometer} before testing.
e.zh: 研究人员在测试前校准了空气张力计。

e.en: An {aerotonometer} measured the gas tension in the sample.
e.zh: 空气张力计测量了样本中的气体张力。

e.en: The glider launched by {aerotow} at noon.
e.zh: 滑翔机中午由飞机拖曳起飞。

e.en: A smooth {aerotow} requires careful coordination.
e.zh: 平稳的飞机拖曳需要细致配合。

e.en: France tested an {aerotrain} in the 1960s.
e.zh: 法国在二十世纪六十年代测试过气垫列车。

e.en: The proposed {aerotrain} promised very high speeds.
e.zh: 拟议中的气垫列车号称速度极高。

e.en: Remote villages depend on {aerotransport} for supplies.
e.zh: 偏远村庄依靠航空运输获得补给。

e.en: The army expanded {aerotransport} during the crisis.
e.zh: 军队在危机期间扩大了空运能力。

e.en: The survey team calibrated the {aerotriangulator} before mapping the valley.
e.zh: 测绘队在绘制山谷地图前校准了航空三角测量仪。

e.en: An old {aerotriangulator} sat beside the photogrammetry charts.
e.zh: 一台旧航空三角测量仪放在摄影测量图旁边。

e.en: The roots showed an {aerotropic} response in the dry soil.
e.zh: 根在干燥土壤中表现出向空气生长的反应。

e.en: Researchers measured the {aerotropic} movement of the fungal threads.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了真菌菌丝的向空气性运动。

e.en: The experiment demonstrated {aerotropism} in the plant roots.
e.zh: 实验显示了植物根部的向气性。

e.en: Some microorganisms rely on {aerotropism} to find oxygen-rich areas.
e.zh: 一些微生物依靠趋气性寻找富氧区域。

e.en: The prototype used an {aeroturbine} to drive the small generator.
e.zh: 原型机用空气涡轮机带动小型发电机。

e.en: Engineers tested the {aeroturbine} under changing wind pressure.
e.zh: 工程师在变化的风压下测试了空气涡轮机。

e.en: The brochure included an {aeroview} of the coastal resort.
e.zh: 宣传册里有一张海滨度假村的空中视图。

e.en: From the drone's {aeroview}, the roads formed a clear grid.
e.zh: 从无人机的航拍视角看，道路形成了清晰的网格。

e.en: The astronaut waited inside the {air-lock} before stepping outside.
e.zh: 宇航员走出舱外前在气闸里等待。

e.en: An {air-lock} in the pipe stopped the water from flowing.
e.zh: 管道里的气塞阻止了水流动。

e.en: The court imposed an {amercement} for the minor offense.
e.zh: 法院对这项轻罪处以罚款。

e.en: Medieval records list each villager's {amercement} after the dispute.
e.zh: 中世纪记录列出了纠纷后每个村民的罚金。

e.en: The doctor noted an {amygdaloid} mass on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描图上注意到一个杏仁状肿块。

e.en: The cliff contained dark {amygdaloid} formed by ancient lava.
e.zh: 悬崖中含有古熔岩形成的深色杏仁岩。

e.en: The warehouse installed an {anti-fire} door near the exit.
e.zh: 仓库在出口附近安装了一扇防火门。

e.en: Workers checked the {anti-fire} equipment every morning.
e.zh: 工人每天早上检查灭火设备。

anti-fouling.t: 防污的；防海生物附着的

e.en: The boat needed fresh {anti-fouling} paint before summer.
e.zh: 这艘船夏天前需要重新刷防污漆。

e.en: Scientists tested an {anti-fouling} coating on underwater sensors.
e.zh: 科学家在水下传感器上测试了一种防附着涂层。

e.en: Soldiers carried {anti-gas} masks during the drill.
e.zh: 士兵在演习中携带防毒气面具。

e.en: The mine added {anti-gas} alarms after the accident.
e.zh: 矿井事故后增设了防瓦斯警报器。

e.en: The province launched an {anti-illiteracy} campaign in rural schools.
e.zh: 该省在乡村学校发起了扫盲运动。

e.en: Her {anti-illiteracy} work focused on adult women.
e.zh: 她的扫盲工作主要面向成年女性。

e.en: The signal traveled {antidromically} along the nerve fiber.
e.zh: 信号沿神经纤维逆向传导。

e.en: The researchers stimulated the axon {antidromically} during the test.
e.zh: 研究人员在测试中逆向刺激了轴突。

e.en: The skeleton's {appendicular} bones include the arms and legs.
e.zh: 骨骼中的附肢骨包括手臂和腿。

e.en: The patient complained of {appendicular} pain in the lower abdomen.
e.zh: 患者诉说下腹部阑尾区域疼痛。

e.en: The committee was {appetent} for quick political gains.
e.zh: 委员会渴望迅速获得政治利益。

e.en: His {appetent} mind absorbed every new theory.
e.zh: 他求知若渴的头脑吸收着每一种新理论。

e.en: He tried to {apple-polish} the manager before reviews.
e.zh: 他在绩效评审前试图讨好经理。

e.en: Her classmates disliked his obvious {apple-polish} in class.
e.zh: 同学们不喜欢他在课堂上明显的拍马屁行为。

e.en: The patient reported severe {arthrodynia} after the infection.
e.zh: 患者报告感染后出现严重关节痛。

e.en: Chronic {arthrodynia} made climbing stairs difficult for her.
e.zh: 慢性关节痛让她上楼变得困难。

arthromeric.t: 节肢体节的；关节节段的

e.en: The specimen showed an {arthromeric} pattern under the microscope.
e.zh: 标本在显微镜下呈现出节肢体节样结构。

e.en: Researchers compared the {arthromeric} segments across related species.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了相关物种的关节节段。

e.en: The table shows remarkable {artisanship} in every detail.
e.zh: 这张桌子的每个细节都体现出精湛手艺。

e.en: Good {artisanship} can make a simple object feel special.
e.zh: 好的工匠技艺能让简单物件显得特别。

e.en: She earns money by {audiotyping} interviews for lawyers.
e.zh: 她靠给律师转写访谈录音赚钱。

e.en: Accurate {audiotyping} requires patience and sharp listening.
e.zh: 准确的音频转写需要耐心和敏锐的听力。

e.en: The note was {autographically} signed by the author.
e.zh: 这张便条由作者亲笔签名。

e.en: The manuscript survives {autographically}, not as a later copy.
e.zh: 这份手稿以作者亲笔原稿形式留存，并非后来的抄本。

averroist.t: 阿威罗伊主义者；其学说的

e.en: The scholar defended an {Averroist} reading of Aristotle.
e.zh: 这位学者维护对亚里士多德的阿威罗伊主义解读。

e.en: An {Averroist} might separate philosophical truth from religious doctrine.
e.zh: 阿威罗伊主义者可能会把哲学真理与宗教教义区分开。

e.en: The crash was {avertable} with better maintenance.
e.zh: 如果维护更好，这场事故本可避免。

e.en: Officials called the shortage an {avertable} crisis.
e.zh: 官员称这次短缺是一场可防止的危机。

e.en: Her {avertence} to conflict made negotiations difficult.
e.zh: 她对冲突的回避让谈判变得困难。

e.en: The study measured children's {avertence} to bitter flavors.
e.zh: 这项研究测量儿童对苦味的厌避倾向。

e.en: Many infections are {avertible} through basic hygiene.
e.zh: 许多感染可以通过基本卫生措施避免。

e.en: The report described the loss as entirely {avertible}.
e.zh: 报告称这次损失完全可以避免。

e.en: The small plane needed more {avgas} before takeoff.
e.zh: 那架小飞机起飞前需要加更多航空汽油。

e.en: Rising {avgas} prices hurt many flight schools.
e.zh: 航空汽油价格上涨影响了许多飞行学校。

e.en: Scientists tried to {avianize} the virus in laboratory eggs.
e.zh: 科学家试图在实验室鸡蛋中使这种病毒适应鸟类。

e.en: The artist chose to {avianize} the mask with feathers and a beak.
e.zh: 艺术家选择用羽毛和鸟喙让面具呈现鸟类特征。

avianized.t: 已禽化的；已适应鸟类的

e.en: The vaccine used an {avianized} strain of the virus.
e.zh: 这种疫苗使用了一种已适应鸟类的病毒株。

e.en: The costume looked deliberately {avianized} with winglike sleeves.
e.zh: 这套服装用像翅膀的袖子刻意做出鸟类化效果。

aviarist.t: 鸟类饲养者；鸟舍管理员

e.en: The {aviarist} checked each cage before sunrise.
e.zh: 鸟类饲养者在日出前检查了每个笼子。

e.en: An experienced {aviarist} can spot illness very early.
e.zh: 有经验的鸟舍管理员能很早发现疾病。

e.en: Cadets learn to {aviate} before studying navigation.
e.zh: 学员先学习驾驶飞机，再学习导航。

e.en: In an emergency, pilots are taught to {aviate} first.
e.zh: 遇到紧急情况时，飞行员被教导要先控制飞行。

e.en: She {aviated} across the desert in a small aircraft.
e.zh: 她驾驶一架小飞机飞越沙漠。

e.en: The trainee {aviated} calmly despite the warning light.
e.zh: 尽管警示灯亮起，受训者仍冷静地操纵飞机。

e.en: He {aviates} for a regional airline.
e.zh: 他为一家地区航空公司驾驶飞机。

e.en: The pilot {aviates} while the copilot handles radios.
e.zh: 飞行员操纵飞机，副驾驶负责无线电。

e.en: She was {aviating} through heavy cloud cover.
e.zh: 她正驾驶飞机穿过厚厚的云层。

e.en: During training, {aviating} comes before communicating.
e.zh: 训练中，控制飞行先于通信。

e.en: The strain's {avirulence} made it useful in vaccine research.
e.zh: 这种菌株的无毒力使它适用于疫苗研究。

e.en: Researchers measured {avirulence} after weakening the virus.
e.zh: 研究人员在削弱病毒后测量其不致病性。

e.en: The lab used an {avirulent} strain for training.
e.zh: 实验室用一种无毒力菌株进行培训。

e.en: An {avirulent} virus may still trigger immunity.
e.zh: 不致病的病毒仍可能激发免疫反应。

e.en: The old scale used {avoirdupois} weights.
e.zh: 这台旧秤使用常衡制砝码。

e.en: He joked about his increasing {avoirdupois}.
e.zh: 他拿自己越来越重的体重开玩笑。

e.en: One signature was still {awanting} from the form.
e.zh: 表格上仍缺少一个签名。

e.en: The old account left several details {awanting}.
e.zh: 那份旧叙述遗漏了几个细节。

e.en: Please send the report to the {above-mentioned} address.
e.zh: 请把报告寄到上述地址。

e.en: The {above-mentioned} rules apply to all visitors.
e.zh: 前面提到的规定适用于所有访客。

e.en: The pipes need an {anti-freezing} coating before winter.
e.zh: 入冬前这些管道需要防冻涂层。

e.en: This {anti-freezing} additive protects the engine in cold weather.
e.zh: 这种防冻添加剂能在寒冷天气保护发动机。

e.en: The court called the decree {anticonstitutional}.
e.zh: 法院称这项法令违反宪法。

e.en: Critics saw the proposal as {anticonstitutional} and dangerous.
e.zh: 批评者认为该提案反宪政且很危险。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {antifebrile} medicine for the child.
e.zh: 医生给孩子开了退烧药。

e.en: Willow bark was once used for its {antifebrile} effect.
e.zh: 柳树皮曾因其解热作用而被使用。

e.en: The insect's wings were {appressed} against its body.
e.zh: 那只昆虫的翅膀紧贴着身体。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {appressed} hairs.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物贴伏的茸毛。

e.en: Take the pain medicine on an {as-needed} basis.
e.zh: 止痛药按需要服用即可。

e.en: We hire extra staff {as-needed} during busy seasons.
e.zh: 旺季时我们会按需增聘员工。

e.en: The young {aviatress} crossed the channel alone.
e.zh: 那位年轻女飞行员独自飞越了海峡。

e.en: Newspapers praised the daring {aviatress} after her record flight.
e.zh: 她创纪录飞行后，报纸称赞这位大胆的女飞行员。

e.en: Several {aviatrices} competed in the early air race.
e.zh: 几位女飞行员参加了早期的空中竞赛。

e.en: The museum honors pioneering {aviatrices} from many countries.
e.zh: 这座博物馆纪念来自多国的女飞行先驱。

e.en: The famous {aviatrix} became a symbol of courage.
e.zh: 那位著名女飞行员成了勇气的象征。

e.en: She trained as an {aviatrix} before the war.
e.zh: 战前她受训成为女飞行员。

e.en: Early {aviatrixes} often flew unreliable machines.
e.zh: 早期女飞行员常驾驶并不可靠的飞机。

e.en: The book profiles several forgotten {aviatrixes}.
e.zh: 这本书介绍了几位被遗忘的女飞行员。

e.en: The lab measured {avicelase} activity in the fungal sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了真菌样本中的微晶纤维素酶活性。

e.en: High {avicelase} production can improve cellulose breakdown.
e.zh: 较高的微晶纤维素酶产量可改善纤维素分解。

e.en: The mineral sample was identified as {avicennite}.
e.zh: 这份矿物样本被鉴定为avicennite矿物。

e.en: Tiny grains of {avicennite} appeared under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下出现了细小的avicennite矿物颗粒。

e.en: The researcher studied an {avicolous} mite species.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了一种寄生于鸟类的螨类。

e.en: Some {avicolous} insects live only in nests.
e.zh: 有些鸟栖昆虫只生活在鸟巢里。

e.en: Her interest in {aviculture} began with parrots.
e.zh: 她对鸟类饲养的兴趣始于鹦鹉。

e.en: Modern {aviculture} emphasizes habitat and diet.
e.zh: 现代养鸟业重视栖息环境和饮食。

e.en: The {aviculturist} designed a spacious aviary.
e.zh: 这位养鸟专家设计了一个宽敞的鸟舍。

e.en: An experienced {aviculturist} can recognize stress in birds.
e.zh: 有经验的养鸟者能看出鸟类的压力反应。

e.en: Egg whites contain {avidin}, which binds biotin.
e.zh: 蛋清含有会结合生物素的抗生物素蛋白。

e.en: Researchers used {avidin} in the labeling experiment.
e.zh: 研究人员在标记实验中使用了抗生物素蛋白。

e.en: The inventor tested his fragile {aviette} at dawn.
e.zh: 发明者在黎明测试了那架脆弱的小型飞机。

e.en: An {aviette} was displayed beside larger aircraft.
e.zh: 一架轻型飞机陈列在较大的飞机旁边。

e.en: The island's {avifauna} includes several rare species.
e.zh: 这座岛的鸟类区系包括几种稀有物种。

e.en: Pollution has changed the local {avifauna}.
e.zh: 污染已经改变了当地鸟类组成。

e.en: The survey recorded major {avifaunal} changes.
e.zh: 这项调查记录了鸟类区系的重大变化。

e.en: They compared {avifaunal} diversity across three wetlands.
e.zh: 他们比较了三个湿地的鸟类多样性。

e.en: The paper provides an {avifaunistic} account of the valley.
e.zh: 这篇论文对该山谷作了鸟类区系研究说明。

e.en: Her {avifaunistic} notes were valuable to conservationists.
e.zh: 她的鸟类区系研究笔记对保护人士很有价值。

e.en: Early pilots relied on simple {avigation} instruments.
e.zh: 早期飞行员依靠简单的航空导航仪器。

e.en: The lecture covered the history of {avigation}.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了空中航行的发展史。

e.en: The {avigator} checked the route before takeoff.
e.zh: 飞行导航员在起飞前检查了航线。

e.en: A skilled {avigator} was essential on long flights.
e.zh: 长途飞行中熟练的飞行导航员至关重要。

avigraph.t: 航空记录仪；飞行记录图

e.en: The engineer examined the {avigraph} after landing.
e.zh: 着陆后工程师检查了航空记录仪。

e.en: An old {avigraph} traced the aircraft's altitude changes.
e.zh: 一台旧飞行记录仪描绘了飞机高度变化。

e.en: The factory produced {avio} parts for small aircraft.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产小型飞机的航空零件。

e.en: He worked in the {avio} industry for decades.
e.zh: 他在航空工业工作了几十年。

e.en: The collector labeled the pale mineral as {aviolite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把那块浅色矿物标为aviolite。

e.en: A trace of {aviolite} appeared in the rock sample.
e.zh: 岩石样本中出现了少量aviolite。

e.en: The company announced {across-the-board} pay cuts.
e.zh: 公司宣布全面降薪。

e.en: Teachers demanded an {across-the-board} review of the policy.
e.zh: 教师们要求对这项政策进行全面审查。
